title_zh: Great conversation with @chamath, @jason, @davidsacks, and @friedberg on all the work ahead when it comes to diffusing benefits of AI broadly, earning permissio
summary_en: Nadella discussed diffusing AI's benefits broadly, earning communities' trust, and AI safety in a conversation with the All-In podcast hosts.
summary_zh: Nadella在与All-In播客主持人的对谈中，讨论了如何广泛普及AI红利、赢得社区信任以及AI安全问题。

source: All-In with Chamath, Jason, Sacks & Fr…
title_en: Satya Nadella on the AI Doomer Slowdown, Microsoft's Master Plan & Who Wins AI
title_zh: Satya Nadella on the AI Doomer Slowdown, Microsoft's Master Plan & Who Wins AI
summary_en: Nadella joined the All-In podcast to discuss the AI doomer slowdown debate and lay out Microsoft's AI strategy.
summary_zh: 纳德拉做客All-In播客，谈论AI末日减速之争，并阐述了微软的AI战略规划。

title_en: Great example from @jeffhollan showing how Foundry makes long-running agents enterprise-ready, starting with business outcomes and building security, safety gua
title_zh: Great example from @jeffhollan showing how Foundry makes long-running agents enterprise-ready, starting with business outcomes and building security, safety gua
summary_en: Nadella highlighted a Microsoft Foundry example of long-running enterprise agents built with security, safety guardrails, auditability and FinOps from the start.
summary_zh: 纳德拉展示了微软Foundry的一个案例：从一开始就将安全防护、可审计性和FinOps融入企业级长时运行智能体。

title_en: Any pursuit of superintelligence has to be grounded in the core principle that if the AI we build is not helping humanity and under human control, it's not wort
title_zh: Any pursuit of superintelligence has to be grounded in the core principle that if the AI we build is not helping humanity and under human control, it's not wort
summary_en: Nadella argued that any pursuit of superintelligence must stay grounded in human control and benefit to humanity, a stance that drew strong engagement (84k views).
summary_zh: 纳德拉表示，对超级智能的追求必须始终以人类控制和人类福祉为前提，这一立场获得了很高的关注度（8.4万次浏览）。

title_en: Quincy, Washington shows what’s possible when you build datacenters with communities, and grow together over time.
title_zh: Quincy, Washington shows what’s possible when you build datacenters with communities, and grow together over time.
summary_en: Nadella pointed to Microsoft's Quincy, Washington datacenter as a model for building AI infrastructure in partnership with local communities.
summary_zh: 纳德拉以微软位于华盛顿州昆西的数据中心为例，阐述与当地社区合作共建AI基础设施的模式。

title_en: More model choice coming to Copilot. Welcome Grok!
title_zh: More model choice coming to Copilot. Welcome Grok!
summary_en: Nadella announced that Grok is joining Copilot's model lineup, adding a rival lab's model to Microsoft's AI product.
summary_zh: 纳德拉宣布Grok加入Copilot的模型阵容，将一家竞争对手实验室的模型纳入微软的AI产品中。

title_en: This first-of-a-kind agreement will set a new standard for safe and responsible AI use in schools. We are making these protections available to every school dis
title_zh: This first-of-a-kind agreement will set a new standard for safe and responsible AI use in schools. We are making these protections available to every school dis
summary_en: Nadella announced a new agreement setting AI safety standards for schools, with the protections extended to every school district in the US.
summary_zh: Nadella宣布了一项为学校设立AI安全标准的新协议，相关保护措施将推广至美国所有学区。

title_en: It was a great week for innovation across the model ecosystem. We're bringing these new models into Copilot, enabling it to take on increasingly complex work, f
title_zh: It was a great week for innovation across the model ecosystem. We're bringing these new models into Copilot, enabling it to take on increasingly complex work, f
summary_en: Nadella touts a strong week of model releases, saying Microsoft is bringing the new models into Copilot for increasingly complex, delegated work.
summary_zh: Nadella称本周模型发布成果丰硕,微软正将新模型引入Copilot,使其能承担更复杂、可委托的任务。

title_en: Super excited about HydraFusion in GitHub Copilot, and what it shows about the shift from model selection to model orchestration. By bringing together multiple
title_zh: Super excited about HydraFusion in GitHub Copilot, and what it shows about the shift from model selection to model orchestration. By bringing together multiple
summary_en: Highlighted HydraFusion in GitHub Copilot as a shift from model selection to model orchestration across multiple models working together.
summary_zh: 强调GitHub Copilot中的HydraFusion标志着从单一模型选择转向多模型协同编排。

title_en: Excited to see early customers already using Astra on Azure! https://t.co/BeaR66ZL0G
title_zh: Excited to see early customers already using Astra on Azure! https://t.co/BeaR66ZL0G
summary_en: Said early customers are already using OpenAI's Astra model on Azure.
summary_zh: 表示已有早期客户在Azure上使用OpenAI的Astra模型。

title_en: Looking forward to this ecosystem with open models continuing to flourish and grow with NVIDIA and Hugging Face, and the continued partnership. Congrats @Jensen
title_zh: Looking forward to this ecosystem with open models continuing to flourish and grow with NVIDIA and Hugging Face, and the continued partnership. Congrats @Jensen
summary_en: Congratulated Jensen Huang and Clement Delangue, saying he's looking forward to the open-model ecosystem continuing to flourish through Microsoft's partnerships with NVIDIA and Hugging Face.
summary_zh: 他向黄仁勋和 Clement Delangue 表示祝贺，并称期待微软与英伟达、Hugging Face 的合作持续推动开源模型生态繁荣发展。

title_en: Delivery day at our Microsoft DCs as the first production Vera Rubins arrive. A huge thank you to our partners at @nvidia and our Azure hardware and datacenter
title_zh: Delivery day at our Microsoft DCs as the first production Vera Rubins arrive. A huge thank you to our partners at @nvidia and our Azure hardware and datacenter
summary_en: Nadella marked the arrival of the first production NVIDIA Vera Rubin systems at Microsoft data centers, thanking NVIDIA and Azure hardware teams.
summary_zh: 纳德拉宣布首批量产NVIDIA Vera Rubin系统抵达微软数据中心,并感谢英伟达和Azure硬件团队。

title_en: Some more detail on the ROIC Intelligence App I built yesterday and mentioned on today's earnings call. I took the PDF that Brian Nowak at Morgan Stanley put to
title_zh: Some more detail on the ROIC Intelligence App I built yesterday and mentioned on today's earnings call. I took the PDF that Brian Nowak at Morgan Stanley put to
summary_en: Nadella detailed the ROIC Intelligence App he built using a Morgan Stanley analyst's hyperscaler ROIC data, which he had mentioned on Microsoft's earnings call.
summary_zh: 纳德拉详细介绍了他利用摩根士丹利分析师的超大规模云厂商ROIC数据构建的ROIC Intelligence应用,此前他曾在财报电话会议中提及此事。

title_en: Just wrapped our earnings call. It was a very strong close to what was a record fiscal year for Microsoft. · Annual revenue: $331B, +18% · MS Cloud: $214B, + 27
title_zh: Just wrapped our earnings call. It was a very strong close to what was a record fiscal year for Microsoft. · Annual revenue: $331B, +18% · MS Cloud: $214B, + 27
summary_en: Nadella summarized Microsoft's FY2026 earnings call, citing $331B annual revenue (+18%), $214B Microsoft Cloud revenue (+27%) and $100B Azure revenue (+41%).
summary_zh: 纳德拉总结了微软2026财年财报电话会议,称年收入达3310亿美元(+18%)、微软云收入2140亿美元(+27%)、Azure收入1000亿美元(+41%)。

title_en: A good read from Mark. Establishing a frontier ecosystem that empowers people and orgs everywhere is what we collectively need to build together.
title_zh: A good read from Mark. Establishing a frontier ecosystem that empowers people and orgs everywhere is what we collectively need to build together.
summary_en: Nadella endorsed Mark Zuckerberg's essay, agreeing the industry needs to collectively build a frontier AI ecosystem that empowers people and organizations.
summary_zh: 纳德拉认可马克·扎克伯格的文章,赞同业界需要共同构建一个赋能个人与组织的前沿AI生态系统。

title_en: Today, we are announcing a series of updates that give customers frontier-grade security at half the cost. MAI-Cyber-1-Flash is our first cybersecurity model, b
title_zh: Today, we are announcing a series of updates that give customers frontier-grade security at half the cost. MAI-Cyber-1-Flash is our first cybersecurity model, b
summary_en: Nadella announced MAI-Cyber-1-Flash, Microsoft's first in-house cybersecurity model, alongside updates giving customers frontier-grade security at lower cost.
summary_zh: 纳德拉宣布推出微软首个自研网络安全模型MAI-Cyber-1-Flash,并公布了以更低成本提供顶尖安全能力的相关更新。

title_en: Open-weight models are essential to a healthy AI ecosystem. Together with others across our industry, we are outlining a path for open-weight models to strength
title_zh: Open-weight models are essential to a healthy AI ecosystem. Together with others across our industry, we are outlining a path for open-weight models to strength
summary_en: Nadella argued open-weight models are essential to a healthy AI ecosystem and outlined a path for them to strengthen U.S. competitiveness.
summary_zh: 纳德拉表示开放权重模型对健康的AI生态系统至关重要,并提出了借助开放权重模型增强美国竞争力的路径。

title_en: Really excited about our expanded partnership with @MistralAI, which is all about bringing customers more choice in how and where they deploy AI!
title_zh: Really excited about our expanded partnership with @MistralAI, which is all about bringing customers more choice in how and where they deploy AI!
summary_en: Nadella announced an expanded partnership with Mistral AI aimed at giving customers more choice in how and where they deploy AI.
summary_zh: 纳德拉宣布与Mistral AI扩大合作,旨在为客户提供更多AI部署方式和位置上的选择。

title_en: An important piece from Demis. We need more of this kind of thinking. A good reminder that the goal is a frontier ecosystem that promotes innovation and choice,
title_zh: An important piece from Demis. We need more of this kind of thinking. A good reminder that the goal is a frontier ecosystem that promotes innovation and choice,
summary_en: Nadella endorsed a piece by Demis Hassabis, agreeing the goal should be a frontier AI ecosystem that promotes innovation and choice rather than one model dominating.
summary_zh: 纳德拉认可戴米斯·哈萨比斯的文章,赞同目标应是促进创新与选择的前沿AI生态,而非由单一模型主导。

title_en: Love this end-to-end example from @jeffhollan of what is now possible when you build long-running agents with Foundry. All now GA.
title_zh: Love this end-to-end example from @jeffhollan of what is now possible when you build long-running agents with Foundry. All now GA.
summary_en: Nadella praised a demo by Microsoft's Jeff Hollan showing long-running agents built with Foundry, now generally available.
summary_zh: 纳德拉称赞微软员工Jeff Hollan展示的基于Foundry构建的长时运行智能体演示,该功能现已全面上线。

title_en: Super to see GPT-5.6 with Work IQ come to Copilot Chat, Cowork, M365 apps, GitHub, and Foundry today. From multi-step agentic work to analysis and content creat
title_zh: Super to see GPT-5.6 with Work IQ come to Copilot Chat, Cowork, M365 apps, GitHub, and Foundry today. From multi-step agentic work to analysis and content creat
summary_en: Nadella announced GPT-5.6 with Work IQ rolling out across Copilot Chat, Cowork, M365 apps, GitHub and Foundry.
summary_zh: 纳德拉宣布搭载Work IQ的GPT-5.6已在Copilot Chat、Cowork、M365应用、GitHub和Foundry上线。

title_en: The future of the firm is a learning loop in which human capital and token capital compound. With our new Frontier Co., our ambition is to help every enterprise
title_zh: The future of the firm is a learning loop in which human capital and token capital compound. With our new Frontier Co., our ambition is to help every enterprise
summary_en: Nadella described Microsoft's new 'Frontier Co.' initiative to help every enterprise build its own AI capability as human and 'token' capital compound.
summary_zh: 纳德拉介绍了微软新推出的"Frontier Co."计划,旨在帮助每家企业在人力资本与"token资本"叠加增长中建立自身AI能力。

title_en: Today we’re bringing skills to Copilot for Excel, giving teams a new way to scale their expertise across every workbook. https://t.co/DfD1nfPEO3
title_zh: Today we’re bringing skills to Copilot for Excel, giving teams a new way to scale their expertise across every workbook. https://t.co/DfD1nfPEO3
summary_en: Nadella announced Copilot skills coming to Excel, letting teams scale expertise across workbooks.
summary_zh: 纳德拉宣布Copilot技能功能登陆Excel,帮助团队在各个工作簿中扩展专业能力。

title_en: New Azure milestone. The fastest time to train yet at the largest reported scale for this leading AI training benchmark. A great example of what is possible whe
title_zh: New Azure milestone. The fastest time to train yet at the largest reported scale for this leading AI training benchmark. A great example of what is possible whe
summary_en: Nadella announced a new Azure milestone: the fastest training time yet at the largest reported scale on a leading AI training benchmark.
summary_zh: 纳德拉宣布Azure新里程碑:在一项主流AI训练基准测试中,以目前报告过的最大规模实现最快训练时间。

title_en: Copilot Cowork is now generally available worldwide, now with multi-model support! Every organization can put long-running agents to work on complex, multi-step
title_zh: Copilot Cowork is now generally available worldwide, now with multi-model support! Every organization can put long-running agents to work on complex, multi-step
summary_en: Nadella announced Copilot Cowork's general availability worldwide with new multi-model support for long-running agent tasks.
summary_zh: 纳德拉宣布Copilot Cowork在全球正式上线,新增多模型支持,可处理长时间运行的智能体任务。

title_en: Today in @naturemethods, we shared research on how AI can help us better understand cell behavior, offering new insights into why cancer medicines do not work t
title_zh: Today in @naturemethods, we shared research on how AI can help us better understand cell behavior, offering new insights into why cancer medicines do not work t
summary_en: Nadella shared Microsoft research published in Nature Methods on using AI to better understand why cancer drugs work differently across patients.
summary_zh: 纳德拉分享了微软发表于《自然·方法》的研究成果,利用AI探究癌症药物在不同患者身上疗效差异的原因。

title_en: Great to see NHS England scaling Microsoft 365 Copilot to more than 500,000 staff. In early trials, staff saved an average of 43 minutes per day, helping put mo
title_zh: Great to see NHS England scaling Microsoft 365 Copilot to more than 500,000 staff. In early trials, staff saved an average of 43 minutes per day, helping put mo
summary_en: Nadella highlighted NHS England scaling Microsoft 365 Copilot to more than 500,000 staff, with early trials showing 43 minutes saved per person per day.
summary_zh: 纳德拉介绍英国国家医疗服务体系(NHS)将Microsoft 365 Copilot推广至超过50万名员工,早期试点显示人均每天节省43分钟。

title_en: Satya Nadella on making human and token capital compound
title_zh: Satya Nadella on making human and token capital compound
summary_en: Long-form interview with Reid Hoffman on Possible, recorded just after Microsoft Build 2026, in which Nadella argues that human capital and token capital have to compound together.
summary_zh: 在 Reid Hoffman 的 Possible 播客中的长访谈，录制于 2026 年 Microsoft Build 之后，他在其中论述人力资本与算力（token）资本必须共同复利增长。

source: Latent Space: The AI Engineer Podcast
title_en: ⚡️Satya Nadella: No Priors x Latent Space Crossover Special at Microsoft Build
title_zh: ⚡️Satya Nadella: No Priors x Latent Space Crossover Special at Microsoft Build
summary_en: Live conversation at Microsoft Build 2026 recorded jointly by Latent Space and No Priors, covering Microsoft's agent platform and model strategy.
summary_zh: 在 2026 年 Microsoft Build 现场，由 Latent Space 与 No Priors 联合录制的对谈，讨论微软的智能体平台与模型策略。

title_en: Building a frontier intelligence ecosystem together. Highlights from my keynote at Microsoft Build this morning. https://t.co/40jxw0J7uE
title_zh: Building a frontier intelligence ecosystem together. Highlights from my keynote at Microsoft Build this morning. https://t.co/40jxw0J7uE
summary_en: Nadella shared highlights from his Microsoft Build keynote on building a 'frontier intelligence ecosystem' together with partners.
summary_zh: 纳德拉分享了他在微软Build大会主题演讲中的精彩内容,主题为与合作伙伴共同构建"前沿智能生态系统"。

title_en: With the new MAI models and Frontier Tuning capabilities we announced today, we're focused on helping every company move from just consuming a frontier model to
title_zh: With the new MAI models and Frontier Tuning capabilities we announced today, we're focused on helping every company move from just consuming a frontier model to
summary_en: Nadella announced new MAI models and Frontier Tuning capabilities to help companies move from consuming frontier models to fully participating at the frontier.
summary_zh: 纳德拉宣布推出新的MAI模型和Frontier Tuning能力,帮助企业从单纯使用前沿模型转向全面参与前沿技术开发。

title_en: With Project Solara, we are building a new platform purpose-built for agent-first devices. Excited to work with @cristianoamon and @Qualcomm on this!
title_zh: With Project Solara, we are building a new platform purpose-built for agent-first devices. Excited to work with @cristianoamon and @Qualcomm on this!
summary_en: Nadella announced Project Solara, a new platform for agent-first devices, built with Qualcomm.
summary_zh: 纳德拉宣布与高通合作推出Project Solara,这是一个面向智能体优先设备的新平台。

title_en: Great to be back at Microsoft Build today. For us, it is not about any one piece of technology or even the platform. It is about how we can build a frontier int
title_zh: Great to be back at Microsoft Build today. For us, it is not about any one piece of technology or even the platform. It is about how we can build a frontier int
summary_en: At Microsoft Build, Nadella said the company's focus is building a shared 'frontier intelligence ecosystem' rather than any single piece of technology.
summary_zh: 在微软Build大会上,纳德拉表示公司的重点是共同构建"前沿智能生态系统",而非某一项单独技术。

title_en: Our goal is to deliver unmetered intelligence to every home and every desk with Windows. NVIDIA RTX Spark marks a real breakthrough toward that vision. Looking
title_zh: Our goal is to deliver unmetered intelligence to every home and every desk with Windows. NVIDIA RTX Spark marks a real breakthrough toward that vision. Looking
summary_en: Nadella framed NVIDIA's RTX Spark as a breakthrough toward delivering 'unmetered intelligence' to every home and desk via Windows.
summary_zh: 纳德拉认为英伟达RTX Spark是通过Windows向千家万户和每张办公桌提供"无限量智能"愿景的一次突破。

title_en: We've redesigned Copilot to be simpler, faster, and more intuitive, to help keep you in the flow of your work. Try it out: https://t.co/iBuMPZ6L4b
title_zh: We've redesigned Copilot to be simpler, faster, and more intuitive, to help keep you in the flow of your work. Try it out: https://t.co/iBuMPZ6L4b
summary_en: Nadella announced a redesigned Copilot aimed at being simpler, faster and more intuitive.
summary_zh: 纳德拉宣布Copilot完成重新设计,变得更简洁、更快速、更直观。

title_en: Our new multi-model agentic security system brings together more than 100 specialized agents across frontier and custom models to find exploitable bugs, deliver
title_zh: Our new multi-model agentic security system brings together more than 100 specialized agents across frontier and custom models to find exploitable bugs, deliver
summary_en: Nadella announced a new multi-model agentic security system combining over 100 specialized agents to find exploitable bugs, achieving top results on the CyberGym benchmark.
summary_zh: 纳德拉宣布推出新的多模型智能体安全系统,集合逾100个专用智能体寻找可利用漏洞,并在CyberGym基准测试中取得领先成绩。

title_en: Excel has quietly been Turing complete for a long time. Nice to see it now edging toward "AI complete"—SGD, attention, next-token prediction… all in cells.
title_zh: Excel has quietly been Turing complete for a long time. Nice to see it now edging toward "AI complete"—SGD, attention, next-token prediction… all in cells.
summary_en: Nadella observed that Excel has long been Turing complete and is now edging toward 'AI complete,' citing SGD, attention and next-token prediction running in cells.
summary_zh: 纳德拉指出Excel长期以来一直是图灵完备的,如今正逐渐迈向"AI完备",称随机梯度下降、注意力机制、下一个词预测等都能在单元格中运行。

title_en: Great to bring GPT 5.5 Instant to M365 Copilot today. With quicker, clearer, and more accurate responses, you can get to useful answers with less back and forth
title_zh: Great to bring GPT 5.5 Instant to M365 Copilot today. With quicker, clearer, and more accurate responses, you can get to useful answers with less back and forth
summary_en: Nadella announced GPT-5.5 Instant coming to Microsoft 365 Copilot for quicker, more accurate responses.
summary_zh: 纳德拉宣布GPT-5.5 Instant接入Microsoft 365 Copilot,带来更快更准确的响应。

title_en: Every firm will need to reconceptualize work as they build agentic systems. As AI and agents take on more of the execution, the opportunity is to expand human a
title_zh: Every firm will need to reconceptualize work as they build agentic systems. As AI and agents take on more of the execution, the opportunity is to expand human a
summary_en: Nadella argued every firm will need to reconceptualize work as agentic systems take on more execution, expanding human agency rather than replacing it.
summary_zh: 纳德拉认为,随着智能体系统承担更多执行工作,每家企业都需要重新构想工作方式,以扩展而非取代人的能动性。

title_en: New in Copilot Cowork: mobile, skills, and plugins. Now available on iOS and Android, so you can delegate work from your phone, pick it back up on your desktop,
title_zh: New in Copilot Cowork: mobile, skills, and plugins. Now available on iOS and Android, so you can delegate work from your phone, pick it back up on your desktop,
summary_en: Nadella announced new Copilot Cowork features including mobile apps for iOS and Android, skills and plugins.
summary_zh: 纳德拉宣布Copilot Cowork新增功能,包括iOS和Android移动应用、技能和插件。

title_en: Agent 365 is now generally available! We’re extending the systems customers already use for identity, security, governance, and management to every AI agent and
title_zh: Agent 365 is now generally available! We’re extending the systems customers already use for identity, security, governance, and management to every AI agent and
summary_en: Nadella announced the general availability of Agent 365, extending identity, security and governance systems to AI agents across the enterprise.
summary_zh: 纳德拉宣布Agent 365正式全面上线,将企业现有的身份、安全和治理体系扩展至各类AI智能体。

title_en: Just wrapped our quarterly earnings call. We are focused on delivering AI infrastructure and solutions that empower every business to eval-max their outcomes in
title_zh: Just wrapped our quarterly earnings call. We are focused on delivering AI infrastructure and solutions that empower every business to eval-max their outcomes in
summary_en: Nadella summarized Microsoft's quarterly earnings call, emphasizing AI infrastructure investment for the agentic computing era.
summary_zh: 纳德拉总结微软季度财报电话会议,强调面向智能体计算时代的AI基础设施投入。

title_en: Great example of what Foundry enables: durable, stateful agents that run across time boundaries, orchestrate tools and models, and close the loop with evaluatio
title_zh: Great example of what Foundry enables: durable, stateful agents that run across time boundaries, orchestrate tools and models, and close the loop with evaluatio
summary_en: Nadella highlighted a Foundry example of durable, stateful agents that run across time boundaries and close the loop with evaluation.
summary_zh: 纳德拉展示了一个Foundry案例:可跨时间持续运行的有状态智能体,并能通过评估形成闭环。

title_en: Agent Mode is here in Outlook! Copilot can now help run your inbox and calendar, triaging emails, rescheduling meetings, and helping you stay on top of what mat
title_zh: Agent Mode is here in Outlook! Copilot can now help run your inbox and calendar, triaging emails, rescheduling meetings, and helping you stay on top of what mat
summary_en: Nadella announced Agent Mode in Outlook, letting Copilot triage emails and reschedule meetings automatically.
summary_zh: 纳德拉宣布Outlook推出智能体模式,Copilot可自动分类邮件并调整会议安排。

title_en: Super to see Accenture roll out 740,000+ M365 Copilot seats—our largest deployment to date! https://t.co/4sIMBwcRAV
title_zh: Super to see Accenture roll out 740,000+ M365 Copilot seats—our largest deployment to date! https://t.co/4sIMBwcRAV
summary_en: Nadella highlighted Accenture's rollout of over 740,000 Microsoft 365 Copilot seats, Microsoft's largest deployment to date.
summary_zh: 纳德拉介绍埃森哲部署超过74万个Microsoft 365 Copilot席位,这是微软迄今最大规模的部署案例。

title_en: Really fun to try this app while in Sydney this week, which uses our tools to help fans deep dive into cricket matches, players, and history. https://t.co/D1wgp

title_en: 全球首颗2nm GPU来了！苏姿丰甩出“最强AI机架”，CPU性能干翻英伟达
title_zh: 全球首颗2nm GPU来了！苏姿丰甩出“最强AI机架”，CPU性能干翻英伟达
summary_en: Su unveiled AMD's first 2nm GPU and a new "strongest AI rack" system, claiming its CPU performance surpasses NVIDIA's.
summary_zh: 苏姿丰发布AMD首款2nm GPU及全新"最强AI机架"系统，称其CPU性能超越英伟达。

title_en: 继英伟达黄仁勋后，AMD苏姿丰也表态支持开源AI模型
title_zh: 继英伟达黄仁勋后，AMD苏姿丰也表态支持开源AI模型
summary_en: Following Nvidia's Jensen Huang, AMD CEO Lisa Su publicly voiced support for open-source AI models.
summary_zh: 继英伟达黄仁勋之后，AMD首席执行官苏姿丰也公开表态支持开源AI模型。

title_en: 挑战英伟达！AMD机架级AI系统全面投产，苏姿丰称智能体兴起拉动GPU需求
title_zh: 挑战英伟达！AMD机架级AI系统全面投产，苏姿丰称智能体兴起拉动GPU需求
summary_en: AMD's rack-scale AI systems entered full production, with Su citing surging agentic-AI demand for GPUs — a direct challenge to Nvidia's datacenter dominance.
summary_zh: AMD机架级AI系统全面投产，苏姿丰表示智能体AI兴起正拉动GPU需求，这被视为对英伟达数据中心主导地位的直接挑战。

title_en: 全球首颗2nm GPU来了！苏姿丰甩出“最强AI机架”，CPU性能干翻英伟达
title_zh: 全球首颗2nm GPU来了！苏姿丰甩出“最强AI机架”，CPU性能干翻英伟达
summary_en: AMD unveiled what it calls the world's first 2nm GPU alongside a new high-density AI rack platform, claiming a CPU performance edge over Nvidia.
summary_zh: AMD发布号称全球首颗2nm GPU及新款高密度AI机架平台，并宣称CPU性能超越英伟达。

title_en: 继英伟达黄仁勋后，AMD苏姿丰也表态支持开源AI模型
title_zh: 继英伟达黄仁勋后，AMD苏姿丰也表态支持开源AI模型
summary_en: Su went on record backing open-source AI models, following Jensen Huang, positioning AMD alongside NVIDIA in favor of open over closed model development.
summary_zh: 继黄仁勋之后，苏姿丰也公开表态支持开源人工智能模型，使AMD在开源与闭源模型之争中与英伟达站在同一立场。

title_en: 全球首颗2nm GPU来了，苏姿丰甩出“最强AI机架”，CPU性能干翻英伟达
title_zh: 全球首颗2nm GPU来了，苏姿丰甩出“最强AI机架”，CPU性能干翻英伟达
summary_en: AMD unveiled the world's first 2nm GPU and a new flagship AI rack platform under Su's leadership.
summary_zh: AMD在苏姿丰领导下发布全球首颗2nm GPU及新一代旗舰AI机架平台。

title_en: AMD CEO Lisa Su tells grads they shape the future, not AI
title_zh: AMD CEO Lisa Su tells grads they shape the future, not AI
summary_en: In a commencement address, AMD CEO Lisa Su tells graduates that they, not AI, will shape the future.
summary_zh: AMD CEO苏姿丰在毕业演讲中对毕业生表示，塑造未来的是他们自己，而非AI。

title_en: 黄仁勋、苏姿丰、陈立武都来！华人AI三巨头齐聚中国台湾抢产能
title_zh: 黄仁勋、苏姿丰、陈立武都来！华人AI三巨头齐聚中国台湾抢产能
summary_en: Su joined Nvidia's Jensen Huang and Intel's Lip-Bu Tan in Taiwan as the three chip leaders competed for manufacturing capacity.
summary_zh: 苏姿丰与英伟达的黄仁勋、英特尔的陈立武齐聚中国台湾，三位华人芯片业领袖同赴当地争夺代工产能。

title_en: Lisa Su meets China's vice premier during China visit — AMD CEO pledges deeper investment days after Trump-Xi summit
title_zh: Lisa Su meets China's vice premier during China visit — AMD CEO pledges deeper investment days after Trump-Xi summit
summary_en: Lisa Su met China's vice premier during a China visit and pledged deeper AMD investment in the country, days after the Trump-Xi summit.
summary_zh: 苏姿丰在访华期间会见中国国务院副总理，并在特朗普与习近平会晤后不久承诺加大AMD在华投资。

title_en: 李开复对话苏姿丰：2026年，AI开始替代整个部门
title_zh: 李开复对话苏姿丰：2026年，AI开始替代整个部门
summary_en: In a dialogue with Kai-Fu Lee, Lisa Su said AI will begin replacing entire departments in 2026, a notable public stance on AI's workplace impact.
summary_zh: 在与李开复的对话中，苏姿丰表示2026年AI将开始替代整个部门，这是她对AI职场影响的一次重要公开表态。

title_en: 苏姿丰谈AMD对大中华区承诺：中国生态系统令人兴奋，我们的投资超出了需求
title_zh: 苏姿丰谈AMD对大中华区承诺：中国生态系统令人兴奋，我们的投资超出了需求
summary_en: Lisa Su reaffirmed AMD's commitment to Greater China, saying the region's AI ecosystem is exciting and AMD's investment there already exceeds current demand.
summary_zh: 苏姿丰重申AMD对大中华区的承诺，表示该地区的AI生态系统令人兴奋，AMD在当地的投资已超出当前需求。

title_en: 美国超威半导体公司董事会主席兼CEO苏姿丰：中国市场极其重要
title_zh: 美国超威半导体公司董事会主席兼CEO苏姿丰：中国市场极其重要
summary_en: Su said the Chinese market remains extremely important to AMD, a stance notable given ongoing U.S. export restrictions on AI chips.
summary_zh: 苏姿丰表示中国市场对AMD而言极其重要，这一表态在美国对AI芯片持续实施出口限制的背景下颇受关注。

title_en: 苏姿丰来华福利拉满：AMD官宣适配小米大模型、300万模型Day0支持+免费AI云上线
title_zh: 苏姿丰来华福利拉满：AMD官宣适配小米大模型、300万模型Day0支持+免费AI云上线
summary_en: During a China visit, AMD announced day-zero support for Xiaomi's large language models plus a free AI cloud offering.
summary_zh: 苏姿丰访华期间，AMD宣布为小米大模型提供Day 0支持，并推出免费AI云服务。

title_en: 苏姿丰现身上海：AMD 大中华区有超 4000 名工程师，预计 2030 年全球将有 50 亿人每日使用 AI
title_zh: 苏姿丰现身上海：AMD 大中华区有超 4000 名工程师，预计 2030 年全球将有 50 亿人每日使用 AI
summary_en: Appearing in Shanghai, Su says AMD's Greater China team has over 4,000 engineers and predicts 5 billion people will use AI daily by 2030.
summary_zh: 苏姿丰现身上海，表示AMD大中华区拥有超过4000名工程师，并预测到2030年全球将有50亿人每天使用AI。

title_en: 何立峰会见AMD CEO苏姿丰！
title_zh: 何立峰会见AMD CEO苏姿丰！
summary_en: Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng met with AMD CEO Lisa Su, a notable diplomatic engagement amid US-China tensions over AI chip exports.
summary_zh: 中国国务院副总理何立峰会见AMD CEO苏姿丰，在中美AI芯片出口紧张局势下具有外交意义。

title_en: 继黄仁勋后，AMD苏姿丰开启访华，谈及AI发展趋势时称未来5年将会有50亿人每日使用AI
title_zh: 继黄仁勋后，AMD苏姿丰开启访华，谈及AI发展趋势时称未来5年将会有50亿人每日使用AI
summary_en: Su visited China following Jensen Huang, discussing AI adoption trends for AMD.
summary_zh: 继黄仁勋之后，苏姿丰开启访华行程并谈及AI发展趋势。

title_en: 黄仁勋苏姿丰，投了田渊栋
title_zh: 黄仁勋苏姿丰，投了田渊栋
summary_en: Report that Jensen Huang and Lisa Su personally invested in a venture by researcher Yuandong Tian, chip industry leaders backing AI research talent directly.
summary_zh: 报道称黄仁勋与苏姿丰个人投资了研究员田渊栋的创业项目，芯片行业领袖直接支持AI研究人才。

title_en: AMD CEO苏姿丰：智能体正引爆人工智能周期巨大需求
title_zh: AMD CEO苏姿丰：智能体正引爆人工智能周期巨大需求
summary_en: Su said AI agents are igniting a huge new wave of demand in the current AI computing cycle.
summary_zh: 苏姿丰表示智能体正在为本轮AI计算周期引爆巨大的新增需求。

title_en: Lisa Su Hosts Howard Lutnick As Commerce Department Highlights 'Gold Standard' American Tech Stack: AMD C
title_zh: Lisa Su Hosts Howard Lutnick As Commerce Department Highlights 'Gold Standard' American Tech Stack: AMD C
summary_en: Lisa Su hosted U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick at AMD as the department showcased AMD's role in the American tech supply chain.
summary_zh: 苏姿丰在AMD接待美国商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克，美国商务部借此展示AMD在美国科技产业链中的地位。

title_en: 三星电子社长卢泰文会见AMD CEO苏姿丰，或扩大合作范围
title_zh: 三星电子社长卢泰文会见AMD CEO苏姿丰，或扩大合作范围
summary_en: Samsung president Roh Tae-moon met AMD CEO Lisa Su to discuss potentially expanding their partnership.
summary_zh: 三星电子社长卢泰文与AMD CEO苏姿丰会面,双方探讨可能扩大合作范围。

title_en: 对黄仁勋说“NO”！苏姿丰发动“去英伟达”战争
title_zh: 对黄仁勋说“NO”！苏姿丰发动“去英伟达”战争
summary_en: Su was described as pushing AMD's "de-Nvidia" strategy, positioning the company as a direct alternative to Nvidia in AI chips.
summary_zh: 报道称苏姿丰正在推动AMD的"去英伟达"战略，将公司定位为AI芯片领域对英伟达的直接替代选择。

title_en: AMD's Lisa Su says AI isn't replacing people, but is changing who gets hired
title_zh: AMD's Lisa Su says AI isn't replacing people, but is changing who gets hired
summary_en: AMD CEO Lisa Su said AI isn't replacing workers but is changing who gets hired, a notable public stance on AI's labor-market impact from a major chipmaker's chief executive.
summary_zh: AMD首席执行官苏姿丰表示，AI并非在取代员工，而是在改变企业招聘的对象，这是一位主要芯片厂商CEO对AI就业市场影响的重要公开表态。

title_en: CES 2026首日激战：黄仁勋官宣下一代AI芯片全面投产，苏姿丰获OpenAI站台力证算力需求
title_zh: CES 2026首日激战：黄仁勋官宣下一代AI芯片全面投产，苏姿丰获OpenAI站台力证算力需求
summary_en: At CES 2026, Su appeared alongside OpenAI to validate demand for AMD's compute, as Huang announced next-gen AI chips entering full production.
summary_zh: 在CES 2026上，苏姿丰与OpenAI同台，为AMD算力需求提供背书，同时黄仁勋宣布下一代AI芯片全面投产。

source: Frontiers of Embodied AI, ETH Zürich
title_en: World models and the next AI revolution
title_zh: 世界模型与下一次 AI 革命
summary_en: Contrasts generative architectures with JEPA, which predicts representations rather than pixels.
summary_zh: 将生成式架构与 JEPA 对比 —— 后者预测的是表征而非像素。

title_en: Self-supervised learning, JEPA, world models and the future of AI
title_zh: 自监督学习、JEPA、世界模型与 AI 的未来

title_en: A Path Towards Autonomous Machine Intelligence
title_zh: 通向自主机器智能的路径
summary_en: The position paper that laid out the whole world-model programme AMI is now funded to build.
summary_zh: 这篇立场论文奠定了 AMI 如今获得融资去建造的整个世界模型纲领。

title_en: LeVJEPA: Efficient & Scalable Video Pretraining without the Heuristics
title_zh: LeVJEPA: Efficient & Scalable Video Pretraining without the Heuristics
summary_en: Strips the hand-tuned heuristics out of video pretraining, cutting the cost of learning representations from video at scale.
summary_zh: 去掉视频预训练中人工调校的启发式技巧，降低大规模视频表征学习的成本。

title_en: Advancing human-centric AI for robust X-ray analysis through holistic self-supervised learning
title_zh: Advancing human-centric AI for robust X-ray analysis through holistic self-supervised learning
summary_en: A Meta FAIR/NYU collaboration applying self-supervised representation learning (RayDINO) to make chest X-ray analysis more robust and clinically reliable.
summary_zh: Meta FAIR与纽约大学合作的论文，将自监督表征学习（RayDINO）应用于胸部X光分析，使其更加稳健、更贴近临床需求。

title_en: Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-$α$, TabPFN-Rel and RPI
title_zh: Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-$α$, TabPFN-Rel and RPI
summary_en: A Prior Labs release for relational learning that open-sources a benchmark, a relational variant of TabPFN and a baseline library; he is one of its co-authors.
summary_zh: Prior Labs 面向关系学习的开源发布，包含一个基准、TabPFN 的关系版本和一套基线库，他是共同作者之一。

title_en: Self-supervised DXA representations encode multi-system disease risk, biological aging and heritability
title_zh: Self-supervised DXA representations encode multi-system disease risk, biological aging and heritability
summary_en: Self-supervised representations of whole-body DXA scans that turn out to encode multi-system disease risk, biological aging and heritability — his self-supervised approach applied to medical imaging.
summary_zh: 用自监督方法学习全身 DXA 扫描的表征，发现其中编码了多系统疾病风险、生理衰老与遗传度——他把自监督学习用到了医学影像上。

title_en: HP-JEPA: Hierarchical Partitioning for Multi-Resolution Graph Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning
title_zh: HP-JEPA: Hierarchical Partitioning for Multi-Resolution Graph Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning
summary_en: Extends his joint-embedding predictive architecture to graphs, using hierarchical partitioning to learn representations at several resolutions at once.
summary_zh: 把他提出的联合嵌入预测架构扩展到图数据，通过层次划分同时在多个分辨率上学习表征。

title_en: Music-JEPA: Learning a World Model of Sound from Action
title_zh: Music-JEPA: Learning a World Model of Sound from Action
summary_en: Applies the JEPA framework to audio, learning a world model of sound from action.
summary_zh: 把 JEPA 框架用于音频，从动作出发学习声音的世界模型。

title_en: Patch Policy: Efficient Embodied Control via Dense Visual Representations
title_zh: Patch Policy: Efficient Embodied Control via Dense Visual Representations
summary_en: With NYU's robot learning group, shows that dense per-patch vision-transformer features make robot policies more effective than compressing each observation into one global vector.
summary_zh: 与纽约大学机器人学习团队合作，证明使用 ViT 的稠密图块特征比把每帧观测压缩成单个全局向量更有效。

title_en: Separating Representation from Reconstruction Enables Scalable Text Encoders
title_zh: Separating Representation from Reconstruction Enables Scalable Text Encoders
summary_en: Argues that BERT-style encoders conflate representation with reconstruction, and separates the two to make text encoders scale.
summary_zh: 指出 BERT 式编码器把表征和重建混为一谈，将两者分离后文本编码器才得以扩展规模。

title_en: AdaJEPA: An Adaptive Latent World Model
title_zh: AdaJEPA: An Adaptive Latent World Model
summary_en: An adaptive latent world model that keeps updating at test time instead of staying frozen when its predictions start to degrade.
summary_zh: 一种自适应的隐空间世界模型，在测试阶段预测开始变差时继续更新，而不是保持冻结。

title_en: SkyJEPA: Learning Long-Horizon World Models for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Control of Quadrotors
title_zh: SkyJEPA: Learning Long-Horizon World Models for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Control of Quadrotors
summary_en: Applies JEPA world models to quadrotor control, transferring long-horizon predictions from simulation to real flight without fine-tuning.
summary_zh: 把 JEPA 世界模型用于四旋翼控制，将长时程预测零样本地从仿真迁移到真实飞行。

title_en: S-JEPA : Soft Clustering Anchors for Self-Supervised Speech Representation Learning
title_zh: S-JEPA : Soft Clustering Anchors for Self-Supervised Speech Representation Learning
summary_en: Replaces hard cluster-ID prediction in self-supervised speech encoders with soft clustering anchors, which stops acoustic ambiguity being collapsed at category boundaries.
summary_zh: 在自监督语音编码器中用软聚类锚点取代硬聚类 ID 预测，避免在类别边界上抹掉声学上的模糊性。

title_en: You Don't Need Strong Assumptions: Visual Representation Learning via Temporal Differences
title_zh: You Don't Need Strong Assumptions: Visual Representation Learning via Temporal Differences
summary_en: Learns visual representations with a temporal-difference objective, arguing that as compute grows the methods assuming least tend to win.
summary_zh: 用时序差分目标学习视觉表征，并论证随着算力增长，假设越少的方法往往越占优势。

title_en: Unifying Object-Centric World Models and Diffusion Policy: A Hierarchical Framework for Multi-Stage Robotic Tasks
title_zh: Unifying Object-Centric World Models and Diffusion Policy: A Hierarchical Framework for Multi-Stage Robotic Tasks
summary_en: Combines object-centric world models with a diffusion policy in a hierarchical controller for multi-stage robotic tasks.
summary_zh: 把以物体为中心的世界模型与扩散策略结合成一个分层控制器，用于多阶段机器人任务。

title_en: When Does LeJEPA Learn a World Model?
title_zh: When Does LeJEPA Learn a World Model?
summary_en: Analyses under what conditions LeJEPA, his joint-embedding predictive architecture line, actually learns a usable world model.
summary_zh: 分析在什么条件下 LeJEPA（他主张的联合嵌入预测架构路线）才真正学到可用的世界模型。

title_en: stable-worldmodel: A Platform for Reproducible World Modeling Research and Evaluation
title_zh: stable-worldmodel: A Platform for Reproducible World Modeling Research and Evaluation
summary_en: An open platform that standardises codebases, datasets and evaluation for world-model research, which the paper argues is currently fragmented.
summary_zh: 一个开放平台，为世界模型研究统一代码库、数据集与评测；论文认为该领域目前过于碎片化。

title_en: Multi-modal AI for comprehensive breast cancer prognostication
title_zh: Multi-modal AI for comprehensive breast cancer prognostication
summary_en: A large multi-institution study, with LeCun among the authors, building multi-modal AI models to predict breast cancer outcomes from imaging and clinical data.
summary_zh: 一项多机构合作研究，杨立昆参与其中，构建结合影像与临床数据的多模态AI模型以预测乳腺癌预后。

title_en: Ep 86: Yann LeCun on Leaving Meta, Breaking The LLM Paradigm, & Why Hinton is Wrong
title_zh: Ep 86: Yann LeCun on Leaving Meta, Breaking The LLM Paradigm, & Why Hinton is Wrong
summary_en: A long interview on why he left Meta, why he holds that the LLM paradigm is a dead end, and where he parts ways with Hinton.
summary_zh: 长篇访谈，谈他离开 Meta 的原因、为何认为大语言模型路线是死胡同，以及他与辛顿的分歧所在。

title_en: Crys-JEPA: Accelerating Crystal Discovery via Embedding Screening and Generative Refinement
title_zh: Crys-JEPA: Accelerating Crystal Discovery via Embedding Screening and Generative Refinement
summary_en: Uses JEPA embeddings to screen candidate crystals before generative refinement, aiming at materials that are stable and novel rather than merely realistic.
summary_zh: 先用 JEPA 嵌入筛选候选晶体，再做生成式精修，目标是稳定且新颖的材料，而不只是看起来合理的材料。

title_en: TabPFN-3: Technical Report
title_zh: TabPFN-3: Technical Report
summary_en: The technical report for the third generation of TabPFN, Prior Labs' foundation model for tabular data, on which he is a co-author.
summary_zh: Prior Labs 表格数据基础模型 TabPFN 第三代的技术报告，他是共同作者之一。

title_en: On Training in Imagination
title_zh: On Training in Imagination
summary_en: Examines model-based reinforcement learning that trains policies on imagined rollouts from a learned dynamics model.
summary_zh: 研究基于模型的强化学习——用学到的动力学模型生成的想象轨迹来训练策略。

title_en: Hierarchical Planning with Latent World Models
title_zh: Hierarchical Planning with Latent World Models
summary_en: Attacks the compounding prediction error that breaks world-model planners on long-horizon tasks by planning hierarchically in latent space.
summary_zh: 通过在隐空间中分层规划，解决世界模型规划器在长时程任务上误差累积的问题。

title_en: Why AI systems don't learn and what to do about it: Lessons on autonomous learning from cognitive science
title_zh: Why AI systems don't learn and what to do about it: Lessons on autonomous learning from cognitive science
summary_en: A position paper with Emmanuel Dupoux and Jitendra Malik on why current AI systems cannot learn autonomously, proposing an architecture drawn from human and animal cognition.
summary_zh: 与 Emmanuel Dupoux、Jitendra Malik 合写的立场论文，论述当前 AI 系统为何无法自主学习，并提出一种借鉴人类与动物认知的架构。

title_en: V-JEPA 2.1: Unlocking Dense Features in Video Self-Supervised Learning
title_zh: V-JEPA 2.1: Unlocking Dense Features in Video Self-Supervised Learning
summary_en: The 2.1 release of V-JEPA, adding dense image and video features to his video self-supervised model family while keeping its global scene understanding.
summary_zh: V-JEPA 2.1 版本，在保留全局场景理解能力的同时，为其视频自监督模型系列加入稠密的图像与视频特征。

title_en: LeWorldModel: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels
title_zh: LeWorldModel: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels
summary_en: An end-to-end JEPA trained straight from pixels, replacing the fragile multi-term losses earlier world models relied on.
summary_zh: 一种直接从像素端到端训练的 JEPA，取代了早期世界模型所依赖的脆弱多项损失。

title_en: Representation Learning for Spatiotemporal Physical Systems
title_zh: Representation Learning for Spatiotemporal Physical Systems
summary_en: Moves machine learning for physical systems past next-frame prediction toward representations of the underlying dynamics.
summary_zh: 让面向物理系统的机器学习超越下一帧预测，转向学习底层动力学的表征。

title_en: Temporal Straightening for Latent Planning
title_zh: Temporal Straightening for Latent Planning
summary_en: Reshapes pretrained visual features by straightening their trajectories over time so they suit planning rather than only recognition.
summary_zh: 通过在时间上“拉直”轨迹来重塑预训练视觉特征，使其适合规划而不只是识别。

title_en: The Spike, the Sparse and the Sink: Anatomy of Massive Activations and Attention Sinks
title_zh: The Spike, the Sparse and the Sink: Anatomy of Massive Activations and Attention Sinks
summary_en: An anatomy of two recurring transformer phenomena — massive activations in a few channels, and attention sinks.
summary_zh: 剖析 Transformer 中两个反复出现的现象：少数通道上的巨大激活值，以及注意力汇聚点。

title_en: AI+HW 2035: Shaping the Next Decade
title_zh: AI+HW 2035: Shaping the Next Decade
summary_en: A ten-year community roadmap for AI and hardware co-design, which he signed alongside some thirty other researchers.
summary_zh: 一份关于 AI 与硬件协同设计的十年社区路线图，他与另外约三十位研究者共同署名。

title_en: Beyond Language Modeling: An Exploration of Multimodal Pretraining
title_zh: Beyond Language Modeling: An Exploration of Multimodal Pretraining
summary_en: Maps the design space for native multimodal pretraining, arguing vision is the critical axis for pushing foundation models beyond language.
summary_zh: 梳理原生多模态预训练的设计空间，主张视觉是推动基础模型超越语言的关键维度。

title_en: What Drives Success in Physical Planning with Joint-Embedding Predictive World Models?
title_zh: What Drives Success in Physical Planning with Joint-Embedding Predictive World Models?
summary_en: A study probing what makes joint-embedding predictive (JEPA) world models succeed at physical planning tasks — his lab's core research direction.
summary_zh: 一篇研究联合嵌入预测（JEPA）世界模型在物理规划任务中成功要素的论文，属于其团队的核心研究方向。

title_en: EP20: Yann LeCun
title_zh: EP20: Yann LeCun
summary_en: A near two-hour interview on The Information Bottleneck in which he lays out his case that training ever larger LLMs will not reach AGI.
summary_zh: 在 The Information Bottleneck 播客中近两小时的访谈，他系统阐述了为何不断把大语言模型做大也到不了 AGI。

title_en: World Models for Learning Dexterous Hand-Object Interactions from Human Videos
title_zh: World Models for Learning Dexterous Hand-Object Interactions from Human Videos
summary_en: A world-model approach that learns dexterous robotic hand-object manipulation by watching human videos.
summary_zh: 一种世界模型方法，通过观看人类操作视频来学习灵巧的机械手–物体交互。

title_en: VL-JEPA: Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Vision-language
title_zh: VL-JEPA: Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Vision-language
summary_en: Extends his joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) to combined vision-language representation learning.
summary_zh: 将其提出的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）扩展到视觉-语言联合表征学习。

title_en: @ChrisMurphyCT You're being played by people who want regulatory capture. They are scaring everyone with dubious studies so that open source models are regulate
title_zh: @ChrisMurphyCT You're being played by people who want regulatory capture. They are scaring everyone with dubious studies so that open source models are regulate
summary_en: Accuses AI-safety alarmism of serving regulatory capture, arguing dubious studies are being used to push open-source models out of the market.
summary_zh: 他指责渲染AI风险的说法服务于监管俘获，认为这类可疑研究意在将开源模型排挤出市场。

title_en: Cambrian-S: Towards Spatial Supersensing in Video
title_zh: Cambrian-S: Towards Spatial Supersensing in Video
summary_en: Introduces Cambrian-S, a video model aimed at 'spatial supersensing' — building richer spatial understanding from video streams.
summary_zh: 提出Cambrian-S模型，致力于视频中的'空间超感知'，从视频流中构建更丰富的空间理解能力。

title_en: MetaMorph: Multimodal Understanding and Generation via Instruction Tuning
title_zh: MetaMorph: Multimodal Understanding and Generation via Instruction Tuning
summary_en: Meta FAIR work on MetaMorph, an instruction-tuned model unifying multimodal understanding and generation in one system.
summary_zh: Meta FAIR的MetaMorph研究，通过指令微调将多模态理解与生成统一在同一模型中。

title_en: Scaling Language-Free Visual Representation Learning
title_zh: Scaling Language-Free Visual Representation Learning
summary_en: Shows that purely visual (language-free) representation learning scales competitively with language-supervised approaches — part of his push against language-centric AI.
summary_zh: 论文表明，纯视觉（无语言监督）的表征学习在扩展规模后可与语言监督方法竞争，呼应其反对以语言为中心的AI路线的立场。

title_en: Gaussian Embeddings: How JEPAs Secretly Learn Your Data Density
title_zh: Gaussian Embeddings: How JEPAs Secretly Learn Your Data Density
summary_en: Argues that JEPA-style self-supervised models implicitly learn the underlying data density, formalized through Gaussian embeddings.
summary_zh: 论文提出JEPA类自监督模型实际上隐式学习了数据的概率密度，并通过高斯嵌入加以形式化。

title_en: Attention Sinks and Compression Valleys in LLMs are Two Sides of the Same Coin
title_zh: Attention Sinks and Compression Valleys in LLMs are Two Sides of the Same Coin
summary_en: Co-authored analysis connecting two known LLM internals phenomena — attention sinks and compression valleys — as the same underlying effect.
summary_zh: 合著论文将大语言模型中两个已知现象——注意力汇聚（attention sinks）与压缩谷（compression valleys）——联系为同一潜在效应的两面。

title_en: LLM-JEPA: Large Language Models Meet Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures
title_zh: LLM-JEPA: Large Language Models Meet Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures
summary_en: Brings his JEPA framework to large language models, testing the predictive-embedding approach outside vision.
summary_zh: 将其JEPA框架引入大语言模型，把预测式嵌入方法拓展到视觉领域之外。

title_en: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
title_zh: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
summary_en: V-JEPA 2, the next generation of his video world-model architecture, enabling understanding, prediction and robotic planning from self-supervised video learning.
summary_zh: V-JEPA 2是其视频世界模型架构的新一代版本，通过自监督视频学习实现理解、预测与机器人规划能力。

title_en: RoboPEPP: Vision-Based Robot Pose and Joint Angle Estimation through Embedding Predictive Pre-Training
title_zh: RoboPEPP: Vision-Based Robot Pose and Joint Angle Estimation through Embedding Predictive Pre-Training
summary_en: RoboPEPP applies embedding-predictive pre-training, in the spirit of JEPA, to estimate robot pose and joint angles from vision.
summary_zh: RoboPEPP将嵌入预测式预训练（延续JEPA思路）应用于通过视觉估计机器人姿态与关节角度。

title_en: Yann LeCun: Human Intelligence is not General Intelligence
title_zh: Yann LeCun: Human Intelligence is not General Intelligence
summary_en: An interview on the limits of today's LLMs and what he thinks is still missing for human-level intelligence.
summary_zh: 访谈，讨论当今大语言模型的局限，以及他认为通往人类水平智能还缺少什么。

title_en: Why Can't AI Make Its Own Discoveries? — With Yann LeCun
title_zh: Why Can't AI Make Its Own Discoveries? — With Yann LeCun
summary_en: He joins Big Technology Podcast to explain why current models have been unable to invent anything genuinely new.
summary_zh: 做客 Big Technology 播客，解释为什么现有模型始终无法真正发明出新东西。

title_en: New paper: turns out you can train deep nets without normalization layers by replacing them with a parameterized tanh()
title_zh: New paper: turns out you can train deep nets without normalization layers by replacing them with a parameterized tanh()
summary_en: Shares a new result showing deep networks can be trained without normalization layers by replacing them with a parameterized tanh function.
summary_zh: 分享一项新研究：用参数化的tanh函数替代归一化层，深度网络无需归一化层也能训练。

title_en: To people who think "China is surpassing the US in AI" the correct thought is "Open source models are surpassing closed ones" See ⬇️⬇️⬇️
title_zh: To people who think "China is surpassing the US in AI" the correct thought is "Open source models are surpassing closed ones" See ⬇️⬇️⬇️
summary_en: Reframes the 'China is surpassing the US in AI' narrative as really being about open-source models surpassing closed ones — a core plank of his open-source advocacy.
summary_zh: 他将'中国在AI上超越美国'的说法重新定义为'开源模型正在超越闭源模型'，这是他倡导开源的核心论点。

title_en: Meta's Chief AI Scientist Yann LeCun Makes the Case for Open Source
title_zh: Meta's Chief AI Scientist Yann LeCun Makes the Case for Open Source
summary_en: A live interview with Kara Swisher making his case for open-source AI and answering the risks critics attach to it.
summary_zh: 与 Kara Swisher 的现场访谈，他为开源 AI 辩护，并回应批评者提出的种种风险。

title_en: I don't wanna say "I told you so", but I told you so. Quote: "Ilya Sutskever, co-founder of AI labs Safe Superintelligence (SSI) and OpenAI, told Reuters recent
title_zh: I don't wanna say "I told you so", but I told you so. Quote: "Ilya Sutskever, co-founder of AI labs Safe Superintelligence (SSI) and OpenAI, told Reuters recent
summary_en: Cites Ilya Sutskever's remark that pre-training scaling has plateaued as vindication of his own long-standing skepticism about scaling laws.
summary_zh: 他援引伊利亚·苏茨克维关于预训练规模化已见顶的表态，视为对自己长期以来质疑规模化定律的印证。

title_en: Worth repeating: Do not confuse retrieval with reasoning. Do not confuse rote learning with understanding. Do not confuse accumulated knowledge with intelligenc
title_zh: Worth repeating: Do not confuse retrieval with reasoning. Do not confuse rote learning with understanding. Do not confuse accumulated knowledge with intelligenc
summary_en: Restates his core argument against LLM-centric AGI claims: don't mistake retrieval for reasoning, or accumulated knowledge for intelligence.
summary_zh: 重申其反对'LLM即通往AGI之路'论调的核心观点：不要把检索误当作推理，也不要把知识积累误当作智能。

title_en: Congrats John and Geoff! Both are former colleagues. I did my postdoc in Geoff's lab in Toronto. After that, I joined Bell Labs, where John was a part-time scie
title_zh: Congrats John and Geoff! Both are former colleagues. I did my postdoc in Geoff's lab in Toronto. After that, I joined Bell Labs, where John was a part-time scie
summary_en: Congratulates former mentors John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton on their Nobel Prize, recalling his postdoc under Hinton and time alongside Hopfield at Bell Labs.
summary_zh: 祝贺前导师约翰·霍普菲尔德和杰弗里·辛顿获得诺贝尔奖，并回忆自己在辛顿门下做博士后及在贝尔实验室与霍普菲尔德共事的经历。

title_en: #416 – Yann Lecun: Meta AI, Open Source, Limits of LLMs, AGI & the Future of AI
title_zh: #416 – Yann Lecun: Meta AI, Open Source, Limits of LLMs, AGI & the Future of AI
summary_en: A long-form conversation with Lex Fridman on Meta AI, open source, the limits of LLMs and his own route to human-level intelligence.
summary_zh: 与 Lex Fridman 的长谈，涉及 Meta AI、开源、大语言模型的局限，以及他自己设想的通往人类水平智能的路径。

title_en: #258 – Yann LeCun: Dark Matter of Intelligence and Self-Supervised Learning
title_zh: #258 – Yann LeCun: Dark Matter of Intelligence and Self-Supervised Learning
summary_en: A conversation with Lex Fridman on self-supervised learning as the dark matter of intelligence.
summary_zh: 与 Lex Fridman 对谈，讨论作为智能“暗物质”的自监督学习。

title_en: Yann LeCun: Deep Learning, Convolutional Neural Networks, and Self-Supervised Learning
title_zh: Yann LeCun: Deep Learning, Convolutional Neural Networks, and Self-Supervised Learning
summary_en: An early Lex Fridman interview covering deep learning, convolutional networks and self-supervised learning.
summary_zh: 早期的 Lex Fridman 访谈，涵盖深度学习、卷积网络与自监督学习。

title_en: Leçon inaugurale - Yann LeCun : L'apprentissage profond : une révolution en intelligence artificielle
title_zh: Leçon inaugurale - Yann LeCun : L'apprentissage profond : une révolution en intelligence artificielle
summary_en: Recording of LeCun's 2016 inaugural lecture at Collège de France on deep learning as a revolution in AI.
summary_zh: 杨立昆2016年在法兰西公学院所作的就职讲座录音，主题为“深度学习：人工智能的一场革命”。

title_en: AMI raises $1.03B seed at $3.5B pre-money — Europe's largest ever
title_zh: AMI 完成 10.3 亿美元种子轮，投前估值 35 亿美元，欧洲史上最大
summary_en: Paris-based, founded December 2025. Co-led by Cathay Innovation, Greycroft, Hiro Capital, HV Capital and Bezos Expeditions. Focus: world models that understand the physical world, hold long-term memory, and plan.
summary_zh: 总部巴黎，2025 年 12 月成立。Cathay Innovation、Greycroft、Hiro Capital、HV Capital 与 Bezos Expeditions 联合领投。方向：能理解物理世界、保有长期记忆并进行规划的世界模型。

title_en: Announces departure from Meta as Chief AI Scientist
title_zh: 宣布卸任 Meta 首席 AI 科学家
summary_en: Leaves to found his own world-model company; later publicly calls Alexandr Wang 'inexperienced' and predicts further Meta AI departures.
summary_zh: 离职创立自己的世界模型公司；此后公开称 Alexandr Wang「缺乏经验」并预言 Meta AI 将继续流失人才。

title_en: Moderna's Bob Langer and AMI's Yann LeCun Cellular Intelligence's board, bringing AI into medicine
title_zh: Moderna's Bob Langer and AMI's Yann LeCun Cellular Intelligence's board, bringing AI into medicine
summary_en: LeCun joined the board of Cellular Intelligence, a new venture co-founded with Moderna's Robert Langer applying AI to medicine.
summary_zh: 杨立昆加入Cellular Intelligence董事会，该公司由他与Moderna的Robert Langer共同参与，致力于将AI应用于医学领域。

title_en: Yann LeCun, Bob Langer, Jens Nielsen and Fabian Theis Join Cellular Intelligence Scientific Advisory Board
title_zh: Yann LeCun, Bob Langer, Jens Nielsen and Fabian Theis Join Cellular Intelligence Scientific Advisory Board
summary_en: LeCun joined the scientific advisory board of Cellular Intelligence, alongside other prominent scientists.
summary_zh: 杨立昆加入Cellular Intelligence公司科学顾问委员会，与多位知名科学家共同任职。

title_en: That viral Yann LeCun ECCV slide telling AI scientists not to work on LLMs? He says it's 100% real
title_zh: That viral Yann LeCun ECCV slide telling AI scientists not to work on LLMs? He says it's 100% real
summary_en: Yann LeCun confirmed as genuine a viral slide from his ECCV talk urging AI researchers to stop working on LLMs.
summary_zh: 杨立昆证实其在ECCV演讲中呼吁研究者停止研究大语言模型的爆红幻灯片确系真实。

title_en: Dario高喊AI刹车，杨立昆翻旧账：7年前你就这么吓人
title_zh: Dario高喊AI刹车，杨立昆翻旧账：7年前你就这么吓人
summary_en: LeCun rebutted Amodei's call to slow AI down, noting Amodei made similarly alarmist warnings seven years ago.
summary_zh: 杨立昆反驳阿莫代伊呼吁放缓AI的言论，指出阿莫代伊七年前也发表过类似的警世言论。

title_en: 杨立昆翻旧账嘲笑达里奥：7年前连GPT-2都觉得危险
title_zh: 杨立昆翻旧账嘲笑达里奥：7年前连GPT-2都觉得危险
summary_en: LeCun publicly mocked Amodei, noting that seven years ago Amodei considered even GPT-2 dangerous, sharpening their public disagreement over AI safety alarm.
summary_zh: 杨立昆公开嘲讽达里奥·阿莫代伊，指出七年前后者甚至认为GPT-2都很危险，凸显两人在AI安全警示问题上的公开分歧。

title_en: Dario 高喊AI 刹车，Altman、马斯克罕见同队支持，杨立昆翻旧账：7年前你就这么吓人- 产业链
title_zh: Dario 高喊AI 刹车，Altman、马斯克罕见同队支持，杨立昆翻旧账：7年前你就这么吓人- 产业链
summary_en: As Dario Amodei sounded the alarm on AI risk with rare backing from Altman and Musk, Yann LeCun pushed back, noting Amodei made similarly alarming predictions seven years ago that didn't come true.
summary_zh: 在Dario Amodei就AI风险发出警告、并罕见获得Altman和马斯克支持之际，杨立昆予以反驳，指出Amodei七年前就发表过类似的危言耸听的预测，但并未成真。

title_en: Dario 高喊 AI 刹车，Altman、马斯克罕见同队支持，杨立昆翻旧账：7年前你就这么吓人
title_zh: Dario 高喊 AI 刹车，Altman、马斯克罕见同队支持，杨立昆翻旧账：7年前你就这么吓人
summary_en: LeCun mocked Amodei's call for an AI slowdown, noting Amodei made similarly alarming warnings seven years ago — pushing back in the ongoing AI-safety debate.
summary_zh: 杨立昆调侃阿莫代伊呼吁AI刹车一事，指出阿莫代伊七年前就发表过类似的警示言论，在AI安全争论中予以反击。

title_en: Dario 高喊 AI 刹车，Altman、马斯克罕见同队支持，杨立昆翻旧账：7年前你就这么吓人
title_zh: Dario 高喊 AI 刹车，Altman、马斯克罕见同队支持，杨立昆翻旧账：7年前你就这么吓人
summary_en: Yann LeCun pushed back on the new wave of AI-slowdown calls from Amodei, Altman and Musk, noting he raised similar warnings seven years ago, reasserting his longstanding dissent on AI-risk alarmism.
summary_zh: 杨立昆对Dario Amodei、Sam Altman和马斯克新一轮呼吁放缓AI发展的言论提出反驳，指出他七年前就曾发出类似警告，重申了他对AI风险恐慌论一贯的不同立场。

title_en: TIME Names Yann LeCun Among 2026's Top AI Figures
title_zh: TIME Names Yann LeCun Among 2026's Top AI Figures

summary_zh: TIME将杨立昆列入2026年AI领域最具影响力人物榜单。

title_zh: “Father of AI” Yann Lecun Raises $1 Billion With Startup Betting That the Industry Is Wrong
summary_en: LeCun's new startup raised $1 billion, betting that the industry's autoregressive-LLM approach to AGI is wrong.
summary_zh: 杨立昆的新公司完成10亿美元融资，押注业界依赖自回归LLM通往AGI的路线是错的。

title_en: Yann LeCun: The 100 Most Influential People in AI 2026
title_zh: Yann LeCun: The 100 Most Influential People in AI 2026

title_zh: From Meta to Stealth: Yann LeCun Sets Out to Build a World-Model AI Startup

summary_zh: 杨立昆离开Meta，创立一家专注于构建世界模型AI的隐身初创公司。

title_zh: AI 教父杨立昆公开开炮：所有人形机器人公司都走错路了

title_zh: 小扎高调开战闭源AI！推30B智能体模型，消费级显卡就能跑，杨立昆点赞

summary_zh: Jukebox，用多尺度 VQ-VAE 在原始音频域直接生成带人声演唱的音乐。

title_en: Dota 2 with Large Scale Deep Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Dota 2 with Large Scale Deep Reinforcement Learning

title_en: Generating Long Sequences with Sparse Transformers
title_zh: Generating Long Sequences with Sparse Transformers

title_en: FFJORD: Free-form Continuous Dynamics for Scalable Reversible Generative Models

title_en: GamePad: A Learning Environment for Theorem Proving
title_zh: GamePad: A Learning Environment for Theorem Proving

title_en: Some Considerations on Learning to Explore via Meta-Reinforcement Learning

title_en: Emergent Complexity via Multi-Agent Competition
title_zh: Emergent Complexity via Multi-Agent Competition

title_en: Continuous Adaptation via Meta-Learning in Nonstationary and Competitive Environments
title_zh: Continuous Adaptation via Meta-Learning in Nonstationary and Competitive Environments
