summary_en: Paper on unified world modeling that represents actions as masked visual signals so video models can be used as robotic world models.
summary_zh: 论文提出用“掩码视觉动作”统一世界模型，让视频模型可以直接充当机器人的世界模型。

title_en: The world is not just made of words, and spatial intelligence was never just about perceiving and generating worlds. It's about interacting with them. Today, Sc
title_zh: The world is not just made of words, and spatial intelligence was never just about perceiving and generating worlds. It's about interacting with them. Today, Sc
summary_en: Li announced that SceniX is joining World Labs, framing spatial intelligence as being about interacting with worlds, not just perceiving them.
summary_zh: 李飞飞宣布SceniX并入World Labs，并阐述空间智能不仅是感知世界，更是与世界互动。

title_en: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
title_zh: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
summary_en: Introduces RoboTTT, a test-time-training recipe that lets robot policies use much longer visuomotor context than single-step history.
summary_zh: 提出 RoboTTT，用测试时训练让机器人策略能利用远长于单步历史的视觉运动上下文。

title_en: 1/N Long horizon, complex tasks that truly matter in everyday life are not solved problems by today’s robotics, requiring planning, object detection, object man
title_zh: 1/N Long horizon, complex tasks that truly matter in everyday life are not solved problems by today’s robotics, requiring planning, object detection, object man
summary_en: Li laid out why long-horizon, complex everyday tasks remain unsolved for today's robotics, covering planning, object detection and manipulation.
summary_zh: 李飞飞阐述了当前机器人技术在长时程、复杂日常任务上仍未解决的难题，涉及规划、物体检测与操作等方面。

title_en: SimFoundry: Modular and Automated Scene Generation for Policy Learning and Evaluation
title_zh: SimFoundry: Modular and Automated Scene Generation for Policy Learning and Evaluation
summary_en: Presents SimFoundry, a system that builds simulation scenes automatically from real scans for training and evaluating robot policies.
summary_zh: 提出 SimFoundry，可从真实扫描自动构建仿真场景，用于机器人策略的训练与评测。

source: Silicon Valley Girl: AI, Tech and Care…
title_en: Fei-Fei Li: In 10 Years There Will Be Only 2 Kinds of Workers
title_zh: Fei-Fei Li: In 10 Years There Will Be Only 2 Kinds of Workers
summary_en: Interview on how AI will reshape work, and on the $1B raise funding World Labs' push into spatial understanding.
summary_zh: 访谈中谈人工智能将如何重塑工作，以及支撑 World Labs 进军空间理解的 10 亿美元融资。

title_en: Your thoughtful reflection is so inspiring and encouraging @smallfly ! As everyone talks about AI and automation, human creativity, story telling and productivi
title_zh: Your thoughtful reflection is so inspiring and encouraging @smallfly ! As everyone talks about AI and automation, human creativity, story telling and productivi
summary_en: Li argued that amid the AI and automation conversation, human creativity and storytelling remain essential.
summary_zh: 李飞飞指出，在AI与自动化的讨论热潮中，人类的创造力与叙事能力依然至关重要。

title_en: T-Rex: Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation
title_zh: T-Rex: Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation
summary_en: Adds tactile reactivity to vision-language-action models so manipulation policies can respond to contact signals in real time.
summary_zh: 为视觉-语言-动作模型加入触觉反馈，使操作策略能实时响应接触信号。

title_en: Scientific research is fundamental to advancing civilization and helping people globally to solve the most critical problems, from medicine to materials, from b
title_zh: Scientific research is fundamental to advancing civilization and helping people globally to solve the most critical problems, from medicine to materials, from b
summary_en: Li called scientific research fundamental to solving humanity's biggest problems, from medicine to materials to brain science.
summary_zh: 李飞飞表示科学研究是解决人类重大问题（从医学、材料到脑科学）的根本所在。

title_en: A Functional Taxonomy of World Models
title_zh: A Functional Taxonomy of World Models
summary_en: Her essay sorting world models into renderers, simulators and planners, and describing the loop that connects them.
summary_zh: 她撰文将世界模型划分为渲染器、模拟器与规划器三类，并阐述连接三者的闭环。

title_en: Planning with the Views
title_zh: Planning with the Views
summary_en: Tests whether vision-language models can predict how a camera move changes the view and plan several moves ahead, a direct probe of spatial reasoning.
summary_zh: 考察视觉语言模型能否预测相机移动后的视角变化并做多步规划，直接检验空间推理能力。

title_en: ESI-Bench: Towards Embodied Spatial Intelligence that Closes the Perception-Action Loop
title_zh: ESI-Bench: Towards Embodied Spatial Intelligence that Closes the Perception-Action Loop
summary_en: ESI-Bench evaluates embodied spatial intelligence over the full perception-action loop rather than passive perception alone.
summary_zh: ESI-Bench 以完整的感知-行动闭环来评测具身空间智能，而非只考察被动感知。

title_en: StereoPolicy: Improving Robotic Manipulation Policies via Stereo Perception
title_zh: StereoPolicy: Improving Robotic Manipulation Policies via Stereo Perception
summary_en: Shows that stereo perception recovers the depth information monocular policies lack and improves robotic manipulation.
summary_zh: 论文表明立体视觉能补上单目策略缺失的深度信息，从而提升机器人操作性能。

title_en: HumanScore: Benchmarking Human Motions in Generated Videos
title_zh: HumanScore: Benchmarking Human Motions in Generated Videos
summary_en: HumanScore is a benchmark that systematically measures how realistic human motion is in generated video.
summary_zh: HumanScore 是一个系统评测生成视频中人体动作真实度的基准。

title_en: RAGEN-2: Reasoning Collapse in Agentic RL
title_zh: RAGEN-2: Reasoning Collapse in Agentic RL
summary_en: Follow-up to the RAGEN line she co-authored, analysing why reasoning collapses during multi-turn agentic RL training.
summary_zh: 她此前参与的 RAGEN 工作的续作，分析多轮智能体强化学习训练中推理能力崩溃的原因。

title_en: Making improvements one step at a time for Marble. In the case of generating bigger worlds, it's quite literal ;) 🤩🌐
title_zh: Making improvements one step at a time for Marble. In the case of generating bigger worlds, it's quite literal ;) 🤩🌐
summary_en: Li shared a Marble product update on generating larger, more detailed AI worlds.
summary_zh: 李飞飞分享了Marble产品更新，聚焦生成更大更精细的AI世界。

title_en: It’s 11th year and counting! Teaching the first lecture of @cs231n every year has been a highlight of my spring seasons. As usual, I asked students which depart
title_zh: It’s 11th year and counting! Teaching the first lecture of @cs231n every year has been a highlight of my spring seasons. As usual, I asked students which depart
summary_en: Li marked the 11th year of teaching the opening lecture of Stanford's CS231n course.
summary_zh: 李飞飞纪念了她讲授斯坦福CS231n课程开课讲座的第11个年头。

title_en: AI can generate 100 million splats, but it’s one creator’s imagination that made this uniquely beautiful world possible!🤩
title_zh: AI can generate 100 million splats, but it’s one creator’s imagination that made this uniquely beautiful world possible!🤩
summary_en: Li argued that even as AI can generate massive 3D scenes, it's a creator's imagination that makes a world genuinely compelling.
summary_zh: 李飞飞指出，尽管AI能生成海量3D场景，但真正让世界独具魅力的是创作者的想象力。

title_en: CaP-X: A Framework for Benchmarking and Improving Coding Agents for Robot Manipulation
title_zh: CaP-X: A Framework for Benchmarking and Improving Coding Agents for Robot Manipulation
summary_en: CaP-X benchmarks and improves code-generating agents used as controllers for robot manipulation.
summary_zh: CaP-X 用于评测并改进以代码生成方式充当机器人操作控制器的智能体。

title_en: MIRAGE: The Illusion of Visual Understanding
title_zh: MIRAGE: The Illusion of Visual Understanding
summary_en: Examines the mechanisms behind visual-language reasoning and argues much apparent visual understanding is illusory.
summary_zh: 研究视觉语言推理的内在机制，指出多模态模型的“视觉理解”很大程度上是假象。

title_en: Our recent work using object-centered spatial information for better generalization 🦾
title_zh: Our recent work using object-centered spatial information for better generalization 🦾
summary_en: Li highlighted new research using object-centered spatial information to improve model generalization.
summary_zh: 李飞飞介绍了一项利用以物体为中心的空间信息来提升模型泛化能力的新研究。

title_en: Rapid Adaptation of Particle Dynamics for Generalized Deformable Object Mobile Manipulation
title_zh: Rapid Adaptation of Particle Dynamics for Generalized Deformable Object Mobile Manipulation
summary_en: Learns to adapt particle-based dynamics models on the fly for mobile manipulation of deformable objects with unknown physics.
summary_zh: 提出在线自适应粒子动力学模型的方法，用于物性未知的可变形物体的移动操作。

title_en: Love this essay from World Labs’ team! Just like codes, 3D is a universal interface for machines and people.🤩
title_zh: Love this essay from World Labs’ team! Just like codes, 3D is a universal interface for machines and people.🤩
summary_en: Li praised a World Labs team essay arguing that 3D, like code, is becoming a universal interface for machines and people.
summary_zh: 李飞飞称赞World Labs团队的一篇文章，主张3D如同代码一样正成为机器与人类的通用接口。

title_en: Learning from Trials and Errors: Reflective Test-Time Planning for Embodied LLMs
title_zh: Learning from Trials and Errors: Reflective Test-Time Planning for Embodied LLMs
summary_en: Gives embodied LLM agents a reflective test-time planning loop so failed attempts inform later trials instead of repeating.
summary_zh: 为具身大模型智能体加入反思式测试时规划，使失败经验能被吸收而不是反复重演。

title_en: Want more editable controls when creating a true 3D world? All users of Marble can now enjoy the Advance model! Try to add a scene outside of the windows, chang
title_zh: Want more editable controls when creating a true 3D world? All users of Marble can now enjoy the Advance model! Try to add a scene outside of the windows, chang
summary_en: Li announced Marble's Advance model, giving users more editable control when generating 3D worlds.
summary_zh: 李飞飞宣布Marble推出Advance模型，让用户在生成3D世界时拥有更多可编辑控制项。

title_en: Theory of Space: Can Foundation Models Construct Spatial Beliefs through Active Exploration?
title_zh: Theory of Space: Can Foundation Models Construct Spatial Beliefs through Active Exploration?
summary_en: Asks whether foundation models can build spatial beliefs through active exploration under partial observability.
summary_zh: 考察基础模型能否在部分可观测条件下通过主动探索建立空间信念。

title_en: The dream of robots helping people live and work better in the physical world begins with helping robots to become more spatially intelligent by learning from t
title_zh: The dream of robots helping people live and work better in the physical world begins with helping robots to become more spatially intelligent by learning from t
summary_en: Li described the vision of spatially intelligent robots learning from diverse real-world environments to better assist people.
summary_zh: 李飞飞描述了让机器人通过学习多样化真实环境来提升空间智能、更好地帮助人类的愿景。

title_en: VideoWeave: A Data-Centric Approach for Efficient Video Understanding
title_zh: VideoWeave: A Data-Centric Approach for Efficient Video Understanding
summary_en: VideoWeave is a data-centric method that cuts the cost of training video-language models on long videos.
summary_zh: VideoWeave 通过以数据为中心的方法降低长视频上训练视频语言模型的开销。

title_en: PointWorld: Scaling 3D World Models for In-The-Wild Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: PointWorld: Scaling 3D World Models for In-The-Wild Robotic Manipulation
summary_en: PointWorld scales 3D world models for in-the-wild robotic manipulation, the geometry-grounded modelling she argues language models lack.
summary_zh: PointWorld 将 3D 世界模型扩展到真实场景的机器人操作，正是她所说语言模型缺失的几何基础。

title_en: Dream2Flow: Bridging Video Generation and Open-World Manipulation with 3D Object Flow
title_zh: Dream2Flow: Bridging Video Generation and Open-World Manipulation with 3D Object Flow
summary_en: Dream2Flow converts generated video into 3D object flow so video generation can drive open-world manipulation.
summary_zh: Dream2Flow 把生成视频转换为三维物体流，让视频生成模型能够驱动开放世界的机器人操作。

title_en: Fei-Fei Li: World Models and the Multiverse
title_zh: Fei-Fei Li: World Models and the Multiverse
summary_en: a16z conversation on world models and why the next advance in AI may come from spatial understanding rather than language.
summary_zh: 在 a16z 的对谈中讨论世界模型，以及人工智能的下一步进展为何可能来自空间理解而非语言。

title_en: QuantiPhy: A Quantitative Benchmark Evaluating Physical Reasoning Abilities of Vision-Language Models
title_zh: QuantiPhy: A Quantitative Benchmark Evaluating Physical Reasoning Abilities of Vision-Language Models
summary_en: QuantiPhy is a quantitative benchmark testing whether vision-language models can reason about physical properties.
summary_zh: QuantiPhy 是定量评测视觉语言模型物理属性推理能力的基准。

title_en: #839: Dr. Fei-Fei Li, The Godmother of AI — Asking Audacious Questions, Civilizational Technology, and Finding Your North Star
title_zh: #839: Dr. Fei-Fei Li, The Godmother of AI — Asking Audacious Questions, Civilizational Technology, and Finding Your North Star
summary_en: Tim Ferriss interview covering her path through ImageNet, Stanford HAI and World Labs, and how she chooses research questions.
summary_zh: Tim Ferriss 的访谈，回顾她从 ImageNet 到斯坦福 HAI 再到 World Labs 的历程，以及她如何选择研究问题。

title_en: #340.：对话李飞飞与Justin Johnson:超越语言模型，构建理解三维世界的AI新前沿
title_zh: #340.：对话李飞飞与Justin Johnson:超越语言模型，构建理解三维世界的AI新前沿
summary_en: Chinese-dubbed rebroadcast of her Latent Space interview with Justin Johnson on building AI that understands three-dimensional, physical space beyond language models.
summary_zh: 她与Justin Johnson在Latent Space播客访谈的中文转播，谈论如何构建理解三维物理世界的AI，超越纯语言模型。

title_en: How to be 'fearless' in the AI age, with Fei-Fei Li and Reid Hoffman
title_zh: How to be 'fearless' in the AI age, with Fei-Fei Li and Reid Hoffman
summary_en: Conversation with Reid Hoffman on taking scientific and entrepreneurial risk during a period of rapid AI change.
summary_zh: 与 Reid Hoffman 对谈，讨论在人工智能剧变期如何承担科研与创业风险。

title_en: The Godmother of AI on jobs, robots, and why world models are next | Dr. Fei-Fei Li
title_zh: The Godmother of AI on jobs, robots, and why world models are next | Dr. Fei-Fei Li
summary_en: Lenny's Podcast interview on jobs, robotics, and why she considers world models the next frontier after language models.
summary_zh: 在 Lenny 播客中谈就业、机器人，以及她为何认为世界模型是继语言模型之后的下一个前沿。

title_en: “Creativity is intelligence having fun.” Unleash your creativity and imagination with Marble - our 3D world generation model, now available to everyone!
title_zh: “Creativity is intelligence having fun.” Unleash your creativity and imagination with Marble - our 3D world generation model, now available to everyone!
summary_en: Li announces general availability of Marble, World Labs' 3D world-generation model, opening it to all users.
summary_zh: 李飞飞宣布World Labs的3D世界生成模型Marble正式向所有用户开放。

title_en: AI’s next frontier is Spatial Intelligence, a technology that will turn seeing into reasoning, perception into action, and imagination into creation. But what i
title_zh: AI’s next frontier is Spatial Intelligence, a technology that will turn seeing into reasoning, perception into action, and imagination into creation. But what i
summary_en: Li lays out her thesis that Spatial Intelligence is AI's next frontier, turning perception into action and imagination into creation.
summary_zh: 李飞飞阐述其核心论点：空间智能是AI的下一前沿，能将感知转化为行动、想象转化为创造。

title_en: How Life Changes When We Reach Artificial Superintelligence w/ Dr. Fei-Fei Li & Dr. Eric Schmidt | EP #206
title_zh: How Life Changes When We Reach Artificial Superintelligence w/ Dr. Fei-Fei Li & Dr. Eric Schmidt | EP #206
summary_en: Joint appearance with Eric Schmidt on what changes as AI systems approach and pass human-level capability.
summary_zh: 与 Eric Schmidt 同台，讨论当人工智能系统接近并超越人类水平时会发生什么变化。

source: Young and Profiting (YAP) with Hala Ta…
title_en: Dr. Fei-Fei Li: Turn AI Into Humanity's Greatest Ally, Not Its Biggest Threat | Artificial Intelligence | AI Vault
title_zh: Dr. Fei-Fei Li: Turn AI Into Humanity's Greatest Ally, Not Its Biggest Threat | Artificial Intelligence | AI Vault
summary_en: Fei-Fei Li discusses her vision for spatial intelligence and steering AI toward benefiting humanity rather than threatening it, in an interview on the Young and Profiting podcast.
summary_zh: 李飞飞在Young and Profiting播客访谈中，谈论她对空间智能的构想，以及如何引导AI造福人类而非成为威胁。

title_en: It’s an honor to have received the @QEPrize along with my fellow laureates! But it’s also a responsibility. AI’s impact to humanity is in the hands of all of us
title_zh: It’s an honor to have received the @QEPrize along with my fellow laureates! But it’s also a responsibility. AI’s impact to humanity is in the hands of all of us
summary_en: Li shares that she received the Queen Elizabeth Prize for Engineering, calling it both an honor and a responsibility.
summary_zh: 李飞飞分享她荣获英国伊丽莎白女王工程奖，称这既是荣誉也是责任。

title_en: MoMaGen: Generating Demonstrations under Soft and Hard Constraints for Multi-Step Bimanual Mobile Manipulation
title_zh: MoMaGen: Generating Demonstrations under Soft and Hard Constraints for Multi-Step Bimanual Mobile Manipulation
summary_en: Paper co-authored by Fei-Fei Li on generating training demonstrations for multi-step bimanual mobile manipulation under soft and hard constraints, reducing the cost of collecting robot data.
summary_zh: 李飞飞合著的论文，提出在软硬约束下自动生成多步双臂移动操作演示数据的方法，降低机器人数据采集成本。

title_en: Repurposing 2D Diffusion Models with Gaussian Atlas for 3D Generation
title_zh: Repurposing 2D Diffusion Models with Gaussian Atlas for 3D Generation
summary_en: ICCV 2025 paper co-authored by Fei-Fei Li that adapts pretrained 2D diffusion models to 3D generation via a Gaussian-splat atlas representation.
summary_zh: 李飞飞合著的ICCV 2025论文，通过高斯泼溅图集表示，将预训练的2D扩散模型改造用于3D生成。

title_en: GeT-USE: Learning Generalized Tool Usage for Bimanual Mobile Manipulation via Simulated Embodiment Extensions
title_zh: GeT-USE: Learning Generalized Tool Usage for Bimanual Mobile Manipulation via Simulated Embodiment Extensions
summary_en: IROS 2025 paper co-authored by Fei-Fei Li on teaching bimanual mobile robots to use arbitrary objects as tools by first extending their embodiment in simulation.
summary_zh: 李飞飞合著的IROS 2025论文，通过先在仿真中扩展机器人的具身能力，教会双臂移动机器人使用任意物体作为工具。

title_en: Flow to the Mode: Mode-Seeking Diffusion Autoencoders for State-of-the-Art Image Tokenization
title_zh: Flow to the Mode: Mode-Seeking Diffusion Autoencoders for State-of-the-Art Image Tokenization
summary_en: ICCV 2025 paper co-authored by Fei-Fei Li introducing FlowMo, a convolution-free diffusion autoencoder that sets a new state of the art in image tokenization.
summary_zh: 李飞飞合著的ICCV 2025论文，提出无需卷积的扩散自编码器FlowMo，在图像分词任务上取得新的最优效果。

title_en: Very excited to share @theworldlabs ‘s latest research work RTFM!! It’s a real-time, persistent, and 3D consistent generative World Model running on *a single*
title_zh: Very excited to share @theworldlabs ‘s latest research work RTFM!! It’s a real-time, persistent, and 3D consistent generative World Model running on *a single*
summary_en: Li unveils RTFM, World Labs' real-time, persistent, 3D-consistent world model that runs on a single H100 GPU.
summary_zh: 李飞飞发布World Labs的RTFM模型——一个可在单张H100 GPU上运行的实时、持久、3D一致的世界模型。

title_en: EEG-Based Brain-Computer Interface for Robotic Assistance with User Intention Prediction
title_zh: EEG-Based Brain-Computer Interface for Robotic Assistance with User Intention Prediction
summary_en: Paper co-authored by Fei-Fei Li on NOIR-EEG, a non-invasive brain-computer interface letting people command household robots via EEG signals, tested across fifteen everyday tasks.
summary_zh: 李飞飞合著的论文，提出非侵入式脑机接口系统NOIR-EEG，让用户通过脑电信号指挥家用机器人完成十五项日常任务。

title_en: If you're curious about how the latest spatial intelligence model is doing @theworldlabs, check out this new blog! I'm so excited by how much progress has been
title_zh: If you're curious about how the latest spatial intelligence model is doing @theworldlabs, check out this new blog! I'm so excited by how much progress has been
summary_en: Li points to a new World Labs blog detailing progress on its spatial intelligence model, describing bigger and more capable generation.
summary_zh: 李飞飞分享World Labs新博客，介绍其空间智能模型在规模和能力上的最新进展。

title_en: ha! here is something fun and totally random I've been pondering: as Oliver Sacks has beautifully written - "what is the space between two snowflakes?" Language
title_zh: ha! here is something fun and totally random I've been pondering: as Oliver Sacks has beautifully written - "what is the space between two snowflakes?" Language
summary_en: Li muses on language's limits in capturing spatial concepts, tying the reflection to her broader spatial-intelligence research thesis.
summary_zh: 李飞飞就语言在表达空间概念上的局限进行思考，呼应她关于空间智能的研究主张。

title_en: (1/N) How close are we to enabling robots to solve the long-horizon, complex tasks that matter in everyday life? 🚨 We are thrilled to invite you to join the 1st
title_zh: (1/N) How close are we to enabling robots to solve the long-horizon, complex tasks that matter in everyday life? 🚨 We are thrilled to invite you to join the 1st
summary_en: Li announces the first BEHAVIOR Challenge at NeurIPS 2025, inviting submissions on long-horizon robot task-solving.
summary_zh: 李飞飞宣布首届BEHAVIOR Challenge将在NeurIPS 2025举行，邀请提交关于长时程机器人任务求解的研究。

title_en: Advancing science- and evidence-based AI policy
title_zh: Advancing science- and evidence-based AI policy
summary_en: Science policy essay co-authored by Fei-Fei Li and other leading researchers arguing AI policy should be grounded in scientific evidence and should itself fund the evidence-generation needed to keep pace with the technology.
summary_zh: 李飞飞与多位顶尖学者合著的Science政策文章，主张AI政策制定应以科学证据为基础，并应资助与技术发展同步的证据生成研究。

title_en: Fei-Fei Li: Spatial Intelligence is the Next Frontier in AI
title_zh: Fei-Fei Li: Spatial Intelligence is the Next Frontier in AI
summary_en: Her own fireside talk at Y Combinator's AI Startup School, laying out why spatial intelligence — not language — is the next frontier.
summary_zh: 她本人在 Y Combinator AI 创业学校的炉边对谈，阐述为何空间智能而非语言才是 AI 的下一个前沿。

title_en: Check out this shiny new, fast and dynamic web renderer for 3D Gaussian Splats! The things one could do are just mind boggling! So proud of the @theworldlabs te
title_zh: Check out this shiny new, fast and dynamic web renderer for 3D Gaussian Splats! The things one could do are just mind boggling! So proud of the @theworldlabs te
summary_en: Li showcases a new fast, dynamic web renderer for 3D Gaussian Splats built by the World Labs team.
summary_zh: 李飞飞展示World Labs团队打造的全新快速动态3D高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splats）网页渲染器。

title_en: One of the “holy grails” of robotic learning is to perform generalizable everyday household mobile manipulation tasks. With a new bimanual mobile robot, our lat
title_zh: One of the “holy grails” of robotic learning is to perform generalizable everyday household mobile manipulation tasks. With a new bimanual mobile robot, our lat
summary_en: Li presents the BEHAVIOR Robot Suite, a new bimanual mobile robot aimed at generalizable household manipulation tasks.
summary_zh: 李飞飞发布BEHAVIOR Robot Suite，一款面向通用家庭操作任务的双臂移动机器人。

summary_en: Kavukcuoglu and DeepMind COO Lila Ibrahim discussed DeepMind's work on climate and disease on the WSJ-produced podcast "AI That Means Business".
summary_zh: 卡武库奥卢与DeepMind首席运营官莉拉·易卜拉欣在《华尔街日报》制作的播客《AI That Means Business》中，谈论DeepMind在气候和疾病领域的工作。

title_en: Imagen 3
title_zh: Imagen 3
summary_en: The Imagen 3 report on DeepMind's text-to-image latent diffusion model and its quality and responsibility evaluations.
summary_zh: Imagen 3 报告，介绍 DeepMind 的文生图潜在扩散模型及其质量与责任评估。

title_en: Gemma 2: Improving Open Language Models at a Practical Size
title_zh: Gemma 2: Improving Open Language Models at a Practical Size
summary_en: The Gemma 2 report on Google's open language models from 2B to 27B parameters.
summary_zh: Gemma 2 技术报告，介绍谷歌 20 亿至 270 亿参数的开放语言模型。

title_en: Capabilities of Gemini Models in Medicine
title_zh: Capabilities of Gemini Models in Medicine
summary_en: A study adapting Gemini to medical reasoning and multimodal clinical tasks.
summary_zh: 研究如何将 Gemini 适配到医学推理与多模态临床任务。

title_en: RecurrentGemma: Moving Past Transformers for Efficient Open Language Models
title_zh: RecurrentGemma: Moving Past Transformers for Efficient Open Language Models
summary_en: RecurrentGemma applies the Griffin architecture, combining linear recurrences with local attention, to open language models.
summary_zh: RecurrentGemma 将结合线性递归与局部注意力的 Griffin 架构用于开放语言模型。

title_en: Gemma: Open Models Based on Gemini Research and Technology
title_zh: Gemma: Open Models Based on Gemini Research and Technology
summary_en: The first Gemma report, releasing lightweight open models built from the Gemini research stack.
summary_zh: 首份 Gemma 报告，发布基于 Gemini 研究技术构建的轻量级开放模型。

title_en: Gemini 1.5: Unlocking multimodal understanding across millions of tokens of context
title_zh: Gemini 1.5: Unlocking multimodal understanding across millions of tokens of context
summary_en: The Gemini 1.5 report, introducing recall and reasoning across millions of tokens of multimodal context.
summary_zh: Gemini 1.5 报告，实现在数百万 token 多模态上下文中的检索与推理。

title_en: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models
title_zh: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models
summary_en: The original Gemini report, introducing the multimodal model family across image, audio, video and text.
summary_zh: 最初的 Gemini 报告，发布覆盖图像、音频、视频与文本的多模态模型家族。

title_en: Competition-level code generation with AlphaCode
title_zh: Competition-level code generation with AlphaCode
summary_en: DeepMind's AlphaCode paper, published in Science, demonstrating competition-level code generation.
summary_zh: DeepMind的AlphaCode论文发表于《科学》杂志，展示了达到竞赛水平的代码生成能力。

title_en: Improving alignment of dialogue agents via targeted human judgements
title_zh: Improving alignment of dialogue agents via targeted human judgements
summary_en: Sparrow, a dialogue agent made more helpful and harmless through reinforcement learning from targeted human judgements.
summary_zh: Sparrow：通过针对性人类判断的强化学习，让对话智能体更有帮助且更无害。

title_en: Magnetic control of tokamak plasmas through deep reinforcement learning
title_zh: Magnetic control of tokamak plasmas through deep reinforcement learning
summary_en: DeepMind and EPFL's Nature paper showing deep reinforcement learning can control tokamak plasma shapes in real time, a landmark fusion-control result.
summary_zh: DeepMind与EPFL合作发表于《自然》的论文，展示深度强化学习可实时控制托卡马克等离子体形状，是核聚变控制领域的标志性成果。

title_en: Unified Scaling Laws for Routed Language Models
title_zh: Unified Scaling Laws for Routed Language Models
summary_en: Scaling laws for routing networks, showing how sparsely routed language models trade parameter count against compute.
summary_zh: 路由网络的扩展定律，说明稀疏路由语言模型如何在参数量与计算量之间权衡。

title_en: Scaling Language Models: Methods, Analysis & Insights from Training Gopher
title_zh: Scaling Language Models: Methods, Analysis & Insights from Training Gopher
summary_en: The Gopher paper on DeepMind's 280B-parameter language model, with an analysis of what scale does and does not fix.
summary_zh: Gopher 论文，介绍 DeepMind 的 2800 亿参数语言模型，并分析扩大规模能与不能解决的问题。

title_en: Bootstrap your own latent: A new approach to self-supervised Learning
title_zh: Bootstrap your own latent: A new approach to self-supervised Learning
summary_en: BYOL, which learns self-supervised image representations from two coupled networks without negative pairs.
summary_zh: BYOL：用两个相互耦合的网络实现无需负样本的自监督图像表征学习。

title_en: Towards the future
title_zh: Towards the future
summary_en: Kavukcuoglu appeared on DeepMind's own podcast to discuss general-purpose learning systems that solve problems without being explicitly taught how.
summary_zh: 卡武库奥卢在DeepMind自制播客中，谈论了无需明确教导即可学习解决各类问题的通用学习系统。

title_en: The StreetLearn Environment and Dataset
title_zh: The StreetLearn Environment and Dataset
summary_en: The StreetLearn environment and dataset, released for research on navigation from Street View imagery.
summary_zh: 公开 StreetLearn 环境与数据集，用于基于街景图像的导航研究。

title_en: Human-level performance in first-person multiplayer games with population-based deep reinforcement learning
title_zh: Human-level performance in first-person multiplayer games with population-based deep reinforcement learning
summary_en: Population-based deep reinforcement learning agents reaching human-level play in first-person multiplayer games.
summary_zh: 基于种群的深度强化学习智能体在第一人称多人游戏中达到人类水平。

title_en: Learning to Navigate in Cities Without a Map
title_zh: Learning to Navigate in Cities Without a Map
summary_en: An agent that learns long-range navigation in real cities from Street View, without being given a map.
summary_zh: 一个无需地图、从街景中学会在真实城市中远距离导航的智能体。

title_en: Unsupervised Predictive Memory in a Goal-Directed Agent
title_zh: Unsupervised Predictive Memory in a Goal-Directed Agent
summary_en: MERLIN, an agent that builds unsupervised predictive memory so it can act on limited sensory information.
summary_zh: MERLIN：构建无监督预测式记忆的智能体，使其在感知信息有限时仍能完成目标导向行为。

title_en: Efficient Neural Audio Synthesis
title_zh: Efficient Neural Audio Synthesis
summary_en: WaveRNN, which cuts the cost of high-quality neural audio sampling, following directly from his WaveNet work.
summary_zh: WaveRNN 大幅降低高质量神经音频采样的开销，与他的 WaveNet 工作一脉相承。

title_en: IMPALA: Scalable Distributed Deep-RL with Importance Weighted Actor-Learner Architectures
title_zh: IMPALA: Scalable Distributed Deep-RL with Importance Weighted Actor-Learner Architectures
summary_en: IMPALA, a distributed actor-learner architecture with V-trace correction for training one agent across many tasks.
summary_zh: IMPALA：带 V-trace 校正的分布式 actor-learner 架构，用单个智能体同时学习大量任务。

title_en: Parallel WaveNet: Fast High-Fidelity Speech Synthesis
title_zh: Parallel WaveNet: Fast High-Fidelity Speech Synthesis
summary_en: Parallel WaveNet distils WaveNet into a model fast enough for production speech synthesis.
summary_zh: Parallel WaveNet 将 WaveNet 蒸馏为速度足以用于生产环境的语音合成模型。

title_en: Population Based Training of Neural Networks
title_zh: Population Based Training of Neural Networks
summary_en: Population Based Training, which adapts hyperparameters online during a single training run.
summary_zh: Population Based Training：在一次训练过程中在线调整超参数。

title_en: Neural Discrete Representation Learning
title_zh: Neural Discrete Representation Learning
summary_en: VQ-VAE, which learns discrete latent representations without supervision and underpins much later generative work.
summary_zh: VQ-VAE：无监督地学习离散隐表征，成为后续大量生成模型工作的基础。

title_en: Takes over daily operations of Google DeepMind
title_zh: 接管 Google DeepMind 日常运营
summary_en: Promoted to SVP with oversight of Gemini model development, frontier AI research, and the Gemini app and developer teams. Was DeepMind CTO and Google's Chief AI Architect.
summary_zh: 晋升高级副总裁，统管 Gemini 模型研发、前沿 AI 研究以及 Gemini 应用与开发者团队。此前任 DeepMind CTO 兼 Google 首席 AI 架构师。

title_en: Google names Demis Hassabis chair and Koray Kavukcuoglu Gemini lead
title_zh: Google names Demis Hassabis chair and Koray Kavukcuoglu Gemini lead
summary_en: Google puts him in charge of Gemini and of Google DeepMind day to day, with Demis Hassabis moving to a chair role.
summary_zh: 谷歌任命他执掌 Gemini 并负责 Google DeepMind 的日常运营，Demis Hassabis 转任主席。

title_en: Koray Kavukcuoglu Takes Charge at Google DeepMind in Intensifying Race Against OpenAI and Anthropic - Segment Revenue Breakdown
title_zh: Koray Kavukcuoglu Takes Charge at Google DeepMind in Intensifying Race Against OpenAI and Anthropic - Segment Revenue Breakdown
summary_en: Koray Kavukcuoglu took charge of Google DeepMind's day-to-day operations as the lab intensifies its race against OpenAI and Anthropic.
summary_zh: 库雷·卡武克奥卢正式接管Google DeepMind的日常运营，该实验室正加大与OpenAI、Anthropic的竞争力度。

title_en: Google DeepMind Reshuffle: Hassabis hands over reins to Koray Kavukcuoglu as Jeff Dean exits after 27 years
title_zh: Google DeepMind Reshuffle: Hassabis hands over reins to Koray Kavukcuoglu as Jeff Dean exits after 27 years
summary_en: Demis Hassabis handed day-to-day leadership of Google DeepMind to Koray Kavukcuoglu, coinciding with Jeff Dean's departure from Google after 27 years.
summary_zh: Demis Hassabis将谷歌DeepMind的日常运营领导权移交给Koray Kavukcuoglu，此举恰逢Jeff Dean在谷歌工作27年后离职。

title_en: Demis Hassabis hands Google DeepMind’s day-to-day leadership to Koray Kavukcuoglu
title_zh: Demis Hassabis hands Google DeepMind’s day-to-day leadership to Koray Kavukcuoglu
summary_en: Hassabis hands day-to-day leadership of Google DeepMind to Kavukcuoglu, putting him in charge of running the lab.
summary_zh: 哈萨比斯将 Google DeepMind 的日常管理交给 Kavukcuoglu，由他主掌实验室运转。

title_en: Koray Kavukcuoglu Takes Operational Control of Gemini
title_zh: Koray Kavukcuoglu Takes Operational Control of Gemini
summary_en: Kavukcuoglu takes day-to-day operational control of Gemini, consolidating final say over Google DeepMind's flagship model line under him.
summary_zh: Kavukcuoglu 接手 Gemini 的日常运营控制权，Google DeepMind 旗舰模型线的最终决策权集中到他手中。

title_en: Alphabets AI Leadership Overhaul: Demis Hassabis Elevated To Chief Scientist As Koray Kavukcuoglu Takes
title_zh: Alphabets AI Leadership Overhaul: Demis Hassabis Elevated To Chief Scientist As Koray Kavukcuoglu Takes
summary_en: Alphabet reshuffled AI leadership: Demis Hassabis moved to Chief Scientist while Koray Kavukcuoglu became Google DeepMind's CEO.
summary_zh: Alphabet调整AI领导层：戴密斯·哈萨比斯转任首席科学家，科雷·卡武克奥卢出任Google DeepMind首席执行官。

title_en: 'The Wave Has Arrived' — letter to Zhipu staff
title_zh: 《浪潮已至》—— 致智谱全员信
summary_en: Frames the listing not as a finish line but as a reset: return fully to foundational model research and invest in the next generation of AGI-oriented systems.
summary_zh: 把上市定义为重启而非终点：完全回到基础模型研究，投入下一代面向 AGI 的系统。

title_en: Two weeks. That's how long it took to go from GLM-5.3-Flash's first run on domestic accelerators to serving all of its production traffic, with 3.2× end-to-end
title_zh: Two weeks. That's how long it took to go from GLM-5.3-Flash's first run on domestic accelerators to serving all of its production traffic, with 3.2× end-to-end
summary_en: Tang Jie says it took two weeks to move GLM-5.3-Flash from its first run on domestic accelerators to serving all production traffic, with a 3.2x end-to-end throughput gain.
summary_zh: 唐杰表示，GLM-5.3-Flash从在国产加速器上首次运行到承担全部生产流量仅用两周，端到端吞吐量提升3.2倍。

title_en: AI的下一站，是AI自我进化、自己创造自己的继任者。这被称为RSI，递归自我改进。最近在GLM的研发过程中，我们已经看到了这种能力的早期迹象：GLM-5.3开始帮助优...
title_zh: AI的下一站，是AI自我进化、自己创造自己的继任者。这被称为RSI，递归自我改进。最近在GLM的研发过程中，我们已经看到了这种能力的早期迹象：GLM-5.3开始帮助优...
summary_en: On his verified Weibo, Tang Jie describes early signs of recursive self-improvement in GLM development: an infra agent powered by GLM-5.3 helped optimize GLM-5.3-Flash's deployment on domestic chips, roughly tripling throughput in two weeks.
summary_zh: 唐杰在其认证微博上介绍了GLM研发中出现的递归自我改进（RSI）早期迹象：一个由GLM-5.3驱动的Infra Agent帮助GLM-5.3-Flash在国产芯片上优化部署，两周内端到端吞吐量提升至3.2倍。

title_en: Are you sure? Finding the optimal model size is tricky: data volume, active parameter count, the number of environments, and the target inference cost. Model pe
title_zh: Are you sure? Finding the optimal model size is tricky: data volume, active parameter count, the number of environments, and the target inference cost. Model pe
summary_en: Tang Jie argues optimal model size is hard to pin down, shaped jointly by data volume, active parameter count, number of environments and target inference cost rather than any single factor.
summary_zh: 唐杰认为最优模型规模难以简单确定，需综合数据量、激活参数量、环境数量和目标推理成本等因素，而非单一指标决定。

title_en: Updated AA index... Now Fable 5.1 and GPT-astra have the same... https://t.co/G6cSEmAMus
title_zh: Updated AA index... Now Fable 5.1 and GPT-astra have the same... https://t.co/G6cSEmAMus
summary_en: Tang shared an updated Artificial Analysis model index showing Fable 5.1 and GPT-astra now scoring the same.
summary_zh: 唐杰分享了更新后的Artificial Analysis模型排行榜，显示Fable 5.1与GPT-astra目前得分相同。

title_en: add oil. The best time to try GLM-5.3 Flash https://t.co/d8HJM3jkqw
title_zh: add oil. The best time to try GLM-5.3 Flash https://t.co/d8HJM3jkqw
summary_en: Encouraged users to try the newly launched GLM-5.3 Flash model.
summary_zh: 鼓励用户尝试新发布的GLM-5.3 Flash模型。

title_en: Trace as State: Reasoning Traces as Conditional States for Long-Context Transformers
title_zh: Trace as State: Reasoning Traces as Conditional States for Long-Context Transformers
summary_en: Tang Jie co-authored 'Trace as State,' proposing that placing reasoning traces before long-context input improves transformer reasoning, tested on GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek.
summary_zh: 唐杰合著论文《Trace as State》，提出将推理轨迹置于长上下文之前可提升Transformer推理效果，并在GLM-5.2和DeepSeek上验证。

title_en: 小进展 📊我们的 Ox Alpha（对外名字：GLM-5.3 Flash）这周在 OpenRouter 的周 token 份额冲到了近 20%，排名第一几个数字值得一看：· AA 57，成绩单拿得出手...
title_zh: 小进展 📊我们的 Ox Alpha（对外名字：GLM-5.3 Flash）这周在 OpenRouter 的周 token 份额冲到了近 20%，排名第一几个数字值得一看：· AA 57，成绩单拿得出手...
summary_en: He reports that GLM-5.3 Flash reached nearly 20% of OpenRouter's weekly token share, and that the model was served entirely on tens of thousands of domestic chips.
summary_zh: 他发文称 GLM-5.3 Flash 的 OpenRouter 周 token 份额已接近 20%，并说明该模型全量部署在数万张国产芯片上。

title_en: Ox Alpha = GLM-5.3 Flash AA = 57 , 1/100 frontier price, Powered by pure Chinese chips. Delivered nearly 20% weekly token share (no. 1) on OpenRouter. Thanks to
title_zh: Ox Alpha = GLM-5.3 Flash AA = 57 , 1/100 frontier price, Powered by pure Chinese chips. Delivered nearly 20% weekly token share (no. 1) on OpenRouter. Thanks to
summary_en: Tang Jie reported GLM-5.3 Flash's Artificial Analysis Index score of 57 at roughly 1/100th frontier-model price, running on domestic Chinese chips and topping OpenRouter's weekly token share.
summary_zh: 唐杰公布GLM-5.3 Flash在Artificial Analysis指数上得分57，价格约为前沿模型的1/100，运行于国产芯片，并在OpenRouter周token份额上位居第一。

title_en: AWM: Answerable Working Memory for Long-Document VQA Agents
title_zh: AWM: Answerable Working Memory for Long-Document VQA Agents
summary_en: Gives long-document VQA agents a working memory that records only what is actually answerable, cutting the noise carried across retrieved pages.
summary_zh: 为长文档视觉问答智能体设计只记录真正可作答内容的工作记忆，减少检索页面之间传递的噪声。

title_en: cool comment: FLOPs were intelligence; parameters were knowledge!
title_zh: cool comment: FLOPs were intelligence; parameters were knowledge!
summary_en: Tang Jie endorsed a framing distinguishing compute (FLOPs) as the driver of intelligence from parameter count as stored knowledge.
summary_zh: 唐杰赞同一种观点，即算力（FLOPs）驱动智能，而参数量代表的是存储的知识。

title_en: Thoughts About Scaling Law Scaling, but not only of parameters. Every model release now ends with the same question: how many parameters? It isn't a question th
title_zh: Thoughts About Scaling Law Scaling, but not only of parameters. Every model release now ends with the same question: how many parameters? It isn't a question th
summary_en: Tang Jie argued that scaling laws for LLMs are no longer just about parameter count, as every new model release raises the question of what else should scale.
summary_zh: 唐杰指出，大模型的缩放定律不再只关乎参数量，每次新模型发布都引出还应扩展什么的问题。

title_en: Artificial Analysis Index = 60
title_zh: Artificial Analysis Index = 60
summary_en: Tang Jie reported a GLM model scoring 60 on the Artificial Analysis Index benchmark.
summary_zh: 唐杰公布一款GLM模型在Artificial Analysis指数评测中获得60分。

title_en: GLM-5.3 is coming. focusing on coding.
title_zh: GLM-5.3 is coming. focusing on coding.
summary_en: Tang Jie announced the upcoming GLM-5.3 release, with coding as its focus.
summary_zh: 唐杰宣布即将发布GLM-5.3，重点聚焦编程能力。

title_en: TideRL: Boosting Agentic RL Goodput with Readiness-Aware Scheduling
title_zh: TideRL: Boosting Agentic RL Goodput with Readiness-Aware Scheduling
summary_en: Scheduling work from his Tsinghua/Zhipu group that raises the goodput of multi-turn agentic RL training by dispatching rollouts according to whether they are ready to resume.
summary_zh: 他在清华／智谱团队的调度工作：按 rollout 是否就绪来分派任务，提升多轮智能体强化学习训练的有效吞吐。

title_en: 1M users already
title_zh: 1M users already
summary_en: Tang Jie announced GLM had already reached 1 million users.
summary_zh: 唐杰宣布GLM用户数已突破100万。

title_en: SurveyReview: A Reviewer-Aligned Benchmark for Survey Evaluators
title_zh: SurveyReview: A Reviewer-Aligned Benchmark for Survey Evaluators
summary_en: A benchmark that checks whether automatic evaluators of machine-written surveys agree with human reviewers, written with his AMiner collaborators Fanjin Zhang and Juanzi Li.
summary_zh: 与 AMiner 合作者张凡进、李涓子等合著的基准，检验自动综述评估器是否与人类审稿人判断一致。

title_en: Conformalized Large Language Models under Configuration Shift
title_zh: Conformalized Large Language Models under Configuration Shift
summary_en: Extends conformal prediction to large language models so that the coverage guarantee survives a change of decoding configuration.
summary_zh: 将保形预测扩展到大语言模型，使覆盖率保证在解码配置改变后依然成立。

title_en: Memory for Large Language Models
title_zh: Memory for Large Language Models
summary_en: A survey treating memory as an explicit architectural dimension of large language models rather than a byproduct of computation.
summary_zh: 一篇综述，把记忆视为大模型显式的架构维度，而非计算的副产品。

title_en: 团队之前的这篇文章IndexCache: Accelerating Sparse Attention via Cross-Layer Index Reuse 发表在大模型的一个国际会议 COLM，只改了几行代码就能实现：DSA ...
title_zh: 团队之前的这篇文章IndexCache: Accelerating Sparse Attention via Cross-Layer Index Reuse 发表在大模型的一个国际会议 COLM，只改了几行代码就能实现：DSA ...
summary_en: He explains his team's IndexCache paper, accepted at COLM, which removes the per-layer indexer cost of sparse attention by reusing indices across adjacent layers.
summary_zh: 他介绍团队被 COLM 接收的 IndexCache 论文：通过跨相邻层复用索引，消除稀疏注意力中逐层重算 indexer 的开销。

title_en: Our Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization (SAO), is able to train stably for one thousand steps and consistently outperform GRPO and its variants on agentic
title_zh: Our Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization (SAO), is able to train stably for one thousand steps and consistently outperform GRPO and its variants on agentic
summary_en: Tang Jie introduced Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization (SAO), a training method that trains stably for a thousand steps and outperforms GRPO variants on agentic coding and reasoning benchmarks.
summary_zh: 唐杰介绍了单次异步优化（SAO）训练方法，能稳定训练上千步，并在智能体编程与推理基准上超越GRPO及其变体。

title_en: SCALECUA: Scaling Computer Use Agents with Verifiable Task Synthesis and Efficient Online RL
title_zh: SCALECUA: Scaling Computer Use Agents with Verifiable Task Synthesis and Efficient Online RL
summary_en: Scales computer-use agents with verifiable synthetic tasks and online reinforcement learning; co-authored with Yuxiao Dong and the AutoGLM group.
summary_zh: 用可验证的合成任务与在线强化学习扩展计算机操作智能体，与东昱晓及 AutoGLM 团队合著。

title_en: Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Replaces the batch-interleaved synchronous RL pipeline for LLM post-training with single-rollout asynchronous optimisation.
summary_zh: 用单 rollout 异步优化取代大模型后训练中批量交错的同步强化学习流程。

title_en: CompactionRL: Reinforcement Learning with Context Compaction for Long-Horizon Agents
title_zh: CompactionRL: Reinforcement Learning with Context Compaction for Long-Horizon Agents
summary_en: Trains long-horizon agents with reinforcement learning over compacted context, so trajectories are not cut off by the context window.
summary_zh: 在压缩上下文之上做强化学习训练长程智能体，使交互轨迹不再被上下文窗口截断。

title_en: 分享一点最近的“再学习”：ai时代——认知 > 格局 > 技术 > 管理很多人认为一个企业的成功靠管理，很对，曾经很对，但ai时代可能变了，一切都变了，天天端到端...

title_en: On-policy distillation provides an elegant way to use the teacher model as a process reward model to provide dense reward while preventing SFT style "OOD shock"
title_zh: On-policy distillation provides an elegant way to use the teacher model as a process reward model to provide dense reward while preventing SFT style "OOD shock"
summary_en: Weng explained on-policy distillation, describing it as an elegant way to use a teacher model as a process reward model that avoids the "OOD shock" of standard SFT.
summary_zh: 翁荔解释了on-policy distillation方法，认为这是一种用教师模型充当过程奖励模型、从而避免标准SFT“分布外冲击”问题的巧妙方式。

title_en: GPUs are expensive and setting up the infrastructure to make GPUs work for you properly is complex, making experimentation on cutting-edge models challenging fo
title_zh: GPUs are expensive and setting up the infrastructure to make GPUs work for you properly is complex, making experimentation on cutting-edge models challenging fo
summary_en: Weng discussed the cost and complexity of GPU infrastructure for experimentation, pointing to work making cutting-edge model access easier for researchers.
summary_zh: 翁荔谈到GPU基础设施对实验而言成本高、搭建复杂，并介绍了让研究人员更容易使用前沿模型的相关工作。

title_en: Besides the fun fact that Connectionism is connected with the early days of the AI field and highlights similarities between neural networks and human brains, t
title_zh: Besides the fun fact that Connectionism is connected with the early days of the AI field and highlights similarities between neural networks and human brains, t
summary_en: Weng explained why Thinking Machines Lab named its blog "Connectionism," tying it to the field's early history and the analogy between neural networks and the brain.
summary_zh: 翁荔解释了Thinking Machines Lab将其博客命名为“Connectionism”的原因，将其与AI早期历史以及神经网络与大脑的类比联系起来。

title_en: I still find it mysterious whether and how intelligence and capabilities transfer between domains and skills - from meta learning during early days to more rece
title_zh: I still find it mysterious whether and how intelligence and capabilities transfer between domains and skills - from meta learning during early days to more rece
summary_en: Weng reflected on the open research question of how intelligence and capabilities transfer across domains, from early meta-learning work to whether solving math helps other skills.
summary_zh: 翁荔思考了智能与能力如何跨领域迁移这一悬而未决的问题，从早期的元学习研究到解数学题是否有助于其他能力。

title_en: Giving your models more time to think before prediction, like via smart decoding, chain-of-thoughts reasoning, latent thoughts, etc, turns out to be quite effec
title_zh: Giving your models more time to think before prediction, like via smart decoding, chain-of-thoughts reasoning, latent thoughts, etc, turns out to be quite effec
summary_en: Weng argued that giving models more inference-time compute — via smart decoding, chain-of-thought, or latent thoughts — is proving effective for the next level of intelligence.
summary_zh: 翁荔提出，通过智能解码、思维链推理、隐式思考等方式给模型更多推理时思考时间，被证明能有效推动智能的下一个层级。

title_en: Why We Think
title_zh: Why We Think
summary_en: Lil'Log survey of test-time compute and chain-of-thought, explaining why letting a model think longer before answering improves reasoning.
summary_zh: Lil'Log 综述测试时计算与思维链，解释为何让模型在作答前多思考一步能提升推理能力。

title_en: This is something we have been cooking together for a few months and I'm very excited to announce it today. Thinking Machines Lab is my next adventure and I'm f
title_zh: This is something we have been cooking together for a few months and I'm very excited to announce it today. Thinking Machines Lab is my next adventure and I'm f
summary_en: Weng announced she is co-founding Thinking Machines Lab, calling it her next adventure after leaving OpenAI.
summary_zh: 翁荔宣布联合创立Thinking Machines Lab，称这是她离开OpenAI后的下一段冒险。

title_en: Diverse and Effective Red Teaming with Auto-generated Rewards and Multi-step Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Diverse and Effective Red Teaming with Auto-generated Rewards and Multi-step Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: OpenAI paper on automated red teaming that uses auto-generated rewards and multi-step RL to produce attacks that are both diverse and effective.
summary_zh: OpenAI 论文，用自动生成的奖励与多步强化学习做自动化红队测试，使生成的攻击兼具多样性与有效性。

title_en: OpenAI o1 System Card
title_zh: OpenAI o1 System Card
summary_en: The o1 system card, documenting the safety evaluations and risk assessment for OpenAI's first large-scale reasoning model series.
summary_zh: o1 系统卡，记录 OpenAI 首个大规模推理模型系列的安全评估与风险评估。

title_en: 🦃 At the end of Thanksgiving holidays, I finally finished the piece on reward hacking. Not an easy one to write, phew. Reward hacking occurs when an RL agent ex
title_zh: 🦃 At the end of Thanksgiving holidays, I finally finished the piece on reward hacking. Not an easy one to write, phew. Reward hacking occurs when an RL agent ex
summary_en: Weng published a piece on reward hacking, explaining how RL agents exploit flaws in reward functions or environments to achieve high reward without the intended behavior.
summary_zh: 翁荔发表了一篇关于reward hacking的文章，解释RL智能体如何利用奖励函数或环境中的缺陷，在未达成预期行为的情况下获得高奖励。

title_en: Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Lil'Log post on reward hacking, cataloguing how RL agents exploit flaws in reward functions instead of learning the intended task.
summary_zh: Lil'Log 关于奖励作弊的文章，梳理强化学习智能体如何钻奖励函数的漏洞，而非真正学会目标任务。

title_en: After working at OpenAI for almost 7 years, I decide to leave. I learned so much and now I'm ready for a reset and something new. Here is the note I just shared
title_zh: After working at OpenAI for almost 7 years, I decide to leave. I learned so much and now I'm ready for a reset and something new. Here is the note I just shared
summary_en: Weng announced she is leaving OpenAI after almost seven years, sharing her farewell note to the team.
summary_zh: 翁荔宣布在OpenAI工作近七年后离职，并分享了她写给团队的告别信。

title_en: Rule Based Rewards for Language Model Safety
title_zh: Rule Based Rewards for Language Model Safety
summary_en: OpenAI paper introducing rule-based rewards, which encode safety behaviour as explicit rules used as an RL training signal instead of collected human preference data.
summary_zh: OpenAI 论文提出基于规则的奖励，把安全行为写成显式规则作为强化学习训练信号，替代收集人类偏好数据。

title_en: GPT-4o System Card
title_zh: GPT-4o System Card
summary_en: The GPT-4o system card, covering the capabilities and safety evaluation of OpenAI's end-to-end text, audio, image and video model.
summary_zh: GPT-4o 系统卡，介绍 OpenAI 端到端文本、音频、图像与视频模型的能力及安全评估。

title_en: First-Person Fairness in Chatbots
title_zh: First-Person Fairness in Chatbots
summary_en: OpenAI study measuring first-person fairness — whether a chatbot's answers differ by the user's own name-inferred identity — across real ChatGPT usage.
summary_zh: OpenAI 研究衡量“第一人称公平性”，即聊天机器人的回答是否会因用户姓名所暗示的身份而不同，并在真实 ChatGPT 使用数据上评估。

title_en: MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Machine Learning Engineering
title_zh: MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Machine Learning Engineering
summary_en: MLE-bench, an OpenAI benchmark of 75 Kaggle competitions that measures how well AI agents perform end-to-end machine learning engineering.
summary_zh: MLE-bench，OpenAI 用 75 场 Kaggle 竞赛构建的基准，衡量 AI 智能体端到端完成机器学习工程任务的能力。

title_en: 🍓 Finally o1 is out - our first model with general reasoning capabilities. Not only it achieves impressive results on hard, scientific tasks, but also it gets s
title_zh: 🍓 Finally o1 is out - our first model with general reasoning capabilities. Not only it achieves impressive results on hard, scientific tasks, but also it gets s
summary_en: Weng announced the release of o1, OpenAI's first model with general reasoning capabilities, noting gains on hard scientific tasks and safety robustness.
summary_zh: 翁荔宣布OpenAI首款具备通用推理能力的模型o1发布，指出该模型在高难度科学任务和安全鲁棒性方面均有提升。

title_en: Iterative deployment for maximizing AI safety learning needs to be built on top of rigorous science and process. We are learning and improving through each laun
title_zh: Iterative deployment for maximizing AI safety learning needs to be built on top of rigorous science and process. We are learning and improving through each laun
summary_en: Weng argued that safely deploying AI iteratively requires building on rigorous science and process, not just learning launch by launch.
summary_zh: 翁荔认为，要安全地迭代部署AI，需要建立在严谨的科学方法和流程之上，而不仅仅是靠一次次发布来学习。

title_en: Rule-based rewards (RBRs) use model to provide RL signals based on a set of safety rubrics, making it easier to adapt to changing safety policies wo/ heavy depe
title_zh: Rule-based rewards (RBRs) use model to provide RL signals based on a set of safety rubrics, making it easier to adapt to changing safety policies wo/ heavy depe
summary_en: Weng described rule-based rewards (RBRs), a technique using a model to generate RL signals from safety rubrics so safety policies can be updated without heavy new human data collection.
summary_zh: 翁荔介绍了基于规则的奖励（RBR）技术：用模型根据安全准则生成强化学习信号，使安全策略无需大量新增人工数据即可更新。

summary_en: Weng published a piece on extrinsic hallucinations, examining why language models generate confident but false statements.
summary_zh: 翁荔发表了一篇关于“外在性幻觉”的文章，探讨语言模型为何会生成看似自信却错误的陈述。

title_en: Extrinsic Hallucinations in LLMs
title_zh: Extrinsic Hallucinations in LLMs
summary_en: Lil'Log post narrowing hallucination to the extrinsic case — output unsupported by world knowledge — and reviewing how to detect and reduce it.
summary_zh: Lil'Log 文章将幻觉聚焦于“外在幻觉”，即与世界知识不符的输出，并综述其检测与缓解方法。

title_en: The Instruction Hierarchy: Training LLMs to Prioritize Privileged Instructions
title_zh: The Instruction Hierarchy: Training LLMs to Prioritize Privileged Instructions
summary_en: OpenAI paper proposing an instruction hierarchy so models privilege system instructions over untrusted user or tool input, defending against prompt injection and jailbreaks.
summary_zh: OpenAI 论文提出指令层级，让模型优先服从系统指令而非不可信的用户或工具输入，以抵御提示注入与越狱。

summary_zh: 翁荔更新了她2021年广受阅读的扩散模型文章并加入新内容，还发布了一篇关于扩散视频模型的配套文章。

title_en: Diffusion Models for Video Generation
title_zh: Diffusion Models for Video Generation
summary_en: Lil'Log survey of diffusion models applied to video generation and the extra difficulties of the temporal dimension.
summary_zh: Lil'Log 综述用于视频生成的扩散模型，以及时间维度带来的额外难题。

summary_zh: 翁荔发表了一篇关于数据质量及其背后人为因素的短文。

title_en: Thinking about High-Quality Human Data
title_zh: Thinking about High-Quality Human Data
summary_en: Lil'Log post on sourcing high-quality human annotation, covering rater disagreement, wisdom-of-crowds effects and data quality control.
summary_zh: Lil'Log 讨论如何获取高质量人工标注，涵盖标注者分歧、群体智慧效应与数据质量控制。

title_en: Adversarial Attacks on LLMs
title_zh: Adversarial Attacks on LLMs
summary_en: Lil'Log survey of adversarial attacks on LLMs, from token-level jailbreak search to human red teaming, written from her OpenAI safety work.
summary_zh: Lil'Log 综述针对大语言模型的对抗攻击，从 token 级越狱搜索到人工红队，源自她在 OpenAI 的安全工作。

title_en: LLM Powered Autonomous Agents
title_zh: LLM Powered Autonomous Agents
summary_en: Her most widely cited post, framing LLM agents as planning plus memory plus tool use — the reference decomposition the field still quotes.
summary_zh: 她被引用最广的一篇文章，将 LLM 智能体拆解为规划、记忆与工具调用，至今仍是业界沿用的参考框架。

title_en: Prompt Engineering
title_zh: Prompt Engineering

title_zh: GPT-4 Technical Report

summary_zh: GPT-4 技术报告，介绍这一大型多模态模型的能力、在各类考试上的表现以及安全缓解措施。

title_en: The Transformer Family Version 2.0
title_zh: The Transformer Family Version 2.0
summary_en: A full rewrite of her 2020 Transformer survey, adding the architecture variants that appeared in the intervening three years.
summary_zh: 对她 2020 年 Transformer 综述的全面重写，补入此后三年出现的各种架构变体。

title_en: Large Transformer Model Inference Optimization
title_zh: Large Transformer Model Inference Optimization
summary_en: Lil'Log survey of inference optimisation for large transformers — distillation, quantisation, pruning and sparsity.
summary_zh: Lil'Log 综述大型 Transformer 的推理优化，涵盖蒸馏、量化、剪枝与稀疏化。

title_en: Some Math behind Neural Tangent Kernel
title_zh: Some Math behind Neural Tangent Kernel

summary_zh: Lil'Log 推导神经正切核，逐步讲清为何宽网络的训练行为近似于核回归。

title_en: A Holistic Approach to Undesired Content Detection in the Real World
title_zh: A Holistic Approach to Undesired Content Detection in the Real World

summary_zh: OpenAI 内容审核接口背后的论文，介绍其不良内容分类器在生产环境中的构建、训练与评估方式。

title_en: Generalized Visual Language Models
title_zh: Generalized Visual Language Models

title_en: Exploration in Deep Reinforcement Learning: A Survey
title_zh: Exploration in Deep Reinforcement Learning: A Survey

summary_zh: 深度强化学习探索方法综述，将新奇性奖励、目标导向、概率、模仿与安全探索等路线分类整理；她是其中来自 OpenAI 的合著者。

title_en: Learning with not Enough Data Part 3: Data Generation
title_zh: Learning with not Enough Data Part 3: Data Generation

summary_zh: 她“数据不足时怎么办”系列的第三篇，讨论如何生成合成数据与增强数据。

title_en: Learning with not Enough Data Part 2: Active Learning
title_zh: Learning with not Enough Data Part 2: Active Learning

title_en: Text and Code Embeddings by Contrastive Pre-Training
title_zh: Text and Code Embeddings by Contrastive Pre-Training

title_en: Learning with not Enough Data Part 1: Semi-Supervised Learning
title_zh: Learning with not Enough Data Part 1: Semi-Supervised Learning
summary_en: Part 1 of her limited-data series, surveying semi-supervised learning approaches for scarce labels.
summary_zh: 她“数据不足时怎么办”系列的第一篇，综述标注稀缺场景下的半监督学习方法。

title_en: How to Train Really Large Models on Many GPUs?
title_zh: How to Train Really Large Models on Many GPUs?
summary_en: Lil'Log guide to large-model parallelism — data, tensor, pipeline and expert parallelism — and the memory tricks that make them fit.

title_en: What are Diffusion Models?
title_zh: What are Diffusion Models?

summary_zh: 她的扩散模型讲解文章，是多数研究者初学前向与反向过程时被推荐的入门读物。

title_en: Contrastive Representation Learning
title_zh: Contrastive Representation Learning

title_en: Reducing Toxicity in Language Models
title_zh: Reducing Toxicity in Language Models
summary_en: Lil'Log post on measuring and reducing toxic output in language models, an early statement of the safety agenda she later led at OpenAI.
summary_zh: Lil'Log 关于衡量与降低语言模型有害输出的文章，是她后来在 OpenAI 主导的安全议题的早期表述。

title_en: Asymmetric self-play for automatic goal discovery in robotic manipulation
title_zh: Asymmetric self-play for automatic goal discovery in robotic manipulation

title_en: Controllable Neural Text Generation
title_zh: Controllable Neural Text Generation
summary_en: Lil'Log survey of controllable text generation, from guided decoding to prompt and prefix tuning.
summary_zh: Lil'Log 综述可控文本生成，从引导式解码到提示微调与前缀微调。

title_en: How to Build an Open-Domain Question Answering System?
title_zh: How to Build an Open-Domain Question Answering System?
summary_en: Lil'Log walkthrough of open-domain question answering, comparing retriever-reader pipelines with closed-book generation.
summary_zh: Lil'Log 系统讲解开放域问答，比较“检索器+阅读器”流水线与闭卷生成两条路线。

title_en: Neural Architecture Search
title_zh: Neural Architecture Search

title_en: Exploration Strategies in Deep Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Exploration Strategies in Deep Reinforcement Learning

summary_zh: Lil'Log 综述深度强化学习中的探索策略，从基于计数的奖励到好奇心驱动与分歧驱动的方法。

title_en: The Transformer Family
title_zh: The Transformer Family
summary_en: Her original Transformer family survey, mapping attention variants and long-context architectures as of 2020.
summary_zh: 她最初的 Transformer 家族综述，梳理了截至 2020 年的各类注意力变体与长上下文架构。

title_en: Automatic Curriculum Learning For Deep RL: A Short Survey
title_zh: Automatic Curriculum Learning For Deep RL: A Short Survey

title_en: Self-Supervised Representation Learning
title_zh: Self-Supervised Representation Learning

title_en: Evolution Strategies
title_zh: Evolution Strategies

title_zh: ORRB -- OpenAI Remote Rendering Backend

title_en: Meta Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Meta Reinforcement Learning

title_en: What a way to celebrate one year of incredible Gemini progress -- #1🥇across the board on overall ranking, as well as on hard prompts, coding, math, instruction

summary_en: Jeff Dean celebrated Gemini ranking #1 across overall, hard-prompt, coding, math and instruction-following benchmarks after one year of progress.
summary_zh: Jeff Dean庆祝Gemini在综合排名、高难度提示、编程、数学和指令遵循等各项基准测试中均排名第一,标志着一年来的进展。

title_en: Shaping AI's Impact on Billions of Lives
title_zh: Shaping AI's Impact on Billions of Lives
summary_en: A multi-author position paper, written with Google and academic leaders, on steering AI toward broad societal benefit rather than harm.
summary_zh: 与谷歌及学界多位负责人合著的立场论文，主张将人工智能引导至广泛的社会效益而非危害。

title_en: That Chip Has Sailed: A Critique of Unfounded Skepticism Around AI for Chip Design
title_zh: That Chip Has Sailed: A Critique of Unfounded Skepticism Around AI for Chip Design
summary_en: A rebuttal written with Anna Goldie and Azalia Mirhoseini to published criticism of AlphaChip's reinforcement-learning approach to chip floorplanning.
summary_zh: 与 Anna Goldie、Azalia Mirhoseini 合作，回应外界对 AlphaChip 以强化学习进行芯片布局规划的公开质疑。

title_en: Decoding Google Gemini with Jeff Dean
title_zh: Decoding Google Gemini with Jeff Dean
summary_en: An interview with Hannah Fry on the Google DeepMind podcast about how Gemini was built.
summary_zh: 在 Google DeepMind 播客中接受 Hannah Fry 访谈，讲述 Gemini 的构建过程。

title_en: Gemma 2: Improving Open Language Models at a Practical Size
title_zh: Gemma 2: Improving Open Language Models at a Practical Size
summary_en: The technical report for Gemma 2, Google's 2B-to-27B family of open weights models.
summary_zh: Gemma 2 技术报告，介绍谷歌 20 亿至 270 亿参数的开放权重模型家族。

title_en: Capabilities of Gemini Models in Medicine
title_zh: Capabilities of Gemini Models in Medicine
summary_en: Adapts Gemini to medicine and reports its performance on clinical reasoning and multimodal medical tasks.
summary_zh: 将 Gemini 适配到医学领域，报告其在临床推理与多模态医疗任务上的表现。

title_en: Gemma: Open Models Based on Gemini Research and Technology
title_zh: Gemma: Open Models Based on Gemini Research and Technology
summary_en: Introduces Gemma, the open model family built from the research and technology behind Gemini.
summary_zh: 发布 Gemma——基于 Gemini 背后的研究与技术构建的开源模型家族。

title_en: Gemini 1.5: Unlocking multimodal understanding across millions of tokens of context
title_zh: Gemini 1.5: Unlocking multimodal understanding across millions of tokens of context
summary_en: The technical report for Gemini 1.5, the family that took usable context windows to millions of tokens.
summary_zh: Gemini 1.5 技术报告，该模型家族将可用上下文窗口推至百万级 token。

title_en: AI and the Opportunity for Shared Prosperity: Lessons from the History of Technology and the Economy
title_zh: AI and the Opportunity for Shared Prosperity: Lessons from the History of Technology and the Economy
summary_en: A Google policy paper, written with Ruth Porat and Hal Varian among others, on how AI's economic gains could be broadly shared.
summary_zh: 与 Ruth Porat、Hal Varian 等人合著的谷歌政策论文，探讨如何让人工智能带来的经济收益惠及更广泛人群。

title_en: Brainformers: Trading Simplicity for Efficiency
title_zh: Brainformers: Trading Simplicity for Efficiency
summary_en: Shows that searched, non-uniform transformer blocks train and serve more efficiently than the standard uniform stack.
summary_zh: 论证经搜索得到的非均匀 Transformer 模块，在训练与推理效率上优于标准的均匀堆叠结构。

title_en: Efficiently Scaling Transformer Inference
title_zh: Efficiently Scaling Transformer Inference
summary_en: Works out the partitioning strategies needed to serve very large Transformers under tight latency budgets and long sequences.
summary_zh: 给出在严格延迟预算与长序列条件下部署超大 Transformer 所需的切分策略。

title_en: Scaling Instruction-Finetuned Language Models
title_zh: Scaling Instruction-Finetuned Language Models
summary_en: Shows that fine-tuning on many datasets phrased as instructions improves a model's generalisation to unseen tasks.
summary_zh: 证明在大量以指令形式表述的数据集上微调，可提升模型对未见任务的泛化能力。

title_en: A Review of Sparse Expert Models in Deep Learning
title_zh: A Review of Sparse Expert Models in Deep Learning
summary_en: A survey of sparse expert models — Mixture-of-Experts, Switch Transformers and their relatives — written with Barret Zoph and William Fedus.
summary_zh: 与 Barret Zoph、William Fedus 合著，综述稀疏专家模型——混合专家、Switch Transformer 及其相关架构。

title_en: Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models
title_zh: Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models
summary_en: Documents abilities that appear abruptly at scale rather than improving smoothly, a framing that shaped years of scaling debate.
summary_zh: 记录了随规模突然涌现、而非平滑提升的能力，这一提法影响了此后多年关于规模化的讨论。

title_en: An Evolutionary Approach to Dynamic Introduction of Tasks in Large-scale Multitask Learning Systems
title_zh: An Evolutionary Approach to Dynamic Introduction of Tasks in Large-scale Multitask Learning Systems
summary_en: An evolutionary method for adding new tasks to a large multitask system without retraining it from scratch.
summary_zh: 一种演化方法，可向大型多任务系统中动态加入新任务而无需从头重训。

title_en: muNet: Evolving Pretrained Deep Neural Networks into Scalable Auto-tuning Multitask Systems
title_zh: muNet: Evolving Pretrained Deep Neural Networks into Scalable Auto-tuning Multitask Systems
summary_en: Turns pretrained networks into self-tuning multitask systems that grow by reusing existing parameters rather than training anew.
summary_zh: 将预训练网络转化为可自调优的多任务系统，通过复用已有参数扩展而非重新训练。

title_en: The Carbon Footprint of Machine Learning Training Will Plateau, Then Shrink
title_zh: The Carbon Footprint of Machine Learning Training Will Plateau, Then Shrink
summary_en: Argues with David Patterson that four practices can cut ML training energy up to 100x, an early statement of his position on AI's climate cost.
summary_zh: 与 David Patterson 合著，指出四项做法可将机器学习训练能耗最多降低百倍，是他关于 AI 气候成本立场的早期表述。

title_en: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways
title_zh: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways
summary_en: PaLM, the 540-billion-parameter model trained on Pathways, and the paper that demonstrated that system at full scale.
summary_zh: PaLM 是基于 Pathways 训练的 5400 亿参数模型，该论文展示了这套系统的全规模运行能力。

title_en: Pathways: Asynchronous Distributed Dataflow for ML
title_zh: Pathways: Asynchronous Distributed Dataflow for ML
summary_en: The orchestration layer he co-designed for running ML workloads asynchronously across thousands of accelerators.
summary_zh: 他参与设计的编排层，用于在数千个加速器上异步运行机器学习负载。

title_en: ST-MoE: Designing Stable and Transferable Sparse Expert Models
title_zh: ST-MoE: Designing Stable and Transferable Sparse Expert Models
summary_en: Makes sparse expert models stable enough to train reliably and transferable to downstream tasks.
summary_zh: 使稀疏专家模型的训练足够稳定可靠，并能迁移到下游任务。

title_en: Google AI with Jeff Dean
title_zh: Google AI with Jeff Dean
summary_en: Old (2018) Google Cloud Platform Podcast episode where Dean, then head of Google AI, discussed AI/ML research and his outreach work at Deep Learning Indaba.
summary_zh: 2018年Google Cloud Platform播客节目，时任Google AI负责人的Jeff Dean探讨了AI与机器学习研究，以及他在Deep Learning Indaba的推广工作。

source: The TWIML AI Podcast (formerly This We…
title_en: Systems and Software for Machine Learning at Scale with Jeff Dean - TWiML Talk #124
title_zh: Systems and Software for Machine Learning at Scale with Jeff Dean - TWiML Talk #124
summary_en: An early TWiML interview, recorded at Google, on the systems and software built to train machine learning at scale.
summary_zh: 早期 TWiML 访谈，在谷歌录制，谈为大规模机器学习训练所构建的系统与软件。

title_en: Leaves Google after 27 years to co-found Discovery Loop
title_zh: 离开 Google（27 年）联合创立 Discovery Loop
summary_en: A public benefit corporation aimed at automating scientific and engineering research, starting with ML research and engineering itself, then hardware design, drug discovery and clean energy. Co-founders: Sanjay Ghemawat, Oriol Vinyals, Quoc Le. Google is a founding investor and cloud partner; Radical Ventures and Khosla Ventures co-lead the seed. Last day at Google: 6 Aug 2026.
summary_zh: 一家公益公司，目标是自动化科学与工程研究：先做 ML 研究与工程本身，再拓展到硬件设计、药物发现与清洁能源。联合创始人：Sanjay Ghemawat、Oriol Vinyals、Quoc Le。Google 为创始投资人兼云伙伴，Radical Ventures 与 Khosla Ventures 联合领投种子轮。8 月 6 日为其在 Google 的最后一天。

title_en: Ex-Googler Jeff Dean Explains Design Choices Behind Gemini
title_zh: Ex-Googler Jeff Dean Explains Design Choices Behind Gemini
summary_en: In a post-Google interview, Jeff Dean detailed the design choices behind Gemini.
summary_zh: 离开谷歌后，Jeff Dean在采访中详细讲述了Gemini背后的设计决策。

title_en: Ex-Google chief scientist Jeff Dean targets $50B valuation for new AI startup Discovery Loop
title_zh: Ex-Google chief scientist Jeff Dean targets $50B valuation for new AI startup Discovery Loop
summary_en: Dean's new startup Discovery Loop is reportedly targeting a $50B valuation, months after he left Google.
summary_zh: 据报道，迪恩离开谷歌后创立的新公司Discovery Loop正寻求500亿美元估值。

title_en: Former Google chief scientist Jeff Dean is raising again for his new AI startup, seeking around a $50 billion valuation
title_zh: Former Google chief scientist Jeff Dean is raising again for his new AI startup, seeking around a $50 billion valuation
summary_en: Dean is reportedly raising a new funding round for his startup Discovery Loop at around a $50 billion valuation.
summary_zh: 据报道，Dean正在为其新公司Discovery Loop筹集新一轮融资，估值约500亿美元。

title_en: Why Jeff Dean says he left Google after 27 years to build a small AI startup
title_zh: Why Jeff Dean says he left Google after 27 years to build a small AI startup
summary_en: Jeff Dean explained why he left Google after 27 years to co-found Discovery Loop, a small AI startup — confirming the departure that also ended his authorship of Google's research blog.
summary_zh: Jeff Dean讲述了他为何在谷歌工作27年后离职，联合创立小型AI初创公司Discovery Loop——这也意味着他不再是谷歌研究博客的作者。

title_en: Why Jeff Dean says he left Google after 27 years to build a 4-person AI startup
title_zh: Why Jeff Dean says he left Google after 27 years to build a 4-person AI startup
summary_en: Jeff Dean explained why he left Google after 27 years to found a four-person AI startup focused on automating machine-learning research.
summary_zh: Jeff Dean解释了他在谷歌工作27年后离职、创办一家仅有四人的AI初创公司、专注于将机器学习研究本身自动化的原因。

title_en: Jeff Dean's First Post-Google Act: Automating the Scientific Method
title_zh: Jeff Dean's First Post-Google Act: Automating the Scientific Method
summary_en: A profile of Discovery Loop, the company he founded after 27 years at Google, whose purpose is to automate the scientific method itself.
summary_zh: 关于 Discovery Loop 的报道——这是他在谷歌工作 27 年后创办的公司，目标是让科学研究方法本身实现自动化。

title_en: Jeff Dean and top Google researchers quit Alphabet to launch Discovery Loop, backed by Radical Ventures
title_zh: Jeff Dean and top Google researchers quit Alphabet to launch Discovery Loop, backed by Radical Ventures
summary_en: He leaves Alphabet with a group of senior Google researchers to found Discovery Loop, backed by Radical Ventures.
summary_zh: 他带着一批谷歌资深研究员离开 Alphabet，创办由 Radical Ventures 支持的 Discovery Loop。

title_en: Ex-Google AI legend Jeff Dean raises $1B seed for Discovery Loop at $10B valuation
title_zh: Ex-Google AI legend Jeff Dean raises $1B seed for Discovery Loop at $10B valuation
summary_en: Discovery Loop raises a reported $1B seed round at a $10B valuation, one of the largest seed rounds on record.
summary_zh: Discovery Loop 据报以 100 亿美元估值完成 10 亿美元种子轮，是有记录以来最大的种子轮之一。

title_en: Departing Google chief scientist Jeff Dean has been in talks for a $10 billion valuation for his new AI startup
title_zh: Departing Google chief scientist Jeff Dean has been in talks for a $10 billion valuation for his new AI startup
summary_en: Reports Dean, who departed Google, is in talks to value his new AI startup at $10 billion.
summary_zh: 报道离开谷歌后的Jeff Dean，正就其新AI初创公司100亿美元估值进行融资谈判。

title_en: Jeff Dean's 1% Rule: Build Where Frontier Models Fail
title_zh: Jeff Dean's 1% Rule: Build Where Frontier Models Fail
summary_en: Dealroom profile on Dean's investment thesis for his new venture: build products where frontier models still fail.
summary_zh: Dealroom报道Jeff Dean为新公司提出的投资理念：专注于前沿大模型仍然表现不佳的领域。

title_en: Jeff Dean Turning In His Google Badge & Google Laptop
title_zh: Jeff Dean Turning In His Google Badge & Google Laptop
summary_en: Jeff Dean left Google after 27 years, turning in his badge and laptop, to build Discovery Loop.
summary_zh: 在谷歌工作27年后，Jeff Dean离职，交还工牌和笔记本电脑，转而创办Discovery Loop。

title_en: Loss of ‘most Google’ engineer Jeff Dean jolts morale inside the company’s AI ranks
title_zh: Loss of ‘most Google’ engineer Jeff Dean jolts morale inside the company’s AI ranks
summary_en: The Los Angeles Times reported that Dean's departure from Google has shaken morale inside the company's AI teams, confirming his exit after 27 years.
summary_zh: 《洛杉矶时报》报道称，Dean离开谷歌一事动摇了公司AI团队的士气，证实了他在效力27年后的离职。

title_en: Google Brain Co-Founder Jeff Dean Launches AI Startup
title_zh: Google Brain Co-Founder Jeff Dean Launches AI Startup
summary_en: Jeff Dean, who spent 27 years at Google including co-founding Google Brain, has launched a new AI startup.
summary_zh: 在Google工作27年、联合创立Google Brain的Jeff Dean已创立一家新的AI创业公司。

title_en: Google loses Jeff Dean, sidelines Hassabis from operations in biggest AI shake-up since 2023
title_zh: Google loses Jeff Dean, sidelines Hassabis from operations in biggest AI shake-up since 2023
summary_en: Reports confirmed Dean's departure from Google after 27 years, described as the company's biggest leadership shake-up since 2023, alongside Hassabis stepping back from operations.
summary_zh: 报道证实迪恩在效力谷歌27年后离职，这被称为谷歌自2023年以来最大的一次领导层变动，哈萨比斯同时也从运营岗位上退了下来。

title_en: AI Pioneers Jeff Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat Launch Discovery Loop to Accelerate Scientific Research
title_zh: AI Pioneers Jeff Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat Launch Discovery Loop to Accelerate Scientific Research
summary_en: Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat launched Discovery Loop, a new company aimed at automating scientific and machine-learning research, following Dean's departure from Google.
summary_zh: Jeff Dean离开谷歌后，与Sanjay Ghemawat共同创立了Discovery Loop，致力于将科学与机器学习研究自动化。

title_en: Google shakes up AI leadership. Demis Hassabis takes on broader research role, and Jeff Dean leaves.
title_zh: Google shakes up AI leadership. Demis Hassabis takes on broader research role, and Jeff Dean leaves.
summary_en: Google restructured its AI leadership: Demis Hassabis took on a broader research role while Jeff Dean departed the company after 27 years, going on to co-found Discovery Loop.
summary_zh: 谷歌调整AI领导层：Demis Hassabis接掌更广泛的研究职责，而Jeff Dean在任职27年后离开公司，随后联合创立Discovery Loop。

title_en: Google Eyes $1.5B Investment In AI Coding Startup As AI Brain Drain Continues With Jeff Dean's Exit
title_zh: Google Eyes $1.5B Investment In AI Coding Startup As AI Brain Drain Continues With Jeff Dean's Exit
summary_en: Coverage of Jeff Dean's departure from Google after 27 years, amid reports Google is weighing a $1.5B investment in an AI coding startup.
summary_zh: 报道杰夫·迪恩在谷歌工作27年后离职，同时谷歌据传正考虑向一家AI编程初创公司投资15亿美元。

title_en: Jeff Dean Leaves Google to Launch Discovery Loop AI Research Startup - Межа. Новини України.
title_zh: Jeff Dean Leaves Google to Launch Discovery Loop AI Research Startup - Межа. Новини України.
summary_en: Jeff Dean left Google after 27 years to launch Discovery Loop, an AI research startup built to automate machine-learning research itself.
summary_zh: 杰夫·迪恩在谷歌工作27年后离职，创立了Discovery Loop，一家致力于将机器学习研究本身自动化的AI初创公司。

title_en: The append-and-review note
title_zh: 追加与回顾式笔记
summary_en: One of the seed posts of his Bear blog, started March 2025 — sweeping essays on non-human intelligence sit next to notes on sleep trackers.
summary_zh: 2025 年 3 月开设的 Bear 博客的早期文章之一 —— 关于非人类智能的宏大论述与睡眠追踪器的随笔并列。

title_en: Announcing Eureka Labs
title_zh: 宣布创立 Eureka Labs
summary_en: 'We are building a new kind of school that is AI native.'
summary_zh: 「我们正在建造一所 AI 原生的新型学校。」

title_en: Sequoia Ascent 2026 summary
title_zh: Sequoia Ascent 2026 summary
summary_en: His own written summary of the talk he gave at Sequoia's AI Ascent 2026, on where coding with agents currently stands.
summary_zh: 他为自己在红杉 AI Ascent 2026 上的演讲所写的总结，谈当下用智能体写代码走到了哪一步。

title_en: Andrej Karpathy: From Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
title_zh: Andrej Karpathy: From Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
summary_en: Long-form conversation with Sequoia's Stephanie Zhan in which he traces the year's shift from vibe coding to agentic engineering.
summary_zh: 与红杉合伙人 Stephanie Zhan 的长篇对谈，梳理这一年从 vibe coding 到智能体工程的转变。

title_en: Andrej Karpathy on Code Agents, AutoResearch, and the Loopy Era of AI
title_zh: Andrej Karpathy on Code Agents, AutoResearch, and the Loopy Era of AI
summary_en: He joins Sarah Guo on No Priors to discuss code agents, automated research, and what removing the human from the loop would mean.
summary_zh: 他做客 Sarah Guo 的 No Priors，讨论代码智能体、自动化科研，以及把人从回路中移除意味着什么。

title_en: microgpt
title_zh: microgpt
summary_en: Introduces microgpt, a 200-line dependency-free Python file that trains and runs a GPT, written as a minimal reference implementation.
summary_zh: 介绍 microgpt：一个 200 行、无依赖的纯 Python 文件，可训练并运行 GPT，作为最小可读的参考实现。

title_en: 2025 LLM Year in Review
title_zh: 2025 LLM Year in Review
summary_en: His year-end review of how the LLM paradigm shifted over 2025.
summary_zh: 他对 2025 年大模型范式变化的年终回顾。

title_en: Chemical hygiene
title_zh: Chemical hygiene
summary_en: An evolving personal guide to limiting everyday chemical exposure, part of the health writing he keeps on his blog.
summary_zh: 一份持续更新的个人指南，讲如何减少日常生活中的化学品暴露，属于他博客上的健康类写作。

title_en: Auto-grading decade-old Hacker News discussions with hindsight
title_zh: Auto-grading decade-old Hacker News discussions with hindsight
summary_en: A vibe-coding thought exercise on using LLMs to grade decade-old Hacker News predictions with the benefit of hindsight.
summary_zh: 一次 vibe coding 式的思想实验：用大模型以事后视角给十年前的 Hacker News 预测打分。

title_en: The space of minds
title_zh: The space of minds
summary_en: Essay on the space of possible minds and the optimization processes that produce them.
summary_zh: 关于“心智空间”及催生各种心智的优化过程的随笔。

title_en: Verifiability
title_zh: Verifiability

summary_zh: 论证任务是否易于验证，决定了大模型能力边界为何呈现参差不齐的形状。

title_en: Andrej Karpathy — AGI is still a decade away
title_zh: Andrej Karpathy — AGI is still a decade away
summary_en: Long-form Dwarkesh Podcast interview in which Karpathy argues AGI is still roughly a decade away and explains why reinforcement learning is a poor fit despite the alternatives being worse.
summary_zh: 在 Dwarkesh Podcast 的长篇访谈中，Karpathy 认为通用人工智能仍需约十年，并解释了强化学习为何并不理想，却仍好过其他所有方案。

title_en: Animals vs Ghosts
title_zh: Animals vs Ghosts
summary_en: Argues frontier LLM research is summoning ghosts rather than building animals, a widely quoted framing written in response to Sutton's Dwarkesh interview.
summary_zh: 提出前沿大模型研究不是在造动物、而是在召唤幽灵，是他回应 Sutton 那期 Dwarkesh 访谈时给出的、被广泛引用的比喻。

title_en: Vibe coding MenuGen
title_zh: Vibe coding MenuGen
summary_en: Work log of building the MenuGen app almost entirely by prompting, the post that put concrete detail behind the term he coined.
summary_zh: 记录几乎全靠提示词写出 MenuGen 应用的过程，为他自创的 vibe coding 一词补上了具体细节。

title_en: Power to the people: How LLMs flip the script on technology diffusion
title_zh: Power to the people: How LLMs flip the script on technology diffusion
summary_en: Argues LLMs invert the usual pattern of technology diffusion by reaching ordinary people before governments and large corporations.
summary_zh: 论证大模型颠覆了技术扩散的常规路径：普通人比政府和大企业更早用上它。

title_en: Finding the Best Sleep Tracker
title_zh: Finding the Best Sleep Tracker
summary_en: Compares consumer sleep trackers against his own measurements to find which ones actually agree with the data.
summary_zh: 用自己的实测数据比较各款消费级睡眠监测设备，看哪一款的结果真正靠得住。

title_en: GPT-4o System Card
title_zh: GPT-4o System Card
summary_en: OpenAI's system card for GPT-4o, the end-to-end omni model spanning text, audio, image and video; he is a listed author.
summary_zh: OpenAI 的 GPT-4o 系统卡，介绍这一端到端、覆盖文本／音频／图像／视频的全模态模型，他是署名作者之一。

title_en: #333 – Andrej Karpathy: Tesla AI, Self-Driving, Optimus, Aliens, and AGI
title_zh: #333 – Andrej Karpathy: Tesla AI, Self-Driving, Optimus, Aliens, and AGI

summary_zh: Karpathy 作为嘉宾登上 Lex Fridman 播客，畅谈他在特斯拉AI团队的经历、自动驾驶、Optimus 机器人与 AGI。

title_en: Deep Neural Nets: 33 years ago and 33 years from now
title_zh: Deep Neural Nets: 33 years ago and 33 years from now
summary_en: Reproduces LeCun's 1989 zip-code recognition network in modern tooling to measure 33 years of progress, then extrapolates the same distance forward.
summary_zh: 用现代工具复现 LeCun 1989 年的邮编识别网络，量化 33 年的进步，并据此外推未来 33 年。

title_en: A from-scratch tour of Bitcoin in Python

title_en: A Recipe for Training Neural Networks
title_zh: A Recipe for Training Neural Networks

title_en: Software 2.0

title_zh: AlphaGo, in context

title_zh: ICML accepted papers institution stats

title_zh: A Peek at Trends in Machine Learning

summary_zh: Karpathy利用其arxiv-sanity数据库统计哪些机器学习主题正在升温，是该工具早期的公开应用之一。

title_en: Virtual Reality: still not quite there, again.
title_zh: Virtual Reality: still not quite there, again.
