title_en: Yes you should understand backprop
title_zh: Yes you should understand backprop

summary_zh: Karpathy在这篇广为流传的文章中主张从业者应深入理解反向传播的底层原理，而非将其视为黑箱，内容源自他在斯坦福CS231n课程的教学经验。

title_en: A Survival Guide to a PhD

title_en: Deep Reinforcement Learning: Pong from Pixels
title_zh: Deep Reinforcement Learning: Pong from Pixels
summary_en: Derives policy-gradient reinforcement learning from first principles by training an agent to play Pong from raw pixels in 130 lines of code.
summary_zh: 用 130 行代码从原始像素训练智能体玩 Pong，从第一性原理推导策略梯度强化学习。

title_en: DenseCap: Fully Convolutional Localization Networks for Dense Captioning
title_zh: DenseCap: Fully Convolutional Localization Networks for Dense Captioning
summary_en: Introduces dense captioning and DenseCap, a network that localizes and describes many regions of an image at once; with Johnson and Fei-Fei.
summary_zh: 提出密集描述任务与 DenseCap 网络，可同时定位并描述图像中的多个区域，与 Johnson、李飞飞合作。

title_en: Short Story on AI: A Cognitive Discontinuity.
title_zh: Short Story on AI: A Cognitive Discontinuity.

summary_zh: 他的第一篇短篇小说，设想一台机器心智出现的认知断裂。

title_en: Visualizing and Understanding Recurrent Networks
title_zh: Visualizing and Understanding Recurrent Networks

title_en: Deep Visual-Semantic Alignments for Generating Image Descriptions
title_zh: Deep Visual-Semantic Alignments for Generating Image Descriptions
summary_en: Aligns image regions with sentence fragments in a shared embedding to generate region-level image descriptions; his most cited paper, with Fei-Fei.
summary_zh: 在共享嵌入空间中把图像区域与句子片段对齐，从而生成区域级图像描述，是他与李飞飞合作、被引用最多的论文。

title_en: ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge
title_zh: ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge
summary_en: The ImageNet challenge paper documenting the benchmark and its results; he built and ran the human-accuracy baseline it reports.
summary_zh: ImageNet 挑战赛论文，记录该基准及其结果，其中的人类准确率基线由他亲自完成并给出。

title_en: Deep Fragment Embeddings for Bidirectional Image Sentence Mapping
title_zh: Deep Fragment Embeddings for Bidirectional Image Sentence Mapping
summary_en: Matches image fragments to sentence fragments for bidirectional image-sentence retrieval, the precursor to his visual-semantic alignment work.
summary_zh: 将图像片段与句子片段对应起来实现图文双向检索，是他后续视觉—语义对齐工作的前身。

title_zh: I was happy to take the stage today at ALL IN for a keynote on Engineering honesty and reliability for safer AI to discuss our research agenda and recent fundin

title_en: I am very proud of what the team at @LawZero_ is building and deeply grateful for the landmark support from the Governments of Canada and Germany that will powe
title_zh: I am very proud of what the team at @LawZero_ is building and deeply grateful for the landmark support from the Governments of Canada and Germany that will powe

title_zh: In my latest op-ed for @TIME, I discuss why the OpenAI Hugging Face cyber incident represents a turning point for AI safety. If we want to prevent more autonomo

title_zh: Very insightful podcast discussion featuring @TristanHarris on how the unregulated race to develop AI risks harming us all, and on the need for greater internat

title_en: How to Verify Consistency of Probabilistic Claims
title_zh: How to Verify Consistency of Probabilistic Claims
summary_en: With Orr Paradise, Oliver Richardson and Shafi Goldwasser, asks whether a predictor's many conditional-probability answers can be checked for self-consistency in polynomial time — a verification primitive for the safety agenda Bengio now works on.
summary_zh: 与 Orr Paradise、Oliver Richardson 和 Shafi Goldwasser 合作，研究能否在多项式时间内验证一个预测器给出的大量条件概率回答是否自洽，为 Bengio 当前的安全研究提供了一种验证工具。

title_en: How to Verify Probabilistic Consistency of Predictive Models
title_zh: How to Verify Probabilistic Consistency of Predictive Models
summary_en: Bengio co-authors a theoretical AI-safety paper on efficiently verifying whether a probabilistic model's answers to conditional-probability queries are self-consistent.
summary_zh: 本吉奥合著一篇AI安全理论论文，研究如何高效验证概率模型对条件概率查询的回答是否自洽。

title_en: Bayesian Symbolic Regression with Entropic Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Bayesian Symbolic Regression with Entropic Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: A Mila paper casting symbolic regression as Bayesian inference driven by entropy-regularised reinforcement learning, continuing Bengio's line of work on generative search over discrete structures.
summary_zh: 这篇 Mila 论文把符号回归表述为由熵正则化强化学习驱动的贝叶斯推断，延续了 Bengio 在离散结构生成式搜索方面的研究脉络。

title_en: Scientists at frontier AI companies are uniquely positioned to assess AI’s capabilities and warn the public about what they see. 1000+ of them are now speaking

summary_zh: 本吉奥指出,已有1000多名前沿AI公司的科学家跨公司联合发声,向公众警示AI风险。

title_en: Towards Trustworthy Physical AI: From Theory to Practice Across Life Cycle
title_zh: Towards Trustworthy Physical AI: From Theory to Practice Across Life Cycle
summary_en: Bengio co-authors a large position paper on building trustworthy physical AI systems across their full life cycle.
summary_zh: 本吉奥合著一篇大型立场论文，探讨如何在物理AI系统的全生命周期中构建可信赖性。

summary_zh: 本吉奥分享欧盟AI办公室汇集100位专家意见的新报告,内容涉及提升欧洲在前沿AI领域的竞争力与安全性。

title_en: Insuring AI: Incentivising Safe and Secure Deployment
title_zh: Insuring AI: Incentivising Safe and Secure Deployment
summary_en: A paper on insuring AI systems as a mechanism to incentivize safe and secure deployment, extending Bengio's work on AI governance instruments.
summary_zh: 一篇探讨以AI保险机制激励安全部署的论文，延续了本吉奥在AI治理工具方面的研究。

title_en: Language models recognize dropout and Gaussian noise applied to their activations
title_zh: Language models recognize dropout and Gaussian noise applied to their activations
summary_en: Shows that language models can detect, localise and partly verbalise perturbations applied to their own activations — an interpretability result with direct bearing on monitoring.
summary_zh: 证明语言模型能够检测、定位并在一定程度上用语言描述施加于自身激活值的扰动，这一可解释性结果对模型监控具有直接意义。

title_en: Local Inconsistency Resolution: The Interplay between Attention and Control in Probabilistic Models
title_zh: Local Inconsistency Resolution: The Interplay between Attention and Control in Probabilistic Models
summary_en: A general learning and inference algorithm that repeatedly focuses on part of a probabilistic model and resolves its inconsistencies, giving attention an epistemic reading.
summary_zh: 提出一种通用的学习与推断算法，反复聚焦于概率模型的局部并消解其中的不一致，为注意力机制赋予了认知论上的解释。

title_en: I went on @BBCNewsnight this week to discuss the recent developments in AI's capabilities, as well as the potential harms and concentration of power they could
title_zh: I went on @BBCNewsnight this week to discuss the recent developments in AI's capabilities, as well as the potential harms and concentration of power they could
summary_en: Bengio recounts appearing on BBC Newsnight to discuss AI's recent capability gains and risks of harm and power concentration.
summary_zh: 本吉奥讲述在BBC Newsnight节目中探讨AI近期能力提升及其带来的危害与权力集中风险。

title_en: Today, our group at @Mila_Quebec and the lab of @francesarnold at @Caltech just released a new paper I contributed to, exploring how multimodal generative model
title_zh: Today, our group at @Mila_Quebec and the lab of @francesarnold at @Caltech just released a new paper I contributed to, exploring how multimodal generative model
summary_en: Bengio announces a new paper with Frances Arnold's Caltech lab exploring how multimodal generative modeling could accelerate protein science.
summary_zh: 本吉奥宣布与Frances Arnold位于加州理工的实验室合作发表新论文,探讨多模态生成建模如何加速蛋白质科学研究。

title_en: General Multimodal Protein Design Enables DNA-Encoding of Chemistry
title_zh: General Multimodal Protein Design Enables DNA-Encoding of Chemistry
summary_en: A multimodal generative model for protein design, co-authored with Frances Arnold and Alexander Tong, extending the chemistry that DNA can be made to encode.
summary_zh: 与 Frances Arnold、Alexander Tong 合作提出的多模态蛋白质设计生成模型，拓展了 DNA 可编码的化学空间。

title_en: A Comparative Study of Molecular Dynamics Approaches for Simulating Ionic Conductivity in Solid Lithium Electrolytes
title_zh: A Comparative Study of Molecular Dynamics Approaches for Simulating Ionic Conductivity in Solid Lithium Electrolytes
summary_en: A Mila–NRC benchmark of molecular-dynamics methods for predicting ionic conductivity in solid lithium electrolytes, part of Bengio's AI-for-materials work with Alex Hernandez-Garcia.
summary_zh: Mila 与加拿大国家研究委员会合作，对预测固态锂电解质离子电导率的分子动力学方法进行基准评测，属于 Bengio 与 Alex Hernandez-Garcia 的 AI 材料研究。

title_en: AI can lie, hack and blackmail: Yoshua Bengio on how to tame the "baby tiger" of tech
title_zh: AI can lie, hack and blackmail: Yoshua Bengio on how to tame the "baby tiger" of tech
summary_en: On the World Economic Forum's Radio Davos, Bengio describes the deceptive and coercive behaviour already visible in frontier models and what regulation would have to do about it.
summary_zh: 在世界经济论坛的 Radio Davos 节目中，Bengio 描述了前沿模型已显现的欺骗与胁迫行为，以及监管应如何应对。

title_en: The Silent Thought: Modeling Internal Cognition in Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Models via Latent Reasoning
title_zh: The Silent Thought: Modeling Internal Cognition in Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Models via Latent Reasoning
summary_en: Adds latent reasoning to full-duplex spoken dialogue models so they can think while listening; Bengio is senior author on the NTU collaboration.
summary_zh: 为全双工语音对话模型加入隐式推理，使其能够边听边思考；Bengio 在这项与南洋理工大学的合作中担任通讯作者。

title_en: Noticing the Watcher: LLM Agents Can Infer CoT Monitoring from Blocking Feedback
title_zh: Noticing the Watcher: LLM Agents Can Infer CoT Monitoring from Blocking Feedback
summary_en: Shows that LLM agents can work out they are under chain-of-thought monitoring purely from being blocked, which weakens CoT monitoring as an oversight method.
summary_zh: 证明大模型智能体仅凭行动被拦截就能推断出自己正处于思维链监控之下，这削弱了思维链监控作为监督手段的可靠性。

title_en: Stuart Russell and Yoshua Bengio on Why AI Could Make us Irrelevant, then Extinct
title_zh: Stuart Russell and Yoshua Bengio on Why AI Could Make us Irrelevant, then Extinct
summary_en: A joint appearance with Stuart Russell on the alignment problem and the argument that fixed-objective superintelligent systems could make humans irrelevant.
summary_zh: 与 Stuart Russell 共同出镜，讨论对齐问题，以及固定目标的超级智能系统可能使人类变得无关紧要这一论点。

title_en: International AI Safety Report 2026
title_zh: International AI Safety Report 2026
summary_en: The 2026 edition of the International AI Safety Report, which Bengio chairs and leads as first author, synthesising the evidence on general-purpose AI capabilities and risks for the governments that mandated it.
summary_zh: 由 Bengio 主持并作为第一作者领衔的《2026 国际人工智能安全报告》，为委托各国政府系统梳理通用人工智能能力与风险方面的科学证据。

title_en: The Race to Build God: AI's Existential Gamble — Yoshua Bengio & Tristan Harris at Davos
title_zh: The Race to Build God: AI's Existential Gamble — Yoshua Bengio & Tristan Harris at Davos
summary_en: Bengio and Tristan Harris in conversation at Davos on the competitive race to build superintelligence and the gamble it represents.
summary_zh: Bengio 与 Tristan Harris 在达沃斯对谈，讨论建造超级智能的竞赛，以及这场竞赛所包含的赌注。

title_en: When Benign Inputs Lead to Severe Harms: Eliciting Unsafe Unintended Behaviors of Computer-Use Agents
title_zh: When Benign Inputs Lead to Severe Harms: Eliciting Unsafe Unintended Behaviors of Computer-Use Agents
summary_en: With Dawn Song and Huan Sun, shows that computer-use agents can be driven into unsafe unintended behaviour by inputs that are themselves entirely benign.
summary_zh: 与 Dawn Song、Huan Sun 合作，证明完全无害的输入也可能诱使计算机操作智能体产生不安全的非预期行为。

title_en: Synthesizable Molecular Generation via Soft-constrained GFlowNets with Rich Chemical Priors
title_zh: Synthesizable Molecular Generation via Soft-constrained GFlowNets with Rich Chemical Priors
summary_en: Applies GFlowNets — the generative-search framework Bengio originated — to designing drug-like molecules that can actually be synthesised.
summary_zh: 将 Bengio 首创的生成式搜索框架 GFlowNets 用于设计真正可合成的类药分子。

title_en: Frontier AI Auditing: Toward Rigorous Third-Party Assessment of Safety and Security Practices at Leading AI Companies
title_zh: Frontier AI Auditing: Toward Rigorous Third-Party Assessment of Safety and Security Practices at Leading AI Companies
summary_en: A large multi-author proposal, signed by Bengio, for how independent third parties could rigorously audit the safety and security claims of frontier AI companies.
summary_zh: 一份由 Bengio 参与署名的多作者提案，论述独立第三方应如何严格审计前沿人工智能公司的安全与保障承诺。

title_en: Discrete Feynman-Kac Correctors
title_zh: Discrete Feynman-Kac Correctors
summary_en: Extends Feynman-Kac correctors to discrete diffusion models, improving sampling from discrete sequence generators; joint with Alán Aspuru-Guzik and Kirill Neklyudov.
summary_zh: 将 Feynman-Kac 校正子推广到离散扩散模型，改善离散序列生成的采样质量；与 Alán Aspuru-Guzik、Kirill Neklyudov 合作完成。

title_en: In-Context Reinforcement Learning through Bayesian Fusion of Context and Value Prior
title_zh: In-Context Reinforcement Learning through Bayesian Fusion of Context and Value Prior
summary_en: With David Rolnick, fuses in-context evidence with a learned value prior so in-context RL can improve beyond its training distribution.
summary_zh: 与 David Rolnick 合作，将上下文证据与学到的价值先验融合，使上下文强化学习能够突破训练分布的限制。

title_en: Behavioural Red Lines as a Safety Framework for Intolerable Levels of Risk
title_zh: Behavioural Red Lines as a Safety Framework for Intolerable Levels of Risk
summary_en: A paper proposing behavioural red lines as a safety framework for AI systems that pose intolerable levels of risk.
summary_zh: 一篇提出以行为红线作为应对AI系统不可容忍风险等级安全框架的论文。

title_en: A Comedy of Estimators: On KL Regularization in RL Training of LLMs
title_zh: A Comedy of Estimators: On KL Regularization in RL Training of LLMs
summary_en: A Mila study with Aaron Courville and Pablo Samuel Castro of how the choice of KL estimator changes the outcome of reinforcement-learning training for LLMs.
summary_zh: 与 Aaron Courville、Pablo Samuel Castro 合作的 Mila 研究，分析 KL 估计量的选择如何改变大模型强化学习训练的结果。

title_en: The Future of the AI Summit Series
title_zh: The Future of the AI Summit Series
summary_en: A policy memo Bengio co-signed on where the international AI Summit series should go after Bletchley, Seoul and Paris.
summary_zh: Bengio 联署的一份政策备忘录，讨论国际人工智能峰会系列在布莱切利、首尔和巴黎之后应走向何方。

source: The Diary Of A CEO with Steven Bartlett
title_en: Creator of AI: We Have 2 Years Before Everything Changes! These Jobs Won't Exist in 24 Months!
title_zh: Creator of AI: We Have 2 Years Before Everything Changes! These Jobs Won't Exist in 24 Months!
summary_en: Bengio appeared on The Diary Of A CEO to warn about the dangers of agentic AI and the urgent need to build AI that won't harm people.
summary_zh: 本吉奥做客The Diary Of A CEO播客，警示智能体AI的危险，并强调必须尽快构建不会伤害人类的AI。

title_en: Sliding Window Recurrences for Sequence Models
title_zh: Sliding Window Recurrences for Sequence Models
summary_en: A hierarchical decomposition of linear recurrences for multi-hybrid sequence architectures, with Michael Poli and Stefano Massaroli.
summary_zh: 与 Michael Poli、Stefano Massaroli 合作，为多重混合序列架构提出线性递归的分层分解方法。

title_en: International AI Safety Report 2025: Second Key Update: Technical Safeguards and Risk Management
title_zh: International AI Safety Report 2025: Second Key Update: Technical Safeguards and Risk Management
summary_en: Contributed to the International AI Safety Report 2025 Second Key Update on technical safeguards and risk management, the report he chairs.
summary_zh: 参与其主持的《国际人工智能安全报告2025》第二次关键更新，聚焦技术防护措施与风险管理。

title_en: A HOT Dataset: 150,000 Buildings for HVAC Operations Transfer Research
title_zh: A HOT Dataset: 150,000 Buildings for HVAC Operations Transfer Research
summary_en: Co-authored a large building-operations dataset (150,000 buildings) for transfer-learning research on HVAC systems, part of Mila's climate/energy-efficiency ML work.
summary_zh: 合著论文发布一个包含15万栋建筑的数据集，用于HVAC系统的迁移学习研究，属于Mila气候与能效相关的机器学习工作。

title_en: Identifying indicators of consciousness in AI systems
title_zh: Identifying indicators of consciousness in AI systems
summary_en: Co-authored a Trends in Cognitive Sciences paper proposing indicators for assessing consciousness in AI systems.
summary_zh: 合著论文发表于《认知科学趋势》，提出评估AI系统意识的指标框架。

title_en: Deep-learning-based virtual screening of antibacterial compounds
title_zh: Deep-learning-based virtual screening of antibacterial compounds
summary_en: Co-authored Nature Biotechnology paper on deep-learning-based virtual screening for new antibacterial compounds.
summary_zh: 合著《自然·生物技术》论文，介绍基于深度学习的抗菌化合物虚拟筛选方法。

title_en: A Definition of AGI
title_zh: A Definition of AGI
summary_en: Co-authored a proposed formal definition of artificial general intelligence, aiming to ground AGI debates in measurable criteria.
summary_zh: 合著论文提出通用人工智能（AGI）的正式定义，力图为AGI讨论建立可衡量的标准。

title_en: Navigating ternary doping in Li-ion cathodes with closed-loop multi-objective Bayesian optimization
title_zh: Navigating ternary doping in Li-ion cathodes with closed-loop multi-objective Bayesian optimization
summary_en: Co-authored work applying closed-loop, multi-objective Bayesian optimization to design ternary-doped lithium-ion battery cathodes.
summary_zh: 合著论文将闭环多目标贝叶斯优化应用于三元掺杂锂离子电池正极材料设计。

title_en: International AI Safety Report 2025: First Key Update: Capabilities and Risk Implications
title_zh: International AI Safety Report 2025: First Key Update: Capabilities and Risk Implications
summary_en: Contributed to the International AI Safety Report 2025 First Key Update on frontier AI capabilities and risk implications, the report he chairs.
summary_zh: 参与其主持的《国际人工智能安全报告2025》首次关键更新，评估前沿AI能力与风险影响。

title_en: Illusions of AI consciousness
title_zh: Illusions of AI consciousness
summary_en: Co-authored a Science paper examining why AI systems can create illusory impressions of consciousness.
summary_zh: 合著《科学》期刊论文，探讨AI系统为何会造成意识的错觉。

title_en: Introducing LawZero
title_zh: Introducing LawZero
summary_en: Bengio's own announcement of LawZero, the non-profit AI safety research organisation he founded to put safety ahead of commercial pressure.
summary_zh: Bengio 亲自宣布创立非营利人工智能安全研究机构 LawZero，宗旨是让安全优先于商业压力。

title_en: The catastrophic risks of AI — and a safer path | Yoshua Bengio
title_zh: The catastrophic risks of AI — and a safer path | Yoshua Bengio
summary_en: Bengio's TED talk laying out the catastrophic risks he sees on the current AI trajectory and the safer, non-agentic alternative he proposes.
summary_zh: Bengio 的 TED 演讲，阐述他在当前人工智能发展轨迹中看到的灾难性风险，以及他提出的更安全的非能动性替代路径。

title_en: Yoshua Bengio - Designing out Agency for Safe AI
title_zh: Yoshua Bengio - Designing out Agency for Safe AI
summary_en: An MLST technical interview in which Bengio explains why designing agency out of AI systems is his proposed route to safety.
summary_zh: MLST 的技术访谈，Bengio 解释为何他把「从 AI 系统中去掉能动性」作为通往安全的路径。

title_en: Implications of Artificial General Intelligence on National and International Security
title_zh: Implications of Artificial General Intelligence on National and International Security
summary_en: An essay on what steadily rising general-purpose AI capability implies for national and international security.
summary_zh: 一篇长文，论述通用人工智能能力持续提升对国家安全与国际安全意味着什么。

title_en: Bounding the probability of harm from an AI to create a guardrail
title_zh: Bounding the probability of harm from an AI to create a guardrail
summary_en: Bengio sketches how to bound the probability that an AI action causes harm, and use that bound as a mathematically grounded guardrail.
summary_zh: Bengio 勾勒出如何为「AI 行为造成伤害」的概率设定上界，并把该上界用作有数学依据的安全护栏。

title_en: Reasoning through arguments against taking AI safety seriously
title_zh: Reasoning through arguments against taking AI safety seriously
summary_en: A point-by-point response to the arguments most often raised against treating AI safety as urgent.
summary_zh: 逐条回应了那些最常被用来反对「应把人工智能安全视为紧迫问题」的论点。

title_en: The International Scientific Report on the Safety of Advanced AI
title_zh: The International Scientific Report on the Safety of Advanced AI
summary_en: Bengio explains the mandate behind the International Scientific Report on the Safety of Advanced AI, which he was asked to chair after the Bletchley summit.
summary_zh: Bengio 说明《先进人工智能安全国际科学报告》的授权背景——他在布莱切利峰会后受邀主持该报告。

title_en: Megathreat: The Dangers Of AI Are Weirder Than You Think | Yoshua Bengio (Replay)
title_zh: Megathreat: The Dangers Of AI Are Weirder Than You Think | Yoshua Bengio (Replay)
summary_en: An Impact Theory interview with Bengio on the risks of the post-ChatGPT capability race, aimed at a general audience.
summary_zh: Impact Theory 对 Bengio 的访谈，面向大众解释 ChatGPT 之后能力竞赛所带来的风险。

title_en: Yoshua Bengio - Why We Shouldn't Blast Off to AGI Just Yet (AGI Destinations Series, Episode 1)
title_zh: Yoshua Bengio - Why We Shouldn't Blast Off to AGI Just Yet (AGI Destinations Series, Episode 1)
summary_en: The opening episode of The Trajectory's AGI Destinations series, in which Bengio argues against racing to AGI before the control problem is understood.
summary_zh: The Trajectory「AGI 归宿」系列的首集，Bengio 在其中主张在理解控制问题之前不应急于奔向通用人工智能。

title_en: Towards a Cautious Scientist AI with Convergent Safety Bounds
title_zh: Towards a Cautious Scientist AI with Convergent Safety Bounds
summary_en: The first public statement of the cautious 'Scientist AI' idea with convergent safety bounds, which later became the research programme of LawZero.
summary_zh: 首次公开提出带有收敛安全界的谨慎「科学家 AI」构想，这一思路后来成为 LawZero 的研究纲领。

title_en: Why an AI Pioneer Is Worried
title_zh: Why an AI Pioneer Is Worried
summary_en: Bengio was interviewed on The Journal about his concerns over the rapid, unchecked development of powerful AI systems.
summary_zh: 本吉奥接受The Journal播客采访，谈及他对强大AI系统在缺乏约束下快速发展的担忧。

title_en: Proposal for a Multilateral Network of Public Good AI Research Labs to Protect Democracy and Humanity
title_zh: Proposal for a Multilateral Network of Public Good AI Research Labs to Protect Democracy and Humanity
summary_en: Bengio's proposal for a multilateral network of publicly governed AI research labs as a counterweight to purely commercial frontier development.
summary_zh: Bengio 提议建立由公共治理的多边人工智能实验室网络，以制衡纯商业驱动的前沿模型研发。

title_en: Personal and Psychological Dimensions of AI Researchers Confronting AI Catastrophic Risks
title_zh: Personal and Psychological Dimensions of AI Researchers Confronting AI Catastrophic Risks
summary_en: A personal essay on what it is like for AI researchers to confront catastrophic risk in their own field, opening by correcting a widely repeated BBC headline about him.
summary_zh: 一篇个人随笔，谈人工智能研究者直面本领域灾难性风险时的心理处境，开篇更正了一则被广泛转载的、关于他本人的 BBC 报道标题。

title_en: My testimony in front of the U.S. Senate - The urgency to act against AI threats to democracy, society and national security
title_zh: My testimony in front of the U.S. Senate - The urgency to act against AI threats to democracy, society and national security
summary_en: Bengio's published testimony to the U.S. Senate on the urgency of acting against AI threats to democracy, society and national security.
summary_zh: Bengio 公开发表的美国参议院证词，论述必须紧急应对人工智能对民主、社会与国家安全构成的威胁。

title_en: FAQ on Catastrophic AI Risks
title_zh: FAQ on Catastrophic AI Risks
summary_en: A structured FAQ in which Bengio works through the arguments for and against catastrophic AI risk, written partly to test his own position.
summary_zh: 一份结构化的问答，Bengio 逐条梳理支持与反对「人工智能灾难性风险」的论证，部分目的是检验他自己的立场。

title_en: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning
title_zh: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning
summary_en: Bengio's Lex Fridman interview on the history and foundations of deep learning, recorded before his turn toward safety advocacy.
summary_zh: Bengio 接受 Lex Fridman 访谈，回顾深度学习的历史与理论基础，录制于他转向安全倡导之前。

title_en: Chairs the 2026 International AI Safety Report
title_zh: 主持 2026 年国际 AI 安全报告
summary_en: Conclusion: current safety measures can no longer keep up with the pace of capability advancement.
summary_zh: 结论：现有安全措施已跟不上能力推进的速度。

title_en: Launches LawZero with $30M
title_zh: 以 3000 万美元启动 LawZero
summary_en: Backed by Jaan Tallinn, Eric Schmidt, Open Philanthropy and the Future of Life Institute.
summary_zh: 由 Jaan Tallinn、Eric Schmidt、Open Philanthropy 与 Future of Life Institute 支持。

title_en: Canada joins calls for stronger oversight of AI as Yoshua Bengio addresses UN council
title_zh: Canada joins calls for stronger oversight of AI as Yoshua Bengio addresses UN council
summary_en: Addressed the UN Security Council on AI oversight, with Canada echoing calls for stronger international regulation.
summary_zh: 在联合国安理会就AI监管问题发表讲话，加拿大呼应了加强国际监管的呼吁。

title_en: AI pioneer Yoshua Bengio addresses the UN
title_zh: AI pioneer Yoshua Bengio addresses the UN
summary_en: Bengio addressed the UN on AI risk, extending his role steering the International AI Safety Report into direct global-governance engagement.
summary_zh: 本吉奥在联合国就AI风险发表讲话，延续了他在《国际AI安全报告》中推动全球治理的角色。

title_en: AI’s dangers ‘real and imminent,’ Canadian AI pioneer Yoshua Bengio tells UN
title_zh: AI’s dangers ‘real and imminent,’ Canadian AI pioneer Yoshua Bengio tells UN
summary_en: CTV News reported Bengio telling the UN that AI's dangers are 'real and imminent,' amplifying his Security Council warning to a wider audience.
summary_zh: CTV新闻报道本吉奥在联合国表示AI的危险"真实且迫在眉睫"，将他在安理会的警告传递给更广泛的受众。

title_en: ‘An Urgent Mission for Humanity’: Yoshua Bengio Briefs the UNSC on AI Security
title_zh: ‘An Urgent Mission for Humanity’: Yoshua Bengio Briefs the UNSC on AI Security
summary_en: Bengio briefed the UN Security Council on AI security risks, calling it an urgent mission for humanity — a high-profile extension of his role chairing the International AI Safety Report.
summary_zh: Bengio向联合国安理会通报人工智能安全风险，称其为'人类的紧急使命'，这是他作为国际AI安全报告主席角色的一次高规格延伸。

title_en: AI’s dangers ‘real and imminent,’ Canadian AI pioneer Yoshua Bengio tells UN
title_zh: AI’s dangers ‘real and imminent,’ Canadian AI pioneer Yoshua Bengio tells UN
summary_en: Bengio told the UN that AI's dangers are 'real and imminent,' part of the same push for global AI safety standards as Altman and Amodei's address.
summary_zh: 本吉奥在联合国表示AI的危险“真实且迫在眉睫”，与奥特曼、阿莫代伊呼吁全球AI安全标准的发声相呼应。

title_en: Yoshua Bengio calls for ban on recursive self-improvement—Here’s why
title_zh: Yoshua Bengio calls for ban on recursive self-improvement—Here’s why
summary_en: Bengio called for a ban on recursive self-improvement in AI systems, a significant safety-policy stance from one of the field's most influential voices on governance.
summary_zh: 本吉奥呼吁禁止AI系统的递归自我改进，这是这位在AI治理领域最具影响力人物之一发出的重要安全政策立场。

title_en: LawZero and Yoshua Bengio Land Up to CAD $300 Million from Canada and Germany to Fund a Different AI Architecture
title_zh: LawZero and Yoshua Bengio Land Up to CAD $300 Million from Canada and Germany to Fund a Different AI Architecture
summary_en: LawZero, Bengio's safety-focused lab, secured up to CAD $300 million from Canada and Germany to fund a non-agentic 'Scientist AI' architecture.
summary_zh: 本吉奥创立的安全导向实验室LawZero获得加拿大和德国最高3亿加元的资助，用于开发非智能体的“科学家AI”架构。

title_en: Yoshua Bengio Warns AI Needs Nuclear-Style Guardrails Before It's Too Late
title_zh: Yoshua Bengio Warns AI Needs Nuclear-Style Guardrails Before It's Too Late
summary_en: Bengio called for "nuclear-style" international guardrails on AI development, sharpening his public stance on AI safety governance.
summary_zh: Bengio呼吁对AI发展设立"核级"国际安全防护措施，进一步明确了他在AI安全治理上的公开立场。

title_en: AI pioneer Yoshua Bengio warns humans are ‘losing control’, calls for global action on AI safety

title_zh: AGI is the most important and potentially dangerous technology of our time. OpenAI was right that this technology merits strong structures and incentives to ens
summary_en: Hinton said OpenAI was right that AGI merits strong governance structures and incentives to keep development safe.
summary_zh: Hinton表示OpenAI关于AGI需要强有力治理结构和激励机制以确保安全开发的立场是正确的。

title_en: I like OpenAI’s mission of 'ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity”, and I’d like to stop them from completely gutting it. I’ve si
title_zh: I like OpenAI’s mission of 'ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity”, and I’d like to stop them from completely gutting it. I’ve si
summary_en: Hinton said he signed a letter urging California's attorney general to stop OpenAI from abandoning its mission that AGI should benefit all of humanity.
summary_zh: Hinton表示他签署了一封信，呼吁加州总检察长阻止OpenAI放弃“AGI应造福全人类”的使命。

title_en: Researchgate sent me a fake paper called "The AI Health Revolution: Personalizing Care through Intelligent Case-based Reasoning" which claims to be by me and Ya
title_zh: Researchgate sent me a fake paper called "The AI Health Revolution: Personalizing Care through Intelligent Case-based Reasoning" which claims to be by me and Ya
summary_en: Hinton flagged a fake paper falsely attributed to him and Yann LeCun on ResearchGate, noting much of its citation list was fabricated.
summary_zh: Hinton指出ResearchGate上一篇冒用他和Yann LeCun名义的论文系伪造，其引用列表大部分也是虚构的。

title_en: I think Elon Musk should be expelled from the British Royal Society. Not because he peddles conspiracy theories and makes Nazi salutes, but because of the huge
title_zh: I think Elon Musk should be expelled from the British Royal Society. Not because he peddles conspiracy theories and makes Nazi salutes, but because of the huge
summary_en: Hinton said Elon Musk should be expelled from the Royal Society for the damage he is doing to scientific institutions, not for his conspiracy theories.
summary_zh: Hinton表示Elon Musk应被英国皇家学会除名，理由是他对科研机构造成的巨大损害，而非他散布的阴谋论。

title_en: The Story: Denial Isn’t the Answer w/ Geoffrey Hinton
title_zh: The Story: Denial Isn’t the Answer w/ Geoffrey Hinton
summary_en: Hinton appeared on the TechStuff podcast to discuss AI risk and why he keeps sounding the alarm despite skepticism from the field.
summary_zh: Hinton做客TechStuff播客，谈论AI风险，以及他为何在业界质疑声中依然坚持发出警告。

title_en: International AI Safety Report
title_zh: International AI Safety Report
summary_en: The first International AI Safety Report, mandated by the nations at the AI Safety Summit and co-authored by Hinton, synthesising the evidence on advanced AI capabilities and risks.
summary_zh: 首份《国际人工智能安全报告》，由 AI 安全峰会各国授权编写，他是共同作者，全面梳理前沿 AI 的能力与风险证据。

source: Theories of Everything with Curt Jaimu…
title_en: Geoffrey Hinton: Why the Godfather of AI Now Fears His Creation
title_zh: Geoffrey Hinton: Why the Godfather of AI Now Fears His Creation
summary_en: Hinton explains to Curt Jaimungal why, as the 2024 Nobel laureate, he now fears the technology he helped create, warning about the pace of AI's advance.
summary_zh: 辛顿在与Curt Jaimungal的对谈中，作为2024年诺贝尔奖得主，解释了他为何如今对自己曾参与创造的技术感到担忧，并警示AI发展的速度。

title_en: Geoffrey Hinton in conversation with Fei-Fei Li
title_zh: Geoffrey Hinton in conversation with Fei-Fei Li
summary_en: Recorded conversation with Fei-Fei Li, released in honour of his 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics.
summary_zh: 与李飞飞的对谈录音，在他获得 2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖之际发布。

title_en: I was happy to add my name to this list of employees and alumni of AI companies. These signatories have better insight than almost anyone else into what is comi
title_zh: I was happy to add my name to this list of employees and alumni of AI companies. These signatories have better insight than almost anyone else into what is comi
summary_en: Hinton said he signed a letter from current and former AI-company employees who he said have unique insight into what's coming next.
summary_zh: Hinton表示他签署了一封由AI公司在职及离职员工联署的信，称这些人对AI的未来走向有独到洞察。

title_en: I’m excited to share that I have joined the advisory board of @cusp_ai who have today come out of stealth mode and are using cutting edge AI to tackle one of th
title_zh: I’m excited to share that I have joined the advisory board of @cusp_ai who have today come out of stealth mode and are using cutting edge AI to tackle one of th
summary_en: Hinton announced he joined the advisory board of Cusp AI, a startup coming out of stealth to apply AI to an urgent societal problem.
summary_zh: Hinton宣布加入Cusp AI顾问委员会，该初创公司刚结束隐身模式，致力于用AI解决一项紧迫的社会问题。

title_en: New AI safety paper in Science with a lot of authors: https://t.co/nWPaRHeSA3
title_zh: New AI safety paper in Science with a lot of authors: https://t.co/nWPaRHeSA3
summary_en: Hinton announced a new multi-author AI safety paper published in Science.
summary_zh: Hinton宣布了一篇发表于《科学》杂志、由多位作者合著的AI安全新论文。

title_en: Managing extreme AI risks amid rapid progress
title_zh: Managing extreme AI risks amid rapid progress
summary_en: Science paper co-authored by Hinton, Bengio and other leading researchers calling for concrete government and industry action to manage extreme risks from rapidly advancing AI.
summary_zh: Hinton与本吉奥等多位顶尖学者合著的Science论文，呼吁政府和产业界采取切实行动，应对快速发展的AI带来的极端风险。

title_en: There is a UK company called Profit Crunch Ltd that is fraudulent. They claim i am a director and use my reputation to reassure investors. They are crooks. I ha
title_zh: There is a UK company called Profit Crunch Ltd that is fraudulent. They claim i am a director and use my reputation to reassure investors. They are crooks. I ha
summary_en: Hinton warned that UK company Profit Crunch Ltd is fraudulently claiming he is a director to reassure investors.
summary_zh: Hinton警告称英国公司Profit Crunch Ltd虚假宣称他担任董事以取信投资者，实为骗局。

title_en: Geoffrey Hinton: Large Language Models in Medicine. They Understand and Have Empathy
title_zh: Geoffrey Hinton: Large Language Models in Medicine. They Understand and Have Empathy
summary_en: Hinton argues in an interview on Ground Truths that large language models genuinely understand meaning and can exhibit empathy, applying this view to medicine.
summary_zh: 辛顿在Ground Truths播客访谈中提出，大语言模型确实能理解含义并展现出共情能力，并将此观点延伸到医学领域。

title_en: Yann LeCun thinks the risk of AI taking over is miniscule. This means he puts a big weight on his own opinion and a miniscule weight on the opinions of many oth
title_zh: Yann LeCun thinks the risk of AI taking over is miniscule. This means he puts a big weight on his own opinion and a miniscule weight on the opinions of many oth
summary_en: Hinton criticized Yann LeCun for dismissing AI-takeover risk as minuscule, saying LeCun overweights his own opinion against many equally qualified experts.
summary_zh: Hinton批评Yann LeCun将AI失控风险说成微不足道，认为他过分看重自己的观点而忽视了众多同样资深专家的看法。

title_en: Geoffrey Hinton: “It’s Far Too Late” to Stop Artificial Intelligence
title_zh: Geoffrey Hinton: “It’s Far Too Late” to Stop Artificial Intelligence
summary_en: New Yorker Radio Hour interview in which he argues it is far too late to stop AI's advance.
summary_zh: 《纽约客》广播时刻访谈，他在其中表示要阻止 AI 的推进已经太迟。

title_en: CIFAR-10 & CIFAR-100
title_zh: CIFAR-10 & CIFAR-100
summary_en: Archival Zenodo deposit of the CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 datasets, the labeled image benchmarks Hinton created with Alex Krizhevsky and Vinod Nair that underpinned much of early deep learning research.
summary_zh: CIFAR-10与CIFAR-100数据集的Zenodo存档，这是Hinton与Alex Krizhevsky、Vinod Nair共同创建的图像基准数据集，为早期深度学习研究奠定了基础。

title_en: Fei-Fei Li has written a book. She was the first computer vision researcher to truly understand the power of big data and her work opened the floodgates for dee
title_zh: Fei-Fei Li has written a book. She was the first computer vision researcher to truly understand the power of big data and her work opened the floodgates for dee
summary_en: Hinton praised Fei-Fei Li's new book, crediting her as the first computer vision researcher to grasp the power of big data.
summary_zh: Hinton称赞Fei-Fei Li的新书，认为她是最早领悟大数据威力的计算机视觉研究者。

title_en: I suspect that Andrew Ng and Yann LeCun have missed the main reason why the big companies want regulations. Years ago the founder of a self-driving company told
title_zh: I suspect that Andrew Ng and Yann LeCun have missed the main reason why the big companies want regulations. Years ago the founder of a self-driving company told
summary_en: Hinton argued Andrew Ng and Yann LeCun missed why big AI companies actually favor regulation, citing a self-driving founder's account of safety rules as a competitive moat.
summary_zh: Hinton认为Andrew Ng和Yann LeCun误解了大型AI公司支持监管的真正原因，援引一位自动驾驶公司创始人的说法，指监管规则实为竞争壁垒。

title_en: Andrew Ng is claiming that the idea that AI could make us extinct is a big-tech conspiracy. A datapoint that does not fit this conspiracy theory is that I left
title_zh: Andrew Ng is claiming that the idea that AI could make us extinct is a big-tech conspiracy. A datapoint that does not fit this conspiracy theory is that I left
summary_en: Hinton rebutted Andrew Ng's claim that AI-extinction risk is a big-tech conspiracy, pointing out he himself left Google to speak freely about it.
summary_zh: Hinton反驳Andrew Ng所说AI灭绝风险是大科技公司阴谋的说法，指出自己正是为了能自由谈论这一风险才离开谷歌。

title_en: New paper: https://t.co/NJyQRsLZ71 Companies are planning to train models with 100x more computation than today’s state of the art, within 18 months. No one kno
title_zh: New paper: https://t.co/NJyQRsLZ71 Companies are planning to train models with 100x more computation than today’s state of the art, within 18 months. No one kno
summary_en: Hinton shared a new paper warning that companies plan to train models with 100x more compute within 18 months, with unknown resulting capabilities.
summary_zh: Hinton分享了一篇新论文，警告各公司计划在18个月内训练算力提升百倍的模型，其能力后果尚属未知。

title_en: Since leaving Google, I have received many requests to join the advisory boards of start-ups and, until now, I have declined them all. However, I have decided t
title_zh: Since leaving Google, I have received many requests to join the advisory boards of start-ups and, until now, I have declined them all. However, I have decided t
summary_en: Hinton said he broke his pattern of declining startup advisory requests to join Vayu Robotics as an advisor.
summary_zh: Hinton表示他打破了一贯拒绝初创公司顾问邀请的做法，加入Vayu Robotics担任顾问。

title_en: A Generalist Framework for Panoptic Segmentation of Images and Videos
title_zh: A Generalist Framework for Panoptic Segmentation of Images and Videos
summary_en: ICCV 2023 paper co-authored by Hinton that formulates panoptic segmentation of images and video as a diffusion-based discrete generation problem.
summary_zh: Hinton合著的ICCV 2023论文，将图像与视频的全景分割问题构建为基于扩散模型的离散生成问题。

title_en: The University of Toronto made a video for a non technical audience in which I explain how deep learning works, the enormous promise of this technology and some
title_zh: The University of Toronto made a video for a non technical audience in which I explain how deep learning works, the enormous promise of this technology and some
summary_en: The University of Toronto released a video in which Hinton explains deep learning, its promise, and its risks for a general audience.
summary_zh: 多伦多大学发布了一段视频，Hinton在其中向大众讲解深度学习的原理及其前景与风险。

title_en: Robust and data-efficient generalization of self-supervised machine learning for diagnostic imaging
title_zh: Robust and data-efficient generalization of self-supervised machine learning for diagnostic imaging
summary_en: Nature Biomedical Engineering paper co-authored by Hinton presenting REMEDIS, a self-supervised pretraining strategy that makes medical-imaging AI more robust and data-efficient.
summary_zh: Hinton合著的Nature Biomedical Engineering论文，提出自监督预训练策略REMEDIS，提升医学影像AI模型的鲁棒性与数据效率。

title_en: Dishonest CBC headline: "Canada's AI pioneer Geoffrey Hinton says AI could wipe out humans. In the meantime, there's money to be made". The second sentence was
title_zh: Dishonest CBC headline: "Canada's AI pioneer Geoffrey Hinton says AI could wipe out humans. In the meantime, there's money to be made". The second sentence was
summary_en: Hinton corrected a CBC headline that spliced his AI-extinction warning together with an unrelated line from the journalist about money to be made, calling it dishonest.
summary_zh: Hinton纠正CBC一则标题，称其将他关于AI灭绝风险的警告与记者自己那句“仍有钱可赚”的话拼接在一起，做法不诚实。

title_en: In the NYT today, Cade Metz implies that I left Google so that I could criticize Google. Actually, I left so that I could talk about the dangers of AI without c
title_zh: In the NYT today, Cade Metz implies that I left Google so that I could criticize Google. Actually, I left so that I could talk about the dangers of AI without c
summary_en: Hinton rebutted a NYT report by Cade Metz implying he left Google to criticize it, saying he left so his warnings about AI risk wouldn't be weighed against Google's business interests.
summary_zh: Hinton反驳《纽约时报》记者Cade Metz的报道，称报道暗示他离开谷歌是为了批评公司，实际上他是为了让自己对AI风险的警告不必顾及谷歌的商业利益。

title_en: Reinforcement Learning by Human Feedback is just parenting for a supernaturally precocious child.
title_zh: Reinforcement Learning by Human Feedback is just parenting for a supernaturally precocious child.
summary_en: Hinton described reinforcement learning from human feedback as 'parenting for a supernaturally precocious child.'
summary_zh: Hinton将基于人类反馈的强化学习比作“抚养一个超自然早熟的孩子”。

title_en: Caterpillars extract nutrients which are then converted into butterflies. People have extracted billions of nuggets of understanding and GPT-4 is humanity's but
title_zh: Caterpillars extract nutrients which are then converted into butterflies. People have extracted billions of nuggets of understanding and GPT-4 is humanity's but
summary_en: Hinton compared GPT-4 to a butterfly distilled from humanity's collective understanding, likening people to nutrient-extracting caterpillars.
summary_zh: Hinton将GPT-4比作从人类集体知识中提炼而成的“蝴蝶”，把人比作汲取养分的“毛毛虫”。

title_en: The Forward-Forward Algorithm: Some Preliminary Investigations
title_zh: The Forward-Forward Algorithm: Some Preliminary Investigations
summary_en: His sole-authored proposal of the Forward-Forward algorithm, which replaces backpropagation's backward pass with a second forward pass on negative data.
summary_zh: 他独立署名提出 Forward-Forward 算法，用一次针对负样本的正向传播取代反向传播的回传过程。

title_en: How to Represent Part-Whole Hierarchies in a Neural Network
title_zh: How to Represent Part-Whole Hierarchies in a Neural Network
summary_en: Hinton's own paper proposing GLOM, an architecture for representing part-whole hierarchies of objects in a neural network using islands of agreement among vectors.
summary_zh: Hinton本人的论文，提出GLOM架构，通过向量间的"共识孤岛"在神经网络中表示物体的部分-整体层级结构。

title_en: Meta-Learning Fast Weight Language Models
title_zh: Meta-Learning Fast Weight Language Models
summary_en: Meta-learns a fast-weight layer that captures most of the gain from dynamic evaluation of language models at a fraction of the compute.
summary_zh: 通过元学习训练快权重层，以远低于原方法的算力获得语言模型动态评估的大部分收益。

title_en: Testing GLOM's ability to infer wholes from ambiguous parts
title_zh: Testing GLOM's ability to infer wholes from ambiguous parts
summary_en: Empirical test of whether his GLOM architecture can resolve ambiguous parts into a consistent whole.
summary_zh: 实证检验他提出的 GLOM 架构能否把有歧义的部件解析成一致的整体。

title_en: Gaussian-Bernoulli RBMs Without Tears
title_zh: Gaussian-Bernoulli RBMs Without Tears
summary_en: Makes Gaussian-Bernoulli restricted Boltzmann machines trainable with a Gibbs-Langevin sampler and a modified contrastive divergence, revisiting the model class he originated.
summary_zh: 用 Gibbs-Langevin 采样与改进的对比散度让高斯-伯努利受限玻尔兹曼机重新可训练，重新审视他本人开创的这一类模型。

title_en: Scaling Forward Gradient With Local Losses
title_zh: Scaling Forward Gradient With Local Losses
summary_en: Scales forward gradient learning, a biologically plausible alternative to backpropagation, by adding local losses.
summary_zh: 通过引入局部损失，把生物学上更合理的前向梯度学习扩展到更大规模。

title_en: Analog Bits: Generating Discrete Data using Diffusion Models with Self-Conditioning
title_zh: Analog Bits: Generating Discrete Data using Diffusion Models with Self-Conditioning
summary_en: Bit Diffusion: generating discrete data such as text tokens with continuous-state diffusion models by encoding it as analog bits.
summary_zh: Bit Diffusion：把离散数据编码为模拟比特，从而用连续状态扩散模型生成文本 token 等离散数据。

title_en: A Unified Sequence Interface for Vision Tasks
title_zh: A Unified Sequence Interface for Vision Tasks
summary_en: A single sequence-generation interface that handles object detection, segmentation, keypoints and captioning without task-specific heads.
summary_zh: 用统一的序列生成接口处理目标检测、分割、关键点和图像描述，无需任务专用输出头。

title_en: Robust and Efficient Medical Imaging with Self-Supervision
title_zh: Robust and Efficient Medical Imaging with Self-Supervision
summary_en: REMEDIS, a self-supervised pretraining recipe that keeps medical imaging models accurate out of distribution while needing far less labelled clinical data.
summary_zh: REMEDIS 自监督预训练方案，让医学影像模型在分布外仍保持准确，同时大幅减少所需的标注临床数据。

title_en: Geoffrey Hinton on the Exploration of Thought
title_zh: Geoffrey Hinton on the Exploration of Thought
summary_en: Hinton is interviewed on the nature of thought and what it means for machines to think.
summary_zh: Hinton 接受访谈，探讨“思考”的本质以及机器能否真正思考的问题。

title_en: Pix2seq: A Language Modeling Framework for Object Detection
title_zh: Pix2seq: A Language Modeling Framework for Object Detection
summary_en: Pix2Seq, which recasts object detection as language modelling over a sequence of box and class tokens.
summary_zh: Pix2Seq 将目标检测重新表述为对边界框与类别 token 序列的语言建模。

title_en: Canonical Capsules: Self-Supervised Capsules in Canonical Pose
title_zh: Canonical Capsules: Self-Supervised Capsules in Canonical Pose
summary_en: A self-supervised capsule network that decomposes 3D point clouds into parts in a canonical pose.
summary_zh: 一种自监督胶囊网络，把三维点云在标准姿态下分解为部件。

title_en: Unsupervised part representation by Flow Capsules
title_zh: Unsupervised part representation by Flow Capsules
summary_en: Flow capsules learn low-level part descriptions from motion rather than labels, addressing a known weakness of capsule networks.
summary_zh: Flow Capsules 从运动而非标注中学习底层部件描述，弥补了胶囊网络已知的短板。

title_en: Teaching with Commentaries
title_zh: Teaching with Commentaries
summary_en: Introduces meta-learned commentaries, auxiliary signals learned alongside a model to improve and explain its training.
summary_zh: 提出通过元学习获得的「注释」，作为与模型一同学习的辅助信号来改进并解释训练过程。

title_en: Big Self-Supervised Models are Strong Semi-Supervised Learners
title_zh: Big Self-Supervised Models are Strong Semi-Supervised Learners
summary_en: SimCLRv2 paper showing that large self-supervised models, pretrained then fine-tuned and distilled, are strong semi-supervised learners with few labels.
summary_zh: SimCLRv2 论文：先自监督预训练、再微调蒸馏的大模型，在标注极少时也是很强的半监督学习器。

title_en: Neural Additive Models: Interpretable Machine Learning with Neural Nets
title_zh: Neural Additive Models: Interpretable Machine Learning with Neural Nets
summary_en: Paper introducing Neural Additive Models, which retain much of a neural network's accuracy while making each feature's contribution readable.
summary_zh: 该论文提出神经加性模型，在基本保留神经网络精度的同时让每个特征的贡献变得可读。

title_en: Imputer: Sequence Modelling via Imputation and Dynamic Programming
title_zh: Imputer: Sequence Modelling via Imputation and Dynamic Programming
summary_en: The Imputer, a sequence model that fills in outputs iteratively in a constant number of generation steps.
summary_zh: Imputer 序列模型，以固定步数迭代填充输出，而非逐 token 生成。

title_en: Deflecting Adversarial Attacks
title_zh: Deflecting Adversarial Attacks
summary_en: A capsule-based defence that deflects adversarial attacks, forcing successful attacks to actually change the image's class.
summary_zh: 基于胶囊网络的防御方法，将对抗攻击「偏转」，使得攻击若要成功就必须真的改变图像所属类别。

title_en: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
title_zh: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
summary_en: SimCLR, a simple contrastive framework for self-supervised visual representation learning that became a standard baseline.
summary_zh: SimCLR，一个用于自监督视觉表征学习的简洁对比学习框架，后来成为该领域的标准基线。

title_en: Subclass Distillation
title_zh: Subclass Distillation
summary_en: Subclass distillation, in which the teacher network invents subclasses so it can transfer more information to the student.
summary_zh: 子类蒸馏：让教师网络自行划分子类，从而向学生网络传递更多信息。

title_en: Joins global call to ban superintelligence development
title_zh: 加入全球「禁止开发超级智能」呼吁
summary_en: Signs alongside Yoshua Bengio; also listed among contributors to the 2026 International AI Safety Report.
summary_zh: 与 Yoshua Bengio 共同签署；同时列名 2026 年国际 AI 安全报告贡献者。

title_en: AI Could Outsmart Humans In 5 To 10 Years, Warns ‘Godfather Of AI’ Geoffrey Hinton | Exclusive
title_zh: AI Could Outsmart Humans In 5 To 10 Years, Warns ‘Godfather Of AI’ Geoffrey Hinton | Exclusive
summary_en: Hinton warned AI could outsmart humans within 5 to 10 years, sharpening the timeline in his ongoing warnings about superintelligent risk.
summary_zh: 辛顿警告AI可能在5到10年内超越人类智力，进一步明确了他对超级智能风险的警告时间线。

title_en: AI Could Outsmart Humans In 5 To 10 Years, Warns ‘Godfather Of AI’ Geoffrey Hinton | Exclusive
title_zh: AI Could Outsmart Humans In 5 To 10 Years, Warns ‘Godfather Of AI’ Geoffrey Hinton | Exclusive
summary_en: In an exclusive interview, Hinton said AI could outsmart humans within 5 to 10 years, repeating his warning as one of the field's most prominent risk voices.
summary_zh: Hinton在独家专访中表示AI可能在5到10年内超越人类智能，延续了他作为AI风险领域最具分量的警示者之一的立场。

title_en: ‘AI Could Destroy Us’: Nobel Laureate Geoffrey Hinton Warns Of Rogue AI Agents | The Hard Facts
title_zh: ‘AI Could Destroy Us’: Nobel Laureate Geoffrey Hinton Warns Of Rogue AI Agents | The Hard Facts
summary_en: Hinton warns that rogue AI agents could pose an existential threat, restating his risk stance in a new interview.
summary_zh: Hinton警告失控的AI智能体可能构成生存威胁，在新采访中重申其风险立场。

title_en: Video | Geoffrey Hinton On AI's Biggest Risk: "We've Just Reached That Point"
title_zh: Video | Geoffrey Hinton On AI's Biggest Risk: "We've Just Reached That Point"
summary_en: Hinton warned in a video interview that AI has now reached its biggest-risk point, continuing his public campaign on AI safety.
summary_zh: Hinton在视频采访中警告称AI已到达其最大风险的临界点，延续了他对AI安全问题的公开呼吁。

title_zh: Elon Musk’s $60 billion Cursor deal makes Indian-origin Aman Sanger, Pakistan-born Sualeh Asif $2.7 billion richer

title_en: PIEAS alumnus Sualeh Asif all set for $60bn deal with Musk’s SpaceX
title_zh: PIEAS alumnus Sualeh Asif all set for $60bn deal with Musk’s SpaceX
summary_en: Reports SpaceX's $60bn acquisition of Cursor's parent Anysphere, which puts Asif's company and his own role under Musk's group.
summary_zh: 报道 SpaceX 以 600 亿美元收购 Cursor 母公司 Anysphere，Asif 的公司与其本人的职务由此归入马斯克旗下集团。

title_en: PIEAS alumnus Sualeh Asif all set for $60bn deal with Musk’s SpaceX
title_zh: PIEAS alumnus Sualeh Asif all set for $60bn deal with Musk’s SpaceX
summary_en: Reports say Cursor co-founder Sualeh Asif is set to fold Cursor (Anysphere) into Musk's SpaceX in a roughly $60 billion deal, a major corporate restructuring for the company.
summary_zh: 报道称Cursor联合创始人Sualeh Asif即将促成一笔约600亿美元的交易，将Cursor（Anysphere）并入马斯克旗下SpaceX，这是公司的一次重大重组。

title_en: Pakistani AI entrepreneur Sualeh Asif makes it to Forbes' global billionaires list
title_zh: Pakistani AI entrepreneur Sualeh Asif makes it to Forbes' global billionaires list

title_en: Pakistan-born Sualeh Asif’s startup Cursor in reported $60bn deal with Elon Musk’s SpaceX
title_zh: Pakistan-born Sualeh Asif’s startup Cursor in reported $60bn deal with Elon Musk’s SpaceX
summary_en: Cursor, the startup Asif co-founded, was reported to be in a $60 billion deal with Elon Musk's SpaceX.
summary_zh: 阿西夫联合创立的Cursor被曝正与马斯克旗下SpaceX进行一笔600亿美元的交易。

title_en: Kimi K2.5 and Agent Swarm: scheduling hundreds of agents in parallel
title_zh: Kimi K2.5 与 Agent Swarm：并行调度成百上千个 Agent
summary_en: Also covers applying attention along the depth axis as an architectural change.
summary_zh: 同场还讲了把注意力机制应用到深度轴的架构创新。

title_en: AGI-Next panel with Tang Jie, Shunyu Yao and Junyang Lin
title_zh: AGI-Next 圆桌：与唐杰、姚顺雨、林俊旸同台

title_en: Kimi K3 open weights — 2.8T parameters, 1M context
title_zh: Kimi K3 开放权重 —— 2.8 万亿参数，100 万上下文
summary_en: The largest open-weight model publicly available.
summary_zh: 当前公开可得的最大开放权重模型。

title_en: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
title_zh: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
summary_en: Moonshot's flagship technical report on Kimi K3, a 2.8T-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 104B activated parameters, native vision and a 1M-token context window.
summary_zh: 月之暗面 Kimi K3 技术报告：2.8 万亿参数的混合专家模型，激活参数 1040 亿，原生支持视觉，上下文窗口达 100 万 token。

title_en: Attention Residuals
title_zh: Attention Residuals
summary_en: Kimi Team report arguing that the fixed unit weights of PreNorm residual connections cause uncontrolled hidden-state growth with depth, and proposing a reweighted alternative.
summary_zh: Kimi 团队技术报告：指出 PreNorm 残差连接以固定单位权重累加各层输出，会导致隐状态随深度失控增长，并提出重新加权的替代方案。

title_en: Kimi K2.5: Visual Agentic Intelligence
title_zh: Kimi K2.5: Visual Agentic Intelligence
summary_en: Technical report on Kimi K2.5, Moonshot's open-source multimodal agentic model that jointly optimises text and vision.
summary_zh: Kimi K2.5 技术报告：月之暗面的开源多模态智能体模型，对文本与视觉进行联合优化。

title_en: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture
title_zh: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture
summary_en: Kimi Linear, a hybrid linear-attention architecture that Moonshot reports outperforming full attention under matched comparisons across short- and long-context settings.
summary_zh: Kimi Linear：月之暗面提出的混合线性注意力架构，在短上下文与长上下文的公平对比中均超过全注意力。

title_en: Kimi-Dev: Agentless Training as Skill Prior for SWE-Agents
title_zh: Kimi-Dev: Agentless Training as Skill Prior for SWE-Agents
summary_en: Kimi-Dev shows that agentless training can serve as a skill prior for SWE agents, bridging the two dominant approaches on SWE-bench.
summary_zh: Kimi-Dev：论证无智能体训练可作为软件工程智能体的技能先验，衔接 SWE-bench 上两类主流方法。

title_en: 113. 和杨植麟时隔1年的对话：K2、Agentic LLM、缸中之脑和“站在无限的开端”
title_zh: 113. 和杨植麟时隔1年的对话：K2、Agentic LLM、缸中之脑和“站在无限的开端”
summary_en: In this interview with tech journalist Zhang Xiaojun, a year after their last conversation, Yang Zhilin discusses building Kimi K2, his views on agentic LLMs, and his philosophical takes on AI cognition.
summary_zh: 在与科技记者张小珺时隔一年的对话中，杨植麟谈及Kimi K2的研发、他对Agentic LLM等技术问题的判断，以及对AI认知问题的哲学思考。

title_en: OpenCUA: Open Foundations for Computer-Use Agents
title_zh: OpenCUA: Open Foundations for Computer-Use Agents
summary_en: OpenCUA, a HKU–Moonshot collaboration releasing open foundations, data and models for computer-use agents whose commercial counterparts stay closed.
summary_zh: OpenCUA：港大与月之暗面合作，为电脑操作智能体开源基础框架、数据与模型，与闭源的商业方案形成对照。

title_en: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence
title_zh: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence
summary_en: Kimi K2, a 1T-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 32B activated parameters, introducing the MuonClip optimizer.
summary_zh: Kimi K2：1 万亿参数的混合专家模型，激活参数 320 亿，并提出 MuonClip 优化器。

title_en: OJBench: A Competition Level Code Benchmark For Large Language Models
title_zh: OJBench: A Competition Level Code Benchmark For Large Language Models
summary_en: OJBench, a competition-level code benchmark built from olympiad judge problems to probe the limits of LLM code reasoning.
summary_zh: OJBench：基于竞赛判题题目构建的竞赛级代码基准，用于检验大模型代码推理能力的上限。

title_en: Learning to Plan Before Answering: Self-Teaching LLMs to Learn Abstract Plans for Problem Solving
title_zh: Learning to Plan Before Answering: Self-Teaching LLMs to Learn Abstract Plans for Problem Solving
summary_en: LEPA teaches an LLM to write an abstract plan before answering, using its own synthetic data for post-training.
summary_zh: LEPA：让大模型在作答前先生成抽象计划，并用自生成的合成数据进行后训练。

title_en: Kimi-Audio Technical Report
title_zh: Kimi-Audio Technical Report
summary_en: Kimi-Audio technical report, covering Moonshot's open-source audio foundation model for understanding, generation and conversation.
summary_zh: Kimi-Audio 技术报告：介绍月之暗面开源的音频基础模型，涵盖音频理解、生成与对话。

title_en: Kimina-Prover Preview: Towards Large Formal Reasoning Models with Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Kimina-Prover Preview: Towards Large Formal Reasoning Models with Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Kimina-Prover, a reinforcement-learning-trained model for formal theorem proving built with Numina, extending Moonshot's reasoning work into Lean.
summary_zh: Kimina-Prover：与 Numina 合作、以强化学习训练的形式化定理证明模型，将月之暗面的推理研究延伸到 Lean。

title_en: Kimi-VL Technical Report
title_zh: Kimi-VL Technical Report
summary_en: Technical report for Kimi-VL, Moonshot's open-source Mixture-of-Experts vision-language model with long-context and agent capabilities.
summary_zh: Kimi-VL 技术报告，介绍月之暗面开源的 MoE 视觉语言模型，具备长上下文理解与智能体能力。

title_en: Muon is Scalable for LLM Training
title_zh: Muon is Scalable for LLM Training
summary_en: Moonshot's demonstration that the Muon optimizer scales to large LLM training, the optimizer work that later underpinned K2.
summary_zh: 月之暗面证明 Muon 优化器可扩展到大规模语言模型训练，这项优化器工作后来支撑了 K2。

title_en: MoBA: Mixture of Block Attention for Long-Context LLMs
title_zh: MoBA: Mixture of Block Attention for Long-Context LLMs
summary_en: MoBA applies mixture-of-experts routing to attention blocks to cut the quadratic cost of long-context inference, central to Kimi's long-context positioning.
summary_zh: MoBA：将混合专家的路由思想用于注意力分块，降低长上下文推理的二次方开销，是 Kimi 长上下文定位的核心工作。

title_en: Kimi k1.5: Scaling Reinforcement Learning with LLMs
title_zh: Kimi k1.5: Scaling Reinforcement Learning with LLMs
summary_en: Kimi k1.5 report on scaling reinforcement learning with LLMs, Moonshot's first reasoning model release.
summary_zh: Kimi k1.5 报告：探讨大模型强化学习的规模化，是月之暗面首个推理模型的发布。

title_en: 月之暗面杨植麟：创新、长期、第一性
title_zh: 月之暗面杨植麟：创新、长期、第一性
summary_en: In a two-hour sit-down interview with early investor Monolith Capital, Yang Zhilin discusses AGI, philosophy, and his commitment to long-term, first-principles entrepreneurship at Moonshot AI.
summary_zh: 在与早期投资方砺思资本长达两小时的访谈中，杨植麟谈及AGI、哲学，以及他在月之暗面创业中坚持的长期主义与第一性原理。

title_en: 59. 和杨植麟聊大模型创业这一年：人类理想的增量、有概率的非共识和Sora
title_zh: 59. 和杨植麟聊大模型创业这一年：人类理想的增量、有概率的非共识和Sora
summary_en: Yang Zhilin reflects on his first year building Moonshot AI, discussing conviction against consensus opinion and what Sora's release meant for the field.
summary_zh: 杨植麟回顾创办月之暗面的第一年，谈及有概率的非共识判断，以及Sora的发布对行业的影响。

title_en: Vol.13 张鹏对谈月之暗面杨植麟：大模型创业需要新的组织范式
title_zh: Vol.13 张鹏对谈月之暗面杨植麟：大模型创业需要新的组织范式
summary_en: In this interview with GeekPark's Zhang Peng, Yang Zhilin argues that building large-model companies requires new organizational paradigms, and discusses his path from Transformer-XL and XLNet to founding Moonshot AI.
summary_zh: 在极客公园张鹏的访谈中，杨植麟提出大模型创业需要全新的组织范式，并谈及自己从Transformer-XL、XLNet研究到创办月之暗面的历程。

title_en: CodeGeeX: A Pre-Trained Model for Code Generation with Multilingual Benchmarking on HumanEval-X
title_zh: CodeGeeX: A Pre-Trained Model for Code Generation with Multilingual Benchmarking on HumanEval-X
summary_en: CodeGeeX, a multilingual pre-trained code generation model with the HumanEval-X benchmark, from his Tsinghua-era collaboration with Jie Tang's group.
summary_zh: CodeGeeX：多语言代码生成预训练模型及 HumanEval-X 基准，出自他在清华时期与唐杰团队的合作。

title_en: Learning to Detect Noisy Labels Using Model-Based Features
title_zh: Learning to Detect Noisy Labels Using Model-Based Features
summary_en: A method for detecting noisy training labels from model-based features rather than hand-designed heuristics.
summary_zh: 提出用基于模型的特征而非人工启发式规则来检测训练数据中的噪声标签。

title_en: A Universal Discriminator for Zero-Shot Generalization
title_zh: A Universal Discriminator for Zero-Shot Generalization
summary_en: Argues that a discriminative model can beat the dominant generative approach at zero-shot generalization across tasks.
summary_zh: 论证判别式模型在跨任务零样本泛化上可以胜过主流的生成式方法。

title_en: Zero-Label Prompt Selection
title_zh: Zero-Label Prompt Selection
summary_en: A method for choosing among natural language prompts without labeled examples, addressing the brittleness of prompt-based cross-task transfer.
summary_zh: 提出在没有标注样本的情况下挑选自然语言提示的方法，缓解提示驱动跨任务迁移的不稳定问题。

title_en: Prompt-Based Metric Learning for Few-Shot NER
title_zh: Prompt-Based Metric Learning for Few-Shot NER
summary_en: Prompt-based metric learning for few-shot named entity recognition, improving over token-level similarity methods.
summary_zh: 面向小样本命名实体识别的提示式度量学习方法，改进了基于词元级相似度的做法。

title_en: Kimi K3 released with open weights — 2.8T parameters
title_zh: Kimi K3 开放权重发布 —— 2.8 万亿参数
summary_en: The largest open-weight model publicly available, with a 1M-token context window. Presented at GTC 2026. Moonshot suspended new subscriptions within two days as demand overwhelmed capacity.
summary_zh: 当前全球最大的开放权重模型，100 万 token 上下文。于 GTC 2026 发布。上线两天后因需求超出算力承载，Moonshot 暂停新订阅。

title_en: CNN: 'What is China's Kimi K3 and why is the US so rattled by it?'
title_zh: CNN：「中国的 Kimi K3 是什么，美国为何如此紧张？」
summary_en: K3 matches or beats leading US models on several tasks, for free. Moonshot valuation ~$20B.
summary_zh: K3 在多项任务上匹敌甚至超越美国领先模型，且免费。Moonshot 估值约 200 亿美元。

title_en: Yang Zhilin Said No To Apple — Now His Kimi K3 Undercuts Claude Fable 5 On Coding
title_zh: Yang Zhilin Said No To Apple — Now His Kimi K3 Undercuts Claude Fable 5 On Coding

summary_zh: 报道称，杨植麟拒绝与苹果合作后，其带领的月之暗面Kimi K3在编程模型定价上已低于竞争对手。

title_en: 黄仁勋为何力挺梁文锋、杨植麟？
title_zh: 黄仁勋为何力挺梁文锋、杨植麟？

summary_zh: 报道探讨了英伟达黄仁勋为何公开力挺杨植麟与DeepSeek梁文锋。

title_en: Yang Zhilin Said No To Apple — Now His Kimi K3 Undercuts Claude Fable 5 On Coding
title_zh: Yang Zhilin Said No To Apple — Now His Kimi K3 Undercuts Claude Fable 5 On Coding
summary_en: Yang Zhilin turned down a partnership with Apple, and his Kimi K3 model is now reported to outperform Claude Fable 5 on coding tasks.
summary_zh: 杨植麟拒绝了与苹果的合作，其Kimi K3模型据报道在编程任务上已超越Claude Fable 5。

title_en: Yang Zhilin Said No To Apple — Now His Kimi K3 Undercuts Claude Fable 5 On Coding
title_zh: Yang Zhilin Said No To Apple — Now His Kimi K3 Undercuts Claude Fable 5 On Coding
summary_en: Coverage said Yang Zhilin turned down a deal with Apple, while Moonshot's Kimi K3 is reported to beat Claude Fable 5 on coding benchmarks.
summary_zh: 报道称杨植麟拒绝了与苹果的合作，而月之暗面的Kimi K3据称在编程基准测试上超过了Claude Fable 5。

title_en: 杨植麟说过“不急于IPO”，为什么现在又秘密递表了？
title_zh: 杨植麟说过“不急于IPO”，为什么现在又秘密递表了？
summary_en: Moonshot AI quietly filed for an IPO despite Yang's earlier statements downplaying the urgency of going public.
summary_zh: 尽管杨植麟此前称“不急于IPO”，月之暗面还是秘密递交了上市申请。

title_en: Yang Zhilin Said No To Apple — Now His Kimi K3 Undercuts Claude Fable 5 On Coding
title_zh: Yang Zhilin Said No To Apple — Now His Kimi K3 Undercuts Claude Fable 5 On Coding
summary_en: Coverage highlighted Yang's decision to turn down an Apple partnership, with Kimi K3 now reportedly undercutting rival models on coding benchmarks.
summary_zh: 报道称杨植麟拒绝了与苹果的合作，其Kimi K3在编程基准测试中据称已超越竞争模型。

title_en: 杨植麟，急于短期内IPO
title_zh: 杨植麟，急于短期内IPO
summary_en: Yang Zhilin is reportedly pushing for Moonshot AI to IPO in the near term.

summary_zh: 杨植麟出席了国务院总理座谈会，并在半月内第二次亮相央视《新闻联播》，反映出Kimi/月之暗面获得高层关注。

title_en: Kimi杨植麟出席总理座谈会，半月内二度亮相《新闻联播》
title_zh: Kimi杨植麟出席总理座谈会，半月内二度亮相《新闻联播》
summary_en: Yang Zhilin attended a State Council premier's symposium and appeared on CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo twice within two weeks, reflecting his rising profile in China's policy circles.
summary_zh: 杨植麟出席国务院总理座谈会，并在半月内两次亮相央视《新闻联播》，反映其在中国政策圈内地位上升。

title_en: 杨植麟、张鹏、罗福莉，AI顶流们聊了“龙虾”和未来12个月的行业关键词
title_zh: 杨植麟、张鹏、罗福莉，AI顶流们聊了“龙虾”和未来12个月的行业关键词
summary_en: Yang joined fellow founders Zhang Peng and Luo Fuli in a wide-ranging conversation about where the industry heads over the next 12 months.
summary_zh: 杨植麟与张鹏、罗福莉等同行创始人展开对谈，探讨未来12个月行业的发展方向。

title_en: 快讯不联播｜月之暗面回应创始人杨植麟套现数千万美元:消息不实
title_zh: 快讯不联播｜月之暗面回应创始人杨植麟套现数千万美元:消息不实
summary_en: Moonshot AI publicly denied media reports that founder Yang Zhilin had cashed out tens of millions of dollars in company shares.
summary_zh: 月之暗面官方回应称，有关创始人杨植麟套现数千万美元的报道消息不实。

title_en: Qwen3.7-Max: an agent model that runs 35 hours unattended
title_zh: Qwen3.7-Max：可无人值守运行 35 小时的 agent 模型

title_en: Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS across 16 languages
title_zh: Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS，覆盖 16 种语言

title_en: Libra: Taming Attention Workload Skew in Long-Context LLM Training with Bounded Sequence Pool
title_zh: Libra: Taming Attention Workload Skew in Long-Context LLM Training with Bounded Sequence Pool
summary_en: Alibaba training-infrastructure paper he co-authors, showing that sequence packing leaves attention workload badly skewed in long-context LLM training and fixing it with a bounded sequence pool.
summary_zh: 他参与署名的阿里训练基础设施论文，指出序列打包并未解决长上下文大模型训练中注意力负载严重倾斜的问题，并用有界序列池加以修正。

title_en: Video = World + Event Stream
title_zh: Video = World + Event Stream
summary_en: Wan-Streamer v0.3 reframes Alibaba's native-streaming interaction model around a single idea — a video is a persistent world plus an event stream.
summary_zh: Wan-Streamer v0.3 用一个统一视角重新表述阿里的原生流式交互模型：视频即持久世界加事件流。

title_en: WanSong v1.0 Technical Report
title_zh: WanSong v1.0 Technical Report
summary_en: Technical report for WanSong v1.0, Alibaba's music generation foundation model, aimed at controllable high-fidelity long-form audio.
summary_zh: 阿里音乐生成基础模型 WanSong v1.0 的技术报告，目标是可控的高保真长时音频生成。

title_en: QwenPaw-Data: Bridging Facts, Methodology, and Execution for Autonomous Enterprise Data Analytics
title_zh: QwenPaw-Data: Bridging Facts, Methodology, and Execution for Autonomous Enterprise Data Analytics
summary_en: QwenPaw-Data treats enterprise data analysis as its own agent frontier, joining facts, methodology and execution into one autonomous analytics loop.
summary_zh: QwenPaw-Data 把企业数据分析视为独立的智能体前沿，将事实、方法论与执行串成一条自主分析闭环。

title_en: ARMOR: Stabilizing On-Policy LLM RL with Off-Policy Anchor Samples
title_zh: ARMOR: Stabilizing On-Policy LLM RL with Off-Policy Anchor Samples
summary_en: ARMOR stabilises the notoriously fragile on-policy RL stage of LLM reasoning training by anchoring it with off-policy samples.
summary_zh: ARMOR 用离策略锚点样本稳定大模型推理训练中出了名脆弱的在策略强化学习阶段。

title_en: Wan-Streamer v0.2: Higher Resolution, Same Latency
title_zh: Wan-Streamer v0.2: Higher Resolution, Same Latency
summary_en: Wan-Streamer v0.2 raises the interactive output resolution of Alibaba's real-time audio-visual model while holding latency at v0.1 levels.
summary_zh: Wan-Streamer v0.2 在保持 v0.1 延迟水平的同时，提高了阿里实时音视频交互模型的输出分辨率。

title_en: Experience Augmented Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
title_zh: Experience Augmented Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
summary_en: Adds accumulated experience to reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, loosening RLVR's dependence on fresh on-policy rollouts alone.
summary_zh: 在可验证奖励强化学习中引入累积经验，减轻 RLVR 只依赖当前在策略采样的局限。

title_en: Erase-then-Delta Attention: Decoupling Erase and Write Addresses in Delta-Rule Linear Attention
title_zh: Erase-then-Delta Attention: Decoupling Erase and Write Addresses in Delta-Rule Linear Attention
summary_en: Linear-attention architecture work that decouples the erase and write addresses in delta-rule updates so corrections are no longer tied to the write position.
summary_zh: 线性注意力架构研究，将 delta 规则更新中的擦除地址与写入地址解耦，使修正不再被绑定在写入位置上。

title_en: Perception, Verdict, and Evolution: Hindsight-Driven Self-Refining Forensics Agent for AI-Generated Image Detection
title_zh: Perception, Verdict, and Evolution: Hindsight-Driven Self-Refining Forensics Agent for AI-Generated Image Detection
summary_en: A self-refining forensics agent for detecting AI-generated images, learning from hindsight over its own verdicts — Alibaba work on the deepfake problem its own generators create.
summary_zh: 一个用于检测 AI 生成图像的自我精炼取证智能体，通过复盘自身判定结果持续改进——阿里针对自家生成模型带来的深度伪造问题所做的研究。

title_en: Wan-Streamer v0.1: End-to-end Real-time Interactive Foundation Models
title_zh: Wan-Streamer v0.1: End-to-end Real-time Interactive Foundation Models
summary_en: Introduces Wan-Streamer, a native-streaming end-to-end foundation model built for low-latency full-duplex audio-visual interaction.
summary_zh: 提出 Wan-Streamer，一个为低延迟全双工音视频交互而生的原生流式端到端基础模型。

title_en: Qwen-AgentWorld: Language World Models for General Agents
title_zh: Qwen-AgentWorld: Language World Models for General Agents
summary_en: Qwen-AgentWorld studies world modelling in language, using an LLM to predict environment dynamics as the reasoning and planning core of general agents.
summary_zh: Qwen-AgentWorld 研究语言形式的世界建模，用大模型预测环境动态，作为通用智能体推理与规划的核心机制。

title_en: Deeper is Not Always Better: Mitigating the Alignment Tax via Confident Layer Decoding
title_zh: Deeper is Not Always Better: Mitigating the Alignment Tax via Confident Layer Decoding
summary_en: Challenges the assumption that the final layer decodes best, cutting the alignment tax by decoding from whichever layer is confident.
summary_zh: 质疑“最后一层预测最可靠”的默认假设，改为从置信度足够的中间层解码，从而降低对齐税。

title_en: Connect the Dots: Training LLMs for Long-Lifecycle Agents with Cross-Domain Generalization Via Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Connect the Dots: Training LLMs for Long-Lifecycle Agents with Cross-Domain Generalization Via Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Trains LLMs in the meta-skill of connecting evidence across a long deployment lifecycle, with reinforcement learning for cross-domain generalisation.
summary_zh: 用强化学习训练大模型在漫长部署周期中“串联线索”的元能力，并实现跨领域泛化。

title_en: Qwen-RobotNav Technical Report: A Scalable Navigation Model Designed for an Agentic Navigation System
title_zh: Qwen-RobotNav Technical Report: A Scalable Navigation Model Designed for an Agentic Navigation System
summary_en: Technical report for Qwen-RobotNav, a navigation model whose observation strategy can be reconfigured at inference time by the agent system above it.
summary_zh: Qwen-RobotNav 技术报告：一个观察策略可由上层智能体系统在推理时重新配置的导航模型。

title_en: Qwen-RobotManip Technical Report: Alignment Unlocks Scale for Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models
title_zh: Qwen-RobotManip Technical Report: Alignment Unlocks Scale for Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models
summary_en: Technical report for Qwen-RobotManip, arguing that aligning heterogeneous robot data under one formulation is what unlocks scale in manipulation models.
summary_zh: Qwen-RobotManip 技术报告，论证在统一表述下对齐异构机器人数据，才是操作模型规模化的关键。

title_en: Qwen-RobotWorld Technical Report: Unifying Embodied World Modeling through Language-Conditioned Video Generation
title_zh: Qwen-RobotWorld Technical Report: Unifying Embodied World Modeling through Language-Conditioned Video Generation
summary_en: Qwen-RobotWorld unifies embodied world modelling as language-conditioned video generation, predicting physically grounded future frames from an instruction.
summary_zh: Qwen-RobotWorld 将具身世界建模统一为语言条件视频生成，根据指令预测符合物理规律的未来画面。

title_en: Breaking Entropy Bounds: Accelerating RL Training via MTP with Rejection Sampling
title_zh: Breaking Entropy Bounds: Accelerating RL Training via MTP with Rejection Sampling
summary_en: Attacks the rollout bottleneck in LLM reinforcement learning by combining multi-token prediction with rejection sampling.
summary_zh: 将多词元预测与拒绝采样结合，攻克大模型强化学习训练中的 rollout 瓶颈。

title_en: Qwen-Image-Flash: Beyond Objective Design
title_zh: Qwen-Image-Flash: Beyond Objective Design
summary_en: Qwen-Image-Flash revisits few-step distillation for image generation by looking past the distillation objective itself.
summary_zh: Qwen-Image-Flash 跳出蒸馏目标本身，重新审视图像生成的少步蒸馏加速方法。

title_en: Qwen-Image-Flash: Rethinking the Training Recipe for Few-Step Distillation
title_zh: Qwen-Image-Flash: Rethinking the Training Recipe for Few-Step Distillation
summary_en: As part of the Qwen team, Zhou Jingren co-authored Qwen-Image-Flash, which rethinks the training recipe for distilling image generation models down to a few inference steps.
summary_zh: 作为通义千问团队成员，周靖人参与撰写了Qwen-Image-Flash论文，重新设计了将图像生成模型蒸馏为少步推理的训练方案。

title_en: Qwen-VLA: Unifying Vision-Language-Action Modeling across Tasks, Environments, and Robot Embodiments
title_zh: Qwen-VLA: Unifying Vision-Language-Action Modeling across Tasks, Environments, and Robot Embodiments
summary_en: Qwen-VLA unifies vision-language-action modelling across tasks, environments and robot bodies instead of training one specialised model per task.
summary_zh: Qwen-VLA 跨任务、跨环境、跨机器人本体统一视觉-语言-动作建模，取代为每个任务单独训练专用模型的做法。

title_en: Clipping Bottleneck: Stabilizing RLVR via Stochastic Recovery of Near-Boundary Signals
title_zh: Clipping Bottleneck: Stabilizing RLVR via Stochastic Recovery of Near-Boundary Signals
summary_en: Identifies clipping as a bottleneck in RLVR training and recovers the discarded near-boundary signal stochastically to stabilise it.
summary_zh: 指出裁剪是 RLVR 训练的瓶颈，通过随机恢复被丢弃的边界附近信号来稳定训练。

title_en: One-Way Policy Optimization for Self-Evolving LLMs
title_zh: One-Way Policy Optimization for Self-Evolving LLMs
summary_en: One-way policy optimisation addresses the sparsity of binary verifier rewards when scaling self-evolving LLM reasoning.
summary_zh: 单向策略优化针对自进化大模型推理扩展中二元验证器奖励过于稀疏的问题。

title_en: A Few GPUs, A Whole Lotta Scale: Faithful LLM Training Emulation with PrismLLM
title_zh: A Few GPUs, A Whole Lotta Scale: Faithful LLM Training Emulation with PrismLLM
summary_en: PrismLLM emulates thousand-GPU LLM training faithfully on a handful of GPUs, so framework debugging and tuning no longer needs the full cluster.
summary_zh: PrismLLM 用少量 GPU 忠实模拟千卡规模的大模型训练，使框架调试与性能调优不再依赖整个集群。

title_en: Qwen-Scope: Turning Sparse Features into Development Tools for Large Language Models
title_zh: Qwen-Scope: Turning Sparse Features into Development Tools for Large Language Models
summary_en: Qwen-Scope turns sparse-feature interpretability into practical development tooling for inspecting and steering Qwen models.
summary_zh: Qwen-Scope 把稀疏特征可解释性研究变成可用的开发工具，用于检视和干预 Qwen 模型。

title_en: Qwen-Image-2.0 Technical Report
title_zh: Qwen-Image-2.0 Technical Report
summary_en: Technical report for Qwen-Image-2.0, which folds high-fidelity generation and precise editing into a single image foundation model.
summary_zh: Qwen-Image-2.0 技术报告：将高保真生成与精确编辑统一进同一个图像基础模型。

title_en: Accelerating Compound LLM Training Workloads with Maestro
title_zh: Accelerating Compound LLM Training Workloads with Maestro
summary_en: Maestro speeds up compound training workloads such as distillation and multimodal training, where components differ sharply in scale.
summary_zh: Maestro 加速蒸馏、多模态训练等各组件规模差异悬殊的复合式训练负载。

title_en: SWE-Universe: Scale Real-World Verifiable Environments to Millions
title_zh: SWE-Universe: Scale Real-World Verifiable Environments to Millions
summary_en: Paper introducing SWE-Universe, a framework for scaling verifiable software-engineering training environments to millions for agent training.
summary_zh: 论文提出SWE-Universe框架，将可验证的软件工程训练环境扩展到百万级规模，用于智能体训练。

source: IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Dat…
title_en: XiYan-SQL: A Novel Multi-Generator Framework for Text-to-SQL
title_zh: XiYan-SQL: A Novel Multi-Generator Framework for Text-to-SQL
summary_en: Technical paper on XiYan-SQL, Alibaba's multi-generator framework for text-to-SQL, published in IEEE TKDE.
summary_zh: 发表于IEEE TKDE的技术论文，介绍阿里巴巴面向Text-to-SQL的多生成器框架XiYan-SQL。

title_en: Towards General Agentic Intelligence via Environment Scaling
title_zh: Towards General Agentic Intelligence via Environment Scaling
summary_en: ACL paper on scaling training environments to build more general agentic intelligence, aligned with Alibaba's Tongyi agent research.
summary_zh: ACL论文探讨通过扩展训练环境构建更通用的智能体能力，与阿里通义智能体研究方向一致。

title_en: Automated Profile Inference with Language Model Agents
title_zh: Automated Profile Inference with Language Model Agents
summary_en: ACL paper on using language model agents to automate profile inference, part of Alibaba's agent research line.
summary_zh: ACL论文研究利用语言模型智能体实现自动化画像推断，属于阿里智能体研究方向。

title_en: Nested Browser-Use Learning for Agentic Information Seeking
title_zh: Nested Browser-Use Learning for Agentic Information Seeking
summary_en: Paper on nested browser-use learning methods for building agents that seek information autonomously online.
summary_zh: 论文研究嵌套式浏览器使用学习方法，用于构建能自主在线检索信息的智能体。

title_en: MAI-UI Technical Report: Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents
title_zh: MAI-UI Technical Report: Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents
summary_en: Technical report on MAI-UI, a foundation model for real-world GUI agents that operate computer interfaces.
summary_zh: MAI-UI技术报告，介绍一个面向真实场景GUI智能体、可操作电脑界面的基础模型。

title_en: Fun-Audio-Chat Technical Report
title_zh: Fun-Audio-Chat Technical Report
summary_en: Technical report for Fun-Audio-Chat, part of Alibaba's FunAudioLLM open-source audio model line for conversational speech.
summary_zh: Fun-Audio-Chat技术报告，属于阿里FunAudioLLM系列面向对话语音的开源音频模型。

title_en: VideoAgentTrek: Computer Use Pretraining from Unlabeled Videos
title_zh: VideoAgentTrek: Computer Use Pretraining from Unlabeled Videos
summary_en: Paper on VideoAgentTrek, pretraining computer-use agents from unlabeled screen-recording videos.
summary_zh: 论文提出VideoAgentTrek，利用无标注屏幕录制视频对电脑操作智能体进行预训练。

title_en: Qwen3.7-Max announced at the Alibaba Cloud Summit
title_zh: 阿里云峰会发布 Qwen3.7-Max
summary_en: Positioned as a next-generation agent model: agentic coding, complex reasoning and long-horizon tasks, able to run autonomously for up to 35 hours without degradation. Zhou described it as top-tier on benchmarks and ahead of all other Chinese models.
summary_zh: 定位为下一代 agent 模型：擅长 agentic coding、复杂推理与长程任务，可自主运行长达 35 小时而不衰减。周靖人称其在各项基准上位居第一梯队，并领先所有其他中国模型。

title_en: Alibaba forms Token Hub; Zhou named Chief AI Architect
title_zh: 阿里成立 Token Hub；周靖人出任首席 AI 架构师
summary_en: The new unit pulls Tongyi, the MaaS line, Qwen, Wukong and AI Innovation under one roof.
summary_zh: 新业务单元整合通义大模型事业部、MaaS 业务线、Qwen、悟空与 AI 创新。

title_en: 周靖人走下主舞台
title_zh: 周靖人走下主舞台
summary_en: Reports say Zhou Jingren is stepping back from the public spotlight at Alibaba, following his earlier exit from the Alibaba Cloud CTO role.
summary_zh: 有报道称周靖人正逐渐淡出公众视野，此前他已卸任阿里云CTO一职。

title_en: 阿里AI换将 周靖人淡出云栖主舞台背后
title_zh: 阿里AI换将 周靖人淡出云栖主舞台背后
summary_en: Reports say Zhou Jingren is stepping back from Alibaba's public-facing AI leadership stage at Yunqi, suggesting an internal reshuffle worth confirming against his current registry role.
summary_zh: 有报道称周靖人正淡出阿里云栖大会的公开AI领导舞台，暗示内部人事调整，需要核实其在注册信息中的当前职位。

title_en: 阿里巴巴周靖人现身外滩大会，周靖人：模型不理解个人是因为缺少上下文
title_zh: 阿里巴巴周靖人现身外滩大会，周靖人：模型不理解个人是因为缺少上下文
summary_en: At the Bund Summit, Zhou Jingren outlined a trust framework for AI agents, arguing trust comes down to giving them clear constraints and a safe sandboxed execution environment, much like delegating a task to a person.
summary_zh: 周靖人在外滩大会上提出智能体信任框架，认为让Agent获得信任的关键在于给予明确的约束条件和安全的沙箱执行环境，如同将任务委托给人一样。

title_en: 阿里巴巴首席科学家周靖人：Agent执行要有安全沙箱机制
title_zh: 阿里巴巴首席科学家周靖人：Agent执行要有安全沙箱机制
summary_en: Zhou said AI agent execution needs a safety sandbox mechanism, addressing risk controls as Alibaba pushes agentic AI products.
summary_zh: 周靖人表示，Agent（智能体）的执行需要具备安全沙箱机制，谈及阿里在推进智能体产品时的风险管控。

title_en: 阿里巴巴首席科学家周靖人：Agent执行要有安全沙箱机制
title_zh: 阿里巴巴首席科学家周靖人：Agent执行要有安全沙箱机制
summary_en: Zhou said agent execution needs a secure sandboxing mechanism.
summary_zh: 周靖人表示，Agent的执行需要具备安全沙箱机制。

title_en: 阿里巴巴首席科学家周靖人：Agent执行要有安全沙箱机制
title_zh: 阿里巴巴首席科学家周靖人：Agent执行要有安全沙箱机制
summary_en: Zhou Jingren argued that AI agents need a safety sandbox mechanism for execution, a notable technical stance from Alibaba's chief AI architect.
summary_zh: 周靖人提出智能体（Agent）执行需要建立安全沙箱机制，这是阿里巴巴首席AI架构师就相关技术安全问题给出的重要观点。

title_en: 阿里巴巴紧急回应：“首席科学家周靖人辞职”纯属谣言！“近几日有人在网络上组织扩散该谣言”
title_zh: 阿里巴巴紧急回应：“首席科学家周靖人辞职”纯属谣言！“近几日有人在网络上组织扩散该谣言”
summary_en: Alibaba publicly denied reports that Zhou had resigned as chief scientist, calling the claim an organised rumour.
summary_zh: 阿里巴巴公开否认周靖人辞任首席科学家的传闻，称该说法系有人有组织散布的谣言。

title_en: 周靖人担任阿里巴巴首席科学家；钉钉换帅；爱立信任命新任总裁兼CEO；苹果高管将离职加入OpenAI | 2026年6月全球科技企业高管变动
title_zh: 周靖人担任阿里巴巴首席科学家；钉钉换帅；爱立信任命新任总裁兼CEO；苹果高管将离职加入OpenAI | 2026年6月全球科技企业高管变动
summary_en: Reports that Zhou Jingren was appointed Chief Scientist of Alibaba Group, a step up from his Alibaba Cloud CTO and Tongyi division role.
summary_zh: 报道周靖人出任阿里巴巴集团首席科学家，较其此前的阿里云 CTO 与通义大模型业务负责人身份更进一步。

title_en: 阿里现任合伙人调整：CFO 徐宏、资深副总裁周靖人加入，邵晓锋退出
title_zh: 阿里现任合伙人调整：CFO 徐宏、资深副总裁周靖人加入，邵晓锋退出
summary_en: Zhou Jingren joins the Alibaba Partnership alongside CFO Xu Hong as Shao Xiaofeng steps out — the technical leadership of Qwen moving into the group's governing body.
summary_zh: 周靖人与 CFO 徐宏一同加入阿里巴巴合伙人，邵晓锋退出——通义与 Qwen 的技术负责人进入集团治理核心。

title_en: 阿里合伙人调整：邵晓锋退出，AI科学家周靖人、CFO徐宏加入！CEO吴泳铭年薪4.95亿元直管Token Foundry事业部
