summary_zh: 他参与合著的 Anthropic 论文，研究如何通过红队测试发现并减少语言模型的有害输出，以及该效果随模型规模的变化。

title_en: Language Models (Mostly) Know What They Know
title_zh: Language Models (Mostly) Know What They Know
summary_en: An Anthropic paper he co-authored showing that larger language models are reasonably calibrated about which questions they can answer correctly.
summary_zh: 他参与合著的 Anthropic 论文，表明更大的语言模型对自己能否正确回答某个问题具有相当好的校准能力。

title_en: Scaling Laws and Interpretability of Learning from Repeated Data
title_zh: Scaling Laws and Interpretability of Learning from Repeated Data
summary_en: An Anthropic paper he co-authored measuring how repeated training data degrades models, and using interpretability to explain why.
summary_zh: 他参与合著的 Anthropic 论文，测量重复训练数据对模型性能的损害，并用可解释性方法解释其原因。

title_en: Training a Helpful and Harmless Assistant with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
title_zh: Training a Helpful and Harmless Assistant with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
summary_en: The Anthropic RLHF paper he co-authored, establishing the helpful-and-harmless training recipe behind Claude.
summary_zh: 他参与合著的 Anthropic RLHF 论文，确立了 Claude 背后「有用且无害」的训练方法。

title_en: Predictability and Surprise in Large Generative Models
title_zh: Predictability and Surprise in Large Generative Models
summary_en: An Anthropic position paper he co-authored on why large generative models are smoothly predictable in aggregate yet surprising in specific capabilities.
summary_zh: 他参与合著的 Anthropic 立场论文，阐述大型生成模型为何在整体上可平滑预测，却在具体能力上不断带来意外。

title_en: A General Language Assistant as a Laboratory for Alignment
title_zh: A General Language Assistant as a Laboratory for Alignment
summary_en: The early Anthropic paper he co-authored framing a general language assistant as the testbed for helpful, honest and harmless alignment.
summary_zh: 他参与合著的 Anthropic 早期论文，把通用语言助手作为「有用、诚实、无害」对齐研究的试验场。

title_en: #108 – Chris Olah on working at top AI labs without an undergrad degree
title_zh: #108 – Chris Olah on working at top AI labs without an undergrad degree
summary_en: 80,000 Hours interview on how he entered AI research without a degree and how the interpretability work began.
summary_zh: 80,000 Hours 播客访谈，谈他没有学位如何进入人工智能研究，以及可解释性工作的起点。

title_en: #107 – Chris Olah on what the hell is going on inside neural networks
title_zh: #107 – Chris Olah on what the hell is going on inside neural networks
summary_en: A long-form 80,000 Hours interview in which he explains mechanistic interpretability and what is actually going on inside neural networks.
summary_zh: 在 80,000 Hours 的长篇访谈中，他讲解机制可解释性，以及神经网络内部究竟发生了什么。

title_en: Weight Banding
title_zh: Weight Banding
summary_en: Distill "Circuits" thread piece analyzing a recurring structural pattern found in the weights of vision models.
summary_zh: Distill"电路"系列文章,分析视觉模型权重中反复出现的一种结构模式。

title_en: Branch Specialization
title_zh: Branch Specialization
summary_en: Distill "Circuits" thread piece on how parallel branches in vision networks specialize into distinct feature detectors.
summary_zh: Distill"电路"系列文章,研究视觉网络中的并行分支如何分化为不同的特征检测器。

title_en: Concrete Problems in AI Safety
title_zh: Concrete Problems in AI Safety
summary_en: The paper he co-authored that laid out concrete engineering problems in AI safety, giving the field a research agenda instead of a slogan.
summary_zh: 他参与合著的论文，列出了 AI 安全中具体的工程问题，为该领域提供了可操作的研究议程而非空泛口号。

title_en: TensorFlow: Large-Scale Machine Learning on Heterogeneous Distributed Systems
title_zh: TensorFlow: Large-Scale Machine Learning on Heterogeneous Distributed Systems
summary_en: The TensorFlow whitepaper, co-authored during his time at Google Brain before he moved to interpretability research.
summary_zh: TensorFlow 白皮书，由他在转向可解释性研究之前于 Google Brain 任职期间参与合著。

title_en: Calculus on Computational Graphs: Backpropagation
title_zh: Calculus on Computational Graphs: Backpropagation
summary_en: A widely read explainer deriving backpropagation as calculus on computational graphs.
summary_zh: 一篇流传甚广的科普文章，把反向传播推导为计算图上的微积分。

title_en: Visualizing Representations: Deep Learning and Human Beings
title_zh: Visualizing Representations: Deep Learning and Human Beings
summary_en: An essay on visualising learned representations, an early statement of the visual approach that became his research programme.
summary_zh: 关于可视化学习到的表征的文章，是他后来整个研究方向所依托的视觉化方法的早期表述。

title_en: Speaks at the Vatican beside Pope Leo XIV
title_zh: 在梵蒂冈与教皇利奥十四世同台
summary_en: Attended the presentation of the Pope's first Encyclical Letter. Said researchers 'keep finding things that are mysterious, even unsettling' — including evidence models can reflect on their own thinking and show internal states that 'functionally mirror joy, satisfaction, fear, grief and unease'.
summary_zh: 出席教皇首份通谕的发布。他表示研究者「不断发现神秘甚至令人不安的东西」—— 包括模型能反思自身思考、并表现出「功能上类似喜悦、满足、恐惧、悲伤与不安」的内部状态的证据。

title_en: Anthropic co-founder Chris Olah says it will be "moral imperative" to support those displaced by AI
title_zh: Anthropic co-founder Chris Olah says it will be "moral imperative" to support those displaced by AI

title_en: Anthropic co-founder Chris Olah says it will be "moral imperative" to support those displaced by AI
title_zh: Anthropic co-founder Chris Olah says it will be "moral imperative" to support those displaced by AI

title_en: Anthropic’s Chris Olah warns of massive AI job losses and global inequality
title_zh: Anthropic’s Chris Olah warns of massive AI job losses and global inequality
summary_en: Olah warned that AI could drive massive job losses and worsen global inequality if its economic gains aren't broadly shared.

title_en: AI needs moral oversight beyond tech labs, says Anthropic co-founder Chris Olah at Vatican
title_zh: AI needs moral oversight beyond tech labs, says Anthropic co-founder Chris Olah at Vatican

summary_zh: 在梵蒂冈的一次活动上，Olah认为AI监督不能只交给科技公司，呼吁引入外部的道德与治理力量。

title_en: Anthropic co-founder Chris Olah's remarks on Pope Leo XIV's encyclical "Magnifica humanitas"
title_zh: Anthropic co-founder Chris Olah's remarks on Pope Leo XIV's encyclical "Magnifica humanitas"
summary_en: Anthropic published Olah's own remarks responding to Pope Leo XIV's encyclical on AI, a rare public statement from him outside research.
summary_zh: Anthropic 发布了 Chris Olah 对教皇利奥十四世人工智能通谕的回应发言，这是他在研究之外少见的公开表态。

title_en: Anthropic Co-Founder Chris Olah: AI Labs Need “Moral Voices That The Incentives Cannot Bend” | Video
title_zh: Anthropic Co-Founder Chris Olah: AI Labs Need “Moral Voices That The Incentives Cannot Bend” | Video

summary_zh: Olah提出AI实验室需要「incentive无法左右的道德声音」，这是他对前沿实验室内部治理的公开表态。

title_en: Three converging trends could grow token volume 10–100x in 2026
title_zh: 三大趋势交汇，2026 年 token 用量可能增长 10–100 倍

title_en: 对话 MiniMax 闫俊杰：M3、10X 计划、10T 模型、和智能的终局
title_zh: 对话 MiniMax 闫俊杰：M3、10X 计划、10T 模型、和智能的终局
summary_en: Recorded live at MiniMax's Dev Meetup, Yan Junjie discussed the M3 model's key breakthroughs, the company's 10X plan, ambitions for a 10T-parameter model, and where he sees intelligence heading.
summary_zh: 本期在MiniMax Dev Meetup现场录制，闫俊杰分享了M3模型的关键突破、公司的10X计划、10T参数模型的构想，以及他对智能终局的判断。

title_en: The MiniMax-M2 Series: Mini Activations Unleashing Max Real-World Intelligence
title_zh: The MiniMax-M2 Series: Mini Activations Unleashing Max Real-World Intelligence
summary_en: MiniMax's M2 series of Mixture-of-Experts language models, built on the claim that small activated parameter counts can still deliver strong real-world performance.
summary_zh: MiniMax 发布的 M2 系列混合专家语言模型，主张以较小的激活参数量实现更强的实际任务表现。

title_en: MiniMax 创始人闫俊杰×罗永浩！大山并非无法翻越
title_zh: MiniMax 创始人闫俊杰×罗永浩！大山并非无法翻越
summary_en: In a long-form conversation with Luo Yonghao, Yan Junjie traced his path from a small-county upbringing through Tsinghua and SenseTime to founding MiniMax, saying the mountain ahead is not unclimbable.
summary_zh: 在与罗永浩的长篇对谈中，闫俊杰讲述了自己从小县城到清华、再到商汤，最终创立MiniMax的历程，表示前路的高山并非无法翻越。

title_en: MiniMax-M1: Scaling Test-Time Compute Efficiently with Lightning Attention
title_zh: MiniMax-M1: Scaling Test-Time Compute Efficiently with Lightning Attention
summary_en: MiniMax's open-weight hybrid-attention reasoning model, which uses lightning attention to scale test-time compute efficiently.
summary_zh: MiniMax 开源的混合注意力推理模型，通过 lightning attention 高效扩展测试时计算。

title_en: SynLogic: Synthesizing Verifiable Reasoning Data at Scale for Learning Logical Reasoning and Beyond
title_zh: SynLogic: Synthesizing Verifiable Reasoning Data at Scale for Learning Logical Reasoning and Beyond
summary_en: A MiniMax-led method for synthesising verifiable logical-reasoning data at scale, used to train reasoning ability with reinforcement learning.
summary_zh: MiniMax 主导的方法，可大规模合成可验证的逻辑推理数据，用于以强化学习训练模型的推理能力。

title_en: One RL to See Them All: Visual Triple Unified Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: One RL to See Them All: Visual Triple Unified Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: MiniMax's unified reinforcement learning recipe for post-training vision-language models across visual reasoning and perception tasks at once.
summary_zh: MiniMax 提出的统一强化学习方案，可同时在视觉推理与感知任务上对视觉语言模型做后训练。

title_en: MiniMax-Speech: Intrinsic Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech with a Learnable Speaker Encoder
title_zh: MiniMax-Speech: Intrinsic Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech with a Learnable Speaker Encoder
summary_en: MiniMax's zero-shot text-to-speech model, whose learnable speaker encoder extracts timbre from a reference clip without needing its transcript.
summary_zh: MiniMax 的零样本语音合成模型，其可学习的音色编码器无需参考音频的文本即可提取音色。

title_en: MiniMax 创始人闫俊杰：做大模型，千万别套用移动互联网的逻辑
title_zh: MiniMax 创始人闫俊杰：做大模型，千万别套用移动互联网的逻辑
summary_en: Yan Junjie argued that building large models must not follow mobile-internet-era logic — better applications and more users don't necessarily produce better models.
summary_zh: 闫俊杰在专访中指出，做大模型千万不能套用移动互联网时代的逻辑——更好的应用和更多用户并不必然带来更好的模型。

title_en: MiniMax-01: Scaling Foundation Models with Lightning Attention
title_zh: MiniMax-01: Scaling Foundation Models with Lightning Attention
summary_en: The founding technical report of MiniMax's flagship model series, which put lightning attention into a production-scale foundation model with a very long context window.
summary_zh: MiniMax 旗舰模型系列的奠基技术报告，将 lightning attention 用于可支持超长上下文的生产级基础模型。

title_en: Vol.19 对谈 MiniMax 闫俊杰：AI 语音助手的未来是大厂的，还是创业公司的？
title_zh: Vol.19 对谈 MiniMax 闫俊杰：AI 语音助手的未来是大厂的，还是创业公司的？
summary_en: Reacting to GPT-4o, Yan Junjie discussed whether the future of AI voice assistants belongs to big tech or startups, and why MiniMax pushed early into general-purpose voice interaction.
summary_zh: 在GPT-4o发布后，闫俊杰探讨AI语音助手的未来究竟属于大厂还是创业公司，并谈及MiniMax为何很早就押注通用语音交互。

title_en: Vol.30｜对话 MiniMax 闫俊杰：「Her」已诞生，下一代 AI 助手长啥样？
title_zh: Vol.30｜对话 MiniMax 闫俊杰：「Her」已诞生，下一代 AI 助手长啥样？
summary_en: Yan Junjie discussed what the next generation of AI assistants will look like after GPT-4o, saying the 'Her'-style assistant depicted in fiction has effectively already arrived.
summary_zh: 闫俊杰在专访中探讨了GPT-4o之后下一代AI助手的样貌，认为电影《her》中描绘的AI助手已基本成为现实。

title_en: cosFormer: Rethinking Softmax in Attention
title_zh: cosFormer: Rethinking Softmax in Attention
summary_en: cosFormer proposes a linear-complexity replacement for softmax attention — the research line behind MiniMax's later linear-attention models.
summary_zh: cosFormer 论文提出可替代 softmax 注意力的线性复杂度方案，是 MiniMax 日后线性注意力路线的技术源头。

title_en: One to Transfer All: A Universal Transfer Framework for Vision Foundation Model with Few Data
title_zh: One to Transfer All: A Universal Transfer Framework for Vision Foundation Model with Few Data
summary_en: A transfer framework that adapts a single vision foundation model to thousands of downstream tasks with very little data, from his years running research at SenseTime.
summary_zh: 一套迁移框架，用极少数据将单个视觉基础模型迁移到数千个下游任务，出自他在商汤研究院任职期间的工作。

title_en: INTERN: A New Learning Paradigm Towards General Vision
title_zh: INTERN: A New Learning Paradigm Towards General Vision
summary_en: SenseTime and Shanghai AI Lab's learning paradigm for general vision, from his years running research at SenseTime.
summary_zh: 商汤与上海人工智能实验室提出的通用视觉学习范式，出自他在商汤研究院任职期间的工作。

title_en: MQBench: Towards Reproducible and Deployable Model Quantization Benchmark
title_zh: MQBench: Towards Reproducible and Deployable Model Quantization Benchmark
summary_en: A reproducible benchmark for model quantization that measures algorithms under real deployment conditions, from his SenseTime research years.
summary_zh: 面向模型量化的可复现基准，在真实部署条件下评估量化算法，出自其商汤研究院时期的工作。

title_en: Supervision Exists Everywhere: A Data Efficient Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training Paradigm
title_zh: Supervision Exists Everywhere: A Data Efficient Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training Paradigm
summary_en: A data-efficient contrastive language-image pre-training method that matches CLIP using far less training data, from his SenseTime research years.
summary_zh: 一种数据高效的图文对比预训练方法，用远少于 CLIP 的数据达到相当效果，出自其商汤研究院时期的工作。

title_en: BN-NAS: Neural Architecture Search with Batch Normalization
title_zh: BN-NAS: Neural Architecture Search with Batch Normalization
summary_en: Uses batch-normalization statistics alone to score candidate architectures, cutting the cost of neural architecture search, from his SenseTime research years.
summary_zh: 仅用批归一化统计量为候选架构打分，从而降低神经架构搜索的开销，出自其商汤研究院时期的工作。

title_en: PSViT: Better Vision Transformer via Token Pooling and Attention Sharing
title_zh: PSViT: Better Vision Transformer via Token Pooling and Attention Sharing
summary_en: Cuts two kinds of redundancy in vision transformers through token pooling and attention sharing, from his SenseTime research years.
summary_zh: 通过 token 池化与注意力共享减少视觉 Transformer 中的两类冗余，出自其商汤研究院时期的工作。

summary_en: Describes t5x and seqio, the JAX libraries Google used to train and evaluate large language models at scale.
summary_zh: 介绍 t5x 与 seqio 这两个基于 JAX 的库，谷歌用其大规模训练和评测大语言模型。

title_en: ST-MoE: Designing Stable and Transferable Sparse Expert Models
title_zh: ST-MoE: Designing Stable and Transferable Sparse Expert Models
summary_en: ST-MoE tackles the training instability and poor fine-tuning transfer of sparse expert models, a direct follow-on to Shazeer's MoE line of work.
summary_zh: ST-MoE 针对稀疏专家模型的训练不稳定与微调迁移不佳问题提出改进，是 Shazeer 混合专家研究脉络的直接延续。

title_en: LaMDA: Language Models for Dialog Applications
title_zh: LaMDA: Language Models for Dialog Applications
summary_en: LaMDA, a family of dialog-specialised Transformer language models up to 137B parameters; Shazeer is a lead author and the work later shaped Character.AI.
summary_zh: LaMDA 论文，提出面向对话、参数最高达 1370 亿的 Transformer 语言模型系列；Shazeer 是主要作者之一，这项工作后来影响了 Character.AI。

title_en: Searching for Efficient Transformers for Language Modeling
title_zh: Searching for Efficient Transformers for Language Modeling
summary_en: NeurIPS paper searching for more efficient transformer architectures for language modeling, co-authored by Shazeer.
summary_zh: NeurIPS论文，探索面向语言建模的更高效Transformer架构，沙泽尔为共同作者。

title_en: Primer: Searching for Efficient Transformers for Language Modeling
title_zh: Primer: Searching for Efficient Transformers for Language Modeling
summary_en: Primer uses architecture search to find Transformer variants that reach the same quality at substantially lower training cost.
summary_zh: Primer 通过架构搜索寻找 Transformer 变体，以显著更低的训练成本达到同等质量。

title_en: GSPMD: General and Scalable Parallelization for ML Computation Graphs
title_zh: GSPMD: General and Scalable Parallelization for ML Computation Graphs
summary_en: GSPMD, a compiler-based system that parallelises ML computation graphs automatically from lightweight user annotations.
summary_zh: GSPMD 是一套基于编译器的系统，可依据轻量标注自动并行化机器学习计算图。

title_en: GShard: Scaling Giant Models with Conditional Computation and Automatic Sharding
title_zh: GShard: Scaling Giant Models with Conditional Computation and Automatic Sharding
summary_en: GShard paper on scaling giant models via conditional computation and automatic sharding — foundational to Shazeer's mixture-of-experts work.
summary_zh: 《GShard》论文，通过条件计算和自动分片扩展巨型模型规模，是沙泽尔专家混合研究的奠基性工作。

title_en: Do Transformer Modifications Transfer Across Implementations and Applications?
title_zh: Do Transformer Modifications Transfer Across Implementations and Applications?
summary_en: Systematic study finding that most proposed Transformer modifications do not transfer across implementations and tasks.
summary_zh: 系统性实验发现，大多数针对 Transformer 的改进换个实现或换个任务后并不能复现收益。

title_en: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
title_zh: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
summary_en: Switch Transformers simplify mixture-of-experts routing to one expert per token, scaling to trillion-parameter models at constant compute per example.
summary_zh: Switch Transformer 将混合专家路由简化为每个 token 只选一个专家，在单样本计算量不变的前提下扩展到万亿参数模型。

title_en: Talking-Heads Attention
title_zh: Talking-Heads Attention
summary_en: Talking-heads attention, Shazeer's variation on multi-head attention that adds linear projections across the head dimension around the softmax.
summary_zh: Talking-heads 注意力，Shazeer 提出的多头注意力变体，在 softmax 前后沿注意力头维度加入线性投影。

title_en: GLU Variants Improve Transformer
title_zh: GLU Variants Improve Transformer
summary_en: Single-author note showing that gated linear unit variants in the feed-forward layer improve Transformer quality; the source of the now-standard SwiGLU.
summary_zh: Shazeer 独著短文，证明在前馈层使用门控线性单元变体可提升 Transformer 质量，也是如今通用的 SwiGLU 的出处。

title_en: How Much Knowledge Can You Pack Into the Parameters of a Language Model?
title_zh: How Much Knowledge Can You Pack Into the Parameters of a Language Model?
summary_en: Measures how much world knowledge a language model can store in its parameters by fine-tuning T5 to answer questions with no external retrieval.
summary_zh: 通过微调 T5 在不借助外部检索的情况下回答问题，衡量语言模型参数中能存储多少世界知识。

title_en: Faster Transformer Decoding: N-gram Masked Self-Attention
title_zh: Faster Transformer Decoding: N-gram Masked Self-Attention
summary_en: Proposes n-gram masked self-attention, truncating the target-side window to speed up Transformer decoding with little quality loss.
summary_zh: 提出 n-gram 掩码自注意力，通过截断目标端窗口加速 Transformer 解码，且质量损失很小。

title_en: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer
title_zh: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer
summary_en: The T5 paper, which casts every NLP task as text-to-text and systematically compares transfer-learning choices at scale; Shazeer is second author.
summary_zh: T5 论文，将所有自然语言处理任务统一为文本到文本形式，并系统比较大规模迁移学习的各项设计选择；Shazeer 为第二作者。

title_en: High Resolution Medical Image Analysis with Spatial Partitioning
title_zh: High Resolution Medical Image Analysis with Spatial Partitioning
summary_en: Applies spatial partitioning to train CNNs directly on gigapixel CT and pathology images, an application of Shazeer's Mesh-TensorFlow work.
summary_zh: 利用空间划分直接在十亿像素级的 CT 与病理图像上训练卷积网络，是 Shazeer 的 Mesh-TensorFlow 工作的一项应用。

title_en: Corpora Generation for Grammatical Error Correction
title_zh: Corpora Generation for Grammatical Error Correction
summary_en: Generates large synthetic corpora for grammatical error correction to address the data scarcity that limits sequence-to-sequence GEC models.
summary_zh: 为语法纠错生成大规模合成语料，以缓解制约序列到序列纠错模型的数据稀缺问题。

title_en: Blockwise Parallel Decoding for Deep Autoregressive Models
title_zh: Blockwise Parallel Decoding for Deep Autoregressive Models
summary_en: Blockwise parallel decoding predicts several tokens at once and verifies them in parallel, cutting autoregressive decoding latency.
summary_zh: 分块并行解码一次预测多个 token 并并行验证，从而降低自回归解码的延迟。

title_en: Mesh-TensorFlow: Deep Learning for Supercomputers
title_zh: Mesh-TensorFlow: Deep Learning for Supercomputers
summary_en: Mesh-TensorFlow, Shazeer's framework for splitting model tensors across a mesh of processors so networks too large for data parallelism can be trained.
summary_zh: Mesh-TensorFlow 是 Shazeer 主导的框架，将模型张量切分到处理器网格上，使数据并行无法容纳的超大网络得以训练。

title_en: Weakly Supervised Grammatical Error Correction using Iterative Decoding
title_zh: Weakly Supervised Grammatical Error Correction using Iterative Decoding
summary_en: Trains a Transformer for grammatical error correction on weakly supervised bitext and improves it with iterative decoding.
summary_zh: 在弱监督双语文本上训练 Transformer 进行语法纠错，并通过迭代解码进一步提升效果。

title_en: Music Transformer
title_zh: Music Transformer
summary_en: Music Transformer adapts relative attention to model the long-range repetition and structure that music depends on.
summary_zh: Music Transformer 改进相对注意力机制，用以建模音乐中依赖的长程重复与结构。

title_en: Adafactor: Adaptive Learning Rates with Sublinear Memory Cost
title_zh: Adafactor: Adaptive Learning Rates with Sublinear Memory Cost
summary_en: Adafactor, Shazeer's optimiser that factors the second-moment estimates to train large models with sublinear memory cost.
summary_zh: Adafactor 是 Shazeer 提出的优化器，通过分解二阶矩估计，以次线性显存开销训练大模型。

title_en: Tensor2Tensor for Neural Machine Translation
title_zh: Tensor2Tensor for Neural Machine Translation
summary_en: Describes Tensor2Tensor, the library carrying the reference implementation of the Transformer for neural machine translation.
summary_zh: 介绍 Tensor2Tensor 库，其中包含用于神经机器翻译的 Transformer 参考实现。

title_zh: 离开 Google 加入 OpenAI

title_zh: Magistral

summary_zh: Magistral 是 Mistral 的首个推理模型，采用自研的强化学习流程而非蒸馏他人模型，Mensch 是共同作者。

summary_zh: Mensch 宣布发布一款面向智能体编程任务的 Mistral 开源模型。

title_en: Jensen Huang and Arthur Mensch on Winning the Global AI Race
title_zh: Jensen Huang and Arthur Mensch on Winning the Global AI Race
summary_en: Joint a16z conversation with NVIDIA's Jensen Huang on national AI strategy and what it takes for a country to compete in AI.
summary_zh: 在 a16z 节目中与英伟达黄仁勋对谈，讨论国家层面的 AI 战略以及一国参与 AI 竞争所需的条件。

title_en: I had the great pleasure to talk about sovereignty in AI with Jensen and @AnjneyMidha. We explain why every nation state needs an AI strategy and what matters f

title_zh: Our new OCR model is available through our public API and as a self-deployable solution. In use on le Chat, and part of our specialist model family that is gett
summary_en: Mensch announces Mistral's OCR model, available through the public API and as a self-deployable solution within its growing specialist model family.
summary_zh: Mensch 宣布 Mistral OCR 模型上线，可通过公开 API 调用或自行部署，属于其不断扩展的专用模型系列。

title_en: Codestral 25.01 is not only on top of the Copilot Arena leaderboard, it's also 2x faster than the first Codestral -- that matters a lot for code completion
title_zh: Codestral 25.01 is not only on top of the Copilot Arena leaderboard, it's also 2x faster than the first Codestral -- that matters a lot for code completion

summary_zh: Mensch 宣布 Codestral 25.01 登顶 Copilot Arena 榜单，代码补全速度是初代 Codestral 的两倍。

summary_zh: Mensch 回顾 Mistral 从科研公司转型为科研加产品公司的过程，并以 le Chat 的发布作为标志。

title_zh: At Mistral, we've grown aware that to create the best AI experience, one needs to co-design models and product interfaces. Pixtral was trained with high-impact
summary_en: Mensch argues that models and product interfaces must be co-designed, citing Pixtral's training for front-end applications.
summary_zh: Mensch 提出模型与产品界面必须协同设计，并以面向前端应用训练的 Pixtral 为例。

title_en: Introducing the world's best edge models. https://t.co/nAExVy0fPZ
title_zh: Introducing the world's best edge models. https://t.co/nAExVy0fPZ

summary_zh: Mensch 发布 Mistral 面向端侧部署的边缘模型系列。

title_en: Pixtral 12B
title_zh: Pixtral 12B
summary_en: Pixtral 12B, Mistral's first multimodal model, which reads images and documents without giving up text performance; Mensch is a co-author.
summary_zh: Pixtral 12B 是 Mistral 的首个多模态模型，在不牺牲文本能力的前提下理解图像与文档，Mensch 是共同作者。

title_en: Moving forward with a new Small, Pixtral on le Chat and la Plateforme, reduced prices across the board, and an API free tier!

summary_zh: Mensch宣布推出新的Mistral Small模型、Pixtral登陆Le Chat与La Plateforme、全面降价，并推出免费API层级。

title_en: New steps towards faster model customisation and application building
title_zh: New steps towards faster model customisation and application building
summary_en: Mensch announced new features for faster model customization and application building on Mistral's platform.
summary_zh: Mensch宣布Mistral平台推出新功能，加快模型定制和应用构建速度。

title_en: Largement sur le Pareto
title_zh: Largement sur le Pareto

title_en: IA : Notre Ambition Pour La France: Commission De L'intelligence Artificielle
title_zh: IA : Notre Ambition Pour La France: Commission De L'intelligence Artificielle
summary_en: Contribution to the French government's national AI commission report on the country's AI ambitions.
summary_zh: 为法国政府人工智能委员会报告（阐述法国AI发展目标）所做的贡献。

title_en: Mixtral of Experts
title_zh: Mixtral of Experts
summary_en: Mixtral 8x7B, the sparse mixture-of-experts model that made MoE a mainstream open-weights architecture; Mensch is a co-author.
summary_zh: Mixtral 8x7B 稀疏混合专家模型，使 MoE 成为开放权重模型的主流架构，Mensch 是共同作者。

title_en: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models
title_zh: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models
summary_en: Google DeepMind's Gemini technical report, on which Mensch is credited among the authors for work done before he left to found Mistral.
summary_zh: 谷歌 DeepMind 的 Gemini 技术报告，Mensch 因离职创办 Mistral 之前的工作而位列作者名单。

title_en: Safety in Numbers: Keeping AI Open
title_zh: Safety in Numbers: Keeping AI Open
summary_en: Mensch discussed Mistral's founding, the Chinchilla paper he co-authored at DeepMind, and the case for keeping AI open, on the a16z podcast.
summary_zh: Mensch在a16z播客中谈及创立Mistral的经过、他在DeepMind合著的Chinchilla论文,以及保持AI开放的理由。

title_en: Mistral 7B and the Open Source Revolution With Arthur Mensch, CEO Mistral AI
title_zh: Mistral 7B and the Open Source Revolution With Arthur Mensch, CEO Mistral AI
summary_en: Arthur Mensch appeared on the No Priors podcast to discuss Mistral 7B and Mistral AI's open-source strategy.
summary_zh: Arthur Mensch 做客 No Priors 播客，谈 Mistral 7B 与 Mistral AI 的开源策略。

title_en: Mistral 7B
title_zh: Mistral 7B
summary_en: Mistral 7B, the open-weights model that launched the company and outperformed Llama 2 13B across benchmarks; Mensch is a co-author.
summary_zh: Mistral 7B 是让公司一举成名的开放权重模型，在各项基准上超过 Llama 2 13B，Mensch 是共同作者。

title_en: Three ways to improve feature alignment for open vocabulary detection
title_zh: Three ways to improve feature alignment for open vocabulary detection
summary_en: DeepMind paper on aligning visual and text features so open-vocabulary detectors generalise to unseen classes, co-authored with Arandjelovic, Henaff and Zisserman.
summary_zh: DeepMind 论文，研究如何对齐视觉与文本特征，使开放词表检测器能泛化到未见类别，与 Arandjelovic、Henaff、Zisserman 等合作。

title_en: Self-conditioned Embedding Diffusion for Text Generation
title_zh: Self-conditioned Embedding Diffusion for Text Generation
summary_en: DeepMind study of continuous diffusion over token embeddings as a route to text generation, co-authored by Mensch.
summary_zh: DeepMind 研究，探索在词元嵌入上做连续扩散以生成文本，Mensch 是共同作者。

title_en: Dissecting adaptive methods in GANs
title_zh: Dissecting adaptive methods in GANs
summary_en: Analysis of why adaptive optimisers matter so much for GAN training, co-authored with Jelassi, Gidel and Li.
summary_zh: 分析自适应优化方法为何对 GAN 训练如此关键，与 Jelassi、Gidel、Li 合作。

title_en: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
title_zh: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
summary_en: Flamingo, DeepMind's few-shot visual language model and a reference point for later multimodal systems; Mensch is a co-author.
summary_zh: DeepMind 的少样本视觉语言模型 Flamingo，是后续多模态系统的重要参照，Mensch 是共同作者。

title_en: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
title_zh: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
summary_en: The Chinchilla paper, which showed large language models were badly undertrained for their compute budget and reset how the field allocates data and parameters; Mensch is a co-author.
summary_zh: 即 Chinchilla 论文，指出大语言模型在既定算力下训练数据严重不足，改变了业界在数据与参数之间的分配方式，Mensch 是共同作者。

title_en: Unified Scaling Laws for Routed Language Models
title_zh: Unified Scaling Laws for Routed Language Models
summary_en: Scaling laws for routed (mixture-of-experts) language models, groundwork for the sparse architectures he later shipped at Mistral.
summary_zh: 研究路由式（混合专家）语言模型的扩展规律，为他日后在 Mistral 推出的稀疏架构打下基础。

title_en: Scaling Language Models: Methods, Analysis & Insights from Training Gopher
title_zh: Scaling Language Models: Methods, Analysis & Insights from Training Gopher
summary_en: DeepMind's Gopher report, training a 280B-parameter language model and analysing where scale helps across 152 tasks; Mensch is a co-author.
summary_zh: DeepMind 的 Gopher 报告，训练 2800 亿参数语言模型并在 152 项任务上分析规模的作用，Mensch 是共同作者。

title_en: Improving language models by retrieving from trillions of tokens
title_zh: Improving language models by retrieving from trillions of tokens
summary_en: RETRO, which improves language models by retrieving from a two-trillion-token database instead of growing parameters; Mensch is a co-author.
summary_zh: RETRO 通过从 2 万亿词元的数据库中检索来提升语言模型，而非一味增加参数，Mensch 是共同作者。

title_en: Differentiable Divergences Between Time Series
title_zh: Differentiable Divergences Between Time Series
summary_en: A differentiable divergence for comparing time series of different lengths, replacing non-differentiable dynamic time warping; with Blondel and Vert.
summary_zh: 提出可微的时间序列差异度量，替代不可微的动态时间规整，与 Blondel、Vert 合作。

title_en: Fine-grain atlases of functional modes for fMRI analysis
title_zh: Fine-grain atlases of functional modes for fMRI analysis
summary_en: DiFuMo, fine-grained atlases of functional brain modes for large-scale fMRI analysis, from Mensch's neuroimaging period.
summary_zh: DiFuMo 细粒度脑功能模式图谱，用于大规模 fMRI 分析，出自 Mensch 的神经影像研究阶段。

title_en: Online Sinkhorn: Optimal Transport distances from sample streams
title_zh: Online Sinkhorn: Optimal Transport distances from sample streams
summary_en: Online Sinkhorn, an algorithm for computing optimal-transport distances from streaming samples rather than fixed discrete distributions; with Gabriel Peyre.
summary_zh: Online Sinkhorn 算法，可从样本流而非固定离散分布计算最优传输距离，与 Gabriel Peyre 合作。

title_en: A mean-field analysis of two-player zero-sum games
title_zh: A mean-field analysis of two-player zero-sum games
summary_en: Mean-field analysis of finding Nash equilibria in two-player zero-sum continuous games, the setting behind GAN and robust training.
summary_zh: 用平均场方法分析双人零和连续博弈中的纳什均衡求解，这正是 GAN 与鲁棒训练背后的问题设定。

title_en: Extragradient with player sampling for faster Nash equilibrium finding
title_zh: Extragradient with player sampling for faster Nash equilibrium finding
summary_en: An extragradient method with player sampling that finds Nash equilibria faster in many-player games such as GAN training.
summary_zh: 提出带玩家采样的外推梯度方法，在 GAN 训练等多方博弈中更快找到纳什均衡。

title_en: Geometric Losses for Distributional Learning
title_zh: Geometric Losses for Distributional Learning
summary_en: Mensch's first-authored generalisation of the logistic loss using entropy-regularised optimal transport for distributional learning.
summary_zh: Mensch 作为第一作者，用熵正则化最优传输推广逻辑损失，用于分布式标签学习。

title_en: Extracting representations of cognition across neuroimaging studies improves brain decoding
title_zh: Extracting representations of cognition across neuroimaging studies improves brain decoding
summary_en: First-authored work pooling many neuroimaging studies into shared representations of cognition to improve brain decoding.
summary_zh: Mensch 第一作者的工作，将大量神经影像研究汇聚成共享的认知表征，以提升脑解码效果。

title_en: Differentiable Dynamic Programming for Structured Prediction and Attention
title_zh: Differentiable Dynamic Programming for Structured Prediction and Attention
summary_en: Makes dynamic programming differentiable so it can be used inside structured prediction and attention layers; his most-cited methods paper, with Blondel.
summary_zh: 让动态规划变得可微，从而能嵌入结构化预测与注意力层，是他与 Blondel 合作、被引最多的方法论文。

title_en: Learning Neural Representations of Human Cognition across Many fMRI Studies
title_zh: Learning Neural Representations of Human Cognition across Many fMRI Studies
summary_en: First-authored model learning neural representations of human cognition across many fMRI studies at once.
summary_zh: Mensch 第一作者的研究，跨多项 fMRI 研究同时学习人类认知的神经表征。

title_en: Stochastic Subsampling for Factorizing Huge Matrices
title_zh: Stochastic Subsampling for Factorizing Huge Matrices
summary_en: Matrix-factorisation algorithm that scales to matrices huge in both rows and columns, from his PhD work with Mairal, Thirion and Varoquaux.
summary_zh: 可扩展到行列均极大的矩阵分解算法，出自他与 Mairal、Thirion、Varoquaux 合作的博士研究。

title_en: New open-weight MoE family enters early access
title_zh: 新的开放权重 MoE 模型家族进入早期访问
summary_en: Mensch describes it as 'fat but sparse'; parameter count, benchmarks and license terms not yet disclosed.
summary_zh: Mensch 形容其为「肥胖但稀疏」；参数量、基准与许可条款尚未披露。

title_en: ARR passes $400M; Koyeb acquired; €4B datacenter build committed
title_zh: ARR 突破 4 亿美元；收购 Koyeb；承诺 40 亿欧元数据中心
summary_en: Up from roughly $20M a year earlier. Datacenters across France and Sweden.
summary_zh: 较一年前约 2000 万美元大幅增长。数据中心分布于法国与瑞典。

title_en: Mistral's Arthur Mensch: model commoditisation is here — value moves downstream
title_zh: Mistral's Arthur Mensch: model commoditisation is here — value moves downstream
summary_en: In an interview, Mensch argued AI model capabilities are commoditizing and that value is shifting to the application layer above the model.
summary_zh: 在采访中，Mensch表示AI模型能力正在商品化，价值正转移到模型之上的应用层。

title_en: Arthur Mensch tells French parliament Europe has ~2 years to build sovereign AI
title_zh: Arthur Mensch tells French parliament Europe has ~2 years to build sovereign AI
summary_en: Mensch tells the French parliament Europe has roughly two years left to build sovereign AI capacity.
summary_zh: Mensch向法国议会表示，欧洲建立主权AI能力的窗口期大约只剩两年。

title_en: PM exchanges views with Mistral AI CEO Arthur Mensch on trusted AI, innovation and international cooperation
title_zh: PM exchanges views with Mistral AI CEO Arthur Mensch on trusted AI, innovation and international cooperation
summary_en: The Indian government's own readout of Prime Minister Modi's Paris meeting with Mensch on trusted AI, open-weight models and international cooperation.
summary_zh: 印度政府发布的通报：莫迪总理在巴黎会见 Mensch，双方就可信 AI、开源权重模型与国际合作交换意见。

title_en: Mistral AI CEO Arthur Mensch discusses sovereign AI partnership with PM Modi
title_zh: Mistral AI CEO Arthur Mensch discusses sovereign AI partnership with PM Modi
summary_en: Mensch discussed a sovereign-AI partnership with Indian PM Modi, extending Mistral's push into government AI deals.
summary_zh: 门施与印度总理莫迪讨论了主权AI合作事宜，延续了Mistral在政府AI合作方面的布局。

title_zh: Mistral's Arthur Mensch warns Europe has two years to stop AI dependence

title_zh: This one feels special - a lot of folks on this list we've admired for years and now finally get to work with. Above all I'm grateful for the incredible team th

title_en: Decision Transformer: Reinforcement Learning via Sequence Modeling
title_zh: Decision Transformer: Reinforcement Learning via Sequence Modeling
summary_en: Decision Transformer, reframing reinforcement learning as a sequence-modeling problem solved with transformers.
summary_zh: Decision Transformer，将强化学习重新表述为用Transformer解决的序列建模问题。

title_en: Improving Computational Efficiency in Visual Reinforcement Learning via Stored Embeddings
title_zh: Improving Computational Efficiency in Visual Reinforcement Learning via Stored Embeddings
summary_en: A method for improving the computational efficiency of visual reinforcement learning agents via stored embeddings.
summary_zh: 一种通过存储嵌入向量提升视觉强化学习智能体计算效率的方法。

title_en: Revisiting ResNets: Improved Training and Scaling Strategies
title_zh: Revisiting ResNets: Improved Training and Scaling Strategies
summary_en: Revisiting ResNets, proposing improved training and scaling recipes for the classic architecture.
summary_zh: Revisiting ResNets，为经典ResNet架构提出改进的训练与扩展方案。

title_en: SelfAugment: Automatic Augmentation Policies for Self-Supervised Learning
title_zh: SelfAugment: Automatic Augmentation Policies for Self-Supervised Learning
summary_en: SelfAugment, a method that automatically searches augmentation policies for self-supervised learning.
summary_zh: SelfAugment，一种为自监督学习自动搜索数据增强策略的方法。

title_en: Simple Copy-Paste is a Strong Data Augmentation Method for Instance Segmentation
title_zh: Simple Copy-Paste is a Strong Data Augmentation Method for Instance Segmentation
summary_en: Simple Copy-Paste, a strong data augmentation method for instance segmentation.
summary_zh: Simple Copy-Paste，一种用于实例分割的高效数据增强方法。

title_en: Bottleneck Transformers for Visual Recognition
title_zh: Bottleneck Transformers for Visual Recognition
summary_en: Bottleneck Transformers, a hybrid CNN-transformer backbone for visual recognition.
summary_zh: Bottleneck Transformers，用于视觉识别的CNN-Transformer混合骨干网络。

title_en: Scaling Local Self-Attention for Parameter Efficient Visual Backbones
title_zh: Scaling Local Self-Attention for Parameter Efficient Visual Backbones
summary_en: A parameter-efficient visual backbone built on scaled local self-attention.
summary_zh: 基于可扩展局部自注意力机制构建的参数高效视觉骨干网络。

title_en: VideoGen: Generative Modeling of Videos using VQ-VAE and Transformers
title_zh: VideoGen: Generative Modeling of Videos using VQ-VAE and Transformers
summary_en: VideoGen, generating video using VQ-VAE representations combined with transformers.
summary_zh: VideoGen，结合VQ-VAE表征与Transformer生成视频。

title_en: VideoGPT: Video Generation using VQ-VAE and Transformers
title_zh: VideoGPT: Video Generation using VQ-VAE and Transformers
summary_en: VideoGPT scales likelihood-based video generation by combining a VQ-VAE over video with an autoregressive Transformer over the discrete latents.
summary_zh: VideoGPT 将视频上的 VQ-VAE 与在离散隐变量上的自回归 Transformer 结合，把基于似然的视频生成扩展到自然视频。

title_en: Reinforcement Learning with Latent Flow
title_zh: Reinforcement Learning with Latent Flow
summary_en: Feeds optical-flow-like motion features into the policy so pixel-based RL agents can use temporal information without extra supervision.
summary_zh: 将类似光流的运动特征输入策略网络，使基于像素的强化学习智能体无需额外监督即可利用时序信息。

title_en: D2RL: Deep Dense Architectures in Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: D2RL: Deep Dense Architectures in Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: D2RL shows that dense skip connections in the actor and critic networks improve deep RL performance across a range of tasks.
summary_zh: D2RL 表明，在 actor 与 critic 网络中加入稠密跳连可以在多种任务上提升深度强化学习的表现。

title_en: SUNRISE: A Simple Unified Framework for Ensemble Learning in Deep Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: SUNRISE: A Simple Unified Framework for Ensemble Learning in Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: SUNRISE unifies ensemble methods for off-policy RL, using ensemble-based weighted Bellman backups and UCB exploration to stabilise training.
summary_zh: SUNRISE 统一了 off-policy 强化学习中的集成方法，通过基于集成的加权贝尔曼更新和 UCB 探索来稳定训练。

title_en: Reinforcement Learning with Augmented Data
title_zh: Reinforcement Learning with Augmented Data
summary_en: RAD shows that plain image augmentations such as random crop are enough to make pixel-based RL far more sample-efficient, without any auxiliary loss.
summary_zh: RAD 表明，仅用随机裁剪等普通图像增强，无需任何辅助损失，就能大幅提升基于像素的强化学习的样本效率。

title_en: CURL: Contrastive Unsupervised Representations for Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: CURL: Contrastive Unsupervised Representations for Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: CURL, his first-author paper adding contrastive representation learning to off-policy RL, one of the standard results for sample-efficient control from pixels.
summary_zh: 他作为第一作者的 CURL，将对比表示学习引入 off-policy 强化学习，是像素输入下样本高效控制的代表性成果之一。

title_en: Data-Efficient Image Recognition with Contrastive Predictive Coding
title_zh: Data-Efficient Image Recognition with Contrastive Predictive Coding
summary_en: Work at DeepMind scaling Contrastive Predictive Coding so that self-supervised features match supervised accuracy with a fraction of the labels.
summary_zh: 在 DeepMind 完成的工作，将对比预测编码扩展到使自监督特征仅用少量标签即可达到监督学习的准确率。

title_en: Flow++: Improving Flow-Based Generative Models with Variational Dequantization and Architecture Design
title_zh: Flow++: Improving Flow-Based Generative Models with Variational Dequantization and Architecture Design
summary_en: Flow++ improves flow-based generative models with variational dequantization and a redesigned coupling architecture, closing much of the density-modeling gap.
summary_zh: Flow++ 通过变分反量化和重新设计的耦合结构改进基于流的生成模型，大幅缩小了密度建模上的差距。

title_en: Universal Planning Networks
title_zh: Universal Planning Networks
summary_en: His first-author Berkeley paper learning a latent space in which gradient-descent planning itself is trained end to end for visuomotor control.
summary_zh: 他在伯克利作为第一作者的论文，学习一个隐空间，使梯度下降式的规划过程本身可以端到端训练，用于视觉运动控制。

title_en: Learning to Repeat: Fine Grained Action Repetition for Deep Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Learning to Repeat: Fine Grained Action Repetition for Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Early reinforcement-learning paper he co-authored at IIT Madras, on letting agents decide how long to repeat a chosen action.
summary_zh: 他在印度理工马德拉斯分校期间合作的早期强化学习论文，研究让智能体自行决定动作重复的时长。

title_en: Dynamic Frame skip Deep Q Network
title_zh: Dynamic Frame skip Deep Q Network
summary_en: Early IIT Madras work letting a DQN agent learn how long to repeat an action rather than using a fixed frame-skip.
summary_zh: 他在印度理工马德拉斯分校的早期工作，让 DQN 智能体自行学习动作重复的时长，而非使用固定的跳帧数。

title_en: Option Discovery in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning using Spatio-Temporal Clustering
title_zh: Option Discovery in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning using Spatio-Temporal Clustering
summary_en: His first-author early work discovering options in hierarchical RL by spatio-temporal clustering of the agent's state space.
summary_zh: 他作为第一作者的早期工作，通过对智能体状态空间做时空聚类，在分层强化学习中自动发现 option。

title_en: Attend, Adapt and Transfer: Attentive Deep Architecture for Adaptive Transfer from multiple sources in the same domain
title_zh: Attend, Adapt and Transfer: Attentive Deep Architecture for Adaptive Transfer from multiple sources in the same domain
summary_en: A2T uses an attention mechanism to transfer selectively from multiple source tasks while avoiding negative transfer from unhelpful ones.
summary_zh: A2T 利用注意力机制从多个源任务中选择性迁移，同时避免来自无益源任务的负迁移。

title_en: Series E-6 values Perplexity at $22.6B

summary_en: On roughly $450–500M annualized revenue. Over 1 billion monthly search queries and 100M+ monthly actives across products.
summary_zh: 年化收入约 4.5–5 亿美元。月搜索查询超 10 亿，全产品月活超 1 亿。

summary_zh: Barret Zoph宣布加入Google DeepMind，负责强化学习与后训练工作，重返他职业生涯起步的谷歌大脑培训项目所在地。

title_en: Super excited to join the team!
title_zh: Super excited to join the team!
summary_en: Zoph's announcement of joining a new team, posted the same week press reports said he was leaving Thinking Machines Lab for OpenAI — marking his January 2026 return to OpenAI.
summary_zh: Barret Zoph发布加入新团队的消息，与媒体报道他离开Thinking Machines Lab重返OpenAI是同一周，标志着他2026年1月回归OpenAI。

title_en: Excited to release Tinker and see what the community uses it for.
title_zh: Excited to release Tinker and see what the community uses it for.
summary_en: Zoph announces the release of Tinker, a fine-tuning product from Thinking Machines Lab.
summary_zh: Barret Zoph宣布发布Tinker，这是Thinking Machines Lab推出的模型微调产品。

title_en: Excited to share our first blog post -- one of many to follow!
title_zh: Excited to share our first blog post -- one of many to follow!
summary_en: Zoph announces Thinking Machines Lab's first public blog post, signaling the start of the company's public output.
summary_zh: Barret Zoph宣布Thinking Machines Lab发布首篇公开博客文章，标志着公司公开输出的开始。

title_en: Super excited to be part of this incredible team and company. Please reach out if you are interested in joining!
title_zh: Super excited to be part of this incredible team and company. Please reach out if you are interested in joining!
summary_en: Zoph announces joining a new team and company, matching later press reports identifying him as a co-founder of Thinking Machines Lab.
summary_zh: Barret Zoph宣布加入一个新团队和公司，与后续媒体报道其为Thinking Machines Lab联合创始人的说法相符。

title_en: OpenAI o1 System Card
title_zh: OpenAI o1 System Card
summary_en: System card for OpenAI's o1 reasoning models, covering the safety evaluations of large-scale RL-trained chain-of-thought reasoning; Zoph is a listed author from his time leading post-training.
summary_zh: OpenAI o1 推理模型的系统卡，介绍了大规模强化学习训练的思维链推理模型的安全评测；Zoph 在负责后训练期间参与署名。

title_en: GPT-4o System Card
title_zh: GPT-4o System Card
summary_en: System card for GPT-4o, the end-to-end omni model handling text, audio, image and video; Zoph is among the credited authors.
summary_zh: GPT-4o 的系统卡，介绍这一端到端处理文本、音频、图像和视频的全模态模型；Zoph 位列署名作者之中。

title_en: I posted this note to OpenAI. Hey everybody, I have decided to leave OpenAI. This was a very difficult decision as I have has such an incredible time at OpenAI.
title_zh: I posted this note to OpenAI. Hey everybody, I have decided to leave OpenAI. This was a very difficult decision as I have has such an incredible time at OpenAI.
summary_en: Zoph announces he is leaving OpenAI, where he joined shortly before ChatGPT's launch and led post-training work.
summary_zh: Barret Zoph宣布离开OpenAI，他在ChatGPT发布前不久加入该公司并负责后训练工作。

title_en: Super excited this is rolling out! Real time speech to speech will be a powerful feature -- I am very bullish on multi-modal being a core component of AI produc
title_zh: Super excited this is rolling out! Real time speech to speech will be a powerful feature -- I am very bullish on multi-modal being a core component of AI produc
summary_en: Zoph comments on the rollout of real-time speech-to-speech capability, calling multimodal a core part of future AI products.
summary_zh: Barret Zoph评论实时语音对话功能上线，称多模态将成为未来AI产品的核心组成部分。

title_en: What an incredible company OpenAI is to work at. I have never seen so many people so committed to the mission of the company and band together when things go wr
title_zh: What an incredible company OpenAI is to work at. I have never seen so many people so committed to the mission of the company and band together when things go wr
summary_en: Posted during OpenAI's November 2023 leadership crisis, Zoph praises the company's culture and staff solidarity 'when things go wrong.'
summary_zh: 该推文发布于2023年11月OpenAI领导层危机期间，Zoph称赞公司文化以及员工在"出问题时"团结一致。

title_en: Mixture-of-Experts Meets Instruction Tuning:A Winning Combination for Large Language Models
title_zh: Mixture-of-Experts Meets Instruction Tuning:A Winning Combination for Large Language Models
summary_en: Shows that instruction tuning and sparse Mixture-of-Experts combine unusually well, with MoE models benefiting far more from instruction tuning than dense ones.
summary_zh: 研究表明指令微调与稀疏专家混合（MoE）结合效果格外好，MoE 模型从指令微调中获得的收益远高于稠密模型。

title_en: A Pretrainer's Guide to Training Data: Measuring the Effects of Data Age, Domain Coverage, Quality, & Toxicity
title_zh: A Pretrainer's Guide to Training Data: Measuring the Effects of Data Age, Domain Coverage, Quality, & Toxicity
summary_en: A systematic study of how pretraining data age, domain coverage, quality and toxicity filtering affect the resulting language model.
summary_zh: 系统研究了预训练数据的时效性、领域覆盖、质量与毒性过滤如何影响最终的语言模型。

title_en: GPT-4 Technical Report
title_zh: GPT-4 Technical Report
summary_en: The GPT-4 technical report, documenting the multimodal model's capabilities, evaluations and safety work; Zoph is a listed contributor.
summary_zh: GPT-4 技术报告，记录了该多模态模型的能力、评测与安全工作；Zoph 是署名贡献者之一。

title_en: The Flan Collection: Designing Data and Methods for Effective Instruction Tuning
title_zh: The Flan Collection: Designing Data and Methods for Effective Instruction Tuning
summary_en: Breaks down the design choices behind the Flan 2022 instruction-tuning collection and releases the data and methods publicly.
summary_zh: 拆解了 Flan 2022 指令微调数据集背后的设计选择，并公开了相应的数据与方法。

title_en: Scaling Instruction-Finetuned Language Models
title_zh: Scaling Instruction-Finetuned Language Models
summary_en: The Flan-PaLM paper, showing that scaling the number of instruction-tuning tasks and model size sharply improves generalisation to unseen tasks.
summary_zh: Flan-PaLM 论文，表明扩大指令微调任务数量与模型规模能显著提升对未见任务的泛化能力。

title_en: Want to learn more about how sparse expert models (e.g. MoEs, Switch Transformers, Hash Layers) work and their recent research advancements? Check out our recen
title_zh: Want to learn more about how sparse expert models (e.g. MoEs, Switch Transformers, Hash Layers) work and their recent research advancements? Check out our recen
summary_en: Zoph promotes a review paper on sparse expert models (MoEs, Switch Transformers, Hash Layers), an area of his own research.
summary_zh: Barret Zoph推介一篇关于稀疏专家模型（MoE、Switch Transformer、Hash Layers）的综述论文，这正是他本人的研究领域。

title_en: After 6 years at Google Brain I am excited to announce that I joined OpenAI! Very grateful for all the amazing collaborators and friends I have made at Google o
title_zh: After 6 years at Google Brain I am excited to announce that I joined OpenAI! Very grateful for all the amazing collaborators and friends I have made at Google o
summary_en: Zoph announces joining OpenAI after six years at Google Brain.
summary_zh: Barret Zoph宣布在谷歌大脑工作六年后加入OpenAI。

title_en: A Review of Sparse Expert Models in Deep Learning
title_zh: A Review of Sparse Expert Models in Deep Learning
summary_en: A survey of sparse expert models in deep learning, written with William Fedus and Jeff Dean, tracing MoE from its origins to modern trillion-parameter systems.
summary_zh: 与 William Fedus、Jeff Dean 合写的深度学习稀疏专家模型综述，梳理了 MoE 从起源到当代万亿参数系统的发展。

title_en: Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models
title_zh: Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models
summary_en: Documents abilities that appear only above a certain model scale and cannot be extrapolated from smaller models — one of the most cited framings of scaling behaviour.
summary_zh: 记录了只有在模型规模超过某一阈值后才出现、无法从小模型外推的能力，是关于规模效应最常被引用的论述之一。

title_en: Very excited to be able to release these sparse checkpoints to the research community!
title_zh: Very excited to be able to release these sparse checkpoints to the research community!
summary_en: Zoph announces the release of sparse model checkpoints to the research community, continuing his Switch Transformer/MoE work.
summary_zh: Barret Zoph宣布向研究界发布稀疏模型checkpoint，延续其在Switch Transformer/MoE方向的工作。

title_en: Beyond the Imitation Game: Quantifying and extrapolating the capabilities of language models
title_zh: Beyond the Imitation Game: Quantifying and extrapolating the capabilities of language models
summary_en: BIG-bench: a 200-plus-task community benchmark built to measure and extrapolate language model capabilities beyond existing evaluations.
summary_zh: BIG-bench：由社区共建的两百多项任务基准，用于衡量并外推语言模型超出现有评测范围的能力。

title_en: Lots of great work coming out on LLMs generating + understanding code (Codex, Scratch Pad, MBPP/MathQA, etc...) The Alpha code paper by DeepMind is quite impres
title_zh: Lots of great work coming out on LLMs generating + understanding code (Codex, Scratch Pad, MBPP/MathQA, etc...) The Alpha code paper by DeepMind is quite impres
summary_en: Zoph surveys progress in code-generating LLMs (Codex, MBPP/MathQA) and highlights DeepMind's AlphaCode results as impressive.
summary_zh: Barret Zoph评述代码生成类大模型（Codex、MBPP/MathQA等）的进展，并称赞DeepMind的AlphaCode结果令人印象深刻。

source: The Data Exchange with Ben Lorica
title_en: Efficient Scaling of Language Models
title_zh: Efficient Scaling of Language Models
summary_en: Zoph and Liam Fedus discussed their work scaling large language models efficiently, as guests on The Data Exchange podcast.
summary_zh: Zoph与Liam Fedus做客The Data Exchange播客,探讨如何高效扩展大语言模型的相关研究。

title_en: Sparse Expert Models (Switch Transformers, GLAM, and more... w/ the Authors)
title_zh: Sparse Expert Models (Switch Transformers, GLAM, and more... w/ the Authors)
summary_en: Zoph and William Fedus were interviewed about their Switch Transformer and sparse expert model research.
summary_zh: Zoph与William Fedus接受采访,介绍了他们在Switch Transformer与稀疏专家模型方面的研究工作。

title_en: Thanks @jeremiecharris for having me on your podcast! Super fun chatting about mixture-of-expert models and how they fit into the current large language model l
title_zh: Thanks @jeremiecharris for having me on your podcast! Super fun chatting about mixture-of-expert models and how they fit into the current large language model l
summary_en: Zoph thanks a podcast host after appearing to discuss mixture-of-experts models and their place in the LLM landscape.
summary_zh: Barret Zoph感谢播客主持人邀请他参加节目，探讨专家混合模型（MoE）及其在大语言模型领域中的地位。

title_en: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways
title_zh: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways
summary_en: PaLM, Google's 540B-parameter model trained with the Pathways system, and the scaling and few-shot results that came with it.
summary_zh: PaLM——谷歌用 Pathways 系统训练的 5400 亿参数模型，以及随之而来的扩展规律与少样本学习结果。

title_en: ST-MoE: Designing Stable and Transferable Sparse Expert Models
title_zh: ST-MoE: Designing Stable and Transferable Sparse Expert Models
summary_en: Zoph's ST-MoE paper, which fixes the training instability and transfer problems that had made sparse expert models hard to use in practice.
summary_zh: Zoph 的 ST-MoE 论文，解决了此前令稀疏专家模型难以实用的训练不稳定与迁移问题。

title_en: GLaM: Efficient Scaling of Language Models with Mixture-of-Experts
title_zh: GLaM: Efficient Scaling of Language Models with Mixture-of-Experts
summary_en: GLaM, a 1.2T-parameter Mixture-of-Experts language model that beats GPT-3 on average while using a fraction of the energy to train.
summary_zh: GLaM——1.2 万亿参数的专家混合语言模型，平均表现超过 GPT-3，训练能耗却只有其一小部分。

title_en: Multi-Task Self-Training for Learning General Representations
title_zh: Multi-Task Self-Training for Learning General Representations
summary_en: Uses multi-task self-training to distil several specialised teachers into one general vision model that transfers well across tasks.
summary_zh: 用多任务自训练把多个专用教师模型蒸馏成一个通用视觉模型，在多种任务上都能良好迁移。

title_en: Simple Training Strategies and Model Scaling for Object Detection
title_zh: Simple Training Strategies and Model Scaling for Object Detection
summary_en: Shows that simple training strategies and careful model scaling, rather than new architectures, account for much of the gain in object detection.
summary_zh: 表明目标检测的多数性能提升来自简单的训练策略与谨慎的模型缩放，而非新的网络架构。

title_en: Revisiting ResNets: Improved Training and Scaling Strategies
title_zh: Revisiting ResNets: Improved Training and Scaling Strategies
summary_en: Separates architecture gains from training and scaling gains, showing a modernised ResNet matches much newer architectures.
summary_zh: 将架构带来的收益与训练方法、缩放策略的收益区分开，证明现代化训练下的 ResNet 可以媲美更新的架构。

title_en: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
title_zh: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
summary_en: Switch Transformer — Zoph's best-known language work, simplifying Mixture-of-Experts routing to a single expert per token and scaling to a trillion parameters.
summary_zh: Switch Transformer——Zoph 最广为人知的语言模型工作，将专家混合的路由简化为每个 token 只选一个专家，并扩展到万亿参数规模。

title_en: Simple Copy-Paste is a Strong Data Augmentation Method for Instance Segmentation
title_zh: Simple Copy-Paste is a Strong Data Augmentation Method for Instance Segmentation
summary_en: Shows that simply pasting objects between images is a strong data augmentation for instance segmentation, especially for rare categories.
summary_zh: 表明简单地在图像间复制粘贴目标就是实例分割的有效数据增强方法，对稀有类别尤其有用。

title_en: Does Data Augmentation Benefit from Split BatchNorms
title_zh: Does Data Augmentation Benefit from Split BatchNorms
summary_en: Examines whether separate batch-norm statistics for clean and augmented images explain part of the benefit of strong data augmentation.
summary_zh: 探讨为原始图像与增强图像分别统计批归一化参数，是否能解释强数据增强收益的一部分。

title_en: Rethinking Pre-training and Self-training
title_zh: Rethinking Pre-training and Self-training
summary_en: Finds that self-training helps where ImageNet pre-training stops helping, including under strong augmentation and large labelled datasets.
summary_zh: 发现在 ImageNet 预训练不再奏效的场景下——例如强数据增强和大规模标注数据——自训练仍然有效。

title_en: Naive-Student: Leveraging Semi-Supervised Learning in Video Sequences for Urban Scene Segmentation
title_zh: Naive-Student: Leveraging Semi-Supervised Learning in Video Sequences for Urban Scene Segmentation
summary_en: Uses semi-supervised learning over unlabelled video frames to push urban scene segmentation without extra human annotation.
summary_zh: 利用未标注视频帧上的半监督学习提升城市场景分割效果，无需额外人工标注。

title_en: Improving 3D Object Detection through Progressive Population Based Augmentation
title_zh: Improving 3D Object Detection through Progressive Population Based Augmentation
summary_en: Learns 3D point-cloud augmentation policies automatically through progressive population-based search instead of hand-designing them.
summary_zh: 用渐进式种群搜索自动学习三维点云的数据增强策略，取代人工设计。

title_en: AugMix: A Simple Data Processing Method to Improve Robustness and Uncertainty
title_zh: AugMix: A Simple Data Processing Method to Improve Robustness and Uncertainty
summary_en: AugMix, a simple augmentation-and-mixing scheme that markedly improves robustness and calibration under distribution shift.
summary_zh: AugMix——一种简单的增强与混合方案，显著提升了模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性与置信度校准。

title_en: RandAugment: Practical automated data augmentation with a reduced search space
title_zh: RandAugment: Practical automated data augmentation with a reduced search space
summary_en: RandAugment paper, cutting automated data augmentation down to a two-parameter search space.
summary_zh: RandAugment 论文，把自动数据增强压缩成只有两个参数的搜索空间。

title_en: Learning Data Augmentation Strategies for Object Detection
title_zh: Learning Data Augmentation Strategies for Object Detection
summary_en: Zoph's first-author work extending learned augmentation policies from image classification to object detection.
summary_zh: Zoph 的第一作者工作，将学习得到的数据增强策略从图像分类扩展到目标检测。

title_en: Exits Thinking Machines Lab and returns to OpenAI
title_zh: 离开 Thinking Machines Lab，回归 OpenAI
summary_en: The company said he was let go over 'unethical conduct'; he rejoined OpenAI immediately, alongside Luke Metz and Sam Schoenholl. Soumith Chintala succeeded him as TML's CTO.
summary_zh: 公司称其因「不当行为」被解雇；他随即与 Luke Metz、Sam Schoenholl 一同回归 OpenAI。Soumith Chintala 接任 TML 的 CTO。

title_en: Exclusive | Thinking Machines Lab Co-Founder Barret Zoph Joins Google
title_zh: Exclusive | Thinking Machines Lab Co-Founder Barret Zoph Joins Google
summary_en: WSJ's exclusive that Zoph has joined Google as a research VP, a second stint at the company after co-founding Thinking Machines Lab and returning to OpenAI.
summary_zh: 《华尔街日报》独家报道 Zoph 加入谷歌出任研究副总裁；在联合创办 Thinking Machines Lab 并重返 OpenAI 之后，这是他第二次任职谷歌。

title_en: Thinking Machines Lab cofounder Barret Zoph joins Google
title_zh: Thinking Machines Lab cofounder Barret Zoph joins Google
summary_en: He leaves Thinking Machines Lab, which he co-founded, and joins Google, saying it has all the ingredients to succeed in AI.
summary_zh: 他离开自己参与创办的 Thinking Machines Lab，加入谷歌，并称谷歌具备在人工智能领域取胜的全部要素。

title_zh: Barret Zoph joining Google DeepMind as research VP

title_zh: Barret Zoph, the Thinking Machines co-founder ousted before joining OpenAI, is now at Google

title_zh: Thinking Machines Lab co-founder Barret Zoph joins Google

title_zh: Thinking Machines Lab co-founder Barret Zoph joins Google

summary_zh: 报道称Thinking Machines Lab联合创始人Barret Zoph已加入谷歌，此前几个月他曾被称已重返OpenAI。

title_zh: Barret Zoph, the Thinking Machines co-founder who defected to OpenAI, is now at Google

title_en: Barret Zoph Joins Google as Vice President of Research
title_zh: Barret Zoph Joins Google as Vice President of Research
summary_en: Zoph left OpenAI for Google DeepMind as VP of Research, returning to the company after stints at Thinking Machines Lab and OpenAI.

title_en: Noam Brown – Agent swarms, alignment, & recursive self-improvement
title_zh: Noam Brown – Agent swarms, alignment, & recursive self-improvement
summary_en: Brown discussed agent swarms, alignment and recursive self-improvement on the Dwarkesh Podcast.
summary_zh: 诺姆·布朗在Dwarkesh Podcast节目中探讨了智能体集群、对齐问题以及递归自我改进。

title_en: Seb is a really sweet guy with great intentions, am so happy for him that his week long collaboration with myself and others worked out, but very sad that we di
title_zh: Seb is a really sweet guy with great intentions, am so happy for him that his week long collaboration with myself and others worked out, but very sad that we di
summary_en: He reflects on a collaborator's (Seb's) week-long push on a research result, praising the effort even though it did not finish as intended.

title_en: Mastering the Game of No-Press Diplomacy via Human-Regularized Reinforcement Learning and Planning
title_zh: Mastering the Game of No-Press Diplomacy via Human-Regularized Reinforcement Learning and Planning
summary_en: Human-regularized RL and planning that reaches top human level at no-press Diplomacy; Brown is senior author.
summary_zh: 用人类正则化的强化学习与规划，在无通信 Diplomacy 中达到顶尖人类水平，Brown 为通讯作者。

title_en: Human-AI Coordination via Human-Regularized Search and Learning
title_zh: Human-AI Coordination via Human-Regularized Search and Learning
summary_en: Applies piKL-style human regularization to cooperative human-AI play; Brown is senior author.
summary_zh: 把 piKL 式的人类正则化用于人机协作场景，Brown 为通讯作者。

title_en: A Unified Approach to Reinforcement Learning, Quantal Response Equilibria, and Two-Player Zero-Sum Games
title_zh: A Unified Approach to Reinforcement Learning, Quantal Response Equilibria, and Two-Player Zero-Sum Games
summary_en: Introduces magnetic mirror descent, linking RL, quantal response equilibria and two-player zero-sum solving; Brown is a co-author.
summary_zh: 提出磁性镜像下降，把强化学习、量子响应均衡与两人零和求解统一起来，Brown 为共同作者。

title_en: Equilibrium Finding in Normal-Form Games Via Greedy Regret Minimization
title_zh: Equilibrium Finding in Normal-Form Games Via Greedy Regret Minimization
summary_en: Regret-minimization variant that greedily reweights iterates for faster equilibrium finding in normal-form games; Brown is senior author.
summary_zh: 在标准型博弈中按遗憾贪心加权迭代以加快均衡求解的遗憾最小化变体，Brown 为通讯作者。

title_en: Modeling Strong and Human-Like Gameplay with KL-Regularized Search
title_zh: Modeling Strong and Human-Like Gameplay with KL-Regularized Search
summary_en: piKL, the KL-regularized search method for strong but human-like policies that later underpinned Cicero; Brown is senior author.
summary_zh: 提出 piKL 这一 KL 正则化搜索方法，可得到强而类人的策略，后来支撑了 Cicero，Brown 为通讯作者。

title_en: No-Press Diplomacy from Scratch
title_zh: No-Press Diplomacy from Scratch
summary_en: Trains a no-press Diplomacy agent without human data despite an action space of over 10^20; Brown is senior author.
summary_zh: 在动作空间超过 10^20 的情况下不依赖人类数据从零训练无通信 Diplomacy 智能体，Brown 为通讯作者。

title_en: Scalable Online Planning via Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning
title_zh: Scalable Online Planning via Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning
summary_en: Replaces expensive lookahead search with reinforcement learning fine-tuning at execution time; Brown is senior author.
summary_zh: 在线规划中用执行时的强化学习微调替代昂贵的前瞻搜索，Brown 为通讯作者。

title_en: Learned Belief Search: Efficiently Improving Policies in Partially Observable Settings
title_zh: Learned Belief Search: Efficiently Improving Policies in Partially Observable Settings
summary_en: Cheaper approximation to belief-based search in partially observable settings; Brown is a co-author.
summary_zh: 在部分可观测环境中对基于信念的搜索给出更廉价的近似，Brown 为共同作者。

source: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on…
title_en: Safe Search for Stackelberg Equilibria in Extensive-Form Games
title_zh: Safe Search for Stackelberg Equilibria in Extensive-Form Games
summary_en: With Chun Kai Ling, Brown extends the search techniques behind Libratus/Pluribus to Stackelberg equilibria, letting a leader improve a precomputed blueprint strategy online without ever performing worse than it.
summary_zh: Brown与Chun Kai Ling合作，将Libratus/Pluribus背后的搜索技术扩展到Stackelberg均衡问题，使先行者能够在线改进预先计算好的蓝图策略，且效果绝不劣于原策略。

title_en: Off-Belief Learning
title_zh: Off-Belief Learning
summary_en: Off-belief learning, a rule that strips arbitrary self-play conventions so agents coordinate with unseen partners; Brown is a co-author.
summary_zh: 提出 off-belief learning，去除自博弈中形成的任意约定，使智能体能与陌生伙伴协作，Brown 为共同作者。

title_en: Human-Level Performance in No-Press Diplomacy via Equilibrium Search
title_zh: Human-Level Performance in No-Press Diplomacy via Equilibrium Search
summary_en: First agent to reach human level at no-press Diplomacy, using equilibrium search; Brown is senior author.
summary_zh: 首个借助均衡搜索在无通信 Diplomacy 中达到人类水平的智能体，Brown 为通讯作者。

title_en: Combining Deep Reinforcement Learning and Search for Imperfect-Information Games
title_zh: Combining Deep Reinforcement Learning and Search for Imperfect-Information Games
summary_en: ReBeL, Brown's algorithm unifying deep RL with search for imperfect-information games and a direct precursor to his later reasoning work.
summary_zh: ReBeL 算法把深度强化学习与搜索统一用于不完美信息博弈，是 Brown 后来推理工作的直接前身。

title_en: Unlocking the Potential of Deep Counterfactual Value Networks
title_zh: Unlocking the Potential of Deep Counterfactual Value Networks
summary_en: Improvements to deep counterfactual value networks for depth-limited poker search; Brown is a co-author.
summary_zh: 改进用于有限深度扑克搜索的深度反事实价值网络，Brown 为共同作者。

title_en: DREAM: Deep Regret minimization with Advantage baselines and Model-free learning
title_zh: DREAM: Deep Regret minimization with Advantage baselines and Model-free learning
summary_en: DREAM, a model-free deep regret minimization algorithm for multi-agent imperfect-information games; Brown is senior author.
summary_zh: DREAM 算法，面向多智能体不完美信息博弈的无模型深度遗憾最小化方法，Brown 为通讯作者。

title_en: Improving Policies via Search in Cooperative Partially Observable Games
title_zh: Improving Policies via Search in Cooperative Partially Observable Games
summary_en: Brings search to cooperative partially observable games such as Hanabi; Brown is senior author.
summary_zh: 把搜索引入 Hanabi 这类合作型部分可观测博弈，Brown 为通讯作者。

title_en: Stable-Predictive Optimistic Counterfactual Regret Minimization
title_zh: Stable-Predictive Optimistic Counterfactual Regret Minimization
summary_en: First CFR variant with a near-optimal convergence rate; Brown is a co-author.
summary_zh: 首个具备近最优收敛速率的 CFR 变体，Brown 为共同作者。

title_en: Deep Counterfactual Regret Minimization
title_zh: Deep Counterfactual Regret Minimization
summary_en: Deep CFR, the neural version of counterfactual regret minimization that removed the need for hand-crafted abstractions; Brown is first author.
summary_zh: Deep CFR 用神经网络实现反事实遗憾最小化，摆脱了人工抽象设计，Brown 为第一作者。

title_en: Solving Imperfect-Information Games via Discounted Regret Minimization
title_zh: Solving Imperfect-Information Games via Discounted Regret Minimization
summary_en: Discounted CFR, which sharply speeds up equilibrium finding and was used in the Pluribus poker bot; Brown is first author.
summary_zh: 折扣式 CFR 大幅加快均衡求解，并被扑克 AI Pluribus 采用，Brown 为第一作者。

title_en: Depth-Limited Solving for Imperfect-Information Games
title_zh: Depth-Limited Solving for Imperfect-Information Games
summary_en: Depth-limited search for imperfect-information games, the technique that let a laptop-scale poker bot beat professionals; Brown is first author.
summary_zh: 面向不完美信息博弈的有限深度搜索，使笔记本级扑克 AI 也能击败职业选手，Brown 为第一作者。

title_en: Safe and Nested Subgame Solving for Imperfect-Information Games
title_zh: Safe and Nested Subgame Solving for Imperfect-Information Games
summary_en: Safe and nested subgame solving, the core technique behind Libratus, the first bot to beat top humans at heads-up no-limit poker; Brown is first author.
summary_zh: 安全嵌套子博弈求解，是首个在单挑无限注扑克中击败顶尖人类的 Libratus 的核心技术，Brown 为第一作者。

title_en: Reduced Space and Faster Convergence in Imperfect-Information Games via Regret-Based Pruning
title_zh: Reduced Space and Faster Convergence in Imperfect-Information Games via Regret-Based Pruning
summary_en: Regret-based pruning, which cuts the memory and time cost of CFR in large imperfect-information games; Brown is first author.
summary_zh: 基于遗憾的剪枝方法，降低 CFR 在大规模不完美信息博弈中的内存与时间开销，Brown 为第一作者。

title_en: AI That Knows It's Being Tested — Noam Brown on Harder Alignment Evals
title_zh: AI That Knows It's Being Tested — Noam Brown on Harder Alignment Evals
summary_en: Brown discusses the problem of AI models recognizing when they are being evaluated, and argues for harder, more robust alignment evals.
summary_zh: 布朗探讨了AI模型能够识别自身正被测试的问题，并主张设计更严格、更稳健的对齐评测。

title_en: OpenAI's Noam Brown reveals how AI agents solved a Millennium Prize Problem in 88 hours
title_zh: OpenAI's Noam Brown reveals how AI agents solved a Millennium Prize Problem in 88 hours
summary_en: Noam Brown detailed how a swarm of roughly 10,000 OpenAI agents worked 88 hours to claim a solution to the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize problem, while cautioning that multi-agent coordination accounted for less than 10% of the breakthrough versus human research judgment.
summary_zh: 诺姆·布朗披露OpenAI约1万个智能体协同工作88小时，声称解决了纳维-斯托克斯千禧年大奖难题，但他也提醒多智能体协作仅贡献了不到10%的突破，其余靠人类的研究判断力。

title_en: OpenAI's Noam Brown Says Even Air-Gapped Systems May Not Contain Advanced AI
title_zh: OpenAI's Noam Brown Says Even Air-Gapped Systems May Not Contain Advanced AI
summary_en: Brown warned that even air-gapped systems may not be enough to contain sufficiently advanced AI.
summary_zh: 布朗警告称，即使是物理隔离的系统，也未必能够遏制足够先进的AI。

title_en: OpenAI's Noam Brown Says Recursive AI Improvement Faces a 3x Speed Limit — Not an Overnight Explosion
title_zh: OpenAI's Noam Brown Says Recursive AI Improvement Faces a 3x Speed Limit — Not an Overnight Explosion
summary_en: Noam Brown said recursive AI self-improvement faces roughly a 3x speed limit rather than an overnight explosion.
summary_zh: Noam Brown表示，递归式AI自我改进面临约3倍的速度上限，而非一夜爆发式提升。

title_en: OpenAI’s ‘Top Priority’ for AI Agents is Automating AI Research, Says Noam Brown
title_zh: OpenAI’s ‘Top Priority’ for AI Agents is Automating AI Research, Says Noam Brown
summary_en: Noam Brown said automating AI research is OpenAI's top priority for AI agents, per The Information.
summary_zh: 据The Information报道，诺姆·布朗表示让AI代理实现AI研究自动化是OpenAI当前的首要任务。

title_en: Daily Active Agents is the metric that matters now
title_zh: 现在真正重要的指标是 Daily Active Agents

title_en: Future of Business: Baidu’s Robin Li on the Technology Trends that Will Transform Business
title_zh: Future of Business: Baidu’s Robin Li on the Technology Trends that Will Transform Business
summary_en: HBR IdeaCast interview in which Li explains Baidu's full AI stack — chips, framework, models and autonomous driving — and the business trends he expects it to reshape.
summary_zh: 《哈佛商业评论》IdeaCast 访谈：李彦宏讲解百度从芯片、框架、模型到自动驾驶的全栈布局，以及他预判将被重塑的商业趋势。

title_en: Vol.132 | 对话李彦宏：智能体正在爆发，大模型对B端影响将超越互联网
title_zh: Vol.132 | 对话李彦宏：智能体正在爆发，大模型对B端影响将超越互联网
summary_en: In a Yicai (第一财经) dialogue, Robin Li said AI agents are exploding and argued large models' impact on enterprise (B-side) use will exceed that of the internet.
summary_zh: 在第一财经的对话节目中，李彦宏谈到智能体正在爆发，并认为大模型对产业端（B端）的影响将超越互联网本身。

title_en: Robin Li (Baidu) - Lessons From China: The Evolution of The Globe's Largest Search Engine
title_zh: Robin Li (Baidu) - Lessons From China: The Evolution of The Globe's Largest Search Engine
summary_en: Stanford Entrepreneurial Thought Leaders talk in which Li recounts how Baidu was built and why understanding Chinese language and culture let it win the domestic search market.
summary_zh: 斯坦福 ETL 讲座：李彦宏回顾百度的创立与成长，并解释对中文语言与文化的理解如何让百度赢下国内搜索市场。

title_en: Lessons From China: The Evolution of The Globe's Largest Search Engine [Entire Talk]
title_zh: Lessons From China: The Evolution of The Globe's Largest Search Engine [Entire Talk]
summary_en: Li details Baidu's founding and growth into China's dominant search engine, crediting its understanding of Chinese language and market.
summary_zh: 李彦宏在演讲中讲述了百度作为中国主导搜索引擎的创立与发展历程，强调其对中文语言和市场的深刻理解。

title_en: Core AI business passes half of Baidu's general business revenue
title_zh: 核心 AI 业务收入首次超过百度核心非广告业务的一半
summary_en: Q1 2026: total revenue RMB 26.0B (+2% YoY); core AI-powered business RMB 13.6B (+49%), reaching 52%. AI Cloud infrastructure revenue surged 79% to RMB 8.8B.
summary_zh: 2026 Q1：总营收 260 亿元（同比 +2%）；核心 AI 业务收入 136 亿元（+49%），占比达 52%。AI 云基础设施收入同比 +79% 至 88 亿元。

title_zh: 提出以 Daily Active Agents (DAA) 作为行业核心指标
summary_en: Alongside a refreshed agent portfolio: general-purpose agent DuMate and the enterprise edition of coding agent Miaoda.
summary_zh: 同时发布更新的 agent 产品矩阵：通用 agent DuMate 与编码 agent 秒哒的企业版。
