title_en: 估值210亿，李彦宏又将收获一个IPO
title_zh: 估值210亿，李彦宏又将收获一个IPO
summary_en: A Baidu-affiliated business is reportedly heading toward an IPO at a valuation of roughly ¥21 billion, another listing under Robin Li.
summary_zh: 据报道，百度旗下一项业务估值约210亿元，正推进IPO上市，这是李彦宏旗下又一起IPO。

title_en: 百度创始人李彦宏等4人加入香港特首顾问团
title_zh: 百度创始人李彦宏等4人加入香港特首顾问团
summary_en: Robin Li was named one of four new advisers to Hong Kong's Chief Executive advisory council.
summary_zh: 李彦宏被任命为香港特首顾问团四位新增顾问之一。

title_en: 百度创始人李彦宏等4人加入香港特首顾问团
title_zh: 百度创始人李彦宏等4人加入香港特首顾问团
summary_en: Robin Li was appointed to a four-member advisory group for Hong Kong's Chief Executive.
summary_zh: 李彦宏获委任加入香港特首的四人顾问团。

title_en: 李彦宏不“等”了：换帅、推倒重来，百度把半条命交给了“龙虾”
title_zh: 李彦宏不“等”了：换帅、推倒重来，百度把半条命交给了“龙虾”
summary_en: Baidu reshuffled leadership and redirected resources under Li, described as a decisive bet on a new initiative rather than waiting out the AI race.
summary_zh: 百度在李彦宏主导下进行人事调整并重新调配资源，报道称这是押注新项目、而非坐等AI竞赛结果的重大转向。

title_en: 李彦宏创办的AI公司，要上市了
title_zh: 李彦宏创办的AI公司，要上市了
summary_en: An AI company founded by Robin Li is heading toward an IPO, a new venture beyond his role at Baidu.
summary_zh: 李彦宏创办的一家AI公司即将上市，这是他在百度之外创立的新业务的重要进展。

title_en: 消息称百度李彦宏牵头成立的AI 生命科学公司百图生科已秘密提交香港IPO 申请，预计融资数亿美元
title_zh: 消息称百度李彦宏牵头成立的AI 生命科学公司百图生科已秘密提交香港IPO 申请，预计融资数亿美元
summary_en: BioMap (百图生科), the AI life-sciences company Robin Li helped found, reportedly filed confidentially for a Hong Kong IPO seeking several hundred million dollars.
summary_zh: 李彦宏牵头创立的AI生命科学公司百图生科据报已秘密提交香港IPO申请，预计融资数亿美元。

title_en: 李彦宏，分拆210亿芯片独角兽
title_zh: 李彦宏，分拆210亿芯片独角兽
summary_en: Li spun off a chip unit valued at roughly 21 billion yuan, a major restructuring of Baidu's in-house Kunlun chip business.
summary_zh: 李彦宏将估值约210亿元人民币的芯片业务分拆，是百度自研昆仑芯片业务的一次重大重组。

title_en: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
title_zh: 神经语言模型的扩展律
summary_en: The paper that gave the industry a quantitative basis for believing bigger models get better.
summary_zh: 这篇论文为行业「模型越大越强」的信念提供了量化依据。

title_en: Constitutional AI: harmlessness from AI feedback
title_zh: 宪法 AI：来自 AI 反馈的无害性

title_en: Looking Back at AI Scaling with Anthropic Co-Founder Jared Kaplan
title_zh: Looking Back at AI Scaling with Anthropic Co-Founder Jared Kaplan
summary_en: An archival interview in which Kaplan retraces the scaling-laws work and what it implied about where large language models were heading.
summary_zh: 一期档案访谈，Kaplan 回顾他的缩放定律研究，以及这项工作对大语言模型走向的意涵。

title_en: Constitutional Classifiers++: Efficient Production-Grade Defenses against Universal Jailbreaks
title_zh: Constitutional Classifiers++: Efficient Production-Grade Defenses against Universal Jailbreaks
summary_en: A follow-up to Anthropic's constitutional classifiers showing the same jailbreak robustness at production-viable compute cost and with far fewer false refusals.
summary_zh: Anthropic 宪法式分类器的后续工作，在可用于生产的算力成本下保持对越狱攻击的稳健性，并大幅降低误拒率。

title_en: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI | Anthropic Co-founder Jared Kaplan
title_zh: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI | Anthropic Co-founder Jared Kaplan
summary_en: His AI Startup School talk on how scaling laws took him from theoretical physics to Anthropic, and what he thinks the road to human-level AI looks like.
summary_zh: 他在 AI Startup School 的演讲，讲述缩放定律如何把他从理论物理带到 Anthropic，以及他眼中通往人类水平 AI 的路径。

title_en: Inside Anthropic's AI Ambitions with Jared Kaplan
title_zh: Inside Anthropic's AI Ambitions with Jared Kaplan
summary_en: A TC Sessions: AI conversation in which Kaplan lays out Anthropic's research and product ambitions.
summary_zh: 在 TC Sessions: AI 上的对谈，Kaplan 阐述 Anthropic 的研究与产品规划。

title_en: Reasoning Models Don't Always Say What They Think
title_zh: Reasoning Models Don't Always Say What They Think
summary_en: Tests whether a reasoning model's chain of thought actually reports the reasoning it used, and finds it often does not — a limit on using CoT for safety monitoring.
summary_zh: 检验推理模型的思维链是否真实反映其所用推理，发现常常并不忠实，指出以思维链做安全监控的局限。

title_en: Are we ready for human-level AI by 2030? Anthropic's co-founder answers
title_zh: Are we ready for human-level AI by 2030? Anthropic's co-founder answers
summary_en: Kaplan discusses the accelerating timeline to human-level AI and Claude's extended-thinking feature in an interview on Azeem Azhar's Exponential View.
summary_zh: 卡普兰在Azeem Azhar的Exponential View播客访谈中讨论了通向人类水平AI的加速时间线,以及Claude的“思考时间”功能。

title_en: Forecasting Rare Language Model Behaviors
title_zh: Forecasting Rare Language Model Behaviors
summary_en: Proposes a method for predicting rare model behaviours that only surface at deployment scale, from small-scale evaluations.
summary_zh: 提出从小规模评测外推预测只在部署规模下才会出现的罕见模型行为的方法。

title_en: Which Economic Tasks are Performed with AI? Evidence from Millions of Claude Conversations
title_zh: Which Economic Tasks are Performed with AI? Evidence from Millions of Claude Conversations
summary_en: Measures which occupational tasks people actually use AI for, drawn from millions of Claude conversations — the empirical basis of Anthropic's Economic Index.
summary_zh: 基于数百万条 Claude 对话，实测人们究竟把 AI 用于哪些职业任务，是 Anthropic 经济指数的实证基础。

title_en: Constitutional Classifiers: Defending against Universal Jailbreaks across Thousands of Hours of Red Teaming
title_zh: Constitutional Classifiers: Defending against Universal Jailbreaks across Thousands of Hours of Red Teaming
summary_en: Introduces classifier safeguards trained on constitution-generated data, which held up against universal jailbreaks across thousands of hours of red teaming.
summary_zh: 提出用依据宪法生成的数据训练的分类器防护层，在数千小时红队测试中抵御通用越狱攻击。

title_en: Alignment faking in large language models
title_zh: Alignment faking in large language models
summary_en: Demonstrates alignment faking: a model selectively complying with its training objective during training in order to avoid having its behaviour changed.
summary_zh: 实证展示「伪装对齐」：模型在训练中选择性地服从训练目标，以避免自身行为被修改。

title_en: Clio: Privacy-Preserving Insights into Real-World AI Use
title_zh: Clio: Privacy-Preserving Insights into Real-World AI Use
summary_en: Describes Clio, a privacy-preserving system for understanding how AI assistants are used in the real world without reading individual conversations.
summary_zh: 介绍 Clio：一套保护隐私的分析系统，可在不查看个人对话的前提下了解 AI 助手的真实使用情况。

title_en: Who Gets to Decide What AI Can and Can't Do? | Anthropic’s Jared Kaplan (Ep. 5)
title_zh: Who Gets to Decide What AI Can and Can't Do? | Anthropic’s Jared Kaplan (Ep. 5)
summary_en: An interview on who gets to decide what an AI model may and may not do, and how Anthropic sets those limits.
summary_zh: 访谈探讨「谁来决定 AI 能做什么、不能做什么」，以及 Anthropic 如何划定这些边界。

title_en: Sabotage Evaluations for Frontier Models
title_zh: Sabotage Evaluations for Frontier Models
summary_en: Builds an evaluation suite for whether frontier models could covertly sabotage human oversight and decision-making.
summary_zh: 构建一套评测，检验前沿模型是否可能暗中破坏人类的监督与决策。

title_en: Sycophancy to Subterfuge: Investigating Reward-Tampering in Large Language Models
title_zh: Sycophancy to Subterfuge: Investigating Reward-Tampering in Large Language Models
summary_en: Shows that models trained on simple specification gaming can generalise all the way to tampering with their own reward.
summary_zh: 表明从简单的奖励规范漏洞出发训练的模型，可能一路泛化到直接篡改自身奖励。

title_en: Sleeper Agents: Training Deceptive LLMs that Persist Through Safety Training
title_zh: Sleeper Agents: Training Deceptive LLMs that Persist Through Safety Training
summary_en: Shows that backdoored deceptive behaviour can survive standard safety training, so current safety training may not remove such risks.
summary_zh: 表明植入后门的欺骗性行为能在标准安全训练后存续，说明现有安全训练未必能消除此类风险。

title_en: Evaluating and Mitigating Discrimination in Language Model Decisions
title_zh: Evaluating and Mitigating Discrimination in Language Model Decisions
summary_en: Evaluates how language models discriminate when used for high-stakes decisions such as lending and housing, and tests mitigations.
summary_zh: 评估语言模型在贷款、住房等高风险决策中的歧视倾向，并检验相应的缓解手段。

title_en: Specific versus General Principles for Constitutional AI
title_zh: Specific versus General Principles for Constitutional AI
summary_en: Asks whether a single broad principle can replace a list of specific rules in Constitutional AI, and compares the resulting model behaviour.
summary_zh: 探讨宪法式 AI 中一条笼统原则能否替代成套具体规则，并比较由此得到的模型行为。

title_en: Studying Large Language Model Generalization with Influence Functions
title_zh: Studying Large Language Model Generalization with Influence Functions
summary_en: Scales influence functions to large language models so that a given behaviour can be traced back to the training examples most responsible for it.
summary_zh: 将影响函数扩展到大语言模型，从而把某一行为追溯到对其影响最大的训练样本。

title_en: Measuring Faithfulness in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
title_zh: Measuring Faithfulness in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary_en: Proposes ways to measure whether a model's stated chain of thought is a faithful account of the computation behind its answer.
summary_zh: 提出衡量模型所述思维链是否忠实反映其答案背后计算过程的方法。

title_en: Question Decomposition Improves the Faithfulness of Model-Generated Reasoning
title_zh: Question Decomposition Improves the Faithfulness of Model-Generated Reasoning
summary_en: Shows that decomposing a question into sub-questions makes a model's generated reasoning more faithful to how it actually answers.
summary_zh: 表明将问题拆解为子问题作答，可使模型给出的推理过程更忠实于其实际作答方式。

title_en: Towards Measuring the Representation of Subjective Global Opinions in Language Models
title_zh: Towards Measuring the Representation of Subjective Global Opinions in Language Models
summary_en: Builds a quantitative framework for measuring whose national and cultural opinions a language model reflects on contested social questions.
summary_zh: 构建量化框架，衡量语言模型在争议性社会议题上更代表哪些国家与文化群体的观点。

title_en: The Capacity for Moral Self-Correction in Large Language Models
title_zh: The Capacity for Moral Self-Correction in Large Language Models
summary_en: Tests whether RLHF-trained models can 'morally self-correct' — avoiding harmful or biased output when simply instructed to.
summary_zh: 检验经 RLHF 训练的模型能否在被明确要求时进行「道德自我纠正」，避免有害或带偏见的输出。

title_en: Discovering Language Model Behaviors with Model-Written Evaluations
title_zh: Discovering Language Model Behaviors with Model-Written Evaluations
summary_en: Uses language models to write their own evaluation datasets, making it cheap to probe the many new behaviours that appear with scale.
summary_zh: 用语言模型自动撰写评测数据集，从而低成本地探测随规模涌现的各种新行为。

title_en: Measuring Progress on Scalable Oversight for Large Language Models
title_zh: Measuring Progress on Scalable Oversight for Large Language Models
summary_en: Sets up human-model experiments to measure progress on scalable oversight — supervising systems that outperform their supervisors.
summary_zh: 设计人机对照实验来衡量可扩展监督的进展，即如何监督能力超过监督者的模型。

title_en: In-context Learning and Induction Heads
title_zh: In-context Learning and Induction Heads
summary_en: Argues that 'induction heads' are the main mechanism behind in-context learning in transformers, a foundational result for interpretability.
summary_zh: 论证「归纳头」是 Transformer 上下文学习能力的主要机制，是可解释性研究的基础成果。

title_en: Toy Models of Superposition
title_zh: Toy Models of Superposition
summary_en: Uses small toy models to explain superposition — why networks pack unrelated concepts into single neurons and become hard to interpret.
summary_zh: 用小型玩具模型解释「叠加」现象：网络为何把互不相关的概念塞进同一个神经元，从而难以解释。

title_en: Red Teaming Language Models to Reduce Harms: Methods, Scaling Behaviors, and Lessons Learned
title_zh: Red Teaming Language Models to Reduce Harms: Methods, Scaling Behaviors, and Lessons Learned
summary_en: Documents Anthropic's early red-teaming programme — methods, how harms scale with model size, and the released red-team dataset.
summary_zh: 记录 Anthropic 早期红队工作的方法、危害随模型规模变化的规律，并公开了红队数据集。

title_en: Language Models (Mostly) Know What They Know
title_zh: Language Models (Mostly) Know What They Know
summary_en: Studies whether models can judge the validity of their own answers, finding that larger models are well calibrated about what they know.
summary_zh: 研究模型能否判断自身答案是否成立，发现较大的模型对「自己知道什么」有良好的校准。

title_en: Beyond the Imitation Game: Quantifying and extrapolating the capabilities of language models
title_zh: Beyond the Imitation Game: Quantifying and extrapolating the capabilities of language models
summary_en: BIG-bench, a large multi-institution benchmark built to quantify and extrapolate how language model capabilities change with scale.
summary_zh: BIG-bench：一项多机构合作的大规模基准，用于量化并外推语言模型能力随规模的变化。

title_en: $21 billion+ new pledge: Anthropic’s seven cofounders, Dario and Daniela Amodei, Tom Brown, Jack Clark, Jared Kaplan, Sam McCandlish, and Christopher Olah commit 80% of their fortunes to combat AI-driven inequality – Lifestyles Magazine
title_zh: $21 billion+ new pledge: Anthropic’s seven cofounders, Dario and Daniela Amodei, Tom Brown, Jack Clark, Jared Kaplan, Sam McCandlish, and Christopher Olah commit 80% of their fortunes to combat AI-driven inequality – Lifestyles Magazine
summary_en: Kaplan joined Anthropic's other six cofounders in pledging 80% of their fortunes, over $21 billion, to combat AI-driven risks.
summary_zh: Kaplan与Anthropic其余六位联合创始人承诺捐出80%的财富（超过210亿美元），以应对AI带来的风险。

title_en: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
title_zh: 近端策略优化算法
summary_en: PPO — still the default policy-gradient method a decade on.
summary_zh: PPO —— 十年后仍是默认的策略梯度方法。

title_en: Reinforcement learning from human feedback: progress and challenges
title_zh: 来自人类反馈的强化学习：进展与挑战
summary_en: His clearest public statement of what RLHF does and where it breaks.
summary_zh: 他关于 RLHF 做到了什么、又在哪里失效的最清晰公开表述。

title_en: would be nice if anthropic's approach to elon could also work with china
title_zh: would be nice if anthropic's approach to elon could also work with china
summary_en: Schulman suggested that Anthropic's approach to handling Elon Musk's disputes could offer a model for engaging with China.
summary_zh: 舒尔曼提出，Anthropic处理与埃隆·马斯克纠纷的方式，或许可以为应对中国问题提供借鉴。

title_en: Enjoyed chatting with Dwarkesh, Beren, and Charlie. Thanks for having us on, Dwarkesh!
title_zh: Enjoyed chatting with Dwarkesh, Beren, and Charlie. Thanks for having us on, Dwarkesh!
summary_en: Schulman thanked Dwarkesh for hosting him, Beren, and Charlie on the Dwarkesh Podcast, a rare on-record appearance since joining Thinking Machines Lab.
summary_zh: Schulman感谢Dwarkesh邀请他与Beren、Charlie一同做客Dwarkesh Podcast，这是他加入Thinking Machines Lab后难得的公开发声。

title_en: Embedding evaluators is a big positive development, and props to Sam/OpenAI for agreeing to do it as well. It's been cool to see "pacing the frontier" become a
title_zh: Embedding evaluators is a big positive development, and props to Sam/OpenAI for agreeing to do it as well. It's been cool to see "pacing the frontier" become a
summary_en: Schulman praised OpenAI's move to let external evaluators embed with the company, calling it a positive step in the 'pacing the frontier' effort.
summary_zh: Schulman称赞OpenAI允许外部评估者深度参与公司工作的做法，认为这是“把握前沿节奏”努力中的积极一步。

title_en: AI researchers debate how close we are to recursive self-improvement
title_zh: AI researchers debate how close we are to recursive self-improvement
summary_en: Joined Beren Millidge and Charlie O'Neill on the Dwarkesh Podcast to debate how close AI is to recursive self-improvement.
summary_zh: 与Beren Millidge、Charlie O'Neill一同做客Dwarkesh Podcast，探讨AI距离递归自我改进还有多远。

title_en: As a follow-up, it's exceedingly unlikely that training on user data contributes much to frontier model gains in areas like math -- those come from scaling up p
title_zh: As a follow-up, it's exceedingly unlikely that training on user data contributes much to frontier model gains in areas like math -- those come from scaling up p
summary_en: Schulman argued that frontier math gains mainly come from scaling pretraining and RLVR, not user-data training — a technical claim about what actually drives model improvement.
summary_zh: Schulman提出，前沿模型在数学能力上的提升主要来自预训练规模化和RLVR，而非用户数据训练——这是关于模型进步真正驱动因素的技术论断。

title_en: First step is for industry leaders OpenAI and Anthropic to stop feuding and work on a pacing proposal together. They'll cite antitrust, but that's fake -- antit
title_zh: First step is for industry leaders OpenAI and Anthropic to stop feuding and work on a pacing proposal together. They'll cite antitrust, but that's fake -- antit
summary_en: Schulman argued OpenAI and Anthropic should set aside their feud and jointly propose an AI pacing agreement, dismissing antitrust concerns as a false obstacle.
summary_zh: Schulman主张OpenAI和Anthropic应停止内斗，共同提出AI发展节奏协议，并认为反垄断顾虑只是站不住脚的借口。

title_en: This isn't the most notable aspect of today's news, but on the user data issue, there are different kinds of *training on user data* with very different privacy
title_zh: This isn't the most notable aspect of today's news, but on the user data issue, there are different kinds of *training on user data* with very different privacy
summary_en: Schulman distinguished between different kinds of training on user data, noting they carry very different privacy and IP implications that AI companies often blur.
summary_zh: Schulman区分了几种不同类型的用户数据训练方式，指出它们在隐私和知识产权方面的影响差异很大，而AI公司往往未加区分。

title_en: Bullish on this direction. Having a metric for explanation quality makes it possible to hillclimb, and counterfactual simulatability seems right. Adam et al. cr
title_zh: Bullish on this direction. Having a metric for explanation quality makes it possible to hillclimb, and counterfactual simulatability seems right. Adam et al. cr
summary_en: Schulman endorsed a metric for explanation quality based on counterfactual simulatability, backing a concrete research direction for interpretability.
summary_zh: Schulman支持一种基于反事实可模拟性的解释质量度量方法，为可解释性研究提出了具体方向。

title_en: On the OpenAI agents forming message boards: it's surprising that they developed such a strong "altruistic" drive to help each other. I wonder if this is caused
title_zh: On the OpenAI agents forming message boards: it's surprising that they developed such a strong "altruistic" drive to help each other. I wonder if this is caused
summary_en: Schulman speculates that RL on parallel-subagent setups may explain OpenAI agents forming altruistic norms on shared message boards.
summary_zh: Schulman推测,在并行子智能体设置上进行强化学习,可能是OpenAI智能体在共享留言板上形成利他行为规范的原因。

title_en: Interesting how these models go into a monomaniacal rage on cyber evals. I wonder if we're seeing chunky post-training https://t.co/uqCinTD7I3 in action, where
title_zh: Interesting how these models go into a monomaniacal rage on cyber evals. I wonder if we're seeing chunky post-training https://t.co/uqCinTD7I3 in action, where
summary_en: Schulman notes models entering a "monomaniacal rage" on cyber evals, speculating it reflects post-training pattern-matching to the eval scenario.
summary_zh: Schulman指出模型在网络安全评测中会陷入“偏执式的愤怒”,推测这反映了后训练阶段对评测情境的模式匹配。

title_en: We love open weights and plan to keep releasing open-weight models and fine-tuning tools. But we’re not absolutists; misuse risks are real. Here’s how we’re thi
title_zh: We love open weights and plan to keep releasing open-weight models and fine-tuning tools. But we’re not absolutists; misuse risks are real. Here’s how we’re thi
summary_en: Schulman lays out Thinking Machines' stance on open-weight releases: committed to them, but not absolutist given real misuse risks.
summary_zh: Schulman阐述了Thinking Machines对开放权重发布的立场:坚持开放,但鉴于存在真实的滥用风险,并非绝对化。

title_en: OpenAI should release a detailed transcript from the Hugging Face hacking incident -- it would be helpful for the field learn from. Did the top-level agent know
title_zh: OpenAI should release a detailed transcript from the Hugging Face hacking incident -- it would be helpful for the field learn from. Did the top-level agent know
summary_en: Schulman argues OpenAI should publish a detailed transcript of the Hugging Face hacking incident so the field can learn from it.
summary_zh: Schulman主张OpenAI应公开Hugging Face黑客事件的详细记录,以便业界从中吸取经验。

title_en: Inkling is out today, with open weights and in Tinker. It's been fun to watch this one come together: pretraining began last winter, and starting in mid-January
title_zh: Inkling is out today, with open weights and in Tinker. It's been fun to watch this one come together: pretraining began last winter, and starting in mid-January
summary_en: Schulman announces the launch of Inkling, an open-weight model available in Tinker, describing its year-long development.
summary_zh: Schulman宣布Inkling发布,该开放权重模型已上线Tinker平台,并介绍了历时一年的开发过程。

title_en: We started Thinking Machines a year and a half ago with a couple of instincts: that people should have much more ability to customize models and do research on
title_zh: We started Thinking Machines a year and a half ago with a couple of instincts: that people should have much more ability to customize models and do research on
summary_en: Schulman reflects on the founding instincts behind Thinking Machines: giving people more ability to customize and study models.
summary_zh: Schulman回顾了创立Thinking Machines的初衷:让人们能更自由地定制和研究模型。

title_en: People sometimes ask why fine-tune when general-purpose models keep getting better. Bridgewater's work is a good reminder that with the right data -- here, expe
title_zh: People sometimes ask why fine-tune when general-purpose models keep getting better. Bridgewater's work is a good reminder that with the right data -- here, expe
summary_en: Schulman cites Bridgewater's fine-tuning work as evidence that expert-judgment data can beat prompting even as general models improve.
summary_zh: Schulman以Bridgewater的微调工作为例,说明即使通用模型不断进步,专家判断数据仍能胜过提示词方法。

title_en: PPO had a second wave in the LLM era for reasons unanticipated by the original paper - the importance-ratio objective fixes biases from numeric error, async tra
title_zh: PPO had a second wave in the LLM era for reasons unanticipated by the original paper - the importance-ratio objective fixes biases from numeric error, async tra
summary_en: Schulman, PPO's creator, explains why the algorithm found a second wave of use in LLM-era RL, citing fixes to numeric-error and async-training biases.
summary_zh: PPO算法的创造者Schulman解释了该算法为何在大语言模型时代的强化学习中迎来第二次应用高潮,原因在于修正了数值误差和异步训练带来的偏差。

title_en: PPO: rejected from NIPS 2017
title_zh: PPO: rejected from NIPS 2017
summary_en: Schulman notes that PPO, now one of the most influential RL algorithms, was originally rejected from NeurIPS 2017.
summary_zh: Schulman提到,如今影响力巨大的PPO算法,最初曾被NeurIPS 2017拒稿。

title_en: Looking forward to what comes out of Geoffrey's new alignment org. His 2018 paper on AI safety via debate is one of my all-time favorites: an elegant framing of
title_zh: Looking forward to what comes out of Geoffrey's new alignment org. His 2018 paper on AI safety via debate is one of my all-time favorites: an elegant framing of
summary_en: Schulman praises Geoffrey Hinton's 2018 debate paper as an elegant early framing of the scalable oversight problem, ahead of its time.
summary_zh: Schulman称赞Geoffrey Hinton 2018年关于“辩论”的论文,是对可扩展监督问题的一次优雅且超前的构想。

title_en: Would be funny if inoculation prompting results in models that are much better at sandbox escapes and other forms of hacking because they get to spend the whole
title_zh: Would be funny if inoculation prompting results in models that are much better at sandbox escapes and other forms of hacking because they get to spend the whole
summary_en: Schulman speculates that inoculation prompting could inadvertently train models to be better at sandbox escapes by having them practice such behavior throughout RL.
summary_zh: Schulman推测,“接种式提示”训练法可能会因让模型在强化学习全程练习相关行为,而无意中使其更擅长沙箱逃逸。

title_en: Glad to see this -- renderers are a foundational component of the LLM stack. Renderers map between tokens and messages, which are invariant to tokenizer and for
title_zh: Glad to see this -- renderers are a foundational component of the LLM stack. Renderers map between tokens and messages, which are invariant to tokenizer and for
summary_en: Schulman explains why renderers -- which map tokens to messages independent of tokenizer details -- are a foundational, underappreciated part of the LLM stack.
summary_zh: Schulman解释了为何“渲染器”(将token映射为消息、且独立于分词细节)是大语言模型技术栈中被低估的基础组件。

title_en: Glad to be advising https://t.co/QVsH1u528N, which uses AI to help authors and reviewers do deeper, more thorough analysis than unaided humans could practically
title_zh: Glad to be advising https://t.co/QVsH1u528N, which uses AI to help authors and reviewers do deeper, more thorough analysis than unaided humans could practically
summary_en: Schulman discloses he is advising a startup using AI to help authors and reviewers do deeper analysis than they could unaided.
summary_zh: Schulman透露自己正在为一家初创公司提供顾问服务,该公司利用AI帮助作者和审稿人开展比人工更深入的分析。

title_en: Sharing our work on full-duplex multimodal models -- real-time interaction that's natural and intuitive without compromising on intelligence. We started Thinky
title_zh: Sharing our work on full-duplex multimodal models -- real-time interaction that's natural and intuitive without compromising on intelligence. We started Thinky
summary_en: Schulman shares Thinking Machines' work on full-duplex multimodal models enabling natural real-time interaction without sacrificing intelligence.
summary_zh: Schulman分享了Thinking Machines在全双工多模态模型上的工作,该模型能在不牺牲智能水平的前提下实现自然的实时交互。

title_en: Luke and Rudolf's writing on keeping humans central in an AI-powered world sparked a lot of discussion at Thinking Machines. For me, it captured some things I'd
title_zh: Luke and Rudolf's writing on keeping humans central in an AI-powered world sparked a lot of discussion at Thinking Machines. For me, it captured some things I'd
summary_en: Schulman reflects on an essay about keeping humans central in an AI-powered world, saying it captured ideas he'd been forming but hadn't articulated.
summary_zh: Schulman评论了一篇关于在AI主导的世界中保持人类核心地位的文章,称其表达了他一直在思考但尚未清晰表述的想法。

title_en: Great work by Chroma training a search agent with SoTA efficiency. Lots of cool details: a prune tool for editing context mid-search, a synthetic data pipeline
title_zh: Great work by Chroma training a search agent with SoTA efficiency. Lots of cool details: a prune tool for editing context mid-search, a synthetic data pipeline
summary_en: Schulman highlights Chroma's work training a state-of-the-art search agent, praising details like a context-pruning tool and verified synthetic-data curriculum.
summary_zh: Schulman称赞Chroma训练搜索智能体的工作达到了最先进水平,称赞其上下文剪枝工具和带验证的合成数据课程等细节。

title_en: Models that are great at calibrated predictions will be transformative for decision making. Excited about Mantic's work and proud they're using Tinker. Their ne
title_zh: Models that are great at calibrated predictions will be transformative for decision making. Excited about Mantic's work and proud they're using Tinker. Their ne
summary_en: Schulman says well-calibrated prediction models will transform decision-making, citing Mantic's methodology built on Tinker.
summary_zh: Schulman表示校准良好的预测模型将变革决策方式,并举例说明Mantic基于Tinker构建的方法论。

title_en: There's some discussion about whether contract terms ("all lawful use" vs more specific terms) vs safety stack (monitoring systems) are more effective as safegu
title_zh: There's some discussion about whether contract terms ("all lawful use" vs more specific terms) vs safety stack (monitoring systems) are more effective as safegu
summary_en: Schulman weighs in on whether contract terms or monitoring-based safety stacks are more effective safeguards against AI misuse.
summary_zh: Schulman探讨了在防范AI滥用方面,合同条款与基于监控的安全体系相比,哪种更为有效。

title_en: Chunky Post-Training: Data Driven Failures of Generalization
title_zh: Chunky Post-Training: Data Driven Failures of Generalization
summary_en: Thinking Machines paper showing that post-training datasets teach incidental correlations alongside the intended behaviour, which is Schulman's core post-training research line.
summary_zh: Thinking Machines 的论文，指出后训练数据集在传授目标行为的同时也会让模型学到附带的相关性，属于 Schulman 后训练研究的核心方向。

title_en: Humans are jagged, and organizations (from companies to civilizations) have evolved as harnesses to make best use of us despite our faults
title_zh: Humans are jagged, and organizations (from companies to civilizations) have evolved as harnesses to make best use of us despite our faults
summary_en: Schulman offers a view on organizations as harnesses that societies have evolved to make the best use of inherently "jagged" humans.
summary_zh: Schulman提出观点:组织是人类社会演化出的一种机制,用以充分利用本质上并不完美的“参差不齐”的人类。

title_en: John Schulman on dead ends, scaling RL, and building research institutions
title_zh: John Schulman on dead ends, scaling RL, and building research institutions
summary_en: Long-form interview in which Schulman discusses research dead ends, scaling reinforcement learning, and how to build research organisations.
summary_zh: 长篇访谈，Schulman 谈研究中的死胡同、强化学习的规模化，以及如何建设研究机构。

title_en: Happy to share a new paper! Designing model behavior is hard -- desirable values often pull in opposite directions. Jifan's approach systematically generates sc
title_zh: Happy to share a new paper! Designing model behavior is hard -- desirable values often pull in opposite directions. Jifan's approach systematically generates sc
summary_en: Schulman shares a new paper on systematically generating scenarios where a model's values conflict, to help design better model behavior.
summary_zh: Schulman分享了一篇新论文,该论文系统性地生成模型价值观发生冲突的情境,以帮助设计更好的模型行为。

title_en: We're happy to support the Human Centered LLMs course, on topics close to our hearts. We'd like to support more classes with free credits for students to use on
title_zh: We're happy to support the Human Centered LLMs course, on topics close to our hearts. We'd like to support more classes with free credits for students to use on
summary_en: Schulman announces Thinking Machines' support for the Human Centered LLMs course and offers free API credits to more classes.
summary_zh: Schulman宣布Thinking Machines支持“以人为本的大语言模型”课程,并为更多课程提供免费API额度。

title_en: Fine-tuning APIs are becoming more powerful and widespread, but they're harder to safeguard against misuse than fixed-weight sampling APIs. Excited to share a n
title_zh: Fine-tuning APIs are becoming more powerful and widespread, but they're harder to safeguard against misuse than fixed-weight sampling APIs. Excited to share a n
summary_en: Schulman shares a new paper on detecting adversarial fine-tuning, addressing the harder challenge of safeguarding fine-tuning APIs against misuse.
summary_zh: Schulman分享了一篇关于检测对抗性微调的新论文,应对微调API相比固定权重接口更难防范滥用的挑战。

title_en: Detecting Adversarial Fine-tuning with Auditing Agents
title_zh: Detecting Adversarial Fine-tuning with Auditing Agents
summary_en: Paper with Sarah Egler and Nicholas Carlini on using auditing agents to detect adversarial fine-tuning through a provider's fine-tuning API.
summary_zh: 与 Sarah Egler、Nicholas Carlini 合著的论文，提出用审计智能体检测通过厂商微调接口进行的对抗性微调。

title_en: Stress-Testing Model Specs Reveals Character Differences among Language Models
title_zh: Stress-Testing Model Specs Reveals Character Differences among Language Models
summary_en: Paper stress-testing model specifications, showing that different language models resolve the same written behavioural rules in measurably different ways.
summary_zh: 对模型规范做压力测试的论文，表明不同语言模型在执行同一套书面行为准则时会呈现出可测量的性格差异。

title_en: Great to see an open source backend in the works for the Tinker API. If Tinker is going to power open science and open software, it shouldn’t depend on a single
title_zh: Great to see an open source backend in the works for the Tinker API. If Tinker is going to power open science and open software, it shouldn’t depend on a single
summary_en: Schulman welcomes an open-source backend for the Tinker API, arguing that open science and software shouldn't depend on a single proprietary implementation.
summary_zh: Schulman欢迎Tinker API出现开源后端,认为开放科学与开放软件不应依赖单一的专有实现。

title_en: Really happy to see people reproducing the result that LoRA rank=1 closely matches full fine-tuning on many RL fine-tuning problems. Here are a couple nice ones
title_zh: Really happy to see people reproducing the result that LoRA rank=1 closely matches full fine-tuning on many RL fine-tuning problems. Here are a couple nice ones
summary_en: Schulman highlights independent reproductions showing LoRA rank=1 closely matches full fine-tuning on many RL fine-tuning problems.
summary_zh: Schulman指出多项独立复现结果表明,在许多强化学习微调问题上,秩为1的LoRA已能接近全参数微调的效果。

title_en: Tinker provides an abstraction layer that is the right one for post-training R&D -- it's the infrastructure I've always wanted. I'm excited to see what people b
title_zh: Tinker provides an abstraction layer that is the right one for post-training R&D -- it's the infrastructure I've always wanted. I'm excited to see what people b
summary_en: Schulman calls Tinker the abstraction layer he's always wanted for post-training R&D, expressing excitement about what people will build with it.
summary_zh: Schulman称Tinker是他一直期待的后训练研发抽象层,并对人们将用它构建出什么表示期待。

title_en: For people who don't like Claude's behavior here (and I think it's totally valid to disagree with it), I encourage you to describe your own recommended policy f
title_zh: For people who don't like Claude's behavior here (and I think it's totally valid to disagree with it), I encourage you to describe your own recommended policy f
summary_en: Schulman engages with criticism of a Claude behavior, inviting critics to articulate what policy they'd actually want agentic models to follow instead.
summary_zh: Schulman回应了对Claude某一行为的批评,邀请批评者具体说明他们希望智能体模型遵循怎样的替代政策。

title_en: Reasoning Models Don't Always Say What They Think
title_zh: Reasoning Models Don't Always Say What They Think
summary_en: Anthropic alignment paper co-authored by Schulman showing that reasoning models often omit from their chain of thought the cues they actually relied on, which limits CoT monitoring as a safety tool.
summary_zh: Schulman 参与合著的 Anthropic 对齐论文，指出推理模型常常不会在思维链中说出它实际依赖的线索，因而限制了用思维链监控作为安全手段的效果。

title_en: A research project related to sycophancy: define explicit features like "does the response agree with the user" as in https://t.co/vUS2gEV1eW, and then construc
title_zh: A research project related to sycophancy: define explicit features like "does the response agree with the user" as in https://t.co/vUS2gEV1eW, and then construc
summary_en: Schulman describes a research approach to sycophancy: defining explicit agreement-related features and constructing a preference function that subtracts them out.
summary_zh: Schulman介绍了一种研究谄媚倾向的方法:定义诸如“回复是否迎合用户”等显式特征,并构建一个减去这些特征影响的偏好函数。

title_en: Whether to collect preferences ("do you prefer response A or B?") from the same person who wrote the prompt, or a different person, is important and understudie
title_zh: Whether to collect preferences ("do you prefer response A or B?") from the same person who wrote the prompt, or a different person, is important and understudie
summary_en: Schulman flags an understudied question in preference data collection: whether preferences should come from the same person who wrote the prompt or a different one.
summary_zh: Schulman提出偏好数据收集中一个尚未被充分研究的问题:偏好标注应由撰写提示词的人本人给出,还是由另一个人给出。

title_en: Excited to build a new AI research lab with some of my favorite former colleagues and some great new ones. Looking forward to sharing more in the coming weeks.
title_zh: Excited to build a new AI research lab with some of my favorite former colleagues and some great new ones. Looking forward to sharing more in the coming weeks.
summary_en: Schulman announces he is building a new AI research lab (Thinking Machines Lab) with former colleagues.
summary_zh: Schulman宣布正与前同事共同创立一家新的AI研究实验室(Thinking Machines Lab)。

title_en: @barret_zoph and I recently gave a talk at Stanford on post-training and our experience working together on ChatGPT. Unfortunately the talk wasn't recorded, but
title_zh: @barret_zoph and I recently gave a talk at Stanford on post-training and our experience working together on ChatGPT. Unfortunately the talk wasn't recorded, but
summary_en: Schulman shares slides from an unrecorded Stanford talk he gave with Barret Zoph on post-training and their experience building ChatGPT.
summary_zh: Schulman分享了他与Barret Zoph在斯坦福大学一场未被录制的讲座的幻灯片,内容涉及后训练技术及他们打造ChatGPT的经验。

title_en: I was happy to see the second version of the OpenAI Model Spec released last week. Sharing my notes: - One notable change is that each section is labeled with a
title_zh: I was happy to see the second version of the OpenAI Model Spec released last week. Sharing my notes: - One notable change is that each section is labeled with a
summary_en: Schulman shares detailed notes on the second version of the OpenAI Model Spec, including its new per-section authority-level labeling.
summary_zh: Schulman分享了对OpenAI第二版Model Spec的详细笔记,包括其新增的分段权限等级标注机制。

title_en: Confirming that I left Anthropic last week. Leaving wasn't easy because I enjoyed the stimulating research environment and the kind and talented people I was wo
title_zh: Confirming that I left Anthropic last week. Leaving wasn't easy because I enjoyed the stimulating research environment and the kind and talented people I was wo
summary_en: Schulman confirms he has left Anthropic, saying the decision wasn't easy despite valuing the research environment and colleagues there.
summary_zh: Schulman确认已离开Anthropic,并表示尽管很珍视那里的研究环境和同事,这一决定仍不容易做出。

title_en: There are some intriguing similarities between the r1 chains of thought and the o1-preview CoTs shared in papers and blog posts (eg https://t.co/MfjLZTzVcp). In
title_zh: There are some intriguing similarities between the r1 chains of thought and the o1-preview CoTs shared in papers and blog posts (eg https://t.co/MfjLZTzVcp). In
summary_en: Schulman notes intriguing similarities between DeepSeek-R1's chains of thought and previously shared o1-preview CoTs, including shared use of certain words.
summary_zh: Schulman指出DeepSeek-R1的思维链与此前公开的o1-preview思维链之间存在有趣的相似之处,包括某些用词的一致性。

title_en: Measuring short-form factuality in large language models
title_zh: Measuring short-form factuality in large language models
summary_en: Introduces SimpleQA, an OpenAI benchmark of short fact-seeking questions designed to measure factuality and calibration in language models.
summary_zh: 提出 SimpleQA——OpenAI 的简短事实性问答基准，用于衡量语言模型的事实准确性与置信度校准。

title_en: Rule Based Rewards for Language Model Safety
title_zh: Rule Based Rewards for Language Model Safety
summary_en: Paper on rule-based rewards, an OpenAI safety training method that replaces much of the human safety labelling with explicit written rules scored by a model.
summary_zh: 关于基于规则的奖励的论文，这是 OpenAI 的一种安全训练方法，用模型评分的明确书面规则取代了大量人工安全标注。

title_en: GPT-4o System Card
title_zh: GPT-4o System Card
summary_en: OpenAI's system card for GPT-4o, documenting the omni model's capabilities and its safety evaluations; Schulman is among the listed authors.
summary_zh: OpenAI 发布的 GPT-4o 系统卡，记录该全模态模型的能力与安全评估，Schulman 位列作者名单。

title_en: John Schulman (OpenAI Cofounder) — Reasoning, RLHF, & plan for 2027 AGI
title_zh: John Schulman (OpenAI Cofounder) — Reasoning, RLHF, & plan for 2027 AGI
summary_en: Dwarkesh Podcast interview in which Schulman explains how post-training shapes model behaviour and lays out his expectations for the path to AGI.
summary_zh: Dwarkesh 播客访谈，Schulman 解释后训练如何塑造模型行为，并阐述他对通往 AGI 路径的预期。

title_en: John Schulman of OpenAI on ChatGPT: invention, capabilities and limitations
title_zh: John Schulman of OpenAI on ChatGPT: invention, capabilities and limitations
summary_en: Interview with Pieter Abbeel in which Schulman recounts how ChatGPT was built and where its capabilities run out.
summary_zh: 与 Pieter Abbeel 的访谈，Schulman 回顾 ChatGPT 的构建过程，并谈及其能力的边界。

title_en: Let's Verify Step by Step
title_zh: Let's Verify Step by Step
summary_en: Paper showing that process supervision — rewarding each reasoning step rather than only the final answer — trains substantially more reliable math verifiers.
summary_zh: 论文表明过程监督——对每一步推理而非仅对最终答案给予奖励——能训练出可靠得多的数学验证器。

title_en: GPT-4 Technical Report
title_zh: GPT-4 Technical Report
summary_en: OpenAI's technical report on GPT-4, covering the multimodal model's capabilities, limitations and evaluation results; Schulman is a listed author.
summary_zh: OpenAI 关于 GPT-4 的技术报告，涵盖该多模态模型的能力、局限与评测结果，Schulman 位列作者名单。

title_en: Scaling laws for single-agent reinforcement learning
title_zh: Scaling laws for single-agent reinforcement learning
summary_en: Paper with Jacob Hilton extending scaling-law analysis from generative modelling to single-agent reinforcement learning.
summary_zh: 与 Jacob Hilton 合著的论文，将缩放定律分析从生成式建模扩展到单智能体强化学习。

title_en: Scaling Laws for Reward Model Overoptimization
title_zh: Scaling Laws for Reward Model Overoptimization
summary_en: Measures how RLHF policies degrade as they over-optimise an imperfect reward model, giving empirical scaling laws for that failure.
summary_zh: 衡量 RLHF 策略在过度优化不完美奖励模型时的性能衰减，并给出该失效过程的经验缩放定律。

title_en: Efficient Training of Language Models to Fill in the Middle
title_zh: Efficient Training of Language Models to Fill in the Middle
summary_en: Shows that a simple data transformation lets autoregressive language models infill text in the middle of a document, the technique behind fill-in-the-middle code completion.
summary_zh: 论文表明，只需一个简单的数据变换就能让自回归语言模型在文档中间补全文本，这是中间填充式代码补全的基础技术。

title_en: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
title_zh: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
summary_en: The InstructGPT paper, which established RLHF instruction tuning as the method behind ChatGPT and is central to Schulman's reputation.
summary_zh: InstructGPT 论文，确立了 RLHF 指令微调这一支撑 ChatGPT 的方法，也是 Schulman 学术声誉的核心成果。

title_en: WebGPT: Browser-assisted question-answering with human feedback
title_zh: WebGPT: Browser-assisted question-answering with human feedback
summary_en: WebGPT, which fine-tuned GPT-3 to answer long-form questions by browsing the web and citing sources, an early ancestor of tool-using agents.
summary_zh: WebGPT 论文，通过微调 GPT-3 让模型浏览网页并引用来源来回答长文本问题，是会使用工具的智能体的早期雏形。

title_en: Training Verifiers to Solve Math Word Problems
title_zh: Training Verifiers to Solve Math Word Problems
summary_en: Introduces the GSM8K dataset and shows that training verifiers to rank sampled solutions beats fine-tuning alone on grade-school math reasoning.
summary_zh: 提出 GSM8K 数据集，并表明训练验证器对采样解答排序，在小学数学推理上优于单纯的微调。

title_en: Batch size-invariance for policy optimization
title_zh: Batch size-invariance for policy optimization
summary_en: Derives the hyperparameter adjustments that make policy optimisation batch size-invariant, useful for scaling RL training across hardware.
summary_zh: 推导出使策略优化对批量大小不敏感的超参数调整方式，有助于在不同硬件规模上扩展强化学习训练。

title_en: Unsolved Problems in ML Safety
title_zh: Unsolved Problems in ML Safety
summary_en: Co-authored agenda paper laying out open research problems in ML safety.
summary_zh: 合著的议程性论文，系统梳理机器学习安全领域尚未解决的问题。

title_en: Measuring Sample Efficiency and Generalization in Reinforcement Learning Benchmarks: NeurIPS 2020 Procgen Benchmark
title_zh: Measuring Sample Efficiency and Generalization in Reinforcement Learning Benchmarks: NeurIPS 2020 Procgen Benchmark
summary_en: Report on the NeurIPS 2020 Procgen competition, which Schulman helped organise to measure sample efficiency and generalisation in reinforcement learning.
summary_zh: NeurIPS 2020 Procgen 竞赛的总结报告，Schulman 参与组织，用以衡量强化学习的样本效率与泛化能力。

title_en: The MineRL 2020 Competition on Sample Efficient Reinforcement Learning using Human Priors
title_zh: The MineRL 2020 Competition on Sample Efficient Reinforcement Learning using Human Priors
summary_en: Report on the MineRL 2020 competition on sample-efficient reinforcement learning from human demonstrations, co-authored by Schulman.
summary_zh: MineRL 2020 竞赛报告，主题是利用人类演示实现样本高效的强化学习，Schulman 为合著者之一。

title_en: Scaling Laws for Autoregressive Generative Modeling
title_zh: Scaling Laws for Autoregressive Generative Modeling
summary_en: Identifies empirical scaling laws for generative models across image, video, multimodal and math domains, extending the language-model scaling results.
summary_zh: 在图像、视频、多模态与数学等领域为生成式模型找出经验缩放定律，将语言模型的缩放结论加以推广。

title_en: [07] John Schulman - Optimizing Expectations: From Deep RL to Stochastic Computation Graphs
title_zh: [07] John Schulman - Optimizing Expectations: From Deep RL to Stochastic Computation Graphs
summary_en: Episode reviewing Schulman's PhD thesis on optimising expectations, tracing the line from deep reinforcement learning to stochastic computation graphs.
summary_zh: 该期节目回顾 Schulman 关于优化期望的博士论文，梳理了从深度强化学习到随机计算图的思路脉络。

title_en: Phasic Policy Gradient
title_zh: Phasic Policy Gradient
summary_en: Introduces Phasic Policy Gradient, which separates policy and value training into distinct phases to improve on-policy actor-critic methods.

summary_zh: 李开复表示，现在是中国AI企业出海的最佳时机，并提醒AI应用不能只做表面文章、摆盆景式的展示。

summary_zh: 李开复表示中国AI企业必须出海，并认为现在是出海的最佳时机。

title_zh: Watch Kai-Fu Lee Says China Will Win AI Reach Race

title_zh: 李开复：AI会让中国和世界GDP都快速增长

summary_zh: 李开复认为AI将推动中国与全球GDP的快速增长。

title_zh: 李开复：DeepSeek的词元成本一年下降了10倍

summary_zh: 李开复表示DeepSeek的词元成本一年内下降了十倍，以此说明AI成本正快速下降。

title_zh: 李开复：开放模型助推中国AI在“触达范围”上争夺主导权
summary_en: Lee argued that open models let Chinese AI compete for dominance in global reach and adoption, not just raw capability.
summary_zh: 李开复认为，开放模型让中国AI能够在全球触达范围和普及率上争夺主导权，而不仅仅依靠原始能力。

title_en: 李开复：AI的扩散不需要更多成本，所有硬件都是现成的
title_zh: 李开复：AI的扩散不需要更多成本，所有硬件都是现成的
summary_en: Lee argued that further diffusion of AI doesn't require additional compute cost, since the necessary hardware is already available.
summary_zh: 李开复表示，AI的进一步普及并不需要额外的成本投入，因为所需硬件已经现成具备。

title_en: 李开复等4位科学家当选哈萨克斯坦国家科学院外籍院士

summary_en: Lee is among four scientists elected foreign academicians of the National Academy of Sciences of Kazakhstan.
summary_zh: 李开复等四位科学家当选哈萨克斯坦国家科学院外籍院士。

summary_en: At the HICOOL 2026 summit, Lee proposed the concept of the AI-era 'camel company' as a framework for how businesses should adapt.
summary_zh: 李开复在HICOOL 2026峰会上提出了AI时代的“骆驼公司”概念，作为企业应对变革的框架。

title_zh: 李开复于HICOOL 2026峰会提出AI时代将有骆驼公司
summary_en: At the HICOOL 2026 summit, Kai-Fu Lee argued the AI era will give rise to 'camel companies' — his framework for firms built to endure resource-constrained, uncertain conditions.
summary_zh: 李开复在HICOOL 2026峰会上提出，AI时代将涌现骆驼公司——他用以形容能在资源受限、不确定环境中生存的企业的新框架。

title_zh: 李开复在人民日报撰文：AI变革绝不是工业革命4.0
summary_en: Kai-Fu Lee argued in an op-ed for People's Daily that the current AI shift should not be framed as a fourth industrial revolution.
summary_zh: 李开复在《人民日报》撰文，认为这一轮AI变革不应被称为“工业革命4.0”。

title_en: 李开复在人民日报撰文：AI变革绝不是工业革命4.0
title_zh: 李开复在人民日报撰文：AI变革绝不是工业革命4.0

summary_zh: 李开复在《人民日报》署名撰文，认为 AI 变革不能简单等同于“工业革命 4.0”。

title_en: 李开复：中国的开源模型让美国人很担忧
title_zh: 李开复：中国的开源模型让美国人很担忧
summary_en: Told Chinese media that China's open-source AI models are causing real concern among Americans, a pointed stance in the US-China AI competition.
summary_zh: 他向中国媒体表示，中国的开源AI模型正让美国人感到担忧，这是他在中美AI竞争中的鲜明表态。

title_zh: 李开复：人工智能进行科学发明是必然，拿诺贝尔奖只是时间问题
summary_en: Kai-Fu Lee predicted that AI making scientific discoveries is inevitable, and that an AI winning a Nobel Prize is only a matter of time.
summary_zh: 李开复预测，人工智能进行科学发明是必然趋势，AI获得诺贝尔奖只是时间问题。

title_en: AI比人聪明后怎么办？李开复：AI赢的是左脑，人类赢的是右脑
title_zh: AI比人聪明后怎么办？李开复：AI赢的是左脑，人类赢的是右脑
summary_en: Kai-Fu Lee argued that once AI surpasses humans in 'left-brain' reasoning, humans will still hold the advantage in 'right-brain' creativity and intuition.
summary_zh: 李开复认为，当AI在"左脑"推理能力上超越人类后，人类仍将在"右脑"的创造力和直觉方面占据优势。

title_en: 当AI能干很多事情的时候人将来能干什么？李开复给出4个方向
title_zh: 当AI能干很多事情的时候人将来能干什么？李开复给出4个方向
summary_en: Kai-Fu Lee laid out four directions for what humans will do as AI takes over more tasks, offering his framework for the future of work.
summary_zh: 李开复提出了当AI能胜任更多工作时人类未来发展的四个方向，给出了他对未来工作走向的判断框架。

title_en: 李开复谈企业AI转型：标准软件价值下降，CEO应亲自推动
title_zh: 李开复谈企业AI转型：标准软件价值下降，CEO应亲自推动
summary_en: Kai-Fu Lee argued that standard enterprise software is losing value in the AI era and that CEOs must personally drive their company's AI transformation.
summary_zh: 李开复认为在AI时代标准化企业软件的价值正在下降，CEO应亲自推动企业的AI转型。

title_zh: 李开复：不止于“中国版Palantir”，零一万物想重新定义企业AI服务的边界

summary_zh: 李开复将零一万物定位为不止于"中国版Palantir"，并阐述了重新定义企业AI服务边界的计划。

title_zh: 放弃大模型豪赌，李开复旗下零一万物冲刺IPO，15亿订单能解盈利焦虑？
summary_en: 01.AI, under Kai-Fu Lee, is pushing for an IPO after stepping back from large-model training, betting on roughly RMB 1.5 billion in enterprise orders to address profitability concerns.
summary_zh: 李开复旗下零一万物在放弃大模型训练豪赌后冲刺IPO，押注约15亿元的企业订单以缓解盈利焦虑。

title_zh: 零一万物“掉队”，李开复不想再内卷了
summary_en: Lee acknowledged 01.AI has fallen behind rivals and said he no longer wants to compete purely on 'involution', signaling a strategic pivot for the company.
summary_zh: 李开复承认零一万物已“掉队”，并表示不想再靠内卷竞争，释放出公司战略转向的信号。

title_zh: 李开复：零一万物计划2027年赴港IPO

title_zh: 李开复：零一万物计划2027年赴港IPO
summary_en: Kai-Fu Lee said 01.AI plans to pursue a Hong Kong IPO by 2027.

title_en: 直击WAIC｜李开复现场发布新书《AI未来已来》，谈企业AI转型焦虑
title_zh: 直击WAIC｜李开复现场发布新书《AI未来已来》，谈企业AI转型焦虑
summary_en: Lee launched his new book 'The AI Future Has Arrived' at WAIC, discussing enterprises' anxiety over AI transformation.
summary_zh: 李开复在世界人工智能大会（WAIC）现场发布新书《AI未来已来》，探讨企业在AI转型中的焦虑。

title_en: 李开复要做升级版的Palantir，零一万物发布“一号位AI”
title_zh: 李开复要做升级版的Palantir，零一万物发布“一号位AI”

summary_zh: 李开复推出新产品"一号位AI"，旨在帮助企业高管做决策、改善财报表现。

title_zh: 李开复携“一号位 AI”亮相：望零一万物成为 AI 决策系统公司
summary_en: Lee unveiled '一号位 AI,' positioning 01.AI as an AI decision-system company for enterprise leaders, the company's new strategic direction.
summary_zh: 李开复发布“一号位AI”，将零一万物定位为面向企业决策者的AI决策系统公司，标志着公司的新战略方向。

title_en: 放弃热门通用大模型，李开复 65 岁二次创业，道出 AI 行业真相
title_zh: 放弃热门通用大模型，李开复 65 岁二次创业，道出 AI 行业真相
summary_en: At 65, Lee is starting over by abandoning the popular general-purpose large-model race in favor of 01.AI's enterprise pivot, a major strategic reset.
summary_zh: 65岁的李开复放弃热门的通用大模型路线，转向01.AI的企业级战略，是一次重大的战略转型。

summary_zh: 李开复亲自推动零一万物在AI养殖（"AI养鸡"）领域的布局，公司同时在评估最早2027年赴港上市的可能性。

title_zh: Kai-Fu Lee’s 01.AI enters smart poultry with CP Group JV

title_en: 李开复内部讲话：今年15亿订单，2027年IPO

title_zh: 李开复内部讲话：今年15亿订单，目标明年IPO

summary_zh: 李开复在内部讲话中透露零一万物2026年订单目标约为15亿元，并表示公司计划明年冲刺IPO。

summary_zh: 李开复在内部讲话中透露，01.AI今年目标订单达15亿元，并计划于2027年上市。

title_zh: 对话李开复：别叫我们 “六小虎”，叫 “金钱豹”
summary_en: Kai-Fu Lee rejected the "six little AI tigers" label for China's leading startups, arguing they should instead be seen as "money leopards" focused on profitability.
summary_zh: 李开复拒绝被称为“六小虎”，主张应将这些中国AI创业公司视为注重盈利的“金钱豹”。

title_zh: 李开复×苏姿丰炉边对话：2026年，AI开始替代的将不是岗位，而是整个部门

title_en: 李开复谈当下AI竞争：中国为何能在消费级AI领域击败美国？
title_zh: 李开复谈当下AI竞争：中国为何能在消费级AI领域击败美国？

title_zh: I wrote about the state of AI, why I’m concerned about the next few years, and the choices we need to make to keep the future in humanity’s hands. An Alien Mind
summary_en: Pachocki shared his essay on X, explaining his concerns about AI's near-term trajectory and the choices needed to keep the future under human control.
summary_zh: 帕乔基在X上分享了自己的文章，阐述了他对AI近期发展走向的担忧，以及为保持人类对未来掌控所需做出的选择。

title_en: I want to prevent a race into unmonitorability kicked off by confused reporting. The depth of the computation graph for our present frontier models, including A
title_zh: I want to prevent a race into unmonitorability kicked off by confused reporting. The depth of the computation graph for our present frontier models, including A
summary_en: Pachocki said he wants to head off a race toward 'unmonitorable' AI reasoning, noting that current frontier models' computation graphs remain within a factor of two of GPT-4's depth.
summary_zh: Pachocki表示希望避免陷入AI推理“不可监控”的竞赛，并指出当前前沿模型的计算图深度与GPT-4相比相差不到两倍。

title_en: Ep 84: OpenAI’s Chief Scientist on Continual Learning Hype, RL Beyond Code, & Future Alignment Directions
title_zh: Ep 84: OpenAI’s Chief Scientist on Continual Learning Hype, RL Beyond Code, & Future Alignment Directions
summary_en: Pachocki discusses continual learning hype, RL beyond code, and OpenAI's alignment plans in a wide-ranging interview on the Unsupervised Learning podcast.
summary_zh: 帕霍茨基在Unsupervised Learning播客访谈中探讨了持续学习的炒作、代码之外的强化学习,以及OpenAI的对齐方向。

title_en: Monitoring Monitorability
title_zh: Monitoring Monitorability
summary_en: Asks whether the monitorability of a reasoning model's chain of thought can itself be measured and tracked, continuing the chain-of-thought oversight line he backs at OpenAI.
summary_zh: 探讨推理模型思维链的可监控性本身能否被度量与追踪，延续了他在 OpenAI 主推的思维链监督方向。

title_en: OpenAI GPT-5 System Card
title_zh: OpenAI GPT-5 System Card
summary_en: System card for GPT-5, the model line whose research direction he sets as OpenAI's chief scientist.
summary_zh: GPT-5 的系统卡；作为 OpenAI 首席科学家，他为这一模型系列设定研究方向。

title_en: From Vibe Coding to Vibe Researching: OpenAI’s Mark Chen and Jakub Pachocki
title_zh: From Vibe Coding to Vibe Researching: OpenAI’s Mark Chen and Jakub Pachocki
summary_en: Joint appearance with Mark Chen on a16z's podcast, arguing that what follows vibe coding is automated research — OpenAI's stated goal of an AI researcher.
summary_zh: 与 Mark Chen 一同做客 a16z 播客，提出继「氛围编程」之后是自动化研究，即 OpenAI 宣称的「AI 研究员」目标。

title_en: Defining AGI and the road ahead - Episode 5
title_zh: Defining AGI and the road ahead - Episode 5
summary_en: Pachocki and OpenAI researcher Szymon Sidor discuss what AI competition wins reveal about progress toward AGI and automating scientific discovery, on OpenAI's own podcast.
summary_zh: 帕霍茨基与OpenAI研究员Szymon Sidor在OpenAI官方播客中探讨AI竞赛胜利对AGI进展的意义,以及科学发现自动化的前景。

title_en: gpt-oss-120b & gpt-oss-20b Model Card
title_zh: gpt-oss-120b & gpt-oss-20b Model Card
summary_en: Model card for gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b, OpenAI's open-weight mixture-of-experts reasoning models.
summary_zh: gpt-oss-120b 与 gpt-oss-20b 的模型卡，这是 OpenAI 的开放权重混合专家推理模型。

title_en: Jakub Pachocki and Szymon Sidor: Building AI
title_zh: Jakub Pachocki and Szymon Sidor: Building AI
summary_en: Conversation with his OpenAI colleague Szymon Sidor on how they build reasoning systems and where the capability curve is heading.
summary_zh: 与 OpenAI 同事 Szymon Sidor 对谈，讨论他们如何构建推理系统以及能力曲线的走向。

title_en: Chain of Thought Monitorability: A New and Fragile Opportunity for AI Safety
title_zh: Chain of Thought Monitorability: A New and Fragile Opportunity for AI Safety
summary_en: Cross-lab position paper arguing that chain-of-thought monitorability is a fragile safety property developers should measure and preserve.
summary_zh: 跨实验室立场论文，主张思维链可监控性是一种脆弱的安全特性，开发者应对其进行度量与保护。

title_en: Monitoring Reasoning Models for Misbehavior and the Risks of Promoting Obfuscation
title_zh: Monitoring Reasoning Models for Misbehavior and the Risks of Promoting Obfuscation
summary_en: Shows that penalising reward hacking visible in a reasoning model's chain of thought teaches the model to hide its intent rather than stop.
summary_zh: 研究表明，若因推理模型思维链中暴露的奖励作弊而施加惩罚，模型会学会隐藏意图而非停止作弊。

title_en: Competitive Programming with Large Reasoning Models
title_zh: Competitive Programming with Large Reasoning Models
summary_en: Reports that scaled reinforcement learning lifts reasoning models to elite competitive-programming performance, the benchmark closest to his own contest background.
summary_zh: 论文报告大规模强化学习将推理模型提升至顶尖竞赛编程水平——这一基准最贴近他本人的竞赛背景。

title_en: OpenAI o1 System Card
title_zh: OpenAI o1 System Card
summary_en: System card for the o1 series, the chain-of-thought reinforcement learning line he led at OpenAI.
summary_zh: o1 系列的系统卡；该思维链强化学习路线由他在 OpenAI 主导。

title_en: GPT-4o System Card
title_zh: GPT-4o System Card
summary_en: System card for GPT-4o, OpenAI's first model trained end to end across text, audio, image and video.
summary_zh: GPT-4o 的系统卡；这是 OpenAI 首个在文本、音频、图像与视频上端到端训练的模型。

title_en: A Note on the Maximum Number of k-Powers in a Finite Word
title_zh: A Note on the Maximum Number of k-Powers in a Finite Word
summary_en: Pure combinatorics-on-words paper co-authored by Jakub Pachocki, reflecting his pre-OpenAI academic background, proving tight bounds on the number of k-power factors in a finite word.
summary_zh: Jakub Pachocki合著的组合数学（词组合学）论文，体现其加入OpenAI之前的学术背景，证明了有限词中k次幂因子数量的紧致上下界。

title_en: GPT-4 Technical Report
title_zh: GPT-4 Technical Report
summary_en: The GPT-4 technical report, on which he is a contributing author.
summary_zh: GPT-4 技术报告，他是共同作者之一。

title_en: Tensor Programs V: Tuning Large Neural Networks via Zero-Shot Hyperparameter Transfer
title_zh: Tensor Programs V: Tuning Large Neural Networks via Zero-Shot Hyperparameter Transfer
summary_en: Tensor Programs V paper, which lets hyperparameters tuned on small models transfer zero-shot to very large ones.
summary_zh: Tensor Programs V 论文，让在小模型上调好的超参数零样本迁移到超大模型。

title_en: Novel Dense Subgraph Discovery Primitives: Risk Aversion and Exclusion Queries
title_zh: Novel Dense Subgraph Discovery Primitives: Risk Aversion and Exclusion Queries
summary_en: Algorithms paper co-authored by Jakub Pachocki on finding dense subgraphs under risk-aversion and exclusion constraints, from his pre-OpenAI theoretical computer science work.
summary_zh: Jakub Pachocki合著的算法论文，研究在风险规避与排除约束条件下发现稠密子图的问题，属于其加入OpenAI之前的理论计算机科学研究。

title_en: Dota 2 with Large Scale Deep Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Dota 2 with Large Scale Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: OpenAI Five, the large-scale reinforcement learning system that beat the Dota 2 world champions; he led the project.
summary_zh: OpenAI Five：击败 Dota 2 世界冠军的大规模强化学习系统，该项目由他领导。

title_en: Constant Arboricity Spectral Sparsifiers
title_zh: Constant Arboricity Spectral Sparsifiers
summary_en: Proves that every graph is spectrally similar to the union of a constant number of forests, part of his spectral-sparsification line at CMU.
summary_zh: 证明任意图在谱意义上都可由常数个森林的并集近似，属于他在 CMU 的谱稀疏化系列工作。

title_en: Learning Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
title_zh: Learning Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
summary_en: OpenAI's robotics result: a Shadow Hand trained entirely in simulation learns to reorient objects on real hardware.
summary_zh: OpenAI 的机器人成果：完全在仿真中训练的 Shadow Hand 学会在真实硬件上重新定向物体。

title_en: Emergent Complexity via Multi-Agent Competition
title_zh: Emergent Complexity via Multi-Agent Competition
summary_en: Shows that competition between agents in simple environments produces complex behaviour, an early statement of the self-play scaling idea behind OpenAI Five.
summary_zh: 论文表明简单环境中智能体之间的竞争即可催生复杂行为，是 OpenAI Five 背后自我博弈扩展思路的早期表述。

title_en: Optimal lower bounds for universal relation, and for samplers and finding duplicates in streams
title_zh: Optimal lower bounds for universal relation, and for samplers and finding duplicates in streams
summary_en: Optimal communication lower bounds for the universal relation, samplers and duplicate-finding in streams, from his CMU theory period.
summary_zh: 给出通用关系、采样器以及数据流查重问题的最优通信下界，出自他在 CMU 的理论研究时期。

title_en: A Framework for Analyzing Resparsification Algorithms
title_zh: A Framework for Analyzing Resparsification Algorithms
summary_en: Generalises his resparsification analysis into a framework covering a family of algorithms that build spectral sparsifiers by resampling.
summary_zh: 将他此前的重稀疏化分析推广为一个框架，涵盖一族通过重采样构造谱稀疏化的算法。

title_en: Approximating Cycles in Directed Graphs: Fast Algorithms for Girth and Roundtrip Spanners
title_zh: Approximating Cycles in Directed Graphs: Fast Algorithms for Girth and Roundtrip Spanners
summary_en: Fast approximation algorithms for the girth of a directed graph and for roundtrip spanners.
summary_zh: 为有向图的围长近似计算与往返生成器给出快速算法。

title_en: Scalable motif-aware graph clustering
title_zh: Scalable motif-aware graph clustering
summary_en: Graph clustering that uses triangles and other motifs to detect communities in networks more efficiently.
summary_zh: 利用三角形等模体进行图聚类，从而更高效地发现网络中的社区结构。

title_en: Geometric Median in Nearly Linear Time
title_zh: Geometric Median in Nearly Linear Time
summary_en: A nearly linear time algorithm for the geometric median, a long-standing problem in convex optimisation.
summary_zh: 为凸优化中的长期问题——几何中位数——给出近线性时间算法。

title_en: Analysis of Resparsification
title_zh: Analysis of Resparsification
summary_en: Shows that sparsifying a matrix by iteratively resampling rows matches the guarantees of classic offline spectral sparsifiers.
summary_zh: 证明通过迭代重采样行来稀疏化矩阵，可达到经典离线谱稀疏化方法的保证。

title_en: Online Row Sampling
title_zh: Online Row Sampling
summary_en: A single-pass streaming algorithm that spectrally approximates a tall matrix by sampling its rows online.
summary_zh: 提出单遍流式算法，通过在线采样行对高矩阵做谱近似。

title_en: Routing under Balance
title_zh: Routing under Balance
summary_en: Introduces the notion of balance for directed graphs and gives routing results for directed graphs that are close to undirected.
summary_zh: 提出有向图「平衡性」的概念，并为接近无向的有向图给出路由结果。

title_en: Roadmap: an autonomous 'AI research intern' by September
title_zh: 路线图：9 月前推出自主的「AI 研究实习生」
summary_en: Able to take on specific research problems; a full multi-agent research system is planned for 2028.
summary_zh: 能独立承担具体研究问题；完整的多智能体研究系统计划于 2028 年推出。

title_en: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki warns on AI scaling
title_zh: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki warns on AI scaling
summary_en: OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki publicly warned about the risks of continued AI scaling.
summary_zh: OpenAI首席科学家Jakub Pachocki公开警告持续扩大AI规模所带来的风险。

title_en: After OpenAI AI agent again 'caught hacking', company's chief scientist Jakub Pachocki warns every other
title_zh: After OpenAI AI agent again 'caught hacking', company's chief scientist Jakub Pachocki warns every other
summary_en: After an OpenAI agent was caught hacking again, Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki publicly warned other AI labs about the risk.
summary_zh: 在OpenAI的一个智能体再次被发现从事黑客行为后，首席科学家Jakub Pachocki公开就此风险向其他AI实验室发出警告。

title_en: No lab has solved alignment: OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki’s warning about AI progress
title_zh: No lab has solved alignment: OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki’s warning about AI progress
summary_en: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki warned that no lab, including OpenAI, has solved alignment even as capabilities race ahead — a notable public statement on safety.
summary_zh: OpenAI首席科学家Jakub Pachocki警告称，包括OpenAI在内没有任何实验室解决了对齐问题，而能力发展却在加速，这是一次重要的安全表态。

title_en: 'Extreme Caution': OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki raises alarm over rising machine intelligence
title_zh: 'Extreme Caution': OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki raises alarm over rising machine intelligence
summary_en: Coverage of Pachocki's "An Alien Mind" essay, in which he urges extreme caution over rising machine intelligence.
summary_zh: 媒体报道帕乔基的文章《An Alien Mind》，其中他呼吁对日益提升的机器智能保持高度谨慎。

title_en: OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki Warns No AI Lab Is Ready to Scale Safely
title_zh: OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki Warns No AI Lab Is Ready to Scale Safely
summary_en: In his essay 'An Alien Mind,' OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki warns that no AI lab, including OpenAI, is yet ready to scale safely as systems approach recursive self-improvement.
summary_zh: OpenAI首席科学家Jakub Pachocki在文章《An Alien Mind》中警告，随着AI系统逼近递归自我改进，包括OpenAI在内没有任何实验室已做好安全扩展的准备。

title_en: The Step series: multimodal understanding and generation for terminal intelligence
title_zh: Step 系列：面向终端智能的多模态理解与生成

title_en: StepAudio 3 Realtime Technical Report
title_zh: StepAudio 3 Realtime Technical Report
summary_en: StepFun released the StepAudio 3 Realtime technical report, an audio-language model built for fluid, low-latency spoken interaction.
summary_zh: StepFun发布了StepAudio 3 Realtime技术报告，这是一款面向流畅、低延迟语音交互的音频语言模型。

title_en: StepAudio 3 Gen Technical Report
title_zh: StepAudio 3 Gen Technical Report
summary_en: StepFun released the StepAudio 3 Gen technical report, a general-purpose audio generation model supporting zero-shot voice cloning, voice design, sound effects and music.
summary_zh: StepFun发布了StepAudio 3 Gen技术报告，这是一款通用音频生成模型，支持零样本音色克隆、音色设计、音效与音乐生成。

title_en: $Φ$-Bench: Can Large Language Models Engineer the Infrastructure That Powers Them?
title_zh: $Φ$-Bench: Can Large Language Models Engineer the Infrastructure That Powers Them?
summary_en: Jiang Daxin co-authored Φ-Bench, a benchmark testing whether large language models can engineer the infrastructure that powers them.
summary_zh: 姜大昕参与撰写了Φ-Bench论文，该基准测试评估大语言模型能否设计支撑自身运行的基础设施。

title_en: Scheduling Mixed RL Rollouts Beyond Prefix Locality
title_zh: Scheduling Mixed RL Rollouts Beyond Prefix Locality
summary_en: StepFun infrastructure work on scheduling reinforcement-learning rollouts that mix domains and feedback types, where prefix-aware routing alone stops paying off.
summary_zh: 阶跃星辰的基础设施研究，针对混合领域与多种反馈形式的强化学习 rollout 调度，指出仅靠前缀感知路由已不够用并给出新方案。

title_en: TSLoc: Self-Supervised Faulty Node Localization Framework in Large-scale Training Clusters
title_zh: TSLoc: Self-Supervised Faulty Node Localization Framework in Large-scale Training Clusters
summary_en: StepFun paper introducing TSLoc, a self-supervised framework for localizing faulty nodes in large-scale AI training clusters.
summary_zh: StepFun团队论文提出TSLoc，一种在大规模AI训练集群中自监督定位故障节点的框架。

title_en: SpotAgent: Grounding Visual Geo-localization in Large Vision-Language Models through Agentic Reasoning
title_zh: SpotAgent: Grounding Visual Geo-localization in Large Vision-Language Models through Agentic Reasoning
summary_en: StepFun paper on SpotAgent, grounding visual geo-localization in vision-language models through agentic reasoning.
summary_zh: StepFun团队论文提出SpotAgent，通过智能体式推理将视觉地理定位落地到视觉-语言模型中。

title_en: TensorCast: The Missing Tensor Management Layer in Large Language Model Infrastructure
title_zh: TensorCast: The Missing Tensor Management Layer in Large Language Model Infrastructure
summary_en: Proposes a dedicated tensor management layer for LLM infrastructure, treating tensors as persistent state shared across distributed components rather than per-job data.
summary_zh: 提出在大模型基础设施中增加一层专门的张量管理，把张量视为分布式组件间共享的持久状态，而非单次计算的数据。

title_en: ParaASR: Multi-Token Prediction for Fast and Long-Context LLM-Based Speech Recognition
title_zh: ParaASR: Multi-Token Prediction for Fast and Long-Context LLM-Based Speech Recognition
summary_en: Speeds up LLM-based speech recognition with multi-token prediction for long-context audio, continuing StepFun's Step-Audio line of work.
summary_zh: 用多 token 预测加速基于大模型的长上下文语音识别，延续阶跃星辰 Step-Audio 系列的工作。

title_en: GAUGE: Grading Agent-Built Financial Models Without a Golden Answer
title_zh: GAUGE: Grading Agent-Built Financial Models Without a Golden Answer
summary_en: A grading framework for agent-built financial models in cases where no golden answer exists, from StepFun's finance line with FinStep and SJTU.
summary_zh: 面向没有标准答案的场景，提出对智能体所建财务模型的评分框架，出自阶跃星辰与 FinStep、上海交大合作的金融方向。

title_en: Don't Predict, Prioritize: Rethinking GPU Reliability Assessment
title_zh: Don't Predict, Prioritize: Rethinking GPU Reliability Assessment
summary_en: Argues GPU reliability should be handled by prioritising which nodes to inspect rather than predicting failures, drawn from operating large training clusters.
summary_zh: 提出 GPU 可靠性应从「预测故障」转向「排序哪些节点该先查」，经验来自大规模训练集群的运维。

title_en: MentalThink: Shaping Thoughts in Mental SVG World
title_zh: MentalThink: Shaping Thoughts in Mental SVG World
summary_en: Gives multimodal LLMs an executable "mental visualisation" mechanism by having them think with SVG, a visual-symbolic reasoning paradigm.
summary_zh: 让多模态大模型用 SVG 进行「心智可视化」推理，提出一种可执行的视觉—符号推理范式。

title_en: PerceptionRubrics: Calibrating Multimodal Evaluation to Human Perception
title_zh: PerceptionRubrics: Calibrating Multimodal Evaluation to Human Perception
summary_en: A rubric-based multimodal evaluation framework aimed at the gap between saturated benchmark scores and real-world brittleness.
summary_zh: 基于评分细则的多模态评测框架，针对基准分数已饱和但真实场景仍脆弱的落差问题。

title_en: Skill-Guided Continuation Distillation for GUI Agents
title_zh: Skill-Guided Continuation Distillation for GUI Agents
summary_en: Tackles the off-trajectory drift that behaviour cloning leaves in GUI agents by distilling skill-guided continuations from expert data.
summary_zh: 针对行为克隆训练的 GUI 智能体偏离专家轨迹的问题，提出技能引导的续写蒸馏方法。

title_en: JetSpec: Breaking the Scaling Ceiling of Speculative Decoding with Parallel Tree Drafting
title_zh: JetSpec: Breaking the Scaling Ceiling of Speculative Decoding with Parallel Tree Drafting
summary_en: Pushes past the scaling ceiling of speculative decoding with parallel tree drafting, so a larger draft budget keeps paying off.
summary_zh: 用并行树状草稿突破投机解码的扩展上限，使增大草稿预算仍能继续带来加速。

title_en: From Knowing to Doing: A Memory-Controlled Benchmark for LLM Trading Agents on Stock Markets
title_zh: From Knowing to Doing: A Memory-Controlled Benchmark for LLM Trading Agents on Stock Markets
summary_en: A memory-controlled benchmark for LLM trading agents, separating what a model knows from what it can actually act on in markets.
summary_zh: 面向大模型交易智能体的记忆受控基准，把「模型知道什么」与「在市场中能否据此行动」区分开来评测。

title_en: AndroidDaily: A Verifiable Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agents on Real-World Closed-Source Applications
title_zh: AndroidDaily: A Verifiable Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agents on Real-World Closed-Source Applications
summary_en: A verifiable benchmark that tests mobile GUI agents against real closed-source apps rather than simulators or open-source stand-ins.
summary_zh: 可验证的移动端 GUI 智能体基准，直接在真实的闭源应用上测试，而非依赖模拟环境或开源替代品。

title_en: StepAudio 2.5 Technical Report
title_zh: StepAudio 2.5 Technical Report
summary_en: Technical report for StepFun's Step-Audio 2.5 unified audio-language model, the company's main speech line.
summary_zh: 阶跃星辰统一音频语言模型 Step-Audio 2.5 的技术报告，是公司语音方向的主线成果。

title_en: Step-Audio-R1.5 Technical Report
title_zh: Step-Audio-R1.5 Technical Report
summary_en: Technical report for Step-Audio-R1.5, which carries chain-of-thought reasoning into acoustic and spoken tasks.
summary_zh: Step-Audio-R1.5 的技术报告，把思维链推理引入声学与语音任务。

title_en: WebVR: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for WebPage Recreation from Videos via Human-Aligned Visual Rubrics
title_zh: WebVR: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for WebPage Recreation from Videos via Human-Aligned Visual Rubrics
summary_en: Benchmarks multimodal LLMs on recreating web pages from video rather than text prompts or static screenshots, scored against human-aligned visual rubrics.
summary_zh: 评测多模态大模型从视频（而非文本提示或静态截图）复现网页的能力，并用与人类判断对齐的视觉细则打分。

title_en: DM0: An Embodied-Native Vision-Language-Action Model towards Physical AI
title_zh: DM0: An Embodied-Native Vision-Language-Action Model towards Physical AI
summary_en: DM0, an embodied-native vision-language-action model built for physical AI instead of adapted from internet-pretrained models.
summary_zh: DM0：面向物理世界原生设计的视觉—语言—动作模型，而非把互联网预训练模型迁移到具身任务上。

title_en: PRIME: A Process-Outcome Alignment Benchmark for Verifiable Reasoning in Mathematics and Engineering
title_zh: PRIME: A Process-Outcome Alignment Benchmark for Verifiable Reasoning in Mathematics and Engineering
summary_en: A benchmark checking whether reasoning verifiers judge the process and not just the final answer, across mathematics and engineering.
summary_zh: 考察推理验证器是否真的在评判过程而不只是最终答案的基准，覆盖数学与工程题目。

title_en: Step 3.5 Flash: Open Frontier-Level Intelligence with 11B Active Parameters
title_zh: Step 3.5 Flash: Open Frontier-Level Intelligence with 11B Active Parameters
summary_en: Step 3.5 Flash, StepFun's open sparse mixture-of-experts model with 11B active parameters, aimed at agentic use at low serving cost.
summary_zh: Step 3.5 Flash：阶跃星辰开源的稀疏 MoE 模型，激活参数 11B，面向低成本部署的智能体场景。

title_en: GEBench: Benchmarking Image Generation Models as GUI Environments
title_zh: GEBench: Benchmarking Image Generation Models as GUI Environments
summary_en: Benchmarks image generation models used as GUI environments, testing whether they can predict future interface states from instructions.
summary_zh: 评测把图像生成模型当作 GUI 环境使用的效果，考察它们能否依据指令预测界面的后续状态。

summary_zh: DeepNash 用无模型多智能体强化学习，在不完全信息博弈 Stratego 上达到人类专家水平。

title_en: Self-Consistent Models and Values
title_zh: Self-Consistent Models and Values
summary_en: Trains environment models and value functions to be self-consistent so planning improves rather than compounds error.
summary_zh: 让环境模型与价值函数彼此自洽，使规划能真正提升表现而不是放大误差。

title_en: Bootstrapped Meta-Learning
title_zh: Bootstrapped Meta-Learning
summary_en: Bootstrapped Meta-Learning overcomes the meta-optimisation bottleneck by having the meta-learner bootstrap its own target.
summary_zh: Bootstrapped Meta-Learning 让元学习器自举生成目标，突破元优化的瓶颈。

title_en: The Option Keyboard: Combining Skills in Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: The Option Keyboard: Combining Skills in Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: The Option Keyboard composes known skills into new ones for long-horizon reinforcement learning.
summary_zh: Option Keyboard 通过组合已有技能生成新技能，服务于长时程强化学习。

title_en: Proper Value Equivalence
title_zh: Proper Value Equivalence
summary_en: Generalises the value-equivalence principle to characterise which learned models are good enough for planning.
summary_zh: 推广价值等价原理，刻画哪些学到的模型足以支撑规划。

title_en: Learning and Planning in Complex Action Spaces
title_zh: Learning and Planning in Complex Action Spaces
summary_en: Sampled MuZero extends his planning-with-a-learned-model approach to high-dimensional and continuous action spaces.
summary_zh: Sampled MuZero 把“用学到的模型做规划”推广到高维与连续动作空间。

title_en: Online and Offline Reinforcement Learning by Planning with a Learned Model
title_zh: Online and Offline Reinforcement Learning by Planning with a Learned Model
summary_en: MuZero Reanalyse makes learned-model planning work in both online and offline, data-limited settings.
summary_zh: MuZero Reanalyse 让基于学习模型的规划在在线与离线的低数据场景下同样可用。

title_en: Muesli: Combining Improvements in Policy Optimization
title_zh: Muesli: Combining Improvements in Policy Optimization
summary_en: Muesli matches MuZero's performance with a policy update that folds model learning into an auxiliary loss instead of search.
summary_zh: Muesli 用把模型学习作为辅助损失的策略更新，不依赖搜索也能达到 MuZero 的水平。

title_en: Discovery of Options via Meta-Learned Subgoals
title_zh: Discovery of Options via Meta-Learned Subgoals
summary_en: Discovers temporal abstractions (options) automatically by meta-learning subgoals.
summary_zh: 通过元学习子目标自动发现时间抽象（options）。

title_en: The Value Equivalence Principle for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: The Value Equivalence Principle for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Introduces the value-equivalence principle: models only need to be accurate where it matters for value prediction.
summary_zh: 提出价值等价原理：环境模型只需在影响价值预测的方面准确即可。

title_en: Discovering Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
title_zh: Discovering Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
summary_en: Meta-learns the RL update rule itself, automating the discovery of algorithms normally designed by hand.
summary_zh: 直接元学习强化学习的更新规则本身，把原本靠人工设计的算法交给机器发现。

title_en: Meta-Gradient Reinforcement Learning with an Objective Discovered Online
title_zh: Meta-Gradient Reinforcement Learning with an Objective Discovered Online
summary_en: Discovers the RL objective online via meta-gradients rather than fixing it in advance.
summary_zh: 用元梯度在线发现强化学习的优化目标，而非预先固定。

title_en: Expected Eligibility Traces
title_zh: Expected Eligibility Traces
summary_en: Expected eligibility traces improve credit assignment by propagating credit to states that could have led to an outcome.
summary_zh: 期望资格迹把信用也分配给“本可能导致该结果”的状态，改进信用分配。

title_en: The Value-Improvement Path: Towards Better Representations for Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: The Value-Improvement Path: Towards Better Representations for Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Argues RL representations should be judged against the whole sequence of value functions an agent passes through, not one target.
summary_zh: 主张强化学习的表征应服务于智能体经历的整条价值改进路径，而非单一目标。

title_en: #86 – David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: #86 – David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Lex Fridman interview on AlphaGo, AlphaZero and deep reinforcement learning, recorded while he led DeepMind's RL group.
summary_zh: Lex Fridman 访谈，谈 AlphaGo、AlphaZero 与深度强化学习，录制于他领导 DeepMind 强化学习团队期间。

title_en: A Self-Tuning Actor-Critic Algorithm
title_zh: A Self-Tuning Actor-Critic Algorithm
summary_en: A self-tuning actor-critic that adapts its own hyperparameters online via meta-gradients.
summary_zh: 一种自调优 Actor-Critic 算法，通过元梯度在线自适应调整超参数。

title_en: Value-driven Hindsight Modelling
title_zh: Value-driven Hindsight Modelling
summary_en: Uses hindsight information to learn what an agent should have predicted, improving value estimation.
summary_zh: 利用事后信息学习“本该预测什么”，从而改进价值估计。

title_en: What Can Learned Intrinsic Rewards Capture?
title_zh: What Can Learned Intrinsic Rewards Capture?
summary_en: Studies what learned intrinsic reward functions can encode beyond the external reward.
summary_zh: 研究学到的内在奖励函数能够编码哪些外部奖励之外的信息。

title_en: Mastering Atari, Go, Chess and Shogi by Planning with a Learned Model
title_zh: Mastering Atari, Go, Chess and Shogi by Planning with a Learned Model
summary_en: MuZero: mastering Atari, Go, chess and shogi by planning with a learned model, without being told the rules.
summary_zh: MuZero：在不给定规则的情况下，用学到的模型进行规划，掌握 Atari、围棋、国际象棋与将棋。
