summary_zh: 萨顿谈及与Dan Fagella的访谈，提出人类与AI应基于自愿合作、互惠互利的未来构想。

title_en: A year later and our work on Loss of Plasticity is finally published, in Nature no less! The Nature version is totally rewritten and has many new results: https
title_zh: A year later and our work on Loss of Plasticity is finally published, in Nature no less! The Nature version is totally rewritten and has many new results: https
summary_en: Sutton announces the Nature publication of his Loss of Plasticity work, rewritten with new results a year after the original release.
summary_zh: 萨顿宣布其"可塑性丧失"研究成果发表于《自然》杂志，该版本较原版全面重写并新增结果。

title_en: Yesterday there was a completely-student-organized summit of the RLAI (Reinforcement Learning and Artificial Intelligence) research group at the University of A
title_zh: Yesterday there was a completely-student-organized summit of the RLAI (Reinforcement Learning and Artificial Intelligence) research group at the University of A
summary_en: Sutton recaps a student-organized RLAI research summit held at Amii's Edmonton headquarters.
summary_zh: 萨顿回顾了在Amii埃德蒙顿总部举行的、由学生自发组织的RLAI研究峰会。

title_en: Richard Sutton - Humanity Never Had Control in the First Place (Worthy Successor Series, Episode 2)
title_zh: Richard Sutton - Humanity Never Had Control in the First Place (Worthy Successor Series, Episode 2)
summary_en: Interview on The Trajectory in which Sutton makes the case that humanity never had control of its succession in the first place, one of his fullest statements on AI risk.
summary_zh: The Trajectory 播客访谈，Sutton 论证人类本来就从未掌控过自身的「继承」问题，是他关于人工智能风险最完整的表述之一。

title_en: An Idiosyncrasy of Time-discretization in Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: An Idiosyncrasy of Time-discretization in Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: With Kris De Asis, shows how the assumption of fixed-duration discrete time steps distorts reinforcement learning algorithms applied to physically continuous systems.
summary_zh: 与 Kris De Asis 合作，指出固定时长离散时间步的假设会如何扭曲应用于物理连续系统的强化学习算法。

title_en: Reward Centering
title_zh: Reward Centering
summary_en: With Naik, Wan and Tomar, shows that subtracting the empirical average reward markedly improves discounted methods on continuing problems.
summary_zh: 与 Naik、Wan 和 Tomar 合作，表明减去经验平均回报可显著改善折扣方法在持续性问题上的表现。

title_en: #170 Richard Sutton on Pursuing AGI Through Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: #170 Richard Sutton on Pursuing AGI Through Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Eye on A.I. interview with Craig Smith on pursuing AGI through reinforcement learning rather than scaled supervised models.
summary_zh: Eye on A.I. 播客中与 Craig Smith 的访谈，谈如何通过强化学习而非扩大规模的监督模型来追求通用人工智能。

title_en: MetaOptimize: A Framework for Optimizing Step Sizes and Other Meta-parameters
title_zh: MetaOptimize: A Framework for Optimizing Step Sizes and Other Meta-parameters
summary_en: Paper proposing MetaOptimize, a framework for adapting step sizes and other meta-parameters during training.
summary_zh: 论文提出 MetaOptimize 框架，在训练过程中自适应调整步长等元参数。

title_en: Step-size Optimization for Continual Learning
title_zh: Step-size Optimization for Continual Learning
summary_en: With Degris, Javed, Sharifnassab and Liu, treats the step size itself as something to be learned so a network can keep learning over its whole lifetime.
summary_zh: 与 Degris、Javed、Sharifnassab 和 Liu 合作，将步长本身作为可学习的对象，使网络能够终身持续学习。

title_en: A Note on Stability in Asynchronous Stochastic Approximation without Communication Delays
title_zh: A Note on Stability in Asynchronous Stochastic Approximation without Communication Delays
summary_en: With Huizhen Yu and Yi Wan, gives a stability proof for asynchronous stochastic approximation without communication delays, extending a method of Borkar and Meyn.
summary_zh: 与 Huizhen Yu 和 Yi Wan 合作，给出无通信延迟下异步随机逼近的稳定性证明，推广了 Borkar 与 Meyn 的方法。

title_en: Iterative Option Discovery for Planning, by Planning
title_zh: Iterative Option Discovery for Planning, by Planning
summary_en: With Kenny Young, discovers temporal abstractions (options) by using planning itself as the objective that judges which options are worth having.
summary_zh: 与 Kenny Young 合作，以规划本身作为衡量哪些选项值得拥有的目标，来发现时间抽象（options）。

title_en: Value-aware Importance Weighting for Off-policy Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Value-aware Importance Weighting for Off-policy Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: With De Asis and Graves, reweights off-policy samples according to their effect on value estimates rather than by raw importance ratios.
summary_zh: 与 De Asis 和 Graves 合作，按样本对价值估计的影响来重新加权离策略样本，而非直接使用原始重要性比率。

title_en: Maintaining Plasticity in Deep Continual Learning
title_zh: Maintaining Plasticity in Deep Continual Learning
summary_en: With Dohare, Hernandez-Garcia, Rahman and Mahmood, documents how deep networks lose the ability to learn under continual training and proposes a way to preserve it — the loss-of-plasticity result.
summary_zh: 与 Dohare、Hernandez-Garcia、Rahman 和 Mahmood 合作，记录深度网络在持续训练下丧失学习能力的现象并提出保持可塑性的方法，即「可塑性丧失」结果。

title_en: Toward Efficient Gradient-Based Value Estimation
title_zh: Toward Efficient Gradient-Based Value Estimation
summary_en: With Arsalan Sharifnassab, narrows the speed gap between gradient-based value estimation and TD learning while keeping the stability advantages of the gradient methods.
summary_zh: 与 Arsalan Sharifnassab 合作，在保留梯度方法稳定性优势的同时，缩小其与 TD 学习之间的速度差距。

title_en: Auxiliary task discovery through generate-and-test
title_zh: Auxiliary task discovery through generate-and-test
summary_en: With Rafiee, Ghiassian, Jin, Luo and Adam White, discovers useful auxiliary tasks by generate-and-test rather than hand-design.
summary_zh: 与 Rafiee、Ghiassian、Jin、Luo 和 Adam White 合作，用「生成—测试」的方式自动发现有用的辅助任务，而非人工设计。

title_en: On Convergence of Average-Reward Off-Policy Control Algorithms in Weakly Communicating MDPs
title_zh: On Convergence of Average-Reward Off-Policy Control Algorithms in Weakly Communicating MDPs
summary_en: With Yi Wan, proves that Differential Q-learning and RVI Q-learning converge in weakly communicating MDPs under the average-reward criterion.
summary_zh: 与 Yi Wan 合作，证明 Differential Q-learning 与 RVI Q-learning 在平均回报准则下于弱连通 MDP 中收敛。

title_en: The Alberta Plan for AI Research
title_zh: The Alberta Plan for AI Research
summary_en: With Michael Bowling and Patrick Pilarski, sets out the Alberta Plan — the long-term research agenda for experience-based intelligence that Sutton's group works to.
summary_zh: 与 Michael Bowling 和 Patrick Pilarski 共同提出「Alberta 计划」，即 Sutton 团队所遵循的、以经验为基础通向智能的长期研究纲领。

title_en: Doubly-Asynchronous Value Iteration: Making Value Iteration Asynchronous in Actions
title_zh: Doubly-Asynchronous Value Iteration: Making Value Iteration Asynchronous in Actions
summary_en: With Tian Tian and Kenny Young, makes value iteration asynchronous in actions as well as states, so updates need not sweep every action.
summary_zh: 与 Tian Tian 和 Kenny Young 合作，让值迭代不仅在状态上、也在动作上异步进行，使更新无需遍历每个动作。

title_en: Toward Discovering Options that Achieve Faster Planning
title_zh: Toward Discovering Options that Achieve Faster Planning
summary_en: With Yi Wan, proposes an option-discovery objective that rewards options for making planning computationally faster.
summary_zh: 与 Yi Wan 合作，提出以「让规划在计算上更快」为衡量标准的选项发现目标。

title_en: The Quest for a Common Model of the Intelligent Decision Maker
title_zh: The Quest for a Common Model of the Intelligent Decision Maker
summary_en: Sole-authored essay arguing that psychology, neuroscience, economics and AI are converging on a single common model of the intelligent decision maker.
summary_zh: Sutton 独著的文章，主张心理学、神经科学、经济学与人工智能正汇聚到关于智能决策者的同一个共同模型上。

title_en: A History of Meta-gradient: Gradient Methods for Meta-learning
title_zh: A History of Meta-gradient: Gradient Methods for Meta-learning
summary_en: Sole-authored review of the history of gradient-based meta-learning, focusing on methods that adapt the step size.
summary_zh: Sutton 独著的综述，回顾基于梯度的元学习发展史，重点是自适应调整步长的方法。

title_en: Reward-Respecting Subtasks for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Reward-Respecting Subtasks for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: With Machado, Holland, Szepesvari, Timbers, Tanner and White, defines subtasks that respect the main reward signal so that learned options remain useful for model-based planning.
summary_zh: 与 Machado、Holland、Szepesvari、Timbers、Tanner 和 White 合作，定义尊重主奖励信号的子任务，使学到的选项对基于模型的规划仍然有用。

title_en: The Alberta Plan for AI Research
title_zh: Alberta Plan for AI Research
summary_en: Advocates long-term, curiosity-driven research on agents that learn and improve across an entire lifetime.
summary_zh: 主张以长期、好奇心驱动的方式研究能在整个生命周期中持续学习与改进的智能体。

title_en: AI pioneer Richard Sutton founds new research lab
title_zh: AI pioneer Richard Sutton founds new research lab
summary_en: Sutton founded a new research lab to pursue continually learning agents rather than the LLM paradigm.
summary_zh: Sutton 创办新的研究实验室，主攻持续学习智能体，而非大语言模型路线。

title_en: Turing Award winner Richard Sutton’s new venture is a bet against today’s AI models
title_zh: Turing Award winner Richard Sutton’s new venture is a bet against today’s AI models
summary_en: Sutton left John Carmack's Keen Technologies to found Oak Lab in Toronto with Khurram Javed, a startup built on his bet that today's large models are the wrong foundation for intelligence.
summary_zh: Sutton 离开 John Carmack 的 Keen Technologies，与 Khurram Javed 在多伦多创办 Oak Lab；这家初创公司建立在他的判断之上：当今的大模型不是通向智能的正确基础。

title_en: Tashan Technology Partners with Turing Award Winner Richard Sutton to Launch "Robot Kindergarten" – Advancing Embodied Intelligence from the Imitation Era to the Experience Era
title_zh: Tashan Technology Partners with Turing Award Winner Richard Sutton to Launch "Robot Kindergarten" – Advancing Embodied Intelligence from the Imitation Era to the Experience Era
summary_en: Chinese robotics firm Tashan Technology announced a partnership with Sutton to launch a "Robot Kindergarten" applying his experience-based learning agenda to embodied intelligence.
summary_zh: 中国机器人公司踏山科技宣布与 Sutton 合作推出「机器人幼儿园」，将他以经验为核心的学习理念应用于具身智能。

title_en: AI pioneer Richard Sutton to receive honourary degree from U of A
title_zh: AI pioneer Richard Sutton to receive honourary degree from U of A
summary_en: The University of Alberta, where he has taught since 2003, announced it would award Sutton an honorary degree.
summary_zh: 阿尔伯塔大学宣布将授予 Sutton 荣誉学位，他自 2003 年起在该校任教。

title_en: Baidu Create 2026 — the ERNIE 5.1 rollout
title_zh: Create 2026 百度 AI 开发者大会 —— 文心 5.1 全面推出

title_en: LifeMem: Enabling Lifelong Experience Reuse for LLM Agents
title_zh: LifeMem: Enabling Lifelong Experience Reuse for LLM Agents
summary_en: Co-authored with NLP researchers from Harbin Institute of Technology and Beijing Institute of Technology, this paper proposes a lifelong memory framework letting LLM agents reuse past experience across tasks.
summary_zh: 该论文由王海峰与哈尔滨工业大学、北京理工大学的自然语言处理学者合作完成，提出了一种让LLM智能体在不同任务间复用历史经验的终身记忆框架。

title_en: JarvisGUI: Towards Cross-Device GUI Agents with Dynamic Task Composition
title_zh: JarvisGUI: Towards Cross-Device GUI Agents with Dynamic Task Composition
summary_en: JarvisGUI proposes a framework for cross-device GUI agents that dynamically compose tasks across multiple devices and platforms, with Wang Haifeng as senior author.
summary_zh: JarvisGUI提出了一种跨设备GUI智能体框架，可在多设备、多平台间动态组合任务，王海峰为资深作者之一。

title_en: Enough is as good as a feast: A Comprehensive Analysis of How Reinforcement Learning Mitigates Task Conflicts in LLMs
title_zh: Enough is as good as a feast: A Comprehensive Analysis of How Reinforcement Learning Mitigates Task Conflicts in LLMs
summary_en: An ICLR 2026 paper with his Baidu NLP colleagues analysing why reinforcement learning suffers far less from task conflict than model merging when consolidating specialised LLMs.
summary_zh: 与百度自然语言处理团队合著的 ICLR 2026 论文，分析在整合多个专用大模型时，强化学习为何比模型融合更少出现任务冲突。

title_en: PEC-Home: Interpretation of Progressively Elliptical Commands in Smart Homes
title_zh: PEC-Home: Interpretation of Progressively Elliptical Commands in Smart Homes
summary_en: An ACL 2026 Findings paper he co-authored on getting smart-home assistants to interpret spoken commands that progressively omit information.
summary_zh: 他参与合著的 ACL 2026 Findings 论文，研究智能家居助手如何理解逐渐省略信息的口语指令。

title_en: DocOS: Towards Proactive Document-Guided Actions in GUI Agents
title_zh: DocOS: Towards Proactive Document-Guided Actions in GUI Agents
summary_en: A benchmark he co-authored for GUI agents that must search out and follow online documentation to complete unfamiliar tasks.
summary_zh: 他参与合著的基准测试，考察图形界面智能体在陌生任务中主动检索并遵循在线文档的能力。

title_en: SimReg: Achieving Higher Performance in the Pretraining via Embedding Similarity Regularization
title_zh: SimReg: Achieving Higher Performance in the Pretraining via Embedding Similarity Regularization
summary_en: Work from his PaddlePaddle team on an embedding-similarity regulariser that speeds up LLM pretraining convergence by over 30%.
summary_zh: 来自其飞桨团队的研究，提出嵌入相似度正则化方法，将大模型预训练收敛速度提升三成以上。

title_en: Sparse Growing Transformer: Training-Time Sparse Depth Allocation via Progressive Attention Looping
title_zh: Sparse Growing Transformer: Training-Time Sparse Depth Allocation via Progressive Attention Looping
summary_en: An ERNIE-team paper on allocating Transformer depth sparsely during training through progressive attention looping, rather than by reusing parameters recursively.
summary_zh: 文心团队论文，提出通过渐进式注意力循环在训练阶段稀疏分配 Transformer 深度，而非依赖参数复用的递归执行。

title_en: Emulating Clinician Cognition via Self-Evolving Deep Clinical Research
title_zh: Emulating Clinician Cognition via Self-Evolving Deep Clinical Research
summary_en: A Baidu–Renmin University paper on DxEvolve, a self-evolving clinical diagnosis agent that reaches clinician-comparable accuracy on a reader-study subset.
summary_zh: 百度与中国人民大学合作论文，提出可自我演进的临床诊断智能体 DxEvolve，在阅片研究子集上达到与临床医生相当的准确率。

title_en: Learning to Generate via Understanding: Understanding-Driven Intrinsic Rewarding for Unified Multimodal Models
title_zh: Learning to Generate via Understanding: Understanding-Driven Intrinsic Rewarding for Unified Multimodal Models
summary_en: A CVPR 2026 paper from his group that uses a unified multimodal model's own understanding ability as an intrinsic reward to improve its image generation.
summary_zh: 其团队的 CVPR 2026 论文，将统一多模态模型自身的理解能力作为内在奖励，用以提升图像生成质量。

title_en: Mixture of Universal Experts: Scaling Virtual Width via Depth-Width Transformation
title_zh: Mixture of Universal Experts: Scaling Virtual Width via Depth-Width Transformation
summary_en: An ERNIE-team paper that scales mixture-of-experts capacity by trading network depth for virtual width instead of enlarging physical dimensions.
summary_zh: 文心团队论文，通过深度与宽度的相互转换扩展混合专家模型的虚拟宽度，而非直接增加物理维度。

title_en: Eureka-Audio: Triggering Audio Intelligence in Compact Language Models
title_zh: Eureka-Audio: Triggering Audio Intelligence in Compact Language Models
summary_en: Baidu's compact audio language model, which he co-authored, matching models 4 to 18 times larger across audio understanding benchmarks.
summary_zh: 他参与合著的百度轻量级音频语言模型，在多项音频理解基准上媲美参数量大 4 至 18 倍的模型。

title_en: RRAttention: Dynamic Block Sparse Attention via Per-Head Round-Robin Shifts for Long-Context Inference
title_zh: RRAttention: Dynamic Block Sparse Attention via Per-Head Round-Robin Shifts for Long-Context Inference
summary_en: A PaddlePaddle-team method for long-context inference that shifts sparse attention blocks round-robin across heads to cut the quadratic cost of attention.
summary_zh: 飞桨团队提出的长上下文推理方法，在各注意力头之间以轮转方式移动稀疏注意力块，降低注意力的平方级开销。

title_en: ERNIE 5.0 Technical Report
title_zh: ERNIE 5.0 Technical Report
summary_en: The ERNIE 5.0 technical report, on which he is first author: Baidu's natively autoregressive foundation model unifying understanding and generation across text, image, video and audio.
summary_zh: 文心 5.0 技术报告，他是第一作者：百度原生自回归基础模型，统一文本、图像、视频与音频的理解与生成。

title_en: MEnvAgent: Scalable Polyglot Environment Construction for Verifiable Software Engineering
title_zh: MEnvAgent: Scalable Polyglot Environment Construction for Verifiable Software Engineering
summary_en: An ICML 2026 spotlight paper he co-authored on automatically building executable multi-language environments so software-engineering agents can be verified at scale.
summary_zh: 他参与合著的 ICML 2026 Spotlight 论文，研究自动构建多语言可执行环境，以便大规模验证软件工程智能体。

title_en: OmegaUse: Building a General-Purpose GUI Agent for Autonomous Task Execution
title_zh: OmegaUse: Building a General-Purpose GUI Agent for Autonomous Task Execution
summary_en: Baidu's general-purpose GUI agent for mobile and desktop, co-authored by him, reporting 96.3% on ScreenSpot-V2 and a 79.1% step success rate on AndroidControl.
summary_zh: 他参与合著的百度通用图形界面智能体，覆盖手机与桌面平台，在 ScreenSpot-V2 上取得 96.3%，在 AndroidControl 上步骤成功率达 79.1%。

title_en: CORD: Bridging the Audio-Text Reasoning Gap via Weighted On-policy Cross-modal Distillation
title_zh: CORD: Bridging the Audio-Text Reasoning Gap via Weighted On-policy Cross-modal Distillation
summary_en: Baidu paper with Wang as senior author proposing weighted on-policy cross-modal distillation to close the audio-text reasoning gap in audio language models.
summary_zh: 百度论文（王海峰为末位/资深作者），提出加权同策略跨模态蒸馏方法，缩小音频语言模型中语音与文本之间的推理差距。

title_en: Distributional Clarity: The Hidden Driver of RL-Friendliness in Large Language Models
title_zh: Distributional Clarity: The Hidden Driver of RL-Friendliness in Large Language Models
summary_en: A Baidu paper identifying distributional clarity as the property that explains why some model families gain far more from reinforcement learning than others.
summary_zh: 百度论文提出以分布清晰度这一性质，解释为何部分模型族能从强化学习中获得远超其他模型的收益。

title_en: VideoAR: Autoregressive Video Generation via Next-Frame & Scale Prediction
title_zh: VideoAR: Autoregressive Video Generation via Next-Frame & Scale Prediction
summary_en: An ERNIE-team autoregressive video generator that predicts the next frame and the next scale instead of relying on diffusion or flow matching.
summary_zh: 文心团队提出的自回归视频生成模型，以预测下一帧与下一尺度替代扩散或流匹配式生成。

title_en: 631.【BAT播报】对话百度AIG总负责人王海峰：AI时代会产生新巨头
title_zh: 631.【BAT播报】对话百度AIG总负责人王海峰：AI时代会产生新巨头
summary_en: Wang Haifeng, head of Baidu's AI Group, discusses in an interview why the AI era will produce new industry giants.
summary_zh: 百度AIG总负责人王海峰在访谈中谈AI时代将如何催生新的行业巨头。

title_en: ERNIE 5.1 becomes the first Chinese LLM in the global Search Arena top 5
title_zh: ERNIE 5.1 成为首个进入全球 Search Arena 前五的中国大模型
summary_en: Debuted at #4 on the LMArena Search Arena leaderboard with 1,223, behind only two Claude Opus variants and GPT-5.5 Search. A MoE with roughly a third of ERNIE 5.0's total parameters, trained at about 6% of comparable frontier compute cost.
summary_zh: 以 1223 分位列 LMArena Search Arena 全球第 4，仅次于两个 Claude Opus 版本与 GPT-5.5 Search。MoE 架构，总参数约为 ERNIE 5.0 的三分之一，训练算力成本约为同级前沿模型的 6%。

title_en: ERNIE 5.0 released — 2.4T parameters, native full-modality
title_zh: 文心 5.0 发布 —— 2.4 万亿参数，原生全模态
summary_en: Native full-modality unified modelling across text, image, audio and video.
summary_zh: 原生全模态统一建模，覆盖文本、图像、音频与视频。

title_en: 李彦宏卸任百度投资董事 马东敏、王海峰成为新任董事
title_zh: 李彦宏卸任百度投资董事 马东敏、王海峰成为新任董事
summary_en: Wang was appointed a director of Baidu's investment arm as Robin Li stepped off that board.
summary_zh: 李彦宏卸任百度投资董事，王海峰出任该公司新任董事。

title_en: Zero-shot text-to-image generation (DALL·E)
title_zh: 零样本文本到图像生成（DALL·E）
summary_en: The paper that started the commercial wave in visual generation.
summary_zh: 引发视觉生成商业化浪潮的论文。

title_en: Hierarchical text-conditional image generation with CLIP latents (DALL·E 2)
title_zh: 基于 CLIP 潜变量的层次化文本条件图像生成（DALL·E 2）

title_en: GPT-4o System Card
title_zh: GPT-4o System Card
summary_en: OpenAI's system card for GPT-4o, the omni model taking text, audio, image and video input; Ramesh is among the contributing authors.
summary_zh: OpenAI 发布的 GPT-4o 系统卡，介绍这一可接受文本、音频、图像和视频输入的全模态模型；Ramesh 是署名作者之一。

title_en: GPT-4 Technical Report
title_zh: GPT-4 Technical Report
summary_en: The GPT-4 technical report, documenting OpenAI's multimodal model that accepts image and text input; Ramesh is one of the contributing authors.
summary_zh: GPT-4 技术报告，记录了 OpenAI 这一可接受图像与文本输入的多模态模型；Ramesh 是参与作者之一。

title_en: DALL-E-2, the Future of Creative Work "Creative Co-Pilot" - with OpenAI's Aditya Ramesh
title_zh: DALL-E-2, the Future of Creative Work "Creative Co-Pilot" - with OpenAI's Aditya Ramesh
summary_en: A podcast interview in which Ramesh explains DALL·E 2 and how text-to-image models change creative work.
summary_zh: 一期播客访谈，Ramesh 讲解 DALL·E 2 以及文生图模型如何改变创意工作。

title_en: Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation with CLIP Latents
title_zh: Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation with CLIP Latents
summary_en: The DALL·E 2 paper, first-authored by Ramesh: a two-stage model that generates images from CLIP text embeddings via a prior plus a diffusion decoder.
summary_zh: DALL·E 2 论文，由 Ramesh 担任第一作者：提出先验模型加扩散解码器的两阶段架构，从 CLIP 文本嵌入生成图像。

title_en: GLIDE: Towards Photorealistic Image Generation and Editing with Text-Guided Diffusion Models
title_zh: GLIDE: Towards Photorealistic Image Generation and Editing with Text-Guided Diffusion Models

title_en: 1,000 days left until the "Final Collapse" | Emad Mostaque
title_zh: 1,000 days left until the "Final Collapse" | Emad Mostaque
summary_en: Interview laying out his "intelligence inversion" thesis and the economic disruption he expects to follow.

title_en: Emad Mostaque on The Last Economy: 1000 Days to Reimagine Work, Value & Human Purpose
title_zh: Emad Mostaque on The Last Economy: 1000 Days to Reimagine Work, Value & Human Purpose
summary_en: Interview on his book The Last Economy and the "intelligence theory" framework he uses to rethink economics under abundant AI.
summary_zh: 访谈他的著作《The Last Economy》，以及他用来在人工智能充裕时代重新思考经济学的「智能理论」框架。

title_en: Emad Mostaque: The Plan to Save Humanity From AI | EP #184
title_zh: Emad Mostaque: The Plan to Save Humanity From AI | EP #184
summary_en: Panel appearance setting out his proposal for open, publicly governed AI as a hedge against concentrated model control.
summary_zh: 在圆桌节目中提出他的主张：以开放、由公众治理的人工智能来对冲模型控制权的集中。

title_en: Emad Mostaque: AGI, AI Agents & the Future of Work (Round 3)
title_zh: Emad Mostaque: AGI, AI Agents & the Future of Work (Round 3)
summary_en: Third appearance on Raoul Pal's show, on AGI timelines, AI agents and what they do to the nature of work.
summary_zh: 第三次做客 Raoul Pal 的节目，谈通用人工智能的时间表、AI 智能体以及它们对工作性质的改变。

title_en: EP #16 AI is Creating Massive Entrepreneurial Opportunity w/ Emad Mostaque
title_zh: EP #16 AI is Creating Massive Entrepreneurial Opportunity w/ Emad Mostaque
summary_en: Early interview from his Stability AI period on AI-generated content, property rights and the disruption he saw coming.
summary_zh: 他在 Stability AI 时期的早期访谈，谈人工智能生成内容、财产权以及他当时预见的行业颠覆。

title_en: Emad Mostaque Says Human Ideas Now Add 'Negative Value' as AI Model Releases Accelerate
title_zh: Emad Mostaque Says Human Ideas Now Add 'Negative Value' as AI Model Releases Accelerate
summary_en: Mostaque argued that as AI model releases accelerate, purely human-generated ideas are now adding "negative value."
summary_zh: Mostaque认为随着AI模型发布速度加快，纯粹由人类产生的想法现在正在带来"负价值"。

title_en: India Stack should become an ‘Intelligence Stack’, says Stability AI co-founder Emad Mostaque
title_zh: India Stack should become an ‘Intelligence Stack’, says Stability AI co-founder Emad Mostaque
summary_en: He proposes that India turn India Stack into an 'intelligence stack' giving every citizen an AI agent, his clearest public pitch yet for national open AI infrastructure.
summary_zh: 他提议印度把India Stack升级为“智能栈”，让每位公民都拥有自己的AI智能体，这是他迄今对国家级开放AI基础设施最明确的公开主张。

title_en: Emad Mostaque: AI agents will go mainstream this year, reducing friction to boost profitability, and the future of AI lies beyond transformers | Raoul Pal
title_zh: Emad Mostaque: AI agents will go mainstream this year, reducing friction to boost profitability, and the future of AI lies beyond transformers | Raoul Pal
summary_en: Mostaque predicted AI agents will go mainstream this year, cutting friction and boosting profitability, and argued the field's future lies beyond transformer architectures.
summary_zh: Mostaque预测AI智能体今年将进入主流，降低摩擦并提升盈利能力，并认为该领域的未来将超越Transformer架构。

title_en: GenCeption: large-scale text-to-video generation as a pre-training paradigm for vision
title_zh: GenCeption：大规模文本到视频生成作为视觉预训练范式
summary_en: Uses a pre-trained video diffusion backbone to define a feed-forward perception model steered by text instructions.
summary_zh: 以预训练视频扩散骨干定义一个由文本指令引导的前馈感知模型。

title_en: GeoPT: teaching models the basics of physics
title_zh: GeoPT：让模型掌握物理基础
summary_en: So they can simulate how objects respond to wind and water more efficiently and accurately.
summary_zh: 以便更高效准确地模拟物体对风与水的响应。

title_en: Video Generation Models are General-Purpose Vision Learners
title_zh: Video Generation Models are General-Purpose Vision Learners
summary_en: Argues video generation models can serve as general-purpose vision learners, continuing his line on generation as representation learning.
summary_zh: 论证视频生成模型可以作为通用视觉学习器，延续他“生成即表征学习”的研究主线。

title_en: ELF: Embedded Language Flows
title_zh: ELF: Embedded Language Flows
summary_en: ELF (Embedded Language Flows) applies flow-based generative modeling to language, a result widely picked up by Chinese labs building continuous diffusion language models.
summary_zh: ELF 把流式生成建模用于语言，引发国内多家团队跟进连续扩散语言模型。

title_en: Image Generators are Generalist Vision Learners
title_zh: Image Generators are Generalist Vision Learners
summary_en: Shows image generators exhibit generalist visual understanding, a Google-MIT collaboration he co-authored.
summary_zh: 一项谷歌与 MIT 的合作研究，表明图像生成模型本身具备通用视觉理解能力。

title_en: GeoPT: Scaling Physics Simulation via Lifted Geometric Pre-Training
title_zh: GeoPT: Scaling Physics Simulation via Lifted Geometric Pre-Training
summary_en: GeoPT pre-trains neural physics simulators on cheap geometry data to sidestep the cost of high-fidelity simulation data.
summary_zh: GeoPT 用低成本几何数据预训练神经物理仿真器，绕开高精度仿真数据昂贵的问题。

title_en: Generative Modeling via Drifting
title_zh: Generative Modeling via Drifting
summary_en: Reformulates generative modeling as an iterative drifting process toward the data distribution.
summary_zh: 把生成建模重新表述为向数据分布逐步漂移的迭代过程。

title_en: One-step Latent-free Image Generation with Pixel Mean Flows
title_zh: One-step Latent-free Image Generation with Pixel Mean Flows
summary_en: One-step image generation directly in pixel space without a latent VAE, reaching strong text-to-image quality at small model size.
summary_zh: 在像素空间直接做一步生成、无需隐空间 VAE，用很小的参数量达到不错的文生图效果。

title_en: Natural Image Pretraining Improves Abstract Reasoning
title_zh: Natural Image Pretraining Improves Abstract Reasoning
summary_en: He is senior author on a paper (confirmed via OpenAlex, MIT affiliation) showing that pretraining on natural images improves models' abstract visual reasoning.
summary_zh: 经OpenAlex核实作者及MIT单位信息，何恺明是这篇论文的通讯作者，该研究证明在自然图像上进行预训练可以提升模型的抽象视觉推理能力。

title_en: Bidirectional Normalizing Flow: From Data to Noise and Back
title_zh: Bidirectional Normalizing Flow: From Data to Noise and Back
summary_en: A normalizing flow formulation in which forward and reverse processes are learned bidirectionally.
summary_zh: 提出双向归一化流，让数据到噪声与噪声到数据的过程同时被学习。

title_en: Improved Mean Flows: On the Challenges of Fastforward Generative Models
title_zh: Improved Mean Flows: On the Challenges of Fastforward Generative Models
summary_en: A follow-up that fixes training-objective and guidance problems in his MeanFlow one-step generative framework.
summary_zh: 对其 MeanFlow 一步生成框架的改进，修正了训练目标与引导机制上的问题。

title_en: ARC Is a Vision Problem!
title_zh: ARC Is a Vision Problem!
summary_en: Recasts the ARC abstract-reasoning benchmark as a vision problem rather than a language one.
summary_zh: 把 ARC 抽象推理基准重新定义为视觉问题，而非语言问题。

title_en: Back to Basics: Let Denoising Generative Models Denoise
title_zh: Back to Basics: Let Denoising Generative Models Denoise
summary_en: Argues denoising generative models should predict clean images directly, enabling generation in pixel space without a latent tokenizer.
summary_zh: 主张去噪生成模型应直接预测干净图像，从而可以在像素空间生成、无需隐空间分词器。

title_en: Diffuse and Disperse: Image Generation with Representation Regularization
title_zh: Diffuse and Disperse: Image Generation with Representation Regularization
summary_en: Introduces a dispersive representation regularizer that improves diffusion generation without extra representation-learning machinery.
summary_zh: 提出 Dispersive 表征正则项，无需额外表征学习模块即可提升扩散生成质量。

title_en: Mean Flows for One-step Generative Modeling
title_zh: Mean Flows for One-step Generative Modeling
summary_en: MeanFlow, his one-step generative modeling framework based on average rather than instantaneous velocity; widely adopted afterwards.
summary_zh: MeanFlow：以平均速度而非瞬时速度刻画流场的一步生成框架，此后被广泛采用。

title_en: Transformers without Normalization
title_zh: Transformers without Normalization
summary_en: Shows Transformers can drop normalization layers entirely by replacing them with a dynamic tanh, co-authored with Yann LeCun.
summary_zh: 与 Yann LeCun 等合作，证明用 Dynamic Tanh 替代归一化层后 Transformer 依然能达到同等甚至更好性能。

title_en: Denoising Hamiltonian Network for Physical Reasoning
title_zh: Denoising Hamiltonian Network for Physical Reasoning
summary_en: A denoising Hamiltonian network that builds physical structure into learned dynamics, part of his MIT physics collaborations.
summary_zh: 提出去噪哈密顿网络，把物理结构嵌入学习到的动力学中，属于他在 MIT 的物理方向合作。

title_en: Fractal Generative Models
title_zh: Fractal Generative Models
summary_en: Fractal Generative Models: generative models built recursively out of generative modules as atomic units.
summary_zh: 分形生成模型：把生成模块作为原子单元递归组合，构建新的生成模型范式。

title_en: Is Noise Conditioning Necessary for Denoising Generative Models?
title_zh: Is Noise Conditioning Necessary for Denoising Generative Models?
summary_en: Challenges the assumption that noise conditioning is required for denoising diffusion models to work.
summary_zh: 挑战“去噪扩散模型必须依赖噪声条件输入”这一普遍认知。

title_en: Fluid: Scaling Autoregressive Text-to-image Generative Models with Continuous Tokens
title_zh: Fluid: Scaling Autoregressive Text-to-image Generative Models with Continuous Tokens
summary_en: Fluid scales autoregressive text-to-image models using continuous rather than discrete tokens.
summary_zh: Fluid 用连续 token 替代离散 token，研究自回归文生图模型的扩展规律。

title_en: Scaling Proprioceptive-Visual Learning with Heterogeneous Pre-trained Transformers
title_zh: Scaling Proprioceptive-Visual Learning with Heterogeneous Pre-trained Transformers
summary_en: Heterogeneous Pre-trained Transformers, a robot-learning approach that trains across different embodiments and sensors.
summary_zh: 异构预训练 Transformer：一种跨不同机器人本体与传感器统一训练的机器人学习方法。

title_en: Autoregressive Image Generation without Vector Quantization
title_zh: Autoregressive Image Generation without Vector Quantization
summary_en: MAR shows autoregressive image generation works without vector quantization, using continuous-valued tokens.
summary_zh: MAR 证明自回归图像生成无需向量量化，用连续值 token 同样可行。

title_en: Physically Compatible 3D Object Modeling from a Single Image
title_zh: Physically Compatible 3D Object Modeling from a Single Image
summary_en: Reconstructs 3D objects from a single image under physical compatibility constraints, an MIT collaboration.
summary_zh: MIT 合作工作：在物理可行性约束下从单张图像重建可制造的三维物体。

title_en: TetSphere Splatting: Representing High-Quality Geometry with Lagrangian Volumetric Meshes
title_zh: TetSphere Splatting: Representing High-Quality Geometry with Lagrangian Volumetric Meshes
summary_en: TetSphere Splatting, a Lagrangian volumetric-mesh representation for high-quality 3D geometry.
summary_zh: TetSphere Splatting：用拉格朗日体网格表示高质量三维几何。

title_en: Dynamic Inhomogeneous Quantum Resource Scheduling with Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Dynamic Inhomogeneous Quantum Resource Scheduling with Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: An unusual cross-domain collaboration with MIT's quantum photonics group applying reinforcement learning to real-time quantum resource scheduling.
summary_zh: 与 MIT 量子光子学团队的跨领域合作，用强化学习做量子资源的实时调度。

title_en: A Decade's Battle on Dataset Bias: Are We There Yet?
title_zh: A Decade's Battle on Dataset Bias: Are We There Yet?
summary_en: Revisits the classic dataset-bias experiment and finds modern networks still classify which dataset an image came from.
summary_zh: 重做经典的数据集偏差实验，发现现代网络依然能轻易分辨图像来自哪个数据集。

title_en: Deconstructing Denoising Diffusion Models for Self-Supervised Learning
title_zh: Deconstructing Denoising Diffusion Models for Self-Supervised Learning
summary_en: Deconstructs denoising diffusion models step by step to isolate what actually gives them self-supervised representation ability.
summary_zh: 逐步拆解去噪扩散模型，找出它们自监督表征能力的真正来源。

title_en: Return of Unconditional Generation: A Self-supervised Representation Generation Method
title_zh: Return of Unconditional Generation: A Self-supervised Representation Generation Method
summary_en: Revives unconditional generation by first generating self-supervised representations, then images conditioned on them.
summary_zh: 先生成自监督表征、再据此生成图像，让无条件生成重新变得可行。

title_en: Receives the CVPR Test of Time Award (Longuet-Higgins Prize)
title_zh: 获 CVPR Test of Time 奖（Longuet-Higgins 奖）

title_en: 视觉版「下一个token预测」找到了？何恺明等押注视频生成
title_zh: 视觉版「下一个token预测」找到了？何恺明等押注视频生成
summary_en: Coverage of Kaiming He and collaborators betting on video generation as the vision-domain analogue of next-token prediction.
summary_zh: 报道称何恺明与合作者押注视频生成，将其作为视觉领域的「下一个token预测」路线。

title_en: 沿着何恺明团队「漂移模型」再走一步：奖励只需排名，单步文生图偏好优化提速3.51倍
title_zh: 沿着何恺明团队「漂移模型」再走一步：奖励只需排名，单步文生图偏好优化提速3.51倍
summary_en: Kaiming He's team extended their 'drift model' work, showing rank-only reward preference optimization that speeds up single-step text-to-image generation by 3.51x.
summary_zh: 何恺明团队在其"漂移模型"研究基础上再进一步，提出仅需排名的奖励机制进行偏好优化，使单步文生图速度提升3.51倍。

title_en: 刚刚，何恺明ResNet、YOLO获时间检验奖！CVPR 2026奖项出炉
title_zh: 刚刚，何恺明ResNet、YOLO获时间检验奖！CVPR 2026奖项出炉
summary_en: ResNet won the CVPR 2026 Longuet-Higgins Test of Time award, formal recognition of the paper that made very deep networks trainable.
summary_zh: ResNet 获得 CVPR 2026 时间检验奖，这是对这篇让极深网络得以训练的论文的正式认可。

title_en: 今年CVPR看点是广东：何恺明再获至高大奖，广工大打破大厂名校垄断
title_zh: 今年CVPR看点是广东：何恺明再获至高大奖，广工大打破大厂名校垄断
summary_en: Kaiming He won a top award at CVPR 2026, extending his run of major recognitions in computer vision.
summary_zh: 何恺明在2026年CVPR上再次获得顶级奖项，延续了他在计算机视觉领域屡获重大认可的纪录。

title_en: 刚刚，何恺明ResNet、YOLO获时间检验奖！CVPR 2026奖项出炉
title_zh: 刚刚，何恺明ResNet、YOLO获时间检验奖！CVPR 2026奖项出炉
summary_en: He Kaiming's ResNet and the YOLO line won CVPR 2026's Test of Time award, recognizing their lasting influence on computer vision.
summary_zh: 何恺明的ResNet与YOLO系列获得CVPR 2026时间检验奖，肯定其对计算机视觉领域的持久影响。

title_en: 字节会师何恺明！开源连续扩散语言模型Cola DLM
title_zh: 字节会师何恺明！开源连续扩散语言模型Cola DLM
summary_en: Kaiming He collaborated with a ByteDance team on Cola DLM, an open-sourced continuous diffusion language model.
summary_zh: 何恺明与字节跳动团队合作，开源了连续扩散语言模型Cola DLM。

title_en: 刚刚，何恺明团队新作，「嵌入式语言流」ELF来了

title_en: 王坚院士：AI不该只吃人类嚼过的东西
title_zh: 王坚院士：AI不该只吃人类嚼过的东西

summary_zh: 王坚指出，AI训练不应只依赖人类已经“嚼过”的数据。

title_en: 王坚做“太空算力”的出发点：从“数据下不来”到“算力送上去”
title_zh: 王坚做“太空算力”的出发点：从“数据下不来”到“算力送上去”
summary_en: Wang explained the rationale behind Zhejiang Lab's 'compute in space' push: since data can't easily come down, send the computing power up instead.
summary_zh: 王坚阐述了浙江实验室推进“太空算力”的出发点：既然数据难以传下来，不如把算力送上去。

title_en: 王坚院士：“科学基础模型”，要去“吃”人类从来没有“吃”过的东西
title_zh: 王坚院士：“科学基础模型”，要去“吃”人类从来没有“吃”过的东西
summary_en: Wang Jian argued that 'scientific foundation models' need to consume data humans have never processed before, laying out his view of where foundation models should head next.
summary_zh: 王坚提出“科学基础模型”需要去处理人类从未处理过的数据，阐述了他对基础模型未来发展方向的看法。

title_en: 王坚：把算力送上太空，让每个年轻人都能成为创造者
title_zh: 王坚：把算力送上太空，让每个年轻人都能成为创造者
summary_en: Wang Jian spoke about sending compute into space so every young person can become a creator, tying into Zhejiang Lab's satellite-compute constellation project.
summary_zh: 王坚谈到把算力送上太空、让每个年轻人都能成为创造者，这与浙江实验室的卫星算力星座项目相关。

title_en: 之江实验室主任王坚：把AI送进太空 2032年完成1000颗星组网

summary_zh: 王坚提出之江实验室把 AI 算力送入太空的计划，目标 2032 年完成 1000 颗卫星组网。

summary_en: Wang Jian argued that China's open-source AI models, built on principles of shared development, are benefiting countries across the Global South.
summary_zh: 王坚表示，中国秉持共商共建共享原则的开源AI模型正在惠及全球南方国家。

title_en: WAIC现场王坚预判：AI范式变革，不在语言而在科学数据
title_zh: WAIC现场王坚预判：AI范式变革，不在语言而在科学数据
summary_en: At WAIC, Wang Jian predicted that the next AI paradigm shift will come not from language but from scientific data.
summary_zh: 王坚在世界人工智能大会（WAIC）上预判，下一轮AI范式变革的关键不在语言，而在科学数据。

title_en: 中国工程院院士、阿里云创始人王坚：AI的下一场革命，关键在“科学数据”
title_zh: 中国工程院院士、阿里云创始人王坚：AI的下一场革命，关键在“科学数据”
summary_en: CAE academician and Alibaba Cloud founder Wang Jian said the next AI revolution hinges on 'scientific data,' a public position on where AI progress should come from next.
summary_zh: 中国工程院院士、阿里云创始人王坚表示AI的下一场革命关键在于“科学数据”，就AI下一步进展的方向表明立场。

summary_en: CAE academician Wang Jian said AI has become the most important public technology good, framing it as shared infrastructure rather than a proprietary product.

summary_zh: 王坚获聘为中国（杭州）人工智能小镇名誉镇长。

title_en: Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML)
title_zh: 模型无关的元学习（MAML）
summary_en: The method that let a policy generalise from very little data.
summary_zh: 让策略可以从极少数据中泛化的方法。

title_en: Stanford IRIS Lab — robot learning research
title_zh: 斯坦福 IRIS 实验室 —— 机器人学习研究

title_en: RL for dynamic tasks requires handling latency. Building on EXPO-FT, we let the base VLA operate on older images while a small edit policy operates in real time
title_zh: RL for dynamic tasks requires handling latency. Building on EXPO-FT, we let the base VLA operate on older images while a small edit policy operates in real time
summary_en: Finn describes new work building on EXPO-FT that lets a VLA operate on stale image frames while a lightweight real-time edit policy compensates for latency, outperforming RTC on dynamic RL tasks.
summary_zh: Finn介绍了基于EXPO-FT的新工作：让VLA基础模型在稍旧的图像帧上运行，同时由一个轻量级实时编辑策略进行延迟补偿，在动态RL任务上的表现超过了RTC。

title_en: New blog post with @perryadong on what we need for robots to be broadly useful in the real world. https://t.co/jxsNeMUhFg Reliability is the one of the biggest
title_zh: New blog post with @perryadong on what we need for robots to be broadly useful in the real world. https://t.co/jxsNeMUhFg Reliability is the one of the biggest
summary_en: Finn announces a new blog post co-authored with Physical Intelligence's Perry Dong arguing that reliability is one of the biggest open challenges to making robot policies broadly useful in the real world.
summary_zh: Finn宣布与Physical Intelligence的Perry Dong合作发表新博文，指出可靠性是让机器人策略在真实世界中广泛可用所面临的最大公开挑战之一。

title_en: A video from a Pi robot deployed at Dandelion Chocolate, fully autonomous w/ no interventions. 🤖 Deploying robots has taught us surprising lessons about the gap
title_zh: A video from a Pi robot deployed at Dandelion Chocolate, fully autonomous w/ no interventions. 🤖 Deploying robots has taught us surprising lessons about the gap
summary_en: A Physical Intelligence Pi robot completed a fully autonomous shift at Dandelion Chocolate with no human interventions, and Finn discusses what the deployment revealed about the gap between demos and real-world robot autonomy.
summary_zh: Physical Intelligence的Pi机器人在Dandelion Chocolate完成了全程无人工干预的自主作业，Finn分享了这次落地暴露出的演示与真实世界机器人自主性之间的差距。

title_en: WHALE: A Simple Recipe for Joint Harness-Weight Optimization
title_zh: WHALE: A Simple Recipe for Joint Harness-Weight Optimization
summary_en: Co-authors WHALE, a method that jointly optimizes an agent's model weights and its executable harness code, outperforming approaches that tune either one alone.
summary_zh: 合著WHALE方法论文，联合优化智能体的模型权重与可执行框架代码，效果优于仅优化其中一项的方案。

title_en: One of the most important aspects of scientific discovery is deciding where to draw insights from. While LLMs are promising tools for science, we lack datasets
title_zh: One of the most important aspects of scientific discovery is deciding where to draw insights from. While LLMs are promising tools for science, we lack datasets
summary_en: Calls for datasets and evaluations on how LLMs can draw scientific insight from prior research, an under-studied step in AI-assisted discovery.
summary_zh: 呼吁建设数据集与评测方法，用于研究大语言模型如何从已有文献中提炼科学洞见——这是人工智能辅助科学发现中尚未被充分研究的一环。

title_en: Q-Learning With World Models
title_zh: Q-Learning With World Models
summary_en: Paper with Perry Dong, Yueru Jia and Dorsa Sadigh combining off-policy Q-learning with learned world models, so a robot policy can be trained from fewer interactions.
summary_zh: 与 Perry Dong、Yueru Jia、Dorsa Sadigh 合著的论文，将离策略 Q 学习与学到的世界模型结合，使机器人策略可以用更少的交互数据训练出来。

title_en: Pre-training Visual Dexterity in Simulation
title_zh: Pre-training Visual Dexterity in Simulation
summary_en: Pre-trains dexterous multi-finger manipulation in simulation, moving robot pre-training beyond the simple parallel-jaw grippers most datasets assume.
summary_zh: 在仿真中预训练多指灵巧操作，让机器人预训练摆脱大多数数据集所假设的简单二指夹爪。

title_en: Chelsea Finn: This is the State of the Art in Robotics
title_zh: Chelsea Finn: This is the State of the Art in Robotics
summary_en: Finn on the Y Combinator podcast on the state of robotics, and why reliability over long horizons — not capability demos — is the hard problem.
summary_zh: Finn 做客 Y Combinator 播客，谈机器人技术现状，以及为何真正的难题是长时间任务的可靠性而非能力演示。

title_en: SpeedTuning: Speeding Up Policy Execution with Lightweight Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: SpeedTuning: Speeding Up Policy Execution with Lightweight Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Uses lightweight reinforcement learning to speed up execution of imitation-learned robot policies, which tend to inherit slow human demonstration speeds.
summary_zh: 用轻量级强化学习加快模仿学习机器人策略的执行速度，这类策略往往继承了人类演示的缓慢节奏。

title_en: Pretraining a Q-function often doesn’t actually help RL finetuning, compared to initializing Q from scratch. We find that pretraining Q-functions on data from d
title_zh: Pretraining a Q-function often doesn’t actually help RL finetuning, compared to initializing Q from scratch. We find that pretraining Q-functions on data from d
summary_en: Finds that pretraining Q-functions rarely helps RL finetuning unless the pretraining data comes from a diverse set of policies.
summary_zh: 研究发现，预训练 Q 函数通常无助于强化学习微调，除非预训练数据来自多样化的策略集合。

title_en: Do You Really Need to Pretrain Q-Functions for Online RL Fine-Tuning?
title_zh: Do You Really Need to Pretrain Q-Functions for Online RL Fine-Tuning?
summary_en: Questions whether Q-functions need pre-training at all before online RL fine-tuning of a pretrained policy.
summary_zh: 质疑在对预训练策略进行在线强化学习微调之前，是否真有必要预训练 Q 函数。

title_en: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
title_zh: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
summary_en: Finn co-authored PolaRiS, a scalable real-to-sim evaluation framework for testing generalist robot policies, presented at RSS 2026.
summary_zh: Finn合著了PolaRiS，一个用于评测通用机器人策略的可扩展“真实到仿真”评估框架，发表于RSS 2026。

title_en: Emergence of Human to Robot Transfer in Vision-Language-Action Models
title_zh: Emergence of Human to Robot Transfer in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary_en: Finn co-authored a study on how vision-language-action models can transfer skills learned from human video to robot execution.
summary_zh: Finn合著了一项研究，探讨视觉-语言-动作模型如何将从人类视频中学到的技能迁移到机器人执行中。

title_en: LLM-as-a-Verifier: A General-Purpose Verification Framework
title_zh: LLM-as-a-Verifier: A General-Purpose Verification Framework
summary_en: Proposes a general-purpose framework for using language models as verifiers, treating verification as the third scaling axis alongside training and test-time compute.
summary_zh: 提出以语言模型作为验证器的通用框架，将验证视为与训练和推理算力并列的第三条扩展轴。

title_en: We’ve been approaching reward supervision for robots the wrong way. I think freeform preferences are part of the answer. A short 🧵 https://t.co/9DZbaf1mNX
title_zh: We’ve been approaching reward supervision for robots the wrong way. I think freeform preferences are part of the answer. A short 🧵 https://t.co/9DZbaf1mNX
summary_en: Argues the field has been approaching reward supervision for robots the wrong way, and makes the case for freeform preference feedback instead.
summary_zh: 她提出，机器人领域一直以错误的方式处理奖励监督问题，并主张改用自由形式的偏好反馈。

title_en: Freeform Preference Learning for Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: Freeform Preference Learning for Robotic Manipulation
summary_en: Learns robot manipulation rewards from freeform human preference feedback, addressing the sparse-signal problem in long-horizon tasks.
summary_zh: 从自由形式的人类偏好反馈中学习机器人操作的奖励，缓解长时程任务中信号稀疏的问题。

title_en: LLM RL optimizes for sequential reasoning We also optimize over the reasoning strategy, incl parallel trains of thought, aggregation of parallel traces, & seque
title_zh: LLM RL optimizes for sequential reasoning We also optimize over the reasoning strategy, incl parallel trains of thought, aggregation of parallel traces, & seque
summary_en: Presents LLM RL that optimizes the reasoning strategy itself — parallel trains of thought, aggregation, and sequencing — not just sequential reasoning.
summary_zh: 提出一种大语言模型强化学习方法，不仅优化顺序推理，还优化推理策略本身，包括并行思维链、聚合与排序。

title_en: Can we translate a rough sense for what to do + VLA prior into successful behavior? Flow reversal steering: 1) runs the VLA's flow ODE backwards to back out noi
title_zh: Can we translate a rough sense for what to do + VLA prior into successful behavior? Flow reversal steering: 1) runs the VLA's flow ODE backwards to back out noi
summary_en: Introduces flow reversal steering, which runs a VLA's flow ODE backward to recover the noise closest to a coarse target trajectory.
summary_zh: 提出「流反转引导」方法，通过反向运行视觉-语言-动作模型的流常微分方程，反推出最接近粗略目标轨迹的噪声。

title_en: SPIRAL: Learning to Search and Aggregate
title_zh: SPIRAL: Learning to Search and Aggregate
summary_en: SPIRAL learns to allocate test-time compute across search and aggregation rather than relying on a fixed reasoning scaffold.
summary_zh: SPIRAL 学习在搜索与聚合之间分配推理时算力，而不是依赖固定的推理脚手架。

title_en: How does test-time scaling impact robots? We find that larger models, more thinking, and more context help significantly for some prompts but not others. Like L
title_zh: How does test-time scaling impact robots? We find that larger models, more thinking, and more context help significantly for some prompts but not others. Like L
summary_en: Finds test-time scaling — larger models, more thinking, more context — helps robot policies on some prompts but not others, motivating a learned router.
summary_zh: 研究发现测试时扩展（更大模型、更多思考、更长上下文）在部分提示下能提升机器人策略表现，但并非对所有提示都有效，因而提出训练一个路由器来自动选择。

title_en: Can robot foundation models collaborate with themself? We finetune a VLA to be able to control any robot in a team. - matches or outperforms training separate m
title_zh: Can robot foundation models collaborate with themself? We finetune a VLA to be able to control any robot in a team. - matches or outperforms training separate m
summary_en: Finetunes a single VLA so it can control any robot in a team, matching or beating separately trained or centralized models.
summary_zh: 对单一视觉-语言-动作模型进行微调，使其能够控制团队中的任意机器人，效果可媲美甚至超过分别训练或集中式训练的模型。

title_en: Improving Robotic Generalist Policies via Flow Reversal Steering
title_zh: Improving Robotic Generalist Policies via Flow Reversal Steering
summary_en: Steers generalist robot policies toward new tasks by reversing the flow of a pretrained policy instead of retraining it.
summary_zh: 通过反转预训练策略的流向来引导通用机器人策略完成新任务，而无需重新训练。

title_en: DIRECT: When and Where Should You Allocate Test-Time Compute in Embodied Planners?
title_zh: DIRECT: When and Where Should You Allocate Test-Time Compute in Embodied Planners?
summary_en: Studies when and where extra test-time compute actually helps vision-language models acting as high-level planners for embodied agents.
summary_zh: 研究当视觉语言模型充当具身智能体的高层规划器时，额外的推理时算力究竟在何时何处才真正有用。

title_en: CHORUS: Decentralized Multi-Embodiment Collaboration with One VLA Policy
title_zh: CHORUS: Decentralized Multi-Embodiment Collaboration with One VLA Policy
summary_en: CHORUS coordinates multiple robots of different embodiments on a shared task using a single decentralised VLA policy.
summary_zh: CHORUS 用单一的去中心化视觉-语言-动作策略，协调不同形态的多台机器人共同完成任务。

title_en: Scaling RL to long horizons remains a major challenge. Long-horizon Q-learning (LQL) prevents compounding bootstrapping errors by bounding the difference in val
title_zh: Scaling RL to long horizons remains a major challenge. Long-horizon Q-learning (LQL) prevents compounding bootstrapping errors by bounding the difference in val
summary_en: Introduces Long-horizon Q-learning (LQL), which bounds the value difference over long horizons to prevent compounding bootstrapping errors in RL.
summary_zh: 提出长时程 Q 学习（LQL），通过限制长时间跨度上的价值差异，防止强化学习中的自举误差累积。

title_en: Ego-Pi: VLA Fine-Tuning for Ego-Centric Human and Robot Data
title_zh: Ego-Pi: VLA Fine-Tuning for Ego-Centric Human and Robot Data
summary_en: Fine-tunes a vision-language-action model on egocentric human video alongside robot data to work around robotics' data scarcity.
summary_zh: 结合第一人称人类视频与机器人数据微调视觉-语言-动作模型，以绕开机器人领域的数据稀缺问题。

title_en: How can VLAs achieve 95+% reliability? Using RL post-training with EXPO-FT: - π0.5 improves to 30/30 success on all 8 tasks tested - uses only 19 min of RL data
title_zh: How can VLAs achieve 95+% reliability? Using RL post-training with EXPO-FT: - π0.5 improves to 30/30 success on all 8 tasks tested - uses only 19 min of RL data
summary_en: EXPO-FT, an RL post-training method, pushes π0.5 to 30/30 task success across 8 tasks using only about 19 minutes of RL data on average.
summary_zh: EXPO-FT 这一强化学习后训练方法，平均仅用约 19 分钟的强化学习数据，就使 π0.5 在 8 项任务上达到 30/30 的成功率。

title_en: EXPO-FT: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Finetuning for Vision-Language-Action Models
title_zh: EXPO-FT: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Finetuning for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary_en: A sample-efficient RL recipe for fine-tuning vision-language-action models on new manipulation tasks.
summary_zh: 一种样本高效的强化学习方案，用于在新的操作任务上微调视觉-语言-动作模型。

title_en: Long-Horizon Q-Learning: Accurate Value Learning via n-Step Inequalities
title_zh: Long-Horizon Q-Learning: Accurate Value Learning via n-Step Inequalities
summary_en: Improves value estimation in off-policy Q-learning over long horizons using n-step inequality constraints.
summary_zh: 利用 n 步不等式约束，改进离策略 Q 学习在长时程任务中的价值估计。

title_en: Can LLMs generate new insights that build on prior research? GiantsBench is a new scientific discovery benchmark, that tests whether models can synthesize new i
title_zh: Can LLMs generate new insights that build on prior research? GiantsBench is a new scientific discovery benchmark, that tests whether models can synthesize new i
summary_en: Introduces GiantsBench, a benchmark testing whether LLMs can synthesize new scientific insights by combining two parent papers.
summary_zh: 提出 GiantsBench 基准，用于测试大语言模型能否综合两篇「母论文」生成新的科学洞见。

title_en: RL fine-tuning often prematurely collapses LLM entropy. Poly-EPO is a scalable set-RL algorithm that optimizes for a set of accurate solutions with diverse reas
title_zh: RL fine-tuning often prematurely collapses LLM entropy. Poly-EPO is a scalable set-RL algorithm that optimizes for a set of accurate solutions with diverse reas
summary_en: Introduces Poly-EPO, a scalable set-RL algorithm that optimizes for a set of accurate but diverse reasoning solutions to counter entropy collapse.
summary_zh: 提出可扩展的集合强化学习算法 Poly-EPO，优化出一组既准确又推理路径多样的解，以对抗强化学习微调中的熵坍缩问题。

title_en: FASTER makes top diffusion RL algos (eg IDQL, EXPO) computationally cheaper while retaining performance Key idea: a denoising critic that operates on noise, ena
title_zh: FASTER makes top diffusion RL algos (eg IDQL, EXPO) computationally cheaper while retaining performance Key idea: a denoising critic that operates on noise, ena
summary_en: Introduces FASTER, which makes top diffusion RL algorithms like IDQL and EXPO computationally cheaper via a denoising critic operating on noise.
summary_zh: 提出 FASTER 方法，通过一个作用于噪声的去噪评论器，大幅降低 IDQL、EXPO 等主流扩散强化学习算法的计算成本，同时保持性能。

title_en: Open-H-Embodiment: A Large-Scale Dataset for Enabling Foundation Models in Medical Robotics
title_zh: Open-H-Embodiment: A Large-Scale Dataset for Enabling Foundation Models in Medical Robotics
summary_en: A large multi-institution dataset for medical robotics, extending the Open X-Embodiment approach to surgical and clinical settings.
summary_zh: 面向医疗机器人的大规模多机构数据集，将 Open X-Embodiment 的思路扩展到外科与临床场景。

title_en: FASTER: Value-Guided Sampling for Fast RL
title_zh: FASTER: Value-Guided Sampling for Fast RL
summary_en: Cuts the cost of test-time action sampling in RL by guiding the sampler with a learned value function.
summary_zh: 用学到的价值函数引导采样，降低强化学习在推理时进行动作采样的开销。

title_en: Poly-EPO: Training Exploratory Reasoning Models
title_zh: Poly-EPO: Training Exploratory Reasoning Models
summary_en: Trains reasoning models that explore rather than converge early, so that test-time compute keeps paying off.
summary_zh: 训练能够持续探索而非过早收敛的推理模型，使推理时算力的增加持续带来收益。

title_en: $π_{0.7}$: a Steerable Generalist Robotic Foundation Model with Emergent Capabilities
title_zh: $π_{0.7}$: a Steerable Generalist Robotic Foundation Model with Emergent Capabilities
summary_en: Physical Intelligence's π0.7 robotic foundation model, which follows diverse language instructions in unseen environments out of the box; Finn is a co-founder and co-author.
summary_zh: Physical Intelligence 的 π0.7 机器人基础模型，可在未见环境中开箱即用地执行多样的语言指令；Finn 是该公司联合创始人与论文作者之一。

title_en: LLM post-training used to mean fine-tuning to a downstream task Robotics has been stuck in this setting, needing task-specific fine-tuning for best performance
title_zh: LLM post-training used to mean fine-tuning to a downstream task Robotics has been stuck in this setting, needing task-specific fine-tuning for best performance
summary_en: Finn announces π0.7, a robot post-training approach that generalizes out of the box instead of requiring task-specific fine-tuning.
summary_zh: Finn 发布 π0.7，一种无需任务特定微调、开箱即可泛化的机器人训练方法。

title_en: GIANTS: Generative Insight Anticipation from Scientific Literature
title_zh: GIANTS: Generative Insight Anticipation from Scientific Literature
summary_en: Tests whether language models can anticipate new scientific insights by synthesising prior literature rather than merely summarising it.
summary_zh: 检验语言模型能否通过综合已有文献来预判新的科学洞见，而不只是做摘要。

title_en: World Action Verifier: Self-Improving World Models via Forward-Inverse Asymmetry
title_zh: World Action Verifier: Self-Improving World Models via Forward-Inverse Asymmetry
summary_en: Uses the asymmetry between forward and inverse dynamics to let world models verify and improve their own predictions.
summary_zh: 利用正向与逆向动力学之间的不对称性，让世界模型验证并改进自身的预测。

title_en: Meta-Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Model Harnesses
title_zh: Meta-Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Model Harnesses
summary_en: Optimises the harness around a language model — what it stores, retrieves and shows the model — end to end, rather than tuning weights.
summary_zh: 端到端地优化语言模型外围的执行框架——它存储、检索并呈现给模型的内容——而非调整模型权重。

title_en: Agents like Claude Code do amazing things relying critically on hand-engineered harnesses We show how agents can optimize the harness w.r.t. end performance Key
title_zh: Agents like Claude Code do amazing things relying critically on hand-engineered harnesses We show how agents can optimize the harness w.r.t. end performance Key
summary_en: Shows agents can optimize their own hand-engineered harness — the kind used by tools like Claude Code — for end performance by storing all experience in a filesystem.
summary_zh: 研究表明，智能体可以像 Claude Code 这类工具一样，通过将全部经验存储在文件系统中，来针对最终表现优化自身的人工设计脚手架。

title_en: Usually, we expect more diverse data >> less diverse data. Cross-embodiment transfer seems to benefit from paired data across embodiments, more so than in
title_zh: Usually, we expect more diverse data >> less diverse data. Cross-embodiment transfer seems to benefit from paired data across embodiments, more so than in
summary_en: Finds cross-embodiment transfer benefits more from paired data across robot embodiments than from simply increasing data diversity.
summary_zh: 研究发现，跨形态迁移更多受益于不同机器人形态间的配对数据，而非单纯增加数据多样性。

title_en: We lack simulated test-beds for studying memory in robot learning. RoboMME is provides a sim benchmark for multiple forms of memory. No single method performs w
title_zh: We lack simulated test-beds for studying memory in robot learning. RoboMME is provides a sim benchmark for multiple forms of memory. No single method performs w
summary_en: Introduces RoboMME, a simulated benchmark for multiple forms of memory in robot learning, finding no single method wins across all tasks.
summary_zh: 提出机器人学习记忆基准 RoboMME，涵盖多种记忆形式，发现没有单一方法能在所有任务上都表现最佳。

title_en: Data Analogies Enable Efficient Cross-Embodiment Transfer
title_zh: Data Analogies Enable Efficient Cross-Embodiment Transfer
summary_en: Shows that organising cross-embodiment robot data by analogy makes transfer between different robots far more efficient.
summary_zh: 表明按类比关系组织跨形态机器人数据，能显著提升不同机器人之间的迁移效率。

title_en: RoboMME: Benchmarking and Understanding Memory for Robotic Generalist Policies
title_zh: RoboMME: Benchmarking and Understanding Memory for Robotic Generalist Policies
summary_en: RoboMME benchmarks memory in generalist robot policies on tasks that require counting repeated actions or tracking occluded objects.
summary_zh: RoboMME 针对需要计数重复动作或追踪被遮挡物体的任务，评测通用机器人策略的记忆能力。

title_en: MEM: Multi-Scale Embodied Memory for Vision Language Action Models
title_zh: MEM: Multi-Scale Embodied Memory for Vision Language Action Models
summary_en: Gives vision-language-action models multi-scale memory instead of a flat window of past observations, for multi-stage real-world tasks.
summary_zh: 为视觉-语言-动作模型引入多尺度记忆，取代扁平的历史观测窗口，以应对多阶段的真实任务。

title_en: We added short-term visual memory + long-term text memory to pi models. 🤖 Enables robots to: - complete tasks up to 15 min long - cook grilled cheese while keep
title_zh: We added short-term visual memory + long-term text memory to pi models. 🤖 Enables robots to: - complete tasks up to 15 min long - cook grilled cheese while keep
summary_en: Adds short-term visual and long-term text memory to pi robot models, enabling tasks up to 15 minutes long, like cooking grilled cheese while tracking time.
summary_zh: 为 pi 系列机器人模型加入短期视觉记忆与长期文本记忆，使其能完成长达 15 分钟的任务，例如一边计时一边煎芝士三明治。

title_en: Pi models are now running in production settings, in collab with @Ultraroboticsco and @weaverobotics. We see: - much higher autonomy with pi-0.6 over using pi-0
title_zh: Pi models are now running in production settings, in collab with @Ultraroboticsco and @weaverobotics. We see: - much higher autonomy with pi-0.6 over using pi-0
summary_en: Reports pi robot models now running in production with partner robotics companies, showing higher autonomy and fewer mistakes than pi-0.5.
summary_zh: 报告 pi 系列机器人模型已在合作机器人公司的生产环境中运行，相比 pi-0.5 自主性更高、失误更少。

title_en: We can improve VLA generalization to new instructions at test time by: 1. run rephrased lang instructions through model 2. use verifier to select best action Pa
title_zh: We can improve VLA generalization to new instructions at test time by: 1. run rephrased lang instructions through model 2. use verifier to select best action Pa
summary_en: She shares a method to improve vision-language-action model generalization at test time by rephrasing instructions and using a verifier to pick the best action.
summary_zh: 她分享了一种在测试时提升视觉-语言-动作模型泛化能力的方法：改写指令并用验证器挑选最佳动作。

title_en: Video gen models make pretty videos, but lack physical accuracy Large robot data is helpful but insufficient, esp since this data is mostly demos By fine-tuning
title_zh: Video gen models make pretty videos, but lack physical accuracy Large robot data is helpful but insufficient, esp since this data is mostly demos By fine-tuning
summary_en: Shows fine-tuning video generation models on real policy data yields far more physically accurate video, addressing a key weakness of video models.
summary_zh: 研究表明，用真实策略数据对视频生成模型进行微调，能显著提升视频的物理准确性，弥补了视频生成模型的一大弱点。

title_en: Scaling Verification Can Be More Effective than Scaling Policy Learning for Vision-Language-Action Alignment
title_zh: Scaling Verification Can Be More Effective than Scaling Policy Learning for Vision-Language-Action Alignment
summary_en: Argues that scaling verification beats scaling policy learning for aligning vision-language-action models with language instructions.
summary_zh: 论证在让视觉-语言-动作模型对齐语言指令这一问题上，扩展验证比扩展策略学习更有效。

title_en: VLAW: Iterative Co-Improvement of Vision-Language-Action Policy and World Model
title_zh: VLAW: Iterative Co-Improvement of Vision-Language-Action Policy and World Model
summary_en: Paper on VLAW, which improves a vision-language-action policy and a world model jointly through repeated online interaction.
summary_zh: 论文提出 VLAW，通过反复的在线交互让视觉-语言-动作策略与世界模型相互迭代改进。

title_en: Larger transformers often make for worse value functions. Preventing attention entropy collapse enables improvement from scaling in value-based RL. Paper: https
title_zh: Larger transformers often make for worse value functions. Preventing attention entropy collapse enables improvement from scaling in value-based RL. Paper: https
summary_en: Finds that preventing attention entropy collapse lets larger transformers scale as value functions in RL, reversing the usual degradation with size.
summary_zh: 研究发现，防止注意力熵坍缩后，更大的 Transformer 可以在强化学习中作为价值函数继续随规模提升表现，扭转了通常「越大越差」的现象。

title_en: SteerVLA: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models in Long-Tail Driving Scenarios
title_zh: SteerVLA: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models in Long-Tail Driving Scenarios
summary_en: Applies VLA steering to autonomous driving, joining high-level semantic reasoning about long-tail events to low-level reactive control; a Stanford–Berkeley collaboration with Levine and Sadigh.
summary_zh: 将视觉-语言-动作模型的引导方法用于自动驾驶，把针对长尾事件的高层语义推理与低层反应式控制结合起来；这是与 Levine、Sadigh 合作的斯坦福—伯克利研究。

title_en: Video models serve as a good pretrained backbone for robot policies. Paper: https://t.co/Q5OZNCOn5E Code: https://t.co/r0nlZq4J36
title_zh: Video models serve as a good pretrained backbone for robot policies. Paper: https://t.co/Q5OZNCOn5E Code: https://t.co/r0nlZq4J36
summary_en: Shows pretrained video models serve as a strong backbone for robot policies.
summary_zh: 研究表明，预训练视频模型可作为机器人策略的良好骨干网络。

title_en: Studying generalist reward models is hard: robot datasets focus on successful demos, not failures. We introduce: - a large-scale reward modeling benchmark - a d
title_zh: Studying generalist reward models is hard: robot datasets focus on successful demos, not failures. We introduce: - a large-scale reward modeling benchmark - a d
summary_en: Introduces a large-scale generalist reward-model benchmark and data augmentation scheme built with failure data, since robot datasets are mostly successful demos.
summary_zh: 提出大规模通用奖励模型基准与数据增强方案，专门引入失败数据，弥补机器人数据集大多只包含成功演示的不足。

title_en: RoboReward: General-Purpose Vision-Language Reward Models for Robotics
title_zh: RoboReward: General-Purpose Vision-Language Reward Models for Robotics
summary_en: Finn co-authored RoboReward, a general-purpose vision-language reward model that matches human-provided rewards in real robot reinforcement learning.
summary_zh: Finn合著了RoboReward，一个通用视觉-语言奖励模型，在真实机器人强化学习中的表现可媲美人工评分。

title_en: We did a fun side project of fine-tuning π’s latest model on most of the tasks from Benjie Holson’s “Robot Olympics” blog post. The robot was able to autonomous
title_zh: We did a fun side project of fine-tuning π’s latest model on most of the tasks from Benjie Holson’s “Robot Olympics” blog post. The robot was able to autonomous
summary_en: Side project fine-tuning π's latest model to autonomously complete all 10 tasks from Benjie Holson's 'Robot Olympics' blog post.
summary_zh: 一个业余项目：对 π 系列最新模型进行微调，使其自主完成 Benjie Holson「机器人奥运会」博文中的全部 10 项任务。

title_en: All of my Deep RL course lecture videos from Spring 2025 are now online! 🥳 Youtube playlist: https://t.co/o5ykWMaWbQ
title_zh: All of my Deep RL course lecture videos from Spring 2025 are now online! 🥳 Youtube playlist: https://t.co/o5ykWMaWbQ
summary_en: Releases all Spring 2025 Deep RL course lecture videos on YouTube.
summary_zh: 在 YouTube 上发布 2025 年春季深度强化学习课程的全部讲座视频。

title_en: How can neural nets learn from experience without the scalar reward bottleneck? Feedback descent enables long-term iterative improvement from text feedback. Blo
title_zh: How can neural nets learn from experience without the scalar reward bottleneck? Feedback descent enables long-term iterative improvement from text feedback. Blo
summary_en: Introduces feedback descent, letting neural nets iteratively improve from text feedback instead of a scalar reward, for both robotics and LLMs.
summary_zh: 提出「反馈下降」方法，使神经网络能够依靠文本反馈而非标量奖励进行持续迭代改进，适用于机器人与大语言模型。

title_en: For robots to be actually useful, they need to be reliable. We’re sharing an RL recipe for VLA models that takes a step in this direction, allowing robots to op
title_zh: For robots to be actually useful, they need to be reliable. We’re sharing an RL recipe for VLA models that takes a step in this direction, allowing robots to op
summary_en: Finn's team releases an RL recipe for vision-language-action models that lets robots operate reliably and autonomously for hours.
summary_zh: Finn 团队发布了一套强化学习方案，让视觉-语言-动作机器人能够可靠地自主运行数小时。

title_en: Most VLAs have no memory. MemER is a scalable method for giving VLAs long-term visual memory. Key ideas: - relevant info is in a small # of frames: store just a
title_zh: Most VLAs have no memory. MemER is a scalable method for giving VLAs long-term visual memory. Key ideas: - relevant info is in a small # of frames: store just a
summary_en: Introduces MemER, a scalable method giving VLAs long-term visual memory by storing only a small number of relevant key frames.
summary_zh: 提出可扩展方法 MemER，通过仅存储少量关键帧，为视觉-语言-动作模型赋予长期视觉记忆。

title_en: Ctrl-World is a controllable world model that generalizes zero-shot to new environments, cameras, and objects. Paper: https://t.co/Bog5hk0h28 Model & code:
title_zh: Ctrl-World is a controllable world model that generalizes zero-shot to new environments, cameras, and objects. Paper: https://t.co/Bog5hk0h28 Model & code:
summary_en: Introduces Ctrl-World, a controllable world model that generalizes zero-shot to new environments, cameras, and objects.
summary_zh: 提出可控世界模型 Ctrl-World，能够零样本泛化到新的环境、摄像机视角与物体。

title_en: Flow matching for value functions. Works well for both offline and offline-to-online RL. Paper: https://t.co/SKWIeGMMeY https://t.co/ajrbBqN8fs
title_zh: Flow matching for value functions. Works well for both offline and offline-to-online RL. Paper: https://t.co/SKWIeGMMeY https://t.co/ajrbBqN8fs
summary_en: Applies flow matching to value functions, working well for both offline and offline-to-online RL.
summary_zh: 将流匹配方法应用于价值函数，在离线强化学习及离线到在线的迁移场景中均表现良好。

title_en: Hierarchical RL for LLM reasoning. Paper: https://t.co/uCq3Pl7Zce
title_zh: Hierarchical RL for LLM reasoning. Paper: https://t.co/uCq3Pl7Zce
summary_en: Applies hierarchical RL to LLM reasoning.
summary_zh: 将分层强化学习方法应用于大语言模型的推理。

title_en: RL fine-tuning often prematurely collapses policy entropy. We consider a general framework, called set RL, i.e. RL over a set of trajectories from a policy. We
title_zh: RL fine-tuning often prematurely collapses policy entropy. We consider a general framework, called set RL, i.e. RL over a set of trajectories from a policy. We
summary_en: Introduces set RL, optimizing over a set of trajectories from a policy to counter the premature entropy collapse of RL fine-tuning.
summary_zh: 提出「集合强化学习」，通过对策略生成的一组轨迹进行联合优化，对抗强化学习微调中过早出现的熵坍缩问题。

title_en: π0.5 weights + fine-tuning code are now open-source! https://t.co/k4IFdgnYfQ
title_zh: π0.5 weights + fine-tuning code are now open-source! https://t.co/k4IFdgnYfQ
summary_en: Open-sources π0.5 model weights and fine-tuning code.
summary_zh: 开源 π0.5 模型权重及微调代码。

title_en: EXPO is a new method for RL post-training of diffusion policies. With good pre-training, it’s both really stable and ~2x more efficient than the most efficient
title_zh: EXPO is a new method for RL post-training of diffusion policies. With good pre-training, it’s both really stable and ~2x more efficient than the most efficient
summary_en: She introduces EXPO, an RL post-training method for diffusion policies that is about twice as efficient as prior approaches.
summary_zh: 她推出 EXPO，一种用于扩散策略强化学习后训练的方法，效率约为现有方法的两倍。

title_en: Chelsea Finn: Building Robots That Can Do Anything
title_zh: Chelsea Finn: Building Robots That Can Do Anything
summary_en: Finn's AI Startup School talk, tracing her path from meta-learning research to building general-purpose robot policies.
summary_zh: Finn 在 AI Startup School 的演讲，回顾她从元学习研究走向构建通用机器人策略的历程。

title_en: The robot can autonomously perform a real gallbladder removal subroutine! - Successfully completed the procedure on all 8 of 8 held-out gallbladders - Uses same
title_zh: The robot can autonomously perform a real gallbladder removal subroutine! - Successfully completed the procedure on all 8 of 8 held-out gallbladders - Uses same
summary_en: Finn shares results of a robot autonomously performing a real gallbladder-removal surgical subroutine, succeeding on all 8 held-out cases.
summary_zh: Finn 分享了机器人自主完成真实胆囊切除手术子流程的结果，在全部8例保留测试中均成功。

title_en: We still lack a scalable recipe for RL post-training seeded with demonstration data. Many methods add an imitation loss, but this constrains learning too much.
title_zh: We still lack a scalable recipe for RL post-training seeded with demonstration data. Many methods add an imitation loss, but this constrains learning too much.
summary_en: She proposes a scalable RL post-training recipe that uses demonstrations only to perturb exploration rather than constrain it via imitation loss.
summary_zh: 她提出了一种可扩展的强化学习后训练方案，只用示范数据来扰动探索而非通过模仿损失加以限制。

title_en: How can robots problem solve in novel environments? We combine high-level reasoning with VLMs with low-level controllers to allow test-time problem solving. Pap
title_zh: How can robots problem solve in novel environments? We combine high-level reasoning with VLMs with low-level controllers to allow test-time problem solving. Pap
summary_en: Finn's team combines VLM-based high-level reasoning with low-level controllers so robots can problem-solve in novel environments at test time.
summary_zh: Finn 团队将基于VLM的高层推理与底层控制器结合，使机器人能在测试时于陷生环境中解决问题。

title_en: How do we make a scalable RL recipe for robots? We study batch online RL w/ demos. Key findings: - iterative filtered imitation is insufficient - need diverse p
title_zh: How do we make a scalable RL recipe for robots? We study batch online RL w/ demos. Key findings: - iterative filtered imitation is insufficient - need diverse p
summary_en: She reports findings on scalable RL for robots, showing iterative filtered imitation is insufficient and diverse diffusion-policy data is needed.
summary_zh: 她发布了关于机器人可扩展强化学习的发现：迭代过滤模仿方法不够，还需要多样化的扩散策略数据。

title_en: Most robot policies don't have any memory! This is because: - policies often perform *worse* with past observations as input - GPU memory and compute constraint
title_zh: Most robot policies don't have any memory! This is because: - policies often perform *worse* with past observations as input - GPU memory and compute constraint
summary_en: Finn's team addresses the lack of memory in robot policies, tackling both performance degradation and GPU constraints to train long-context policies.
summary_zh: Finn 团队解决了机器人策略缺乏记忆的问题，同时应对性能下降和GPU资源限制，以训练长上下文策略。

title_en: Introducing π-0.5! The model works out of the box in completely new environments. Here the robot cleans new kitchens & bedrooms. 🤖 Detailed paper + videos i
title_zh: Introducing π-0.5! The model works out of the box in completely new environments. Here the robot cleans new kitchens & bedrooms. 🤖 Detailed paper + videos i
summary_en: Finn launches π-0.5, a robot policy that works out of the box in entirely new kitchens and bedrooms it has never seen.
summary_zh: Finn 发布 π-0.5，该机器人策略无需额外训练即可在从未见过的新厨房和卧室中工作。

title_en: Data curation is crucial for post-training recipes. But how do we curate? Curation is usually manual & tedious. And, it's hard to tell if a strategy in the data
title_zh: Data curation is crucial for post-training recipes. But how do we curate? Curation is usually manual & tedious. And, it's hard to tell if a strategy in the data
summary_en: She introduces an automated way to curate post-training data, addressing how hard it is to tell if a curation strategy will be reliable.
summary_zh: 她推出了一种自动化的后训练数据筛选方法，解决了难以判断筛选策略是否可靠的问题。

title_en: The Robotics Revolution, with Physical Intelligence’s Cofounder Chelsea Finn
title_zh: The Robotics Revolution, with Physical Intelligence’s Cofounder Chelsea Finn
summary_en: Finn on No Priors discussing Physical Intelligence's approach to robot foundation models and what still blocks general-purpose robots.
summary_zh: Finn 做客 No Priors，讨论 Physical Intelligence 的机器人基础模型路线，以及通用机器人仍面临的障碍。

title_en: We can now fine-tune the 7B OpenVLA model for 50 Hz control! 🤖 Paper: https://t.co/TxQJ42lYi8 Code: https://t.co/u5nzhytzRA
title_zh: We can now fine-tune the 7B OpenVLA model for 50 Hz control! 🤖 Paper: https://t.co/TxQJ42lYi8 Code: https://t.co/u5nzhytzRA
summary_en: Finn's team shows the 7B OpenVLA model can now be fine-tuned to run at 50 Hz control frequency.
summary_zh: Finn 团队展示了70亿参数的 OpenVLA 模型现在可以微调到50Hz的控制频率。

title_en: LLM post-training still optimizes for aggregate preferences. Can we optimize for individual preferences, with in-context learning? Few-shot preference optimizat
title_zh: LLM post-training still optimizes for aggregate preferences. Can we optimize for individual preferences, with in-context learning? Few-shot preference optimizat
summary_en: She introduces few-shot preference optimization (FSPO), letting LLM post-training personalize to individual preferences via in-context learning.
summary_zh: 她推出少样本偏好优化（FSPO），通过上下文学习让LLM后训练能够针对个体偏好进行个性化。

title_en: Can we prompt robots, just like we prompt language models? With hierarchy of VLA models + LLM-generated data, robots can: - reason through long-horizon tasks -
title_zh: Can we prompt robots, just like we prompt language models? With hierarchy of VLA models + LLM-generated data, robots can: - reason through long-horizon tasks -
summary_en: Finn's team shows robots can be prompted like language models, using a hierarchy of VLA models plus LLM-generated data for long-horizon reasoning.
summary_zh: Finn 团队展示了机器人也可以像语言模型一样被提示，通过VLA模型层级结构和LLM生成的数据完成长时程推理任务。

title_en: Our first open-source release at Pi 🤖 - π₀ and π₀-FAST model weights - code for model, on-robot inference, & fine-tuning - fine-tuned checkpoints that can b
title_zh: Our first open-source release at Pi 🤖 - π₀ and π₀-FAST model weights - code for model, on-robot inference, & fine-tuning - fine-tuned checkpoints that can b
summary_en: Physical Intelligence releases its first open-source models, π₀ and π₀-FAST, with weights and fine-tuning code.
summary_zh: Physical Intelligence 发布了首个开源模型 π₀ 和 π₀-FAST，包含权重和微调代码。

title_en: Disappointed with your ICLR paper being rejected? Ten years ago today, Sergey and I finished training some of the first end-to-end neutral nets for robot contro
title_zh: Disappointed with your ICLR paper being rejected? Ten years ago today, Sergey and I finished training some of the first end-to-end neutral nets for robot contro
summary_en: Finn recalls finishing training some of the first end-to-end neural networks for robot control ten years earlier with Sergey Levine, a formative moment for the field.
summary_zh: Finn 回顾了十年前与 Sergey Levine 一起完成早期端到端神经网络机器人控制训练的经历，这是该领域的一个奠基性时刻。

title_en: Why is action chunking crucial for robot dexterity? 🤖 - We identify a natural tradeoff between temporal consistency and reactivity - New policy decoding techniq
title_zh: Why is action chunking crucial for robot dexterity? 🤖 - We identify a natural tradeoff between temporal consistency and reactivity - New policy decoding techniq
summary_en: She explains why action chunking matters for robot dexterity, introducing a decoding technique balancing temporal consistency and reactivity.
summary_zh: 她解释了动作分块对机器人灵巧性的重要性，并介绍了一种兼顾时间一致性和反应速度的解码技术。

title_en: Chelsea Finn: how to build AI that can keep up with an always changing world
title_zh: Chelsea Finn: how to build AI that can keep up with an always changing world
summary_en: Finn talks with Pieter Abbeel about distribution shift, meta-learning, model editing and single-life RL.
summary_zh: Finn 与 Pieter Abbeel 对谈分布偏移、元学习、模型编辑与单次生命强化学习。

title_en: Chelsea Finn: How to make artificial intelligence more meta
title_zh: Chelsea Finn: How to make artificial intelligence more meta
summary_en: Stanford's Future of Everything interview on meta-learning — teaching models to learn new tasks from very little data.
summary_zh: 斯坦福 Future of Everything 节目关于元学习的访谈——让模型学会用极少的数据掌握新任务。

title_en: Episode 19 - Chelsea Finn
title_zh: Episode 19 - Chelsea Finn
summary_en: Finn appears as the guest on Eye on A.I. episode 19, discussing her path into robotics research and her work in meta-learning.
summary_zh: Finn作为嘉宾出现在Eye on A.I.播客第19期，讲述她进入机器人研究领域的历程及元学习方面的工作。

title_en: Chelsea Finn: The 100 Most Influential People in AI 2026
title_zh: Chelsea Finn: The 100 Most Influential People in AI 2026
summary_en: Named to Time's 2026 list of the 100 most influential people in AI.
summary_zh: 入选《时代》周刊 2026 年“人工智能领域最具影响力 100 人”名单。

title_en: Long Short-Term Memory
title_zh: 长短期记忆网络
summary_en: With Sepp Hochreiter. The architecture that carried sequence modelling for two decades.
summary_zh: 与 Sepp Hochreiter 合著。支撑了序列建模二十年的架构。

title_en: Annotated history of modern AI and deep learning
title_zh: 现代 AI 与深度学习的注释史
summary_en: His running, heavily footnoted account of who did what first — contentious and worth reading for exactly that reason.
summary_zh: 他持续更新、脚注密集的「谁先做了什么」记述 —— 有争议，也正因如此值得一读。

title_en: Some claim that AGI is here now. Ridiculous. No AGI without mastery of the real world! No true self-improvement without self-improving hardware, as opposed to t
title_zh: Some claim that AGI is here now. Ridiculous. No AGI without mastery of the real world! No true self-improvement without self-improving hardware, as opposed to t
summary_en: Schmidhuber dismissed claims that AGI has already arrived, arguing true self-improvement requires mastery of the real world and self-improving hardware.
summary_zh: Schmidhuber驳斥了AGI已经到来的说法，认为真正的自我改进需要掌握真实世界并具备自我改进的硬件。

title_en: RSI will "only be seen inside a few frontier AI labs" ? Nonsense. Concrete RSI algorithms have existed for almost 4 decades. See "Meta Learning and Recursive Se
title_zh: RSI will "only be seen inside a few frontier AI labs" ? Nonsense. Concrete RSI algorithms have existed for almost 4 decades. See "Meta Learning and Recursive Se
summary_en: Schmidhuber pushed back on claims that recursive self-improvement is confined to a few frontier labs, pointing to his own 1987 work on meta-learning and self-improvement as prior art.
summary_zh: 施密德胡伯反驳了“递归自我改进只存在于少数前沿实验室”的说法，指出他自己1987年关于元学习与自我改进的工作早已提出这一思路。

title_en: RT @SchmidhuberAI: This "recurrent depth" is essentially what's in Sec. 5.3 of the 2015 paper: On Learning to Think: Algorithmic Informatio…
title_zh: RT @SchmidhuberAI: This "recurrent depth" is essentially what's in Sec. 5.3 of the 2015 paper: On Learning to Think: Algorithmic Informatio…
summary_en: Schmidhuber reasserted that today's 'recurrent depth' techniques were already described in his 2015 'Learning to Think' paper, a priority claim about the field's lineage.
