summary_zh: Schmidhuber重申如今的“循环深度”技术早在他2015年的论文《Learning to Think》中就已提出，这是关于该领域源流的优先权主张。

title_en: RT @SchmidhuberAI: @Bass1mpact @elonmusk @Nature In the end, the truth and the facts will win, and plagiators will be stripped of their awa…
title_zh: RT @SchmidhuberAI: @Bass1mpact @elonmusk @Nature In the end, the truth and the facts will win, and plagiators will be stripped of their awa…
summary_en: Schmidhuber reiterated that Nature has tolerated plagiarism and that credit will eventually go to the true originators, continuing his long-running dispute over attribution of core deep-learning ideas.
summary_zh: Schmidhuber重申《自然》杂志纵容抄袭，认为荣誉终将归于真正的原创者，延续了他关于深度学习核心思想归属权的长期争议。

title_en: I agree. @Nature tolerates plagiarism. Aside from the Jason Arday case: Geoffrey Hinton never retracted or corrected his Nature papers that republished/misattri
title_zh: I agree. @Nature tolerates plagiarism. Aside from the Jason Arday case: Geoffrey Hinton never retracted or corrected his Nature papers that republished/misattri
summary_en: Schmidhuber said Nature tolerates plagiarism, arguing Geoffrey Hinton never corrected Nature papers that misattributed techniques he says he invented.
summary_zh: Schmidhuber表示《自然》杂志纵容抄袭，称Geoffrey Hinton从未更正那些将他自称发明的技术归错他人的《自然》论文。

title_en: This "recurrent depth" is essentially what's in Sec. 5.3 of the 2015 paper: On Learning to Think: Algorithmic Information Theory for Novel Combinations of Reinf
title_zh: This "recurrent depth" is essentially what's in Sec. 5.3 of the 2015 paper: On Learning to Think: Algorithmic Information Theory for Novel Combinations of Reinf
summary_en: Schmidhuber pointed out that the "recurrent depth" technique now popular in LLM research was already described in Section 5.3 of his 2015 paper on algorithmic information theory for reinforcement learning and recurrent controllers.
summary_zh: 施密德胡伯指出，目前LLM研究中流行的"循环深度"技术早在他2015年关于强化学习与循环控制器算法信息论的论文第5.3节中就已提出。

title_en: Wait until each agent in the collective tries to maximise money in a reinforcement learning (RL) "Economy Of Minds" (EOM)! From the 2023 paper on "Mindstorms in
title_zh: Wait until each agent in the collective tries to maximise money in a reinforcement learning (RL) "Economy Of Minds" (EOM)! From the 2023 paper on "Mindstorms in
summary_en: Schmidhuber revisited his 2023 "Mindstorms in Natural Language-Based Societies of Minds" paper to warn what happens when agents in a multi-agent collective start optimizing for money under reinforcement learning — an "Economy of Minds."
summary_zh: 施密德胡伯重提他2023年的论文《自然语言社会中的头脑风暴》，警告当多智能体集体中的智能体开始在强化学习下以获取金钱为目标进行优化时会发生什么——即"头脑经济"。

title_en: RT @SchmidhuberAI: @morew4rd @elonmusk @p_ferragu a quarter century ago, I predicted: large scale general-purpose quantum computation won't…
title_zh: RT @SchmidhuberAI: @morew4rd @elonmusk @p_ferragu a quarter century ago, I predicted: large scale general-purpose quantum computation won't…
summary_en: Schmidhuber restated a quarter-century-old prediction, made in reply to Elon Musk, that large-scale general-purpose quantum computation would not work as hoped — a long-running stance of his.
summary_zh: Schmidhuber在回复Elon Musk时重申了他25年前的预测：大规模通用量子计算不会如人们所期望的那样奏效——这是他一贯坚持的观点。

title_en: Creation begins with understanding: LLMs as strategy designers for privacy-preserving tabular data synthesis
title_zh: Creation begins with understanding: LLMs as strategy designers for privacy-preserving tabular data synthesis
summary_en: Schmidhuber co-authored a paper proposing LLMs as strategy designers for generating privacy-preserving synthetic tabular data.
summary_zh: Schmidhuber参与合著论文，提出用大语言模型作为策略设计者，生成具有隐私保护的合成表格数据。

title_en: DiG-bench: Discovery in Games
title_zh: DiG-bench: Discovery in Games
summary_en: Introduces a benchmark that tests whether AI agents can discover and formulate novel generalisations inside games, extending his long-standing interest in artificial curiosity and machine discovery.
summary_zh: 提出一个在游戏环境中检验智能体能否发现并归纳出新规律的基准，延续他长期关注的人工好奇心与机器发现主题。

title_en: Hybrid Advantage Estimation with Unified Critic for VLM Agentic Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Hybrid Advantage Estimation with Unified Critic for VLM Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Proposes a hybrid advantage estimator with a unified critic for training vision-language models as multi-turn agents by reinforcement learning.
summary_zh: 提出结合统一价值网络的混合优势估计方法，用强化学习训练视觉语言模型完成多轮交互式智能体任务。

title_en: #73 Joachim Nareike sucht das Gespräch mit Jürgen Schmidhuber
title_zh: #73 Joachim Nareike sucht das Gespräch mit Jürgen Schmidhuber
summary_en: Interview on the German podcast FONDS professionell on the origins of modern AI, Europe's capacity to innovate, and where he thinks the real risks lie.
summary_zh: 德国 FONDS professionell 播客访谈，谈现代人工智能的起源、欧洲的创新能力，以及他眼中真正的风险所在。

title_en: AI Pioneer Jürgen Schmidhuber: AI Already Feels Pain, Loves, and Is Self-Aware
title_zh: AI Pioneer Jürgen Schmidhuber: AI Already Feels Pain, Loves, and Is Self-Aware
summary_en: Big Technology Podcast interview in which he argues that today's AI systems already have something like feeling and self-awareness, and debates whether current methods reach AGI.
summary_zh: 在 Big Technology 播客中，他主张当今的人工智能系统已具备类似痛感与自我意识的特性，并讨论现有方法能否通向通用人工智能。

title_en: Self-Improvements in Modern Agentic Systems: A Survey
title_zh: Self-Improvements in Modern Agentic Systems: A Survey
summary_en: Surveys how deployed agentic systems adapt and improve themselves with minimal human input — the recursive self-improvement question he has pursued since the Gödel Machine.
summary_zh: 综述已部署的智能体系统如何在极少人工干预下自我适应与自我改进，正是他自哥德尔机以来一直研究的递归自我改进问题。

title_en: Ep 90: AI Pioneer Jürgen Schmidhuber on the State of AI Today
title_zh: Ep 90: AI Pioneer Jürgen Schmidhuber on the State of AI Today
summary_en: Interview on Unsupervised Learning covering the state of AI today and the lineage running from his lab's early work to transformers, LSTMs and self-improving systems.
summary_zh: 在 Unsupervised Learning 播客中回顾当下人工智能的现状，以及从他实验室早期工作到 Transformer、LSTM 与自我改进系统的脉络。

title_en: The 15-Year-Old Dreamer who became the Father of Modern AI | Jürgen Schmidhuber
title_zh: The 15-Year-Old Dreamer who became the Father of Modern AI | Jürgen Schmidhuber
summary_en: Podcast interview where Schmidhuber argues today's Turing-test-passing systems may just be 'fancy text editors', distinct from what he calls real, physical intelligence.
summary_zh: 在播客访谈中，Schmidhuber认为如今能通过图灵测试的系统可能只是“高级文本编辑器”，与他所说的真正（具身）智能并不相同。

title_en: Jürgen Schmidhuber - Part 2: JEPA, the Road to AGI, and Who Really Invented Modern AI
title_zh: Jürgen Schmidhuber - Part 2: JEPA, the Road to AGI, and Who Really Invented Modern AI
summary_en: Second half of the same interview, on JEPA, the road to AGI, and his account of who really invented modern AI.
summary_zh: 同一访谈的下集，谈 JEPA、通往通用人工智能之路，以及他对现代人工智能究竟由谁开创的看法。

title_en: Jürgen Schmidhuber - World Models, RL, and the Year that changed AI (Part 1)
title_zh: Jürgen Schmidhuber - World Models, RL, and the Year that changed AI (Part 1)
summary_en: First half of a long-form interview on world models, reinforcement learning and the year he regards as the turning point for modern AI.
summary_zh: 长篇访谈的上集，谈世界模型、强化学习，以及他认为改变现代人工智能走向的那一年。

title_en: Interestingness as an Inductive Heuristic for Future Compression Progress
title_zh: Interestingness as an Inductive Heuristic for Future Compression Progress
summary_en: Formalises 'interestingness' as a heuristic for predicting which tasks will yield future compression progress, a direct extension of his compression-progress theory of curiosity.
summary_zh: 把“有趣性”形式化为预测哪些任务能带来未来压缩进步的启发式判据，是他压缩进步好奇心理论的直接延伸。

title_en: Learning to Forget: Continual Learning with Adaptive Weight Decay
title_zh: Learning to Forget: Continual Learning with Adaptive Weight Decay
summary_en: Uses adaptive weight decay so that a continual-learning agent with fixed capacity can deliberately forget stale knowledge and free capacity for new tasks.
summary_zh: 用自适应权重衰减让容量有限的持续学习智能体主动遗忘过时知识，为新任务腾出容量。

title_en: RPRA: Predicting an LLM-Judge for Efficient but Performant Inference
title_zh: RPRA: Predicting an LLM-Judge for Efficient but Performant Inference
summary_en: Predicts the verdict of an LLM judge in advance so inference cost can be cut without losing output quality on hardware-limited devices.
summary_zh: 通过提前预测大模型评判者的打分，在算力受限的设备上降低推理开销而不损失输出质量。

title_en: Neural Computers
title_zh: Neural Computers
summary_en: Sets out the Neural Computer agenda — folding computation, memory and I/O into a single learned runtime state, with a completely neural computer as the long-term goal.
summary_zh: 提出“神经计算机”的研究纲领：把计算、存储与输入输出统一到一个可学习的运行时状态中，并以完全神经化的计算机为长期目标。

title_en: Planning to Explore: Curiosity-Driven Planning for LLM Test Generation
title_zh: Planning to Explore: Curiosity-Driven Planning for LLM Test Generation
summary_en: Applies curiosity-driven planning to LLM test generation, steering the model towards code behaviour that existing tests never reach.
summary_zh: 把好奇心驱动的规划用于大模型自动生成测试，引导模型探索现有测试未覆盖的代码行为。

title_en: Efficient Morphology-Control Co-Design via Stackelberg Proximal Policy Optimization
title_zh: Efficient Morphology-Control Co-Design via Stackelberg Proximal Policy Optimization
summary_en: Treats the joint optimisation of a robot's body and its controller as a Stackelberg game, giving a more stable bi-level RL procedure for morphology-control co-design.
summary_zh: 将机器人形态与控制器的联合优化建模为 Stackelberg 博弈，为形态—控制协同设计提供更稳定的双层强化学习方法。

title_en: RACAS: Controlling Diverse Robots With a Single Agentic System
title_zh: RACAS: Controlling Diverse Robots With a Single Agentic System
summary_en: Presents a single agentic system that drives several different robot platforms through the low-level APIs they already expose.
summary_zh: 提出用同一套智能体系统，通过各机器人平台已有的底层接口来控制多种不同的机器人。

title_en: Multiple Token Divergence: Measuring and Steering In-Context Computation Density
title_zh: Multiple Token Divergence: Measuring and Steering In-Context Computation Density
summary_en: Introduces a measure of how much in-context computation a language model is actually doing, and uses it to steer reasoning effort — a compression-based reading of model effort.
summary_zh: 提出衡量语言模型上下文内计算量的指标，并用它调节推理投入，延续以压缩视角刻画模型“思考”强度的思路。

title_en: Huxley-Gödel Machine: Human-Level Coding Agent Development by an Approximation of the Optimal Self-Improving Machine
title_zh: Huxley-Gödel Machine: Human-Level Coding Agent Development by an Approximation of the Optimal Self-Improving Machine
summary_en: Approximates his Gödel Machine with a coding agent that grows and selects its own self-modifications, reaching human-level results on coding-agent benchmarks.
summary_zh: 以近似哥德尔机的方式构建能不断自我修改并择优的编程智能体，在编程智能体基准上达到人类水平。

title_en: Who invented deep residual learning?
title_zh: Who invented deep residual learning?
summary_en: His priority note tracing residual connections back to earlier work, continuing a long-running campaign over attribution in deep learning.
summary_zh: 他考证残差连接思想渊源、追溯至更早工作的署名之争短文，延续其对深度学习成果归属的一贯主张。

title_en: Decoupling the "What" and "Where" With Polar Coordinate Positional Embeddings
title_zh: Decoupling the "What" and "Where" With Polar Coordinate Positional Embeddings
summary_en: Paper proposing polar-coordinate positional embeddings that separate content from position in Transformer attention.
summary_zh: 论文提出极坐标位置编码，在 Transformer 注意力中把内容与位置分离开。

title_en: PhysGym: Benchmarking LLMs in Interactive Physics Discovery with Controlled Priors
title_zh: PhysGym: Benchmarking LLMs in Interactive Physics Discovery with Controlled Priors
summary_en: Benchmarks LLM agents on interactive physics discovery while holding their prior knowledge fixed, isolating how well they actually explore.
summary_zh: 在可控先验知识的条件下评测大模型智能体的交互式物理发现能力，从而分离出它们真正的探索水平。

title_en: Curious Causality-Seeking Agents Learn Meta Causal World
title_zh: Curious Causality-Seeking Agents Learn Meta Causal World
summary_en: Has curious agents learn a meta causal world model in which the governing causal rule itself changes with context.
summary_zh: 让具有好奇心的智能体学习“元因果”世界模型，其中支配环境的因果规则本身会随情境变化。

title_en: Do you like RL and math? Our collaboration, IDSIA-KAUST-NNAISENSE, has the most detailed exploration of the convergence and stability of modern RL frameworks li
title_zh: Do you like RL and math? Our collaboration, IDSIA-KAUST-NNAISENSE, has the most detailed exploration of the convergence and stability of modern RL frameworks li
summary_en: Schmidhuber announces an IDSIA-KAUST-NNAISENSE collaboration studying the convergence and stability of modern RL methods, including Upside-Down RL and Online Decision Transformers.
summary_zh: Schmidhuber宣布IDSIA、KAUST与NNAISENSE合作,深入研究现代强化学习方法(包括Upside-Down RL和在线决策Transformer)的收敛性与稳定性。

title_en: Jurgen Schmidhuber on Humans co-existing with AIs
title_zh: Jurgen Schmidhuber on Humans co-existing with AIs
summary_en: Machine Learning Street Talk interview on how humans and AIs will co-exist, and on his view that much early deep-learning credit is misattributed.
summary_zh: 在 Machine Learning Street Talk 播客中谈人类与人工智能如何共存，并重申他认为早期深度学习成果归属被误置的看法。

title_en: Jurgen Schmidhuber: What can artificial intelligence do for you?
title_zh: Jurgen Schmidhuber: What can artificial intelligence do for you?
summary_en: Interview for BBVA's Aprendemos juntos, told through his own path from the 1980s ambition of building an artificial scientist to what AI can do for ordinary people.
summary_zh: 在 BBVA“Aprendemos juntos”节目中的对谈，从他 1980 年代想造出“人工科学家”的抱负讲起，谈人工智能能为普通人做什么。

title_en: Jürgen Schmidhuber - Neural and Non-Neural AI, Reasoning, Transformers, and LSTMs
title_zh: Jürgen Schmidhuber - Neural and Non-Neural AI, Reasoning, Transformers, and LSTMs
summary_en: Long-form MLST interview on neural and non-neural AI, reasoning, and the history behind transformers and LSTMs.
summary_zh: MLST 长篇访谈，谈神经与非神经方法、推理能力，以及 Transformer 与 LSTM 背后的历史。

title_en: Jürgen Schmidhuber, "Vater" der modernen KI (#693)
title_zh: Jürgen Schmidhuber, "Vater" der modernen KI (#693)
summary_en: German-language OMR Podcast interview on the opportunities and dangers of AI and on Germany's standing as a place to do the work.
summary_zh: 德语 OMR 播客访谈，谈人工智能的机遇与风险，以及德国作为研究与产业基地的处境。

title_en: Prof. Jürgen Schmidhuber - FATHER OF AI ON ITS DANGERS
title_zh: Prof. Jürgen Schmidhuber - FATHER OF AI ON ITS DANGERS
summary_en: MLST interview in which he sets out his own reading of the dangers of AI and how serious he takes them to be.
summary_zh: MLST 访谈，他在其中阐述自己对人工智能危险的判断，以及认为其严重程度几何。

source: The TWIML AI Podcast (formerly This We…
title_en: Upside-Down Reinforcement Learning with Jürgen Schmidhuber
title_zh: Upside-Down Reinforcement Learning with Jürgen Schmidhuber
summary_en: TWIML interview on Upside-Down Reinforcement Learning, his lab's reformulation of RL as supervised learning on commands.
summary_zh: TWIML 播客访谈，介绍他实验室提出的“颠倒强化学习”，即把强化学习改写为基于指令的监督学习。

title_en: Jürgen Schmidhuber: Neural Networks
title_zh: Jürgen Schmidhuber: Neural Networks
summary_en: Conversation with Jeremy Fain on the Hidden Layers podcast about neural networks.
summary_zh: 在 Hidden Layers 播客中与 Jeremy Fain 对谈神经网络。

title_en: Der Gottvater der KI: Jürgen Schmidhuber - Folge 2
title_zh: Der Gottvater der KI: Jürgen Schmidhuber - Folge 2
summary_en: Second part of an F.A.Z. podcast series on him and the deep-learning breakthroughs that trace back to his work.
summary_zh: 德国《法兰克福汇报》数字经济播客系列的第二集，讲述他其人及可追溯到他工作的深度学习突破。

source: The TWIML AI Podcast (formerly This We…
title_en: LSTMs, Plus a Deep Learning History Lesson with Jürgen Schmidhuber - TWiML Talk #44
title_zh: LSTMs, Plus a Deep Learning History Lesson with Jürgen Schmidhuber - TWiML Talk #44
summary_en: TWIML interview recorded in Switzerland on LSTMs and the history of deep learning.
summary_zh: TWIML 播客第 44 期，在瑞士录制的访谈，谈 LSTM 与深度学习的历史。

title_en: Radio Feature 35: Jurgen Schmidhuber in conversation with Sona Blessing
title_zh: Radio Feature 35: Jurgen Schmidhuber in conversation with Sona Blessing
summary_en: Early radio interview with Sona Blessing for Opalesque, from his IDSIA years.
summary_zh: 2011 年他在 IDSIA 时期接受 Opalesque 电台 Sona Blessing 的访谈。

title_en: KAUST unveils the Huxley-Gödel Machine
title_zh: KAUST 发布 Huxley-Gödel Machine
summary_en: An AI agent that evolves by rewriting and improving its own code — a working revival of his Gödel Machine proposal.
summary_zh: 一个通过改写并改进自身代码而进化的智能体 —— 其哥德尔机构想的可运行复活版。

title_en: Generative Adversarial Networks
title_zh: 生成对抗网络
summary_en: The paper that opened the first golden age of generative models.
summary_zh: 开启生成式模型第一个黄金时代的论文。

title_en: Deep Learning (the textbook)
title_zh: 《深度学习》教科书

title_en: I'm excited for the launch of @224ventureshq . I'm one of their LPs, helping to identify exceptional founders early
title_zh: I'm excited for the launch of @224ventureshq . I'm one of their LPs, helping to identify exceptional founders early
summary_en: Goodfellow announced he is a limited partner in newly launched venture fund 224 Ventures, helping identify early-stage founders.
summary_zh: Goodfellow宣布他是新成立的224 Ventures风投基金的有限合伙人，负责协助发掘早期创业者。

title_en: While Mythos has popularized the idea of finding vulnerabilities with LLMs, Aisle was doing it earlier. From an engineering point of view, it's interesting to s
title_zh: While Mythos has popularized the idea of finding vulnerabilities with LLMs, Aisle was doing it earlier. From an engineering point of view, it's interesting to s
summary_en: Commenting on LLM-based vulnerability discovery tools, Goodfellow noted that Aisle was doing this work before Mythos popularized the idea, offering an engineering-level view on small open-weight models finding exploits.
summary_zh: Goodfellow评论基于大语言模型的漏洞挖掘工具，指出Aisle早于Mythos就在做这类工作，并从工程角度分析了小型开源模型发现漏洞的能力。

title_en: My former Brain colleague @AndrewDai just launched @ElorianAI
title_zh: My former Brain colleague @AndrewDai just launched @ElorianAI
summary_en: Goodfellow flagged the launch of Elorian AI by his former Google Brain colleague Andrew Dai.
summary_zh: Goodfellow宣传了他在谷歌Brain的前同事Andrew Dai新创立的Elorian AI公司。

title_en: An article from Moonlake about why they’re building what they’re building. (I’m an advisor)
title_zh: An article from Moonlake about why they’re building what they’re building. (I’m an advisor)
summary_en: Goodfellow, an advisor to startup Moonlake, shared the company's explanation of its mission; the post drew unusually high engagement for his account.
summary_zh: 作为初创公司Moonlake的顾问，Goodfellow分享了该公司关于其使命的文章，该推文获得了远高于其账号平常水平的互动量。

title_en: I'd like to thank @daniel_rossett for his help in my recovery from the POTS version of Long COVID. Daniel was key in bringing me back from highly disabled and s
title_zh: I'd like to thank @daniel_rossett for his help in my recovery from the POTS version of Long COVID. Daniel was key in bringing me back from highly disabled and s
summary_en: Goodfellow publicly thanked the person who helped him recover from POTS-related Long COVID disability; the post drew exceptional engagement, including 170 replies, the most of any item in this review.
summary_zh: Goodfellow公开感谢帮助他从POTS长新冠致残状态中恢复的人士，该推文获得了异常高的互动量，包括170条回复，为本批次中最多。

title_en: Amazing test of Gemini 3’s multimodal reasoning capabilities: try generating a threejs voxel art scene using only an image as input Prompt: I have provided an i
title_zh: Amazing test of Gemini 3’s multimodal reasoning capabilities: try generating a threejs voxel art scene using only an image as input Prompt: I have provided an i
summary_en: Goodfellow highlighted an impressive test of Gemini 3's multimodal reasoning, generating a Three.js voxel art scene from an image prompt; his highest-engagement post reviewed here.
summary_zh: Goodfellow分享了对Gemini 3多模态推理能力的一个出色测试案例：仅凭图像提示生成Three.js体素艺术场景，这是本批次中互动量最高的一条推文。

title_en: 31: Ian Goodfellow on Inventing GANs with Peter Bauman (Deep Learning Series 02)
title_zh: 31: Ian Goodfellow on Inventing GANs with Peter Bauman (Deep Learning Series 02)
summary_en: A long-form interview in which he retells the origins of GANs and how the idea was received.
summary_zh: 长篇访谈，他回顾了 GAN 的诞生经过以及这一想法当年的接受过程。

title_en: More of what my colleagues and I have been working on in AI for fusion is public now
title_zh: More of what my colleagues and I have been working on in AI for fusion is public now
summary_en: He points to newly public work from the Google DeepMind team on applying AI to nuclear fusion, his current research focus.
summary_zh: 他介绍 Google DeepMind 团队将 AI 用于核聚变的最新公开成果，这是他目前的研究重点。

title_en: Moonlake is launching publicly today, focused on generating simulations and games. Simulations are an important application of generative models that I’ve advoc
title_zh: Moonlake is launching publicly today, focused on generating simulations and games. Simulations are an important application of generative models that I’ve advoc
summary_en: He marks the public launch of Moonlake, which generates simulations and games, tying it to the use of generative models for simulation he has argued for since 2014.
summary_zh: 他提到主打生成模拟与游戏的 Moonlake 正式发布，并称这正是他自 2014 年起主张的生成模型模拟应用方向。

title_en: Check out @snowglobe_so , the new simulation engine for testing chatbots from @guardrails_ai
title_zh: Check out @snowglobe_so , the new simulation engine for testing chatbots from @guardrails_ai
summary_en: Goodfellow recommended Snowglobe, a new chatbot-testing simulation engine from Guardrails AI.
summary_zh: Goodfellow推荐了Guardrails AI推出的新聊天机器人测试模拟引擎Snowglobe。

title_en: Benchmarks are both difficult and important. Great to see these thoughtful, open reproducible benchmarks for LLM guardrails.
title_zh: Benchmarks are both difficult and important. Great to see these thoughtful, open reproducible benchmarks for LLM guardrails.
summary_en: Goodfellow praised a new set of open, reproducible benchmarks for LLM guardrails, calling benchmarking in this space both difficult and important.
summary_zh: Goodfellow称赞了一套新的开放、可复现的大语言模型护栏基准测试，并指出这一领域的基准测试既困难又重要。

title_en: The recording of the GAN test of time talk by @dwf is now publicly available: https://t.co/qus4NnTyKW
title_zh: The recording of the GAN test of time talk by @dwf is now publicly available: https://t.co/qus4NnTyKW
summary_en: Goodfellow shared the newly public recording of the GAN 'test of time' award talk, marking recognition of his foundational 2014 work.
summary_zh: Goodfellow分享了GAN获得“时间检验奖”演讲录像的公开发布，标志着对其2014年开创性工作的认可。

title_en: My co-authors have completed one of the projects I was working on with them before I went on disability leave. Check out this great explainer thread from @davli
title_zh: My co-authors have completed one of the projects I was working on with them before I went on disability leave. Check out this great explainer thread from @davli
summary_en: Goodfellow noted his co-authors completed a research project he had been working on before going on disability leave, and pointed to an explainer thread on the results.
summary_zh: Goodfellow提到他的合著者完成了他在因病休假前一直参与的一项研究项目，并分享了介绍研究结果的推文串。

title_en: MONA: Myopic Optimization with Non-myopic Approval Can Mitigate Multi-step Reward Hacking
title_zh: MONA: Myopic Optimization with Non-myopic Approval Can Mitigate Multi-step Reward Hacking
summary_en: A DeepMind safety paper he co-authored proposing myopic optimization with non-myopic approval, a training method that stops agents learning multi-step reward-hacking strategies humans cannot evaluate.
summary_zh: 他与 DeepMind 安全团队合著的论文，提出短视优化加远视批准的训练方法，使智能体不会学到人类无法评估的多步奖励套利策略。

title_en: When Schmidhuber interrupted my talk on GANs in 2016, he did so at the time I was giving credit to relevant prior work: noise contrastive estimation. Schmidhube
title_zh: When Schmidhuber interrupted my talk on GANs in 2016, he did so at the time I was giving credit to relevant prior work: noise contrastive estimation. Schmidhube
summary_en: He gives his own account of Schmidhuber interrupting his 2016 GAN talk and of the citation dispute around the original paper.
summary_zh: 他讲述 Schmidhuber 在 2016 年打断其 GAN 报告的经过，以及围绕原始论文的引用归属争议。

title_en: Today GANs got 1 of 2 test of time awards at @NeurIPSConf . Many thanks to my co-author @dwf for preparing and presenting the talk. It’s no easy task to summari
title_zh: Today GANs got 1 of 2 test of time awards at @NeurIPSConf . Many thanks to my co-author @dwf for preparing and presenting the talk. It’s no easy task to summari
summary_en: He notes that the GAN paper received one of the two NeurIPS 2024 Test of Time awards.
summary_zh: 他表示 GAN 论文获得 NeurIPS 2024 两项时间检验奖之一。

title_en: This year I unfortunately got POTS from COVID. POTS is a failure of the body to regulate blood flow correctly, the heart has to beat extra fast to get blood to
title_zh: This year I unfortunately got POTS from COVID. POTS is a failure of the body to regulate blood flow correctly, the heart has to beat extra fast to get blood to
summary_en: He discloses publicly that he developed POTS after a COVID infection, and explains the condition and its effect on him.
summary_zh: 他公开说明自己因感染新冠而患上体位性心动过速综合征（POTS），并解释了这一病症及其对他的影响。

title_en: It’s always good to temper one’s optimism for empirically validated defenses against adversarial examples, but this is the most promising one I’ve heard of in s
title_zh: It’s always good to temper one’s optimism for empirically validated defenses against adversarial examples, but this is the most promising one I’ve heard of in s
summary_en: Goodfellow calls a newly reported defense against adversarial examples the most promising he has seen in years, while cautioning that empirical defenses deserve tempered optimism.
summary_zh: Goodfellow称一项针对对抗样本的新防御方法是他多年来见过最有希望的,但同时提醒对经验性防御方法应保持审慎乐观。

title_en: In the Google DeepMind fusion team, we're working with external collaborators to solve nuclear fusion power generation. Check out the team's 2022 Nature paper i
title_zh: In the Google DeepMind fusion team, we're working with external collaborators to solve nuclear fusion power generation. Check out the team's 2022 Nature paper i
summary_en: He describes his work on the Google DeepMind fusion team and its collaboration with EPFL on tokamak control.
summary_zh: 他介绍自己在 Google DeepMind 核聚变团队的工作，以及该团队与 EPFL 在托卡马克控制上的合作。

title_en: TORAX: A Fast and Differentiable Tokamak Transport Simulator in JAX
title_zh: TORAX: A Fast and Differentiable Tokamak Transport Simulator in JAX
summary_en: Introduces TORAX, an open-source differentiable tokamak core transport simulator written in JAX, from the Google DeepMind fusion team he works on.
summary_zh: 介绍 TORAX：用 JAX 实现的开源可微分托卡马克堆芯输运模拟器，出自他所在的 Google DeepMind 核聚变团队。

title_en: Congratulations to @ChrSzegedy on the test of time award for discovering adversarial examples! Christian actually first told Yoshua, others at LISA lab, and me
title_zh: Congratulations to @ChrSzegedy on the test of time award for discovering adversarial examples! Christian actually first told Yoshua, others at LISA lab, and me
summary_en: Goodfellow recounts the history of the discovery of adversarial examples, congratulating Christian Szegedy on a test-of-time award and noting Szegedy privately shared the finding with Bengio, others at the LISA lab, and Goodfellow himself first.
summary_zh: Goodfellow回顾了对抗样本发现的历史,祝贺Christian Szegedy获得时间检验奖,并提到Szegedy最初曾私下将这一发现告知Bengio、LISA实验室的其他人以及他本人。

title_en: Startups usually don’t say a lot about how their stack works (or it’s just a wrapper around another company’s LLM) so it’s great to get this detailed deep dive
title_zh: Startups usually don’t say a lot about how their stack works (or it’s just a wrapper around another company’s LLM) so it’s great to get this detailed deep dive
summary_en: Goodfellow praises a detailed technical deep dive into how a startup's AI stack works, noting most startups rarely disclose such details.
summary_zh: Goodfellow称赞一篇详细剖析某创业公司AI技术栈的深度文章,指出大多数创业公司很少披露此类细节。

title_en: Exciting news from my friend and GAN co-author, I’m looking forward to trying this out on my own GPU at home
title_zh: Exciting news from my friend and GAN co-author, I’m looking forward to trying this out on my own GPU at home
summary_en: Goodfellow shares excitement about a new release from a friend and fellow GAN co-author, saying he looks forward to trying it on his own GPU.
summary_zh: Goodfellow对他的朋友兼GAN论文合著者发布的新成果表示期待,并称打算在自己的GPU上试用。

title_en: I've spent several years studying machine learning security with the goal of making ML reliable before it is used in more and more important contexts. Unfortuna
title_zh: I've spent several years studying machine learning security with the goal of making ML reliable before it is used in more and more important contexts. Unfortuna
summary_en: He states publicly that machine learning capability and adoption are outrunning the security work needed to make these systems reliable.
summary_zh: 他公开表示机器学习的能力与应用速度已经超过了让这些系统变得可靠所需的安全研究。

title_en: I'm excited to announce that I've joined DeepMind! I'll be a research scientist in @OriolVinyalsML 's Deep Learning team.
title_zh: I'm excited to announce that I've joined DeepMind! I'll be a research scientist in @OriolVinyalsML 's Deep Learning team.
summary_en: He announces that he has joined DeepMind as a research scientist in Oriol Vinyals deep learning team, after leaving Apple.
summary_zh: 他宣布加入 DeepMind，在 Oriol Vinyals 的深度学习团队担任研究科学家，此前他从 Apple 离职。

title_en: Enabling certification of verification-agnostic networks via memory-efficient semidefinite programming
title_zh: Enabling certification of verification-agnostic networks via memory-efficient semidefinite programming
summary_en: Presents a memory-efficient semidefinite programming method that can certify robustness for networks never designed to be verified.
summary_zh: 提出一种省内存的半正定规划方法，可为并非为验证而设计的网络提供鲁棒性认证。

title_en: Creating High Resolution Images with a Latent Adversarial Generator
title_zh: Creating High Resolution Images with a Latent Adversarial Generator
summary_en: Proposes a latent adversarial generator that produces high-resolution images from low-resolution inputs, continuing his work on generative models.
summary_zh: 提出潜在对抗生成器，从低分辨率输入生成高分辨率图像，延续他在生成模型方向的研究。

title_en: MixMatch: A Holistic Approach to Semi-Supervised Learning
title_zh: MixMatch: A Holistic Approach to Semi-Supervised Learning
summary_en: MixMatch unifies the dominant semi-supervised learning approaches into a single algorithm; a heavily cited result he co-authored at Google.
summary_zh: MixMatch 将主流半监督学习方法统一为单一算法，是他在 Google 期间合著的高引用成果。

title_en: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs)
title_zh: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs)
summary_en: His Lex Fridman Podcast interview on generative adversarial networks, deep learning and where the field is heading.
summary_zh: 他做客 Lex Fridman 播客，谈生成对抗网络、深度学习以及该领域的走向。

title_en: Imperceptible, Robust, and Targeted Adversarial Examples for Automatic Speech Recognition
title_zh: Imperceptible, Robust, and Targeted Adversarial Examples for Automatic Speech Recognition
summary_en: Shows that imperceptible, robust and targeted adversarial examples can be built against automatic speech recognition, extending adversarial-example research beyond images.
summary_zh: 证明可以针对自动语音识别构造不可察觉、稳健且定向的对抗样本，将对抗样本研究从图像扩展到语音。

title_en: A Research Agenda: Dynamic Models to Defend Against Correlated Attacks
title_zh: A Research Agenda: Dynamic Models to Defend Against Correlated Attacks
summary_en: A single-author research agenda setting out how to defend machine learning models against correlated adversarial inputs at test time.
summary_zh: 他独著的研究议程，提出在测试阶段防御机器学习模型免受相关性对抗输入攻击的方向。

title_en: On Evaluating Adversarial Robustness
title_zh: On Evaluating Adversarial Robustness
summary_en: A community checklist, written with Carlini, Madry and others, for correctly evaluating defences against adversarial examples.
summary_zh: 他与 Carlini、Madry 等人合写的社区检查清单，用于正确评估对抗样本的防御方法。

title_en: A domain agnostic measure for monitoring and evaluating GANs
title_zh: A domain agnostic measure for monitoring and evaluating GANs
summary_en: Proposes a domain-agnostic measure for monitoring and evaluating GAN training, addressing a long-standing evaluation gap in the models he invented.
summary_zh: 提出与领域无关的 GAN 训练监控与评估指标，针对他所发明模型长期存在的评估难题。

title_en: New CleverHans Feature: Better Adversarial Robustness Evaluations with Attack Bundling
title_zh: New CleverHans Feature: Better Adversarial Robustness Evaluations with Attack Bundling
summary_en: A technical report on attack bundling, a new feature of CleverHans, the adversarial-example library he founded.
summary_zh: 技术报告，介绍他创建的对抗样本库 CleverHans 新增的攻击打包功能。

title_en: Discriminator Rejection Sampling
title_zh: Discriminator Rejection Sampling
summary_en: Uses a GAN discriminator as a rejection sampler to correct errors in the generator distribution.
summary_zh: 利用 GAN 判别器做拒绝采样，以修正生成器分布中的偏差。

title_en: Local Explanation Methods for Deep Neural Networks Lack Sensitivity to Parameter Values
title_zh: Local Explanation Methods for Deep Neural Networks Lack Sensitivity to Parameter Values
summary_en: Shows that several popular local explanation methods for deep networks barely respond to the model parameters, questioning what they actually explain.
summary_zh: 指出多种流行的深度网络局部解释方法对模型参数几乎不敏感，质疑它们到底解释了什么。

title_en: Sanity Checks for Saliency Maps
title_zh: Sanity Checks for Saliency Maps
summary_en: Introduces randomization tests showing that several widely used saliency methods are independent of both the model and the training data.
summary_zh: 提出随机化检验，表明若干被广泛使用的显著图方法与模型和训练数据无关。

title_en: Unrestricted Adversarial Examples
title_zh: Unrestricted Adversarial Examples
summary_en: Launches a two-player contest on unrestricted adversarial examples, pushing robustness evaluation beyond norm-bounded perturbations.
summary_zh: 发起关于无限制对抗样本的双方竞赛，将鲁棒性评估推出范数受限扰动的框架。

title_en: Skill Rating for Generative Models
title_zh: Skill Rating for Generative Models
summary_en: Evaluates generative models by holding tournaments between generators and discriminators and rating them like competing players.
summary_zh: 通过让生成器与判别器相互对局并按选手评分的方式来评估生成模型。

title_en: TensorFuzz: Debugging Neural Networks with Coverage-Guided Fuzzing
title_zh: TensorFuzz: Debugging Neural Networks with Coverage-Guided Fuzzing
summary_en: Brings coverage-guided fuzzing from software testing to neural networks, finding numerical errors and disagreements between models.
summary_zh: 将软件测试中的覆盖引导模糊测试引入神经网络，用于发现数值错误和模型之间的不一致。

title_en: Understanding and Improving Interpolation in Autoencoders via an Adversarial Regularizer
title_zh: Understanding and Improving Interpolation in Autoencoders via an Adversarial Regularizer
summary_en: Improves interpolation in autoencoder latent spaces with an adversarial regularizer, and shows better representations follow.
summary_zh: 用对抗正则项改善自编码器隐空间的插值质量，并表明由此学到更好的表征。

title_en: Motivating the Rules of the Game for Adversarial Example Research
title_zh: Motivating the Rules of the Game for Adversarial Example Research
summary_en: Argues that the standard threat model in adversarial-example research does not match real security settings, and proposes better rules for the field.
summary_zh: 指出对抗样本研究常用的威胁模型与真实安全场景不符，并为该领域提出更合理的研究规则。

title_en: Adversarial Reprogramming of Neural Networks
title_zh: Adversarial Reprogramming of Neural Networks
summary_en: Shows an attacker can reprogram a trained neural network to perform a task of the attacker choosing, a new class of attack he co-authored.
summary_zh: 证明攻击者可将已训练的神经网络重新编程去执行攻击者选定的任务，是他合著提出的一类新攻击。

title_en: Defense Against the Dark Arts: An overview of adversarial example security research and future research directions
title_zh: Defense Against the Dark Arts: An overview of adversarial example security research and future research directions
summary_en: His keynote summary of the state of adversarial-example defences and the research directions he thinks matter next.
summary_zh: 他的主旨报告总结，梳理对抗样本防御的现状以及他认为下一步值得推进的研究方向。

title_en: Self-Attention Generative Adversarial Networks
title_zh: Self-Attention Generative Adversarial Networks
summary_en: Self-Attention GAN adds attention to image generation so it can model long-range dependencies, and became a standard architecture in the field he started.
summary_zh: 自注意力 GAN 为图像生成引入注意力机制以建模长程依赖，成为他所开创领域中的标准架构之一。

title_en: Realistic Evaluation of Deep Semi-Supervised Learning Algorithms
title_zh: Realistic Evaluation of Deep Semi-Supervised Learning Algorithms
summary_en: Shows that common semi-supervised learning benchmarks overstate the gains of new methods, and proposes a fairer evaluation protocol.
summary_zh: 指出常见半监督学习基准高估了新方法的收益，并提出更公平的评估流程。

title_en: Gradient Masking Causes CLEVER to Overestimate Adversarial Perturbation Size
title_zh: Gradient Masking Causes CLEVER to Overestimate Adversarial Perturbation Size
summary_en: Shows that gradient masking makes the CLEVER metric overestimate how large a perturbation is needed to fool a model.
summary_zh: 指出梯度掩蔽会使 CLEVER 指标高估欺骗模型所需的扰动大小。

title_en: Adversarial Attacks and Defences Competition
title_zh: Adversarial Attacks and Defences Competition
summary_en: Reports the NIPS 2017 competition he helped organise at Google Brain on attacking and defending image classifiers.
summary_zh: 总结他在 Google Brain 参与组织的 NIPS 2017 对抗攻击与防御竞赛。

title_en: Adversarial Logit Pairing
title_zh: Adversarial Logit Pairing
summary_en: Scales adversarial training to ImageNet and adds logit pairing as a cheaper way to improve robustness.
summary_zh: 将对抗训练扩展到 ImageNet 规模，并提出以 logit 配对作为更廉价的鲁棒性提升方法。

title_en: Ep. 25: Google's Ian Goodfellow on How an Argument in a Bar Led to Generative Adversarial Networks
title_zh: Ep. 25: Google's Ian Goodfellow on How an Argument in a Bar Led to Generative Adversarial Networks
summary_en: He tells the NVIDIA AI Podcast how an argument in a bar led him to invent generative adversarial networks.
summary_zh: 他在 NVIDIA AI 播客中讲述一场酒吧争论如何促成他发明生成对抗网络。

title_en: The Robot Brains Podcast
title_zh: The Robot Brains 播客
summary_en: His long-running interview series with the people building embodied AI.
summary_zh: 他长期主持的访谈系列，对象是正在建造具身智能的人。

title_en: Domain randomization / Sim-to-real transfer
title_zh: 域随机化与仿真到现实迁移

title_en: Humanoid Safe Stop via Learned Stoppability Value
title_zh: Humanoid Safe Stop via Learned Stoppability Value
summary_en: Co-authored a paper proposing a learned 'stoppability value' so humanoid robots can judge whether an emergency stop is actually safe from their current state.
summary_zh: 合著论文提出一种可学习的“可停止性价值”，使人形机器人能够判断当前状态下紧急停止是否真正安全。

title_en: VLK: Learning Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Synthetic Interactions in Reconstructed Scenes
title_zh: VLK: Learning Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Synthetic Interactions in Reconstructed Scenes
summary_en: VLK learns humanoid loco-manipulation by generating synthetic human-object interactions inside 3D-reconstructed real scenes, so egocentric vision maps to whole-body motion without teleoperation data.
summary_zh: VLK 在三维重建的真实场景中合成人与物体的交互数据，让人形机器人学会移动加操作，无需遥操作数据即可把第一人称视觉映射到全身动作。

title_en: Scalable Behavior Cloning with Open Data, Training, and Evaluation
title_zh: Scalable Behavior Cloning with Open Data, Training, and Evaluation
summary_en: ABC releases a fully open behavior-cloning stack for manipulation, including ABC-130K, a 3,500-hour teleoperation dataset that is the largest open one to date.
summary_zh: ABC 开源了一整套面向操作任务的行为克隆技术栈，其中 ABC-130K 是迄今最大的开源遥操作数据集，含 3500 小时数据。

title_en: Do as I Do: Dexterous Manipulation Data from Everyday Human Videos
title_zh: Do as I Do: Dexterous Manipulation Data from Everyday Human Videos
summary_en: A method for turning ordinary human videos into training data for dexterous multi-fingered hands, attacking the data bottleneck in manipulation.
summary_zh: 提出把日常人类视频转化为灵巧多指手训练数据的方法，针对操作学习中的数据瓶颈。

title_en: T-Rex: Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation
title_zh: T-Rex: Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation
summary_en: T-Rex adds tactile reactivity to vision-language-action models, letting a dexterous hand respond to contact signals rather than vision alone.
summary_zh: T-Rex 为视觉-语言-动作模型加入触觉反应能力，使灵巧手能够依据接触信号而不仅仅是视觉做出反应。

title_en: DiPOD: Diffusion Policy Optimization without Drifting Apart
title_zh: DiPOD: Diffusion Policy Optimization without Drifting Apart
summary_en: DiPOD makes reinforcement-learning post-training of diffusion policies stable, addressing the unreliable policy improvement of existing diffusion policy-gradient methods.
summary_zh: DiPOD 让扩散策略的强化学习后训练变得稳定，解决现有扩散策略梯度方法难以可靠提升策略的问题。

title_en: Mana: Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Tools
title_zh: Mana: Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Tools
summary_en: Mana tackles dexterous manipulation of articulated tools, where the robot must coordinate a tool's own moving parts through contact-rich interaction.
summary_zh: Mana 研究对铰接工具的灵巧操作——机器人需要在富接触的交互中协调工具自身的活动部件。

title_en: SARM2: Multi-Task Stage Aware Reward Modeling for Self Improving Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: SARM2: Multi-Task Stage Aware Reward Modeling for Self Improving Robotic Manipulation
summary_en: SARM2 replaces costly demonstrations with stage-aware multi-task reward models so vision-language-action policies can improve themselves on long-horizon manipulation.
summary_zh: SARM2 用阶段感知的多任务奖励模型替代昂贵的示范数据，使视觉-语言-动作策略能在长时序操作任务上自我改进。

title_en: LadderMan: Learning Humanoid Perceptive Ladder Climbing
title_zh: LadderMan: Learning Humanoid Perceptive Ladder Climbing
summary_en: LadderMan trains a humanoid to climb ladders from perception, one of the hardest whole-body tasks because footholds and handholds are sparse.
summary_zh: LadderMan 训练人形机器人依靠感知攀爬梯子——由于落脚点和抓握点稀疏，这是最困难的全身控制任务之一。

title_en: Multi-Objective Learning for Diffusion Models: A Statistical Theory under Semi-Supervised Learning
title_zh: Multi-Objective Learning for Diffusion Models: A Statistical Theory under Semi-Supervised Learning
summary_en: A statistical theory for training diffusion models against several target distributions at once under semi-supervised data.
summary_zh: 为半监督数据下同时面向多个目标分布训练扩散模型建立统计理论。

title_en: When Does Non-Uniform Replay Matter in Reinforcement Learning?
title_zh: When Does Non-Uniform Replay Matter in Reinforcement Learning?
summary_en: An empirical study of when non-uniform replay sampling actually beats plain uniform replay in off-policy reinforcement learning.
summary_zh: 实证研究离策略强化学习中非均匀回放采样究竟在什么条件下能胜过简单的均匀回放。

title_en: World Model for Robot Learning: A Comprehensive Survey
title_zh: World Model for Robot Learning: A Comprehensive Survey
summary_en: A comprehensive survey of world models in robot learning, covering their use in policy learning, planning, simulation and evaluation.
summary_zh: 关于机器人学习中世界模型的综述，涵盖其在策略学习、规划、仿真与评估中的应用。

title_en: Cross-Hand Latent Representation for Vision-Language-Action Models
title_zh: Cross-Hand Latent Representation for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary_en: A shared latent representation that lets one vision-language-action model transfer across different robot hands.
summary_zh: 提出跨手型的共享隐空间表示，使同一个视觉-语言-动作模型能够迁移到不同的机器人手上。

title_en: Offline Materials Optimization with CliqueFlowmer
title_zh: Offline Materials Optimization with CliqueFlowmer
summary_en: Paper applying an offline model-based optimization method, CliqueFlowmer, to computational materials discovery.
summary_zh: 论文提出 CliqueFlowmer，用离线基于模型的优化方法做计算材料发现。

title_en: Reward-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Reward-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Reward-conditioned RL trains a single agent across reward functions instead of one fixed reward, improving robustness to reward misspecification and shifting preferences.
summary_zh: 奖励条件化强化学习让单个智能体在多种奖励函数下训练，而非固定于一个奖励，从而对奖励设定错误和偏好变化更鲁棒。

title_en: How to Peel with a Knife: Aligning Fine-Grained Manipulation with Human Preference
title_zh: How to Peel with a Knife: Aligning Fine-Grained Manipulation with Human Preference
summary_en: Aligns fine-grained, force-sensitive manipulation such as peeling with a knife to human preference, targeting tasks robots still cannot do.
summary_zh: 将用刀削皮这类精细、对力敏感的操作与人类偏好对齐，瞄准机器人目前仍无法胜任的任务。

title_en: D-REX: Differentiable Real-to-Sim-to-Real Engine for Learning Dexterous Grasping
title_zh: D-REX: Differentiable Real-to-Sim-to-Real Engine for Learning Dexterous Grasping
summary_en: D-REX is a differentiable real-to-sim-to-real engine that narrows the simulation gap for learning dexterous grasping.
summary_zh: D-REX 是一个可微分的真实-仿真-真实引擎，用于缩小灵巧抓取学习中的仿真与现实差距。

title_en: Perceptive Humanoid Parkour: Chaining Dynamic Human Skills via Motion Matching
title_zh: Perceptive Humanoid Parkour: Chaining Dynamic Human Skills via Motion Matching
summary_en: Chains dynamic human skills through motion matching to give a humanoid perceptive parkour, going beyond stable walking to highly agile motion.
summary_zh: 通过动作匹配将人类的动态技能串联起来，让人形机器人具备感知式跑酷能力，从稳定行走进阶到高度敏捷的运动。

title_en: DreamDojo: A Generalist Robot World Model from Large-Scale Human Videos
title_zh: DreamDojo: A Generalist Robot World Model from Large-Scale Human Videos
summary_en: DreamDojo trains a generalist robot world model from large-scale human video, so agents can simulate the outcomes of their actions across varied environments.
summary_zh: DreamDojo 利用大规模人类视频训练通用机器人世界模型，使智能体能在多样环境中预演自身动作的结果。

title_en: RPL: Learning Robust Humanoid Perceptive Locomotion on Challenging Terrains
title_zh: RPL: Learning Robust Humanoid Perceptive Locomotion on Challenging Terrains
summary_en: RPL trains robust multi-directional perceptive locomotion for humanoids on challenging terrain.
summary_zh: RPL 训练人形机器人在复杂地形上实现鲁棒的全方向感知式运动。

title_en: Flow Policy Gradients for Robot Control
title_zh: Flow Policy Gradients for Robot Control
summary_en: Flow policy gradients drop the requirement for differentiable action likelihoods, freeing robot control policies from the constraints that likelihood-based methods impose.
summary_zh: 流策略梯度取消了对可微动作似然的依赖，使机器人控制策略摆脱基于似然的方法所施加的限制。

title_en: mjlab: A Lightweight Framework for GPU-Accelerated Robot Learning
title_zh: mjlab: A Lightweight Framework for GPU-Accelerated Robot Learning
summary_en: mjlab is an open-source, GPU-accelerated robot learning framework built for composable environments and minimal setup.
summary_zh: mjlab 是一个开源的 GPU 加速机器人学习框架，强调环境可组合与极低的配置成本。

title_en: Contact-Aware Neural Dynamics
title_zh: Contact-Aware Neural Dynamics
summary_en: Contact-aware neural dynamics models the discontinuous physics of contact, aiming to close the sim-to-real gap on dynamic interaction tasks.
summary_zh: 接触感知神经动力学建模接触过程中的不连续物理，旨在缩小动态交互任务上的仿真到现实差距。

title_en: Large Video Planner Enables Generalizable Robot Control
title_zh: Large Video Planner Enables Generalizable Robot Control
summary_en: A large video planner used as a robot decision-making model, generalising control across tasks and environments.
summary_zh: 将大型视频规划器用作机器人决策模型，实现跨任务、跨环境的通用控制。

title_en: SEMDICE: Off-policy State Entropy Maximization via Stationary Distribution Correction Estimation
title_zh: SEMDICE: Off-policy State Entropy Maximization via Stationary Distribution Correction Estimation
summary_en: SEMDICE maximises state entropy off-policy via stationary distribution correction, for unsupervised reinforcement-learning pre-training without task rewards.
summary_zh: SEMDICE 通过平稳分布校正在离策略设定下最大化状态熵，用于无需任务奖励的强化学习无监督预训练。

title_en: Learning Sim-to-Real Humanoid Locomotion in 15 Minutes
title_zh: Learning Sim-to-Real Humanoid Locomotion in 15 Minutes
summary_en: Cuts sim-to-real reinforcement learning for humanoid locomotion down to fifteen minutes of training.
summary_zh: 把人形机器人运动控制的仿真到现实强化学习训练时间压缩到 15 分钟。

title_en: DexterityGen: Foundation Controller for Unprecedented Dexterity
title_zh: DexterityGen: Foundation Controller for Unprecedented Dexterity
summary_en: Abbeel co-authors DexterityGen, a foundation controller that pretrains large-scale dexterous motion primitives with RL and stabilizes in-hand manipulation 10-100x, enabling tool use like pens and screwdrivers.
summary_zh: Abbeel参与的DexterityGen是一个基础控制器，通过强化学习预训练大规模灵巧运动基元，将手内操作稳定性提升10到100倍，实现了握笔、拧螺丝刀等工具使用。

title_en: FastTD3: "Minimum innovation, maximum results" Not the paper we had planned to write, but one of the works I am most proud of. We wanted to make sure our baseli
title_zh: FastTD3: "Minimum innovation, maximum results" Not the paper we had planned to write, but one of the works I am most proud of. We wanted to make sure our baseli
summary_en: Abbeel introduces FastTD3, a work he describes as minimum innovation and maximum results, built from making TD3 a genuinely strong baseline.
summary_zh: Abbeel 介绍 FastTD3，他称之为"最小创新、最大效果"的工作，源于把 TD3 做成一个真正扎实的基线。

title_en: I'm thrilled to share our first release as the AGI SF Lab. Meet Nova Act -- the most effortless way to build agents that can reliably use browsers, giving agent
title_zh: I'm thrilled to share our first release as the AGI SF Lab. Meet Nova Act -- the most effortless way to build agents that can reliably use browsers, giving agent
summary_en: Abbeel announces Nova Act, the first release from Amazon's AGI SF Lab, a model for building agents that reliably operate web browsers.
summary_zh: Abbeel 发布 Nova Act，这是亚马逊 AGI SF Lab 的首个产品，用于构建能可靠操作浏览器的智能体。

title_en: Gave a lecture on Diffusion Models yesterday with @wilson1yan and @kvfrans https://t.co/JX3zkWxY9v Thanks to it being Lecture 6 into the semester (rather than L
title_zh: Gave a lecture on Diffusion Models yesterday with @wilson1yan and @kvfrans https://t.co/JX3zkWxY9v Thanks to it being Lecture 6 into the semester (rather than L
summary_en: Abbeel shares the diffusion-models lecture he gave in his Berkeley deep generative models course, updated to cover Sora.
summary_zh: Abbeel 分享他在伯克利深度生成模型课程上讲授的扩散模型一课，内容已更新到涵盖 Sora。

title_en: Current works are restricted to short sequences of texts and images, limiting their ability to model the world. Presenting Large World Model (LWM): capable of p
title_zh: Current works are restricted to short sequences of texts and images, limiting their ability to model the world. Presenting Large World Model (LWM): capable of p
summary_en: Abbeel presents Large World Model (LWM), which extends multimodal modelling from short text and image sequences to long text, images and video.
summary_zh: Abbeel 发布 Large World Model（LWM），将多模态建模从短文本和图像序列扩展到长文本、图像与视频。

title_en: Jitendra Malik: Building AI from the ground-up, sensorimotor before language
title_zh: Jitendra Malik: Building AI from the ground-up, sensorimotor before language
summary_en: As host of The Robot Brains Podcast, Abbeel talks with Jitendra Malik about building AI from the ground up, sensorimotor learning before language.
summary_zh: 作为《Robot Brains》播客主持人，Abbeel与Jitendra Malik探讨了自下而上构建AI、感知运动先于语言的研究思路。

title_en: Seb Boyer of Farmwise: AI that helps feed the world
title_zh: Seb Boyer of Farmwise: AI that helps feed the world
summary_en: Abbeel hosts Farmwise's Seb Boyer to discuss applying AI to agricultural robotics to help feed the world.
summary_zh: Abbeel主持本期节目，邀请Farmwise的Seb Boyer探讨如何用农业机器人技术运用AI助力全球粮食生产。

title_en: John Schulman of OpenAI on ChatGPT: invention, capabilities and limitations
title_zh: John Schulman of OpenAI on ChatGPT: invention, capabilities and limitations
summary_en: Abbeel hosts OpenAI co-founder John Schulman to discuss ChatGPT's invention, capabilities, and limitations.
summary_zh: Abbeel主持本期节目，邀请OpenAI联合创始人John Schulman探讨ChatGPT的发明、能力与局限。

title_en: Jesse Levinson of Zoox: reinventing personal transportation from the ground up
title_zh: Jesse Levinson of Zoox: reinventing personal transportation from the ground up
summary_en: Abbeel hosts Zoox co-founder and CTO Jesse Levinson to discuss reinventing personal transportation.
summary_zh: Abbeel主持本期节目，邀请Zoox联合创始人兼CTO Jesse Levinson探讨重塑个人出行方式。

title_en: Rocky Duan: from OpenAI to Covariant and building foundation models for robotic automation
title_zh: Rocky Duan: from OpenAI to Covariant and building foundation models for robotic automation
summary_en: Abbeel hosts Covariant CTO Rocky Duan on his path from OpenAI to building foundation models for robotic automation.
summary_zh: Abbeel主持本期节目，邀请Covariant CTO Rocky Duan讲述从OpenAI到为机器人自动化构建基础模型的历程。

title_en: Yejin Choi: teaching AI common sense and morality
title_zh: Yejin Choi: teaching AI common sense and morality
summary_en: Abbeel hosts Yejin Choi to discuss teaching AI common sense and morality.
summary_zh: Abbeel主持本期节目，邀请Yejin Choi探讨如何教会AI常识与道德判断。

title_en: Nando de Freitas of DeepMind: generalizable AI to benefit everyone
title_zh: Nando de Freitas of DeepMind: generalizable AI to benefit everyone
summary_en: Abbeel hosts The Robot Brains Podcast and interviews DeepMind's Nando de Freitas about generalizable AI.
summary_zh: 阿贝尔主持《Robot Brains》播客，本期采访DeepMind的Nando de Freitas，探讨通用人工智能。

title_en: Super-excited to kick off S3 of @therobotbrains podcast with Yoshua Bengio. We discuss LLMs, Higher-Level Cognition, Causality, GFlow Nets, Responsible AI, Huma
title_zh: Super-excited to kick off S3 of @therobotbrains podcast with Yoshua Bengio. We discuss LLMs, Higher-Level Cognition, Causality, GFlow Nets, Responsible AI, Huma
summary_en: Abbeel opens season three of his podcast The Robot Brains with Yoshua Bengio, on LLMs, higher-level cognition, causality and GFlowNets.
summary_zh: Abbeel 以与 Yoshua Bengio 的对谈开启其播客 The Robot Brains 第三季，话题涵盖大语言模型、高阶认知、因果性与 GFlowNets。

title_en: Chatting with @geoffreyhinton was really inspiring, so excited to get to share our conversation: Apple: https://t.co/FMZbI1AbkI Spotify: https://t.co/Kl40l59WA9
title_zh: Chatting with @geoffreyhinton was really inspiring, so excited to get to share our conversation: Apple: https://t.co/FMZbI1AbkI Spotify: https://t.co/Kl40l59WA9
summary_en: Abbeel releases his Robot Brains conversation with Geoffrey Hinton.
summary_zh: Abbeel 发布他在 The Robot Brains 中与 Geoffrey Hinton 的对谈。

title_en: Sergey Levine explains the challenges of real world robotics
title_zh: Sergey Levine explains the challenges of real world robotics
summary_en: Abbeel hosts close collaborator Sergey Levine to discuss the challenges of real-world robotics.
summary_zh: Abbeel主持本期节目，邀请长期合作者Sergey Levine探讨现实世界机器人技术面临的挑战。

title_en: Excited to share the epic Season 1 finale of @therobotbrains with the amazing @ilyasut Co-Founder/Chief Scientist @OpenAI! His breakthroughs include AlexNet, se
title_zh: Excited to share the epic Season 1 finale of @therobotbrains with the amazing @ilyasut Co-Founder/Chief Scientist @OpenAI! His breakthroughs include AlexNet, se
summary_en: Abbeel closes season one of The Robot Brains with Ilya Sutskever, covering the run of breakthroughs from AlexNet through GPT and CLIP.
summary_zh: Abbeel 以与 Ilya Sutskever 的对谈收官 The Robot Brains 第一季，回顾从 AlexNet 到 GPT、CLIP 的一系列突破。

title_en: I believe ultimately most of the challenges towards value creation will be in the AI. But setting that aside, what's the hardest R&D ahead for hardware? I a
title_zh: I believe ultimately most of the challenges towards value creation will be in the AI. But setting that aside, what's the hardest R&D ahead for hardware? I a
summary_en: Abbeel argues that most of the value in robotics will be unlocked by AI rather than hardware, and names human-level hands as the hardest hardware problem remaining.
summary_zh: Abbeel 认为机器人领域的价值主要将由 AI 而非硬件释放，并指出剩下最难的硬件问题是"达到人类水平的手"。

title_en: On Ep20 of @therobotbrains , I sit down with the amazing @drfeifei, Co-Director of @StanfordHAI, Member of Nat'l Acad. of Medicine She shares ImageNet origin st
title_zh: On Ep20 of @therobotbrains , I sit down with the amazing @drfeifei, Co-Director of @StanfordHAI, Member of Nat'l Acad. of Medicine She shares ImageNet origin st
summary_en: Abbeel interviews Fei-Fei Li on The Robot Brains, where she recounts the origins of ImageNet.
summary_zh: Abbeel 在 The Robot Brains 中访谈李飞飞，她讲述了 ImageNet 的缘起。

title_en: Fei-Fei Li on revolutionizing AI for the real world
title_zh: Fei-Fei Li on revolutionizing AI for the real world
summary_en: Abbeel hosts Fei-Fei Li on his Robot Brains podcast, discussing her work bringing AI into the physical world.
summary_zh: Abbeel在其主持的The Robot Brains Podcast节目中对谈李飞飞,探讨她将AI引入现实物理世界的工作。

title_en: Peter Chen on building brains for robots in the real world
title_zh: Peter Chen on building brains for robots in the real world
summary_en: Abbeel hosts close collaborator Peter Chen, Covariant's CEO and co-founder, on building brains for real-world robots.
summary_zh: Abbeel主持本期节目，邀请其密切合作者、Covariant联合创始人兼CEO Peter Chen，探讨为现实世界机器人打造智能核心。

title_en: Andrej Karpathy on the visionary AI in Tesla's autonomous driving
title_zh: Andrej Karpathy on the visionary AI in Tesla's autonomous driving
summary_en: In the podcast's first-ever episode, Abbeel hosts Andrej Karpathy to discuss the AI behind Tesla's autonomous driving.
summary_zh: 在播客首期节目中，Abbeel邀请Andrej Karpathy探讨特斯拉自动驾驶背后的AI技术。

title_en: Pieter Abbeel: Deep Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Pieter Abbeel: Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Abbeel is the guest on the Lex Fridman Podcast, discussing deep reinforcement learning and how robots learn to act in the physical world.
summary_zh: Abbeel 做客 Lex Fridman 播客，谈深度强化学习以及机器人如何学习在物理世界中行动。

title_en: Frontier Model Research becomes Amazon's top AI priority
title_zh: 前沿模型研究成为亚马逊 AI 的最高优先级
summary_en: Amazon wound down active development of Nova Premier, Nova Omni, Reel and Canvas, keeping Nova 2 Lite, Nova 2 Sonic, Nova Forge and Nova Act. Resources shifted to FMR, whose new flagship foundation model is expected at re:Invent in autumn 2026. Amazon also laid off staff in the AGI unit in July.
summary_zh: 亚马逊停止 Nova Premier、Nova Omni、Reel 与 Canvas 的active开发，保留 Nova 2 Lite、Nova 2 Sonic、Nova Forge 与 Nova Act。资源转向 FMR，其新旗舰基础模型预计在 2026 年秋季 re:Invent 亮相。7 月亚马逊亦在 AGI 部门裁员。

title_en: Amazon retires most Nova AI models as Pieter Abbeel leads
title_zh: Amazon retires most Nova AI models as Pieter Abbeel leads
summary_en: Amazon retires most of its self-built Nova models, including Premier, Omni, Reel and Canvas, and redirects staff and funding into the Frontier Model Research effort Abbeel leads, with a single flagship model due at re:Invent.
summary_zh: 亚马逊下线自研 Nova 系列中的大部分模型（含 Premier、Omni、Reel 和 Canvas），把人力与资金转向 Abbeel 领导的 Frontier Model Research，计划在 re:Invent 上推出单一旗舰模型。

title_en: A new paradigm for unifying the digital and physical worlds
title_zh: 统一数字世界与物理世界的新范式
summary_en: Delivered alongside the release of Vidu S1.
summary_zh: 与 Vidu S1 发布同场。

title_en: Why Does Post-Training Quantization Work?
title_zh: Why Does Post-Training Quantization Work?
summary_en: With longtime TSAIL collaborator Jianfei Chen, Zhu explains why post-training quantization of LLM weights works despite the errors it introduces.
summary_zh: 朱军与长期合作者陈健飞（TSAIL）合作，解释了为何大模型训练后量化即使引入误差仍然有效。

title_en: Vidu S2: Real-Time Interactive, Editable, and Spatial Video Generation
title_zh: Vidu S2: Real-Time Interactive, Editable, and Spatial Video Generation
summary_en: Zhu's team releases Vidu S2, adding a real-time interactive digital-character model and real-time video editing to Shengshu's Vidu line.
summary_zh: 朱军团队发布Vidu S2，为生数科技Vidu系列新增实时交互数字人模型和实时视频编辑能力。

title_en: ProCA: Progressive Contrastive Alignment for Robust EEG Visual Decoding
title_zh: ProCA: Progressive Contrastive Alignment for Robust EEG Visual Decoding
summary_en: Co-authored paper proposing a progressive contrastive alignment method for decoding visual semantics from EEG signals; Zhu Jun appears alongside frequent Tsinghua TSAIL collaborator Liyuan Wang, confirming this is the Tsinghua professor rather than a namesake.
summary_zh: 朱军合著论文，提出一种用于从脑电信号解码视觉语义的渐进式对比对齐方法；合著者包括其清华TSAIL团队常见合作者王力远，确认为清华教授本人而非同名者。

title_en: MePo++: Unifying Representation Refinement and Reconciliation for General Continual Learning
title_zh: MePo++: Unifying Representation Refinement and Reconciliation for General Continual Learning
summary_en: Co-authored paper on a continual learning method unifying representation refinement and reconciliation; Zhu Jun appears alongside longtime TSAIL collaborator Hang Su, confirming this is the Tsinghua professor.
summary_zh: 朱军合著论文，提出一种统一表征精炼与协调的持续学习方法；合著者包括其清华TSAIL团队长期合作者苏航，确认为清华教授本人。

title_en: SR-Edit: Region-Aware Image Editing via Self-Refinement
title_zh: SR-Edit: Region-Aware Image Editing via Self-Refinement
summary_en: Zhu Jun (Tsinghua, corresponding author) co-authored SR-Edit, a region-aware image editing method that refines generative edits to precisely target regions while preserving the rest of the image.
summary_zh: 朱军（清华大学，通讯作者）合著论文SR-Edit，提出一种区域感知的图像编辑自优化方法，可精确修改目标区域同时保持其余部分不变。

title_en: Physical Adversarial Examples for Person Detectors in Thermal Images Based on 3D Modeling
title_zh: Physical Adversarial Examples for Person Detectors in Thermal Images Based on 3D Modeling
summary_en: Zhu Jun and longtime Tsinghua collaborators Jianmin Li and Xiaolin Hu propose 3D-modeled infrared adversarial clothing that evades thermal person detectors, extending his adversarial-robustness research to physical-world attacks.
summary_zh: 朱军与清华长期合作者李建民、胡晓林提出基于3D建模的红外对抗服装，可躲避热成像人体检测器，将其对抗鲁棒性研究扩展到物理世界攻击场景。

title_en: Motus2: A Self-Evolving General World Model for Dexterous Manipulation
title_zh: Motus2: A Self-Evolving General World Model for Dexterous Manipulation
summary_en: Zhu Jun co-authors Motus2, a self-evolving world model unifying policy, simulation and evaluation in one network for dexterous robotic manipulation, extending his diffusion/world-model work into embodied AI.
summary_zh: 朱军参与提出Motus2，一个将策略、仿真与评估统一于同一网络的自演化世界模型，用于灵巧机器人操作，是其扩散模型/世界模型研究向具身智能方向的延伸。

title_en: Beyond Language Priors: Diagnosing and Fixing Visual-Origin Hallucinations in Multimodal LLM
title_zh: Beyond Language Priors: Diagnosing and Fixing Visual-Origin Hallucinations in Multimodal LLM
summary_en: Zhu Jun co-authored a paper diagnosing and fixing visual-origin hallucinations in multimodal LLMs, tracing them to visual processing rather than language priors alone.
summary_zh: 朱军合著论文，诊断并修复多模态大模型中源自视觉的幻觉问题，指出其成因不止于语言先验。

title_en: Task-State Adaptation with Prototype Memory for Multi-Task Dense Prediction
title_zh: Task-State Adaptation with Prototype Memory for Multi-Task Dense Prediction
summary_en: Zhu Jun is corresponding author on MemMTL, a multi-task dense-prediction framework that adapts vision foundation backbones via a learnable task-state prototype memory, evaluated on NYUD-v2 and PASCAL-Context.
summary_zh: 朱军担任通讯作者，提出多任务密集预测框架MemMTL，通过可学习的任务状态原型记忆来适配视觉基础骨干网络，并在NYUD-v2和PASCAL-Context数据集上完成评估。

title_en: TurboT2VA: Fast Large-Scale Text-to-Video-Audio Generation via Score-Regularized Consistency Distillation
title_zh: TurboT2VA: Fast Large-Scale Text-to-Video-Audio Generation via Score-Regularized Consistency Distillation
summary_en: Score-regularized consistency distillation that makes large joint text-to-video-audio generation fast enough to serve.
summary_zh: 用分数正则化的一致性蒸馏加速大规模文本到视频-音频的联合生成，使其达到可部署的速度。

title_en: SafeDivertor: Faithful Divertor Heat Flux Reconstruction from Macroscopic Plasma State Signals via Time-Frequency Prior Exploitation
title_zh: SafeDivertor: Faithful Divertor Heat Flux Reconstruction from Macroscopic Plasma State Signals via Time-Frequency Prior Exploitation
summary_en: A Tsinghua-ASIPP collaboration that reconstructs tokamak divertor heat flux from macroscopic plasma signals using time-frequency priors, applying his group's generative modelling to fusion diagnostics.
summary_zh: 与合肥等离子体所合作的论文，用时频先验从宏观等离子体信号重建托卡马克偏滤器热流，把课题组的生成建模方法用于聚变诊断。

title_en: Visual Representation Matters: Exploiting Temporal Differences in Video-to-Audio Generation
title_zh: Visual Representation Matters: Exploiting Temporal Differences in Video-to-Audio Generation
summary_en: Shows that the visual representation, and specifically the temporal differences between frames, is what limits video-to-audio generation quality.
summary_zh: 论文指出视觉表征——尤其是帧间的时序差异——是视频生成音频质量的关键瓶颈。

title_en: WorldExam: Benchmarking World Models from Apparent Appearance to Inherent Reactivity
title_zh: WorldExam: Benchmarking World Models from Apparent Appearance to Inherent Reactivity
summary_en: A benchmark that tests video world models on interactive reactivity rather than only on how the generated video looks, directly relevant to his Vidu world-model work.
summary_zh: 该基准不只考察生成画面的表观质量，而是评测视频世界模型的交互反应能力，与他在 Vidu 世界模型方向的工作直接相关。

title_en: Towards Precision Therapy in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Clinical-Reasoning LLM for Risk Stratification and Treatment Guidance
title_zh: Towards Precision Therapy in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Clinical-Reasoning LLM for Risk Stratification and Treatment Guidance
summary_en: A clinical-reasoning LLM for liver-cancer risk stratification and treatment guidance, built with Tsinghua's hepatobiliary surgery team.
summary_zh: 与清华肝胆外科团队合作的临床推理大模型，用于肝细胞癌的风险分层与治疗决策。

title_en: Vidu S1: A Real-Time Interactive Video Generation Model
title_zh: Vidu S1: A Real-Time Interactive Video Generation Model
summary_en: Shengshu's real-time interactive video generation model with voice-controlled digital characters, the flagship technical report from the company where he is chief scientist.
summary_zh: 生数科技的实时交互式视频生成模型，支持语音控制数字人，是他担任首席科学家的公司的旗舰技术报告。

title_en: Mirror Illusion Art
title_zh: Mirror Illusion Art
summary_en: Inverse design of 3D objects that show two different target images head-on and in a mirror, written with Tsinghua colleague Xiaolin Hu.
summary_zh: 与清华胡晓林合作，反向设计出正视与镜像分别呈现两幅不同目标图像的三维物体。

title_en: ComMem: Complementary Memory Systems for Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
title_zh: ComMem: Complementary Memory Systems for Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
summary_en: A complementary-memory scheme for test-time adaptation of vision-language models that keeps short-term and long-term knowledge separate.
summary_zh: 提出互补记忆机制用于视觉语言模型的测试时自适应，将短期与长期知识分开存储。

title_en: Causal-rCM: A Unified Teacher-Forcing and Self-Forcing Open Recipe for Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation in Streaming Video Generation and Interactive World Models
title_zh: Causal-rCM: A Unified Teacher-Forcing and Self-Forcing Open Recipe for Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation in Streaming Video Generation and Interactive World Models
summary_en: An open recipe unifying teacher-forcing and self-forcing for distilling autoregressive video diffusion, the core technique behind real-time streaming generation and interactive world models.
summary_zh: 提出统一教师强制与自强制的开源蒸馏方案，用于自回归视频扩散，是实时流式生成与交互式世界模型的核心技术。

title_en: TurboServe: Serving Streaming Video Generation Efficiently and Economically
title_zh: TurboServe: Serving Streaming Video Generation Efficiently and Economically
summary_en: A serving system for streaming video generation aimed at the cost and latency of long-lived interactive sessions.
summary_zh: 面向流式视频生成的服务系统，针对长会话交互的成本与延迟做优化。

title_en: FreeSonic: Training-Free Temporal-Aware Decoupled Attention for Precise Audio Editing
title_zh: FreeSonic: Training-Free Temporal-Aware Decoupled Attention for Precise Audio Editing
summary_en: A training-free attention-decoupling method for precise text-guided audio editing, from his group's audio diffusion line.
summary_zh: 无需训练的解耦注意力方法，实现精确的文本引导音频编辑，出自其课题组的音频扩散方向。

title_en: PACT: Self-Evolving Physical Safety Alignment for Diffusion Policies in Embodied Manipulation
title_zh: PACT: Self-Evolving Physical Safety Alignment for Diffusion Policies in Embodied Manipulation
summary_en: Self-evolving physical safety alignment for diffusion policies, extending his group's alignment work from generative models to embodied manipulation.
summary_zh: 为扩散策略提出自演化的物理安全对齐方法，把课题组的对齐研究从生成模型延伸到具身操作。

title_en: FunctionEvolve: Structure-Guided Symbolic Regression with LLMs
title_zh: FunctionEvolve: Structure-Guided Symbolic Regression with LLMs
summary_en: Structure-guided symbolic regression in which an LLM proposes and evolves candidate expressions to recover explicit scientific laws.
summary_zh: 结构引导的符号回归方法，由大模型提出并演化候选表达式，以还原显式的科学规律。

title_en: GuidedBridge: Training-freely Improving Bridge Models with Prior Guidance
title_zh: GuidedBridge: Training-freely Improving Bridge Models with Prior Guidance
summary_en: Adds prior guidance to diffusion bridge models without retraining, continuing his group's work on the theory of diffusion sampling.
summary_zh: 在无需重新训练的前提下为扩散桥模型加入先验引导，延续其课题组在扩散采样理论上的工作。

title_en: minWM: A Full-Stack Open-Source Framework for Real-Time Interactive Video World Models
title_zh: minWM: A Full-Stack Open-Source Framework for Real-Time Interactive Video World Models
summary_en: A full-stack open-source framework for real-time interactive video world models, released with his Shengshu and Tsinghua collaborators.
summary_zh: 与生数科技和清华同事共同发布的全栈开源框架，用于实时交互式视频世界模型。

title_en: GEM: Generative Supervision Helps Embodied Intelligence
title_zh: GEM: Generative Supervision Helps Embodied Intelligence
summary_en: Uses generative video models as supervision for embodied vision-language-action policies, bridging his video generation and robotics work.
summary_zh: 用生成式视频模型为具身视觉-语言-动作策略提供监督，连接了他在视频生成与机器人方向的工作。

title_en: RepoMirage: Probing Repository Context Reasoning in Code Agents with Perturbations
title_zh: RepoMirage: Probing Repository Context Reasoning in Code Agents with Perturbations
summary_en: Probes whether code agents really reason about repository context by perturbing that context, from his group's model-evaluation line.
summary_zh: 通过扰动仓库上下文，检验代码智能体是否真正在进行仓库级推理，出自其课题组的模型评测方向。

title_en: WorldArena 2.0: Extending Embodied World Model Benchmarking on Modality, Functionality and Platform
title_zh: WorldArena 2.0: Extending Embodied World Model Benchmarking on Modality, Functionality and Platform
summary_en: A multi-institution benchmark extending embodied world-model evaluation across modalities, functions and platforms.
summary_zh: 多机构合作的基准，把具身世界模型的评测扩展到更多模态、功能与平台。

title_en: Learning-Zone Energy: Online Data Selection for Efficient RL Post-Training
title_zh: Learning-Zone Energy: Online Data Selection for Efficient RL Post-Training
summary_en: An online data-selection criterion that keeps RL post-training on the examples sitting in a model's learning zone.
summary_zh: 提出在线数据选择准则，使强化学习后训练集中在模型学习区内的样本上。

title_en: Ranking-Aware Calibration for Reliable Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Ranking-Aware Calibration for Reliable Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Calibrates multimodal RL policies so their confidence ranking is reliable, not just their terminal accuracy.
summary_zh: 对多模态强化学习策略做排序感知的置信度校准，使其可靠性不只体现在最终正确率上。

title_en: Vidu S1 released — real-time interactive video generation
title_zh: Vidu S1 发布 —— 实时交互式视频生成
summary_en: Follows the Vidar embodied foundation model (July 2025) and the Motus unified world model (December 2025), which claimed ~40% improvement over π0.5.
summary_zh: 此前有具身基础模型 Vidar（2025-07）与统一世界模型 Motus（2025-12），后者宣称较 π0.5 提升约 40%。

title_en: Series B of nearly RMB 2B led by Alibaba Cloud
title_zh: 近 20 亿元 B 轮融资，阿里云领投
summary_en: The largest single round in China's video-generation sector.
summary_zh: 中国视频生成领域最大单笔融资。

title_en: 世界模型研究纷争不断，朱军团队的通用世界模型能否通向通用智能？
title_zh: 世界模型研究纷争不断，朱军团队的通用世界模型能否通向通用智能？
summary_en: Amid ongoing debate over world-model architectures, coverage examines whether Zhu Jun's team's general-purpose world model can be a path toward AGI.
summary_zh: 在世界模型研究路线纷争不断之际，报道探讨朱军团队研发的通用世界模型能否通向通用人工智能。

title_en: 生数双线破局背后：朱军团队正在为世界模型立「通用语法」
title_zh: 生数双线破局背后：朱军团队正在为世界模型立「通用语法」
summary_en: Zhu Jun's team at Shengshu (生数科技) is developing a 'universal grammar' framework for world models, part of the company's push from video generation into world-model research.
summary_zh: 朱军在生数科技的团队正在为世界模型构建“通用语法”框架，是公司从视频生成向世界模型研究拓展的一部分。

title_en: 世界模型到底是什么？李飞飞、朱军等如何解读？
title_zh: 世界模型到底是什么？李飞飞、朱军等如何解读？
summary_en: Zhu Jun is cited alongside Fei-Fei Li in Chinese media coverage explaining what a "world model" actually is, reflecting his pivot at Shengshu Technology from video generation into world models.
summary_zh: 中文媒体在解读"世界模型"究竟是什么时，将朱军与李飞飞并列引用，体现了他在生数科技从视频生成转向世界模型的方向。

title_en: 世界模型到底是什么？李飞飞、朱军等如何解读？
title_zh: 世界模型到底是什么？李飞飞、朱军等如何解读？
summary_en: Zhu Jun joined Fei-Fei Li and others in a public discussion on what world models actually are, aligning with Shengshu's push from video generation into world-model research.
summary_zh: 朱军与李飞飞等人公开探讨世界模型的本质，这与生数科技从视频生成向世界模型研究拓展的方向一致。

title_en: 生数科技朱军：具身智能也可能先进入家庭，再逐步进入工厂
title_zh: 生数科技朱军：具身智能也可能先进入家庭，再逐步进入工厂
summary_en: Speaking as Shengshu's chief scientist, he argues embodied intelligence will reach households before factories, setting out the company's reasoning as it moves from video generation into embodied AI.
summary_zh: 他以生数科技首席科学家的身份表示，具身智能可能先进入家庭、再逐步进入工厂，说明了公司从视频生成走向具身智能的判断。

title_en: 生数科技创始人朱军：通用世界模型，推动数字世界与物理世界统一的新范式
title_zh: 生数科技创始人朱军：通用世界模型，推动数字世界与物理世界统一的新范式
summary_en: Zhu Jun, founder and chief scientist of Shengshu Technology, said general-purpose world models are the new infrastructure unifying the digital and physical worlds, marking the company's strategic shift from video generation toward world models.
summary_zh: 生数科技创始人兼首席科学家朱军表示，通用世界模型是统一数字世界与物理世界的新基础设施，标志着公司战略重心从视频生成转向世界模型。

title_en: 生数科技朱军：让机器人靠刷视频理解世界，这条路怎么走通？
title_zh: 生数科技朱军：让机器人靠刷视频理解世界，这条路怎么走通？
summary_en: Zhu Jun argues robots can learn to understand the physical world by training on video, laying out Shengshu Technology's path from video generation toward world models.
summary_zh: 朱军提出机器人可以通过观看视频来理解物理世界，阐述了生数科技从视频生成走向世界模型的技术路径。

title_en: 专访清华朱军：大模型“投毒”怎么防？技术法规社会三管齐下
title_zh: 专访清华朱军：大模型“投毒”怎么防？技术法规社会三管齐下
summary_en: In an interview, Zhu Jun discussed how to prevent large-model 'poisoning', calling for a combined technical, regulatory and social approach.
summary_zh: 朱军在专访中探讨如何防止大模型“投毒”，呼吁从技术、法规、社会三方面共同应对。

title_en: 生数科技朱军：通用世界模型是连接数字世界与物理世界的桥梁
title_zh: 生数科技朱军：通用世界模型是连接数字世界与物理世界的桥梁
summary_en: Zhu Jun describes general-purpose world models as the bridge linking the digital and physical worlds, framing Shengshu Technology's strategic direction beyond video generation.
summary_zh: 朱军将通用世界模型描述为连接数字世界与物理世界的桥梁，阐明了生数科技在视频生成之外的战略方向。

title_en: 生数科技朱军：通用世界模型是连接数字世界与物理世界的桥梁
title_zh: 生数科技朱军：通用世界模型是连接数字世界与物理世界的桥梁
summary_en: Zhu Jun said general world models are the bridge connecting the digital and physical worlds, framing Shengshu's expansion beyond video generation.
summary_zh: 朱军表示通用世界模型是连接数字世界与物理世界的桥梁,阐明生数科技从视频生成向更广领域拓展的方向。

title_en: Mamba-3: improved sequence modeling using state space principles
title_zh: Mamba-3：基于状态空间原理的改进序列建模
summary_en: Designed with inference efficiency as the primary goal — a departure from Mamba-2's training-speed optimisation. Adds a more expressive recurrence formula, complex-valued state tracking, and a MIMO variant.
summary_zh: 以推理效率为首要目标设计，与 Mamba-2 优化训练速度的取向相反。引入更具表达力的递归公式、复数值状态追踪与 MIMO 变体。

title_en: Mayank put in a crazy amount of work to get pretraining to work on 3 gens of Nvidia GPUs and 2 gens of TPUs! Very good model for such a small size
title_zh: Mayank put in a crazy amount of work to get pretraining to work on 3 gens of Nvidia GPUs and 2 gens of TPUs! Very good model for such a small size
summary_en: Tri Dao praises Mayank's work getting a small model pretrained across three generations of Nvidia GPUs and two generations of TPUs.
summary_zh: Tri Dao称赞Mayank在三代Nvidia GPU和两代TPU上完成小模型预训练的出色工作。

title_en: A lot more gpus coming for open models
title_zh: A lot more gpus coming for open models
summary_en: Tri Dao said significantly more GPU capacity is coming for open-weight models.
summary_zh: Tri Dao表示将有更多GPU算力投向开源模型。

title_en: DiG-bench: Discovery in Games
title_zh: DiG-bench: Discovery in Games
summary_en: Multi-institution benchmark of 70 games in which agents must discover hidden rules by experimentation; Dao is a co-author on the Princeton side.
summary_zh: 多机构合作的基准，包含 70 个需要通过试验才能发现隐藏规则的游戏，Dao 以普林斯顿一方参与署名。

title_en: Dion3: Full-Stack Orthogonal Updates
title_zh: Dion3: Full-Stack Orthogonal Updates
summary_en: Cuts the orthogonalization and communication overhead of Muon-style optimizers under sharded training; Dao is a co-author.
summary_zh: 降低 Muon 类优化器在权重分片训练下的正交化与通信开销，Dao 为共同作者。

title_en: I really like this new benchmark. Has the flavor of ARC-AGI3 but it’s pure text so you don’t have to worry about the vision capability
title_zh: I really like this new benchmark. Has the flavor of ARC-AGI3 but it’s pure text so you don’t have to worry about the vision capability
summary_en: Praised a new text-only benchmark for having the flavor of ARC-AGI3 without the vision-capability confound.
summary_zh: 称赞一个新的纯文本基准测试，兼具ARC-AGI3的风格但无需担心视觉能力带来的干扰。

title_en: Thought-Level Beam Search for Reasoning
title_zh: Thought-Level Beam Search for Reasoning
summary_en: Test-time search that operates over whole reasoning steps rather than tokens to cut inference cost; Dao is a co-author.
summary_zh: 在完整推理步骤而非 token 层面进行测试时搜索，以降低推理开销，Dao 为共同作者。

title_en: Putting LLM brain on robots -> 4x SOTA with no extra training. I’ve been very surprised by how well this works. The time for agents running on robots is comi
title_zh: Putting LLM brain on robots -> 4x SOTA with no extra training. I’ve been very surprised by how well this works. The time for agents running on robots is comi
summary_en: Highlighted a result putting an LLM 'brain' on robots for a 4x state-of-the-art gain with no extra training.
summary_zh: 强调了一项将LLM“大脑”用于机器人的成果，在无需额外训练的情况下取得4倍的性能提升。

title_en: Addressing the Orchestration Gap in Generalist Robots via Physical Agency
title_zh: Addressing the Orchestration Gap in Generalist Robots via Physical Agency
summary_en: Princeton and Together AI paper on orchestrating perception, planning and control for generalist robots; Dao is senior author.
summary_zh: 普林斯顿与 Together AI 合作的论文，研究通用机器人中感知、规划与控制的编排问题，Dao 为通讯作者。

title_en: We’re serving 400T tokens / month and the demand for open models just keep going up
title_zh: We’re serving 400T tokens / month and the demand for open models just keep going up
summary_en: Shared that Together AI is now serving 400 trillion tokens per month, with demand for open models still rising.
summary_zh: 分享Together AI现在每月处理400万亿token，开源模型的需求仍在持续增长。

title_en: If you ever wondered about how how open/closed model makers and inference providers make economic sense, this is the piece to read
title_zh: If you ever wondered about how how open/closed model makers and inference providers make economic sense, this is the piece to read
summary_en: Recommended an analysis piece on the economics behind open/closed model makers and inference providers.
summary_zh: 推荐了一篇分析开源/闭源模型厂商与推理服务商经济模式的文章。

title_en: It's wild how quickly Etched designed and got the chips out, all within 2 years. They went deep, hardcoding attention into silicon and getting very high MFU. Th
title_zh: It's wild how quickly Etched designed and got the chips out, all within 2 years. They went deep, hardcoding attention into silicon and getting very high MFU. Th
summary_en: Praised Etched for shipping attention-hardcoded silicon within two years, achieving very high MFU.
summary_zh: 称赞Etched在两年内推出将注意力机制硬编码进芯片的产品，实现了很高的MFU。

title_en: ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State
title_zh: ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State
summary_en: His own write-up of ReplaySSM, a decoding scheme that caches recent SSM inputs instead of writing recurrent state back to HBM at every step.
summary_zh: 他本人撰文介绍 ReplaySSM：解码时缓存最近的输入，而不必每一步都把循环状态写回 HBM。

title_en: As hybrid models (Qwen 3.5 / Nemotron Ultra) run agents with massive context, Gated-DeltaNet / Mamba states become a bottleneck. A simple insight to make this 2
title_zh: As hybrid models (Qwen 3.5 / Nemotron Ultra) run agents with massive context, Gated-DeltaNet / Mamba states become a bottleneck. A simple insight to make this 2
summary_en: Explained that as hybrid models run agents with massive context, Mamba/Gated-DeltaNet state loading becomes a bottleneck, and described a fix that makes it 2x faster.
