summary_zh: 解释了混合模型在长上下文agent场景中Mamba/Gated-DeltaNet状态加载成为瓶颈的问题，并介绍了一个使其提速2倍的方法。

title_en: SonicSampler: Unified Tile-Aware Kernels for LLM Sampling and Speculative Verification
title_zh: SonicSampler: Unified Tile-Aware Kernels for LLM Sampling and Speculative Verification
summary_en: Fused tile-aware GPU kernels covering LLM sampling and speculative-decoding verification; Dao is senior author.
summary_zh: 为 LLM 采样与投机解码验证设计的融合式 tile 感知 GPU 内核，Dao 为通讯作者。

title_en: After some mathematical rewrite, turns out all of transformer is a series of gemm + epilogue. Given a few optimized primitives, LLMs (and novice humans) can wri
title_zh: After some mathematical rewrite, turns out all of transformer is a series of gemm + epilogue. Given a few optimized primitives, LLMs (and novice humans) can wri
summary_en: Described a mathematical rewrite showing the transformer reduces to a series of gemm + epilogue operations, letting LLMs write speed-of-light kernels.
summary_zh: 介绍了一种数学重写方法，表明整个transformer可归结为一系列gemm+epilogue运算，使LLM能够写出极速内核。

title_en: CODA: Rewriting Transformer Blocks as GEMM-Epilogue Programs
title_zh: CODA: Rewriting Transformer Blocks as GEMM-Epilogue Programs
summary_en: Rewrites transformer blocks as GEMM-epilogue programs to remove memory-bound overhead in training; Dao is senior author.
summary_zh: 把 Transformer 模块改写为 GEMM 尾声程序，消除训练中的访存瓶颈，Dao 为通讯作者。

title_en: Search Your Block Floating Point Scales!
title_zh: Search Your Block Floating Point Scales!
summary_en: Searches block-floating-point scale factors to improve low-precision inference on newer GPU formats; Dao is a co-author.
summary_zh: 搜索块浮点的缩放因子，以改善新一代 GPU 低精度格式下的推理效果，Dao 为共同作者。

title_en: SonicMoE: A Hardware-Efficient and Software-Extensible Blueprint for Fine-Grained MoEs
title_zh: SonicMoE: A Hardware-Efficient and Software-Extensible Blueprint for Fine-Grained MoEs
summary_en: His blog post on SonicMoE, a Blackwell-oriented design for fine-grained mixture-of-experts that holds activation memory flat as expert granularity rises.
summary_zh: 他的博客文章介绍 SonicMoE：一种面向 Blackwell 的细粒度 MoE 设计，在专家粒度提高时仍能保持激活显存不增长。

title_en: @WentaoGuo7 explains really well this nice mathematical rewrite of the MoE backward. This leads to much lower activation mem, and way faster speed, esp for fine
title_zh: @WentaoGuo7 explains really well this nice mathematical rewrite of the MoE backward. This leads to much lower activation mem, and way faster speed, esp for fine
summary_en: Highlighted a mathematical rewrite of the MoE backward pass that lowers activation memory and speeds up fine-grained MoE training.
summary_zh: 介绍了一种MoE反向传播的数学重写方法，降低了激活内存占用并加快了细粒度MoE训练速度。

title_en: SAW-INT4: System-Aware 4-Bit KV-Cache Quantization for Real-World LLM Serving
title_zh: SAW-INT4: System-Aware 4-Bit KV-Cache Quantization for Real-World LLM Serving
summary_en: System-aware 4-bit KV-cache quantization for LLM serving that mixes latency- and throughput-sensitive traffic; Dao is a co-author.
summary_zh: 面向同时承载低延迟与高吞吐请求的 LLM 服务的系统感知 4-bit KV 缓存量化方案，Dao 为共同作者。

title_en: The dynamical system view gives very clean conditions for looped transformer to be stable
title_zh: The dynamical system view gives very clean conditions for looped transformer to be stable
summary_en: Noted that a dynamical-systems view gives clean stability conditions for looped transformers.
summary_zh: 指出从动力系统的视角可以给出循环transformer稳定性的简洁条件。

title_en: Introspective Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: Introspective Diffusion Language Models
summary_en: Attributes the quality gap of diffusion language models to inconsistent self-scoring and proposes a fix; Dao is a co-author.
summary_zh: 把扩散语言模型的质量差距归因于自评一致性不足并给出改进方案，Dao 为共同作者。

title_en: Squeeze Evolve: Unified Multi-Model Orchestration for Verifier-Free Evolution
title_zh: Squeeze Evolve: Unified Multi-Model Orchestration for Verifier-Free Evolution
summary_en: Multi-model orchestration for verifier-free evolutionary search, tackling diversity collapse and compute cost; Dao is a co-author.
summary_zh: 面向无验证器演化搜索的多模型编排方法，缓解多样性坍缩与算力开销，Dao 为共同作者。

title_en: Fast muon optimizer coming to consumer cards. All the code was written as matmul + epilogue so once the mainloop was implemented for Blackwell consumer cards, a
title_zh: Fast muon optimizer coming to consumer cards. All the code was written as matmul + epilogue so once the mainloop was implemented for Blackwell consumer cards, a
summary_en: Announced a fast Muon optimizer implementation coming to consumer GPU cards, built on a matmul+epilogue kernel design.
summary_zh: 宣布基于matmul+epilogue内核设计的快速Muon优化器实现即将登陆消费级GPU显卡。

title_en: Gram Newton-Schulz: A Fast, Hardware-Aware Newton-Schulz Algorithm for Muon
title_zh: Gram Newton-Schulz: A Fast, Hardware-Aware Newton-Schulz Algorithm for Muon
summary_en: His post on a hardware-aware Newton-Schulz variant that cuts the per-step cost of Muon, the optimizer now used to train models like Kimi K2 Thinking and GLM-5.
summary_zh: 他撰文提出一种硬件友好的 Newton-Schulz 变体，降低 Muon 优化器的单步开销——Kimi K2 Thinking、GLM-5 等模型的训练都在使用该优化器。

title_en: It's my favorite kind of work: linear algebra insight + fast kernels. When playing w Muon a while ago, we were thinking why not speed it up by operating on the
title_zh: It's my favorite kind of work: linear algebra insight + fast kernels. When playing w Muon a while ago, we were thinking why not speed it up by operating on the
summary_en: Shared a linear-algebra insight for speeding up the Muon optimizer by operating on a small square matrix instead of the full one.
summary_zh: 分享了一个加速Muon优化器的线性代数思路：对一个小方阵而非完整矩阵进行运算。

title_en: Nonlinear RNNs seem to do sth genuinely different from attn and linear RNNs/SSMs. By themselves they already do quite well w the right parametrization, but just
title_zh: Nonlinear RNNs seem to do sth genuinely different from attn and linear RNNs/SSMs. By themselves they already do quite well w the right parametrization, but just
summary_en: Argued nonlinear RNNs behave genuinely differently from attention and linear RNNs/SSMs, and can substantially help when combined with them.
summary_zh: 认为非线性RNN与注意力机制及线性RNN/SSM有本质不同，与后者结合时能带来显著提升。

title_en: The frontier has increasingly shifted to hybrid models - from Qwen to Kimi-Linear and now with NVIDIA's Nemotron-3 Super - that rely on a strong linear sequence
title_zh: The frontier has increasingly shifted to hybrid models - from Qwen to Kimi-Linear and now with NVIDIA's Nemotron-3 Super - that rely on a strong linear sequence
summary_en: Announced the release of Mamba-3, positioning it within the industry shift toward hybrid models with strong linear sequence components.
summary_zh: 宣布发布Mamba-3，并将其置于行业转向强线性序列组件混合模型的趋势中。

title_en: Mamba-3 Part 1
title_zh: Mamba-3 Part 1
summary_en: Part 1 of his Mamba-3 series, introducing the next generation of the state space architecture he co-created.
summary_zh: 他的 Mamba-3 系列第一篇，介绍这一由他共同提出的状态空间架构的新一代版本。

title_en: Mamba-3 Part 2 - Methodological Deep Dive
title_zh: Mamba-3 Part 2 - Methodological Deep Dive
summary_en: Part 2 of his Mamba-3 series, a methodological deep dive into how the new architecture is derived.
summary_zh: 他的 Mamba-3 系列第二篇，深入拆解新架构的方法论推导过程。

title_en: M$^2$RNN: Non-Linear RNNs with Matrix-Valued States for Scalable Language Modeling
title_zh: M$^2$RNN: Non-Linear RNNs with Matrix-Valued States for Scalable Language Modeling
summary_en: Non-linear RNN with matrix-valued state aimed at tasks beyond the expressivity limits of transformers; Dao is senior author.
summary_zh: 带矩阵值状态的非线性 RNN，面向超出 Transformer 表达能力上限的任务，Dao 为通讯作者。

title_en: FlashAttention-4: Algorithm and Kernel Pipelining Co-Design for Asymmetric Hardware Scaling
title_zh: FlashAttention-4: Algorithm and Kernel Pipelining Co-Design for Asymmetric Hardware Scaling
summary_en: His announcement of FlashAttention-4, co-designing the attention algorithm with kernel pipelining for hardware whose compute and memory scale unevenly.
summary_zh: 他发布 FlashAttention-4：将注意力算法与内核流水线协同设计，以适配算力与访存增长不匹配的硬件。

title_en: AI+HW 2035: Shaping the Next Decade
title_zh: AI+HW 2035: Shaping the Next Decade
summary_en: Community roadmap report on the next decade of AI and hardware co-design, co-signed by Dao.
summary_zh: 关于未来十年 AI 与硬件协同设计的社区路线图报告，Dao 为联合署名者之一。

title_en: The FA4 paper is finally out after a year of work. On Blackwell GPUs, attention now goes about as fast as matmul even though the bottlenecks are so different! T
title_zh: The FA4 paper is finally out after a year of work. On Blackwell GPUs, attention now goes about as fast as matmul even though the bottlenecks are so different! T
summary_en: Released the FlashAttention 4 paper after a year of work, making attention run about as fast as matmul on Blackwell GPUs.
summary_zh: 历时一年发布FlashAttention 4论文，使注意力计算在Blackwell GPU上达到接近矩阵乘法的速度。

title_en: Attack of the asynchronous machines. We’ve seen this a lot in GPU kernels. This time the same principle applies in speculative decoding
title_zh: Attack of the asynchronous machines. We’ve seen this a lot in GPU kernels. This time the same principle applies in speculative decoding
summary_en: Drew an analogy between asynchronous GPU kernel techniques and applying the same principle to speculative decoding.
summary_zh: 将GPU内核中的异步技术类比应用于投机解码，指出了相同的原理。

title_en: Speculative Speculative Decoding
title_zh: Speculative Speculative Decoding
summary_en: Adds a second layer of speculation on top of speculative decoding to further cut sequential decode cost; Dao is a co-author.
summary_zh: 在投机解码之上再叠加一层投机，进一步降低顺序解码开销，Dao 为共同作者。

title_en: This was a wild bug hunt, weeks of effort from @MayankMish98 to track down. The wrong init of Mamba2 in many reimplementations causes the layer to decay its sta
title_zh: This was a wild bug hunt, weeks of effort from @MayankMish98 to track down. The wrong init of Mamba2 in many reimplementations causes the layer to decay its sta
summary_en: Described a hard-to-find bug where incorrect initialization of Mamba2 in many reimplementations causes the layer to decay state too quickly in short contexts.
summary_zh: 介绍了一个难以发现的bug：许多Mamba2的复现版本因初始化错误，导致状态在短上下文中过快衰减。

title_en: When RL Meets Adaptive Speculative Training: A Unified Training-Serving System
title_zh: When RL Meets Adaptive Speculative Training: A Unified Training-Serving System
summary_en: Unified system that trains the speculator online during RL post-training instead of offline; Dao is a co-author.
summary_zh: 把投机模型训练与 RL 后训练服务打通，在线而非离线更新投机器，Dao 为共同作者。

title_en: This is what we've been coking for the last 9 months: make MoEs training goes ~2x faster and ~2x less memory! Highlights: - MoE typically takes the most time an
title_zh: This is what we've been coking for the last 9 months: make MoEs training goes ~2x faster and ~2x less memory! Highlights: - MoE typically takes the most time an
summary_en: Announced work making MoE training roughly 2x faster and using 2x less memory, the product of nine months of effort.
summary_zh: 宣布了历时九个月的成果：让MoE训练速度提升约2倍，内存占用降低约2倍。

title_en: SonicMoE: Accelerating MoE with IO and Tile-aware Optimizations
title_zh: SonicMoE: Accelerating MoE with IO and Tile-aware Optimizations
summary_en: IO- and tile-aware kernels that accelerate mixture-of-experts models; Dao is senior author.
summary_zh: 面向 MoE 模型的 IO 与 tile 感知内核优化，Dao 为通讯作者。

title_en: Nvidia continues to put out some of the strongest and fastest open models. Pretraining and post training data are released as well, something very few orgs have
title_zh: Nvidia continues to put out some of the strongest and fastest open models. Pretraining and post training data are released as well, something very few orgs have
summary_en: Praised Nvidia for releasing some of the strongest and fastest open models along with pretraining and post-training data, which few labs do.
summary_zh: 称赞英伟达发布了业内最强、最快的开源模型之一，并罕见地开放了预训练和后训练数据。

title_en: Beat the long tail: Distribution-Aware Speculative Decoding for RL Training
title_zh: Beat the long tail: Distribution-Aware Speculative Decoding for RL Training
summary_en: Distribution-aware speculative decoding that speeds up the rollout phase of RL post-training; Dao is a co-author.
summary_zh: 用分布感知的投机解码加速 RL 后训练中的 rollout 阶段，Dao 为共同作者。

title_en: Thank you @schmidtsciences for the 2025 #AI2050 Early Career Fellowship supporting my work on self-improving AI systems: as AI gets better, it should help human
title_zh: Thank you @schmidtsciences for the 2025 #AI2050 Early Career Fellowship supporting my work on self-improving AI systems: as AI gets better, it should help human
summary_en: Announced receiving the 2026 AI2050 Early Career Fellowship from Schmidt Sciences to support his work on self-improving AI systems.
summary_zh: 宣布获得施密特科学基金会2026年AI2050早期职业奖学金，用于支持其自我改进AI系统方面的研究。

title_en: Opportunistic Expert Activation: Batch-Aware Expert Routing for Faster Decode Without Retraining
title_zh: Opportunistic Expert Activation: Batch-Aware Expert Routing for Faster Decode Without Retraining
summary_en: Batch-aware expert routing that speeds up mixture-of-experts decoding without retraining; Dao is a co-author.
summary_zh: 无需重新训练的批次感知专家路由，加快 MoE 模型的解码速度，Dao 为共同作者。

title_en: This work, led by @_junxiong_wang and @ben_athi, is a first step towards building AI systems that evolve and get better as you use them. More to come!
title_zh: This work, led by @_junxiong_wang and @ben_athi, is a first step towards building AI systems that evolve and get better as you use them. More to come!
summary_en: Announced work led by two collaborators as a first step toward AI systems that evolve and improve as they are used.
summary_zh: 宣布由两名合作者主导的一项工作，是迈向能在使用过程中自我进化改进的AI系统的第一步。

title_en: Ep 74: Chief Scientist of Together.AI Tri Dao On The End of Nvidia's Dominance, Why Inference Costs Fell & The Next 10X in Speed
title_zh: Ep 74: Chief Scientist of Together.AI Tri Dao On The End of Nvidia's Dominance, Why Inference Costs Fell & The Next 10X in Speed
summary_en: Long-form interview in which he argues Nvidia's dominance is ending and explains where the next 10x in inference speed will come from.
summary_zh: 长篇访谈：他认为英伟达的主导地位正在终结，并解释推理速度下一个 10 倍将从何而来。

title_en: Clarification: I was comparing A @ B + C here, where the cute-dsl version is quite good at overlapping the epilogue. On the standard matmul A @ B, cuBLAS is ver
title_zh: Clarification: I was comparing A @ B + C here, where the cute-dsl version is quite good at overlapping the epilogue. On the standard matmul A @ B, cuBLAS is ver
summary_en: Clarified a benchmark comparison, noting cuBLAS remains very strong on standard matmul while the cute-dsl version overlaps the epilogue well for fused operations.
summary_zh: 澄清了一项基准对比：在标准矩阵乘法上cuBLAS依然非常强，而cute-dsl版本在融合运算中能较好地重叠epilogue。

title_en: Hierarchical layout is super elegant. Feels like the right abstraction for high performance GPU kernels. FlashAttention 2 actually started bc we wanted to rewri
title_zh: Hierarchical layout is super elegant. Feels like the right abstraction for high performance GPU kernels. FlashAttention 2 actually started bc we wanted to rewri
summary_en: Called CuTe's hierarchical layout an elegant abstraction for GPU kernels, and shared that FlashAttention 2 originated from wanting to rewrite FA1 in CuTe.
summary_zh: 称CuTe的层次化布局是GPU内核的优雅抽象，并透露FlashAttention 2正是源于想用CuTe重写FA1。

title_en: I played w it for 1h. Went through my usual prompts (math derivations, floating point optimizations, …). It’s a good model, feels comparable to the best frontie
title_zh: I played w it for 1h. Went through my usual prompts (math derivations, floating point optimizations, …). It’s a good model, feels comparable to the best frontie
summary_en: Gave a hands-on assessment after an hour testing a new model on his usual prompts, calling it comparable to the best frontier models.
summary_zh: 用惯用的提示词测试了一款新模型一小时后给出评价，认为其表现可与最强的前沿模型媲美。

title_en: They’ve finally done it. They got rid of tokenizers!
title_zh: They’ve finally done it. They got rid of tokenizers!
summary_en: Highlighted a notable milestone: a model that has done away with tokenizers entirely.
summary_zh: 强调了一个重要进展：一款完全摒弃了分词器的模型。

title_en: Getting mem-bound kernels to speed-of-light isn't a dark art, it's just about getting the a couple of details right. We wrote a tutorial on how to do this, with
title_zh: Getting mem-bound kernels to speed-of-light isn't a dark art, it's just about getting the a couple of details right. We wrote a tutorial on how to do this, with
summary_en: Announced a tutorial, with usable code, on getting memory-bound GPU kernels to speed-of-light performance.
summary_zh: 发布了一份关于如何将内存受限的GPU内核优化到极速性能的教程，并附有可直接使用的代码。

title_en: Albert articulates really well the trade offs between transformers and SSMs. This is why I work on both
title_zh: Albert articulates really well the trade offs between transformers and SSMs. This is why I work on both
summary_en: Endorsed a colleague's articulation of the tradeoffs between transformers and SSMs, explaining why he works on both.
summary_zh: 认可了一位同事对transformer与SSM之间权衡的阐述，并解释了自己为何同时研究这两者。

title_en: Turns out you can do length generalization for recurrent model by simply training for another extra 100 steps with a careful choice of initial states
title_zh: Turns out you can do length generalization for recurrent model by simply training for another extra 100 steps with a careful choice of initial states
summary_en: Shared a finding that recurrent models can achieve length generalization with just ~100 extra training steps and careful choice of initial states.
summary_zh: 分享了一项发现：只需约100步额外训练并谨慎选择初始状态，循环模型即可实现长度泛化。

title_en: Crazy that we now have an open source model with 13B params that’s competitive w o1. And Mamba layers help bring much higher inference throughput
title_zh: Crazy that we now have an open source model with 13B params that’s competitive w o1. And Mamba layers help bring much higher inference throughput
summary_en: Noted a 13B-parameter open-source model now competitive with o1, with Mamba layers boosting inference throughput.
summary_zh: 指出一款130亿参数的开源模型已能与o1媲美，其中Mamba层显著提升了推理吞吐量。

title_en: Albert and co continue to do excellent work on quantization. This time the trick is to minimize KL wrt the original model, with a clever hessian factorization
title_zh: Albert and co continue to do excellent work on quantization. This time the trick is to minimize KL wrt the original model, with a clever hessian factorization
summary_en: Praised ongoing quantization work minimizing KL divergence to the original model via a clever Hessian factorization.
summary_zh: 称赞了一项通过巧妙的Hessian分解、以最小化与原模型KL散度为目标的量化研究。

title_en: Sparse attn has been around for a while, but test time compute might be the era where it really shines
title_zh: Sparse attn has been around for a while, but test time compute might be the era where it really shines
summary_en: Argued sparse attention, though not new, may finally shine in the test-time-compute era.
summary_zh: 认为稀疏注意力机制虽非新技术，但在测试时计算的时代可能会真正发挥优势。

title_en: State space models and RNNs compress history into a constant size state, while attn has KV cache scaling linearly in seqlen. We can instead start from RNNs and
title_zh: State space models and RNNs compress history into a constant size state, while attn has KV cache scaling linearly in seqlen. We can instead start from RNNs and
summary_en: Explained how SSMs/RNNs compress history into constant-size state versus attention's linearly scaling KV cache, and proposed letting state size grow logarithmically instead.
summary_zh: 解释了SSM/RNN将历史压缩为固定大小状态、而注意力的KV缓存随序列长度线性增长的区别，并提出让状态大小按对数增长的思路。

title_en: Log-Linear Attention
title_zh: Log-Linear Attention
summary_en: Attention variant with logarithmically growing state, sitting between linear attention and full attention; Dao is a co-author.
summary_zh: 状态规模按对数增长的注意力变体，介于线性注意力与完整注意力之间，Dao 为共同作者。

title_en: We've been thinking about what the "ideal" architecture should look like in the era where inference is driving AI progress. GTA & GLA are steps in this directio
title_zh: We've been thinking about what the "ideal" architecture should look like in the era where inference is driving AI progress. GTA & GLA are steps in this directio
summary_en: Introduced GTA and GLA as steps toward an 'ideal' architecture for the era where inference efficiency drives AI progress.
summary_zh: 介绍了GTA和GLA架构，作为在推理效率驱动AI进步的时代迈向“理想”架构的探索。

title_en: Hardware-Efficient Attention for Fast Decoding
title_zh: Hardware-Efficient Attention for Fast Decoding
summary_en: Attention designs that cut KV-cache loading and speed up large-batch, long-context decoding; Dao is senior author.
summary_zh: 提出减少 KV 缓存读取的注意力设计，加快大批量、长上下文场景下的解码，Dao 为通讯作者。

title_en: Long-Context State-Space Video World Models
title_zh: Long-Context State-Space Video World Models

summary_zh: 余凯宣布地平线即将推出“星空”芯片，这是中国首款舱驾融合汽车芯片，预计可为单车降低成本1500至4000元——是公司核心芯片产品线的一次具体发布。

title_en: 地平线创始人兼CEO余凯：L2市占近50%，2026年发布首款舱驾融合智能体芯片
title_zh: 地平线创始人兼CEO余凯：L2市占近50%，2026年发布首款舱驾融合智能体芯片
summary_en: Yu says Horizon Robotics now holds nearly 50% share in the L2 driver-assist market and will launch its first cockpit-driving fused agentic chip in 2026.
summary_zh: 余凯表示地平线在L2市场份额已接近50%，并将于2026年推出首款舱驾融合智能体芯片。

title_en: 地平线余凯：将发布新款舱驾融合智能体芯片，每辆车可节省1500到4000元成本
title_zh: 地平线余凯：将发布新款舱驾融合智能体芯片，每辆车可节省1500到4000元成本
summary_en: Horizon Robotics founder Kai Yu announced a new cockpit-driving fusion intelligent chip that will cut per-vehicle costs by 1,500-4,000 yuan.
summary_zh: 地平线创始人余凯宣布将发布新款舱驾融合智能体芯片，每辆车可节省1500至4000元成本。

title_en: 疑地平线员工内涵小鹏？余凯亲自“割席”：不代表官方
title_zh: 疑地平线员工内涵小鹏？余凯亲自“割席”：不代表官方
summary_en: Kai Yu publicly distanced Horizon Robotics from an employee's comments seen as disparaging XPeng, stating they did not represent the company.
summary_zh: 针对疑似地平线员工内涵小鹏一事，余凯亲自表态与该言论"割席"，称其不代表公司官方立场。

source: 正说知见 | 汽车行业内参
title_en: 余凯：3年将实现脱手开、5年实现闭眼开
title_zh: 余凯：3年将实现脱手开、5年实现闭眼开
summary_en: Kai Yu predicts Horizon-equipped vehicles will reach hands-free driving within 3 years and eyes-closed autonomy within 5, a concrete public timeline for the company's self-driving roadmap.
summary_zh: 余凯预测搭载地平线方案的车辆将在3年内实现脱手驾驶、5年内实现闭眼驾驶，为公司自动驾驶路线图给出具体时间表。

title_en: The Second Half
title_zh: 下半场
summary_en: The argument that evaluation now matters more than training — one of the most widely repeated theses in agent research.
summary_zh: 主张评测比训练更重要 —— Agent 研究中被复述最多的论断之一。

title_en: Hy ai4s is hiring :)
title_zh: Hy ai4s is hiring :)
summary_en: Yao announced his Hunyuan AI4Science team at Tencent is hiring, a signal of the group he is building out under the newly merged foundation model department.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨宣布腾讯混元AI4Science团队正在招聘，显示出他在新合并的基础模型部门下组建团队的进展。

title_en: 115. 对OpenAI姚顺雨3小时访谈：6年Agent研究、人与系统、吞噬的边界、既单极又多元的世界
title_zh: 115. 对OpenAI姚顺雨3小时访谈：6年Agent研究、人与系统、吞噬的边界、既单极又多元的世界
summary_en: Shunyu Yao gives a three-hour interview on his six years of agent research, the human-system boundary, and a world both unipolar and pluralistic.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨接受三小时访谈，畅谈六年Agent研究、人与系统的边界，以及"既单极又多元"的世界。

title_en: Hy2 -> Hy3 preview -> Hy3 Another massive leap forward, under half a year. Not just a leap of reasoning or agentic capabilities. Also a leap of anti-hallu
title_zh: Hy2 -> Hy3 preview -> Hy3 Another massive leap forward, under half a year. Not just a leap of reasoning or agentic capabilities. Also a leap of anti-hallu
summary_en: Yao described the rapid Hy2-to-Hy3 progression as a major leap not just in reasoning and agentic ability but in reliability and reduced hallucination, framing the pace of Hunyuan's model iteration.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨称混元从Hy2到Hy3的快速迭代不仅是推理和智能体能力的飞跃，也是可靠性提升和幻觉减少的重大进步，展现了混元模型迭代的速度。

title_en: 汤道生x姚顺雨对谈：腾讯AI下半场
title_zh: 汤道生x姚顺雨对谈：腾讯AI下半场
summary_en: In a public dialogue with Tencent CSIG CEO Tang Daosheng, Shunyu Yao argued AI's 'second half' is just beginning and that the core challenge has shifted from method to finding problems worth solving.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨与腾讯CSIG CEO汤道生公开对谈，提出AI"下半场"才刚刚开始，核心矛盾已从方法论转向寻找值得解决的真问题。

title_en: CL-bench Life: Can Language Models Learn from Real-Life Context?
title_zh: CL-bench Life: Can Language Models Learn from Real-Life Context?
summary_en: Extends his context-learning benchmark to everyday personal settings, testing whether assistants actually learn from real-life context.
summary_zh: 把其上下文学习基准扩展到日常生活场景，检验助手能否真正从真实生活情境中学习。

title_en: Our goal is to build practical models with comprehensive capabilities beyond open benchmarks. And the only way to do it to co-design with diverse products while
title_zh: Our goal is to build practical models with comprehensive capabilities beyond open benchmarks. And the only way to do it to co-design with diverse products while
summary_en: Yao laid out Hunyuan's strategy: building practical, broadly capable models by co-designing with real products at scale rather than chasing open benchmarks, a post that drew nearly a million views.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨阐述了混元的策略：通过与实际产品大规模协同设计来打造实用、能力全面的模型，而非一味追逐公开基准测试，该帖子浏览量接近百万。

title_en: CL-bench: A Benchmark for Context Learning
title_zh: CL-bench: A Benchmark for Context Learning
summary_en: Benchmark measuring whether language models can learn from task-specific context instead of relying on pretrained knowledge.
summary_zh: 提出评测语言模型能否从任务上下文中学习、而非仅依赖预训练知识的基准。

title_en: 腾讯姚顺雨、Qwen林俊旸、智谱唐杰的AGI-Next圆桌对话, 2026
title_zh: 腾讯姚顺雨、Qwen林俊旸、智谱唐杰的AGI-Next圆桌对话, 2026
summary_en: At the closed-door AGI-Next summit, Shunyu Yao joined a roundtable with Zhipu's Tang Jie, Moonshot's Yang Zhilin and Qwen's Lin Junyang to debate paradigm shifts, agents and China's odds in the AI race.
summary_zh: 在AGI-Next闭门峰会上，姚顺雨与智谱唐杰、月之暗面杨植麟、Qwen林俊旸同台圆桌，探讨范式变革、智能体与中国AI的胜算。

title_en: How to evaluate llms when we can’t trust benchmark numbers anymore?
title_zh: How to evaluate llms when we can’t trust benchmark numbers anymore?
summary_en: Poses the evaluation problem behind his Second Half thesis: how to judge language models once benchmark numbers can no longer be trusted.
summary_zh: 提出「下半场」论述背后的核心难题：当基准分数不再可信，该如何评估大模型。

title_en: An awesome piece by @_kevinlu . I find lots of the points connected to my own post https://t.co/WddJkbSfks Pre-training is a genius idea that essentially levera
title_zh: An awesome piece by @_kevinlu . I find lots of the points connected to my own post https://t.co/WddJkbSfks Pre-training is a genius idea that essentially levera
summary_en: Connects Kevin Lu's essay to his own argument that pre-training worked because it leveraged the output of billions of people rather than a handful of annotators.
summary_zh: 呼应 Kevin Lu 的文章，并接上他自己的论点：预训练之所以奏效，是因为它借用了数十亿人的产出，而非少数标注者的劳动。

title_en: Contextual Experience Replay for Self-Improvement of Language Agents
title_zh: Contextual Experience Replay for Self-Improvement of Language Agents
summary_en: Lets language agents self-improve by distilling past trajectories into reusable in-context experience, tested on web navigation.
summary_zh: 让语言智能体把过往轨迹提炼成可复用的上下文经验，从而自我改进，在网页导航任务上验证。

title_en: When Models Know More Than They Can Explain: Quantifying Knowledge Transfer in Human-AI Collaboration
title_zh: When Models Know More Than They Can Explain: Quantifying Knowledge Transfer in Human-AI Collaboration
summary_en: Studies whether stronger model reasoning also transfers as usable knowledge to human collaborators.
summary_zh: 研究模型推理能力增强后，能否把知识有效传递给与之协作的人类。

title_en: Check out our coding agent, which sets new sota on swebench! What agent next?
title_zh: Check out our coding agent, which sets new sota on swebench! What agent next?
summary_en: Announces that the coding agent he worked on set a new state of the art on SWE-bench, the benchmark he co-authored.
summary_zh: 宣布他参与的编程智能体在 SWE-bench 上刷新最好成绩，而该基准正是他的共同作品。

title_en: An impression for existential AI risk: it’s rather controllable in single-agent (ReAct) setups, where reading human-like sequential traj is doable albeit tediou
title_zh: An impression for existential AI risk: it’s rather controllable in single-agent (ReAct) setups, where reading human-like sequential traj is doable albeit tediou
summary_en: His stated view on existential AI risk: readable and largely controllable in single-agent ReAct-style loops, much harder to inspect once agents interact.
summary_zh: 他对 AI 存在性风险的公开看法：单智能体 ReAct 式回路的轨迹尚可读、可控，多智能体交互一旦出现就难以审视。

title_en: We’re releasing - CUA, the first agent model from OpenAI - Operator, the first agent product from OpenAI - https://t.co/64dDnCi0sC , the first agent job post fr
title_zh: We’re releasing - CUA, the first agent model from OpenAI - Operator, the first agent product from OpenAI - https://t.co/64dDnCi0sC , the first agent job post fr
summary_en: Announces OpenAI's release of CUA and Operator, its first agent model and first agent product, which he helped build.
summary_zh: 宣布 OpenAI 发布 CUA 与 Operator——公司首个智能体模型与首款智能体产品，他参与其中。

title_en: Tree of thoughts is not about llm/cot cant solve game of 24, or you have to use complex prompt engineering or control flow to do it. It’s about multiagent in so
title_zh: Tree of thoughts is not about llm/cot cant solve game of 24, or you have to use complex prompt engineering or control flow to do it. It’s about multiagent in so
summary_en: Corrects a common misreading of his own Tree of Thoughts paper, framing it as search at test time rather than prompt engineering.
summary_zh: 澄清外界对他《思维树》论文的常见误读：论文讲的是测试时的搜索，而不是提示工程技巧。

title_en: I think the biggest surprise for me in 2024 is that small models can also generalize
title_zh: I think the biggest surprise for me in 2024 is that small models can also generalize
summary_en: His takeaway from 2024: the biggest surprise was that small models generalize too.
summary_zh: 他对 2024 年的总结：最大的意外是小模型同样能够泛化。

title_en: It seems increasingly clear "agi" wont be a singularity point event thing, unless we fundamentally break the train test barrier from traditional ml
title_zh: It seems increasingly clear "agi" wont be a singularity point event thing, unless we fundamentally break the train test barrier from traditional ml
summary_en: Argues AGI will not arrive as a single singularity-style event unless the train/test boundary inherited from traditional machine learning is broken.
summary_zh: 他认为，除非打破传统机器学习遗留的训练/测试界限，AGI 不会以奇点式的单一事件到来。

title_en: Had a fun time delivering language agent tutorial (https://t.co/UlDj9S4BfC) with @ysu_nlp @Diyi_Yang @taoyds @emnlpmeeting ! Thanks for joining and asking good
title_zh: Had a fun time delivering language agent tutorial (https://t.co/UlDj9S4BfC) with @ysu_nlp @Diyi_Yang @taoyds @emnlpmeeting ! Thanks for joining and asking good
summary_en: Marks the language-agent tutorial he co-delivered with collaborators at EMNLP 2024, with the materials linked.
summary_zh: 记录他与合作者在 EMNLP 2024 共同讲授的语言智能体教程，并附上教程材料。

title_en: My mental model of a good paper: 1. Solves some questions 2. Opens up new questions or directions for future research Reviewers nowadays: - Ignores things in 1
title_zh: My mental model of a good paper: 1. Solves some questions 2. Opens up new questions or directions for future research Reviewers nowadays: - Ignores things in 1
summary_en: His standard for a good paper — it answers a question and opens new ones — together with a criticism of how reviewers weigh the two.
summary_zh: 他心目中好论文的标准——既解决问题，又开启新的方向——以及对当下评审只盯前者的批评。

title_en: almost forget to post: i've joined @OpenAI! time to convert the research vision to reality, and expect something exciting to drop out :)
title_zh: almost forget to post: i've joined @OpenAI! time to convert the research vision to reality, and expect something exciting to drop out :)
summary_en: Yao announced he joined OpenAI to work on turning language-agent research into real products.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨宣布加入OpenAI,致力于将语言智能体的研究愿景转化为现实产品。

title_en: Excited to share what I did @SierraPlatform with @noahrshinn pedram and @karthik_r_n ! 𝜏-bench evaluates critical agent capabilities omitted by current benchmar
title_zh: Excited to share what I did @SierraPlatform with @noahrshinn pedram and @karthik_r_n ! 𝜏-bench evaluates critical agent capabilities omitted by current benchmar
summary_en: Yao introduced tau-bench, a new benchmark built with Sierra to evaluate agent capabilities like robustness and complex rule-following that existing benchmarks miss.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨发布了与Sierra合作推出的τ-bench基准,用于评估现有基准所忽略的智能体能力,如鲁棒性和复杂规则遵循。

title_en: misalignment of ai and humans is not as dangerous as misalignment of our own behavior and desire, or misalignment among our various desires, or misalignment amo
title_zh: misalignment of ai and humans is not as dangerous as misalignment of our own behavior and desire, or misalignment among our various desires, or misalignment amo
summary_en: Yao argued AI-human misalignment is less dangerous than the misalignment within humans' own behavior and desires, or among people's differing desires.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨提出观点:AI与人类之间的不一致,其危险程度不及人类自身行为与欲望之间的不一致,或人与人之间欲望的不一致。

title_en: I've defended my PhD! "Language Agents: From Next-Token Prediction to Digital Automation" - Talk (WebShop, SWE-bench, ReAct, ToT, CoALA, and on the future of ag
title_zh: I've defended my PhD! "Language Agents: From Next-Token Prediction to Digital Automation" - Talk (WebShop, SWE-bench, ReAct, ToT, CoALA, and on the future of ag
summary_en: Yao announced defending his PhD thesis, 'Language Agents: From Next-Token Prediction to Digital Automation,' covering WebShop, SWE-bench, ReAct, Tree of Thoughts and CoALA.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨宣布完成博士论文答辩,题目为《语言智能体:从下一词预测到数字自动化》,涵盖WebShop、SWE-bench、ReAct、思维树(ToT)和CoALA等工作。

title_en: SWE-agent paper: https://t.co/H8gKlbzl1m If you care about - SWE: check detailed design & analysis - agents: check principles & insights for agent-compu
title_zh: SWE-agent paper: https://t.co/H8gKlbzl1m If you care about - SWE: check detailed design & analysis - agents: check principles & insights for agent-compu
summary_en: Yao described the SWE-agent paper's design and the agent-computer interface (ACI) concept, connecting it to software engineering and HCI/cognitive science.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨介绍了SWE-agent论文的设计,提出智能体-计算机接口(ACI)概念,并将其与软件工程及人机交互/认知科学相联系。

title_en: Coding is the frontier of AI. Excited to push the two frontiers of AI coding: 1. SWE(-bench/agent) 2. Olympiad programming (this tweet) Introduce USACO benchmar
title_zh: Coding is the frontier of AI. Excited to push the two frontiers of AI coding: 1. SWE(-bench/agent) 2. Olympiad programming (this tweet) Introduce USACO benchmar
summary_en: Yao introduced the USACO benchmark for olympiad-level programming, extending his push on AI coding alongside SWE-bench/SWE-agent.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨发布了面向奥林匹克编程水平的USACO基准,延续了他在SWE-bench/SWE-agent之外对AI编程能力的推进。

title_en: When I first saw Tree of Thoughts I also asked myself this😀 great exploration into if next-token prediction can simulate search, and if you're interested in thi
title_zh: When I first saw Tree of Thoughts I also asked myself this😀 great exploration into if next-token prediction can simulate search, and if you're interested in thi
summary_en: Yao commented on a follow-up exploring whether next-token prediction can simulate search, connecting it to his Tree of Thoughts work.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨评论了一项探讨下一词预测能否模拟搜索的后续研究,并将其与自己的思维树(Tree of Thoughts)工作联系起来。

title_en: Swe-agent achieves ~ Devin while only using < 2min and $4 per case
title_zh: Swe-agent achieves ~ Devin while only using < 2min and $4 per case
summary_en: Yao reported that SWE-agent matches Devin's performance while costing about $4 and under 2 minutes per case.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨指出,SWE-agent在效果上接近Devin,但每个案例仅需约4美元和不到2分钟。

title_en: Extremely excited to open-source our SWE-agent that achieves SoTA on SWE-bench😃 Turns out ReAct + Agent-Computer Interface (ACI) can go a long way, very excited
title_zh: Extremely excited to open-source our SWE-agent that achieves SoTA on SWE-bench😃 Turns out ReAct + Agent-Computer Interface (ACI) can go a long way, very excited
summary_en: Yao announced open-sourcing SWE-agent, which achieves state-of-the-art results on SWE-bench by combining ReAct with an agent-computer interface.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨宣布开源SWE-agent,该系统结合ReAct与智能体-计算机接口(ACI),在SWE-bench上取得了当时最优结果。

title_en: Is it just me or haystack is too stupid for benchmarking long context capabilities? If swe-bench is too hard, at least we need tasks that require reasoning over
title_zh: Is it just me or haystack is too stupid for benchmarking long context capabilities? If swe-bench is too hard, at least we need tasks that require reasoning over
summary_en: Yao critiqued the 'needle in a haystack' test as inadequate for benchmarking long-context reasoning, arguing for tasks requiring reasoning across multiple parts of long context.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨批评'大海捞针'测试不足以衡量长上下文推理能力,主张应设计需要跨长文本多个部分进行推理的任务。

title_en: Solving >10% of our SWE-Bench (https://t.co/gP4rgwPDK3) is THE most impressive result in 2024 so far, and a milestone for the research and application of AI
title_zh: Solving >10% of our SWE-Bench (https://t.co/gP4rgwPDK3) is THE most impressive result in 2024 so far, and a milestone for the research and application of AI
summary_en: Yao called Cognition Labs solving over 10% of SWE-Bench, the benchmark he co-created, the most impressive AI agent result of 2024 so far.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨称赞Cognition Labs在他参与创建的SWE-Bench上解决超过10%的问题,是2024年迄今AI智能体领域最令人印象深刻的成果。

title_en: Benchmark will be bipolar, objective ones will all be evaluated by code execution, subjective ones human preference (and maybe human simulater)
title_zh: Benchmark will be bipolar, objective ones will all be evaluated by code execution, subjective ones human preference (and maybe human simulater)
summary_en: Yao predicted benchmarks will split in two: objective ones evaluated by code execution, subjective ones by human (or simulated human) preference.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨预测未来基准测试将分化为两类:客观类通过代码执行评估,主观类则依赖人类(或模拟人类)偏好评估。

title_en: IMO the most important aspect of video generation is coherent long horizon. It is an indication of capturing the world dynamics beyond pixels, and an important
title_zh: IMO the most important aspect of video generation is coherent long horizon. It is an indication of capturing the world dynamics beyond pixels, and an important
summary_en: Yao argued coherent long-horizon generation is the most important aspect of video models, seeing it as a step toward capturing world dynamics and 'world models.'
summary_zh: 姚顺雨认为,连贯的长时程生成是视频生成模型最重要的方面,并将其视为捕捉世界动态、迈向'世界模型'的关键一步。

title_en: Cool work and great extension of WebShop (https://t.co/eCk9bpOP9w) --- We've been thinking about making it personalized for some years, it's great someone start
title_zh: Cool work and great extension of WebShop (https://t.co/eCk9bpOP9w) --- We've been thinking about making it personalized for some years, it's great someone start
summary_en: Yao praised a personalization extension of his WebShop benchmark, noting his team had long considered building that direction themselves.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨称赞了一项对其WebShop基准的个性化扩展工作,并提到团队早就设想过朝这个方向发展。

title_en: 129 - Transformers and Hierarchical Structure, with Shunyu Yao
title_zh: 129 - Transformers and Hierarchical Structure, with Shunyu Yao
summary_en: An early interview where Yao discussed his research on how transformers represent bounded-depth hierarchical structure in language, before his later work on ReAct and agents.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨在ReAct与智能体研究之前的一次早期访谈，探讨了Transformer如何表示语言中有限深度的层级结构。

title_en: Ungrounded Meaning
title_zh: Ungrounded Meaning
summary_en: An early blog post responding to work on whether a language model can acquire meaning from ungrounded form alone.
summary_zh: 早期博文，回应「语言模型能否仅凭无指涉的形式习得意义」这一问题的相关研究。

title_en: Joins Tencent as Chief AI Scientist
title_zh: 加入腾讯任首席 AI 科学家
summary_en: Tencent merged its Hunyuan multimodal and LLM divisions into a single Foundation Model Department under him — part of a broader wave of Chinese labs recruiting from US frontier labs.
summary_zh: 腾讯将混元多模态与大语言模型两个部门合并为基础模型部由其统领 —— 属于中国实验室从美国前沿实验室大举招募的更大浪潮。

title_en: 王兴兴再登《财富》40岁以下商界精英榜，张雪、姚顺雨等首次入选
title_zh: 王兴兴再登《财富》40岁以下商界精英榜，张雪、姚顺雨等首次入选
summary_en: Shunyu Yao was named to Fortune China's 40 Under 40 business elite list for the first time.
summary_zh: 姚顺雨首次入选《财富》中国40位40岁以下商界精英榜。

title_en: The next phase of intelligence

summary_en: Argues the next phase will not come from scaling models larger but from redesigning AI to understand the world and plan within it.
summary_zh: 主张下一阶段不来自把模型做得更大，而来自重新设计能理解世界并在其中规划的 AI。

title_en: Diffusion can multiply LLM, not just add to it to work in parallel, the outcome is a lossless acceleration of any existing LLMs. Try it out!
title_zh: Diffusion can multiply LLM, not just add to it to work in parallel, the outcome is a lossless acceleration of any existing LLMs. Try it out!
summary_en: Xing argues diffusion can multiply rather than simply add to an LLM's capability when run in parallel, giving a lossless speedup to existing models.
summary_zh: 邢波提出扩散模型并行运行时能对LLM能力做“乘法”式提升而非简单叠加，从而为现有模型带来无损加速。

title_en: Glad to be quoted here of my standing on AI dystopia -- an idea, a software (which AI is), a blueprint on a file (which AI generates), is NOT a physical actuati
title_zh: Glad to be quoted here of my standing on AI dystopia -- an idea, a software (which AI is), a blueprint on a file (which AI generates), is NOT a physical actuati
summary_en: Xing argued AI itself is not physical actuation, and that closing the gap to real-world dystopian risk takes far more than software alone.
summary_zh: 邢波指出AI本身并非物理执行，从软件到现实世界的"AI反乌托邦"风险之间还有很长的路要走。

title_en: Glad to be quoted here (thank you @CNN and @TM_Brown!) of my standing on AI dystopia -- an idea, a software (which AI is), a blueprint on a file (which AI gener
title_zh: Glad to be quoted here (thank you @CNN and @TM_Brown!) of my standing on AI dystopia -- an idea, a software (which AI is), a blueprint on a file (which AI gener
summary_en: After being quoted by CNN, Eric Xing argued that AI — as an idea, software, or design blueprint — is not itself physical actuation, pushing back on dystopian framings of AI risk.
summary_zh: 邢波在被CNN引用后指出，AI作为一种想法、软件或设计蓝图，本身并不等同于物理执行，以此反驳对AI风险的“反乌托邦”式描述。

title_en: We discussed fundamental issues in the definition, model architecture, computational algorithm, and meaningful evaluation/qualification of a fully steerable vir
title_zh: We discussed fundamental issues in the definition, model architecture, computational algorithm, and meaningful evaluation/qualification of a fully steerable vir
summary_en: Eric Xing discussed open problems in defining and evaluating a fully steerable, multi-modal "virtual cell" model.
summary_zh: 邢波探讨了在定义和评估一个可完全操控、多模态的“虚拟细胞”模型时存在的根本性问题。

title_en: Glad to share my perspective on the recent AI-pacing and humanity risk narratives on @CNBC. AI, however powerful, is a piece of software residing inside a chip;
title_zh: Glad to share my perspective on the recent AI-pacing and humanity risk narratives on @CNBC. AI, however powerful, is a piece of software residing inside a chip;
summary_en: Xing shared his view, given on CNBC, that AI risk should be engineered against rather than treated as an abstract existential threat, since AI is software running on a chip with no independent physical agency.
summary_zh: 邢波分享了他在CNBC上的观点：AI风险应通过工程手段加以管控，而非视为抽象的生存威胁，因为AI本质上是运行在芯片上的软件，不具备独立的物理行动能力。

title_en: Well, I’d add one more with myself, as one with a PhD in biology and another PhD in AI and now working in both, to make n=2. Generating a hypothetical genome bl
title_zh: Well, I’d add one more with myself, as one with a PhD in biology and another PhD in AI and now working in both, to make n=2. Generating a hypothetical genome bl
summary_en: Xing, who holds PhDs in both biology and AI, weighed in on generating a virus's genome blueprint via LLMs versus wet-lab methods, offering himself as a case study in dual-domain expertise.
summary_zh: 邢波拥有生物学和人工智能双博士学位，他就使用大语言模型生成病毒基因组蓝图与湿实验室方法的对比发表看法，并以自身为跨领域专长的案例。

title_en: HypoEvolve: Genetic Algorithms Enable Multi-Agent LLMs to Discover Scientific Hypotheses
title_zh: HypoEvolve: Genetic Algorithms Enable Multi-Agent LLMs to Discover Scientific Hypotheses
summary_en: Eric Xing co-authored HypoEvolve, a genetic-algorithm framework that lets multi-agent LLM systems generate and refine scientific hypotheses.
summary_zh: 邢波合著了HypoEvolve，一个利用遗传算法让多智能体大语言模型系统生成并优化科学假设的框架。

title_en: If you truly enjoy math, rather than the glory or award coming with the race, you can still work on the problem in your own way even if a brute force solution b
title_zh: If you truly enjoy math, rather than the glory or award coming with the race, you can still work on the problem in your own way even if a brute force solution b
summary_en: Xing argued that genuinely enjoying a math problem matters more than racing to beat AI or other mathematicians to a solution.
summary_zh: 邢波指出，真正享受数学问题本身，比急于在与AI或其他数学家的竞赛中抢先解题更重要。

title_en: A great article by @PatrickMoorhead on what "open source" truly entails: an API is a hotel room you pay to stay without owning it; open weights is a house that
title_zh: A great article by @PatrickMoorhead on what "open source" truly entails: an API is a hotel room you pay to stay without owning it; open weights is a house that
summary_en: Xing endorsed an argument distinguishing API access, open weights, and true open source as different degrees of openness — comparing them to a rented hotel room, a house with no blueprints, and full ownership.
summary_zh: 邢波转发并认可了一种观点：API、开放权重与真正的开源代表不同程度的"开放"，如同租用的酒店房间、没有图纸的房子与完全拥有的房产，用以厘清"开源"一词的真正含义。

title_en: Everyone is talking about how AI borrowed a human idea and solved a millennium prize problem ahead of the mathematician without giving him credit. To me, this i
title_zh: Everyone is talking about how AI borrowed a human idea and solved a millennium prize problem ahead of the mathematician without giving him credit. To me, this i
summary_en: Xing weighed in on the debate over an AI system solving a Millennium Prize-level problem without crediting the mathematician whose idea it built on, framing it as a human ethics failure rather than an AI one.
summary_zh: 针对AI在未署名致谢原创数学家的情况下解出千禧年大奖难题级问题一事，邢波表示这是人类伦理问题而非AI本身的问题。

title_en: Check out "Uno Discrete Diffusion" embedded in our K2 Horizon release. From our 360 open-source release, you will find out how it works yourself and use it for
title_zh: Check out "Uno Discrete Diffusion" embedded in our K2 Horizon release. From our 360 open-source release, you will find out how it works yourself and use it for
summary_en: Xing pointed to 'Uno Discrete Diffusion' inside the K2 Horizon release, part of a fully open-source rollout.
summary_zh: 邢波介绍了K2 Horizon版本中的“Uno Discrete Diffusion”，这是本次全开源发布的一部分。

title_en: The #1 model outside US and China, but 360-open. Meaningful AI progress depends on the ability to examine, build upon, and improve the technology, not simply ac
title_zh: The #1 model outside US and China, but 360-open. Meaningful AI progress depends on the ability to examine, build upon, and improve the technology, not simply ac
summary_en: Xing calls K2 Horizon the top open model outside the US and China, arguing real AI progress requires the ability to examine and build on the technology, not just access it via API.
summary_zh: 邢波称K2 Horizon是美中之外排名第一的开源模型,并强调真正的AI进步需要能够审查和基于技术本身进行改进,而不仅仅是通过API访问。

title_en: When you consider a house, do you just want to be a pay-to-stay tenant like in a hotel, or buy it but without its blueprint and material documents, or own the h
title_zh: When you consider a house, do you just want to be a pay-to-stay tenant like in a hotel, or buy it but without its blueprint and material documents, or own the h
summary_en: Xing uses a housing analogy to argue for full model ownership — owning a house with its blueprints, not just renting or buying without the underlying plans.
summary_zh: 邢波用买房作类比,主张应完整拥有模型——就像拥有带图纸的房子,而不是仅仅租住或买房却拿不到设计图纸。

title_en: Unlocking Lossless Speedups in LLMs via Discrete Diffusion
title_zh: Unlocking Lossless Speedups in LLMs via Discrete Diffusion
summary_en: Xing co-authored a paper proposing discrete diffusion methods to achieve lossless inference speedups in LLMs over standard autoregressive decoding.
summary_zh: 邢波合著论文，提出用离散扩散方法在不损失质量的前提下加速大语言模型推理，优于传统自回归解码。

source: Journal of the American Statistical As…
title_en: “Rebuilding” Statistics in the Age of AI: Culture, Infrastructure, and Training
title_zh: “Rebuilding” Statistics in the Age of AI: Culture, Infrastructure, and Training
summary_en: Xing co-authored a Journal of the American Statistical Association piece on rebuilding statistics' culture, infrastructure and training for the AI era.
summary_zh: 邢波合著了一篇发表于《美国统计学会杂志》的文章，探讨在AI时代重建统计学的文化、基础设施与人才培养。

title_en: Toward a First-Principles Update Geometry for the Language-Model Head
title_zh: Toward a First-Principles Update Geometry for the Language-Model Head
summary_en: Eric Xing co-authored a paper proposing a first-principles update geometry for language-model output heads, refining optimizer design for foundation-model training.
summary_zh: 邢波合著了一篇论文，提出针对语言模型输出层的第一性原理更新几何方法，改进了基础模型训练中的优化器设计。

title_zh: You can sign up early access to #AIDO Cell —the world‘s first virtual cell, read the full technical report on system guide, and explore collaboration with us at

title_en: We are proud to release the world's first virtual cell -- a multi-modal, multi-scale, dynamic, and stateful world model of the cell, the first step toward an AI
title_zh: We are proud to release the world's first virtual cell -- a multi-modal, multi-scale, dynamic, and stateful world model of the cell, the first step toward an AI
summary_en: Xing announced the release of AIDO, billed as the first virtual-cell world model — a multi-modal, multi-scale, stateful model of the cell — toward an AI-driven Digital Organism.
summary_zh: 邢波宣布发布AIDO，号称首个虚拟细胞世界模型——一个多模态、多尺度、有状态的细胞模型，迈向AI驱动的数字生命体。

title_en: Our #AIDO perspective is on the cover page of @NatureMedicine !
title_zh: Our #AIDO perspective is on the cover page of @NatureMedicine !
summary_en: Xing noted that his team's AIDO perspective piece made the cover of Nature Medicine.
summary_zh: 邢波指出其团队关于AIDO的观点文章登上了《自然·医学》封面。

title_en: AI is more than LLMs and agentic systems thereupon that deliver "book intelligence", it can help better understand nature and life by simulating it computationa
title_zh: AI is more than LLMs and agentic systems thereupon that deliver "book intelligence", it can help better understand nature and life by simulating it computationa
summary_en: Xing argued AI's value extends beyond LLMs and agents to simulating nature and life computationally, pointing to his Nature Medicine paper.
summary_zh: 邢波指出AI的价值不止于大模型和智能体，还能通过计算方式模拟自然与生命，并引用了其在《自然·医学》发表的论文。

title_en: Raven: High-Recall Sequence Modeling with Sparse Memory Routing
title_zh: Raven: High-Recall Sequence Modeling with Sparse Memory Routing
summary_en: Introduces Raven, a linear-time sequence model that routes writes into a sparse memory instead of a dense state, recovering long-context recall; co-authored with Albert Gu's group.
summary_zh: 提出 Raven：用稀疏记忆路由取代稠密状态写入的线性时间序列模型，以恢复长上下文召回能力，与 Albert Gu 团队合作完成。

title_en: Context-Adaptive Inference: A Unified Statistical and Foundation-Model View
title_zh: Context-Adaptive Inference: A Unified Statistical and Foundation-Model View
summary_en: Unifies classical varying-coefficient statistics and foundation-model in-context adaptation under one account of context-adaptive inference, continuing Xing's contextualized machine learning line.
summary_zh: 将经典的变系数统计方法与基础模型的上下文内自适应统一为一套「上下文自适应推断」框架，延续邢波在情境化机器学习方向的研究。

title_en: It was a pleasure to sit down with @BeckyCNN to discuss impact of AI on society and how to prepare our young generation for that — learn it, use it, and ask new
title_zh: It was a pleasure to sit down with @BeckyCNN to discuss impact of AI on society and how to prepare our young generation for that — learn it, use it, and ask new
summary_en: Xing discussed with CNN's Becky Anderson how AI is reshaping society and how the next generation should prepare for it.
summary_zh: 邢波在接受CNN Becky Anderson采访时探讨了AI对社会的影响，以及年轻一代应如何为此做好准备。

title_en: Retrieval-Augmented Interpretable Learning: Towards Task-Specific Zero-Shot Models in Healthcare
title_zh: Retrieval-Augmented Interpretable Learning: Towards Task-Specific Zero-Shot Models in Healthcare
summary_en: Presents RAIL, a meta-learning framework that generates task-specific interpretable models for healthcare with no task-specific training data.
summary_zh: 提出 RAIL 元学习框架，无需任务专属训练数据即可为医疗场景零样本生成可解释模型。

title_en: Agree. Not just in LLM-biz, industry in general, even in academia, university presidents, provosts, are better served if they themselves are down-to-earth doers
title_zh: Agree. Not just in LLM-biz, industry in general, even in academia, university presidents, provosts, are better served if they themselves are down-to-earth doers
summary_en: Xing argued that university presidents and provosts, like industry leaders, are better served by staying hands-on practitioners rather than purely administrators.
summary_zh: 邢波认为，大学校长和教务长与业界领袖一样，若能保持亲力亲为的实践者身份而非纯粹的管理者，会做得更好。

title_en: We discussed foundational issues underlying how to make truly “agentive” systems. https://t.co/sgO2XjDg0b
title_zh: We discussed foundational issues underlying how to make truly “agentive” systems. https://t.co/sgO2XjDg0b
summary_en: Xing shared a discussion on the foundational issues in building truly "agentive" AI systems.
summary_zh: 邢波分享了一场关于构建真正“具备能动性”的AI系统所涉及的基础性问题的讨论。

title_en: Critique of Agent Model
title_zh: Critique of Agent Model
summary_en: A position paper he leads as first author arguing that current "agentic" LLM systems lack a coherent model of agency, and setting out what one would require.
summary_zh: 他作为第一作者撰写的立场论文，指出当前所谓「智能体」的大模型系统缺乏连贯的能动性模型，并提出这样的模型应具备什么。

title_en: A companion paper to the critique of agent model paper. https://t.co/4tEIM7TO3u
title_zh: A companion paper to the critique of agent model paper. https://t.co/4tEIM7TO3u
summary_en: Xing shared a companion paper to his critique of the agent-model framing of AI systems.
summary_zh: 邢波分享了一篇论文，作为其对“智能体模型”框架批判的姊妹篇。

title_en: Decoding the “Critique of Agent Model” Paper https://t.co/V3Ry8HVnYs
title_zh: Decoding the “Critique of Agent Model” Paper https://t.co/V3Ry8HVnYs
summary_en: Xing shared a piece decoding his own paper critiquing the "agent model" framing of AI systems.
summary_zh: 邢波分享了一篇解读其批判“智能体模型”论文的文章。

title_en: From Reasoning Traces to Reusable Modules: Understanding Compositional Generalization in Language Model Reasoning
title_zh: From Reasoning Traces to Reusable Modules: Understanding Compositional Generalization in Language Model Reasoning
summary_en: Paper analysing how SFT-plus-RL post-training produces reusable reasoning modules and where compositional generalisation comes from.
summary_zh: 论文分析 SFT 加强化学习的后训练如何形成可复用的推理模块，以及组合泛化的来源。

title_en: The outlook of an AI-driven Digital Organism (AIDO), such as a virtual cell (VC), has recently captivated much excitement and imagination from both AI and Biolo
title_zh: The outlook of an AI-driven Digital Organism (AIDO), such as a virtual cell (VC), has recently captivated much excitement and imagination from both AI and Biolo
summary_en: Xing laid out the outlook and open problems for an AI-driven Digital Organism such as a virtual cell, a topic drawing excitement across AI and biology.
summary_zh: 邢波阐述了AI驱动的数字生命体（如虚拟细胞）的前景与待解难题，这一话题正引发AI与生物学界的广泛关注。

title_en: With the rise of LLM systems marketed as "coding agents", "AI co-scientists", etc. that promise to drive up productivity, and at the same time outcry of "existe
title_zh: With the rise of LLM systems marketed as "coding agents", "AI co-scientists", etc. that promise to drive up productivity, and at the same time outcry of "existe
summary_en: Xing weighed in on the hype around LLM-based "coding agents" and "AI co-scientists" versus concerns about AI escaping human control.
summary_zh: 邢波就被包装成“编程智能体”“AI联合科学家”的大模型系统所受追捧，以及AI失控等“存在性”担忧发表了看法。

title_en: Uniform Diffusion Models Revisited: Leave-One-Out Denoiser and Absorbing State Reformulation
title_zh: Uniform Diffusion Models Revisited: Leave-One-Out Denoiser and Absorbing State Reformulation
summary_en: Revisits uniform discrete diffusion, deriving a leave-one-out denoiser and an absorbing-state reformulation of the reverse dynamics.
summary_zh: 重新审视均匀离散扩散模型，推导出留一去噪器，并将逆向动力学重构为吸收态形式。

title_en: Efficient Agentic Reasoning Through Self-Regulated Simulative Planning
title_zh: Efficient Agentic Reasoning Through Self-Regulated Simulative Planning
summary_en: Proposes agents that decide for themselves when to plan, using self-regulated simulative planning rather than relying on planning to emerge from end-to-end training.
summary_zh: 提出让智能体自行决定何时规划的自调节模拟规划方法，而非指望规划能力从端到端训练中自发涌现。

title_en: CHI-Bench: Can AI Agents Automate End-to-End, Long-Horizon, Policy-Rich Healthcare Workflows?
title_zh: CHI-Bench: Can AI Agents Automate End-to-End, Long-Horizon, Policy-Rich Healthcare Workflows?
summary_en: Introduces CHI-Bench, a benchmark testing whether agents can run long-horizon, policy-dense healthcare workflows end to end.
summary_zh: 提出 CHI-Bench 基准，检验智能体能否端到端执行长周期、规则密集的医疗业务流程。

title_en: GQA-μP: The maximal parameterization update for grouped query attention
title_zh: GQA-μP: The maximal parameterization update for grouped query attention
summary_en: Derives the maximal update parameterization for grouped query attention, so tuned hyperparameters transfer across model scales under GQA.
summary_zh: 推导分组查询注意力下的最大更新参数化，使调好的超参数能在 GQA 架构中跨模型规模迁移。

title_en: EMO: Frustratingly Easy Progressive Training of Extendable MoE
title_zh: EMO: Frustratingly Easy Progressive Training of Extendable MoE
summary_en: Presents EMO, a progressive training recipe that lets a sparse mixture-of-experts model be extended with more experts after training has begun.
summary_zh: 提出 EMO 渐进式训练方法，使稀疏专家混合模型在训练开始后仍可继续扩充专家数量。

title_en: Siliconsciousness: The Great and Good Disruptive Power of World Models
title_zh: Siliconsciousness: The Great and Good Disruptive Power of World Models
summary_en: Xing joined David Rothkopf on The DSR Network's Siliconsciousness podcast to discuss MBZUAI's approach to AI education, world models, and human agency in AI.
summary_zh: 邢波在The DSR Network的Siliconsciousness播客节目中与David Rothkopf对谈，探讨了MBZUAI的AI教育方式、世界模型以及AI时代的人类能动性问题。

title_en: “A university that asks students what they want and gives it to them is not educating – it is catering.” In my annual MBZUAI commencement address today, I empha
title_zh: “A university that asks students what they want and gives it to them is not educating – it is catering.” In my annual MBZUAI commencement address today, I empha
summary_en: In his MBZUAI commencement address, Xing argued that a university that simply gives students what they ask for is catering, not educating.
summary_zh: 邢波在MBZUAI毕业典礼致辞中提出，一所大学若只是满足学生的要求，那是在迎合而非教育。

title_en: COPUS: Co-adaptive Parallelism and Batch Size Selection in Large Language Model Training
title_zh: COPUS: Co-adaptive Parallelism and Batch Size Selection in Large Language Model Training
summary_en: Systems work from his distributed-training line: COPUS jointly selects global batch size and 3D parallelism strategy for LLM training instead of tuning them separately.
summary_zh: 延续其分布式训练方向的系统工作：COPUS 联合选择大模型训练的全局批大小与三维并行策略，而非分别调优。

title_en: At ⁦@genbioai⁩, we use AI to build AI, so virtual cells can be made and harnessed automatically at scale. https://t.co/A58YNZwraO
title_zh: At ⁦@genbioai⁩, we use AI to build AI, so virtual cells can be made and harnessed automatically at scale. https://t.co/A58YNZwraO
summary_en: Xing described GenBio AI's approach of using AI to build AI, so virtual cells can be generated and deployed automatically at scale.
summary_zh: 邢波介绍了GenBio AI“用AI构建AI”的方法，使虚拟细胞得以自动化、规模化地生成与应用。

title_en: CocoaBench: Evaluating Unified Digital Agents in the Wild
title_zh: CocoaBench: Evaluating Unified Digital Agents in the Wild
summary_en: CocoaBench evaluates unified digital agents across software engineering, research and GUI automation in realistic settings.
summary_zh: CocoaBench 在贴近真实的场景中，横跨软件工程、深度研究与图形界面自动化评测统一型数字智能体。

title_en: World Reasoning Arena
title_zh: World Reasoning Arena
summary_en: From the PAN team he co-leads: a benchmark for world models that tests reasoning about environments rather than narrow prediction tasks.
summary_zh: 出自他共同领导的 PAN 团队：面向世界模型的基准，考察对环境的推理能力而非狭窄的预测任务。

title_en: A major breakthrough that will tip the landscape of world models! The #FastVideo from Institute of Foundation Models of @mbzuai in collaboration with UC San Die
title_zh: A major breakthrough that will tip the landscape of world models! The #FastVideo from Institute of Foundation Models of @mbzuai in collaboration with UC San Die
summary_en: Xing highlighted FastVideo, a world-model breakthrough from MBZUAI's Institute of Foundation Models with UC San Diego.
summary_zh: 邢波介绍了FastVideo——MBZUAI基础模型研究所与加州大学圣地亚哥分校合作取得的世界模型突破。

title_en: #351 Will World Models Bring us AGI? with Eric Xing, President & Professor at MBZUAI
title_zh: #351 Will World Models Bring us AGI? with Eric Xing, President & Professor at MBZUAI
summary_en: Long-form DataFramed interview in which he argues world models, not language models, are the route to general intelligence.
summary_zh: 在 DataFramed 播客的长篇访谈中，他提出通向通用智能的路径是世界模型而非语言模型。

title_en: IsoCompute Playbook: Optimally Scaling Sampling Compute for LLM RL
title_zh: IsoCompute Playbook: Optimally Scaling Sampling Compute for LLM RL
summary_en: Studies how to allocate sampling compute in RL post-training of LLMs, giving iso-compute scaling prescriptions analogous to pre-training scaling laws.
summary_zh: 研究大模型强化学习后训练中采样算力的分配方式，给出与预训练缩放律相对应的等算力扩展方案。

title_en: Mobile-O: Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation on Mobile Device
title_zh: Mobile-O: Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation on Mobile Device
summary_en: MBZUAI work on Mobile-O, a unified multimodal understanding-and-generation model small enough to run on edge devices.
summary_zh: MBZUAI 的 Mobile-O 工作：一个足够轻量、可在端侧设备运行的统一多模态理解与生成模型。

title_en: CellMaster: Collaborative Cell Type Annotation in Single-Cell Analysis
title_zh: CellMaster: Collaborative Cell Type Annotation in Single-Cell Analysis
summary_en: Applies multi-agent LLM collaboration to cell type annotation, a long-standing bottleneck in single-cell RNA-seq analysis.
summary_zh: 将多智能体大模型协作用于细胞类型标注——单细胞 RNA 测序分析中长期存在的瓶颈。

title_en: scPilot: Large Language Model Reasoning Toward Automated Single-Cell Analysis and Discovery
title_zh: scPilot: Large Language Model Reasoning Toward Automated Single-Cell Analysis and Discovery
summary_en: scPilot has an LLM reason directly over single-cell RNA-seq data in natural language, extending his computational-biology work to omics-native reasoning.
summary_zh: scPilot 让大模型以自然语言直接对单细胞 RNA 测序数据进行推理，将他的计算生物学工作扩展到组学原生推理。

title_en: Retrieval-Aware Distillation for Transformer-SSM Hybrids
title_zh: Retrieval-Aware Distillation for Transformer-SSM Hybrids
summary_en: Distills retrieval-capable attention behaviour into Transformer-SSM hybrids to close the in-context retrieval gap of state-space models.
summary_zh: 将具备检索能力的注意力行为蒸馏进 Transformer-SSM 混合架构，弥补状态空间模型在上下文内检索上的短板。

title_en: FIRE-Bench: Evaluating AI Agents on the Rediscovery of Scientific Insights
title_zh: FIRE-Bench: Evaluating AI Agents on the Rediscovery of Scientific Insights
summary_en: Paper introducing FIRE-Bench, a benchmark testing whether LLM agents can rediscover known scientific insights.
summary_zh: 论文提出 FIRE-Bench，用于检验大模型智能体能否重新发现已知的科学结论。

title_en: My conversation with @partickmoorhead at #Davos26 on rethinking AI ladders (book-intelligence, physical intelligence, social intelligence, and philosophical int
title_zh: My conversation with @partickmoorhead at #Davos26 on rethinking AI ladders (book-intelligence, physical intelligence, social intelligence, and philosophical int
summary_en: Xing discussed rethinking "AI ladders" — book, physical, social and philosophical intelligence — plus world models and open research, in a Davos conversation with Patrick Moorhead.
summary_zh: 邢波在达沃斯与Patrick Moorhead对谈，探讨重新审视“AI阶梯”（书本智能、物理智能、社会智能与哲学智能）、世界模型及开放研究。

title_en: The #K2Think V2 we released today represents a significant leap of the already-strong performance on deep reasoning over V1 (https://t.co/qiELrJOmDt), and furth
title_zh: The #K2Think V2 we released today represents a significant leap of the already-strong performance on deep reasoning over V1 (https://t.co/qiELrJOmDt), and furth
summary_en: Xing announced K2 Think V2, a significant leap in deep-reasoning performance and reliability over V1.
summary_zh: 邢波宣布K2 Think V2发布，在深度推理性能和可靠性上较V1有显著提升。

title_en: "Rebuilding" Statistics in the Age of AI: A Town Hall Discussion on Culture, Infrastructure, and Training
title_zh: "Rebuilding" Statistics in the Age of AI: A Town Hall Discussion on Culture, Infrastructure, and Training
summary_en: He is one of the panellists in this published record of the JSM town hall on how statistics should rebuild its culture, infrastructure and training for the AI era.
summary_zh: 他是这场 JSM 圆桌讨论的与会者之一，会议记录探讨统计学应如何为人工智能时代重建其学术文化、基础设施与人才培养。

title_en: It was a pleasure to share the stage with @Yoshua_Bengio, @YejinChoinka, @harari_yuval, and @nxthompson, at #WEF26 in Davos to discuss "Next Phase of Intelligen
title_zh: It was a pleasure to share the stage with @Yoshua_Bengio, @YejinChoinka, @harari_yuval, and @nxthompson, at #WEF26 in Davos to discuss "Next Phase of Intelligen
summary_en: Xing shared his reservations on current AI trajectories at a WEF Davos panel with Yoshua Bengio, Yejin Choi and Yuval Harari on the "Next Phase of Intelligence."
summary_zh: 邢波在达沃斯世界经济论坛与Yoshua Bengio、Yejin Choi、Yuval Harari同台探讨“智能的下一阶段”，并分享了他对当前AI发展路径的保留意见。

title_en: LAPS: A Length-Aware-Prefill LLM Serving System
title_zh: LAPS: A Length-Aware-Prefill LLM Serving System
summary_en: LLM serving system that disaggregates requests by prompt length to cut time-to-first-token, from his systems group with Qirong Ho.
summary_zh: 与何奇龙团队合作的大模型服务系统，按提示长度拆分请求以降低首字延迟。

title_en: 2025 has been a productive year for me as a researcher and engineering lead. I managed to spend time working on three exciting technical projects in addition to
title_zh: 2025 has been a productive year for me as a researcher and engineering lead. I managed to spend time working on three exciting technical projects in addition to
summary_en: Xing reflected on 2025 as a productive year, working on three technical research projects alongside leading MBZUAI.
summary_zh: 邢波回顾2025年，称这是充实的一年，在领导MBZUAI的同时还推进了三个技术研究项目。

title_en: 2025 marks a year of transformation for @mbzuai. We have begun a new chapter in our development - from an AI-centric university to an AI-powered comprehensive u
title_zh: 2025 marks a year of transformation for @mbzuai. We have begun a new chapter in our development - from an AI-centric university to an AI-powered comprehensive u
summary_en: Xing described 2025 as a year of transformation for MBZUAI, shifting from an AI-centric university toward an AI-powered comprehensive university.
summary_zh: 邢波称2025年是MBZUAI转型的一年，学校正从以AI为中心的大学向AI驱动的综合性大学迈进。

title_en: Long context LLM training made (quasi) linear via core-attention disaggregation. 👇
title_zh: Long context LLM training made (quasi) linear via core-attention disaggregation. 👇
summary_en: Xing shared work making long-context LLM training quasi-linear via core-attention disaggregation.
summary_zh: 邢波分享了通过核心注意力解耦实现长上下文大模型训练近线性化的研究工作。

title_en: K2-V2 is a 70B parameter 360-open #LLM built from scratch as a superior base for reasoning adaptation, in addition to functions such as conversation and knowled
title_zh: K2-V2 is a 70B parameter 360-open #LLM built from scratch as a superior base for reasoning adaptation, in addition to functions such as conversation and knowled
summary_en: Xing detailed K2-V2, a 70B-parameter fully open LLM built from scratch as a base for reasoning, conversation and knowledge retrieval.
summary_zh: 邢波介绍了K2-V2，一个从零训练、完全开放的700亿参数大模型，可作为推理、对话与知识检索的基础模型。

title_en: When you map today’s #LLMs across performance, openness, and scale, the landscape becomes unmistakable: U.S. frontier models dominate performance, but remain co
title_zh: When you map today’s #LLMs across performance, openness, and scale, the landscape becomes unmistakable: U.S. frontier models dominate performance, but remain co
summary_en: Xing mapped the LLM landscape across performance, openness and scale, noting U.S. frontier models dominate performance but stay closed while Chinese open-weight systems close the gap.
summary_zh: 邢波从性能、开放度与规模三个维度描绘了大模型格局，指出美国前沿模型性能领先但保持闭源，而中国开源模型正在缩小差距。

title_en: Bridging Streaming Continual Learning via In-Context Large Tabular Models
title_zh: Bridging Streaming Continual Learning via In-Context Large Tabular Models
summary_en: Uses in-context learning in large tabular models to handle streaming continual learning, bridging concept drift adaptation and catastrophic forgetting.
summary_zh: 利用大型表格模型的上下文内学习处理流式持续学习，将概念漂移适应与灾难性遗忘两类问题连接起来。

title_en: Beyond the Black Box: Identifiable Interpretation and Control in Generative Models via Causal Minimality
title_zh: Beyond the Black Box: Identifiable Interpretation and Control in Generative Models via Causal Minimality
summary_en: With Kun Zhang's causality group, shows that causal minimality yields identifiable and controllable interpretations of generative models.
summary_zh: 与张坤的因果推断团队合作，论证因果最小性可为生成模型带来可识别、可控制的解释。

title_en: Impressive position of the 5-year old @mbzuai of UAE in this picture 😊 Congratulations to our faculty and students!
title_zh: Impressive position of the 5-year old @mbzuai of UAE in this picture 😊 Congratulations to our faculty and students!
summary_en: Xing celebrated MBZUAI's strong showing, at five years old, in a ranking of top AI research contributors.
summary_zh: 邢波庆祝仅五岁的MBZUAI在AI研究贡献排名中取得优异成绩。

title_en: Now you have an alternative to the super popular but unfortunately not so transparent (you have no idea how it was trained, what data was used, is it safe …) ba
title_zh: Now you have an alternative to the super popular but unfortunately not so transparent (you have no idea how it was trained, what data was used, is it safe …) ba
summary_en: Xing positioned his team's model as a transparent alternative to popular but opaque base LLMs like Qwen 2.5/3, whose training data and safety are undisclosed.
summary_zh: 邢波将其团队的模型定位为Qwen 2.5/3等热门但不透明基础大模型的透明替代方案，后者的训练数据与安全性均未公开。

title_en: In this paper we present the first full implementation of the Generative Latent Prediction (GLP) architecture of world modeling, that brings perception, state,
title_zh: In this paper we present the first full implementation of the Generative Latent Prediction (GLP) architecture of world modeling, that brings perception, state,
summary_en: Xing presented the first full implementation of the Generative Latent Prediction (GLP) world-modeling architecture, unifying perception, state, action and causality.
summary_zh: 邢波展示了生成式潜在预测（GLP）世界建模架构的首个完整实现，将感知、状态、动作与因果统一于一体。

title_en: I am excited to unveil PAN, a general, interactable, and long-horizon world model that invites you to step into infinitely possible real or surreal worlds unfol
title_zh: I am excited to unveil PAN, a general, interactable, and long-horizon world model that invites you to step into infinitely possible real or surreal worlds unfol
summary_en: Xing unveiled PAN, a general, interactive, long-horizon world model for exploring possible real or imagined worlds.
summary_zh: 邢波发布了PAN——一个通用、可交互、长时程的世界模型，可用于探索可能的现实或想象世界。

title_en: Great to meet @demishassabis today at @mbzuai to introduce to him our university and discuss a wide range of topics from world model to virtual cell and find lo
title_zh: Great to meet @demishassabis today at @mbzuai to introduce to him our university and discuss a wide range of topics from world model to virtual cell and find lo
summary_en: Xing hosted Demis Hassabis at MBZUAI, discussing world models, virtual cells and shared research directions.
summary_zh: 邢波在MBZUAI接待了Demis Hassabis，双方就世界模型、虚拟细胞等共同研究方向进行了交流。

title_en: #2: Is the Path to Empowerment Paved by AI? - Eric Xing
title_zh: #2: Is the Path to Empowerment Paved by AI? - Eric Xing
summary_en: Interview recorded in Abu Dhabi on his leadership of MBZUAI, the first university dedicated solely to AI.
summary_zh: 在阿布扎比录制的访谈，谈他执掌全球首所人工智能专门大学 MBZUAI 的经历。

title_en: MBZUAI's Institute of Foundation Models releases open reasoning model K2 Think
title_zh: MBZUAI 基础模型研究院开源推理模型 K2 Think
summary_en: Covered internationally as part of the UAE's sovereign-AI push.
summary_zh: 被国际媒体视为阿联酋主权 AI 推进的一部分。

title_en: 邢波团队发布《智能体模型批评》，质疑当前AI智能体是否真正具备能动性
title_zh: 邢波团队发布《智能体模型批评》，质疑当前AI智能体是否真正具备能动性
summary_en: Xing's team published a critique of current agent models, questioning whether they possess real agency.
summary_zh: 邢波团队发布《智能体模型批评》，质疑当前 AI 智能体是否真正具备能动性。

title_en: Normalized cuts and image segmentation
title_zh: 归一化割与图像分割
summary_en: One of the foundations the whole segmentation line was built on.
summary_zh: 整条分割研究线赖以建立的基础之一。

title_en: Rich feature hierarchies for accurate object detection (R-CNN)
title_zh: 面向精确目标检测的丰富特征层次（R-CNN）

title_en: Very cool result, Congrats! There is an insightful quote from philosopher Merleau-Ponty, " We know not through our intellect but through our experience" . The e
title_zh: Very cool result, Congrats! There is an insightful quote from philosopher Merleau-Ponty, " We know not through our intellect but through our experience" . The e
summary_en: Commented on a robot-learning result, citing Merleau-Ponty to argue reinforcement learning captures experiential rather than purely intellectual knowledge.
summary_zh: 针对一项机器人学习成果发表评论，引用梅洛-庞蒂的话，认为强化学习捕捉的是经验性而非纯智力性的知识。

title_en: 3D/4D reconstruction is one of the great achievements of computer vision. With roots in photogrammetry, multi-view geometry was much studied (e.g. Hartley & Zis
title_zh: 3D/4D reconstruction is one of the great achievements of computer vision. With roots in photogrammetry, multi-view geometry was much studied (e.g. Hartley & Zis
summary_en: Jitendra Malik argues 3D/4D reconstruction is one of computer vision's great achievements, tracing its lineage from photogrammetry and multi-view geometry to recent progress.
summary_zh: Jitendra Malik撰文指出3D/4D重建是计算机视觉的重大成就之一，并梳理了从摄影测量学、多视图几何到近期进展的发展脉络。

title_en: Toru raises fundamental concerns with which I agree. It is amazing to see the progress in VLMs such as Astra, building on the work of generations of scientists.
title_zh: Toru raises fundamental concerns with which I agree. It is amazing to see the progress in VLMs such as Astra, building on the work of generations of scientists.
summary_en: Malik agreed with a critique that VLMs like Astra fail to cite the generations of prior scientific work they build on.
summary_zh: 马利克赞同一种批评观点，认为像Astra这样的视觉语言模型没有引用其所依赖的历代科学研究成果。

title_en: In the old days we used to talk about "graduate student descent" or "researcher gradient descent" as referring to the phase in research where one tries various
title_zh: In the old days we used to talk about "graduate student descent" or "researcher gradient descent" as referring to the phase in research where one tries various
summary_en: Malik reflects on the earlier era of 'graduate student descent' — the trial-and-error phase of research before more principled methods — offering a historical perspective on how ML research practice has evolved.
summary_zh: 马利克回顾了早期"研究生下降法"（即研究中不断试错的阶段）的说法，从历史视角反思了机器学习研究方法的演变。

title_en: An open letter signed by 24 Fields Medalists is worth paying attention. You may want to peruse "A Severe Misalignment of AI in Mathematics" https://t.co/8jwxjF8
title_zh: An open letter signed by 24 Fields Medalists is worth paying attention. You may want to peruse "A Severe Misalignment of AI in Mathematics" https://t.co/8jwxjF8
summary_en: Jitendra Malik points his followers to an open letter signed by 24 Fields Medalists warning of a severe misalignment in AI-generated mathematics.
summary_zh: Jitendra Malik提醒关注者留意一封由24位菲尔兹奖得主联署的公开信，警告AI在数学领域存在严重的“对齐”问题。

title_en: I am seeing claims around LLMs, specifically Astra having made serious progress on robotics. The tasks that are demonstrated are simple pick and place tasks wit
title_zh: I am seeing claims around LLMs, specifically Astra having made serious progress on robotics. The tasks that are demonstrated are simple pick and place tasks wit
summary_en: Malik pushed back on claims that LLMs like Astra have made serious robotics progress, noting demoed tasks are limited to simple pick-and-place with parallel-jaw grippers.
summary_zh: Malik反驳了关于Astra等LLM在机器人领域取得重大进展的说法，指出目前演示的任务仅限于平行夹爪的简单抓取放置。

title_en: in view of OpenAI's claim about Navier Stokes, it is important that we hear alternative points of view on how it happened. From Tristan Buckmaster, Prof. at NYU
title_zh: in view of OpenAI's claim about Navier Stokes, it is important that we hear alternative points of view on how it happened. From Tristan Buckmaster, Prof. at NYU
summary_en: Malik pushed back on OpenAI's Navier-Stokes claim, pointing to an alternative view from NYU's Tristan Buckmaster.
summary_zh: Malik对OpenAI关于Navier-Stokes方程的说法提出质疑，并引用纽约大学Tristan Buckmaster的不同观点。

title_en: Scientific terms should have precision. If we use the terms VLM, VLA, WAM in an indiscriminate fashion, as is becoming common in robotics, we are not helping cl
title_zh: Scientific terms should have precision. If we use the terms VLM, VLA, WAM in an indiscriminate fashion, as is becoming common in robotics, we are not helping cl
summary_en: Malik argued robotics is using terms like VLM, VLA and WAM too loosely, urging more precision for the sake of clear communication.
summary_zh: Malik认为机器人学界对VLM、VLA、WAM等术语的使用过于随意,呼吁更严谨的表述以利于清晰交流。

title_en: Nice idea to train to predict future sensory inputs along with action sequences. @ir413 Ilija Radosavovic et al (NeurIPS 2024) showed this for humanoid locomoti
title_zh: Nice idea to train to predict future sensory inputs along with action sequences. @ir413 Ilija Radosavovic et al (NeurIPS 2024) showed this for humanoid locomoti
summary_en: Malik praised a new approach to predicting future sensory inputs alongside action sequences, noting his student's NeurIPS 2024 work showed the same idea for humanoid locomotion.
summary_zh: Malik称赞一种同时预测未来感官输入与动作序列的新方法,并指出他学生在NeurIPS 2024上已就人形机器人运动展示过类似想法。

title_en: I concur, and the point is broader than just for Biology. Science does not advance by "pure thinking" alone. We need to do experiments, and interpret the result
title_zh: I concur, and the point is broader than just for Biology. Science does not advance by "pure thinking" alone. We need to do experiments, and interpret the result
summary_en: Malik argued that science, including biology, cannot advance through 'pure thinking' alone and requires experiments to test and refine hypotheses.
summary_zh: Malik指出科学(包括生物学)无法仅靠'纯思考'推进,必须通过实验来检验和完善假设。

title_en: Learning Physical Interaction: A Survey of Tactile- and Force-aware Robot Learning
title_zh: Learning Physical Interaction: A Survey of Tactile- and Force-aware Robot Learning
summary_en: Survey of tactile- and force-aware robot learning, mapping how robots perceive and regulate physical contact — the contact-rich manipulation line his Berkeley group has driven.
summary_zh: 关于触觉与力感知机器人学习的综述，梳理机器人如何感知并调节与物理世界的接触，正是他在伯克利的团队长期推进的富接触操作方向。

title_en: Highly performant open weights frontier models such as Kimi are a competitive threat to OpenAI & Anthropic, but probably for everyone else these are a win. Hope
title_zh: Highly performant open weights frontier models such as Kimi are a competitive threat to OpenAI & Anthropic, but probably for everyone else these are a win. Hope
