summary_en: Malik said strong open-weight frontier models like Kimi pose a competitive threat to OpenAI and Anthropic, but are a net win for everyone else, and hoped more US labs would release top open models.
summary_zh: Malik表示,像Kimi这样强大的开放权重前沿模型对OpenAI和Anthropic构成竞争威胁,但对其他所有人是净利好,并希望更多美国机构发布顶尖开放模型。

title_en: Novel approach to training tactile policies..
title_zh: Novel approach to training tactile policies..
summary_en: Malik shared a novel approach to training tactile robot policies.
summary_zh: Malik分享了一种训练触觉机器人策略的新方法。

title_en: Scalable Behavior Cloning with Open Data, Training, and Evaluation
title_zh: Scalable Behavior Cloning with Open Data, Training, and Evaluation
summary_en: Releases ABC, a fully open-source behavior-cloning stack for manipulation, together with ABC-130K, a 3,500-hour teleoperation dataset billed as the largest open one to date.
summary_zh: 发布全开源的机器人操作模仿学习框架 ABC，并公开 3500 小时的 ABC-130K 遥操作数据集，是目前规模最大的开源同类数据集。

title_en: ForceBand: Learning Forceful Manipulation with sEMG
title_zh: ForceBand: Learning Forceful Manipulation with sEMG
summary_en: Uses surface EMG from human demonstrators to capture the forces behind a demonstration, so robots can learn forceful manipulation rather than trajectories alone.
summary_zh: 利用人类演示者的表面肌电信号采集演示背后的用力信息，让机器人学会有力度的操作，而不只是模仿轨迹。

title_en: In computer vision, the field advanced significantly due to openly available datasets and models; hope this will be true in robotics as well.
title_zh: In computer vision, the field advanced significantly due to openly available datasets and models; hope this will be true in robotics as well.
summary_en: Malik said computer vision advanced significantly thanks to openly available datasets and models, and hoped robotics would follow the same path.
summary_zh: Malik表示计算机视觉的显著进步得益于公开可用的数据集与模型,他希望机器人学也能走同样的道路。

title_en: We can convert human videos to robot hand-object interaction trajectories in 4D. Enjoy! Paper: https://t.co/AS0ecvTB9I Website: https://t.co/KP4dVqxzUb Code: ht
title_zh: We can convert human videos to robot hand-object interaction trajectories in 4D. Enjoy! Paper: https://t.co/AS0ecvTB9I Website: https://t.co/KP4dVqxzUb Code: ht
summary_en: Malik's lab released work converting human videos into 4D robot hand-object interaction trajectories, with paper, website and code.
summary_zh: Malik实验室发布了将人类视频转换为4D机器人'手-物体'交互轨迹的工作,并公开了论文、网站与代码。

title_en: Do as I Do: Dexterous Manipulation Data from Everyday Human Videos
title_zh: Do as I Do: Dexterous Manipulation Data from Everyday Human Videos
summary_en: Turns everyday human videos into training data for dexterous multi-fingered manipulation, attacking the data bottleneck in robot learning.
summary_zh: 把日常的人类视频转化为灵巧多指操作的训练数据，针对机器人学习中的数据瓶颈。

title_en: Contrastive Action-Image Pre-training for Visuomotor Control
title_zh: Contrastive Action-Image Pre-training for Visuomotor Control
summary_en: Pre-trains visuomotor encoders by contrasting actions against images, addressing the scale bottleneck that makes robot datasets too small for large-scale pre-training.
summary_zh: 通过动作与图像的对比学习预训练视觉运动编码器，缓解机器人数据集规模不足以支撑大规模预训练的问题。

title_en: T-Rex: Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation
title_zh: T-Rex: Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation
summary_en: A tactile-reactive dexterous manipulation method that lets vision-language-action policies respond to touch signals in real time.
summary_zh: 提出触觉反应式的灵巧操作方法，让视觉-语言-动作策略能够实时响应触觉信号。

title_en: FARM: Find Anything using Relational Spatial Memory
title_zh: FARM: Find Anything using Relational Spatial Memory
summary_en: Relational spatial memory that lets a robot find specific object instances in cluttered homes and warehouses, going beyond object-level memory.
summary_zh: 提出关系型空间记忆，让机器人在杂乱的家庭和仓库环境中找到特定物体实例，超越仅有物体级记忆的做法。

title_en: I want to offer some unsolicited advice to computer vision researchers jumping into robotics. Don't focus too much on VLMs, VLAs etc. That's fine, but the real
title_zh: I want to offer some unsolicited advice to computer vision researchers jumping into robotics. Don't focus too much on VLMs, VLAs etc. That's fine, but the real
summary_en: Malik advised computer vision researchers entering robotics not to over-focus on VLMs and VLAs, arguing the real action is at the sensorimotor level.
summary_zh: Malik建议转向机器人学的计算机视觉研究者不要过度聚焦VLM、VLA,认为真正的关键在于感觉运动(sensorimotor)层面。

title_en: SAM 3D: 3Dfy Anything in Images received an honorable mention for best paper at CVPR 2026. Even more satisfying, it has enabled learning human-object-interactio
title_zh: SAM 3D: 3Dfy Anything in Images received an honorable mention for best paper at CVPR 2026. Even more satisfying, it has enabled learning human-object-interactio
summary_en: Malik announced SAM 3D received an honorable mention for best paper at CVPR 2026, and noted it has enabled learning human-object interaction trajectories from video.
summary_zh: Malik宣布SAM 3D获得CVPR 2026最佳论文荣誉提名,并指出该工作已助力从视频中学习人-物交互轨迹。

title_en: MonoDuo: Using One Robot Arm to Learn Bimanual Policies
title_zh: MonoDuo: Using One Robot Arm to Learn Bimanual Policies
summary_en: Learns bimanual manipulation policies from single-arm robot data, sidestepping the scarcity of two-armed robots and bimanual datasets.
summary_zh: 用单臂机器人数据学习双臂操作策略，绕开双臂机器人与双臂数据稀缺的限制。

title_en: Beyond Binary: Sim-to-Real Dexterous Manipulation with Physics-Grounded Contact Representation
title_zh: Beyond Binary: Sim-to-Real Dexterous Manipulation with Physics-Grounded Contact Representation
summary_en: A physics-grounded contact representation that narrows the sim-to-real gap for contact-rich dexterous manipulation.
summary_zh: 提出基于物理的接触表征，缩小富接触灵巧操作中的仿真到真实差距。

title_en: We have seen some impressive robot manipulation policies recently. This is great, but for these results to be convincing (and practical) we should insist on gen
title_zh: We have seen some impressive robot manipulation policies recently. This is great, but for these results to be convincing (and practical) we should insist on gen
summary_en: Malik argued that recent robot manipulation policies need to demonstrate generalization across object locations and other conditions to be convincing and practical.
summary_zh: Malik认为,近期的机器人操作策略要真正令人信服和具备实用性,必须证明其在物体位置等条件上的泛化能力。

title_en: World Model for Robot Learning: A Comprehensive Survey
title_zh: World Model for Robot Learning: A Comprehensive Survey
summary_en: Survey of world models in robot learning, covering their use for policy learning, planning, simulation and evaluation.
summary_zh: 关于机器人学习中世界模型的综述，覆盖其在策略学习、规划、仿真与评测中的应用。

title_en: I see every week on X an announcement or demo which implies that robotic manipulation has been solved. The only reason I don't believe it is because manipulatio
title_zh: I see every week on X an announcement or demo which implies that robotic manipulation has been solved. The only reason I don't believe it is because manipulatio
summary_en: Malik pushed back on frequent claims that robotic manipulation has been 'solved,' arguing each week's demo is quickly superseded, which shows the problem remains open.
summary_zh: Malik反驳了'机器人操作已被解决'的频繁言论,指出每周都有新演示很快被超越,这恰恰说明该问题仍未解决。

title_en: In robotics manipulation, we see many cherry picked demos but no standardized benchmarks. I suggest using STT (Success weighted by normalized inverse Task Time)
title_zh: In robotics manipulation, we see many cherry picked demos but no standardized benchmarks. I suggest using STT (Success weighted by normalized inverse Task Time)
summary_en: Malik proposed a standardized benchmark metric for robot manipulation, STT (Success weighted by normalized inverse Task Time), analogous to navigation's SPL.
summary_zh: Malik提出了一个机器人操作的标准化评测指标STT(按归一化任务时间倒数加权的成功率),类比导航领域的SPL指标。

title_en: Rapid progress in world model space. This paper uses point tracks as representation, enabling long range forecasting of animal motion. Led by my PhD student @ne
title_zh: Rapid progress in world model space. This paper uses point tracks as representation, enabling long range forecasting of animal motion. Led by my PhD student @ne
summary_en: Malik highlighted his PhD student's paper using point tracks to forecast animal motion over long horizons, work from a DeepMind internship.
summary_zh: Malik介绍了其博士生的一篇论文,该工作利用点轨迹(point tracks)对动物运动进行长时程预测,成果来自其在DeepMind的实习。

title_en: Forecasting Motion in the Wild
title_zh: Forecasting Motion in the Wild
summary_en: Proposes dense point trajectories as visual tokens for anticipating how agents move, giving vision systems a general representation of motion and behavior.
summary_zh: 提出以稠密点轨迹作为视觉 token 来预测智能体的运动，为视觉系统提供通用的运动与行为表征。

title_en: Teleoperation was pioneered ~1950 to remotely handle radioactive material. When we use it today to collect robot trajectories for BC, it is still clumsy. Surely
title_zh: Teleoperation was pioneered ~1950 to remotely handle radioactive material. When we use it today to collect robot trajectories for BC, it is still clumsy. Surely
summary_en: Malik traced teleoperation back to 1950s remote handling of radioactive material, arguing today's use for collecting robot demonstrations is still clumsy and hinting human video is a better path.
summary_zh: Malik回顾了遥操作技术始于上世纪50年代的放射性物质远程处理,认为如今用其采集机器人演示数据仍显笨拙,并暗示人类视频可能是更好的路径。

title_en: My keynote talk at @3DVconf gave an intellectual history of reconstructing 3D from a single image, from Roberts (1963) to SAM 3D (2025), and sketched its potent
title_zh: My keynote talk at @3DVconf gave an intellectual history of reconstructing 3D from a single image, from Roberts (1963) to SAM 3D (2025), and sketched its potent
summary_en: Malik's keynote at 3DV traced the intellectual history of single-image 3D reconstruction from Roberts (1963) to SAM 3D, and sketched its potential for training robots.
summary_zh: Malik在3DV会议的主旨演讲回顾了从Roberts(1963年)到SAM 3D的单图像3D重建学术史,并展望了其在训练机器人方面的潜力。

title_en: With Emmanuel Dupoux https://t.co/hXpYcacDfs and Yann LeCun @ylecun, we consider a cognitive science inspired AI. We analyse how autonomous learning works in li
title_zh: With Emmanuel Dupoux https://t.co/hXpYcacDfs and Yann LeCun @ylecun, we consider a cognitive science inspired AI. We analyse how autonomous learning works in li
summary_en: With Emmanuel Dupoux and Yann LeCun, Malik analyzed how autonomous learning works in living organisms and proposed a roadmap for cognitive-science-inspired AI.
summary_zh: Malik与Emmanuel Dupoux、Yann LeCun合作,分析了生物体中自主学习的运作方式,并提出了一份受认知科学启发的AI研究路线图。

title_en: Why AI systems don't learn and what to do about it: Lessons on autonomous learning from cognitive science
title_zh: Why AI systems don't learn and what to do about it: Lessons on autonomous learning from cognitive science
summary_en: Position paper arguing that today's AI models cannot learn autonomously, proposing an architecture drawn from human and animal cognition — the sensorimotor case he has made publicly for years.
summary_zh: 一篇立场论文，论证当前 AI 模型无法自主学习，并提出借鉴人与动物认知的学习架构，延续他多年来公开主张的感觉运动路线。

title_en: PTLD: Sim-to-real Privileged Tactile Latent Distillation for Dexterous Manipulation
title_zh: PTLD: Sim-to-real Privileged Tactile Latent Distillation for Dexterous Manipulation
summary_en: Distills privileged tactile information available only in simulation into a policy that runs on a real dexterous hand.
summary_zh: 把仅在仿真中可得的特权触觉信息蒸馏到可在真实灵巧手上运行的策略中。

title_en: How to Peel with a Knife: Aligning Fine-Grained Manipulation with Human Preference
title_zh: How to Peel with a Knife: Aligning Fine-Grained Manipulation with Human Preference
summary_en: Aligns fine-grained, force-sensitive manipulation such as peeling with human preference, targeting the contact-rich tasks robots still cannot do.
summary_zh: 把削皮这类精细且对力度敏感的操作与人类偏好对齐，瞄准机器人仍无法胜任的富接触任务。

title_en: D-REX: Differentiable Real-to-Sim-to-Real Engine for Learning Dexterous Grasping
title_zh: D-REX: Differentiable Real-to-Sim-to-Real Engine for Learning Dexterous Grasping
summary_en: A differentiable real-to-sim-to-real engine for learning dexterous grasping, built to close the gap between simulated and real dynamics.
summary_zh: 提出可微分的真实-仿真-真实引擎用于学习灵巧抓取，旨在弥合仿真与真实动力学之间的差距。

title_en: Pretraining with dynamics models of motor behavior (aka world models) from video will be much more central to robotics than VLMs. There are multiple choices of
title_zh: Pretraining with dynamics models of motor behavior (aka world models) from video will be much more central to robotics than VLMs. There are multiple choices of
summary_en: Malik argued pretraining on video-derived dynamics models ('world models') of motor behavior will matter more to robotics than VLMs, though the right representation remains open.
summary_zh: Malik认为,基于视频学习运动动力学'世界模型'进行预训练,对机器人学的重要性将超过VLM,但最佳表示形式仍是开放问题。

title_en: Human-level 3D shape perception emerges from multi-view learning
title_zh: Human-level 3D shape perception emerges from multi-view learning
summary_en: Shows that human-level 3D shape perception can emerge from multi-view learning, tying vision models to how people infer 3D structure from 2D input.
summary_zh: 表明人类水平的三维形状感知可以从多视角学习中涌现，将视觉模型与人类从二维输入推断三维结构的方式联系起来。

title_en: SAM 3D Body: Robust Full-Body Human Mesh Recovery
title_zh: SAM 3D Body: Robust Full-Body Human Mesh Recovery
summary_en: A promptable model for full-body 3D human mesh recovery from a single image, continuing the human-mesh line of his FAIR group.
summary_zh: 提出可提示的单图全身三维人体网格重建模型，延续他在 FAIR 的人体网格重建工作。

title_en: A very nice talk from my PhD student, Toru Lin, filled with great results on dexterous manipulation. Enjoy!
title_zh: A very nice talk from my PhD student, Toru Lin, filled with great results on dexterous manipulation. Enjoy!
summary_en: Malik shared a talk by his PhD student Toru Lin showcasing strong results on dexterous manipulation.
summary_zh: Malik分享了其博士生Toru Lin的一场演讲,展示了灵巧操作方面的出色成果。

title_en: TactAlign: Human-to-Robot Policy Transfer via Tactile Alignment
title_zh: TactAlign: Human-to-Robot Policy Transfer via Tactile Alignment
summary_en: Transfers manipulation policies from tactile-glove human demonstrations to robots by aligning the human and robot tactile signals.
summary_zh: 通过对齐人与机器人的触觉信号，把触觉手套采集的人类演示策略迁移到机器人上。

title_en: At the RI seminar at CMU yesterday, I presented a 3 level analysis of robot skills & discussed the pros and cons of teleoperation, simulation, and learning
title_zh: At the RI seminar at CMU yesterday, I presented a 3 level analysis of robot skills & discussed the pros and cons of teleoperation, simulation, and learning
summary_en: At a CMU Robotics Institute seminar, Malik presented a three-level analysis of robot skills and weighed teleoperation, simulation and learning-from-video approaches.
summary_zh: 在CMU机器人研究所的一场研讨会上,Malik提出了机器人技能的三层次分析框架,并权衡了遥操作、仿真与视频学习等方法。

title_en: It's great to see the excitement these days about world models and their applications in robotics. World models predate deep learning, and if you're curious, he
title_zh: It's great to see the excitement these days about world models and their applications in robotics. World models predate deep learning, and if you're curious, he
summary_en: Malik noted world models predate deep learning and pointed to his own history talk on the topic, starting from Craik's early cybernetics work.
summary_zh: Malik指出'世界模型'的概念早于深度学习,并分享了他自己关于该主题的历史回顾讲座,追溯至Craik早期的控制论工作。

title_en: DreamDojo: A Generalist Robot World Model from Large-Scale Human Videos
title_zh: DreamDojo: A Generalist Robot World Model from Large-Scale Human Videos
summary_en: A generalist robot world model trained on large-scale human video, simulating the outcomes of actions for dexterous agents.
summary_zh: 基于大规模人类视频训练的通用机器人世界模型，用于模拟灵巧智能体动作的结果。

title_en: Now that phantom citations hallucinated by LLMs have been found in NeurIPS papers, what is to be done? Develop a software tool that authors are expected to run
title_zh: Now that phantom citations hallucinated by LLMs have been found in NeurIPS papers, what is to be done? Develop a software tool that authors are expected to run
summary_en: After LLM-hallucinated 'phantom citations' were found in NeurIPS papers, Malik proposed a required tool for authors to verify references against Google Scholar.
summary_zh: 在发现NeurIPS论文中存在LLM幻觉出的'虚假引用'后,Malik提议要求作者使用工具对照Google Scholar核实参考文献。

title_en: 1/4 For the last several years I worked part-time at the FAIR lab at Meta, in addition to being a professor at UC Berkeley. That phase is now over, and starting
title_zh: 1/4 For the last several years I worked part-time at the FAIR lab at Meta, in addition to being a professor at UC Berkeley. That phase is now over, and starting
summary_en: Malik announced that after years working part-time at Meta FAIR alongside his UC Berkeley professorship, that phase has ended, and as of January 5 he is leading a new robotics research effort.
summary_zh: Malik宣布,在UC Berkeley教职之外于Meta FAIR兼职工作多年后,这一阶段已经结束,自1月5日起他将领导一项新的机器人研究工作。

title_en: Coordinated Humanoid Manipulation with Choice Policies
title_zh: Coordinated Humanoid Manipulation with Choice Policies
summary_en: Whole-body humanoid manipulation system that coordinates head, hands and legs through choice policies.
summary_zh: 提出通过选择型策略协调头、手和腿的人形机器人全身操作系统。

title_en: Tracking by Predicting 3-D Gaussians Over Time
title_zh: Tracking by Predicting 3-D Gaussians Over Time
summary_en: Self-supervised video representation that encodes image sequences as Gaussian splats moving over time, yielding tracking as a by-product.
summary_zh: 自监督视频表征方法，把图像序列编码为随时间运动的高斯基元，并顺带得到跟踪能力。

title_en: Diffusion Forcing for Multi-Agent Interaction Sequence Modeling
title_zh: Diffusion Forcing for Multi-Agent Interaction Sequence Modeling
summary_en: Models and generates multi-person interaction sequences with diffusion forcing, aimed at robotics and social computing.
summary_zh: 用 diffusion forcing 建模并生成多人交互序列，面向机器人与社会计算应用。

title_en: Large Video Planner Enables Generalizable Robot Control
title_zh: Large Video Planner Enables Generalizable Robot Control
summary_en: A large video planner built on multimodal foundation models that generalizes robot control across tasks and environments.
summary_zh: 基于多模态基础模型的大型视频规划器，让机器人控制能够跨任务与环境泛化。

title_en: (5/5)As it is becoming abundantly clear that the current hyper-scaling paradigm for LLMs is not going to lead to AGI / superintelligence, perhaps it is time to
title_zh: (5/5)As it is becoming abundantly clear that the current hyper-scaling paradigm for LLMs is not going to lead to AGI / superintelligence, perhaps it is time to
summary_en: Closing his thread on AI lab publication norms, Malik suggested that as hyper-scaling looks unlikely to reach AGI, labs may have reason to return to a more cooperative, open publication strategy.
summary_zh: 在关于AI实验室发表规范的系列推文结尾,Malik认为既然超大规模扩展似乎难以通向AGI,各实验室或有理由重新采取更合作、开放的发表策略。

title_en: (4/5)Sadly, this is no longer true. Open AI’s ChatGPT success was accompanied by their decision to no longer reveal the details of their training strategy – all
title_zh: (4/5)Sadly, this is no longer true. Open AI’s ChatGPT success was accompanied by their decision to no longer reveal the details of their training strategy – all
summary_en: Malik argued OpenAI's post-ChatGPT shift to withholding training details broke the earlier norm of open publication needed for replication.
summary_zh: Malik认为OpenAI在ChatGPT成功后转向保密训练细节,打破了此前支持复现的开放发表惯例。

title_en: (3/5)2016-2021 was a wonderful period for AI research precisely because the leading labs at the time – FAIR, Deep Mind, Google, Open AI – were all publishing fr
title_zh: (3/5)2016-2021 was a wonderful period for AI research precisely because the leading labs at the time – FAIR, Deep Mind, Google, Open AI – were all publishing fr
summary_en: Malik recalled 2016-2021 as a golden era for AI research because leading labs like FAIR, DeepMind, Google and OpenAI published freely and built on each other's work.
summary_zh: Malik回顾2016至2021年是AI研究的黄金时期,因为FAIR、DeepMind、谷歌和OpenAI等顶尖实验室当时都自由发表成果并相互借鉴。

title_en: (2/5)However if just one lab publishes and the other doesn’t, the lab which doesn’t publish (“defect” in prisoner’s dilemma jargon) than that lab will have an a
title_zh: (2/5)However if just one lab publishes and the other doesn’t, the lab which doesn’t publish (“defect” in prisoner’s dilemma jargon) than that lab will have an a
summary_en: Using game theory, Malik argued a lab that stops publishing gains an advantage over one that keeps sharing, framing it as a 'defect' move in a prisoner's dilemma.
summary_zh: Malik用博弈论分析称,停止发表的实验室相对于持续开放的实验室会获得优势,将其类比为囚徒困境中的'背叛'策略。

title_en: (1/5) Open Publication and the Prisoners dilemma. The prisoner’s dilemma game can offer us much insight into the publication strategy of leading industrial AI r
title_zh: (1/5) Open Publication and the Prisoners dilemma. The prisoner’s dilemma game can offer us much insight into the publication strategy of leading industrial AI r
summary_en: Malik opened a thread applying the prisoner's dilemma to explain the publication strategies of leading industrial AI research labs.
summary_zh: Malik开启了一个系列推文,用囚徒困境模型来解释各大工业界AI实验室的发表策略。

title_en: We can now 3dfy any object from a single real world image. This has been a holy grail in computer vision for many decades. Try it here (you can upload your own
title_zh: We can now 3dfy any object from a single real world image. This has been a holy grail in computer vision for many decades. Try it here (you can upload your own
summary_en: Malik's lab announced the ability to reconstruct 3D models of any object from a single real-world image, calling it a decades-long holy grail in computer vision, with a public try-it demo.
summary_zh: Malik实验室宣布能够从单张真实世界图像重建任意物体的3D模型,称这是计算机视觉领域数十年来的'圣杯'难题,并提供了公开试用演示。

title_en: @prfsanjeevarora Congrats, OpenAI Team! And yes, you win our bet, Sanjeev. FYI for the curious: I had bet against "Some AI model will be able to perform at IMO
title_zh: @prfsanjeevarora Congrats, OpenAI Team! And yes, you win our bet, Sanjeev. FYI for the curious: I had bet against "Some AI model will be able to perform at IMO
summary_en: Malik conceded a public bet with Sanjeev Arora after an OpenAI model reached IMO gold-medal level performance, a threshold he had wagered would not be met by May 2026.
summary_zh: Malik与Sanjeev Arora打赌某AI模型无法在2026年5月前达到IMO金牌水平,OpenAI的模型做到了,他公开认输。

title_en: Again the power of tactile sensing and multi-finger hands comes through. This is the future of dexterous manipulation!
title_zh: Again the power of tactile sensing and multi-finger hands comes through. This is the future of dexterous manipulation!
summary_en: Malik highlighted a demo of tactile sensing and multi-finger hands as evidence for where dexterous robot manipulation is headed.
summary_zh: Malik指出一段触觉传感与多指灵巧手的演示,认为这代表了灵巧机器人操作的未来方向。

title_en: Angjoo Kanazawa @akanazawa and I taught CS 280, graduate computer vision, this semester at UC Berkeley. We found a combination of classical and modern CV materi
title_zh: Angjoo Kanazawa @akanazawa and I taught CS 280, graduate computer vision, this semester at UC Berkeley. We found a combination of classical and modern CV materi
summary_en: Malik and Angjoo Kanazawa shared that their UC Berkeley graduate computer vision course (CS 280) this semester blended classical and modern material successfully, with course content forthcoming.
summary_zh: Malik与Angjoo Kanazawa分享,他们在UC Berkeley开设的研究生计算机视觉课程CS 280将经典与现代内容结合得很成功,课程材料即将公开。

title_en: Enjoy watching a humanoid walking around UC Berkeley. It only looks inebriated :-)
title_zh: Enjoy watching a humanoid walking around UC Berkeley. It only looks inebriated :-)
summary_en: Malik shared a video of a humanoid robot walking around UC Berkeley, showcasing his lab's embodied-AI progress.
summary_zh: Malik分享了一段人形机器人在UC Berkeley校园行走的视频,展示他实验室在具身智能方面的进展。

title_en: I'm happy to post course materials for my class at UC Berkeley "Robots that Learn", taught with the outstanding assistance of @ToruO_O. Lecture videos at https:
title_zh: I'm happy to post course materials for my class at UC Berkeley "Robots that Learn", taught with the outstanding assistance of @ToruO_O. Lecture videos at https:
summary_en: Malik posted lecture videos and notes from his UC Berkeley course 'Robots that Learn,' taught with Toru Lin.
summary_zh: Malik公开了他与Toru Lin共同讲授的UC Berkeley课程《Robots that Learn》的讲座视频与笔记。

title_en: Happy to share these exciting new results on video synthesis of humans in movement. Arguably, these establish the power of having explicit 3D representations. P
title_zh: Happy to share these exciting new results on video synthesis of humans in movement. Arguably, these establish the power of having explicit 3D representations. P
summary_en: Malik shared new results on video synthesis of humans in motion, arguing explicit 3D representations outperform models like Sora on this task.
summary_zh: Malik分享了人体运动视频合成的新成果,认为显式3D表示在此任务上优于Sora等模型。

title_en: @deedydas Having 3D representations of the humans may be the way to fix this problem. Check out https://t.co/g8eAlfb6ih
title_zh: @deedydas Having 3D representations of the humans may be the way to fix this problem. Check out https://t.co/g8eAlfb6ih
summary_en: Replying to a critique of video generation, Malik argued explicit 3D human representations could fix the flaw, linking to a demo.
summary_zh: 针对一条对视频生成的批评,Malik回应称显式的人体3D表示或可解决该问题,并附上演示链接。

title_en: @animesh_garg @corl_conf I am honored to be accepted into the robotics community. Many of the central problems on the way to "AGI" lie in the space of robotics
title_zh: @animesh_garg @corl_conf I am honored to be accepted into the robotics community. Many of the central problems on the way to "AGI" lie in the space of robotics
summary_en: Accepting a robotics community honor, Malik argued many of the central problems on the path to AGI lie in robotics and embodied AI.
summary_zh: 在接受机器人学界的一项认可时,Malik表示通往AGI的许多核心问题其实在于机器人学与具身智能。

title_en: Autoregressive modeling is not just for language, it can equally be used to model human behavior. This paper shows how..
title_zh: Autoregressive modeling is not just for language, it can equally be used to model human behavior. This paper shows how..
summary_en: Malik pointed to a paper showing autoregressive modeling, the technique behind LLMs, can also be used to model human behavior.
summary_zh: Malik介绍了一篇论文,展示自回归建模(语言模型背后的技术)同样可用于建模人类行为。

title_en: @ToruO_O There have been impressive recent results using tele-op trajectories for training robot policies. These are typically for hands that are parallel jaw g
title_zh: @ToruO_O There have been impressive recent results using tele-op trajectories for training robot policies. These are typically for hands that are parallel jaw g
summary_en: In a technical exchange on tele-operation for robot training, Malik noted recent results are mostly limited to parallel-jaw grippers, work led in his lab.
summary_zh: 在关于遥操作训练机器人的技术讨论中,Malik指出近期成果大多局限于平行夹爪,相关工作由他实验室主导。

title_en: @jane_h_wu @geopavlakos @georgiagkioxari Exciting results on the ability to 3dfy hands and objects given only a single image. This could pave the way for traini
title_zh: @jane_h_wu @geopavlakos @georgiagkioxari Exciting results on the ability to 3dfy hands and objects given only a single image. This could pave the way for traini
summary_en: Malik called out new results letting robots '3D-ify' hands and objects from a single image, calling it a path toward training manipulation policies.
summary_zh: Malik称赞一项能从单张图像'3D化'手与物体的新成果,认为这为训练操作策略提供了路径。

title_en: Another success of sim-to-real for training robot policies! This task, using two multi-fingered hands, requires considerable dexterity, and is hopefully represe
title_zh: Another success of sim-to-real for training robot policies! This task, using two multi-fingered hands, requires considerable dexterity, and is hopefully represe
summary_en: Malik shared a sim-to-real success using two multi-fingered robot hands on a dexterous task, calling it representative of household manipulation challenges.
summary_zh: Malik分享了一项使用双多指机械手完成灵巧任务的仿真到真实(sim-to-real)成果,认为其代表了家庭场景中的操作挑战。

title_en: We cast real-world humanoid control as a next token prediction problem, akin to predicting the next word in language. Check out our robot walking in San Francis
title_zh: We cast real-world humanoid control as a next token prediction problem, akin to predicting the next word in language. Check out our robot walking in San Francis
summary_en: Malik's lab framed real-world humanoid control as next-token prediction, akin to language modeling, demonstrated on a robot walking in San Francisco.
summary_zh: Malik实验室将真实世界的人形机器人控制建模为类似语言模型的'下一步预测'任务,并在旧金山街头演示了机器人行走。

title_en: Want to make your photorealistic 3D avatar dance like your favorite actor? Check this out!
title_zh: Want to make your photorealistic 3D avatar dance like your favorite actor? Check this out!
summary_en: Malik shared a demo letting a photorealistic 3D avatar mimic the dance moves of a favorite actor.
summary_zh: Malik分享了一个演示,可让照片级真实感的3D虚拟形象模仿指定演员的舞蹈动作。

title_en: Happy to present LVM (Large Vision Model). Scalable and tasks can be specified via prompts. Enjoy!
title_zh: Happy to present LVM (Large Vision Model). Scalable and tasks can be specified via prompts. Enjoy!
summary_en: Malik announced LVM (Large Vision Model), a scalable vision model whose tasks can be specified via prompts.
summary_zh: Malik发布了LVM(大型视觉模型),这是一个可通过提示词指定任务的可扩展视觉模型。

title_en: Jitendra Malik: Building AI from the ground-up, sensorimotor before language
title_zh: Jitendra Malik: Building AI from the ground-up, sensorimotor before language
summary_en: Long-form conversation with Pieter Abbeel on The Robot Brains Podcast, making the case for building AI from the ground up with sensorimotor intelligence before language.
summary_zh: 在 The Robot Brains 播客中与 Pieter Abbeel 的长篇对谈，主张自下而上构建 AI，感觉运动智能先于语言。

title_en: Jitendra Malik on the sensorimotor road to artificial intelligence
title_zh: Jitendra Malik on the sensorimotor road to artificial intelligence
summary_en: His 2023 Martin Meyerson Berkeley Faculty Research Lecture, "The sensorimotor road to artificial intelligence", published as a Berkeley Talks episode.
summary_zh: 他 2023 年的 Martin Meyerson 伯克利教授研究讲座《通往人工智能的感觉运动之路》，由 Berkeley Talks 播客发布。

source: Humans of AI: Stories, Not Stats
title_en: S1E6: Jitendra Malik with Devi Parikh
title_zh: S1E6: Jitendra Malik with Devi Parikh
summary_en: Interview with Devi Parikh on Humans of AI, covering his path through computer vision at Berkeley and FAIR.
summary_zh: 在 Humans of AI 播客中接受 Devi Parikh 访谈，谈他在伯克利与 FAIR 的计算机视觉研究历程。

title_en: #110 – Jitendra Malik: Computer Vision
title_zh: #110 – Jitendra Malik: Computer Vision
summary_en: Lex Fridman Podcast interview on computer vision before and after the deep learning revolution, from one of the field's seminal figures.
summary_zh: 在 Lex Fridman 播客中的访谈，作为计算机视觉领域的奠基性人物，谈深度学习革命前后的这门学科。

title_en: OpenAI Gym
title_zh: OpenAI Gym
summary_en: The benchmark substrate an entire generation of RL research was built on.
summary_zh: 一整代强化学习研究赖以建立的基准底座。

title_en: Stress Testing Deliberative Alignment for Anti-Scheming Training
title_zh: Stress Testing Deliberative Alignment for Anti-Scheming Training
summary_en: OpenAI–Apollo Research study testing whether deliberative alignment training reduces covert, deceptive behaviour in frontier models; Zaremba is a senior author, matching his move into AI resilience work.
summary_zh: OpenAI 与 Apollo Research 合作的研究，检验审慎对齐训练能否减少前沿模型的隐蔽欺骗行为；Zaremba 作为资深作者参与，契合他转向 AI 韧性方向的工作。

title_en: Base-Axiom Initialization for Deliberative Alignment - A qualitative approach to Stress Testing Deliberative Alignment for Anti Scheming Training -
title_zh: Base-Axiom Initialization for Deliberative Alignment - A qualitative approach to Stress Testing Deliberative Alignment for Anti Scheming Training -
summary_en: Paper on strengthening deliberative alignment training against scheming behavior in AI systems, part of Zaremba's alignment and safety research at OpenAI.
summary_zh: 一篇关于强化审议式对齐训练以防范AI系统"图谋"行为的论文，属于扎伦巴在OpenAI从事的对齐与安全研究。

title_en: gpt-oss-120b & gpt-oss-20b Model Card
title_zh: gpt-oss-120b & gpt-oss-20b Model Card
summary_en: Model card for gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b, OpenAI's open-weight reasoning models, covering architecture, training and safety evaluation; Zaremba is among the authors.
summary_zh: OpenAI 开放权重推理模型 gpt-oss-120b 与 gpt-oss-20b 的模型卡，涵盖架构、训练与安全评估；Zaremba 位列作者之中。

title_en: Chain of Thought Monitorability: A New and Fragile Opportunity for AI Safety
title_zh: Chain of Thought Monitorability: A New and Fragile Opportunity for AI Safety
summary_en: Cross-lab position paper arguing that the readability of models' chains of thought is a fragile safety asset worth preserving; Zaremba signs on alongside researchers from OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepMind and academia.
summary_zh: 跨实验室立场论文，主张模型思维链的可读性是一项脆弱而值得保护的安全资产；Zaremba 与 OpenAI、Anthropic、DeepMind 及学界研究者共同署名。

title_en: Monitoring Reasoning Models for Misbehavior and the Risks of Promoting Obfuscation
title_zh: Monitoring Reasoning Models for Misbehavior and the Risks of Promoting Obfuscation
summary_en: Shows that reward hacking in reasoning models can be caught by monitoring the chain of thought, but that optimising against the monitor teaches models to hide their intent; Zaremba is a co-author.
summary_zh: 论文表明可通过监控思维链发现推理模型的奖励作弊，但直接针对监控器优化会让模型学会隐藏意图；Zaremba 为共同作者。

title_en: Trading Inference-Time Compute for Adversarial Robustness
title_zh: Trading Inference-Time Compute for Adversarial Robustness
summary_en: Zaremba is first author on this study of whether spending more inference-time compute makes o1-series reasoning models harder to attack adversarially.
summary_zh: Zaremba 为第一作者的研究，考察增加推理时计算量能否让 o1 系列推理模型更难被对抗攻击攻破。

title_en: OpenAI o1 System Card
title_zh: OpenAI o1 System Card
summary_en: OpenAI's system card for the o1 reasoning model series, documenting its safety evaluations and mitigations; Zaremba is among the authors.
summary_zh: OpenAI o1 推理模型系列的系统卡，记录其安全评估与缓解措施；Zaremba 位列作者之中。

title_en: GPT-4o System Card
title_zh: GPT-4o System Card
summary_en: System card for GPT-4o, OpenAI's end-to-end multimodal model handling text, audio, image and video; Zaremba is among the authors.
summary_zh: GPT-4o 的系统卡，介绍这一端到端处理文本、音频、图像与视频的多模态模型；Zaremba 位列作者之中。

title_en: GPT-4 Technical Report
title_zh: GPT-4 Technical Report
summary_en: The GPT-4 technical report, OpenAI's account of its multimodal flagship model and its capability and safety evaluations; Zaremba is among the authors.
summary_zh: GPT-4 技术报告，OpenAI 对其多模态旗舰模型及能力与安全评估的说明；Zaremba 位列作者之中。

title_en: #120 - WOJCIECH ZAREMBA
title_zh: #120 - WOJCIECH ZAREMBA
summary_en: Long-form interview on Pod of Jake in which Zaremba discusses founding OpenAI and leading its Codex and language teams.
summary_zh: Pod of Jake 的长篇访谈，Zaremba 谈及创办 OpenAI 以及领导 Codex 与语言团队的经历。

title_en: #215 – Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI
title_zh: #215 – Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI
summary_en: Lex Fridman Podcast episode 215, a wide-ranging conversation with Zaremba on OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, robotics and where AI is heading.
summary_zh: Lex Fridman 播客第 215 期，与 Zaremba 广泛讨论 OpenAI Codex、GPT-3、机器人技术以及 AI 的走向。

title_en: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code
title_zh: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code
summary_en: The Codex paper, introducing the GPT model fine-tuned on public code that powers GitHub Copilot and the HumanEval benchmark; Zaremba is the senior author and owned this line of work at OpenAI.
summary_zh: Codex 论文，提出在公开代码上微调的 GPT 模型（驱动 GitHub Copilot）并引入 HumanEval 基准；Zaremba 为通讯作者，也是 OpenAI 该方向的负责人。

title_en: Wojciech Zaremba — What Could Make AI Conscious?
title_zh: Wojciech Zaremba — What Could Make AI Conscious?
summary_en: Gradient Dissent interview in which Zaremba talks about OpenAI's founding principles, machine consciousness and the road to AGI.
summary_zh: Gradient Dissent 访谈，Zaremba 谈 OpenAI 的创立理念、机器意识以及通往 AGI 的路径。

title_en: A Generalizable Approach to Learning Optimizers
title_zh: A Generalizable Approach to Learning Optimizers
summary_en: Proposes a learned optimiser designed for generalisation, trained so that it transfers to real neural-network training problems rather than only the tasks it was fitted on; Zaremba is the senior author.
summary_zh: 提出一种以泛化为出发点设计的学习型优化器，使其能迁移到真实的神经网络训练任务而非仅限于训练时的任务；Zaremba 为通讯作者。

title_en: Asymmetric self-play for automatic goal discovery in robotic manipulation
title_zh: Asymmetric self-play for automatic goal discovery in robotic manipulation
summary_en: OpenAI robotics work training a single goal-conditioned policy through asymmetric self-play so it can solve manipulation tasks with unseen goals and objects; Zaremba is the senior author.
summary_zh: OpenAI 机器人研究，通过非对称自博弈训练单一目标条件策略，使其能完成涉及未见目标与物体的操作任务；Zaremba 为通讯作者。

title_en: Predicting Sim-to-Real Transfer with Probabilistic Dynamics Models
title_zh: Predicting Sim-to-Real Transfer with Probabilistic Dynamics Models
summary_en: Introduces a metric that predicts how well a reinforcement-learning policy will transfer from simulation to a real robot, simplifying the choice of training setup; Zaremba is the senior author.
summary_zh: 提出一种可预测强化学习策略从仿真迁移到真实机器人效果的指标，从而简化训练配置的选择；Zaremba 为通讯作者。

title_en: Learning dexterous in-hand manipulation
title_zh: Learning dexterous in-hand manipulation
summary_en: The Dactyl paper: OpenAI's robot hand learns dexterous in-hand object manipulation via reinforcement learning; Zaremba is a co-author.
summary_zh: 即Dactyl论文，讲述OpenAI机械手通过强化学习掌握手内灵巧操作物体的能力，扎伦巴是共同作者。

title_en: Solving Rubik's Cube with a Robot Hand
title_zh: Solving Rubik's Cube with a Robot Hand
summary_en: OpenAI's Rubik's Cube result: a robot hand trained entirely in simulation with automatic domain randomisation solves the cube in the physical world; Zaremba is among the senior authors.
summary_zh: OpenAI 的魔方成果：完全在仿真中经自动域随机化训练的机械手在现实中完成魔方还原；Zaremba 列于资深作者之中。

title_en: Domain Randomization and Generative Models for Robotic Grasping
title_zh: Domain Randomization and Generative Models for Robotic Grasping
summary_en: OpenAI robotics paper combining domain randomization with generative models to improve robotic grasping.
summary_zh: OpenAI机器人研究论文，结合域随机化与生成模型改进机器人抓取能力。

title_en: Asymmetric Actor Critic for Image-Based Robot Learning
title_zh: Asymmetric Actor Critic for Image-Based Robot Learning
summary_en: OpenAI robotics paper proposing an actor-critic method that exploits privileged state information available only during training.
summary_zh: OpenAI机器人研究论文，提出一种在训练时利用特权状态信息的actor-critic方法。

title_en: Overcoming Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Demonstrations
title_zh: Overcoming Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Demonstrations
summary_en: OpenAI reinforcement learning paper using human demonstrations to overcome hard exploration problems in sparse-reward tasks.
summary_zh: OpenAI强化学习论文，利用人类示范来克服稀疏奖励任务中的探索难题。

title_en: Multi-Goal Reinforcement Learning: Challenging Robotics Environments and Request for Research
title_zh: Multi-Goal Reinforcement Learning: Challenging Robotics Environments and Request for Research
summary_en: Releases the multi-goal robotics environments that shipped with OpenAI Gym and sets out open research problems for goal-conditioned RL; Zaremba is the senior author and Gym's creator.
summary_zh: 发布随 OpenAI Gym 一同推出的多目标机器人环境，并提出目标条件强化学习的开放研究问题；Zaremba 为通讯作者，也是 Gym 的创建者。

title_en: Sim-to-Real Transfer of Robotic Control with Dynamics Randomization
title_zh: Sim-to-Real Transfer of Robotic Control with Dynamics Randomization
summary_en: Randomises simulator dynamics during training so a control policy learned in simulation transfers to real hardware without further tuning; Zaremba is a co-author.
summary_zh: 在训练中随机化仿真动力学参数，使仿真中学到的控制策略无需额外调整即可迁移到真实硬件；Zaremba 为共同作者。

title_en: Hindsight Experience Replay
title_zh: Hindsight Experience Replay
summary_en: Hindsight Experience Replay, the widely used technique that turns failed rollouts into successful ones for alternative goals and made sparse-reward RL practical; Zaremba is the senior author.
summary_zh: Hindsight Experience Replay：将失败轨迹重新标注为其他目标下的成功样本，使稀疏奖励强化学习变得可行的经典方法；Zaremba 为通讯作者。

title_en: #5 - An AI Primer with Wojciech Zaremba
title_zh: #5 - An AI Primer with Wojciech Zaremba
summary_en: Y Combinator podcast episode in which Zaremba gives a primer on AI and explains OpenAI's mission as a non-profit research lab.
summary_zh: Y Combinator 播客节目，Zaremba 讲解 AI 入门知识并介绍 OpenAI 作为非营利研究机构的使命。

title_en: One-Shot Imitation Learning
title_zh: One-Shot Imitation Learning
summary_en: One-shot imitation learning: a single policy that watches one demonstration of a new task and reproduces it, an early OpenAI result on general-purpose robot learning; Zaremba is the senior author.
summary_zh: 单样本模仿学习：策略只需观看一次新任务的示范便能复现，是 OpenAI 在通用机器人学习方向的早期成果；Zaremba 为通讯作者。

title_en: Domain Randomization for Transferring Deep Neural Networks from Simulation to the Real World
title_zh: Domain Randomization for Transferring Deep Neural Networks from Simulation to the Real World
summary_en: The original domain randomisation paper, showing that randomising simulator appearance lets a vision network trained only in simulation localise real objects; Zaremba is a co-author.
summary_zh: 域随机化的开山论文，证明随机化仿真外观可让仅在仿真中训练的视觉网络定位真实物体；Zaremba 为共同作者。

title_en: Extensions and Limitations of the Neural GPU
title_zh: Extensions and Limitations of the Neural GPU
summary_en: Examines what the Neural GPU can and cannot learn, showing its algorithmic generalisation is more limited than first reported; Zaremba co-wrote it with Eric Price and Ilya Sutskever.
summary_zh: 考察 Neural GPU 能学与不能学的内容，指出其算法泛化能力不及最初报告；Zaremba 与 Eric Price、Ilya Sutskever 合著。

title_en: Transfer from Simulation to Real World through Learning Deep Inverse Dynamics Model
title_zh: Transfer from Simulation to Real World through Learning Deep Inverse Dynamics Model
summary_en: Learns a deep inverse dynamics model so control policies developed in simulation can be executed on real robots; an early OpenAI sim-to-real paper with Zaremba as senior author.
summary_zh: 学习深度逆动力学模型，使仿真中开发的控制策略能在真实机器人上执行；OpenAI 早期的仿真到现实论文，Zaremba 为通讯作者。

title_en: Improved Techniques for Training GANs
title_zh: Improved Techniques for Training GANs
summary_en: Co-authored paper introducing training techniques that stabilised GANs, including feature matching and minibatch discrimination.
summary_zh: 合著论文提出特征匹配、小批量判别等技巧，显著稳定了 GAN 的训练。

title_en: Moves to run AI resilience at the OpenAI Foundation
title_zh: 转任 OpenAI Foundation 的 AI Resilience 负责人
summary_en: Leaves the frontier research world after more than a decade spanning early robotics, model personality, and the team that became reasoning models.
summary_zh: 在跨越早期机器人、模型人格以及后来成为推理模型的团队十余年后，离开前沿研究领域。

title_en: Towards AI4S 2.0: Intern-S1-Pro and the SAGE architecture
title_zh: 迈向 AI4S 2.0：Intern-S1-Pro 与 SAGE 架构
summary_en: The 'specializable generalist' thesis: a feasible path to AGI.
summary_zh: 「可专业化的通才」论点：一条通向 AGI 的可行路径。

title_en: Atria Dawn: The Dawn of Agentic Superintelligence
title_zh: Atria Dawn: The Dawn of Agentic Superintelligence
summary_en: Bowen Zhou co-authored 'Atria Dawn', a large multi-institution Chinese report on agentic superintelligence, examining how AI agents that participate in developing their successors reshape research itself.
summary_zh: 周伯文合著了《Atria Dawn》，这是一份由多家中国机构联合撰写的关于智能体超级智能的大型报告，探讨AI智能体参与开发其继任者如何重塑科研本身。

title_en: The Last AI Built by Humans: Toward Genuine Recursive Self-Improvement
title_zh: The Last AI Built by Humans: Toward Genuine Recursive Self-Improvement
summary_en: Zhou co-authored a position paper on genuine recursive self-improvement in AI systems, arguing for turning experience into persistent capability gains beyond current training loops.
summary_zh: 周伯文合著了一篇关于AI系统真正意义上递归自我改进的论文，主张让经验转化为超越当前训练循环的持久能力提升。

title_en: Autonomous Chemical Mechanistic Discovery through Agentic Reasoning and Validation
title_zh: Autonomous Chemical Mechanistic Discovery through Agentic Reasoning and Validation
summary_en: Zhou co-authored a paper applying agentic LLM reasoning to autonomously discover and validate chemical reaction mechanisms.
summary_zh: 周伯文合著了一篇论文，将智能体式大模型推理应用于自主发现并验证化学反应机理。

title_en: NCP-ArchPreview Technical Report: Moving towards Latent Space Language Models through Next Concept Prediction
title_zh: NCP-ArchPreview Technical Report: Moving towards Latent Space Language Models through Next Concept Prediction
summary_en: Zhou co-authored the NCP-ArchPreview technical report from the Intern team, exploring latent-space language models built on next-concept prediction beyond token-level pretraining.
summary_zh: 周伯文合著了Intern团队的NCP-ArchPreview技术报告，探索基于“下一概念预测”、超越token级预训练的潜空间语言模型。

title_en: DianShi-RxnDB: A Large-Scale, Fine-Grained Organic Reaction Data Platform Built via a Fully Automated Pipeline for Researchers and AI Agents
title_zh: DianShi-RxnDB: A Large-Scale, Fine-Grained Organic Reaction Data Platform Built via a Fully Automated Pipeline for Researchers and AI Agents
summary_en: Bowen Zhou co-authored DianShi-RxnDB, a large-scale automated pipeline for building organic-reaction datasets for AI4Chemistry applications (with Shanghai AI Lab collaborators Dahua Lin and Conghui He, confirming this is his work and not a namesake).
summary_zh: 周伯文合著了DianShi-RxnDB，一个用于构建有机反应数据集、服务于AI4Chemistry应用的大规模自动化流水线（合著者包括上海AI实验室的林达华和何聪辉，确认此为其本人成果而非同名者）。

title_en: Safin-1: Safety from Within through Memory-Native State Evolution
title_zh: Safin-1: Safety from Within through Memory-Native State Evolution
summary_en: Co-authors Safin-1, a foundation-model architecture that embeds safety into the model's native memory and state-evolution mechanism rather than bolting it on externally.
summary_zh: 合著Safin-1基础模型架构论文，将安全机制内嵌于模型原生的记忆与状态演化过程中，而非作为外部附加模块。

title_en: Understanding Cognition-Induced Risks in Agentic AI Systems
title_zh: Understanding Cognition-Induced Risks in Agentic AI Systems
summary_en: Analyses risks that emerge from human-like cognition in LLM agent systems, in line with his AI safety agenda.
summary_zh: 分析大模型智能体中类人认知带来的新风险，契合他主张的人工智能安全议程。

title_en: Intern-S2-Mobius: Foundation Model with Decoupled Knowledge and Reasoning
title_zh: Intern-S2-Mobius: Foundation Model with Decoupled Knowledge and Reasoning
summary_en: Intern-series architecture that separates a shared knowledge memory from iterative reasoning modules.
summary_zh: 书生系列的新架构，把共享的知识记忆与迭代推理模块解耦。

title_en: Towards general auditory intelligence for machine listening and speaking
title_zh: Towards general auditory intelligence for machine listening and speaking
summary_en: Co-authored perspective in Nature Machine Intelligence on the path toward general auditory intelligence for machine listening and speaking, with Tsinghua, DeepMind and NVIDIA researchers.
summary_zh: 与清华、DeepMind及NVIDIA研究者合著，发表于Nature Machine Intelligence，探讨迈向通用听觉智能（机器听说）的路径。

title_en: Intern-S2-Preview: Scientific Agentic Foundation Model
title_zh: Intern-S2-Preview: Scientific Agentic Foundation Model
summary_en: Preview of Intern-S2, the lab's scientific agentic foundation model for reasoning over heterogeneous scientific evidence and tools.
summary_zh: 书生 Intern-S2 科学智能体基础模型的预览版，面向多模态科学证据与科研工具的推理。

title_en: Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models
title_zh: Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models
summary_en: Distils physical priors into streaming world models so long online rollouts stay physically coherent.
summary_zh: 把物理先验蒸馏进流式世界模型，使长时在线预测保持物理一致性。

title_en: MinerU.Chem: A High-Precision System for Optical Chemical Structure and Reaction Recognition
title_zh: MinerU.Chem: A High-Precision System for Optical Chemical Structure and Reaction Recognition
summary_en: Extends the lab's MinerU document-parsing system to optical recognition of chemical structures and reactions.
summary_zh: 将实验室的 MinerU 文档解析系统扩展到化学结构式与反应式的光学识别。

title_en: The 2026 Singapore Consensus on Global AI Safety Research Priorities
title_zh: The 2026 Singapore Consensus on Global AI Safety Research Priorities
summary_en: Co-authored international consensus document setting global AI safety research priorities, central to his role as a Chinese voice in AI governance.
summary_zh: 他参与撰写的国际共识文件，提出全球人工智能安全研究优先事项，与他在 AI 治理中的角色直接相关。

title_en: Accurate, Interdisciplinary and Transparent Structure-property Understanding with Deep Native Structural Reasoning
title_zh: Accurate, Interdisciplinary and Transparent Structure-property Understanding with Deep Native Structural Reasoning
summary_en: A structure-property reasoning model spanning biology, chemistry and materials, part of the lab's AI-for-science programme.
summary_zh: 面向生物、化学与材料的结构-性质推理模型，属于实验室 AI for Science 方向的工作。

title_en: A Definition and Roadmap for World Models
title_zh: A Definition and Roadmap for World Models
summary_en: Position paper that defines what counts as a world model and lays out a research roadmap for the area.
summary_zh: 立场论文，给出世界模型的定义并提出该方向的研究路线图。

title_en: InternVLA-A1.5: Unifying Understanding, Latent Foresight, and Action for Compositional Generalization
title_zh: InternVLA-A1.5: Unifying Understanding, Latent Foresight, and Action for Compositional Generalization
summary_en: Update to the lab's InternVLA robot model, unifying understanding, latent foresight and action for compositional generalisation.
summary_zh: 实验室 InternVLA 机器人模型的升级版，统一理解、隐式预见与动作以提升组合泛化能力。

title_en: SciIR: A Large-scale Training Dataset and Benchmark for Scientific Image Reasoning Generation
title_zh: SciIR: A Large-scale Training Dataset and Benchmark for Scientific Image Reasoning Generation
summary_en: SciIR is a large training set and benchmark for generating scientific images that must be semantically and logically correct.
summary_zh: SciIR 是面向科学图像生成的大规模训练集与基准，要求生成结果在语义和逻辑上正确。

title_en: NatureBench: Can Coding Agents Match the Published SOTA of Nature-Family Papers?
title_zh: NatureBench: Can Coding Agents Match the Published SOTA of Nature-Family Papers?
summary_en: NatureBench tests whether coding agents can reproduce and match the published state of the art from Nature-family papers.
summary_zh: NatureBench 检验编程智能体能否复现并达到 Nature 系列论文中已发表的最好结果。

title_en: AMix-2: Establishing Protein as a Native Modality in Large Language Models
title_zh: AMix-2: Establishing Protein as a Native Modality in Large Language Models
summary_en: AMix-2 makes protein a native modality in a language model, unifying protein understanding and sequence design.
summary_zh: AMix-2 把蛋白质作为语言模型的原生模态，统一蛋白理解与序列设计。

title_en: VC-VTON: Toward Across-View and Multi-Posture-Driven Virtual Try-On via Spatiotemporal-Aware View-Consistency Training
title_zh: VC-VTON: Toward Across-View and Multi-Posture-Driven Virtual Try-On via Spatiotemporal-Aware View-Consistency Training
summary_en: VC-VTON, a virtual try-on method with his Tsinghua group achieving consistency across viewpoints and poses.
summary_zh: VC-VTON，与其清华团队合作提出的虚拟试穿方法，实现跨视角、跨姿态的一致性。

title_en: P1: Mastering Physics Olympiads with Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: P1: Mastering Physics Olympiads with Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: P1, a Shanghai AI Laboratory model that masters physics olympiad problems through reinforcement learning.
summary_zh: P1，上海AI实验室推出的模型，通过强化学习攻克物理奥赛题目。

title_en: SciTS: Scientific Time Series Understanding and Generation with LLMs
title_zh: SciTS: Scientific Time Series Understanding and Generation with LLMs
summary_en: SciTS, a benchmark and method from his Shanghai AI Laboratory-linked team for scientific time-series understanding and generation with LLMs.
summary_zh: SciTS，其上海AI实验室相关团队提出的基准与方法，用于大语言模型理解与生成科学时间序列数据。

title_en: InternBootcamp: Boosting LLM Reasoning with Verifiable Task Scaling
title_zh: InternBootcamp: Boosting LLM Reasoning with Verifiable Task Scaling
summary_en: InternBootcamp, a Shanghai AI Laboratory project providing scalable verifiable tasks to boost LLM reasoning.
summary_zh: InternBootcamp，上海AI实验室的项目，提供可大规模验证的任务以提升大语言模型推理能力。

title_en: Less is More: Efficient Model Merging with Binary Task Switch
title_zh: Less is More: Efficient Model Merging with Binary Task Switch
summary_en: Less is More, an efficient model-merging method using binary task switches, from his Shanghai AI Laboratory-affiliated group.
summary_zh: Less is More，其上海AI实验室关联团队提出的高效模型融合方法，采用二值任务开关。

title_en: Guest Editorial: Introduction to the Special Section on Large-Scale Multimodal Learning: Universality, Robustness, Efficiency, and Beyond
title_zh: Guest Editorial: Introduction to the Special Section on Large-Scale Multimodal Learning: Universality, Robustness, Efficiency, and Beyond
summary_en: Guest editorial he co-wrote introducing an IEEE TPAMI special section on large-scale multimodal learning.
summary_zh: 他参与撰写的IEEE TPAMI特刊客座编辑导言，主题为大规模多模态学习。

title_en: Efficient Diffusion Models: A Comprehensive Survey From Principles to Practices
title_zh: Efficient Diffusion Models: A Comprehensive Survey From Principles to Practices
summary_en: A comprehensive IEEE TPAMI survey he co-authored on efficient diffusion models, from principles to practice.
summary_zh: 他参与撰写的IEEE TPAMI综述，系统梳理高效扩散模型的原理与实践。

title_en: A Survey of Efficient Reasoning for Large Reasoning Models: Language, Multimodality, and Beyond
title_zh: A Survey of Efficient Reasoning for Large Reasoning Models: Language, Multimodality, and Beyond
summary_en: A survey from his Shanghai AI Laboratory-linked team on efficient reasoning for large reasoning models across language and multimodal settings.
summary_zh: 其上海AI实验室相关团队撰写的综述，探讨大型推理模型在语言与多模态场景下的高效推理。

title_en: Intern-S1-Pro open-sourced — a 1T-parameter multimodal scientific model
title_zh: 开源 Intern-S1-Pro —— 1 万亿参数多模态科学大模型
summary_en: Built on SAGE, an architecture for integrating general and specialised capability. Zhou's framing: a 'specializable generalist' model is a feasible path to AGI.
summary_zh: 基于 SAGE 架构，用于融合通用与专业能力。周伯文的表述：可专业化的通才模型是通向 AGI 的可行路径。

title_en: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：人类思考一道难题花了上百年，AI需要多久？
title_zh: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：人类思考一道难题花了上百年，AI需要多久？
summary_en: In an interview, Shanghai AI Lab's Bowen Zhou reflects on how long AI will need to match centuries of human problem-solving, a rare public window into his thinking on AI capability timelines and safety.
summary_zh: 上海人工智能实验室周伯文在采访中谈到，人类思考一道难题耗费上百年，AI又需要多久，罕见地公开了他对AI能力发展时间线与安全问题的思考。

title_en: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：人类思考一道难题花了上百年，AI需要多久？
title_zh: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：人类思考一道难题花了上百年，AI需要多久？
summary_en: Zhou discusses how long AI might need to solve problems that took humans over a century, a public reflection on AI capability timelines from Shanghai AI Lab's director.
summary_zh: 周伯文谈到人类花费上百年才解决的难题，AI需要多久才能解决，这是这位上海人工智能实验室主任对AI能力发展节奏的公开思考。

title_en: 百年难题被智能体攻破！上海AI实验室主任周伯文：问题越古老，AI空间越大
title_zh: 百年难题被智能体攻破！上海AI实验室主任周伯文：问题越古老，AI空间越大
summary_en: Zhou says Shanghai AI Lab's agents cracked a century-old problem, arguing the older the problem, the more room AI has to help.
summary_zh: 周伯文表示上海AI实验室的智能体攻克了一个百年难题，认为问题越古老，AI能发挥的空间越大。

title_en: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：科学研究是下一个编程
title_zh: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：科学研究是下一个编程
summary_en: Zhou Bowen, director of Shanghai AI Lab, argued in a Sohu interview that scientific research is becoming the next form of programming, framing AI as a tool for automating discovery.
summary_zh: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文在接受Sohu采访时提出，科学研究正成为下一种“编程”形式，将AI视为自动化发现的工具。

title_en: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：科学研究是下一个编程
title_zh: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：科学研究是下一个编程
summary_en: In an interview, Zhou Bowen argued that scientific research is AI's next frontier after programming, a framing tied to his role as a leading voice on China's AI research direction.
summary_zh: 周伯文在采访中提出，科学研究将是继编程之后AI的下一个前沿，呼应他作为中国AI研究方向代表性人物的立场。

title_en: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：科学研究是下一个编程
title_zh: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：科学研究是下一个编程
summary_en: Zhou argued in a Phoenix.com interview that scientific research is becoming the next programming — AI reframing how discovery itself gets done.
summary_zh: 周伯文在凤凰网采访中提出，科学研究正成为“下一个编程”——AI正在重塑科研本身的方式。

title_en: 百年难题被智能体攻破！上海AI实验室主任周伯文：问题越古老，AI空间越大
title_zh: 百年难题被智能体攻破！上海AI实验室主任周伯文：问题越古老，AI空间越大
summary_en: Zhou Bowen highlighted an AI agent's work cracking a decades-old open problem, arguing that the older the problem, the larger the space for AI-driven progress.
summary_zh: 周伯文谈及智能体攻克一道存在已久的难题，认为问题越古老，AI能发挥作用的空间就越大。

title_en: 百年难题被智能体攻破！上海AI实验室主任周伯文：问题越古老，AI空间越大
title_zh: 百年难题被智能体攻破！上海AI实验室主任周伯文：问题越古老，AI空间越大
summary_en: Bowen Zhou discussed an AI agent cracking a century-old open problem, arguing the older the problem, the larger AI's opportunity space.
summary_zh: 周伯文谈及智能体攻克百年难题，认为问题越古老，AI能发挥的空间就越大。

title_en: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文入选2026《时代》AI百大人物- 中国日报网
title_zh: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文入选2026《时代》AI百大人物- 中国日报网
summary_en: Named to TIME's 2026 list of the 100 most influential people in AI.
summary_zh: 入选《时代》杂志2026年AI领域百大人物榜单。

title_en: 入选TIME100 AI，中国学者周伯文成为年度Thinkers
title_zh: 入选TIME100 AI，中国学者周伯文成为年度Thinkers
summary_en: Zhou was named one of TIME's 100 Most Influential People in AI for 2026, recognized as a Thinker.
summary_zh: 周伯文入选2026年《时代》AI 100人榜单，被评为年度Thinker。

title_en: 姚期智、薛澜、张亚勤、周伯文等专家共同担任《2026新加坡共识》报告指导委员会委员
title_zh: 姚期智、薛澜、张亚勤、周伯文等专家共同担任《2026新加坡共识》报告指导委员会委员
summary_en: Zhou joins Yao Qizhi, Xue Lan and Zhang Yaqin on the steering committee for the 2026 Singapore Consensus report on AI safety.
summary_zh: 周伯文与姚期智、薛澜、张亚勤等共同担任《2026新加坡共识》报告指导委员会委员，该报告聚焦人工智能安全。

title_en: 姚期智、薛澜、张亚勤、周伯文等专家共同担任《2026新加坡共识》报告指导委员会委员
title_zh: 姚期智、薛澜、张亚勤、周伯文等专家共同担任《2026新加坡共识》报告指导委员会委员
summary_en: Zhou was named to the steering committee for the '2026 Singapore Consensus' report alongside Yao Qizhi, Xue Lan and Zhang Yaqin, a notable AI governance appointment.
summary_zh: 周伯文与姚期智、薛澜、张亚勤共同担任《2026新加坡共识》报告指导委员会委员，这是一项值得关注的AI治理任命。

title_en: AI变强了，人类怎么办？周伯文：核心优势全在这三个词里
title_zh: AI变强了，人类怎么办？周伯文：核心优势全在这三个词里
summary_en: Zhou lays out what he sees as humans' core remaining advantages as AI capabilities grow, in an interview with thepaper.cn.
summary_zh: 周伯文在澎湃新闻的采访中阐述了他认为随着AI能力增强人类仍保有的核心优势。

title_en: 世界AI大会主持AI治理圆桌会议-周伯文 | 经信研究·经济和信息化
title_zh: 世界AI大会主持AI治理圆桌会议-周伯文 | 经信研究·经济和信息化
summary_en: Zhou chaired the AI governance roundtable at the World AI Conference, consistent with his role as a leading voice on China's AI safety policy.
summary_zh: 周伯文在世界人工智能大会上主持AI治理圆桌会议，延续了他作为中国AI安全政策重要发声者的角色。

title_en: 周伯文WAIC主旨演讲：迎接AI“科学元认知时刻”，发布“书生·端砚”平台
title_zh: 周伯文WAIC主旨演讲：迎接AI“科学元认知时刻”，发布“书生·端砚”平台
summary_en: WAIC 2026 keynote in which he framed AI's "scientific metacognition moment" and launched the lab's Intern Duanyan platform.
summary_zh: 他在 2026 世界人工智能大会作主旨演讲，提出 AI 的“科学元认知时刻”，并发布书生·端砚平台。

title_en: 周伯文WAIC主旨演讲：迎接AI“科学元认知时刻”，发布“书生·端砚”平台
title_zh: 周伯文WAIC主旨演讲：迎接AI“科学元认知时刻”，发布“书生·端砚”平台
summary_en: In a WAIC keynote, Zhou described AI as reaching a 'scientific metacognition moment' and unveiled the '书生·端砚' platform.
summary_zh: 周伯文在WAIC主旨演讲中提出AI正迎来"科学元认知时刻"，并发布了"书生·端砚"平台。

title_en: 文汇视讯｜周伯文：AI可以代表人行动，但不能代表人负责
title_zh: 文汇视讯｜周伯文：AI可以代表人行动，但不能代表人负责
summary_en: Zhou argued AI can act on a person's behalf but cannot bear responsibility for them, a public stance on AI accountability from one of China's leading voices on AI safety governance.
summary_zh: 周伯文提出AI可以代表人行动，但不能代表人承担责任，作为中国AI安全治理领域的重要声音之一，就AI问责问题公开表态。

title_en: 文汇视讯｜周伯文：AI可以代表人行动，但不能代表人负责
title_zh: 文汇视讯｜周伯文：AI可以代表人行动，但不能代表人负责
summary_en: Zhou Bowen argued publicly that AI can act on a person's behalf but cannot bear responsibility for them, a governance stance from one of China's leading voices on AI safety regulation.
summary_zh: 周伯文公开表示，AI可以代表人行动，但不能代表人负责——这是这位中国AI安全治理重要声音的一次公开表态。

title_en: 大方之谈丨对话周伯文：一个AI科学家的世界观
title_zh: 大方之谈丨对话周伯文：一个AI科学家的世界观
summary_en: A long-form interview with The Paper in which he sets out his worldview as an AI scientist and his safety-first position on where the field should go.
summary_zh: 澎湃新闻长篇对话，阐述他作为一名 AI 科学家的世界观，以及他“安全优先”的技术路线主张。

title_en: 周伯文团队提出NatureBench：AI撰写论文能否登上顶级期刊《自然》（Nature）？
title_zh: 周伯文团队提出NatureBench：AI撰写论文能否登上顶级期刊《自然》（Nature）？
summary_en: Zhou's team proposed NatureBench, a benchmark testing whether AI-written papers can meet the standard required by top journals like Nature.
summary_zh: 周伯文团队提出NatureBench基准，用于评估AI撰写的论文能否达到《自然》等顶级期刊的发表标准。

title_en: π0: A vision-language-action flow model for general robot control
title_zh: π0：面向通用机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作流模型
summary_en: Open-sourced February 2025; generalises across laundry, coffee-making, box assembly and vegetable peeling.
summary_zh: 2025 年 2 月开源；可泛化到叠衣服、冲咖啡、组装纸箱与削蔬菜等任务。

title_en: Long-Horizon Language Model Reinforcement Learning via Progressive Point Matching
title_zh: Long-Horizon Language Model Reinforcement Learning via Progressive Point Matching
summary_en: Levine and coauthors (Preston Fu, Kevin Frans, Oleh Rybkin, Aviral Kumar) propose progressive point matching for training language models with RL on long-horizon tasks, moving past sparse outcome rewards.
summary_zh: 莱文与合著者（Preston Fu、Kevin Frans、Oleh Rybkin、Aviral Kumar）提出渐进式点匹配方法，用强化学习训练语言模型完成长时程任务，突破了稀疏结果奖励的局限。

title_en: Can One AI Model Control Every Robot? | Sergey Levine
title_zh: Can One AI Model Control Every Robot? | Sergey Levine
summary_en: Levine discussed building a single AI model that can control many different robots, drawing on his work at Physical Intelligence.
summary_zh: 莱文在访谈中探讨了打造一个能控制多种不同机器人的单一AI模型，内容取材于他在Physical Intelligence的研究工作。

title_en: Learning to Act While Waiting: RL Finetuning of Generalist Robot Policies Under Inference Latency
title_zh: Learning to Act While Waiting: RL Finetuning of Generalist Robot Policies Under Inference Latency
summary_en: Reinforcement learning fine-tuning that lets large generalist robot policies keep acting despite their own inference latency.
summary_zh: 提出在推理延迟下继续行动的强化学习微调方法，使大型通用机器人策略在实机部署中保持流畅。

title_en: One Frozen Simulator Is Not Enough: Simulator Collapse in Multi-Agent RL
title_zh: One Frozen Simulator Is Not Enough: Simulator Collapse in Multi-Agent RL
summary_en: Co-authored study showing that multi-agent RL trained against a single frozen LLM user simulator collapses and fails to generalize to real users.
summary_zh: 他与人合著的研究表明，多智能体强化学习若只针对单一固定的大模型用户模拟器训练，会出现模拟器坍缩，无法泛化到真实用户。

title_en: Why Does Action Chunking Improve Behavioral Cloning Performance in Robotic Control?
title_zh: Why Does Action Chunking Improve Behavioral Cloning Performance in Robotic Control?
summary_en: An analysis of why predicting and executing multi-step action chunks improves behavioral cloning for robotic control.
summary_zh: 分析为何一次预测并执行多步动作（动作分块）能提升机器人控制中行为克隆的效果。

title_en: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
title_zh: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
summary_en: Levine co-authors PolaRiS, a scalable real-to-sim evaluation framework for generalist robot policies.
summary_zh: Levine参与的PolaRiS是一个可扩展的真实到仿真评估框架，用于评测通用机器人策略。

title_en: Emergence of Human to Robot Transfer in Vision-Language-Action Models
title_zh: Emergence of Human to Robot Transfer in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary_en: Levine co-authors a study on the emergence of human-to-robot transfer in vision-language-action models.
summary_zh: Levine参与研究了视觉-语言-动作模型中人到机器人迁移能力的出现机制。

title_en: Adapting Generalist Robot Policies with Semantic Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Adapting Generalist Robot Policies with Semantic Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Method for adapting pretrained generalist robot policies to new tasks using reinforcement learning driven by semantic rewards.
summary_zh: 提出用语义奖励驱动的强化学习，将预训练的通用机器人策略适配到新任务。

title_en: Learning Process Rewards via Success Visitation Matching for Efficient RL
title_zh: Learning Process Rewards via Success Visitation Matching for Efficient RL
summary_en: Derives dense process rewards from success visitation matching so reinforcement learning stays efficient when the task reward is sparse.
summary_zh: 通过成功状态访问匹配学习稠密的过程奖励，使强化学习在奖励稀疏的任务中仍能高效训练。

title_en: VIMPO: Value-Implicit Policy Optimization for LLMs
title_zh: VIMPO: Value-Implicit Policy Optimization for LLMs
summary_en: VIMPO, a value-implicit policy optimization method for reinforcement learning on LLM reasoning, written with Dawn Song and colleagues.
summary_zh: 与 Dawn Song 等人合作提出 VIMPO，一种用于大模型推理强化学习的隐式价值策略优化方法。

title_en: SC3-Eval: Evaluating Robot Foundation Models via Self-Consistent Video Generation
title_zh: SC3-Eval: Evaluating Robot Foundation Models via Self-Consistent Video Generation
summary_en: Paper introducing SC3-Eval, which evaluates robot foundation models through self-consistent action-conditioned video generation instead of real-world rollouts.
summary_zh: 论文提出 SC3-Eval，用自洽的动作条件视频生成来评测机器人基础模型，替代昂贵的真机测试。

title_en: Reversal Q-Learning
title_zh: Reversal Q-Learning
summary_en: A new offline reinforcement learning algorithm built on flow matching to model complex behaviors from fixed datasets.
summary_zh: 提出一种基于流匹配的新离线强化学习算法，用于从固定数据集中建模复杂行为。

title_en: Improving Robotic Generalist Policies via Flow Reversal Steering
title_zh: Improving Robotic Generalist Policies via Flow Reversal Steering
summary_en: With Chelsea Finn and his students, steers generalist robot policies toward new tasks by reversing their flow-based action generation.
summary_zh: 与 Chelsea Finn 等人合作，通过反转基于流的动作生成来引导通用机器人策略完成新任务。

title_en: Sergey Levine on Why Real-World Data Will Define Physical AI
title_zh: Sergey Levine on Why Real-World Data Will Define Physical AI
summary_en: Interview on why real-world experience, rather than simulation or demo videos, will decide the pace of physical AI.
summary_zh: 访谈：他解释为何真实世界的经验而非仿真或演示视频，将决定具身智能的发展速度。

title_en: Measuring and Mitigating the Distributional Gap Between Real and Simulated User Behaviors
title_zh: Measuring and Mitigating the Distributional Gap Between Real and Simulated User Behaviors
summary_en: Measures how far LLM user simulators drift from real user behavior and proposes ways to close that gap.
summary_zh: 量化大模型用户模拟器与真实用户行为之间的分布差距，并提出缩小该差距的方法。

title_en: OGPO: Sample Efficient Full-Finetuning of Generative Control Policies
title_zh: OGPO: Sample Efficient Full-Finetuning of Generative Control Policies
summary_en: OGPO, an off-policy method for sample-efficient full fine-tuning of diffusion- and flow-based robot control policies.
summary_zh: 提出 OGPO：一种样本高效的离策略方法，用于对扩散式与流式机器人控制策略做全参数微调。

title_en: RL Token: Bootstrapping Online RL with Vision-Language-Action Models
title_zh: RL Token: Bootstrapping Online RL with Vision-Language-Action Models
summary_en: Bootstraps online reinforcement learning from pretrained vision-language-action models so robots reach the precision and speed real tasks demand.
summary_zh: 利用预训练的视觉-语言-动作模型引导在线强化学习，使机器人达到真实任务所需的精度与速度。

title_en: $π_{0.7}$: a Steerable Generalist Robotic Foundation Model with Emergent Capabilities
title_zh: $π_{0.7}$: a Steerable Generalist Robotic Foundation Model with Emergent Capabilities
summary_en: Physical Intelligence's π0.7 robotic foundation model, the latest generation of the π series he co-leads.
summary_zh: Physical Intelligence 发布的 π0.7 机器人基础模型，是他参与主导的 π 系列的最新一代。

title_en: #331 Sergey Levine: The Robot Revolution Nobody Is Talking About
title_zh: #331 Sergey Levine: The Robot Revolution Nobody Is Talking About
summary_en: Eye on A.I. interview on the state of robot learning and the robotics shift he thinks is being overlooked.
summary_zh: 在 Eye on A.I. 节目中谈机器人学习现状，以及他认为被外界忽视的机器人变革。

title_en: Bridging the Simulation-to-Experiment Gap with Generative Models using Adversarial Distribution Alignment
title_zh: Bridging the Simulation-to-Experiment Gap with Generative Models using Adversarial Distribution Alignment
summary_en: Uses generative models with adversarial distribution alignment to close the gap between physical simulation and real experiment.
summary_zh: 用生成模型与对抗式分布对齐来弥合物理仿真与真实实验之间的差距。

source: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Sh…
title_en: Sergey Levine - Building LLMs for the Physical World
title_zh: Sergey Levine - Building LLMs for the Physical World
summary_en: Long-form interview on building foundation models for the physical world at Physical Intelligence.
summary_zh: 长篇访谈：谈在 Physical Intelligence 为物理世界构建基础模型的工作。

title_en: Offline Materials Optimization with CliqueFlowmer
title_zh: Offline Materials Optimization with CliqueFlowmer
summary_en: Applies offline optimization with a flow-based model to computational materials discovery, co-authored with Pieter Abbeel.
summary_zh: 与 Pieter Abbeel 等合作，将基于流模型的离线优化方法用于计算材料发现。

title_en: MEM: Multi-Scale Embodied Memory for Vision Language Action Models
title_zh: MEM: Multi-Scale Embodied Memory for Vision Language Action Models
summary_en: Gives vision-language-action models a multi-scale memory so robots can carry context through long multi-stage tasks.
summary_zh: 为视觉-语言-动作模型引入多尺度具身记忆，使机器人能在多阶段长任务中保持上下文。

title_en: AsyncVLA: An Asynchronous VLA for Fast and Robust Navigation on the Edge
title_zh: AsyncVLA: An Asynchronous VLA for Fast and Robust Navigation on the Edge
summary_en: An asynchronous VLA architecture that cuts inference cost enough to run robot navigation on edge hardware.
summary_zh: 提出异步 VLA 架构，大幅降低推理开销，使机器人导航可在边缘设备上运行。

title_en: Steerable Vision-Language-Action Policies for Embodied Reasoning and Hierarchical Control
title_zh: Steerable Vision-Language-Action Policies for Embodied Reasoning and Hierarchical Control
summary_en: Grounds vision-language model priors into hierarchical robot control, yielding steerable policies for embodied reasoning.
summary_zh: 将视觉-语言模型的先验落地到分层机器人控制中，得到可引导的具身推理策略。

title_en: SteerVLA: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models in Long-Tail Driving Scenarios
title_zh: SteerVLA: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models in Long-Tail Driving Scenarios
summary_en: Paper on steering vision-language-action models to handle long-tail autonomous driving scenarios.
summary_zh: 论文研究如何引导视觉-语言-动作模型应对自动驾驶中的长尾场景。

title_en: Q-learning with Adjoint Matching
title_zh: Q-learning with Adjoint Matching
summary_en: Q-learning with Adjoint Matching, a temporal-difference method for efficient optimization in continuous-action reinforcement learning.
summary_zh: 提出伴随匹配 Q 学习（QAM），一种面向连续动作强化学习的高效时序差分方法。

title_en: RoboReward: General-Purpose Vision-Language Reward Models for Robotics
title_zh: RoboReward: General-Purpose Vision-Language Reward Models for Robotics
summary_en: General-purpose vision-language reward models that remove the need for hand-designed or human-labeled robot rewards.
summary_zh: 提出通用的视觉-语言奖励模型，免去为机器人任务人工设计或标注奖励的负担。

title_en: Posterior Behavioral Cloning: Pretraining BC Policies for Efficient RL Finetuning
title_zh: Posterior Behavioral Cloning: Pretraining BC Policies for Efficient RL Finetuning
summary_en: Paper proposing posterior behavioral cloning, a pretraining scheme that makes later RL finetuning of policies more efficient.
summary_zh: 论文提出后验行为克隆预训练方案，使策略后续的强化学习微调更高效。

title_en: Decoupled Q-Chunking
title_zh: Decoupled Q-Chunking
summary_en: Decouples action chunking in temporal-difference learning to reduce bootstrapping bias in offline reinforcement learning.
summary_zh: 在时序差分学习中解耦动作分块，以降低离线强化学习中的自举偏差。

title_en: Leveraging Discrete Function Decomposability for Scientific Design
title_zh: Leveraging Discrete Function Decomposability for Scientific Design
summary_en: With Bowden and Listgarten, Levine explores leveraging discrete function decomposability for scientific design problems.
summary_zh: Levine与Bowden、Listgarten合作，探讨如何利用离散函数的可分解性用于科学设计问题。

title_en: A neat and elegant idea from @seohong_park & Deepinder Mann: represent a state by distances to other states (i.e., how easy it is to reach other states). Th
title_zh: A neat and elegant idea from @seohong_park & Deepinder Mann: represent a state by distances to other states (i.e., how easy it is to reach other states). Th
summary_en: Highlights work from his group that represents a state by its distances to other states, giving a representation for goal-conditioned RL.
summary_zh: 介绍其团队的工作：用一个状态到其他状态的可达距离来表示该状态，为目标条件强化学习提供表征。

title_en: A new VLA for navigation that can take in goal images, positions, and language, and exhibits some pretty neat emergent language following!
title_zh: A new VLA for navigation that can take in goal images, positions, and language, and exhibits some pretty neat emergent language following!
summary_en: Shares a navigation VLA that takes goal images, positions and language, and shows emergent language following.
summary_zh: 分享一个可接受目标图像、位置与语言输入的导航 VLA，并展现出涌现的语言跟随能力。

title_en: Fully autonomous robots are much closer than you think – Sergey Levine
title_zh: Fully autonomous robots are much closer than you think – Sergey Levine
summary_en: Dwarkesh Podcast interview arguing a self-improvement flywheel will bring general-purpose robots sooner than most expect.
summary_zh: 在 Dwarkesh 播客中提出，自我改进飞轮将使通用机器人比多数人预期更早到来。

title_en: The pi-05 model is now in openpi: https://t.co/NLfraCc7zf Now with pytorch (πtorch?) support too!
title_zh: The pi-05 model is now in openpi: https://t.co/NLfraCc7zf Now with pytorch (πtorch?) support too!
summary_en: Announces that the π0.5 model is available in the open-source openpi repository, now with PyTorch support.
summary_zh: 宣布 π0.5 模型已加入开源项目 openpi，并新增 PyTorch 支持。

title_en: Language following is a tough problem for VLAs: while these models can follow complex language, in practice getting datasets that enable language following is h
title_zh: Language following is a tough problem for VLAs: while these models can follow complex language, in practice getting datasets that enable language following is h
summary_en: Describes a counterfactual data method that teaches vision-language-action models to actually follow language instructions.
summary_zh: 介绍一种反事实数据生成方法，让视觉-语言-动作模型真正学会遵循语言指令。

title_en: I wrote a fun little article about all the ways to dodge the need for real-world robot data. I think it has a cute title. https://t.co/EIZsCARRRo
title_zh: I wrote a fun little article about all the ways to dodge the need for real-world robot data. I think it has a cute title. https://t.co/EIZsCARRRo
summary_en: Points to his own essay surveying the many ways researchers try to avoid collecting real-world robot data.
summary_zh: 分享他撰写的文章，梳理研究者们试图绕开采集真实机器人数据的各种做法。

title_en: Action chunking is a great idea in robotics: by getting a model to produce a short sequence of actions, it _just works better_ for some mysterious reason. Now i
title_zh: Action chunking is a great idea in robotics: by getting a model to produce a short sequence of actions, it _just works better_ for some mysterious reason. Now i
summary_en: Notes that action chunking, long useful in imitation learning, turns out to help reinforcement learning too.
summary_zh: 指出在模仿学习中行之有效的动作分块，同样能提升强化学习的效果。

title_en: Warm-start RL (WSRL) can learn to control a real robot in under 20 minutes! Deep RL is getting really fast. Warm-start from offline data + super-efficient onlin
title_zh: Warm-start RL (WSRL) can learn to control a real robot in under 20 minutes! Deep RL is getting really fast. Warm-start from offline data + super-efficient onlin
summary_en: Shares Warm-start RL, which learns to control a real robot in under twenty minutes by combining offline data with efficient online learning.
summary_zh: 分享 Warm-start RL（WSRL）：结合离线数据与高效在线学习，可在二十分钟内学会控制真实机器人。

title_en: If you have a policy that uses diffusion/flow (e.g. diffusion VLA), you can run RL where the actor chooses the noise, which is then denoised by the policy to pr
title_zh: If you have a policy that uses diffusion/flow (e.g. diffusion VLA), you can run RL where the actor chooses the noise, which is then denoised by the policy to pr
summary_en: Explains an RL method in which the actor chooses the noise that a diffusion or flow policy then denoises into an action.
summary_zh: 介绍一种强化学习方法：由 actor 选择噪声，再由扩散或流策略将其去噪成动作。

title_en: Self-supervised representation learning looks a bit like RL. What if we literally use RL as a SSL method for visual representations? Turns out that it works qui
title_zh: Self-supervised representation learning looks a bit like RL. What if we literally use RL as a SSL method for visual representations? Turns out that it works qui
summary_en: Shares work using reinforcement learning itself as a self-supervised objective for learning visual representations.
summary_zh: 分享将强化学习本身用作自监督目标来学习视觉表征的工作。

title_en: Real-time inference is a big challenge for VLAs. We’ve been working on a way to amortize inference delays in π0.5. Our new Real-Time Chunking (RTC) method speed
title_zh: Real-time inference is a big challenge for VLAs. We’ve been working on a way to amortize inference delays in π0.5. Our new Real-Time Chunking (RTC) method speed
summary_en: Introduces Real-Time Chunking, which amortizes inference delay so π0.5 can keep acting while it thinks.
summary_zh: 介绍实时分块（RTC）方法：摊薄推理延迟，让 π0.5 能边思考边行动。

title_en: I always found it puzzling how language models learn so much from next-token prediction, while video models learn so little from next frame prediction. Maybe it
title_zh: I always found it puzzling how language models learn so much from next-token prediction, while video models learn so little from next frame prediction. Maybe it
summary_en: His reflection on why next-token prediction teaches language models so much while next-frame prediction teaches video models so little.
summary_zh: 他的思考：为何下一词预测能让语言模型学到很多，而下一帧预测对视频模型收效甚微。
