title_zh: Intelligence will not become a commodity. Intelligence will not be too cheap to meter. In the future, the real gap between people will be defined by their acces
summary_en: Argues intelligence will stay scarce rather than become a cheap commodity, and that access to intelligence will define the real gap between people.
summary_zh: 认为智能不会变成廉价商品，未来人与人之间真正的差距将由获取智能的能力决定。

title_en: So cute. Neither GPT-5.2 nor Gemini 3 could generate a reply like the one below. We’re still very far from AGI. https://t.co/xhh5QFbysI
title_zh: So cute. Neither GPT-5.2 nor Gemini 3 could generate a reply like the one below. We’re still very far from AGI. https://t.co/xhh5QFbysI
summary_en: Points to a case where neither GPT-5.2 nor Gemini 3 could generate a reply as apt as a human's, arguing AI is still far from AGI.
summary_zh: 指出GPT-5.2和Gemini 3都无法生成像人类那样恰当的回复，认为AI距离AGI仍很遥远。

title_en: The day AI completely replaces politicians will be humanity’s greatest victory.
title_zh: The day AI completely replaces politicians will be humanity’s greatest victory.
summary_en: Calls the day AI fully replaces politicians "humanity's greatest victory."
summary_zh: 称AI完全取代政治家的那一天将是"人类最伟大的胜利"。

title_en: "Gemini 3 flash achieved 90% acc @ 1 million ctx. ... what black magic did they do?" Yes, we've developed powerful new techniques for Gemini 3 long-context reas
title_zh: "Gemini 3 flash achieved 90% acc @ 1 million ctx. ... what black magic did they do?" Yes, we've developed powerful new techniques for Gemini 3 long-context reas
summary_en: Confirms his team developed new techniques behind Gemini 3 Flash's 90% accuracy at 1-million-token context, crediting collaborators.
summary_zh: 确认他的团队研发出让Gemini 3 Flash在百万级上下文中达到90%准确率的新技术，并感谢合作者。

title_en: Nothing is more fun than creating intelligence
title_zh: Nothing is more fun than creating intelligence
summary_en: A one-line declaration that creating intelligence is the most fun work there is — one of his most-viewed posts in this batch.
summary_zh: 一句宣言："创造智能是最有趣的事"——是本批次中浏览量最高的帖子之一。

title_en: Yejin is a true pioneer in reasoning research. Her work has deeply inspired the whole community.
title_zh: Yejin is a true pioneer in reasoning research. Her work has deeply inspired the whole community.
summary_en: Publicly credits Yejin Choi as a true pioneer of reasoning research who has inspired the community.
summary_zh: 公开称赞Yejin Choi是推理研究领域真正的先驱，激励了整个学术社区。

title_en: My daughter has very mathematical thinking, while her younger brother is naturally inclined toward computational thinking. I once gave them a problem: Divide th
title_zh: My daughter has very mathematical thinking, while her younger brother is naturally inclined toward computational thinking. I once gave them a problem: Divide th
summary_en: Describes his daughter and son's contrasting mathematical vs. computational thinking styles through a number-partition puzzle he gave them.
summary_zh: 通过一道数字分组题，描述了女儿偏数学思维、儿子偏计算思维的不同风格。

title_en: My daughter quit TikTok. It’s hard for her to tell whether a video is human made or AI generated.
title_zh: My daughter quit TikTok. It’s hard for her to tell whether a video is human made or AI generated.
summary_en: Notes his daughter quit TikTok because she can no longer reliably tell human-made videos from AI-generated ones.
summary_zh: 提到女儿因难以分辨视频是人工制作还是AI生成而退出了TikTok。

title_en: My daughter told me not to go to NeurIPS this year. She wants me to stay home with her. Otherwise, she said she’d tweet “NeurIPS is over.” 😅 I’ll miss seeing my
title_zh: My daughter told me not to go to NeurIPS this year. She wants me to stay home with her. Otherwise, she said she’d tweet “NeurIPS is over.” 😅 I’ll miss seeing my
summary_en: A personal note about skipping NeurIPS at his daughter's request, which drew reach far beyond his usual scale.
summary_zh: 一条关于应女儿要求缺席NeurIPS的个人感言，获得了远超他平时规模的传播。

title_en: Scaling laws hit a wall. Human innovation doesn’t.
title_zh: Scaling laws hit a wall. Human innovation doesn’t.
summary_en: Argues scaling laws have hit a wall while human innovation has not.
summary_zh: 主张扩展定律（scaling laws）已经触顶，而人类的创新并未止步。

title_en: my little one scored in the "exceptionally gifted" range on iq test. way higher than any llm so far. i’m now fully convinced by that test. before she tweeted, w
title_zh: my little one scored in the "exceptionally gifted" range on iq test. way higher than any llm so far. i’m now fully convinced by that test. before she tweeted, w
summary_en: Notes his daughter scored in the "exceptionally gifted" range on an IQ test, higher than any LLM so far, after they raced through AMC 8 problems together.
summary_zh: 提到女儿在IQ测试中达到"极高天赋"区间，超过目前任何LLM，此前两人曾一起竞速解AMC 8题目。

title_en: the game over tweet was posted by my little one playing with my phone. it's been deleted.
title_zh: the game over tweet was posted by my little one playing with my phone. it's been deleted.
summary_en: Clarifies that a viral "game over" tweet from his account was posted and then deleted by his young daughter playing with his phone.
summary_zh: 澄清此前一条刷屏的"game over"推文，是女儿玩他手机时发布后又删除的。

title_en: "Gemini 3 is the largest leap in a long time."
title_zh: "Gemini 3 is the largest leap in a long time."
summary_en: Calls Gemini 3 the largest leap in a long time, as someone working on it.
summary_zh: 作为参与其研发的一员，称Gemini 3是很长一段时间以来最大的一次飞跃。

title_en: Wild to think Gemini 3 is still built by humans. Humans with shockingly unlimited innovation bandwidth.
title_zh: Wild to think Gemini 3 is still built by humans. Humans with shockingly unlimited innovation bandwidth.
summary_en: Marvels that Gemini 3 is still built by humans, crediting the team's innovation bandwidth.
summary_zh: 感叹Gemini 3仍是由人类打造，称团队的创新能力令人惊叹。

title_en: we live in a parallel universe lol
title_zh: we live in a parallel universe lol
summary_en: A brief, cryptic aside ("we live in a parallel universe") that became one of his most-viewed posts.
summary_zh: 一句简短而含糊的感叹——"我们生活在平行宇宙里"——成为他浏览量最高的帖子之一。

title_en: Slides for my lecture “LLM Reasoning” at Stanford CS 25: https://t.co/eApGUHyIDo Key points: 1. Reasoning in LLMs simply means generating a sequence of intermed
title_zh: Slides for my lecture “LLM Reasoning” at Stanford CS 25: https://t.co/eApGUHyIDo Key points: 1. Reasoning in LLMs simply means generating a sequence of intermed
summary_en: Shares slides from his Stanford CS 25 lecture on LLM reasoning, summarizing that reasoning means generating intermediate tokens before the final answer.
summary_zh: 分享他在斯坦福CS 25课程"LLM推理"讲座的幻灯片，概括推理即在给出最终答案前生成中间token序列。

title_en: LLMs for IMO 2025: gemini-2.5-pro (31.55%), o3 high (16.67%), Grok 4 (11.90%). https://t.co/MoaRJgBeN1 https://t.co/qJ6RQalEiH
title_zh: LLMs for IMO 2025: gemini-2.5-pro (31.55%), o3 high (16.67%), Grok 4 (11.90%). https://t.co/MoaRJgBeN1 https://t.co/qJ6RQalEiH
summary_en: Posts benchmark results for LLMs on IMO 2025 problems: Gemini 2.5 Pro at 31.55%, o3 (high) at 16.67%, Grok 4 at 11.90%.
summary_zh: 公布LLM在2025年IMO题目上的成绩：Gemini 2.5 Pro为31.55%，o3（高算力）为16.67%，Grok 4为11.90%。

title_en: Gemini 2.5: Pushing the Frontier with Advanced Reasoning, Multimodality, Long Context, and Next Generation Agentic Capabilities
title_zh: Gemini 2.5: Pushing the Frontier with Advanced Reasoning, Multimodality, Long Context, and Next Generation Agentic Capabilities
summary_en: Google DeepMind technical report on the Gemini 2.5 model family, covering reasoning, multimodality, long context and agentic capability; he is a listed contributor.
summary_zh: 谷歌 DeepMind 的 Gemini 2.5 系列模型技术报告，涵盖推理、多模态、长上下文与智能体能力，他是署名贡献者之一。

title_en: Scientific progress comes from scaling the right dimension. Scaling all dimensions is just wasteful engineering.
title_zh: Scientific progress comes from scaling the right dimension. Scaling all dimensions is just wasteful engineering.
summary_en: Argues scientific progress comes from scaling the right dimension, calling scaling everything "wasteful engineering."
summary_zh: 主张科学进步来自于扩展正确的维度，称一味扩展所有维度是"浪费的工程"。

title_en: Reasoning is far from being solved. Looking forward to seeing new breakthroughs.
title_zh: Reasoning is far from being solved. Looking forward to seeing new breakthroughs.
summary_en: States reasoning is still far from solved and he looks forward to further breakthroughs.
summary_zh: 表示推理问题远未解决，并期待该领域取得新的突破。

title_en: NATURAL PLAN: Benchmarking LLMs on Natural Language Planning
title_zh: NATURAL PLAN: Benchmarking LLMs on Natural Language Planning
summary_en: Introduces NATURAL PLAN, a natural-language planning benchmark (trip, meeting, calendar) used to measure where LLM planning breaks down.
summary_zh: 提出 NATURAL PLAN 自然语言规划基准，用行程、会议、日程三类任务衡量大模型规划能力的短板。

title_en: Best Practices and Lessons Learned on Synthetic Data
title_zh: Best Practices and Lessons Learned on Synthetic Data
summary_en: Survey of practices and pitfalls in generating and using synthetic training data for large models.
summary_zh: 系统梳理大模型合成数据的生成与使用方法，以及其中的常见陷阱。

title_en: Gemini 1.5: Unlocking multimodal understanding across millions of tokens of context
title_zh: Gemini 1.5: Unlocking multimodal understanding across millions of tokens of context
summary_en: Technical report for Gemini 1.5, the model family that pushed context length to millions of tokens; he is a listed contributor.
summary_zh: Gemini 1.5 技术报告，该系列将上下文长度推进到百万 token 级别，他是署名贡献者之一。

title_en: Chain of Thought Empowers Transformers to Solve Inherently Serial Problems
title_zh: Chain of Thought Empowers Transformers to Solve Inherently Serial Problems
summary_en: Theoretical result showing chain-of-thought lets constant-depth transformers solve inherently serial problems they otherwise cannot.
summary_zh: 从理论上证明思维链使常数深度 Transformer 能够求解原本无法处理的本质串行问题。

title_en: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Without Prompting
title_zh: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Without Prompting
summary_en: Shows chain-of-thought paths already exist in the model's decoding space and can be surfaced by changing decoding rather than prompting.
summary_zh: 指出思维链路径本就存在于模型的解码空间中，改变解码方式即可引出，无需提示词。

title_en: Transformers Can Achieve Length Generalization But Not Robustly
title_zh: Transformers Can Achieve Length Generalization But Not Robustly
summary_en: Studies length generalization in transformers, finding it achievable with the right position encoding and data format but highly unstable.
summary_zh: 研究 Transformer 的长度泛化，发现在合适的位置编码与数据格式下可以实现，但非常不稳定。

title_en: Premise Order Matters in Reasoning with Large Language Models
title_zh: Premise Order Matters in Reasoning with Large Language Models
summary_en: Shows LLM reasoning accuracy drops sharply when premises are reordered, a brittleness finding for chain-of-thought reasoning.
summary_zh: 发现仅仅打乱前提顺序就会让大模型推理准确率显著下降，揭示思维链推理的脆弱性。

title_en: Self-Discover: Large Language Models Self-Compose Reasoning Structures
title_zh: Self-Discover: Large Language Models Self-Compose Reasoning Structures
summary_en: Proposes SELF-DISCOVER, in which a model composes its own task-specific reasoning structure before solving a problem.
summary_zh: 提出 SELF-DISCOVER：让模型先自行组合出适合该任务的推理结构，再去解题。

title_en: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models
title_zh: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models
summary_en: The original Gemini technical report introducing the Ultra/Pro/Nano multimodal model family; he is a listed contributor.
summary_zh: 初代 Gemini 技术报告，发布 Ultra/Pro/Nano 多模态模型系列，他是署名贡献者之一。

title_en: Universal Self-Consistency for Large Language Model Generation
title_zh: Universal Self-Consistency for Large Language Model Generation
summary_en: Extends his self-consistency method to free-form generation by having the model itself select the most consistent answer.
summary_zh: 把他此前的自洽性方法扩展到自由形式生成，改由模型自己挑选最一致的答案。

title_en: Instruction-Following Evaluation for Large Language Models
title_zh: Instruction-Following Evaluation for Large Language Models
summary_en: Introduces IFEval, a verifiable instruction-following benchmark that became a standard evaluation for instruction-tuned models.
summary_zh: 提出 IFEval 可自动校验的指令跟随基准，后来成为指令微调模型的标准评测之一。

title_en: Large Language Models can Learn Rules
title_zh: Large Language Models can Learn Rules
summary_en: Shows LLMs can induce explicit rules from examples and then reason with the learned rule library.
summary_zh: 证明大模型可以从样例中归纳出显式规则，再用学到的规则库进行推理。

title_en: Take a Step Back: Evoking Reasoning via Abstraction in Large Language Models
title_zh: Take a Step Back: Evoking Reasoning via Abstraction in Large Language Models
summary_en: Introduces Step-Back Prompting, which asks the model to abstract a high-level principle before working through the details.
summary_zh: 提出 Step-Back 提示法：先让模型抽象出高层原理，再回到细节求解。

title_en: FreshLLMs: Refreshing Large Language Models with Search Engine Augmentation
title_zh: FreshLLMs: Refreshing Large Language Models with Search Engine Augmentation
summary_en: Builds FreshQA and shows search-augmented prompting substantially improves LLM answers on fast-changing facts.
summary_zh: 构建 FreshQA 数据集，并证明检索增强提示能明显改善大模型在时效性事实上的回答。

title_en: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
title_zh: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
summary_en: Argues LLMs cannot reliably self-correct their own reasoning without external feedback, a widely cited corrective to self-refinement claims.
summary_zh: 论证大模型在没有外部反馈时无法可靠地自我纠错，是对自我修正类方法的一次广受引用的纠偏。

title_en: Large Language Models as Analogical Reasoners
title_zh: Large Language Models as Analogical Reasoners
summary_en: Proposes analogical prompting, where the model generates its own relevant exemplars instead of relying on hand-written ones.
summary_zh: 提出类比提示法：由模型自行生成相关范例，而不依赖人工编写的示例。

title_en: Large Language Models as Optimizers
title_zh: Large Language Models as Optimizers
summary_en: Proposes OPRO, using an LLM as a black-box optimizer that iteratively rewrites its own prompts.
summary_zh: 提出 OPRO，把大模型当作黑盒优化器，让它迭代地改写自身提示词。

title_en: Simple synthetic data reduces sycophancy in large language models
title_zh: Simple synthetic data reduces sycophancy in large language models
summary_en: Shows a lightweight synthetic-data fine-tuning recipe reduces sycophancy, where models echo a user's stated view.
summary_zh: 证明一套轻量的合成数据微调方法可以减少模型迎合用户观点的谄媚行为。

title_en: Large Language Models as Tool Makers
title_zh: Large Language Models as Tool Makers
summary_en: Proposes LATM, where a strong model writes reusable tools that a cheaper model then calls to solve tasks.
summary_zh: 提出 LATM：由强模型编写可复用工具，再交给更便宜的模型调用来完成任务。

title_en: Training Socially Aligned Language Models on Simulated Social Interactions
title_zh: Training Socially Aligned Language Models on Simulated Social Interactions
summary_en: Trains socially aligned language models on simulated multi-agent social interactions rather than static preference data.
summary_zh: 用模拟的多智能体社会互动而非静态偏好数据来训练具有社会对齐性的语言模型。

title_en: Mixture-of-Experts Meets Instruction Tuning:A Winning Combination for Large Language Models
title_zh: Mixture-of-Experts Meets Instruction Tuning:A Winning Combination for Large Language Models
summary_en: Shows sparse mixture-of-experts models benefit disproportionately from instruction tuning (FLAN-MoE).
summary_zh: 证明稀疏专家混合模型从指令微调中获益尤其明显（FLAN-MoE）。

title_en: A Pretrainer's Guide to Training Data: Measuring the Effects of Data Age, Domain Coverage, Quality, & Toxicity
title_zh: A Pretrainer's Guide to Training Data: Measuring the Effects of Data Age, Domain Coverage, Quality, & Toxicity
summary_en: Measures how pretraining data age, domain coverage, quality and toxicity filtering affect downstream model behaviour.
summary_zh: 量化预训练数据的时效、领域覆盖、质量与毒性过滤对下游模型行为的影响。

title_en: Leaves Google DeepMind for Meta Superintelligence Labs
title_zh: 离开 Google DeepMind 加入 Meta 超级智能实验室
summary_en: The move went unannounced and was reported four months later, as part of a broader DeepMind exodus — six researchers to Meta, OpenAI and Anthropic in five months, tied to a resource shift toward commercial coding applications.
summary_zh: 此次调动未公开宣布，四个月后才被报道，属于 DeepMind 更大规模人才流失的一部分 —— 五个月内六名研究员流向 Meta、OpenAI 与 Anthropic，起因是资源向商业编码应用倾斜。

title_en: 谷歌人才「失血」：周登勇、Noam Shazeer等出走，Coding突击队重构训练引冲突
title_zh: 谷歌人才「失血」：周登勇、Noam Shazeer等出走，Coding突击队重构训练引冲突
summary_en: He leaves Google for Meta alongside other senior researchers, in a departure wave tied to internal conflict over training and product direction.
summary_zh: 他与多位资深研究员一同从谷歌转投 Meta，这波离职与内部在训练方向和产品路线上的分歧有关。

title_en: Drug discovery has no magic wands
title_zh: 药物发现没有魔杖
summary_en: A direct response to the claim that superintelligence will simply cure cancer.
summary_zh: 对「超级智能将直接治愈癌症」这一说法的正面回应。

title_en: A tidal wave of data is enabling AI-powered drug discovery
title_zh: 数据的浪潮正在使 AI 驱动的药物发现成为可能

title_en: Changing minds: How AI is transforming the life sciences
title_zh: Changing minds: How AI is transforming the life sciences
summary_en: Koller was lead author of a Cell perspective on how AI is transforming life-sciences research, drawing on her work applying machine learning to drug discovery at insitro.
summary_zh: Koller作为第一作者在《细胞》期刊发表了一篇关于AI如何改变生命科学研究的评论文章，结合她在insitro将机器学习应用于药物研发的工作。

title_en: Only about a quarter of human diseases have an approved therapy. By some estimates it's a few percent. Most of those treatments slow a disease rather than stop
title_zh: Only about a quarter of human diseases have an approved therapy. By some estimates it's a few percent. Most of those treatments slow a disease rather than stop
summary_en: Koller argued only a small fraction of human diseases have effective treatments, framing the opportunity AI-driven drug discovery has to close that gap.
summary_zh: Koller指出只有一小部分人类疾病拥有有效疗法,阐述了AI驱动的药物发现在弥合这一差距上的机会。

title_en: Daphne Koller - The Future of AI in Biology and Drug Discovery
title_zh: Daphne Koller - The Future of AI in Biology and Drug Discovery
summary_en: Long-form interview on where AI in biology and drug discovery is heading, tracing her path from probabilistic graphical models to insitro.
summary_zh: 长篇访谈，谈人工智能在生物学与药物研发中的走向，回顾她从概率图模型到 insitro 的历程。

source: Machine Learning: How Did We Get Here?
title_en: Learning Probabilistic Models with Daphne Koller
title_zh: Learning Probabilistic Models with Daphne Koller
summary_en: Interview on her research at the intersection of machine learning and probabilistic reasoning, and her move from Stanford into building companies.
summary_zh: 访谈她在机器学习与概率推理交叉领域的研究，以及她从斯坦福转向创业的经历。

title_en: Is AI Drug Discovery Finally Here? - with Daphne Koller
title_zh: Is AI Drug Discovery Finally Here? - with Daphne Koller
summary_en: Interview asking whether AI-driven drug discovery has finally arrived, argued from insitro's own pipeline.
summary_zh: 访谈探讨人工智能驱动的药物研发是否终于成真，并以 insitro 自身的管线为依据。

title_en: The Machine Learns Medicine: Daphne Koller’s Vision for AI in Biotech
title_zh: The Machine Learns Medicine: Daphne Koller’s Vision for AI in Biotech
summary_en: Koller appeared on Leadership Next to discuss her thesis that AI could transform biology the way calculus transformed physics, drawing on her work at insitro.
summary_zh: 科勒做客Leadership Next播客,阐述了她认为AI能像微积分改变物理学一样改变生物学的观点,并结合了她在insitro的工作。

title_en: Daphne Koller | How machine learning could save millions of lives
title_zh: Daphne Koller | How machine learning could save millions of lives
summary_en: Podcast interview on how machine learning applied to human biology could change which medicines reach patients.
summary_zh: 播客访谈，谈将机器学习应用于人类生物学如何改变最终能够送到患者手中的药物。

title_en: Exploring AI Innovation: insitro CEO Daphne Koller On AI In Drug Discovery
title_zh: Exploring AI Innovation: insitro CEO Daphne Koller On AI In Drug Discovery
summary_en: Conversation with Stanford Medicine dean Lloyd Minor on how machine learning can accelerate drug discovery.
summary_zh: 与斯坦福医学院院长 Lloyd Minor 对谈，讨论机器学习如何加速药物研发。

title_en: What's next for data-driven medicine - and what AI-powered innovation needs now: insitro CEO Daphne Koller
title_zh: What's next for data-driven medicine - and what AI-powered innovation needs now: insitro CEO Daphne Koller
summary_en: Interview on what data-driven medicine needs next and how attitudes to AI in healthcare have shifted.
summary_zh: 访谈数据驱动医学的下一步需求，以及医疗界对人工智能态度的转变。

title_en: Daphne Koller: Changing Lives With Coursera
title_zh: Daphne Koller: Changing Lives With Coursera
summary_en: Podcast interview on founding Coursera and moving from machine-learning research into company building.
summary_zh: 播客访谈，谈创办 Coursera 以及从机器学习研究走向创业的经历。

title_en: From Theory to Therapy: The Evolution of AI in Medicine with Dr. Daphne Koller
title_zh: From Theory to Therapy: The Evolution of AI in Medicine with Dr. Daphne Koller
summary_en: Interview charting her trajectory from early AI research to applying machine learning in medicine.
summary_zh: 访谈梳理她从早期人工智能研究到将机器学习应用于医学的职业轨迹。

title_en: Daphne Koller: The Convergence of A.I. and Digital Biology
title_zh: Daphne Koller: The Convergence of A.I. and Digital Biology
summary_en: Conversation with Eric Topol on the convergence of AI and digital biology.
summary_zh: 与 Eric Topol 对谈人工智能与数字生物学的融合。

title_en: When AI and Genomics Collide
title_zh: When AI and Genomics Collide
summary_en: Daphne Koller joins a16z's Vijay Pande to discuss the convergence of AI and genomics in drug discovery, drawing on her work at insitro.
summary_zh: 达芙妮·科勒与a16z的Vijay Pande对谈，探讨AI与基因组学在药物发现中的融合，并分享insitro的相关工作。

title_en: AI Revolution: Digital Biology with insitro's Daphne Koller
title_zh: AI Revolution: Digital Biology with insitro's Daphne Koller
summary_en: Conversation with a16z's Vijay Pande on engineering drug discovery with machine learning, including what a language model for cells would mean.
summary_zh: 与 a16z 的 Vijay Pande 对谈如何用机器学习重构药物研发，包括「细胞的大语言模型」意味着什么。

title_en: How AI can make drug discovery fail less, with Daphne Koller from Insitro
title_zh: How AI can make drug discovery fail less, with Daphne Koller from Insitro
summary_en: Interview on using machine learning to lower the failure rate of drug discovery.

title_zh: #93 – Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning
summary_en: Long-form Lex Fridman interview on biomedicine and machine learning, spanning her Stanford research, Coursera and insitro.
summary_zh: Lex Fridman 长篇访谈，谈生物医学与机器学习，涵盖她在斯坦福的研究、Coursera 与 insitro。

title_en: Peptide-Spectra Matching from Weak Supervision
title_zh: Peptide-Spectra Matching from Weak Supervision
summary_en: Uses weak supervision to match peptides to mass spectra without large labelled ground-truth datasets; she is senior author on the Google Brain and Calico collaboration.
summary_zh: 用弱监督实现肽段与质谱的匹配，无需大规模标注真值数据；她是这项 Google Brain 与 Calico 合作研究的资深作者。

title_en: Inferring Multidimensional Rates of Aging from Cross-Sectional Data
title_zh: Inferring Multidimensional Rates of Aging from Cross-Sectional Data
summary_en: Method for inferring individual multidimensional rates of aging from cross-sectional data, co-authored with Pierson, Koh, Leskovec and Liang.
summary_zh: 提出从横截面数据推断个体多维衰老速率的方法，与 Pierson、Koh、Leskovec 和 Liang 合著。

source: Stories by Daphne Koller on Medium
title_en: insitro: Rethinking drug discovery using machine learning
title_zh: insitro: Rethinking drug discovery using machine learning
summary_en: Daphne Koller's own Medium post laid out insitro's founding thesis: using machine learning to rethink drug discovery.
summary_zh: Daphne Koller在其Medium博客中阐述了insitro的创立理念：用机器学习重新构想药物研发。

title_zh: Excited to join Calico and apply machine learning to improving human health https://t.co/XtBlHEVqyW. Come help build our world-class team!
summary_en: Koller announced she was joining Calico to apply machine learning to human health research.
summary_zh: Koller宣布加入Calico,将机器学习应用于人类健康研究。

title_en: Thrilled to work w/ @IllinoisCS to launch a top-ranked master's degree in data science offered entirely on Coursera! https://t.co/dE01XjnPaX
title_zh: Thrilled to work w/ @IllinoisCS to launch a top-ranked master's degree in data science offered entirely on Coursera! https://t.co/dE01XjnPaX
summary_en: Koller launched a top-ranked online master's degree in data science with the University of Illinois, delivered entirely through Coursera.
summary_zh: Koller与伊利诺伊大学合作,通过Coursera推出一个排名靠前的在线数据科学硕士学位项目。

title_en: Tuned Models of Peer Assessment in MOOCs
title_zh: Tuned Models of Peer Assessment in MOOCs
summary_en: Models that make peer grading more accurate at MOOC scale, from her Coursera-era work with Chris Piech and Andrew Ng.
summary_zh: 提出在 MOOC 规模下提升同伴评分准确度的模型，来自她 Coursera 时期与 Chris Piech、吴恩达的合作。

title_en: Probability Estimation in Face of Irrelevant Information
title_zh: Probability Estimation in Face of Irrelevant Information
summary_en: Early work with Adam Grove on how a decision-theoretic agent should estimate probabilities when much of what it observes is irrelevant.
summary_zh: 与 Adam Grove 合作的早期工作，研究决策论智能体在观测中大量信息无关时应如何估计概率。

title_en: Generating New Beliefs From Old
title_zh: Generating New Beliefs From Old
summary_en: Continues the random-worlds line of work on deriving degrees of belief from a knowledge base as new information arrives.
summary_zh: 延续「随机世界」方法的研究，探讨在获得新信息时如何从知识库导出信念度。

title_en: Stochastic Simulation Algorithms for Dynamic Probabilistic Networks
title_zh: Stochastic Simulation Algorithms for Dynamic Probabilistic Networks
summary_en: Stochastic sampling algorithms for approximate posterior inference in dynamic probabilistic networks.
summary_zh: 提出用于动态概率网络近似后验推断的随机采样算法。

title_en: Context-Specific Independence in Bayesian Networks
title_zh: Context-Specific Independence in Bayesian Networks
summary_en: Introduces context-specific independence, a finer-grained notion of independence that yields more compact Bayesian networks and faster inference.
summary_zh: 提出「上下文特定独立性」，一种更细粒度的独立性概念，可获得更紧凑的贝叶斯网络与更快的推断。

title_en: Nonuniform Dynamic Discretization in Hybrid Networks
title_zh: Nonuniform Dynamic Discretization in Hybrid Networks
summary_en: Revisits variable discretization for inference in hybrid networks that mix continuous and discrete variables in arbitrary topologies.
summary_zh: 重新审视混合网络中的变量离散化问题，这类网络在任意拓扑下同时包含连续与离散变量。

title_en: Object-Oriented Bayesian Networks
title_zh: Object-Oriented Bayesian Networks
summary_en: Introduces object-oriented Bayesian networks, letting large domains be assembled from reusable model components.
summary_zh: 提出面向对象贝叶斯网络，使大型领域模型可以由可复用的组件搭建。

title_en: Update Rules for Parameter Estimation in Bayesian Networks
title_zh: Update Rules for Parameter Estimation in Bayesian Networks
summary_en: Recasts parameter estimation in Bayesian networks with missing values and hidden variables using online-learning update rules.
summary_zh: 借助在线学习的更新规则，重新表述含缺失值与隐变量的贝叶斯网络参数估计问题。

title_en: Tractable Inference for Complex Stochastic Processes
title_zh: Tractable Inference for Complex Stochastic Processes
summary_en: Shows that approximation error stays bounded over time when monitoring a stochastic process, the contraction result that makes practical filtering in dynamic Bayesian networks possible.
summary_zh: 证明在监测随机过程时近似误差随时间保持有界，这一收缩性结果使动态贝叶斯网络的实用滤波成为可能。

title_en: SPOOK: A System for Probabilistic Object-Oriented Knowledge Representation
title_zh: SPOOK: A System for Probabilistic Object-Oriented Knowledge Representation
summary_en: SPOOK, a working system for probabilistic object-oriented knowledge representation built on her object-oriented Bayesian network language.
summary_zh: SPOOK，一个基于她的面向对象贝叶斯网络语言构建的概率式面向对象知识表示系统。

title_en: A General Algorithm for Approximate Inference and its Application to Hybrid Bayes Nets
title_zh: A General Algorithm for Approximate Inference and its Application to Hybrid Bayes Nets
summary_en: Generalises the clique tree algorithm so approximate inference also works in hybrid Bayesian networks.
summary_zh: 推广团树算法，使近似推断同样适用于混合贝叶斯网络。

title_en: Discovering the Hidden Structure of Complex Dynamic Systems
title_zh: Discovering the Hidden Structure of Complex Dynamic Systems
summary_en: Learns the structure of dynamic Bayesian networks, hidden variables included, for complex systems where no expert model exists.
summary_zh: 在没有专家模型可用的复杂系统中，学习包含隐变量的动态贝叶斯网络结构。

title_en: Probabilistic Models for Agents' Beliefs and Decisions
title_zh: Probabilistic Models for Agents' Beliefs and Decisions
summary_en: A probabilistic framework for reasoning about the beliefs and decisions of other agents, including their beliefs about each other.
summary_zh: 提出一个概率框架，用于推理其他智能体的信念与决策，包括它们彼此之间的信念。

title_en: Policy Iteration for Factored MDPs
title_zh: Policy Iteration for Factored MDPs
summary_en: Policy iteration that exploits factored structure to solve very large MDPs represented as dynamic Bayesian networks.
summary_zh: 利用因子化结构的策略迭代方法，用以求解以动态贝叶斯网络表示的超大规模 MDP。

title_en: Being Bayesian about Network Structure
title_zh: Being Bayesian about Network Structure
summary_en: With Nir Friedman, reasons over the full posterior across network structures instead of selecting a single model, giving better answers about which variable causes which.
summary_zh: 与 Nir Friedman 合作，在网络结构的完整后验上进行推理而非只选择单一模型，从而更好地判断变量之间的依赖关系。

title_en: Utilities as Random Variables: Density Estimation and Structure Discovery
title_zh: Utilities as Random Variables: Density Estimation and Structure Discovery
summary_en: Treats a person's utility as a random variable like any other domain attribute, enabling density estimation and structure discovery over utility functions.
summary_zh: 把个人效用视为与其他领域属性一样的随机变量，从而可以对效用函数做密度估计与结构发现。

title_en: Exact Inference in Networks with Discrete Children of Continuous Parents
title_zh: Exact Inference in Networks with Discrete Children of Continuous Parents
summary_en: Early graphical-models paper on exact inference in hybrid Bayesian networks with discrete children of continuous parents.
summary_zh: 她在概率图模型方向的早期论文，研究连续父节点带离散子节点的混合贝叶斯网络中的精确推断。

title_en: Discriminative Probabilistic Models for Relational Data
title_zh: Discriminative Probabilistic Models for Relational Data
summary_en: Relational Markov networks: discriminative models for labelling entities whose labels depend on one another, with Ben Taskar and Pieter Abbeel.
summary_zh: 关系马尔可夫网络：与 Ben Taskar、Pieter Abbeel 合作，为标签相互依赖的实体提出判别式标注模型。

title_en: Continuous Time Bayesian Networks
title_zh: Continuous Time Bayesian Networks
summary_en: Introduces continuous time Bayesian networks, a language for structured stochastic processes that evolve in continuous rather than discrete time.
summary_zh: 提出连续时间贝叶斯网络，一种描述在连续时间而非离散时间上演化的结构化随机过程的语言。

title_en: Monitoring a Complez Physical System using a Hybrid Dynamic Bayes Net
title_zh: Monitoring a Complez Physical System using a Hybrid Dynamic Bayes Net
summary_en: Applies a hybrid dynamic Bayesian network to unsupervised fault monitoring of a system designed to produce oxygen from the Martian atmosphere.
summary_zh: 将混合动态贝叶斯网络用于无人监督的故障监测，对象是一套从火星大气中制取氧气的系统。

title_en: Learning Hierarchical Object Maps Of Non-Stationary Environments with mobile robots
title_zh: Learning Hierarchical Object Maps Of Non-Stationary Environments with mobile robots
summary_en: Robot mapping that represents non-stationary environments as hierarchies of objects rather than static unstructured maps.
summary_zh: 机器人建图方法，将非静态环境表示为对象的层次结构，而非静态的无结构地图。

title_en: Learning Module Networks
title_zh: Learning Module Networks
summary_en: Module networks share parameters across related variables so structure can be learned from few samples, applied to gene expression data.
summary_zh: 模块网络在相关变量间共享参数，使得少量样本也能学出结构，并应用于基因表达数据。

title_en: insitro acquires CombinAbleAI and launches the TherML platform
title_zh: insitro 收购 CombinAbleAI 并发布 TherML 平台
summary_en: An end-to-end, modality-agnostic system for designing small molecules, antibodies, oligonucleotides and other complex biologics. First development candidate CTRO-1013 nominated, CMC initiated, first-in-human trial design finalised, clinic targeted for 2026.
summary_zh: 端到端、模态无关的系统，可设计小分子、抗体、寡核苷酸等复杂生物制剂。首个候选药 CTRO-1013 已提名，CMC 启动，首次人体试验设计定稿，目标 2026 年进入临床。

title_en: A Collectivist, Economic Perspective on AI
title_zh: 关于 AI 的集体主义经济学视角
summary_en: Position paper arguing AI should be designed around markets and collectives rather than individual intelligence.
summary_zh: 立场论文，主张 AI 应围绕市场与集体、而非个体智能来设计。

title_en: Artificial Intelligence — the revolution hasn't happened yet
title_zh: 人工智能 —— 革命尚未发生

title_en: A Collectivist, Economic Vision for AI
title_zh: A Collectivist, Economic Vision for AI
summary_en: Jordan's CACM piece argues for a collectivist, economic vision of AI systems design, drawing on markets and mechanism design rather than treating social consequences as an afterthought.
summary_zh: Jordan在《ACM通讯》上撰文，主张以集体主义、经济学的视角设计AI系统，借鉴市场与机制设计，而非将社会影响视为附带问题。

source: Journal of the American Statistical As…
title_en: Principal-Agent Hypothesis Testing
title_zh: Principal-Agent Hypothesis Testing
summary_en: With Bates, Sklar and Soloff, Jordan formalizes a principal-agent model of hypothesis testing, showing how the statistical standard set by a regulator shapes a strategic agent's incentives.
summary_zh: Jordan与Bates、Sklar、Soloff合作，将假设检验建模为委托-代理问题，说明监管者设定的统计标准如何影响策略性主体的激励。

title_en: Beyond Optimal Rates in Stochastic Optimization: Trajectory-Adaptive Stopping Rules
title_zh: Beyond Optimal Rates in Stochastic Optimization: Trajectory-Adaptive Stopping Rules
summary_en: Trajectory-adaptive stopping rules for stochastic optimization, replacing the usual fixed horizon chosen before the algorithm runs; author list confirmed with Liviu Aolaritei and Francis Bach.
summary_zh: 为随机优化提出依轨迹自适应的停止规则，取代算法运行前预先设定的固定时域；作者名单确认包含 Liviu Aolaritei 与 Francis Bach。

title_en: Post-Training at the Edge of Detectability: A Game-Theoretic Approach to Fine-Tuning
title_zh: Post-Training at the Edge of Detectability: A Game-Theoretic Approach to Fine-Tuning
summary_en: A game-theoretic account of RL fine-tuning that asks how far a post-trained policy can drift from its reference before the change becomes statistically detectable; author list confirmed with Keegan Harris and Nika Haghtalab.
summary_zh: 用博弈论刻画强化学习微调，讨论后训练策略在多大程度上偏离参考策略仍难以被统计检测；作者名单确认包含 Keegan Harris 与 Nika Haghtalab。

title_en: Towards Optimal Estimators for Randomized Control Trials
title_zh: Towards Optimal Estimators for Randomized Control Trials
summary_en: Derives estimators for randomized controlled trials that improve on the standard difference-in-means, joint work with Harsh Parikh, Nilesh Tripuraneni and collaborators in industry and academia.
summary_zh: 推导优于标准均值差估计量的随机对照试验估计方法，与 Harsh Parikh、Nilesh Tripuraneni 等业界与学界合作者共同完成。

title_en: Provably Optimal Learning Algorithms for Assistance Games
title_zh: Provably Optimal Learning Algorithms for Assistance Games
summary_en: Gives provably optimal learning algorithms for online assistance games, in which an informed and an uninformed agent repeatedly interact to maximise a shared reward; co-authored with Stuart Russell and Nika Haghtalab.
summary_zh: 为在线辅助博弈（知情方与不知情方反复互动以最大化共同奖励）给出可证明最优的学习算法，与 Stuart Russell、Nika Haghtalab 合著。

title_en: Blackwell Approachability and Gradient Equilibrium are Equivalent
title_zh: Blackwell Approachability and Gradient Equilibrium are Equivalent
summary_en: Proves that Blackwell approachability and the recently introduced gradient-equilibrium framework are equivalent, with Ryan J. Tibshirani and Nika Haghtalab.
summary_zh: 与 Ryan J. Tibshirani、Nika Haghtalab 合作证明 Blackwell 可接近性与新近提出的梯度均衡框架是等价的。

title_en: Strategic Feature Selection
title_zh: Strategic Feature Selection
summary_en: Studies how a predictor should choose its features when the inputs can be strategically manipulated in high-stakes settings such as healthcare resource allocation.
summary_zh: 研究在医疗资源分配等高风险场景中输入特征可能被策略性操纵时，预测模型应如何选择特征。

title_en: Towards Accurate Model Selection in Deep Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
title_zh: Towards Accurate Model Selection in Deep Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
summary_en: Model-selection methods for deep unsupervised domain adaptation, continuing his long-running collaboration with Mingsheng Long's group at Tsinghua.
summary_zh: 面向深度无监督域适应的模型选择方法，延续他与清华大学龙明盛团队的长期合作。

title_en: Diffusion-Robust Optimization over Graphs
title_zh: Diffusion-Robust Optimization over Graphs
summary_en: Introduces a robust-optimization model for directed graphs in which edge-weight perturbations diffuse along adjacent edges, with Liviu Aolaritei and Paul Grigas.
summary_zh: 与 Liviu Aolaritei、Paul Grigas 提出有向图上的鲁棒优化模型，其中边权扰动会沿相邻边扩散传播。

title_en: CalArena: A Large-Scale Post-Hoc Calibration Benchmark
title_zh: CalArena: A Large-Scale Post-Hoc Calibration Benchmark
summary_en: A large-scale benchmark for post-hoc calibration methods, built with Francis Bach and his Inria colleagues.
summary_zh: 与 Francis Bach 及 Inria 同事共同构建的大规模事后校准方法基准。

title_en: Intelligence is collective, not artificial — Prof. Michael I. Jordan (UC Berkeley / Inria)
title_zh: Intelligence is collective, not artificial — Prof. Michael I. Jordan (UC Berkeley / Inria)
summary_en: Long-form interview in which Jordan argues intelligence should be understood as collective and economic rather than as an artificial individual mind.
summary_zh: 长篇访谈，Jordan 主张应把智能理解为集体性和经济性的现象，而非人造的个体心智。

title_en: Response Time Enhances Alignment with Heterogeneous Preferences
title_zh: Response Time Enhances Alignment with Heterogeneous Preferences
summary_en: Uses labeller response time as a signal for aligning language models to heterogeneous rather than pooled human preferences, with Federico Echenique and Alireza Fallah.
summary_zh: 与 Federico Echenique、Alireza Fallah 合作，利用标注者的反应时间作为信号，使语言模型对齐异质而非汇总后的人类偏好。

title_en: Super-Level-Set Regression: Conditional Quantiles via Volume Minimization
title_zh: Super-Level-Set Regression: Conditional Quantiles via Volume Minimization
summary_en: Constructs minimum-volume conditional prediction regions without estimating the full conditional distribution, with Sacha Braun and Francis Bach.
summary_zh: 与 Sacha Braun、Francis Bach 提出无需估计完整条件分布即可构造最小体积条件预测区域的方法。

title_en: Explaining and Preventing Alignment Collapse in Iterative RLHF
title_zh: Explaining and Preventing Alignment Collapse in Iterative RLHF
summary_en: Explains why iterative RLHF collapses once the reward model is retrained on data the policy itself generated, and proposes a remedy; with Etienne Gauthier and Francis Bach.
summary_zh: 与 Etienne Gauthier、Francis Bach 分析迭代式 RLHF 在奖励模型使用策略自身生成的数据重训时为何会崩溃，并提出缓解方案。

source: HAL (Le Centre pour la Communication S…
title_en: UniGuide: Learning Guidance Policies for Multi-Objective Diffusion Sampling
title_zh: UniGuide: Learning Guidance Policies for Multi-Objective Diffusion Sampling
summary_en: Co-authored 'UniGuide,' a paper on learning guidance policies for multi-objective diffusion sampling, published via HAL/Inria.
summary_zh: 合著论文《UniGuide》，研究面向多目标扩散采样的引导策略学习，发表于HAL/Inria平台。

source: Machine Learning: How Did We Get Here?
title_en: Machine Learning Meets Statistics with Michael I. Jordan
title_zh: Machine Learning Meets Statistics with Michael I. Jordan
summary_en: A long-form interview on Tom Mitchell's history-of-machine-learning podcast in which Jordan traces his path from control theory and statistics toward economics.
summary_zh: 在 Tom Mitchell 主持的机器学习史播客中的长篇访谈，Jordan 回顾了他从控制论、统计学一路走向经济学的研究轨迹。

title_en: Calibeating Made Simple
title_zh: Calibeating Made Simple
summary_en: Simplifies the analysis of calibeating — online post-processing of external forecasts to beat an informativeness benchmark — with Yurong Chen, Zhiyi Huang and Haipeng Luo.
summary_zh: 与 Yurong Chen、Zhiyi Huang、Haipeng Luo 合作，简化了 calibeating（在线后处理外部预测以超越信息量基准）的分析。

title_en: Multi-Armed Sequential Hypothesis Testing by Betting
title_zh: Multi-Armed Sequential Hypothesis Testing by Betting
summary_en: Extends sequential testing by betting to a multi-armed setting where the statistician chooses which data source to draw from at each step, with Ian Waudby-Smith.
summary_zh: 与 Ian Waudby-Smith 将“下注式”序贯检验推广到多臂设置，统计学家在每一步可选择从哪个数据源取样。

title_en: Post-Hoc Large-Sample Statistical Inference
title_zh: Post-Hoc Large-Sample Statistical Inference
summary_en: Large-sample inference procedures that remain valid when the significance level is chosen after looking at the data, with Aaditya Ramdas, Ben Chugg and Ian Waudby-Smith.
summary_zh: 与 Aaditya Ramdas、Ben Chugg、Ian Waudby-Smith 提出在显著性水平于看过数据之后才选定时仍然有效的大样本推断方法。

title_en: A Variational Estimator for $L_p$ Calibration Errors
title_zh: A Variational Estimator for $L_p$ Calibration Errors
summary_en: Proposes a variational estimator for L_p calibration error, part of his ongoing calibration work with Francis Bach's group at Inria.
summary_zh: 提出 L_p 校准误差的变分估计量，属于他与 Inria 的 Francis Bach 团队持续开展的校准研究。

title_en: Towards Anytime-Valid Statistical Watermarking
title_zh: Towards Anytime-Valid Statistical Watermarking
summary_en: Brings anytime-valid sequential testing to the statistical watermarking of LLM output, with Kannan Ramchandran and Jiantao Jiao.
summary_zh: 与 Kannan Ramchandran、Jiantao Jiao 合作，将随时有效的序贯检验引入大语言模型输出的统计水印检测。

title_en: Signaling in Data Markets via Free Samples
title_zh: Signaling in Data Markets via Free Samples
summary_en: Models how sellers in a data market can signal privately known data quality through free samples, with Alireza Fallah and Nivasini Ananthakrishnan.
summary_zh: 与 Alireza Fallah、Nivasini Ananthakrishnan 建模数据市场中卖方如何通过免费样本传递其私有的数据质量信息。

title_en: Locally Adaptive Multi-Objective Learning
title_zh: Locally Adaptive Multi-Objective Learning
summary_en: A general framework for learning a single predictor that satisfies several objectives at once, including calibration, with Isaac Gibbs and Jivat Neet Kaur.
summary_zh: 与 Isaac Gibbs、Jivat Neet Kaur 提出一个通用框架，用于学习同时满足包括校准在内的多个目标的单一预测器。

title_en: How Sampling Shapes LLM Alignment: From One-Shot Optima to Iterative Dynamics
title_zh: How Sampling Shapes LLM Alignment: From One-Shot Optima to Iterative Dynamics
summary_en: Analyses how the sampling of candidate responses shapes LLM alignment, from one-shot optima through to the dynamics of iterated training.
summary_zh: 分析候选回复的采样方式如何影响大语言模型的对齐效果，从单轮最优一直讨论到迭代训练的动力学。

title_en: Dynamic Programming for Epistemic Uncertainty in Markov Decision Processes
title_zh: Dynamic Programming for Epistemic Uncertainty in Markov Decision Processes
summary_en: A general theory of ambiguity-averse Markov decision processes that treats uncertain transition probabilities as random variables and evaluates policies through a risk measure.
summary_zh: 提出模糊厌恶型马尔可夫决策过程的一般理论，将不确定的转移概率视为随机变量，并用风险度量来评估策略。

title_en: On Nonasymptotic Confidence Intervals for Treatment Effects in Randomized Experiments
title_zh: On Nonasymptotic Confidence Intervals for Treatment Effects in Randomized Experiments
summary_en: Sharpens the effective sample size needed for nonasymptotic confidence intervals on treatment effects in randomized experiments, with Sivaraman Balakrishnan and Avi Feller.
summary_zh: 与 Sivaraman Balakrishnan、Avi Feller 合作，改进随机实验中处理效应非渐近置信区间所需的有效样本量。

title_en: Anytime Detection of Strategic Deviations in Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: Anytime Detection of Strategic Deviations in Multi-Agent Systems
summary_en: Gives an anytime-valid test for detecting when agents in a multi-agent system drift away from stable rational behaviour, with Etienne Gauthier and Francis Bach.
summary_zh: 与 Etienne Gauthier、Francis Bach 提出随时有效的检验方法，用于发现多智能体系统中个体何时偏离稳定的理性行为。

title_en: Stopping Rules for Stochastic Gradient Descent via Anytime-Valid Confidence Sequences
title_zh: Stopping Rules for Stochastic Gradient Descent via Anytime-Valid Confidence Sequences
summary_en: Uses anytime-valid confidence sequences to decide when to stop stochastic gradient descent from the observed trajectory alone, with Liviu Aolaritei.
summary_zh: 与 Liviu Aolaritei 合作，用随时有效的置信序列仅凭观测到的轨迹来判断随机梯度下降何时应当停止。

title_en: Conditional Coverage Diagnostics for Conformal Prediction
title_zh: Conditional Coverage Diagnostics for Conformal Prediction
summary_en: Diagnostics for assessing conditional coverage in conformal prediction, where standard methods guarantee only marginal coverage; with Sacha Braun and Francis Bach.
summary_zh: 与 Sacha Braun、Francis Bach 提出评估共形预测条件覆盖率的诊断方法，而标准方法只能保证边缘覆盖率。

title_en: #74 – Michael I. Jordan: Machine Learning, Recommender Systems, and the Future of AI
title_zh: #74 – Michael I. Jordan: Machine Learning, Recommender Systems, and the Future of AI
summary_en: His 2020 Lex Fridman Podcast appearance, a widely referenced long-form conversation on machine learning, recommender systems and where AI is heading.
summary_zh: 他 2020 年在 Lex Fridman 播客上的访谈，是一次被广泛引用的长篇对话，讨论机器学习、推荐系统以及人工智能的走向。

title_en: Heads Inria's new five-year 'Markets and Machine Learning' chair
title_zh: 领衔 Inria 新设五年期「Markets and Machine Learning」讲席
summary_en: Bringing economics and machine learning together.
summary_zh: 将经济学与机器学习结合。

title_en: Elected foreign member of the Chinese Academy of Sciences
title_zh: 当选中国科学院外籍院士
summary_en: Also elected to Italy's Accademia di Ingegneria e Tecnologia.
summary_zh: 同时当选意大利工程与技术学院院士。

title_en: Beware of 'looks right': three hard thresholds AI must cross to enter medicine
title_zh: 警惕「看似对」：AI 进入医疗必须跨越的三道刚性门槛
summary_en: Argues general models cannot meet clinical requirements — only medically augmented models can.
summary_zh: 主张通用模型达不到临床要求，只有医疗增强大模型可以。

title_en: Vol.29 对话王小川：造医生，战豆包，与无尽的 AI 非共识。
title_zh: Vol.29 对话王小川：造医生，战豆包，与无尽的 AI 非共识。
summary_en: In an interview on 硅基立场, Wang Xiaochuan argued AI healthcare's end goal is a genuinely independent AI doctor, not just an efficiency tool, and defended Baichuan's contrarian focus on medical models over the industry's rush into general models and coding.
summary_zh: 在“硅基立场”节目专访中，王小川提出AI医疗的终极方向是打造真正独立的AI医生，而非单纯的效率工具，并阐释百川智能为何在行业扎堆通用模型与代码赛道时坚持医疗这一非共识路线。

title_en: Vol.95｜对话王小川：专注 AI 医疗后，我的内心越来越平静
title_zh: Vol.95｜对话王小川：专注 AI 医疗后，我的内心越来越平静
summary_en: Wang Xiaochuan reflected on a year focused entirely on AI medicine at Baichuan, saying the narrower bet has left him calmer even as skepticism about AI healthcare persists.
summary_zh: 王小川在专访中回顾了百川智能全力聚焦AI医疗的一年，表示尽管外界对AI医疗仍有质疑，但这一更聚焦的选择让他内心愈发平静。

title_en: Vol10 对话赫拉利x王小川：人类如何与AI共存？
title_zh: Vol10 对话赫拉利x王小川：人类如何与AI共存？
summary_en: Wang Xiaochuan joined historian Yuval Noah Harari for a conversation on how humans and AI can coexist.
summary_zh: 王小川与历史学家尤瓦尔·赫拉利对谈，探讨人类如何与AI共存。

title_en: 与王小川聊AI✖️医疗：通向“生命科学的数学原理”
title_zh: 与王小川聊AI✖️医疗：通向“生命科学的数学原理”
summary_en: In this LateTalk interview, Wang Xiaochuan discusses Baichuan's pivot to AI-driven medicine, calling it a search for 'the mathematical principles of life,' shortly after the company shipped its Baichuan-M1-Preview reasoning model.
summary_zh: 在这期《晚点聊》访谈中，王小川谈到百川转向AI医疗方向，称之为寻找“生命科学的数学原理”，此前不久公司刚发布了推理模型Baichuan-M1-Preview。

title_en: Vol.35｜对话王小川：AI 医疗，代表了 AGI 之后更大的世界
title_zh: Vol.35｜对话王小川：AI 医疗，代表了 AGI 之后更大的世界
summary_en: Wang discussed Baichuan's pivot into AI medicine and why he sees it as a bigger opportunity than general AGI, in a LinkStart interview.
summary_zh: 王小川在"开始连接 LinkStart"访谈中谈及百川智能转向AI医疗的战略，并阐述了他认为这比通用AGI蕴含更大机会的原因。

title_en: 76. 王小川返场谈o1与强化学习：摸到了一条从快思考走向慢思考的路
title_zh: 76. 王小川返场谈o1与强化学习：摸到了一条从快思考走向慢思考的路
summary_en: Wang Xiaochuan returned to 张小珺Jùn's interview series to discuss OpenAI's o1 and reinforcement learning, describing it as a path from 'fast thinking' toward 'slow thinking' in AI.
summary_zh: 王小川在张小珺Jùn的访谈节目中再次做客，谈OpenAI o1与强化学习，称这标志着AI从“快思考”走向“慢思考”的路径。

title_en: 61. 和王小川聊再创业这一年：回应朱啸虎与中国AGI第三种可能
title_zh: 61. 和王小川聊再创业这一年：回应朱啸虎与中国AGI第三种可能
summary_en: In this interview, Wang Xiaochuan responded to investor Zhu Xiaohu's public skepticism about Baichuan and laid out what he called a third possible path for China's pursuit of AGI, beyond pure idealism or pure market pragmatism.
summary_zh: 在此次访谈中，王小川回应了投资人朱啸虎对百川智能的公开质疑，提出了中国追求AGI的“第三种可能”，介于理想主义与市场现实主义之间。

title_en: Vol.10 百川智能王小川：大模型创业100天的思考
title_zh: Vol.10 百川智能王小川：大模型创业100天的思考
summary_en: Wang Xiaochuan reflected on Baichuan's first 100 days as a large-model startup in this interview, shortly after releasing the open Baichuan-7B and Baichuan-13B models.
summary_zh: 在这次专访中，王小川回顾了百川智能作为大模型创业公司的头100天，彼时公司刚发布开源的Baichuan-7B与Baichuan-13B模型。

title_en: S3E04｜对话王小川：通用人工智能是一次文艺复兴
title_zh: S3E04｜对话王小川：通用人工智能是一次文艺复兴
summary_en: Wang Xiaochuan discussed why he came out of his post-Sogou stint in life sciences to found Baichuan, calling the arrival of general AI 'a renaissance.'
summary_zh: 王小川在专访中谈及为何结束在生命科学领域的探索期、重新出山创立百川智能，称通用人工智能的到来是“一次文艺复兴”。

title_en: 艾问·王小川：搜狗熬到上市，不服李彦宏的王小川能挑战百度吗？
title_zh: 艾问·王小川：搜狗熬到上市，不服李彦宏的王小川能挑战百度吗？
summary_en: In this 2017 interview, then-Sogou CEO Wang Xiaochuan discussed Sogou's long road to its IPO and whether the company could challenge Baidu.
summary_zh: 在这次2017年的专访中，时任搜狗CEO的王小川谈及搜狗艰难上市的历程，以及公司能否挑战百度。

title_en: 王小川-中国互联网创业的机会在哪里
title_zh: 王小川-中国互联网创业的机会在哪里
summary_en: A recorded talk by Wang Xiaochuan on where China's internet entrepreneurship opportunities lie, from his time leading Sogou.
summary_zh: 王小川关于中国互联网创业机会的一次演讲录音，来自他执掌搜狗时期。

title_en: Baichuan-M4 and AI family doctor '百小医' launched
title_zh: 发布 Baichuan-M4 与 AI 家庭医生「百小医」
summary_en: Ranks first simultaneously on HealthBench, HealthBench Hard and HealthBench Professional, ahead of GPT-5.5, Opus 4.7 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro; factual hallucination rate down to 3.3%. Joint clinical research underway with Beijing Children's Hospital, CAMS Cancer Hospital and Ruijin Hospital.
summary_zh: 在 HealthBench、HealthBench Hard 与 HealthBench Professional 三项同时登顶，超越 GPT-5.5、Opus 4.7 与 DeepSeek-V4-Pro；事实性幻觉率降至 3.3%。已与北京儿童医院、中国医学科学院肿瘤医院、瑞金医院开展联合临床研究。

title_en: ~RMB 3B cash on hand; IPO targeted for 2027
title_zh: 手握约 30 亿元现金，目标 2027 年 IPO

title_en: 王小川引入原搜狗负责人董璐为合伙人，老团队集结杀入AI赛道
title_zh: 王小川引入原搜狗负责人董璐为合伙人，老团队集结杀入AI赛道
summary_en: Wang brought in former Sogou executive Dong Lu as a partner at Baichuan, regrouping his old Sogou team as the company pushes further into AI.
summary_zh: 王小川引入原搜狗高管董璐担任合伙人，让老搜狗团队重新集结，助力百川进一步发力AI领域。

title_en: 王小川引入新合伙人，前搜狗市场负责人董璐加盟
title_zh: 王小川引入新合伙人，前搜狗市场负责人董璐加盟
summary_en: Wang Xiaochuan brought on a new partner at Baichuan: Dong Lu, former head of marketing at Sogou.
summary_zh: 王小川为百川智能引入新合伙人——前搜狗市场负责人董璐加盟。

title_en: 王小川引入新合伙人，前搜狗市场负责人董璐加盟
title_zh: 王小川引入新合伙人，前搜狗市场负责人董璐加盟
summary_en: Wang Xiaochuan brought on Dong Lu, Sogou's former head of marketing, as a new partner at Baichuan.
summary_zh: 王小川引入前搜狗市场负责人董璐作为百川智能的新合伙人。

title_en: AI医生还未落地，联合创始人先走完了，百川智能只剩王小川
title_zh: AI医生还未落地，联合创始人先走完了，百川智能只剩王小川
summary_en: Report that Baichuan's other co-founders have all departed, leaving Wang Xiaochuan as the company's sole remaining founder even as its AI-doctor product has yet to ship.
summary_zh: 报道称百川智能的其他联合创始人已相继离职，如今只剩王小川一人，而其AI医生产品尚未落地。

title_en: 最后一个联合创始人离开，王小川身后空无一人
title_zh: 最后一个联合创始人离开，王小川身后空无一人

summary_zh: 百川智能最后一位联合创始人离职，创始团队只剩王小川一人。

title_en: 百川智能联创全员出走，王小川孤军奋战
title_zh: 百川智能联创全员出走，王小川孤军奋战
summary_en: Baichuan Intelligence's co-founders have all left the company, leaving Wang Xiaochuan as the only founder still running it.
summary_zh: 百川智能的联合创始人已全部离职，只剩王小川一人独自执掌公司。

title_en: 百川智能联创全员出走，王小川孤军奋战
title_zh: 百川智能联创全员出走，王小川孤军奋战
summary_en: All of Baichuan's co-founders have departed, leaving Wang Xiaochuan to run the company alone — a major shakeup at the top of the firm.
summary_zh: 百川智能的联合创始人已全部离职，王小川独自支撑公司运营，公司高层发生重大变动。

title_en: 王小川：医疗行业对大模型有三大刚性要求，但通用模型一条都不达标
title_zh: 王小川：医疗行业对大模型有三大刚性要求，但通用模型一条都不达标
summary_en: Wang Xiaochuan argues that healthcare places three hard requirements on large models that no general-purpose model currently meets, the reasoning behind Baichuan's pivot to medicine.
summary_zh: 王小川提出医疗行业对大模型有三大刚性要求，而通用模型一条都不达标，这正是百川智能转向医疗的理由。

title_en: 王小川隔空回应张文宏：医生成长不能以患者为成本
title_zh: 王小川隔空回应张文宏：医生成长不能以患者为成本
summary_en: Wang publicly responded to physician Zhang Wenhong, arguing doctors' growth should not come at patients' expense — a stance tied to Baichuan's medical AI focus.
summary_zh: 王小川公开回应医生张文宏，认为医生的成长不应以患者为代价，这一立场与百川专注医疗AI的方向相关。

title_en: 张文宏拒绝将AI引入病历系统，王小川回应：医生成长不能以患者为成本，一些场景AI+医生已经优于单个医生。#一财情报局
title_zh: 张文宏拒绝将AI引入病历系统，王小川回应：医生成长不能以患者为成本，一些场景AI+医生已经优于单个医生。#一财情报局
summary_en: Responding to a doctor's rejection of AI in medical records, Wang Xiaochuan argued that in some scenarios AI-plus-doctor already outperforms a solo doctor, defending Baichuan's medical-AI focus.
summary_zh: 针对某医生拒绝将AI引入病历系统的说法,王小川回应称在部分场景下AI+医生已优于单个医生,为百川的医疗AI方向辩护。

title_en: 从AI六小虎，到被误解的逃兵，王小川带领百川智能回牌桌？
title_zh: 从AI六小虎，到被误解的逃兵，王小川带领百川智能回牌桌？
summary_en: A profile examines whether Wang Xiaochuan is steering Baichuan back into serious AI competition after the company was written off as a straggler among China's 'AI six tigers'.
summary_zh: 一篇报道分析王小川能否带领曾被视为“AI六小虎”掉队者的百川智能重返竞争牌桌。

title_en: 王小川押注严肃医疗，AI能比普通医生强吗？

title_en: Raven: High-Recall Sequence Modeling with Sparse Memory Routing
title_zh: Raven: High-Recall Sequence Modeling with Sparse Memory Routing
summary_en: Sequence model that routes writes into sparse memory slots to improve long-context recall; Gu is senior author.
summary_zh: 通过把写入路由到稀疏记忆槽来提升长上下文召回的序列模型，Gu 为通讯作者。

title_en: Evaluations are difficult and vague for all generative models, and benchmarks only capture a small slice. Our blog post dives into the nuances for TTS
title_zh: Evaluations are difficult and vague for all generative models, and benchmarks only capture a small slice. Our blog post dives into the nuances for TTS

title_zh: Transformers are better at copying, while RNNs are better at modeling "meaning-bearing words—the nouns, verbs, & adjectives that say what a sentence is abou

summary_zh: 指出Transformer更擅长复制信息，而RNN类模型更擅长捕捉句子中承载语义的关键词。

summary_en: Proposed a more fine-grained approach to hybrid sequence models that mixes attention and linear layers within a single layer rather than interleaving them naively.
summary_zh: 提出一种更精细的混合序列模型设计思路，在单层内部混合注意力与线性层，而非简单地交替堆叠。

title_zh: a dynamical systems point of view, which looks like an SSM applied along the residual stream, informs more principled ways to scale looped architectures

summary_zh: 提出将SSM视为作用于残差流上的动力系统这一视角，可为扩展循环架构提供更有原则性的方法。

title_en: Raven Part-1 - Memory as a set of Slots
title_zh: Raven Part-1 - Memory as a set of Slots
summary_en: Goomba Lab post introducing Raven, a recurrent architecture that holds memory as a set of addressable slots instead of one fixed-size state.
summary_zh: Goomba Lab 博客，介绍 Raven 架构：将记忆表示为一组可寻址的槽位，而非单一固定大小的状态。

title_zh: Mamba-3 Part 1

title_zh: Mamba-3: Improved Sequence Modeling using State Space Principles

title_zh: immensely proud of the team for our best model yet. grateful to be able to work with such a strong team of researchers who are always curious and willing to exp
summary_en: Said Cartesia shipped its best model yet, crediting the research team's willingness to explore unconventional approaches.
summary_zh: 表示Cartesia推出了迄今最好的模型，并称赞研究团队勇于探索非常规方法。

title_en: at the tokenizer workshop panel at ICML, i made an offhand joke about eventually going to raw pixels being the way, i didn't press it too hard bc the pitchforks
title_zh: at the tokenizer workshop panel at ICML, i made an offhand joke about eventually going to raw pixels being the way, i didn't press it too hard bc the pitchforks
summary_en: Recounted a joke made at an ICML tokenizer workshop panel about eventually moving to raw pixels, amid the debate sparked by H-Net.
summary_zh: 回顾在ICML分词器研讨会panel上开的一个关于最终转向原始像素的玩笑，当时H-Net引发的争论正激烈。

title_en: I really like this research direction! For a long time, I've been talking about the "brain vs. database" analogy of SSMs vs Transformers. An extension of this t
title_zh: I really like this research direction! For a long time, I've been talking about the "brain vs. database" analogy of SSMs vs Transformers. An extension of this t
summary_en: Elaborated on his long-standing "brain vs. database" analogy for comparing SSMs and Transformers, extending it further.
summary_zh: 进一步阐述他一直以来用来比较SSM与Transformer的“大脑对数据库”类比。

title_en: Chimera: State Space Models Beyond Sequences
title_zh: Chimera: State Space Models Beyond Sequences
summary_en: Extends state-space models from sequences to images and graphs through structured mixers; Gu is senior author.
summary_zh: 通过结构化混合算子把状态空间模型从序列推广到图像与图数据，Gu 为通讯作者。

title_en: really glad to see so much effort being put into furthering understanding of H-Nets! the main caveat with these results is the scale: the blog's experiments go
title_zh: really glad to see so much effort being put into furthering understanding of H-Nets! the main caveat with these results is the scale: the blog's experiments go
summary_en: Welcomed efforts to better understand H-Nets but cautioned that the experiments only reach a scale about 1000x smaller than needed to be conclusive.
summary_zh: 欢迎深入理解H-Net的研究工作，但提醒相关实验规模比得出结论所需的规模小约1000倍。

title_en: Autoregressive Universal Video Segmentation Model
title_zh: Autoregressive Universal Video Segmentation Model
summary_en: NVIDIA collaboration applying autoregressive sequence modeling to unprompted video segmentation; Gu is a co-author.
summary_zh: 与 NVIDIA 合作，把自回归序列建模用于无提示的视频分割，Gu 为共同作者。

title_en: a common belief is that Transformers scale well because of less inductive bias, when it actually does have specific inductive biases. we developed H-Nets not to
title_zh: a common belief is that Transformers scale well because of less inductive bias, when it actually does have specific inductive biases. we developed H-Nets not to
summary_en: Argued Transformers do have specific inductive biases despite common belief otherwise, explaining H-Nets were developed for reasons beyond fixing tokenization.
summary_zh: 反驳普遍认为“Transformer几乎没有归纳偏置”的看法，并说明开发H-Net的初衷不仅是为了解决分词问题。

title_en: H-Nets - the Future
title_zh: H-Nets - the Future
summary_en: Argues that hierarchical networks learning their own chunking can replace fixed tokenisation in sequence models.
summary_zh: 论证让分层网络自行学习分块方式，可以取代序列模型中固定的分词步骤。

title_en: H-Nets - the Past
title_zh: H-Nets - the Past
summary_en: Companion post tracing the line of ideas that led to H-Nets, from earlier state-space and hierarchical models.
summary_zh: 配套文章，回溯从早期状态空间模型与分层模型一路通向 H-Nets 的思想脉络。

title_en: Dynamic Chunking for End-to-End Hierarchical Sequence Modeling
title_zh: Dynamic Chunking for End-to-End Hierarchical Sequence Modeling
summary_en: H-Net, which learns its own chunking end to end and removes the need for a tokenizer; Gu is senior author.
summary_zh: 提出 H-Net，端到端学习分块方式，从而不再需要分词器，Gu 为通讯作者。

title_en: On the Tradeoffs of SSMs and Transformers
title_zh: On the Tradeoffs of SSMs and Transformers
summary_en: His widely read essay on what state-space models and attention each buy you, and why he considers tokenisation a crutch.
summary_zh: 他流传甚广的一篇文章，剖析状态空间模型与注意力机制各自的取舍，并指出分词只是一根拐杖。

title_en: Understanding and Improving Length Generalization in Recurrent Models
title_zh: Understanding and Improving Length Generalization in Recurrent Models
summary_en: Explains why recurrent models fail on sequences longer than they were trained on, and what fixes the failure.
summary_zh: 解释循环模型为何在超出训练长度的序列上失效，以及如何修正这一问题。

title_en: Understanding the Skill Gap in Recurrent Language Models: The Role of the Gather-and-Aggregate Mechanism
title_zh: Understanding the Skill Gap in Recurrent Language Models: The Role of the Gather-and-Aggregate Mechanism
summary_en: Traces the recall weakness of recurrent language models to a small gather-and-aggregate mechanism; Gu is senior author.
summary_zh: 把循环语言模型在检索上的短板追溯到少数收集-聚合机制，Gu 为通讯作者。

title_en: Lyra: An Efficient and Expressive Subquadratic Architecture for Modeling Biological Sequences
title_zh: Lyra: An Efficient and Expressive Subquadratic Architecture for Modeling Biological Sequences
summary_en: Subquadratic architecture for biological sequence modeling; Gu is a co-author.
summary_zh: 面向生物序列建模的次二次架构，Gu 为共同作者。

title_en: Thinking Slow, Fast: Scaling Inference Compute with Distilled Reasoners
title_zh: Thinking Slow, Fast: Scaling Inference Compute with Distilled Reasoners
summary_en: Distills transformer reasoners into recurrent models so test-time compute scaling stays cheap; Gu is a co-author.
summary_zh: 把 Transformer 推理模型蒸馏到循环架构，使测试时计算的扩展更廉价，Gu 为共同作者。

title_en: Llamba: Scaling Distilled Recurrent Models for Efficient Language Processing
title_zh: Llamba: Scaling Distilled Recurrent Models for Efficient Language Processing
summary_en: Distills Llama-3.x into the Mamba architecture, a Cartesia-linked line of efficient recurrent models; Gu is senior author.
summary_zh: 把 Llama-3.x 蒸馏为 Mamba 架构的高效循环模型系列，与 Cartesia 一脉相承，Gu 为通讯作者。

title_en: HybriDNA: A Hybrid Transformer-Mamba2 Long-Range DNA Language Model
title_zh: HybriDNA: A Hybrid Transformer-Mamba2 Long-Range DNA Language Model
summary_en: Hybrid transformer-Mamba2 DNA language model for long genomic sequences; Gu is a co-author.
summary_zh: 面向长基因组序列的 Transformer-Mamba2 混合 DNA 语言模型，Gu 为共同作者。

title_en: On the Benefits of Memory for Modeling Time-Dependent PDEs
title_zh: On the Benefits of Memory for Modeling Time-Dependent PDEs
summary_en: Shows non-Markovian memory improves neural solvers for time-dependent PDEs; Gu is a co-author.
summary_zh: 表明引入非马尔可夫记忆能改善时变偏微分方程的神经求解器，Gu 为共同作者。

title_en: Cross-Architecture Distillation Part I - The MOHAWK Framework
title_zh: Cross-Architecture Distillation Part I - The MOHAWK Framework
summary_en: Introduces MOHAWK, a framework for distilling a pretrained Transformer into a Mamba-style recurrent model.
summary_zh: 介绍 MOHAWK 框架：把已预训练的 Transformer 蒸馏成 Mamba 式的循环模型。

title_en: Cross-Architecture Distillation Part II - Phi-Mamba-1.5B Model and Training Laws
title_zh: Cross-Architecture Distillation Part II - Phi-Mamba-1.5B Model and Training Laws
summary_en: Second part of the distillation series, reporting the Phi-Mamba-1.5B model and the training laws that govern cross-architecture distillation.
summary_zh: 蒸馏系列的第二部分，公布 Phi-Mamba-1.5B 模型以及跨架构蒸馏所遵循的训练规律。

title_en: Transformers to SSMs: Distilling Quadratic Knowledge to Subquadratic Models
title_zh: Transformers to SSMs: Distilling Quadratic Knowledge to Subquadratic Models
summary_en: MOHAWK, a method for distilling pretrained transformers into subquadratic state-space models; Gu is senior author.
summary_zh: MOHAWK 方法，把预训练 Transformer 蒸馏为次二次的状态空间模型，Gu 为通讯作者。

title_en: Mamba, Mamba-2 and Post-Transformer Architectures for Generative AI with Albert Gu
title_zh: Mamba, Mamba-2 and Post-Transformer Architectures for Generative AI with Albert Gu
summary_en: Long-form interview on Mamba, Mamba-2 and where post-Transformer architectures go next.
summary_zh: 长篇访谈，谈 Mamba、Mamba-2 以及后 Transformer 架构的下一步方向。

title_en: Hydra: Bidirectional State Space Models Through Generalized Matrix Mixers
title_zh: Hydra: Bidirectional State Space Models Through Generalized Matrix Mixers
summary_en: Bidirectional state-space model derived from a unifying matrix-mixer view of sequence models; Gu is senior author.
summary_zh: 从统一的矩阵混合视角推导出的双向状态空间模型，Gu 为通讯作者。

title_en: The State Space Model Revolution, with Albert Gu
title_zh: The State Space Model Revolution, with Albert Gu
summary_en: Interview covering the state-space model line of work and the founding of Cartesia.
summary_zh: 访谈，围绕状态空间模型这一研究路线以及 Cartesia 的创立展开。

title_en: State Space Models and Real-time Intelligence with Karan Goel and Albert Gu from Cartesia
title_zh: State Space Models and Real-time Intelligence with Karan Goel and Albert Gu from Cartesia
summary_en: Appears with Cartesia co-founder Karan Goel to discuss state-space models and real-time voice systems.
summary_zh: 与 Cartesia 联合创始人 Karan Goel 一同出镜，讨论状态空间模型与实时语音系统。

title_en: An Empirical Study of Mamba-based Language Models
title_zh: An Empirical Study of Mamba-based Language Models
summary_en: NVIDIA-led 8B-scale comparison of Mamba, hybrid and transformer language models; Gu is a co-author.
summary_zh: 由 NVIDIA 主导的 8B 规模对比研究，比较 Mamba、混合架构与 Transformer 语言模型，Gu 为共同作者。

title_en: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality
title_zh: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality
summary_en: The Mamba-2 paper, establishing a structured state space duality between attention and SSMs; written with Tri Dao.
summary_zh: Mamba-2 论文，建立注意力与状态空间模型之间的结构化对偶关系，由 Gu 与 Tri Dao 合著。

title_en: Caduceus: Bi-Directional Equivariant Long-Range DNA Sequence Modeling
title_zh: Caduceus: Bi-Directional Equivariant Long-Range DNA Sequence Modeling
summary_en: Bidirectional, reverse-complement-equivariant DNA sequence model built on Mamba; Gu is a co-author.
summary_zh: 基于 Mamba 的双向、反向互补等变 DNA 序列模型，Gu 为共同作者。

title_en: Griffin: Mixing Gated Linear Recurrences with Local Attention for Efficient Language Models
title_zh: Griffin: Mixing Gated Linear Recurrences with Local Attention for Efficient Language Models
summary_en: DeepMind's Hawk and Griffin architectures mixing gated linear recurrences with local attention; Gu is a co-author.
summary_zh: DeepMind 的 Hawk 与 Griffin 架构，把门控线性循环与局部注意力结合，Gu 为共同作者。

title_en: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
title_zh: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
summary_en: The original Mamba paper introducing selective state spaces, Gu's best-known work and the basis for Cartesia's models.
summary_zh: Mamba 原始论文，提出选择性状态空间，是 Gu 最知名的工作，也是 Cartesia 模型的基础。

title_en: Augmenting conformers with structured state-space sequence models for online speech recognition
title_zh: Augmenting conformers with structured state-space sequence models for online speech recognition
summary_en: Google collaboration adding structured state-space layers to conformer encoders for streaming speech recognition; Gu is a co-author.
summary_zh: 与 Google 合作，在 conformer 编码器中加入结构化状态空间层以支持流式语音识别，Gu 为共同作者。

title_en: Resurrecting Recurrent Neural Networks for Long Sequences
title_zh: Resurrecting Recurrent Neural Networks for Long Sequences
summary_en: DeepMind paper showing carefully initialized linear RNNs can match deep state-space models on long sequences; Gu is a co-author.
summary_zh: DeepMind 论文，表明精心初始化的线性 RNN 在长序列上可媲美深度状态空间模型，Gu 为共同作者。

title_en: On the Opportunities and Risks of Foundation Models
title_zh: 论基础模型的机遇与风险
summary_en: The report that coined the term 'foundation model'.
summary_zh: 提出「基础模型」这一术语的报告。

title_en: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models (HELM)
title_zh: 语言模型的整体评测（HELM）
summary_en: Entered maintenance mode on 1 June 2026.

title_en: CS336: Language Models from Scratch
title_zh: CS336：从零构建语言模型
summary_en: The course is one of the more useful public artefacts of the year — it forces the whole stack into view.
summary_zh: 这门课是这一年更有用的公共产物之一 —— 它逼着你把整个技术栈摊开来看。

title_zh: Glad to see another live training run! Here's how Marin 535B-A23B is doing today: https://t.co/Bc3CcV4FOm Anyone else want to share? https://t.co/S71nmJ4fS3
summary_en: Liang posted a live status update on the Marin 535B-A23B training run, part of his push for open, transparent model development.
summary_zh: Percy Liang分享了Marin 535B-A23B训练任务的实时进展，延续他推动开放透明模型开发的一贯立场。

title_en: Data Scarcity and Model Sparsity: Mixtures-of-Experts Overfit More to Repeated Data
title_zh: Data Scarcity and Model Sparsity: Mixtures-of-Experts Overfit More to Repeated Data
summary_en: Co-authored with Stanford and collaborators including Jure Leskovec, this paper shows mixture-of-experts models overfit more than dense transformers when training data must be repeated, relevant to CRFM's work on data-constrained scaling.
summary_zh: 该论文由Percy Liang与Jure Leskovec等合作者共同完成，发现在训练数据需要重复使用时，混合专家（MoE）模型比稠密Transformer更容易过拟合，这与CRFM在数据受限扩展方面的研究相关。

title_en: A year ago, David was the only FTE on Marin. Today, thanks to Open Athena, Marin has 10 FTE. Read his post to better understand the context of Marin. And David
title_zh: A year ago, David was the only FTE on Marin. Today, thanks to Open Athena, Marin has 10 FTE. Read his post to better understand the context of Marin. And David
summary_en: Noted that Marin, Stanford CRFM's open-source model project, has grown from one full-time engineer a year ago to ten thanks to Open Athena.
summary_zh: 他提到，得益于 Open Athena，斯坦福 CRFM 的开源模型项目 Marin 的全职工程师已从一年前的 1 人增长到 10 人。

title_en: Open models gaining momentum. This is incentive-aligned and just makes sense.
title_zh: Open models gaining momentum. This is incentive-aligned and just makes sense.
summary_en: Said open models are gaining momentum and that this trend is incentive-aligned and makes sense.
summary_zh: 他表示开源模型正在获得越来越多的关注，这一趋势符合激励机制、合乎逻辑。

title_zh: Marin 535B-A23B is 13% through training. This hero run would not be possible without the generous support of the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation, which provi

summary_zh: Percy Liang报告称Marin 535B-A23B模型的训练已完成13%，这要归功于黄仁勋与劳丽·黄基金会为算力提供的资助。

title_en: The "What-If Machine" is a vivid articulation of what Simile is building. It's not just about forecasting the future passively. It's about understanding how act
title_zh: The "What-If Machine" is a vivid articulation of what Simile is building. It's not just about forecasting the future passively. It's about understanding how act

summary_zh: Percy Liang称赞Simile的“假设机器”理念，认为它不只是被动预测未来，而是主动建模干预行为将如何改变未来。

title_en: Marin 535B-A23B is ~7% done training, and so far things look on track. Next Tuesday (Sept 1 @ 10 PT), we will have a Zoom panel/discussion where the Marin team
title_zh: Marin 535B-A23B is ~7% done training, and so far things look on track. Next Tuesday (Sept 1 @ 10 PT), we will have a Zoom panel/discussion where the Marin team

summary_zh: Liang宣布Marin的5350亿参数混合专家模型训练进度约7%且进展顺利,并计划举行Zoom公开讨论其设计决策。

title_en: Prefix Sliding for efficient test-time scaling
title_zh: Prefix Sliding for efficient test-time scaling
summary_en: Cuts the memory cost of holding long reasoning traces at inference by sliding the prefix, making test-time scaling cheaper.
summary_zh: 通过滑动前缀降低推理时保存长推理轨迹的显存开销，使测试时扩展更为廉价。

title_zh: The fact that Simile’s first technical blog post is about confidence is notable. Confidence is paramount to simulation. If a coding agent messes up, you can oft
summary_en: Liang argued that confidence estimation is central to simulation models, since an agent that can't tell when it's wrong can't repair the error.
summary_zh: Liang认为置信度评估对模拟模型至关重要,因为无法判断自身是否出错的智能体也就无法自我修正。

title_en: 🚢 Marin 535B-A23B started training this week! As usual, the whole process is open. Voyage plan: pretraining (80%) + midtraining (20%) on 18.75T tokens on 11 x G
title_zh: 🚢 Marin 535B-A23B started training this week! As usual, the whole process is open. Voyage plan: pretraining (80%) + midtraining (20%) on 18.75T tokens on 11 x G
summary_en: Liang announced that Marin's 535B-parameter MoE model began training on 18.75T tokens across 11 GB200 NVL72 clusters, with the process kept fully open.
summary_zh: Liang宣布Marin的5350亿参数MoE模型已在11个GB200 NVL72集群上开始训练18.75万亿个token,全过程保持开放。

title_en: DelusionEval: Measuring Delusion-Linked Behaviors in AI Chatbots
title_zh: DelusionEval: Measuring Delusion-Linked Behaviors in AI Chatbots
summary_en: DelusionEval, a benchmark for whether AI chatbots reinforce delusional thinking, extending his line of standardised evaluation to psychological harm.
summary_zh: DelusionEval 基准，用于衡量 AI 聊天机器人是否会助长妄想性思维，将他的标准化评测路线延伸到心理伤害领域。

title_en: It's time to scale that Simile. Our ambition is to build a foundation model that can predict what anyone will do in any situation. Research-wise, Simile in 2026
title_zh: It's time to scale that Simile. Our ambition is to build a foundation model that can predict what anyone will do in any situation. Research-wise, Simile in 2026

summary_zh: Liang将其新项目Simile(一个旨在预测人类行为的基础模型)类比为2019年OpenAI之于语言模型的地位。

title_en: The most important word here is *ecosystem*. It's not just about having an open-weight model. Open-weight models are a means to an end. To have a truly strong,
title_zh: The most important word here is *ecosystem*. It's not just about having an open-weight model. Open-weight models are a means to an end. To have a truly strong,
summary_en: Liang argued that a genuinely open AI ecosystem needs more than open-weight models, and laid out the additional pieces he thinks are required.
summary_zh: Liang认为真正开放的AI生态系统仅有开放权重模型远远不够,并阐述了还需要哪些要素。

title_en: ⚡! Tokenization is the first thing you do in CS336 (language models from scratch). If Marcel can work his magic for the rest of the LM pipeline, the world will
title_zh: ⚡! Tokenization is the first thing you do in CS336 (language models from scratch). If Marcel can work his magic for the rest of the LM pipeline, the world will
summary_en: Liang noted that tokenization is the opening topic of his Stanford CS336 course on building language models from scratch.
summary_zh: Liang提到分词是他在斯坦福CS336(从零构建语言模型)课程中讲授的第一个主题。

title_en: Extractable Memorization From First Principles
title_zh: Extractable Memorization From First Principles
summary_en: Rebuilds the definition of extractable memorization in language models to fix validity problems that made earlier extraction studies over- and under-state the risk.
summary_zh: 重新界定语言模型「可提取记忆」的定义，修正以往提取研究中高估或低估风险的效度问题。

title_en: FLARE-AI: Flaw Reporting for AI
title_zh: FLARE-AI: Flaw Reporting for AI
summary_en: FLARE-AI proposes shared infrastructure for reporting flaws in deployed AI systems, co-signed with a broad coalition of safety and policy researchers.
summary_zh: FLARE-AI 提出用于报告已部署 AI 系统缺陷的共享基础设施，由安全与政策领域的众多研究者共同署名。

title_en: Economic Evaluations of Language Models
title_zh: Economic Evaluations of Language Models
summary_en: Introduces EconEvals, an open-source suite that assesses how well language models perform economically valuable tasks.
summary_zh: 提出开源评测套件 EconEvals，衡量语言模型完成具有经济价值任务的能力。

title_en: Fantastic Pretraining Optimizers and Where to Find Them II: Hyperball Optimization
title_zh: Fantastic Pretraining Optimizers and Where to Find Them II: Hyperball Optimization
summary_en: Second instalment of his group's controlled comparison of pretraining optimizers, examining why matrix-based methods lose their edge over AdamW at scale.
summary_zh: 其团队预训练优化器对照研究的第二篇，考察矩阵类优化器相对 AdamW 的优势为何随规模扩大而消失。

title_en: There are two types of advances: (i) a singular change that provides 3x and (ii) a series of micro changes that each provide 20%. It is easy to celebrate (i), b
title_zh: There are two types of advances: (i) a singular change that provides 3x and (ii) a series of micro changes that each provide 20%. It is easy to celebrate (i), b
summary_en: Liang argued that incremental, compounding improvements matter as much as singular breakthroughs, even though they get less credit.
summary_zh: Liang指出渐进式、持续累积的改进与单一突破性进展同样重要,尽管前者更少获得认可。

title_zh: Here's a simple idea that works surprisingly well: model generates a response, it "self-verifies" its own response, and trains on those that pass. No ground tru
