summary_zh: Liang介绍了一种自我验证方法:模型仅使用通过自我检验的自身生成回答进行训练,无需真实答案或外部验证器。

title_en: Algorithmic Monocultures in Hiring
title_zh: Algorithmic Monocultures in Hiring
summary_en: Tests whether employers sharing the same few hiring algorithms systematically screen out the same applicants, part of his algorithmic-accountability work.
summary_zh: 研究雇主共用少数几家招聘算法是否会系统性地筛掉同一批求职者，属于他的算法问责研究。

title_en: Not only do we want to train a good model, we want to know it'll be good before we even start training. About a month ago, the Marin team launched a 129B (16B a
title_zh: Not only do we want to train a good model, we want to know it'll be good before we even start training. About a month ago, the Marin team launched a 129B (16B a
summary_en: Liang described Marin's practice of preregistering loss predictions for a 129B-parameter MoE run before training, to test whether performance can be forecast in advance.
summary_zh: Liang介绍了Marin在训练前为1290亿参数MoE模型预先登记损失预测的做法,以检验能否提前预知模型表现。

title_en: Self-Verified Distillation: Your Language Model Is Secretly Its Own Synthetic Data Pipeline
title_zh: Self-Verified Distillation: Your Language Model Is Secretly Its Own Synthetic Data Pipeline
summary_en: Shows a post-trained language model can keep improving from unlabeled prompts alone, acting as its own synthetic-data pipeline.
summary_zh: 表明经过后训练的语言模型仅凭无标注提示即可自我改进，充当自身的合成数据流水线。

title_en: For the next Marin model, we are putting together a new data mix. Currently we have 18T tokens, but could use more. So if you are sitting on some secret stash o
title_zh: For the next Marin model, we are putting together a new data mix. Currently we have 18T tokens, but could use more. So if you are sitting on some secret stash o
summary_en: Liang said Marin's next model needs a new data mix beyond its current 18T tokens and asked the community for high-quality token sources.
summary_zh: Liang表示Marin下一代模型需要在现有18万亿token基础上补充新的数据组合,并向社区征集高质量数据来源。

title_en: DecodingTrust-Agent Platform (DTap): A Controllable and Interactive Red-Teaming Platform for AI Agents
title_zh: DecodingTrust-Agent Platform (DTap): A Controllable and Interactive Red-Teaming Platform for AI Agents
summary_en: DTap, a controllable red-teaming platform for stress-testing AI agents, extending the DecodingTrust line of trustworthiness evaluation.
summary_zh: DTap 是用于对 AI 智能体做压力测试的可控红队平台，延续 DecodingTrust 的可信度评测路线。

title_en: I find myself repeatedly explaining the difference between open-weight (DeepSeek), open-source (Olmo), open-development (Marin). Let's see if this restaurant an
title_zh: I find myself repeatedly explaining the difference between open-weight (DeepSeek), open-source (Olmo), open-development (Marin). Let's see if this restaurant an
summary_en: Liang laid out his distinction between open-weight (e.g. DeepSeek), open-source (e.g. Olmo) and open-development (Marin) models using a restaurant analogy.
summary_zh: Liang用餐厅类比阐述了开放权重(如DeepSeek)、开源(如Olmo)和开放式开发(Marin)三种模型开放程度的区别。

title_en: Marin is using quantile balancing from @Jianlin_S (who developed RoPE, which was also a good idea) to train our current 1e23 FLOPs MoE. The idea is elegant: ass
title_zh: Marin is using quantile balancing from @Jianlin_S (who developed RoPE, which was also a good idea) to train our current 1e23 FLOPs MoE. The idea is elegant: ass
summary_en: Liang explained that Marin's current MoE run uses a quantile-balancing technique from Jianlin Su (creator of RoPE) to route tokens to experts.
summary_zh: Liang介绍Marin目前的MoE训练采用了苏剑林(RoPE的提出者)的分位数平衡方法来分配token给专家模块。

title_en: This week, @classiclarryd kicked off a 129B (16B active) 1e23 FLOPs MoE run. In typical Marin style, we have fit scaling laws and have made a loss projection of
title_zh: This week, @classiclarryd kicked off a 129B (16B active) 1e23 FLOPs MoE run. In typical Marin style, we have fit scaling laws and have made a loss projection of
summary_en: Liang reported that Marin kicked off a 129B-parameter (16B active) MoE training run with a preregistered loss projection of 2.252.
summary_zh: Liang报告Marin启动了1290亿参数(160亿激活参数)的MoE训练,并预先登记了2.252的损失预测值。

title_en: This is Act II. Act I was about making an anonymity layer for LLMs (VPN for intelligence). Act II is about building a deeply personalized, private assistant on
title_zh: This is Act II. Act I was about making an anonymity layer for LLMs (VPN for intelligence). Act II is about building a deeply personalized, private assistant on
summary_en: Liang described the second phase of his project: building a deeply personalized private AI assistant on top of an anonymity layer for LLMs.
summary_zh: Liang介绍了其项目的第二阶段:在为LLM构建的匿名层之上打造一个深度个性化的私人助手。

title_en: Our 1e23 Delphi run finished last night. It's loss was within 0.005 of the projected (preregistered) loss. Note that these projections were based on only traini
title_zh: Our 1e23 Delphi run finished last night. It's loss was within 0.005 of the projected (preregistered) loss. Note that these projections were based on only traini
summary_en: Liang reported that Marin's 1e23-FLOP Delphi training run finished with a loss within 0.005 of the value predicted from models 100x smaller.
summary_zh: Liang报告Marin的1e23 FLOPs规模Delphi训练已完成,损失值与用小100倍模型预测的结果相差仅0.005。

title_en: Academic titles are funny. After 14 years, I finally have the official title that people might have always assumed I had.
title_zh: Academic titles are funny. After 14 years, I finally have the official title that people might have always assumed I had.
summary_en: Liang noted that after 14 years he finally received the official academic title people had long assumed he already held.
summary_zh: Liang表示自己在14年后终于获得了人们一直以为他早已拥有的正式学术头衔。

title_en: Last time Marin 32B got burned by loss spikes, so this makes me very nervous...but maybe Delphi 1e23 will be different🤞
title_zh: Last time Marin 32B got burned by loss spikes, so this makes me very nervous...but maybe Delphi 1e23 will be different🤞
summary_en: Liang expressed anxiety going into the Delphi 1e23-FLOP training run, recalling that the earlier Marin 32B run had been hit by loss spikes.
summary_zh: Liang提到对即将进行的1e23 FLOPs规模Delphi训练感到紧张,因为此前Marin 32B训练曾遭遇损失骤增问题。

title_en: Estimating near-verbatim extraction risk in language models with decoding-constrained beam search
title_zh: Estimating near-verbatim extraction risk in language models with decoding-constrained beam search
summary_en: Estimates near-verbatim extraction risk with a decoding-constrained beam search, from his ongoing collaboration with legal scholars on memorization and copyright.
summary_zh: 用受约束解码的束搜索估计近似逐字提取风险，出自他与法学学者在记忆与版权问题上的持续合作。

title_en: In our last episode, careful tuning, scaling, and ensembles led to a 5x gain in data efficiency (requires 5x less data to get the same loss). Now, with a rephra
title_zh: In our last episode, careful tuning, scaling, and ensembles led to a 5x gain in data efficiency (requires 5x less data to get the same loss). Now, with a rephra
summary_en: Liang reported that adding a rephraser model on top of prior tuning and ensembling gains yielded a further 1.8x improvement in data efficiency.
summary_zh: Liang报告在此前调优与集成方法带来的效率提升基础上,加入改写模型后数据效率又提升了1.8倍。

title_en: Data-efficient pre-training by scaling synthetic megadocs
title_zh: Data-efficient pre-training by scaling synthetic megadocs
summary_en: Studies how to design synthetic data so pre-training keeps improving when data rather than compute is the binding constraint.
summary_zh: 研究在数据而非算力成为瓶颈时，如何设计合成数据以持续提升预训练效果。

title_en: In Marin, we are trying to get really good at scaling laws. We have trained models up to 1e22 FLOPs and have made a prediction of the loss at 1e23 FLOPs, which
title_zh: In Marin, we are trying to get really good at scaling laws. We have trained models up to 1e22 FLOPs and have made a prediction of the loss at 1e23 FLOPs, which
summary_en: Liang described Marin's scaling-law work, having trained models up to 1e22 FLOPs to predict performance at 1e23 FLOPs.
summary_zh: Liang介绍了Marin的规模定律研究,已训练出高达1e22 FLOPs的模型以预测1e23 FLOPs时的表现。

title_en: I think it’s pretty clear that simulation is the next frontier for AI. The most impressive feats of AI to date are when we have a clear environment + reward, wh
title_zh: I think it’s pretty clear that simulation is the next frontier for AI. The most impressive feats of AI to date are when we have a clear environment + reward, wh
summary_en: Liang argued simulation is AI's next frontier, since the field's biggest breakthroughs have come where a clear environment and reward exist.
summary_zh: Liang认为模拟是AI的下一个前沿领域,因为该领域最大的突破往往出现在有明确环境和奖励的场景中。

title_en: Normally replay old data reduces forgetting, but it actually helps you learn on new data too! We finally put this paper out on arxiv, but had it up as a Marin G
title_zh: Normally replay old data reduces forgetting, but it actually helps you learn on new data too! We finally put this paper out on arxiv, but had it up as a Marin G
summary_en: Liang announced an arXiv paper showing that replaying old data not only reduces forgetting but also improves learning on new data.
summary_zh: Liang宣布发表了一篇arXiv论文,证明重放旧数据不仅能减少遗忘,还能提升对新数据的学习效果。

title_en: Replaying pre-training data improves fine-tuning
title_zh: Replaying pre-training data improves fine-tuning
summary_en: Shows that replaying pre-training data during fine-tuning produces a better domain model than fine-tuning on target data alone.
summary_zh: 表明在微调时掺回预训练数据，比只用目标领域数据微调能得到更好的领域模型。

title_en: I stopped using ChatGPT a few months ago. Since then, I have been only using oa-chat. All chat history is stored locally. Each query is sent to OpenAI under a t
title_zh: I stopped using ChatGPT a few months ago. Since then, I have been only using oa-chat. All chat history is stored locally. Each query is sent to OpenAI under a t
summary_en: Liang said he switched from ChatGPT to his own privacy-preserving 'oa-chat' tool, which stores history locally and anonymizes each query sent to OpenAI.
summary_zh: Liang表示自己已改用其自研的隐私保护工具'oa-chat',该工具在本地存储聊天记录,并对发给OpenAI的每次请求做匿名化处理。

title_en: These days, I'm much more excited about dataset releases than model releases. Models come and go and don't compose, whereas good datasets are more enduring and
title_zh: These days, I'm much more excited about dataset releases than model releases. Models come and go and don't compose, whereas good datasets are more enduring and
summary_en: Liang said he now finds dataset releases more exciting than model releases, since datasets endure and can be reused and revised while models come and go.
summary_zh: Liang表示他现在对数据集发布比模型发布更感兴趣,因为数据集更持久、可被反复研究使用和修订,而模型则不断更替。

title_en: Beyond a Single Extractor: Re-thinking HTML-to-Text Extraction for LLM Pretraining
title_zh: Beyond a Single Extractor: Re-thinking HTML-to-Text Extraction for LLM Pretraining
summary_en: Argues that a single HTML-to-text extractor is the wrong foundation for web-scale pretraining corpora, and proposes a better extraction pipeline.
summary_zh: 论证用单一的 HTML 转文本抽取器构建网络规模预训练语料并不合适，并提出更好的抽取流水线。

title_en: VLAW: Iterative Co-Improvement of Vision-Language-Action Policy and World Model
title_zh: VLAW: Iterative Co-Improvement of Vision-Language-Action Policy and World Model
summary_en: Co-improves a vision-language-action policy and a world model through iterative online interaction, with Chelsea Finn's robotics group.
summary_zh: 与 Chelsea Finn 的机器人团队合作，通过迭代式在线交互协同改进视觉-语言-动作策略与世界模型。

title_en: We are about to enter the age of simulation.
title_zh: We are about to enter the age of simulation.
summary_en: Liang declared that AI is entering the age of simulation.
summary_zh: Liang宣称AI正在进入模拟时代。

title_en: $3M to support the development of open benchmarks!
title_zh: $3M to support the development of open benchmarks!
summary_en: Liang announced $3M in funding to support the development of open benchmarks.
summary_zh: Liang宣布提供300万美元资金支持开放基准测试的开发。

title_en: When RL Meets Adaptive Speculative Training: A Unified Training-Serving System
title_zh: When RL Meets Adaptive Speculative Training: A Unified Training-Serving System
summary_en: A unified system that trains the speculative decoder alongside serving rather than offline, speeding up LLM inference; work with the Together AI group he co-founded.
summary_zh: 提出训练与推理服务统一的系统，让投机解码器随服务在线训练而非离线训练以加速大模型推理；与他联合创办的 Together AI 团队合作。

title_en: It's a triple threat - It produces actions! It produces future states! It produces values! You just need a good video model to get you started, and you get SOTA
title_zh: It's a triple threat - It produces actions! It produces future states! It produces values! You just need a good video model to get you started, and you get SOTA
summary_en: Liang described a video-model-based approach that jointly produces actions, future states and values, calling it state-of-the-art with only a good video model needed to start.
summary_zh: Liang介绍了一种基于视频模型的方法,可同时生成动作、未来状态和价值,称仅需一个优秀的视频模型即可达到最先进水平。

title_en: Cosmos Policy: Fine-Tuning Video Models for Visuomotor Control and Planning
title_zh: Cosmos Policy: Fine-Tuning Video Models for Visuomotor Control and Planning
summary_en: Fine-tunes video generation models into visuomotor control and planning policies, with NVIDIA and Chelsea Finn's group.
summary_zh: 将视频生成模型微调为视觉运动控制与规划策略，与英伟达及 Chelsea Finn 团队合作。

title_en: Don't use weight decay. Just normalize everything you see (updates + parameters). Works on top of your favorite optimizer (e.g., Muon). Result: 33% speedup + be
title_zh: Don't use weight decay. Just normalize everything you see (updates + parameters). Works on top of your favorite optimizer (e.g., Muon). Result: 33% speedup + be
summary_en: Liang shared a training trick, skipping weight decay in favor of normalizing updates and parameters, reporting a 33% speedup and better hyperparameter transfer on top of Muon.
summary_zh: Liang分享了一个训练技巧:不使用权重衰减,而是对更新量和参数做归一化处理,在Muon优化器基础上实现33%的加速并改善超参数迁移效果。

title_en: If you use Pythia and like it, we're making an updated version. Tell us what you want. Here's a question for y'all: would you rather have a scaling suite traine
title_zh: If you use Pythia and like it, we're making an updated version. Tell us what you want. Here's a question for y'all: would you rather have a scaling suite traine
summary_en: Liang said his team is preparing an updated Pythia model suite and asked users whether they'd prefer training data drawn from Nemotron-CC.
summary_zh: Liang表示团队正在准备更新版的Pythia模型套件,并询问用户是否希望使用Nemotron-CC的训练数据。

title_en: To what extent can you prompt an LM and have it generated a whole copyrighted book? This doesn't work generically, but in some cases, we were able to get much m
title_zh: To what extent can you prompt an LM and have it generated a whole copyrighted book? This doesn't work generically, but in some cases, we were able to get much m
summary_en: Liang reported research on the extent to which prompting a language model can reproduce a whole copyrighted book verbatim.
summary_zh: Liang介绍了一项研究,探讨通过提示语言模型能在多大程度上还原一整本受版权保护的书籍内容。

title_en: Need a reward model for robotics? Frontier VLMs actually don't work. We fine-tune one that works better.
title_zh: Need a reward model for robotics? Frontier VLMs actually don't work. We fine-tune one that works better.
summary_en: Liang said frontier vision-language models don't work well as robotics reward models out of the box, so his team fine-tuned one that performs better.
summary_zh: Liang表示前沿视觉语言模型直接用作机器人奖励模型效果不佳,因此团队对其进行微调以获得更好表现。

title_en: Extracting books from production language models
title_zh: Extracting books from production language models
summary_en: Demonstrates recovering book-length text from production language models, bearing directly on the copyright questions around memorization.
summary_zh: 展示了从已上线的语言模型中还原成书长度的文本，直接关系到记忆引发的版权争议。

title_en: RoboReward: General-Purpose Vision-Language Reward Models for Robotics
title_zh: RoboReward: General-Purpose Vision-Language Reward Models for Robotics
summary_en: RoboReward, general-purpose vision-language reward models for robotics that remove the need for hand-labelled rewards.
summary_zh: RoboReward 是面向机器人的通用视觉-语言奖励模型，免去人工标注奖励的需要。

title_en: This is not just another strong open model. Nemotron actually releases training data (!), RL environments, and training code. This is a big difference: almost a
title_zh: This is not just another strong open model. Nemotron actually releases training data (!), RL environments, and training code. This is a big difference: almost a
summary_en: Liang praised Nemotron for releasing training data, RL environments and training code alongside the model, unlike most developers who only share weights.
summary_zh: Liang称赞Nemotron在发布模型的同时公开了训练数据、强化学习环境和训练代码,而多数开发者只提供模型权重。

title_en: The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index
title_zh: The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index
summary_en: The 2025 edition of the Foundation Model Transparency Index he helped launch, scoring how openly the major developers report their practices.
summary_zh: 他参与发起的基础模型透明度指数 2025 年版，评估主要开发者披露自身实践的开放程度。

title_en: Open-weight != transparency: What's interesting is not that IBM's open-weight Granite 3.3 is most transparent (95%), or that xAI's closed Grok 3 is least transp
title_zh: Open-weight != transparency: What's interesting is not that IBM's open-weight Granite 3.3 is most transparent (95%), or that xAI's closed Grok 3 is least transp
summary_en: Liang argued open-weight release does not equal transparency, noting his Foundation Model Transparency Index scored IBM's open-weight Granite 3.3 highest (95%) and xAI's closed Grok 3 lowest (14%).
summary_zh: Liang指出开放权重不等于透明度,他的基础模型透明度指数显示IBM开放权重的Granite 3.3得分最高(95%),而xAI闭源的Grok 3得分最低(14%)。

title_en: Comparing AI Agents to Cybersecurity Professionals in Real-World Penetration Testing
title_zh: Comparing AI Agents to Cybersecurity Professionals in Real-World Penetration Testing
summary_en: First head-to-head evaluation of AI agents against professional penetration testers in a live enterprise network.
summary_zh: 首次在真实企业网络环境中将 AI 智能体与专业渗透测试人员正面对比评测。

title_en: Nice to see AA tracking openness! No matter how many times one says it, people don't seem to understand that openness is more than "the ability to download mode
title_zh: Nice to see AA tracking openness! No matter how many times one says it, people don't seem to understand that openness is more than "the ability to download mode
summary_en: Liang welcomed a new tracker for AI model openness, reiterating that openness means more than just being able to download model weights.
summary_zh: Liang对一项追踪AI模型开放度的新工具表示欢迎,并重申开放不仅仅意味着可以下载模型权重。

title_en: Beat the long tail: Distribution-Aware Speculative Decoding for RL Training
title_zh: Beat the long tail: Distribution-Aware Speculative Decoding for RL Training
summary_en: Speeds up the rollout phase of RL post-training with distribution-aware speculative decoding.
summary_zh: 用分布感知的投机解码加速强化学习后训练中的 rollout 阶段。

title_en: On the Entropy Calibration of Language Models
title_zh: On the Entropy Calibration of Language Models
summary_en: Asks whether a language model's entropy over its own generations matches its log loss on human text, and when that miscalibration can be avoided.
summary_zh: 探讨语言模型在自身生成上的熵是否与其在人类文本上的对数损失相匹配，以及这种失准何时可以避免。

title_en: How are OpenAI, Scale, NVIDIA, Softbank, Disney, Google, AMD, Coreweave dependent on each other? Our new AI supply chains tracks and visualizes the relationship
title_zh: How are OpenAI, Scale, NVIDIA, Softbank, Disney, Google, AMD, Coreweave dependent on each other? Our new AI supply chains tracks and visualizes the relationship
summary_en: Liang announced a new CRFM tool that tracks and visualizes the dependencies among major AI companies such as OpenAI, NVIDIA and Google.
summary_zh: Liang宣布CRFM推出一款新工具,用于追踪并可视化OpenAI、英伟达、谷歌等主要AI公司之间的依赖关系。

title_en: ⛵Marin 32B Base (mantis) is done training! It is the best open-source base model (beating OLMo 2 32B Base) and it’s even close to the best comparably-sized open
title_zh: ⛵Marin 32B Base (mantis) is done training! It is the best open-source base model (beating OLMo 2 32B Base) and it’s even close to the best comparably-sized open
summary_en: Liang announced that Marin 32B Base finished training and became the best fully open-source base model, close to top open-weight models like Gemma 3 27B.
summary_zh: Liang宣布Marin 32B Base完成训练,成为最佳完全开源基础模型,性能接近Gemma 3 27B等顶尖开放权重模型。

title_en: Relative Scaling Laws for LLMs
title_zh: Relative Scaling Laws for LLMs
summary_en: Measures scaling laws relative to specific subpopulations instead of aggregate test sets, exposing gaps that aggregate curves hide.
summary_zh: 以特定子群体而非聚合测试集为参照测量扩展律，揭示聚合曲线所掩盖的差距。

title_en: Blackbox Model Provenance via Palimpsestic Membership Inference
title_zh: Blackbox Model Provenance via Palimpsestic Membership Inference
summary_en: Shows an open-weight model's owner can prove that a blackbox derivative is built on their model, using membership inference on training order.
summary_zh: 表明开放权重模型的所有者可借助基于训练顺序的成员推断，证明某个黑盒衍生模型源自自己的模型。

title_en: Holistic Agent Leaderboard: The Missing Infrastructure for AI Agent Evaluation
title_zh: Holistic Agent Leaderboard: The Missing Infrastructure for AI Agent Evaluation
summary_en: The Holistic Agent Leaderboard, carrying the HELM approach to standardised evaluation over to AI agents.
summary_zh: Holistic Agent Leaderboard 将 HELM 的标准化评测思路延伸到 AI 智能体。

title_en: MLE-Smith: Scaling MLE Tasks with Automated Multi-Agent Pipeline
title_zh: MLE-Smith: Scaling MLE Tasks with Automated Multi-Agent Pipeline
summary_en: MLE-Smith, an automated multi-agent pipeline that generates machine-learning-engineering tasks to train and evaluate agents on.
summary_zh: MLE-Smith 是一条自动化的多智能体流水线，批量生成机器学习工程任务以训练和评测智能体。

title_en: Ep 44: Co-Founder of Together.AI Percy Liang on What’s Next in Research, Reaction to o1 and How AI will Change Simulation
title_zh: Ep 44: Co-Founder of Together.AI Percy Liang on What’s Next in Research, Reaction to o1 and How AI will Change Simulation
summary_en: Long-form interview on where AI research goes next, his reaction to OpenAI's o1, and using AI for simulation.
summary_zh: 长篇访谈，谈 AI 研究的下一步、他对 OpenAI o1 的反应，以及用 AI 做模拟仿真。

title_en: Percy Liang, Stanford: The paradigm shift and societal effects of foundation models
title_zh: Percy Liang, Stanford: The paradigm shift and societal effects of foundation models
summary_en: Interview on the foundation-model paradigm shift and its societal effects — the framing he himself introduced.
summary_zh: 访谈围绕基础模型带来的范式转变及其社会影响展开，而这一提法正是他本人提出的。

title_en: Shaping AI Benchmarks with Together AI Co-Founder Percy Liang
title_zh: Shaping AI Benchmarks with Together AI Co-Founder Percy Liang
summary_en: Interview with Lukas Biewald on AI benchmarking and why standardised evaluation matters.
summary_zh: 与 Lukas Biewald 对谈 AI 基准测试，以及标准化评估为何重要。

title_en: The future of AI Chat: Foundation models and responsible innovation
title_zh: The future of AI Chat: Foundation models and responsible innovation
summary_en: Liang discusses foundation models and responsible AI innovation as the paradigm shift reshaping the field.
summary_zh: Liang在节目中探讨了基础模型以及负责任的人工智能创新，将其视为该领域的范式转变。
