title_en: How to Use AI and Music to Boost Creativity with Percy Liang, Computer Scientist and Classical Pianist
title_zh: How to Use AI and Music to Boost Creativity with Percy Liang, Computer Scientist and Classical Pianist
summary_en: Interview on how his classical piano training feeds his research, an unusually personal profile.
summary_zh: 访谈聊他的古典钢琴训练如何滋养研究工作，是一篇难得的个人向侧写。

title_en: Adept CEO David Luan and Stanford's Percy Liang | Words into Action
title_zh: Adept CEO David Luan and Stanford's Percy Liang | Words into Action
summary_en: Greylock conversation with Adept's David Luan on turning language models into systems that take actions.
summary_zh: 在 Greylock 与 Adept 的 David Luan 对谈，讨论如何让语言模型成为能执行动作的系统。

title_en: What is the role of academia in modern AI research? With Stanford Professor Dr. Percy Liang
title_zh: What is the role of academia in modern AI research? With Stanford Professor Dr. Percy Liang
summary_en: Argues for what academia can still contribute to AI research now that frontier work needs industrial compute.
summary_zh: 论述在前沿研究依赖工业级算力之后，学术界还能为 AI 研究贡献什么。

title_en: Percy Liang on the Center for Research on Foundation Models
title_zh: Percy Liang on the Center for Research on Foundation Models
summary_en: Explains why he founded CRFM and what he wanted the centre to do about benchmarking, scaling and privacy.
summary_zh: 讲述他创办 CRFM 的缘由，以及他希望该中心在基准测试、规模化与隐私方面做些什么。

title_en: Percy Liang on Machine Learning Robustness, Foundation Models, and Reproducibility
title_zh: Percy Liang on Machine Learning Robustness, Foundation Models, and Reproducibility
summary_en: Interview on machine learning robustness, foundation models and reproducibility.
summary_zh: 访谈内容涵盖机器学习鲁棒性、基础模型与可复现性。

source: Behind The Tech with Kevin Scott
title_en: Percy Liang: Stanford University Professor, technologist, and researcher in AI
title_zh: Percy Liang: Stanford University Professor, technologist, and researcher in AI
summary_en: Early interview with Kevin Scott on the difficulty of conversational AI, recorded before the foundation-model era he later named.
summary_zh: 与 Kevin Scott 的早期对谈，讨论对话式 AI 的难点，录制于他后来命名的基础模型时代之前。

title_en: HELM enters maintenance mode
title_zh: HELM 进入维护模式
summary_en: The holistic evaluation framework that shaped how the field talks about model transparency stops active development.
summary_zh: 这套塑造了业界谈论模型透明度方式的整体评测框架停止主动开发。

title_en: 斯坦福教授直播训练535B大模型，模型训练背后的「黑箱」正在被打开？
title_zh: 斯坦福教授直播训练535B大模型，模型训练背后的「黑箱」正在被打开？
summary_en: Liang's Marin open lab began publicly livestreaming the training of its 535B-parameter model, opening up a process usually kept behind closed doors.
summary_zh: 梁的Marin开放实验室开始公开直播其535B参数模型的训练过程，打破了训练过程通常不公开的惯例。

title_en: High-resolution image synthesis with latent diffusion models
title_zh: 基于潜在扩散模型的高分辨率图像合成
summary_en: The Stable Diffusion paper — the direct source of the open image-generation wave.
summary_zh: 即 Stable Diffusion 论文 —— 图像生成开源浪潮的直接源头。

title_en: FLUX.2
title_zh: FLUX.2
summary_en: High-resolution photorealism, character and style consistency, multi-reference editing.
summary_zh: 高分辨率写实、角色与风格一致性、多参考图编辑。

title_en: Wie entwickelt man KI, die die Welt wirklich versteht, Robin Rombach?
title_zh: Wie entwickelt man KI, die die Welt wirklich versteht, Robin Rombach?
summary_en: Handelsblatt Disrupt interview in which Rombach discusses visual intelligence for robot perception, Black Forest Labs' dealings with Elon Musk, and competing with Google.
summary_zh: 《商报》Disrupt 播客访谈：Rombach 谈机器人感知所需的视觉智能、Black Forest Labs 与马斯克的接触，以及与谷歌的竞争。

title_en: Robin Rombach über Robotergehirne, verhandeln mit Musk und Frust über die deutsche Selbstaufgabe
title_zh: Robin Rombach über Robotergehirne, verhandeln mit Musk und Frust über die deutsche Selbstaufgabe
summary_en: Rombach appears as a guest on the Handelsblatt Disrupt podcast, giving a rare look inside Black Forest Labs and discussing robotics, negotiating with Musk, and Germany's competitiveness.
summary_zh: Rombach作为嘉宾做客Handelsblatt Disrupt播客，罕见地分享了Black Forest Labs的内部情况，并谈及机器人、与马斯克的谈判以及德国的竞争力问题。

title_en: Self-Supervised Flow Matching for Scalable Multi-Modal Synthesis
title_zh: Self-Supervised Flow Matching for Scalable Multi-Modal Synthesis
summary_en: Black Forest Labs paper showing that flow-matching models can learn strong semantic representations on their own, removing the dependence on separately trained external encoders.
summary_zh: Black Forest Labs 的论文：流匹配模型可自监督地学得强语义表征，从而摆脱对单独训练的外部编码器的依赖。

title_en: Drug-like antibodies with low immunogenicity in human panels designed with Latent-X2
title_zh: Drug-like antibodies with low immunogenicity in human panels designed with Latent-X2
summary_en: Latent-X2 designs drug-like antibodies that show low immunogenicity in human panels; Rombach is credited as an author and advisor to Latent Labs.
summary_zh: Latent-X2 设计出在人体样本中免疫原性较低的类药抗体；Rombach 以作者兼 Latent Labs 顾问身份署名。

title_en: Latent-X: An Atom-level Frontier Model for De Novo Protein Binder Design
title_zh: Latent-X: An Atom-level Frontier Model for De Novo Protein Binder Design
summary_en: Latent-X, an atom-level generative model for de novo protein binder design that skips large-scale screening; Rombach is credited as an author and advisor to Latent Labs.
summary_zh: Latent-X 是用于从头设计蛋白结合体的原子级生成模型，可省去大规模筛选；Rombach 以作者兼 Latent Labs 顾问身份署名。

title_en: FLUX.1 Kontext: Flow Matching for In-Context Image Generation and Editing in Latent Space
title_zh: FLUX.1 Kontext: Flow Matching for In-Context Image Generation and Editing in Latent Space
summary_en: FLUX.1 Kontext, Black Forest Labs' flow-matching model that unifies image generation and in-context editing — the flagship release of the company he leads.
summary_zh: FLUX.1 Kontext 是 Black Forest Labs 将图像生成与上下文编辑统一起来的流匹配模型，也是他所领导公司的旗舰发布。

title_en: Fast High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Adversarial Diffusion Distillation
title_zh: Fast High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Adversarial Diffusion Distillation
summary_en: Paper on fast high-resolution image synthesis via latent adversarial diffusion distillation (SDXL Turbo).
summary_zh: 论文介绍通过潜空间对抗扩散蒸馏实现快速高分辨率图像生成（SDXL Turbo）。

title_en: Adversarial Diffusion Distillation
title_zh: Adversarial Diffusion Distillation
summary_en: Adversarial Diffusion Distillation paper, the technique behind SDXL Turbo's few-step image generation.
summary_zh: 《对抗扩散蒸馏》论文，即SDXL Turbo少步数图像生成技术背后的方法。

title_en: SV3D: Novel Multi-view Synthesis and 3D Generation from a Single Image Using Latent Video Diffusion
title_zh: SV3D: Novel Multi-view Synthesis and 3D Generation from a Single Image Using Latent Video Diffusion
summary_en: SV3D paper on novel multi-view synthesis and 3D generation from a single image using latent video diffusion.
summary_zh: 《SV3D》论文，利用潜在视频扩散从单张图像实现新视角合成与3D生成。

title_en: The Researcher to Founder Journey, and the Power of Open Models
title_zh: The Researcher to Founder Journey, and the Power of Open Models
summary_en: Rombach and his Black Forest Labs co-founders discuss their path from researchers to founders and the case for open models.
summary_zh: Rombach与Black Forest Labs联合创始人们探讨了从研究者到创业者的转型历程，以及开放模型的价值。

title_en: Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
title_zh: Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
summary_en: The Stable Diffusion 3 paper: scaling rectified flow transformers for high-resolution text-to-image synthesis.
summary_zh: Stable Diffusion 3 论文：将修正流 Transformer 扩展到高分辨率文生图合成。

title_en: aMUSEd: An Open MUSE Reproduction
title_zh: aMUSEd: An Open MUSE Reproduction
summary_en: aMUSEd, an open lightweight masked image model reproducing MUSE at a tenth of the parameters for fast text-to-image generation.
summary_zh: aMUSEd 是对 MUSE 的开源轻量复现，参数量仅十分之一，用于快速文生图。

title_en: Text to Video: The Next Leap in AI Generation
title_zh: Text to Video: The Next Leap in AI Generation
summary_en: Rombach discusses Stable Video Diffusion and the leap to text-to-video AI generation.
summary_zh: Rombach探讨了Stable Video Diffusion以及文本生成视频这一AI生成技术的新飞跃。

title_en: DiffusionSat: A Generative Foundation Model for Satellite Imagery
title_zh: DiffusionSat: A Generative Foundation Model for Satellite Imagery
summary_en: DiffusionSat adapts diffusion generative modelling to satellite imagery, a Stanford collaboration he co-authored.
summary_zh: DiffusionSat 将扩散生成模型迁移到卫星遥感影像，他是这项斯坦福合作研究的共同作者。

title_en: Stable Video Diffusion: Scaling Latent Video Diffusion Models to Large Datasets
title_zh: Stable Video Diffusion: Scaling Latent Video Diffusion Models to Large Datasets
summary_en: Stable Video Diffusion: scaling latent video diffusion and its data curation to state-of-the-art text- and image-to-video generation.
summary_zh: Stable Video Diffusion：扩展潜空间视频扩散模型与数据整理流程，做到当时领先的文生视频与图生视频效果。

title_en: SDXL: Improving Latent Diffusion Models for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
title_zh: SDXL: Improving Latent Diffusion Models for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
summary_en: SDXL, the larger-backbone latent diffusion model that became the widely used open text-to-image baseline.
summary_zh: SDXL 采用更大骨干网络的潜空间扩散模型，成为被广泛使用的开源文生图基线。

title_en: NeuralField-LDM: Scene Generation with Hierarchical Latent Diffusion Models
title_zh: NeuralField-LDM: Scene Generation with Hierarchical Latent Diffusion Models
summary_en: NeuralField-LDM generates 3D scenes with hierarchical latent diffusion, extending latent diffusion beyond flat images.
summary_zh: NeuralField-LDM 用分层潜空间扩散生成三维场景，把潜空间扩散从二维图像推向三维。

title_en: Align your Latents: High-Resolution Video Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
title_zh: Align your Latents: High-Resolution Video Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
summary_en: Video LDM: turning image latent diffusion models into high-resolution video generators by learning temporal layers.
summary_zh: Video LDM：通过训练时间维度的网络层，把图像潜空间扩散模型变成高分辨率视频生成器。

title_en: On Distillation of Guided Diffusion Models
title_zh: On Distillation of Guided Diffusion Models
summary_en: Distillation of classifier-free guided diffusion models into far fewer sampling steps, an early step toward fast diffusion inference.
summary_zh: 将无分类器引导的扩散模型蒸馏到远少的采样步数，是扩散快速推理的早期工作。

title_en: Text-Guided Synthesis of Artistic Images with Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion Models
title_zh: Text-Guided Synthesis of Artistic Images with Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion Models
summary_en: Retrieval-augmented diffusion models for text-guided artistic image synthesis, conditioning generation on retrieved examples.
summary_zh: 用检索增强的扩散模型做文本引导的艺术图像合成，以检索到的样例作为生成条件。

title_en: Semi-Parametric Neural Image Synthesis
title_zh: Semi-Parametric Neural Image Synthesis
summary_en: Semi-parametric image synthesis: pairing a generative model with an external image database so capability scales without growing the network.
summary_zh: 半参数化图像合成：让生成模型搭配外部图像数据库，不扩大网络也能提升能力。

title_en: ImageBART: Bidirectional Context with Multinomial Diffusion for Autoregressive Image Synthesis
title_zh: ImageBART: Bidirectional Context with Multinomial Diffusion for Autoregressive Image Synthesis
summary_en: ImageBART combines autoregressive image synthesis with multinomial diffusion to give the model bidirectional context.
summary_zh: ImageBART 将自回归图像合成与多项式扩散结合，为模型引入双向上下文。

title_en: High-Resolution Complex Scene Synthesis with Transformers
title_zh: High-Resolution Complex Scene Synthesis with Transformers
summary_en: Transformer-based synthesis of complex high-resolution scenes from coarse layouts.
summary_zh: 基于 Transformer，从粗粒度布局合成复杂的高分辨率场景图像。

title_en: Stochastic Image-to-Video Synthesis using cINNs
title_zh: Stochastic Image-to-Video Synthesis using cINNs
summary_en: Stochastic image-to-video synthesis with conditional invertible neural networks, predicting plausible futures from a single frame.
summary_zh: 用条件可逆神经网络做随机的图生视频合成，从单帧预测多种合理的后续运动。

title_en: Geometry-Free View Synthesis: Transformers and no 3D Priors
title_zh: Geometry-Free View Synthesis: Transformers and no 3D Priors
summary_en: Geometry-free novel view synthesis, showing transformers can generate new views without explicit 3D priors.
summary_zh: 无几何先验的新视角合成，证明 Transformer 无需显式三维先验也能生成新视角。

title_en: Taming Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
title_zh: Taming Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
summary_en: Taming Transformers (VQGAN), the discrete latent representation that made high-resolution transformer image synthesis practical and fed directly into latent diffusion.
summary_zh: Taming Transformers（VQGAN）提出的离散潜表示，使高分辨率 Transformer 图像合成可行，并直接为潜空间扩散奠定基础。

title_en: A Note on Data Biases in Generative Models
title_zh: A Note on Data Biases in Generative Models
summary_en: A short note on how dataset biases propagate into generative models and how they surface in the samples.
summary_zh: 一篇简短论文，讨论数据集偏差如何传导进生成模型，并在生成样本中显现。

title_en: Making Sense of CNNs: Interpreting Deep Representations & Their Invariances with INNs
title_zh: Making Sense of CNNs: Interpreting Deep Representations & Their Invariances with INNs
summary_en: Interpreting what CNN representations encode and which invariances they discard, using invertible neural networks.
summary_zh: 借助可逆神经网络解释 CNN 表征编码了什么信息、又丢弃了哪些不变性。

title_en: $300M Series B at a $3.25B post-money valuation
title_zh: 3 亿美元 B 轮，投后估值 32.5 亿美元
summary_en: Co-led by Salesforce Ventures and Anjney Midha (a16z), with NVIDIA, General Catalyst and Temasek. Total raised ~$450M. FLUX.2 announced 25 November 2025.
summary_zh: Salesforce Ventures 与 a16z 的 Anjney Midha 联合领投，NVIDIA、General Catalyst、淡马锡参与。累计融资约 4.5 亿美元。FLUX.2 于 2025-11-25 发布。

title_en: Multi-year $140M contract with Meta
title_zh: 与 Meta 签署 1.4 亿美元多年合约
summary_en: Total contract value across Meta, Adobe, Canva and Snap reached roughly $300M.
summary_zh: Meta、Adobe、Canva 与 Snap 的合约总值约 3 亿美元。

title_en: Essays on research taste and scaling
title_zh: 关于研究品味与 scaling 的随笔

title_en: very cool result showing how wet lab data enables a specialized model to beat gpt-6 astra at a task at the frontier of science! in general scaling is great and
title_zh: very cool result showing how wet lab data enables a specialized model to beat gpt-6 astra at a task at the frontier of science! in general scaling is great and
summary_en: Wei commented on a result showing a specialized model trained on wet-lab data beating a frontier model at a science task, reaffirming that scaling still matters even as specialized approaches show promise.
summary_zh: 韦杰评论了一项结果：一个基于湿实验室数据训练的专用模型在前沿科学任务上超过了通用前沿模型，他借此重申即便专用方法展现出潜力，规模化仍然重要。

title_en: WearableQA: A Benchmark for Health Reasoning over Real-World Wearable Data
title_zh: WearableQA: A Benchmark for Health Reasoning over Real-World Wearable Data
summary_en: Jason Wei co-authors WearableQA, a benchmark testing whether AI systems can reason over real users' longitudinal wearable health data, with colleagues from Meta's wearables team.
summary_zh: Jason Wei与Meta可穿戴设备团队的同事共同提出WearableQA基准，用于测试AI系统能否对真实用户的长期可穿戴健康数据进行推理。

title_en: Prefix Sliding for efficient test-time scaling
title_zh: Prefix Sliding for efficient test-time scaling
summary_en: Paper introducing prefix sliding, a method that drops early reasoning tokens from the KV cache to make test-time scaling cheaper; co-authored with Muennighoff, Liang, Zettlemoyer, Choi and Lewis.
summary_zh: 论文提出 prefix sliding 方法，通过丢弃 KV 缓存中较早的推理 token 来降低测试时扩展的开销；合作者包括 Muennighoff、Percy Liang、Zettlemoyer、Yejin Choi 和 Mike Lewis。

title_en: Cognitive reward shapes in sports and career Sports are amazing environments to learn. When you play a sport for thousands of hours, you start to see the world
title_zh: Cognitive reward shapes in sports and career Sports are amazing environments to learn. When you play a sport for thousands of hours, you start to see the world
summary_en: Wei draws an analogy between reward shaping in sports and in careers, arguing thousands of hours in a sport reshapes how you perceive the world.
summary_zh: Wei将体育与职业中的"奖励塑造"作类比,认为在一项运动上投入数千小时会重塑一个人看待世界的方式。

title_en: When language models first started using tools well, I was sympathetic to the narrative that instead of scaling up language models, all we needed was a strong e
title_zh: When language models first started using tools well, I was sympathetic to the narrative that instead of scaling up language models, all we needed was a strong e
summary_en: Wei revisits his earlier sympathy for the 'small cognitive core plus strong tools' narrative for language models, and where his thinking has shifted since.
summary_zh: Wei回顾自己曾经认同的"小型认知核心加强工具"语言模型叙事,并说明此后想法的转变。

title_en: What's left for humans?
title_zh: What's left for humans?
summary_en: Personal essay arguing from his experience with Tesla full self-driving about which human capabilities remain valuable as AI systems surpass people at more tasks.
summary_zh: 个人随笔，从使用特斯拉全自动驾驶的体验出发，讨论当 AI 在越来越多任务上超过人类之后，人还剩下什么价值。

title_en: What's left for humans in a world where machine intelligence has so many advantages? I recently got a Tesla, and using full self-driving has been a wake up call
title_zh: What's left for humans in a world where machine intelligence has so many advantages? I recently got a Tesla, and using full self-driving has been a wake up call
summary_en: Wei reflects on what's left for humans as machines gain more advantages, prompted by his experience using Tesla's full self-driving.
summary_zh: Wei借助使用特斯拉全自动驾驶的体验,反思在机器智能优势日增的世界里人类还剩下什么位置。

title_en: On HealthBench Pro, Muse Spark 1.1 achieves similar performance with GPT-5.6 Sol (maybe slightly better) at a fraction of the cost. Affordable health superintel
title_zh: On HealthBench Pro, Muse Spark 1.1 achieves similar performance with GPT-5.6 Sol (maybe slightly better) at a fraction of the cost. Affordable health superintel
summary_en: Wei reports Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 matches or slightly beats GPT-5.6 Sol on HealthBench Pro at a fraction of the cost, calling affordable health superintelligence the team's north star.
summary_zh: Wei称Meta的Muse Spark 1.1在HealthBench Pro上以更低成本达到甚至略微超过GPT-5.6 Sol的表现,并称"可负担的健康超级智能"是团队的目标。

title_en: Muse Spark 1.1 outperforms GPT-5.6 Sol and Gemini 3.1 on Radiology's Last Exam. We don't beat Fable (yet). And Humans are still a lot better, but we are working
title_zh: Muse Spark 1.1 outperforms GPT-5.6 Sol and Gemini 3.1 on Radiology's Last Exam. We don't beat Fable (yet). And Humans are still a lot better, but we are working
summary_en: Wei reports Muse Spark 1.1 outperforms GPT-5.6 Sol and Gemini 3.1 on Radiology's Last Exam, though it still trails Fable and humans.
summary_zh: Wei称Muse Spark 1.1在"放射学终极考试"上超过GPT-5.6 Sol和Gemini 3.1,但仍落后于Fable和人类。

title_en: In addition to agents and coding, Muse Spark 1.1 is also really strong at answering health questions, a steadily growing use case for AI. On HealthBench-Pro, Mu
title_zh: In addition to agents and coding, Muse Spark 1.1 is also really strong at answering health questions, a steadily growing use case for AI. On HealthBench-Pro, Mu
summary_en: Wei highlights Muse Spark 1.1's strength at answering health questions, reporting a 5% improvement over rivals on HealthBench-Pro.
summary_zh: Wei强调Muse Spark 1.1在回答健康问题方面的优势,称其在HealthBench-Pro上比对手高出5%。

title_en: Beautifully written piece by @FAbnousi about how AI for health might look like in the future The current data in health is limited because it only captures epis
title_zh: Beautifully written piece by @FAbnousi about how AI for health might look like in the future The current data in health is limited because it only captures epis
summary_en: Wei amplifies a piece by Meta's Freddy Abnousi on the future of AI in health, adding that current health data is limited to episodic clinical snapshots.
summary_zh: Wei转发Meta的Freddy Abnousi关于AI医疗未来的文章,并补充指出目前的健康数据仅限于零散的临床快照。

title_en: Fun nine months! My first week i remember we had a long dinner in the cafeteria daydreaming about the cool research directions to pursue, then going to back to
title_zh: Fun nine months! My first week i remember we had a long dinner in the cafeteria daydreaming about the cool research directions to pursue, then going to back to
summary_en: Marking nine months since his move, Wei recalls his first week — long dinners dreaming up research directions before writing early inference scripts.
summary_zh: 在加入新团队九个月之际,Wei回忆起入职第一周——在餐厅畅想研究方向,随后回去写最初的推理脚本。

title_en: Bullish, in the coming decades majority of compute will be spent on ai for science
title_zh: Bullish, in the coming decades majority of compute will be spent on ai for science
summary_en: Wei predicts that in the coming decades, most compute will be spent on AI for science.
summary_zh: Wei预测未来几十年,大部分算力将被用于"AI用于科学"这一方向。

title_en: Old friends, new lab
title_zh: Old friends, new lab
summary_en: Jason Wei announces joining Meta Superintelligence Labs, reuniting with former OpenAI colleagues, marking his departure from OpenAI.
summary_zh: Jason Wei宣布加入Meta超级智能实验室,与多位前OpenAI同事重聚,标志着他离开OpenAI。

title_en: Life lessons from reinforcement learning
title_zh: Life lessons from reinforcement learning
summary_en: Essay drawing life lessons from reinforcement learning, arguing that learning from your own experience beats imitating others' trajectories.
summary_zh: 用强化学习的思路谈人生：从自身经验中学习，胜过模仿他人的轨迹。

title_en: Asymmetry of verification and verifier’s rule
title_zh: Asymmetry of verification and verifier’s rule
summary_en: Proposes the "verifier's law": tasks that are far easier to verify than to solve are the ones RL will solve fastest, which explains where AI progress is heading.
summary_zh: 提出「验证者法则」：验证远比求解容易的任务，正是强化学习最快攻克的任务，以此解释 AI 进展的方向。

title_en: Becoming an RL diehard in the past year and thinking about RL for most of my waking hours inadvertently taught me an important lesson about how to live my own l
title_zh: Becoming an RL diehard in the past year and thinking about RL for most of my waking hours inadvertently taught me an important lesson about how to live my own l
summary_en: Wei reflects on how a year immersed in reinforcement learning reshaped how he thinks about setting goals in his own life.
summary_zh: Wei反思过去一年沉浸于强化学习的研究如何改变了他对自己人生目标设定方式的看法。

title_en: New blog post about asymmetry of verification and "verifier's law": https://t.co/bvS8HrX1jP Asymmetry of verification–the idea that some tasks are much easier t
title_zh: New blog post about asymmetry of verification and "verifier's law": https://t.co/bvS8HrX1jP Asymmetry of verification–the idea that some tasks are much easier t
summary_en: Wei announces a blog post introducing 'verifier's law': the idea that tasks are far easier to verify than to solve, and why that asymmetry matters for AI progress.
summary_zh: Wei发布博客文章提出"验证者法则":验证任务远比解决任务容易,并阐述这种不对称性对AI进展的意义。

title_en: Bryan Johnson longevity mix is the most popular drink at ragers in SF https://t.co/zJE36CoV6V
title_zh: Bryan Johnson longevity mix is the most popular drink at ragers in SF https://t.co/zJE36CoV6V
summary_en: Wei notes that Bryan Johnson's longevity drink mix has become a popular fixture at San Francisco parties.
summary_zh: Wei提到Bryan Johnson的长寿饮品配方已成为旧金山派对上颇受欢迎的饮品。

title_en: We don’t have AI self-improves yet, and when we do it will be a game-changer. With more wisdom now compared to the GPT-4 days, it's obvious that it will not be
title_zh: We don’t have AI self-improves yet, and when we do it will be a game-changer. With more wisdom now compared to the GPT-4 days, it's obvious that it will not be
summary_en: Wei argues AI has not yet achieved self-improvement, and that when it does, progress will be fast but not an overnight 'fast takeoff'.
summary_zh: Wei认为AI尚未实现自我提升,一旦实现,进展会很快,但不会是一夜之间的"快速起飞"。

title_en: The most rewarding thing about working in the office on nights and weekends is not the actual work you get done, but the spontaneous conversations with other pe
title_zh: The most rewarding thing about working in the office on nights and weekends is not the actual work you get done, but the spontaneous conversations with other pe
summary_en: Wei says the real reward of working late in the office isn't the output, but the spontaneous conversations with other people still working.
summary_zh: Wei表示深夜在办公室工作真正的收获不是产出本身,而是与同样在加班的人的即兴交流。

title_en: I would say that we are undoubtedly at AGI when AI can create a real, living unicorn. And no I don’t mean a $1B company you nerds, I mean a literal pink horse w
title_zh: I would say that we are undoubtedly at AGI when AI can create a real, living unicorn. And no I don’t mean a $1B company you nerds, I mean a literal pink horse w
summary_en: Wei offers a memorable bar for AGI: not a $1B company, but AI that can literally create a living unicorn.
summary_zh: Wei给出一个令人印象深刻的AGI判定标准:不是十亿美元的公司,而是AI能真正创造出一只活的独角兽。

title_en: The greatest contribution of human language is bootstrapping language model training
title_zh: The greatest contribution of human language is bootstrapping language model training
summary_en: Wei argues the greatest contribution of human language is that it bootstraps the training of language models.
summary_zh: Wei认为人类语言最大的贡献在于它为语言模型的训练提供了起点。

title_en: AI research is strange in that you spend a massive amount of compute on experiments to learn simple ideas that can be expressed in just a few sentences. Literal
title_zh: AI research is strange in that you spend a massive amount of compute on experiments to learn simple ideas that can be expressed in just a few sentences. Literal
summary_en: Wei observes that AI research often spends huge compute budgets to learn ideas that can be summarized in a few sentences.
summary_zh: Wei指出AI研究常常投入巨大算力,只为得出几句话就能概括的简单结论。

title_en: My favorite thing an old OpenAI buddy of mine told me is, whenever he hears that someone is a “great AI researcher”, he just directly spends 5 minutes looking a
title_zh: My favorite thing an old OpenAI buddy of mine told me is, whenever he hears that someone is a “great AI researcher”, he just directly spends 5 minutes looking a
summary_en: Wei shares an ex-OpenAI colleague's heuristic for judging a 'great AI researcher': spend five minutes looking at their PRs and wandb runs.
summary_zh: Wei分享一位前OpenAI同事判断"优秀AI研究者"的方法:花五分钟看这个人的PR和wandb训练记录。

title_en: One way of thinking about what AI will automate first is via the “description-execution gap”: how much harder is it to describe the task than to actually do it?
title_zh: One way of thinking about what AI will automate first is via the “description-execution gap”: how much harder is it to describe the task than to actually do it?
summary_en: Wei proposes the 'description-execution gap' as a lens for predicting which tasks AI will automate first: those far easier to do than to describe.
summary_zh: Wei提出"描述-执行差距"这一视角,用来预测AI会率先自动化哪些任务:即执行远比描述容易的任务。

title_en: RL environment specs are among the most consequential things we can write as AI researchers. A relatively short spec (e.g., <1000 words of instructions sayin
title_zh: RL environment specs are among the most consequential things we can write as AI researchers. A relatively short spec (e.g., <1000 words of instructions sayin
summary_en: Wei argues that RL environment specs — short instructions defining problems and grading criteria — are among the most consequential documents AI researchers write.
summary_zh: Wei认为强化学习环境规格说明——定义问题和评分标准的简短指令——是AI研究者撰写的最具影响力的文档之一。

title_en: It’s actually a good thing these days to have subtle grammar errors in your writing. It sprinkles on a clear human touch. You never want your reader questioning
title_zh: It’s actually a good thing these days to have subtle grammar errors in your writing. It sprinkles on a clear human touch. You never want your reader questioning
summary_en: Wei argues that subtle grammar errors in writing now signal authentic human authorship, as readers grow wary of AI-generated text.
summary_zh: Wei认为如今文字中细微的语法错误反而成了真实人类写作的标志,因为读者越来越警惕AI生成的文本。

title_en: Was attending a talk in a big lecture hall and the guy in front of me had the craziest conversation with ChatGPT for the whole hour about how to get his girlfri
title_zh: Was attending a talk in a big lecture hall and the guy in front of me had the craziest conversation with ChatGPT for the whole hour about how to get his girlfri
summary_en: Wei recounts overhearing a stranger's hour-long ChatGPT conversation about winning back his girlfriend, an anecdote on how deeply people lean on AI for personal problems.
summary_zh: Wei讲述在一场讲座上无意听到陌生人用ChatGPT进行长达一小时的对话,试图挽回女友,以此说明人们已深度依赖AI处理个人问题。

title_en: The 80-20 rule happens often in AI research, where you get 80% of the payoff from the first 20% of the effort. But there is often also an inverse rule, where it
title_zh: The 80-20 rule happens often in AI research, where you get 80% of the payoff from the first 20% of the effort. But there is often also an inverse rule, where it
summary_en: Wei describes how the 80-20 rule often applies in AI research, but notes an inverse effect where the final 20% of effort can yield the most payoff.
summary_zh: Wei描述二八法则在AI研究中的常见表现,同时指出有时会出现相反效应——最后20%的努力反而带来最大回报。

title_en: There are traditionally two types of research: problem-driven research and method-driven research. As we’ve seen with large language models and now AlphaEvolve,
title_zh: There are traditionally two types of research: problem-driven research and method-driven research. As we’ve seen with large language models and now AlphaEvolve,
summary_en: Wei distinguishes problem-driven from method-driven research and argues AlphaEvolve shows total compute now matters more than which camp you're in.
summary_zh: Wei区分了问题驱动型与方法驱动型研究,并认为AlphaEvolve表明如今总算力投入比属于哪种研究路线更重要。

title_en: AI research is a max-performance domain
title_zh: AI research is a max-performance domain
summary_en: Argues AI research is a "max-performance domain" where being world-class at one part of the job is enough, unlike fields that demand consistent all-round performance.
summary_zh: 提出 AI 研究是「极值表现型领域」：只要在工作的某一环节做到世界一流即可，不同于要求全面稳定发挥的领域。

title_en: A recent clarity that I gained is viewing AI research as a “max-performance domain”, which means that you can be world-class by being very good at only one part
title_zh: A recent clarity that I gained is viewing AI research as a “max-performance domain”, which means that you can be world-class by being very good at only one part
summary_en: Wei describes AI research as a 'max-performance domain', where being world-class at just one part of the job can be enough.
summary_zh: Wei将AI研究描述为一个"最大性能领域",在其中只需在工作的某一环节做到世界一流即可脱颖而出。

title_en: The most impressive thing that Tesla FSD can do that I’ve never seen any human is that it stays calm and doesn’t get upset after my mom criticizes its driving f
title_zh: The most impressive thing that Tesla FSD can do that I’ve never seen any human is that it stays calm and doesn’t get upset after my mom criticizes its driving f
summary_en: Wei jokes that Tesla's full self-driving impresses him most by staying calm despite his mom criticizing its driving the whole trip.
summary_zh: Wei打趣说,特斯拉全自动驾驶最让他佩服的一点,是即使他妈妈全程批评它的开车方式,它依然保持"冷静"。

title_en: The AI milestone that would touch my heart the most is not solving International Math Olympiad or even breakthrough scientific discovery, but if AI could animat
title_zh: The AI milestone that would touch my heart the most is not solving International Math Olympiad or even breakthrough scientific discovery, but if AI could animat
summary_en: Wei says the AI milestone that would move him most isn't solving math olympiads or scientific discovery, but AI animating another season of Avatar: The Last Airbender.
summary_zh: Wei表示最能打动他的AI里程碑不是攻克数学奥赛或科学发现,而是AI能制作出《降世神通》新一季动画。

title_en: Discriminator-generator gap seems to be the most important idea in AI for scientific innovation. With compute + clever search, anything that we can measure will
title_zh: Discriminator-generator gap seems to be the most important idea in AI for scientific innovation. With compute + clever search, anything that we can measure will
summary_en: Wei calls the discriminator-generator gap the most important idea for AI-driven scientific innovation, since anything measurable can be optimized with compute and search.
summary_zh: Wei认为判别器-生成器差距是AI推动科学创新中最重要的理念,因为任何可被衡量的东西都能通过算力和搜索得到优化。

title_en: AlphaEvolve is deeply disturbing for RL diehards like yours truly Maybe midtrain + good search is all you need for AI for scientific innovation And what an alph
title_zh: AlphaEvolve is deeply disturbing for RL diehards like yours truly Maybe midtrain + good search is all you need for AI for scientific innovation And what an alph
summary_en: Wei reacts to DeepMind's AlphaEvolve, calling it unsettling evidence that mid-training plus good search may be all that's needed for AI-driven scientific discovery.
summary_zh: Wei评论DeepMind的AlphaEvolve,称其令人不安地证明中期训练加良好搜索或许就足以推动AI科学发现。

title_en: HealthBench: Evaluating Large Language Models Towards Improved Human Health
title_zh: HealthBench: Evaluating Large Language Models Towards Improved Human Health
summary_en: OpenAI benchmark of 5,000 physician-graded multi-turn health conversations, co-authored by Wei.
summary_zh: OpenAI 发布的健康对话评测基准，包含 5000 组由医生评分的多轮对话，Wei 是共同作者。

title_en: New HealthBench eval! Very excited we (@OpenAI) are investing in AI for health, a defining use case for AGI. Favorite plot is how the performance-cost frontier
title_zh: New HealthBench eval! Very excited we (@OpenAI) are investing in AI for health, a defining use case for AGI. Favorite plot is how the performance-cost frontier
summary_en: Wei announces a new HealthBench evaluation from OpenAI, highlighting how the performance-cost frontier for AI in health has improved over time.
summary_zh: Wei宣布OpenAI推出新的HealthBench评测,展示AI在健康领域性能与成本的权衡曲线如何不断改善。

title_en: Ten binary-choice questions that reveal a lot about your taste as an AI researcher. What are your preferences? 1. ChatGPT or Claude? 2. LMSYS or math competitio
title_zh: Ten binary-choice questions that reveal a lot about your taste as an AI researcher. What are your preferences? 1. ChatGPT or Claude? 2. LMSYS or math competitio
summary_en: Wei poses ten binary-choice questions meant to reveal an AI researcher's taste and preferences, from ChatGPT vs. Claude to training vs. test-time compute.
summary_zh: Wei提出十道二选一问题,用来揭示AI研究者的偏好与品味,比如ChatGPT还是Claude、训练算力还是推理算力。

title_en: The longest chain-of-thought / reasoning trace I have witnessed was almost twenty minutes long and involved crazy backtracking, constraint verification, and too
title_zh: The longest chain-of-thought / reasoning trace I have witnessed was almost twenty minutes long and involved crazy backtracking, constraint verification, and too
summary_en: Wei describes witnessing a nearly twenty-minute chain-of-thought reasoning trace involving extensive backtracking, constraint verification, and tool use.
summary_zh: Wei描述自己见过的最长思维链推理轨迹长达近二十分钟,涉及大量回溯、约束验证和工具调用。

title_en: Beautifully written post from Shunyu connects the dots the past 10 years in AI: - Winners of the “first half” of the AI game have been methods papers, not bench
title_zh: Beautifully written post from Shunyu connects the dots the past 10 years in AI: - Winners of the “first half” of the AI game have been methods papers, not bench
summary_en: Wei amplifies a post from Shunyu Yao tracing the last decade of AI progress, adding his own summary of how the field's 'winners' have shifted.
summary_zh: Wei转发姚顺雨梳理AI过去十年发展脉络的文章,并补充总结该领域"赢家"角色的变化。

title_en: Peak AI x singapore https://t.co/EOo7CawxL4
title_zh: Peak AI x singapore https://t.co/EOo7CawxL4
summary_en: Wei posts a photo captioned 'Peak AI x Singapore' from an AI event in Singapore.
summary_zh: Wei发布一张配文"Peak AI x Singapore"的照片,记录在新加坡参加的一场AI活动。

title_en: BrowseComp: A Simple Yet Challenging Benchmark for Browsing Agents
title_zh: BrowseComp: A Simple Yet Challenging Benchmark for Browsing Agents
summary_en: Wei is first author on BrowseComp, OpenAI's 1,266-question benchmark for web-browsing agents.
summary_zh: Wei 以第一作者身份提出 BrowseComp，这是 OpenAI 面向网页浏览智能体的 1266 题评测基准。

title_en: New benchmark for deep research agents! An agent that is creative and persistent should be able to find any piece of information on the open web, even if it req
title_zh: New benchmark for deep research agents! An agent that is creative and persistent should be able to find any piece of information on the open web, even if it req
summary_en: Wei announces a new benchmark testing whether deep research agents can find any piece of information on the open web, however obscure.
summary_zh: Wei发布一个新基准,测试深度研究智能体能否在开放网络上找到任何(哪怕极其冷僻的)信息。

title_en: I am super excited for AI for scientific innovation, a direction that will certainly grow in the next five years. I think there will be two flavors of it. The f
title_zh: I am super excited for AI for scientific innovation, a direction that will certainly grow in the next five years. I think there will be two flavors of it. The f
summary_en: Wei says he's excited about AI for scientific innovation as a growth direction for the next five years, outlining two distinct approaches to it.
summary_zh: Wei表示对"AI用于科学创新"这一方向未来五年的发展感到兴奋,并概述了实现它的两种不同路径。

title_en: Recently I have taken on a more defensive style of “debugging-prioritized” model training: - Create toy datasets that are easy to understand and have highly exp
title_zh: Recently I have taken on a more defensive style of “debugging-prioritized” model training: - Create toy datasets that are easy to understand and have highly exp
summary_en: Wei describes adopting a 'debugging-prioritized' style of model training, using toy datasets with predictable behavior as sanity checks.
summary_zh: Wei描述自己采用"以调试为先"的模型训练方式,用行为可预期的小型数据集作为健全性检查。

title_en: In today’s competitive product landscape, scientific understanding of models often lags behind speed of model deployment. If the goal is to train a deployable m
title_zh: In today’s competitive product landscape, scientific understanding of models often lags behind speed of model deployment. If the goal is to train a deployable m
summary_en: Wei argues scientific understanding of models often lags behind the speed of product deployment, a tension in training deployable models under compute constraints.
summary_zh: Wei指出对模型的科学理解常常落后于产品部署的速度,这在算力受限下训练可部署模型时形成矛盾。

title_en: Seems to be not a coincidence that what AI is good at is correlated with the backgrounds of AI researchers. Demis was a chess prodigy; Jakub (Chief Scientist) a
title_zh: Seems to be not a coincidence that what AI is good at is correlated with the backgrounds of AI researchers. Demis was a chess prodigy; Jakub (Chief Scientist) a
summary_en: Wei observes that what AI excels at correlates with the backgrounds of its top researchers, citing Demis Hassabis's chess background as an example.
summary_zh: Wei观察到AI擅长的领域与顶尖研究者的背景相关,并以Demis Hassabis的国际象棋背景为例。

title_en: Made this plot for an upcoming talk---crazy how quickly benchmarks get saturated these days. Looking forward to seeing how things play out for Humanity's Last E
title_zh: Made this plot for an upcoming talk---crazy how quickly benchmarks get saturated these days. Looking forward to seeing how things play out for Humanity's Last E
summary_en: Wei shares a chart made for an upcoming talk showing how quickly AI benchmarks get saturated, and looks ahead to Humanity's Last Exam.
summary_zh: Wei分享一张为演讲准备的图表,展示AI基准测试被迅速刷满的速度,并展望"人类终极考试"基准。

title_en: Very excited to finally share OpenAI's "deep research" model, which achieves twice the score of o3-mini on Humanity's Last Exam, and can even perform some tasks
title_zh: Very excited to finally share OpenAI's "deep research" model, which achieves twice the score of o3-mini on Humanity's Last Exam, and can even perform some tasks
summary_en: Wei announces OpenAI's 'deep research' model, which doubles o3-mini's score on Humanity's Last Exam and can complete some tasks that would take PhD experts over ten hours.
summary_zh: Wei宣布OpenAI的"深度研究"模型上线,其在"人类终极考试"上的得分是o3-mini的两倍,并能完成部分需要博士专家耗时十余小时的任务。

title_en: Dopamine cycles in AI research
title_zh: Dopamine cycles in AI research
summary_en: Describes the daily dopamine cycle of running experiments in AI research and how it shapes which problems researchers choose to work on.
summary_zh: 描述 AI 研究中每天跑实验形成的多巴胺循环，以及它如何影响研究者选择做什么问题。

title_en: Somewhat meta but there is a dopamine cycle in doing AI research that is pretty interesting Every day you wake up and you think about what experiment to run. Yo
title_zh: Somewhat meta but there is a dopamine cycle in doing AI research that is pretty interesting Every day you wake up and you think about what experiment to run. Yo
summary_en: Wei describes the daily dopamine cycle of AI research: waking up, picking an experiment, and living with the uncertainty of whether it will pan out.
summary_zh: Wei描述AI研究中每日的"多巴胺循环":醒来后决定要做什么实验,并承受实验是否成功的不确定性。

title_en: Magic is what happens when an unstoppable RL optimization algorithm powered by sufficient compute meets an unhackable RL environment
title_zh: Magic is what happens when an unstoppable RL optimization algorithm powered by sufficient compute meets an unhackable RL environment
summary_en: Wei offers a pithy definition of AI 'magic': an unstoppable RL optimization algorithm with sufficient compute meeting an unhackable RL environment.
summary_zh: Wei用一句话定义AI的"魔法":拥有充足算力、无法被攻破的强化学习优化算法遇上不可被作弊的强化学习环境。

title_en: Nice paper from Deepmind takes a fresh angle on factuality: https://t.co/3MDQlmNU9W While most existing factuality datasets focus on public world knowledge, thi
title_zh: Nice paper from Deepmind takes a fresh angle on factuality: https://t.co/3MDQlmNU9W While most existing factuality datasets focus on public world knowledge, thi
summary_en: Wei highlights a DeepMind paper taking a new angle on factuality, evaluating whether model responses are grounded rather than just testing public world knowledge.
summary_zh: Wei推荐一篇DeepMind论文,从新角度研究事实性问题,评估模型回答是否有据可依,而非仅测试公共常识。

title_en: An underrated but occasionally make-or-break skill in AI research (that didn’t really exist ten years ago) is the ability to find a dataset that actually exerci
title_zh: An underrated but occasionally make-or-break skill in AI research (that didn’t really exist ten years ago) is the ability to find a dataset that actually exerci
summary_en: Wei argues that finding a dataset that genuinely exercises a new method — a skill barely needed a decade ago — is an underrated, make-or-break AI research skill.
summary_zh: Wei认为找到真正能检验新方法的数据集,是一项十年前几乎不存在、如今却常常决定成败的被低估的AI研究技能。

title_en: Reflecting back, these were the biggest technical lessons for me in AI in the past five years: 2020: you can cast any language task as sequence prediction and l
title_zh: Reflecting back, these were the biggest technical lessons for me in AI in the past five years: 2020: you can cast any language task as sequence prediction and l
summary_en: Wei recaps the biggest technical lessons he's drawn from AI research each year since 2020, from sequence prediction to scaling.
summary_zh: Wei回顾了自2020年以来他每年从AI研究中得到的最大技术心得,从序列预测到规模扩展。

title_en: Realization: the old style of “hallucinations research” via self-calibration is probably going to die down. I used to be very excited about it but now I am skep
title_zh: Realization: the old style of “hallucinations research” via self-calibration is probably going to die down. I used to be very excited about it but now I am skep
summary_en: Wei predicts self-calibration approaches to hallucination research will fade, now that models increasingly have internet access to check themselves against.
summary_zh: Wei预测基于自我校准的幻觉研究方向将逐渐式微,因为模型正越来越多地获得联网核实的能力。

title_en: OpenAI o1 System Card
title_zh: OpenAI o1 System Card
summary_en: OpenAI's system card for the o1 reasoning series, on which Wei is a listed contributor.
summary_zh: OpenAI o1 推理模型系列的系统卡，Wei 是署名贡献者之一。

title_en: Biggest unsolved problem in artificial intelligence is what to do in the 3-5 minutes when o3 is thinking
title_zh: Biggest unsolved problem in artificial intelligence is what to do in the 3-5 minutes when o3 is thinking
summary_en: Wei jokes that the biggest unsolved problem in AI is what humans should do during the few minutes a reasoning model like o3 spends thinking.
summary_zh: Wei打趣道,AI领域最大的未解难题是:当o3这样的推理模型思考三五分钟时,人类该做什么。

title_en: Deliberative Alignment: Reasoning Enables Safer Language Models
title_zh: Deliberative Alignment: Reasoning Enables Safer Language Models
summary_en: OpenAI paper on training models to reason explicitly over safety policies before answering; Wei is a co-author.
summary_zh: OpenAI 关于让模型在作答前显式推理安全规范的论文，Wei 为共同作者。

title_en: Measuring short-form factuality in large language models
title_zh: Measuring short-form factuality in large language models
summary_en: Wei is first author on SimpleQA, OpenAI's benchmark for short-form factuality in language models.
summary_zh: Wei 以第一作者身份提出 SimpleQA，用于衡量语言模型在简答事实题上的准确率。

title_en: GPT-4o System Card
title_zh: GPT-4o System Card
summary_en: OpenAI's GPT-4o system card, which lists Wei among the contributors.
summary_zh: OpenAI GPT-4o 系统卡，Wei 位列贡献者名单。

title_en: Successful language model evals
title_zh: Successful language model evals
summary_en: Sets out what makes a language model eval succeed and get adopted, arguing that evals act as the research community's incentive structure.
summary_zh: 探讨什么样的语言模型评测才算成功并被广泛采用，认为评测实际上构成了研究社区的激励机制。

title_en: Six intuitions about large language models
title_zh: Six intuitions about large language models
summary_en: Six intuitions for why large language models work so well, drawn largely from manually inspecting model behaviour rather than from theory.
summary_zh: 提出关于大语言模型为何有效的六个直觉，主要来自对模型行为的人工观察而非理论推导。

title_en: FreshLLMs: Refreshing Large Language Models with Search Engine Augmentation
title_zh: FreshLLMs: Refreshing Large Language Models with Search Engine Augmentation
summary_en: Study of how language models handle fast-changing facts, with a search-augmented prompting fix; Wei is a co-author.
summary_zh: 研究语言模型如何应对快速变化的事实，并提出结合搜索的提示方法，Wei 为共同作者。

title_en: Observations from tracking Twitter
title_zh: Observations from tracking Twitter
summary_en: Reports what he learned from systematically tracking his own Twitter activity, on research communication as part of doing research well.
summary_zh: 记录他系统追踪自己推特数据后的发现，讨论研究传播本身也是做好研究的一部分。

title_en: Mixture-of-Experts Meets Instruction Tuning:A Winning Combination for Large Language Models
title_zh: Mixture-of-Experts Meets Instruction Tuning:A Winning Combination for Large Language Models
summary_en: Shows sparse mixture-of-experts models benefit disproportionately from instruction tuning; Wei is a co-author.
summary_zh: 论文表明稀疏专家混合模型从指令微调中获益尤为明显，Wei 为共同作者。

title_en: A Pretrainer's Guide to Training Data: Measuring the Effects of Data Age, Domain Coverage, Quality, & Toxicity
title_zh: A Pretrainer's Guide to Training Data: Measuring the Effects of Data Age, Domain Coverage, Quality, & Toxicity
summary_en: Empirical study of how pretraining data age, domain coverage, quality and toxicity affect language models; Wei is a co-author.
summary_zh: 系统研究预训练数据的时效、领域覆盖、质量与毒性对语言模型的影响，Wei 为共同作者。

title_en: Common arguments regarding emergent abilities
title_zh: Common arguments regarding emergent abilities
summary_en: Responds to the common objections to emergent abilities in large language models, a direct follow-up to the emergence paper he co-authored.
summary_zh: 回应外界对大语言模型「涌现能力」的常见质疑，是他参与撰写的涌现能力论文的直接后续。

title_en: GPT-4 Technical Report
title_zh: GPT-4 Technical Report
summary_en: OpenAI's GPT-4 technical report, on which Wei is a listed contributor.
summary_zh: OpenAI GPT-4 技术报告，Wei 是署名贡献者之一。

title_en: Foundation Models for Decision Making: Problems, Methods, and Opportunities
title_zh: Foundation Models for Decision Making: Problems, Methods, and Opportunities
summary_en: Survey framing foundation models as agents for sequential decision making; Wei is a co-author.
summary_zh: 把基础模型置于序贯决策场景下的综述，Wei 为共同作者。

title_en: Larger language models do in-context learning differently
title_zh: Larger language models do in-context learning differently
summary_en: Finds that large models can override semantic priors and learn from flipped or arbitrary in-context labels; Wei is second author.
summary_zh: 发现大模型能够覆盖语义先验，从翻转或任意的上下文标签中学习，Wei 为第二作者。

title_en: Practicing AI research
title_zh: Practicing AI research
summary_en: Practical advice on how to do AI research, covering how he picks problems, runs experiments and works with collaborators.
summary_zh: 关于如何做 AI 研究的实践建议，涵盖他如何选题、跑实验以及与合作者协作。

title_en: The Flan Collection: Designing Data and Methods for Effective Instruction Tuning
title_zh: The Flan Collection: Designing Data and Methods for Effective Instruction Tuning
summary_en: Documents the data and method choices behind Flan 2022 instruction tuning, a direct continuation of Wei's FLAN work.
summary_zh: 梳理 Flan 2022 指令微调背后的数据与方法选择，是 Wei 的 FLAN 系列工作的延续。

title_en: Research I enjoy
title_zh: Research I enjoy
summary_en: On choosing research you actually enjoy, arguing that enjoyment is what sustains output over a career-length endeavour.
summary_zh: 谈如何选择自己真正享受的研究方向，认为兴趣才是支撑数十年科研产出的动力。

title_en: Large Language Models Encode Clinical Knowledge
title_zh: Large Language Models Encode Clinical Knowledge
summary_en: Introduces MultiMedQA and Med-PaLM for medical question answering; Wei is a co-author.
summary_zh: 提出 MultiMedQA 基准与 Med-PaLM 医学问答模型，Wei 为共同作者。

title_en: 137 emergent abilities of large language models
title_zh: 137 emergent abilities of large language models
summary_en: His running catalogue of 137 emergent abilities observed in large language models, the reference list behind the emergent abilities work.
summary_zh: 他持续维护的大语言模型 137 项涌现能力清单，是涌现能力研究背后的参考列表。

title_en: Inverse scaling can become U-shaped
title_zh: Inverse scaling can become U-shaped
summary_en: Wei is first author on this result showing inverse-scaling tasks reverse into U-shaped curves at larger scale.
summary_zh: Wei 以第一作者发表的结果，指出所谓逆缩放任务在更大模型上会反转成 U 形曲线。

title_en: Scaling Instruction-Finetuned Language Models
title_zh: Scaling Instruction-Finetuned Language Models
summary_en: The Flan-T5 / Flan-PaLM paper scaling instruction finetuning across tasks and model sizes; Wei is a co-author.
summary_zh: Flan-T5 / Flan-PaLM 论文，把指令微调扩展到更多任务与更大模型，Wei 为共同作者。

title_en: Transcending Scaling Laws with 0.1% Extra Compute
title_zh: Transcending Scaling Laws with 0.1% Extra Compute
summary_en: Shows a short extra UL2 training stage adds substantial capability for about 0.1% extra compute; Wei is second author.
summary_zh: 论文表明用约 0.1% 的额外算力继续做一段 UL2 训练即可显著提升模型能力，Wei 为第二作者。

title_en: Challenging BIG-Bench Tasks and Whether Chain-of-Thought Can Solve Them
title_zh: Challenging BIG-Bench Tasks and Whether Chain-of-Thought Can Solve Them
summary_en: Isolates 23 hard BIG-Bench tasks (BBH) and shows chain-of-thought prompting solves many of them; Wei is a co-author.
summary_zh: 从 BIG-Bench 中筛出 23 个困难任务（BBH），证明思维链提示能解决其中不少，Wei 为共同作者。

title_en: Mind's Eye: Grounded Language Model Reasoning through Simulation
title_zh: Mind's Eye: Grounded Language Model Reasoning through Simulation
summary_en: Grounds language-model reasoning by running a physics simulator and feeding the results back into the prompt; Wei is second author.
summary_zh: 通过调用物理仿真器并把结果回填进提示，为语言模型推理提供物理世界依据，Wei 为第二作者。

title_en: Language Models are Multilingual Chain-of-Thought Reasoners
title_zh: Language Models are Multilingual Chain-of-Thought Reasoners
summary_en: Introduces the MGSM benchmark and shows chain-of-thought reasoning transfers across languages; Wei is a co-author.
summary_zh: 提出 MGSM 基准，证明思维链推理可以跨语言迁移，Wei 为共同作者。

title_en: Rationale-Augmented Ensembles in Language Models
title_zh: Rationale-Augmented Ensembles in Language Models
summary_en: Studies ensembling over sampled rationales as a way to make chain-of-thought prompting more robust; Wei is second author.
summary_zh: 研究对采样得到的推理链做集成，使思维链提示更稳健，Wei 为第二作者。

title_en: Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models
title_zh: Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models
summary_en: Wei is first author of the paper that named emergent abilities of large language models, one of his most cited works.
summary_zh: Wei 以第一作者提出大语言模型的涌现能力这一概念，是他被引用最多的工作之一。

title_en: Least-to-Most Prompting Enables Complex Reasoning in Large Language Models
title_zh: Least-to-Most Prompting Enables Complex Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary_en: Least-to-most prompting, which decomposes a problem into subproblems solved in sequence; Wei is a co-author.
summary_zh: 提出由简至繁提示法，把问题拆成子问题依次求解，Wei 为共同作者。

title_en: UL2: Unifying Language Learning Paradigms
title_zh: UL2: Unifying Language Learning Paradigms
summary_en: The UL2 mixture-of-denoisers pretraining objective and model family; Wei is a co-author.
summary_zh: UL2 论文，提出混合去噪器的统一预训练目标与模型系列，Wei 为共同作者。

title_en: Joins Meta's superintelligence lab from OpenAI
title_zh: 从 OpenAI 加入 Meta 超级智能实验室
summary_en: Moves alongside Hyung Won Chung, a long-time collaborator at both Google and OpenAI. At OpenAI he worked on reasoning and agents, and is best known there for o3 and deep research.
summary_zh: 与在 Google 和 OpenAI 都长期合作的 Hyung Won Chung 一同加入。在 OpenAI 期间他从事推理与智能体研究，最知名的成果是 o3 与 deep research。

title_en: White-Box Transformers via Sparse Rate Reduction
title_zh: 经由稀疏率约简的白盒 Transformer

title_en: ReduNet: a white-box deep network from the principle of maximizing rate reduction
title_zh: ReduNet：源于最大化率约简原理的白盒深度网络

title_en: Wonder how many are AI-generated and noises... As our theory of intelligence has suggested, the essence of intelligence is the ability to remove noise and reduc
title_zh: Wonder how many are AI-generated and noises... As our theory of intelligence has suggested, the essence of intelligence is the ability to remove noise and reduc
summary_en: Ma applied his theory that intelligence is fundamentally about reducing noise and entropy to a discussion of AI-generated online content.
summary_zh: 马毅将其"智能的本质是消除噪声、降低熵"的理论应用于对网络AI生成内容的讨论。

title_en: The only reason why this is happening is because there is little cost in producing noises and the reviewing process is noisy too hence noises get through. One s
title_zh: The only reason why this is happening is because there is little cost in producing noises and the reviewing process is noisy too hence noises get through. One s
summary_en: Ma argued that peer review is being flooded with low-effort submissions because producing noise is costless, and proposed charging a submission fee to curb it.
summary_zh: 马毅认为学术评审正被低成本制造的"噪声"投稿淹没，并提议通过收取投稿费来遏制这一现象。

title_en: People keep talking about aligning AI with humans. Judging from the behaviours of the frontier labs, I wonder: Are we humans aligned among ourselves? Are people
title_zh: People keep talking about aligning AI with humans. Judging from the behaviours of the frontier labs, I wonder: Are we humans aligned among ourselves? Are people
summary_en: Yi Ma questioned whether humans are even aligned among themselves, challenging the framing of AI-human alignment.
summary_zh: 马毅质疑人类彼此之间是否真正“对齐”，对“AI与人类对齐”这一提法本身提出了反思。

title_en: As I have said many times by now, there is only one type of intelligence: one that can self-learn and self-improve its own knowledge. That is *the* common chara
title_zh: As I have said many times by now, there is only one type of intelligence: one that can self-learn and self-improve its own knowledge. That is *the* common chara
summary_en: Yi Ma restated his core thesis that intelligence is defined by the capacity to self-learn and self-improve, the same parsimony and self-consistency argument underlying his theoretical work.
summary_zh: 马毅重申了他的核心观点：智能的本质在于能够自我学习与自我改进，这与他一直主张的简约性与自洽性理论一脉相承。

title_en: Why people who monger fear about AI and ask the (rest of the) world to slow down are always the ones who invest enormously in AI and constantly advance it at an
title_zh: Why people who monger fear about AI and ask the (rest of the) world to slow down are always the ones who invest enormously in AI and constantly advance it at an
summary_en: Ma argued that people who warn the world to slow down on AI are usually the same ones racing to invest in and advance it fastest.
summary_zh: 马毅认为，那些鼓吹AI威胁论、呼吁世界放缓的人，往往正是在AI领域投入最多、推进最快的人。

title_en: Automating mechanical programming and mathematical deduction are a good thing in a long run for the society -- More people can focus on using programs and mathe
title_zh: Automating mechanical programming and mathematical deduction are a good thing in a long run for the society -- More people can focus on using programs and mathe
summary_en: Ma argued that automating mechanical programming and mathematical deduction is a long-run good, freeing people to focus on real scientific and technical problems.
summary_zh: 马毅认为，将机械式编程与数学推导自动化从长远看是好事，能让人们把精力投入到真正的科学和技术问题上。

title_en: Computer scientists discover the power of *closed loop* and *error correction*! I have advocated for many years by now that all intelligent systems would be clo
title_zh: Computer scientists discover the power of *closed loop* and *error correction*! I have advocated for many years by now that all intelligent systems would be clo
summary_en: Ma argued that closed-loop, error-correcting design—not open-ended end-to-end systems—is the right path for intelligent systems, restating a long-standing position of his.
summary_zh: 马毅主张智能系统应采用闭环、可纠错的设计，而非开环端到端方案，重申了他一贯坚持的观点。

title_en: Whoever fear-mongering AI is probably trying to send three messages: one for investors, we are close to *the* end so it is now or never to be on my bandwagon; a
title_zh: Whoever fear-mongering AI is probably trying to send three messages: one for investors, we are close to *the* end so it is now or never to be on my bandwagon; a
summary_en: Yi Ma argues on X that AI fear-mongering serves two audiences at once — investors being told to jump on the bandwagon before it's too late, and governments being nudged toward restrictive policy.
summary_zh: 马毅在X上发文认为，渲染AI恐慌情绪同时说给两类人听：催促投资人赶紧上车的紧迫感，以及推动政府出台限制性政策的信号。

title_en: A good final representation of high-dim real world data (distributions) will always be linear and sparse. Sparse representation is also what our brain seeks.
title_zh: A good final representation of high-dim real world data (distributions) will always be linear and sparse. Sparse representation is also what our brain seeks.
summary_en: Yi Ma argues that good final representations of high-dimensional real-world data will always be linear and sparse, echoing his parsimony-based theory of deep learning.
summary_zh: 马毅提出，高维真实世界数据的良好最终表示总是线性且稀疏的，呼应他基于简约性的深度学习理论。

title_en: I agree with Terence’s view from the perspective of mathematics. However, relieving humans from mediocre mechanical mathematical deductions will allow most math
title_zh: I agree with Terence’s view from the perspective of mathematics. However, relieving humans from mediocre mechanical mathematical deductions will allow most math
summary_en: Ma weighed in on a debate sparked by Terence Tao, arguing that offloading routine mechanical math deduction to AI would free mathematicians to focus on deeper problems.
summary_zh: 马毅就陶哲轩引发的讨论发表看法，认为将常规机械式数学推导交给AI，能让数学家专注于更深层次的问题。

title_en: Scientists are entitled to their personal opinions. But they should be, better than most people, know the difference between personal opinions and scientific co
title_zh: Scientists are entitled to their personal opinions. But they should be, better than most people, know the difference between personal opinions and scientific co
summary_en: Yi Ma argued on X that scientists must clearly separate personal opinions from scientific conclusions grounded in rigorous evidence.
summary_zh: 马毅在X上表示，科学家应比常人更清楚地区分个人观点与需要严谨证据支撑的科学结论。

title_en: This is joint work from Hong Kong University and TranscEngram.
title_zh: This is joint work from Hong Kong University and TranscEngram.
summary_en: Yi Ma announced new joint research from the University of Hong Kong and TranscEngram.
summary_zh: 马毅宣布了一项由香港大学与TranscEngram合作完成的新研究工作。

title_en: The Imitator Game: Benchmarking Robot Imitative Ability Beyond Action Prediction
title_zh: The Imitator Game: Benchmarking Robot Imitative Ability Beyond Action Prediction
summary_en: An HKU benchmark he co-authored that tests whether robot policies imitate at the level of intent rather than merely copying the demonstrated actions.
summary_zh: 他参与合作的港大基准测试，考察机器人策略能否在意图层面进行模仿，而不只是复制示范动作。

title_en: To visit Singapore from August 16 to 19, giving an opening keynote (and a tutorial) at the Workshop on Mathematical Foundations of AI Models organized by the In
title_zh: To visit Singapore from August 16 to 19, giving an opening keynote (and a tutorial) at the Workshop on Mathematical Foundations of AI Models organized by the In
summary_en: Announced he will give the opening keynote and a tutorial at the Workshop on Mathematical Foundations of AI Models in Singapore, Aug 16-19 2026.
summary_zh: 宣布将于2026年8月16日至19日在新加坡的人工智能模型数学基础研讨会上做开幕主题演讲并主持一场教程。

title_en: Yes, almost... especially once one realizes, for high-dim data distributions with low-dim structures, Bayesian inference exactly corresponds to constrained opti
title_zh: Yes, almost... especially once one realizes, for high-dim data distributions with low-dim structures, Bayesian inference exactly corresponds to constrained opti
summary_en: Argues that for high-dimensional data with low-dimensional structure, Bayesian inference is exactly equivalent to constrained optimization — a core claim of his parsimony-based theory of intelligence.
summary_zh: 他提出，对于具有低维结构的高维数据，贝叶斯推断在数学上等价于约束优化——这是他简约性智能理论的核心论点。

title_en: Five years ago, while the entire AI industry is celebrating *end-to-end* models, we have made the rather unfavorable statement that all truly intelligent system
title_zh: Five years ago, while the entire AI industry is celebrating *end-to-end* models, we have made the rather unfavorable statement that all truly intelligent system
summary_en: Argues that, contrary to the industry's embrace of end-to-end models, truly intelligent systems must learn via closed-loop feedback — a five-year-old position he says has been vindicated.
summary_zh: 他指出，与业界追捧端到端模型相反，真正智能的系统必须通过闭环反馈来学习——这是他五年前就提出、如今认为已被验证的观点。

title_en: Now suddenly everyone in AI is talking about loops, whereas control system engineers (aka the cybernetics program) had known for a long time that all intelligen
title_zh: Now suddenly everyone in AI is talking about loops, whereas control system engineers (aka the cybernetics program) had known for a long time that all intelligen
summary_en: Says the AI field is only now catching up to what control-systems engineers (cybernetics) have long known: intelligent systems learn through closed loops.
summary_zh: 他表示，AI领域现在才意识到控制系统工程师（控制论）早已明白的道理：智能系统是通过闭环来学习的。

title_en: Well, this is also because folks in the industry are all committed to the current brute-force resource-demanding approach... as if this was the only way to real
title_zh: Well, this is also because folks in the industry are all committed to the current brute-force resource-demanding approach... as if this was the only way to real
summary_en: Criticizes the AI industry's continued commitment to brute-force, resource-heavy approaches as if that were the only path to intelligence.
summary_zh: 他批评AI行业依然执着于暴力、资源消耗型方法，仿佛那是实现智能的唯一途径。

title_en: Yes. Strictly speaking, deduction does not produce any new information or knowledge. But deducing from what requires ingenuity and creativity. Hence future math
title_zh: Yes. Strictly speaking, deduction does not produce any new information or knowledge. But deducing from what requires ingenuity and creativity. Hence future math
summary_en: Argues deduction alone produces no new knowledge, so future mathematics depends on people who can generate it — a stance on creativity versus formal reasoning.
summary_zh: 他认为演绎本身不会产生新知识，因此未来的数学要依靠能够生成新知识的人——这是他关于创造力与形式推理关系的观点。

title_en: Based on my understanding, or definition, of Intelligence, a system that can discover, create or innovate new useful information/knowledge by itself is a system
title_zh: Based on my understanding, or definition, of Intelligence, a system that can discover, create or innovate new useful information/knowledge by itself is a system
summary_en: Defines intelligence as a system's ability to discover, create or innovate new useful knowledge by itself, distinguishing it from systems that merely reproduce existing knowledge.
summary_zh: 他将智能定义为系统自主发现、创造或创新有用知识的能力，并以此将其与仅能复现已有知识的系统区分开来。

title_en: I have said the same thing for years. There will be new principled architectures that support optimization/learning mechanisms that are magnitudes more power-ef
title_zh: I have said the same thing for years. There will be new principled architectures that support optimization/learning mechanisms that are magnitudes more power-ef
summary_en: Reiterates his long-held view that new, principled architectures will emerge that are far more power-efficient than current practice.
summary_zh: 他重申长期以来的观点：将出现比当前做法更加节能高效的全新原理性架构。

title_en: Whom doesn’t come for the money, including Dario himself, despite whatever he claims…
title_zh: Whom doesn’t come for the money, including Dario himself, despite whatever he claims…
summary_en: Pushes back on the idea that AI researchers are purely money-driven, naming Dario Amodei as an example of someone whose stated motivations he's skeptical of.
summary_zh: 他反驳AI研究者纯粹为钱的说法，并点名Dario Amodei，对其所宣称的动机表示怀疑。

title_en: https://t.co/hWWDVPQ2iu Summer school at HKU CDS Shanghai campus.
title_zh: https://t.co/hWWDVPQ2iu Summer school at HKU CDS Shanghai campus.
summary_en: Shared photos from the summer school held at HKU CDS's Shanghai campus.
summary_zh: 分享了在港大数据科学学院上海校区举办的暑期学校的照片。

title_en: Wait, this is very detrimental: OpenAI wants (the government) to ban open AI?
title_zh: Wait, this is very detrimental: OpenAI wants (the government) to ban open AI?
summary_en: Reacts with alarm to reports that OpenAI is pushing for government restrictions on open AI models.
summary_zh: 对有关OpenAI推动政府限制开源AI模型的报道表示担忧。

title_en: Open source is always vital for science and technology to advance, and is particularly important for the study of (artificial) Intelligence, which is still at i
title_zh: Open source is always vital for science and technology to advance, and is particularly important for the study of (artificial) Intelligence, which is still at i
summary_en: Argues open source is vital to advancing science and technology, and especially important given how early-stage the study of intelligence still is.
summary_zh: 他认为开源对科技进步至关重要，鉴于智能研究仍处于早期阶段，开源尤为重要。

title_en: For the current AI technology, there is no duopoly, as China was forced to take the open-source position, thanks to the genius fear-mongering strategy taken byt
title_zh: For the current AI technology, there is no duopoly, as China was forced to take the open-source position, thanks to the genius fear-mongering strategy taken byt
summary_en: Argues there is no US-China AI duopoly, saying US strategy pushed China toward open source, and states his own view of what constitutes true intelligence.
summary_zh: 他认为中美AI并非双寡头格局，称中国是被美方策略逼向开源路线，并阐述了他对真正智能的看法。

title_en: Why the computer industry is so suddenly obsessed with proving most of their jobs are probably the easiest to be replaced by machines that they made in the firs
title_zh: Why the computer industry is so suddenly obsessed with proving most of their jobs are probably the easiest to be replaced by machines that they made in the firs
summary_en: Criticizes the computer industry for rushing to prove its own jobs are the easiest to automate, framing it as a way to charge others for the resulting disruption.
summary_zh: 他批评计算机行业急于证明自身工作最容易被机器取代，认为这是一种借此向他人收费的方式。

title_en: The new HKU CDS Shanghai Campus is hosting its first AI summer camp this week for high school students, from all over the world. I just gave an overview lecture
title_zh: The new HKU CDS Shanghai Campus is hosting its first AI summer camp this week for high school students, from all over the world. I just gave an overview lecture
summary_en: Gave the opening lecture on intelligence at the first AI summer camp for high-school students at HKU CDS's new Shanghai campus.
summary_zh: 在港大数据科学学院上海新校区举办的首届面向高中生的AI夏令营上，做了关于智能的开场讲座。

title_en: Well, try to produce and compare with a similar map of (robotics) companies in the Great Bay Area of Shenzhen/Hong Kong or the Yangzi Delta Area of Shanghai/Han
title_zh: Well, try to produce and compare with a similar map of (robotics) companies in the Great Bay Area of Shenzhen/Hong Kong or the Yangzi Delta Area of Shanghai/Han
summary_en: Discusses mapping robotics companies across China's Greater Bay Area and Yangtze River Delta, noting the limited overlap between the clusters.
summary_zh: 他探讨了绘制中国大湾区与长三角地区机器人公司分布图的问题，并指出两大产业集群之间重合有限。

title_en: As I have advocated for many years, Information Theory should serve as the theoretical foundation for the study of Intelligence. But the community as a whole ha
title_zh: As I have advocated for many years, Information Theory should serve as the theoretical foundation for the study of Intelligence. But the community as a whole ha
summary_en: Reiterates his long-standing advocacy that information theory should be the theoretical foundation for the study of intelligence, and argues the field has largely missed this.
summary_zh: 他重申多年来的主张：信息论应作为智能研究的理论基础，并认为该领域在很大程度上错失了这一机会。

title_en: Just came back from ICML. Gave a keynote at the Foundation of Deep Generative Models Workshop, in which I stated that Intelligence should be a scientific subjec

title_zh: The Mathematical Foundations of Intelligence [Professor Yi Ma]

title_en: “如果相信只靠 Scaling Laws 就能实现 AGI，你该改行了”，与香港大学马毅聊智能

summary_en: Yi Ma argues that scaling laws alone cannot achieve AGI, laying out his theoretical objections to the field's dominant empiricist, black-box approach.

summary_en: At the 2026 Bund Summit, Ma argued world models have moved beyond 3D reconstruction and object recognition toward perception, cognition, learning and value creation for robots in open physical environments.

title_zh: 马毅外滩大会谈AI与人的价值：共性与个性之间需要新平衡 香港大学计算与数据科学学院院长*「更好的AI时代，是每个人都能在里面找到人类社会共性价值和个人价值之间的新平衡」*在2026外滩大会对话环节中表示
summary_en: At the Bund Summit, Yi Ma, dean of HKU's School of Computing and Data Science, argues the AI era needs a new balance between shared human values and individual value.
summary_zh: 在外滩大会上，香港大学计算与数据科学学院院长马毅表示，更好的AI时代需要在人类社会共性价值与个人价值之间找到新的平衡。

summary_zh: 在与作家刘震云的对话中，港大计算与数据科学学院院长马毅指出，大语言模型能传递人类共有的知识，却难以理解个体独特的价值观——这与他对黑箱式AI的理论批判一致。

title_en: 刘震云、马毅谈AI时代：机器拿走共性，人更要守住个性

title_en: Not All Disagreement Is Learnable: Token Teachability in On-Policy Distillation
title_zh: Not All Disagreement Is Learnable: Token Teachability in On-Policy Distillation
summary_en: Studies which teacher-student token disagreements are actually learnable in on-policy distillation.
summary_zh: 研究在同策略蒸馏中，师生之间哪些 token 级别的分歧才是真正可学的。

title_en: OScaR: The Occam's Razor for Extreme KV Cache Quantization in LLMs and Beyond
title_zh: OScaR: The Occam's Razor for Extreme KV Cache Quantization in LLMs and Beyond

summary_zh: 一种极低比特 KV Cache 量化方法，用于缓解长上下文与多模态推理的显存瓶颈。

title_en: E-PMQ: Expert-Guided Post-Merge Quantization with Merged-Weight Anchoring
title_zh: E-PMQ: Expert-Guided Post-Merge Quantization with Merged-Weight Anchoring

summary_zh: 将模型合并与训练后量化结合，以合并后的权重为锚进行量化。

title_en: FeatCal: Feature Calibration for Post-Merging Models
title_zh: FeatCal: Feature Calibration for Post-Merging Models
summary_en: Calibrates features of merged models to recover the accuracy that merging loses relative to individual task experts.
summary_zh: 通过特征校准弥补合并模型相对单一任务专家模型的性能损失。

title_en: Geometry Conflict: Explaining and Controlling Forgetting in LLM Continual Post-Training
title_zh: Geometry Conflict: Explaining and Controlling Forgetting in LLM Continual Post-Training

title_en: Attention Sink in Transformers: A Survey on Utilization, Interpretation, and Mitigation
title_zh: Attention Sink in Transformers: A Survey on Utilization, Interpretation, and Mitigation

summary_zh: 关于 Transformer 中 attention sink 现象的综述，梳理其利用、解释与缓解方法。

title_en: InfiCoEvalChain: A Blockchain-Based Decentralized Framework for Collaborative LLM Evaluation
title_zh: InfiCoEvalChain: A Blockchain-Based Decentralized Framework for Collaborative LLM Evaluation
summary_en: A decentralized, blockchain-based framework for collaborative LLM evaluation, matching her public argument for decentralizing large models.

title_zh: MergePipe: A Budget-Aware Parameter Management System for Scalable LLM Merging

summary_zh: 面向预算的参数管理系统，让大规模大模型合并在工程流水线中可用。

title_en: BPDQ: Bit-Plane Decomposition Quantization on a Variable Grid for Large Language Models
title_zh: BPDQ: Bit-Plane Decomposition Quantization on a Variable Grid for Large Language Models
summary_en: A post-training quantization scheme using bit-plane decomposition on a variable grid for memory-constrained LLM serving.
summary_zh: 一种基于可变网格位平面分解的训练后量化方案，面向显存受限的大模型部署。

title_en: Canonical Intermediate Representation for LLM-based optimization problem formulation and code generation
title_zh: Canonical Intermediate Representation for LLM-based optimization problem formulation and code generation
summary_en: Uses a canonical intermediate representation so LLMs can turn natural-language descriptions into correct optimization models and code.
summary_zh: 引入规范化中间表示，让大模型能把自然语言描述转换成正确的优化模型与求解代码。

title_en: InfiAgent: An Infinite-Horizon Framework for General-Purpose Autonomous Agents
title_zh: InfiAgent: An Infinite-Horizon Framework for General-Purpose Autonomous Agents

summary_zh: 她实验室 InfiAgent 框架的无限时域版本，针对长任务中上下文膨胀与误差累积的问题。

title_en: InfiMed-ORBIT: Aligning LLMs on Open-Ended Complex Tasks via Rubric-Based Incremental Training
title_zh: InfiMed-ORBIT: Aligning LLMs on Open-Ended Complex Tasks via Rubric-Based Incremental Training
summary_en: Aligns medical LLMs on open-ended tasks with rubric-based incremental RL, part of her InfiMed medical model line.
summary_zh: 用基于评分细则的增量式强化学习对齐医疗大模型，属于她的 InfiMed 医疗模型系列。

title_en: Model Merging Scaling Laws in Large Language Models
title_zh: Model Merging Scaling Laws in Large Language Models
summary_en: Derives empirical scaling laws for model merging, giving a quantitative rule for the returns of adding more experts.
summary_zh: 给出模型合并的经验缩放律，量化了增加专家模型所带来的收益。

title_en: A Comprehensive FP8 Training Recipe for Reasoning-Enhanced Language Models
title_zh: A Comprehensive FP8 Training Recipe for Reasoning-Enhanced Language Models
summary_en: A full FP8 training recipe for reasoning-oriented LLMs, aimed at cutting training cost.
summary_zh: 面向推理增强型大模型的完整 FP8 训练方案，目标是降低训练成本。

title_en: InfiAgent: Self-Evolving Pyramid Agent Framework for Infinite Scenarios
title_zh: InfiAgent: Self-Evolving Pyramid Agent Framework for Infinite Scenarios

summary_zh: InfiAgent 的早期版本：面向开放场景的自演化金字塔式智能体框架。

title_zh: PTQTP: Post-Training Quantization to Trit-Planes for Large Language Models

summary_zh: 将大模型训练后量化压缩到三值位平面，把比特宽度推向极限。

title_en: InfiGUI-G1: Advancing GUI Grounding with Adaptive Exploration Policy Optimization
title_zh: InfiGUI-G1: Advancing GUI Grounding with Adaptive Exploration Policy Optimization
summary_en: InfiGUI-G1 improves GUI grounding for vision-based computer-use agents via an adaptive exploration policy.
summary_zh: InfiGUI-G1 用自适应探索策略优化提升视觉 GUI 智能体的元素定位能力。

title_en: InfiAlign: A Scalable and Sample-Efficient Framework for Aligning LLMs to Enhance Reasoning Capabilities
title_zh: InfiAlign: A Scalable and Sample-Efficient Framework for Aligning LLMs to Enhance Reasoning Capabilities
summary_en: InfiAlign, a sample-efficient post-training alignment framework for improving LLM reasoning.
summary_zh: InfiAlign：一套样本高效的后训练对齐框架，用于提升大模型推理能力。

title_en: OS Agents: A Survey on MLLM-based Agents for General Computing Devices Use
title_zh: OS Agents: A Survey on MLLM-based Agents for General Computing Devices Use

summary_zh: 她参与合著的多机构综述，系统梳理了基于多模态大模型的操作系统与 GUI 智能体。

summary_zh: 杨红霞警告称，如果未来所有数据都被少数几家公司掌控，将是极其可怕的局面。

title_en: 香港AI专家杨红霞：领域模型几百亿参数就够，内地医院专用模型准确率远超Gemini-3
title_zh: 香港AI专家杨红霞：领域模型几百亿参数就够，内地医院专用模型准确率远超Gemini-3
summary_en: Yang argued domain-specific models need only tens of billions of parameters, citing a hospital-specific model that outperforms Gemini-3 in accuracy on the mainland.
summary_zh: 杨红霞认为领域模型只需几百亿参数即可，并举例称内地一款医院专用模型的准确率超过了Gemini-3。

title_en: 香港AI专家杨红霞谈“AI大力出奇迹”失效原因
title_zh: 香港AI专家杨红霞谈“AI大力出奇迹”失效原因

summary_zh: 杨红霞谈到「AI大力出奇迹」（暴力堆算力）为何正在失效。

title_en: 香港AI专家杨红霞：领域模型几百亿参数就够，内地医院专用模型准确率远超Gemini-3
title_zh: 香港AI专家杨红霞：领域模型几百亿参数就够，内地医院专用模型准确率远超Gemini-3
summary_en: Yang argued domain-specific models don't need huge parameter counts, citing a mainland hospital model that outperforms Gemini-3 in accuracy on medical tasks.
summary_zh: 杨红霞表示垂直领域模型无需庞大参数量即可胜任，并举例内地一家医院的专用模型在准确率上已超过Gemini-3。

title_zh: 杨红霞：领域模型只需几百亿参数，130亿参数鼻咽癌模型准确率超95% 远超Gemini-3
summary_en: Yang said a domain-specific model with only about 13B parameters beat Gemini-3 on nasopharyngeal-cancer diagnosis accuracy (over 95%), arguing domain models don't need hundreds of billions of parameters.
summary_zh: 杨红霞表示，仅130亿参数的领域模型在鼻咽癌诊断准确率上超过95%，超过Gemini-3，说明领域模型并不需要千亿级参数规模。

title_en: 杨红霞教授：大模型将从中心化走向去中心化，领域模型可超越全球最强通用模型
title_zh: 杨红霞教授：大模型将从中心化走向去中心化，领域模型可超越全球最强通用模型
summary_en: She publicly argued that large models will shift from centralized to decentralized and that domain-specific models can outperform the strongest general models — the thesis behind her PolyU and InfiX work.
summary_zh: 她公开提出大模型将从中心化走向去中心化、领域模型可以超越最强通用模型，这也是她在理大及 InfiX 系列工作的核心主张。

title_zh: Seven years ago, Muyang started working on this problem before it was popular. Zhekai and Yujun have been building alongside him ever since, and together with J
