title_en: Transcribe, Translate, or Transliterate: An Investigation of Intermediate Representations in Spoken Language Models
title_zh: Transcribe, Translate, or Transliterate: An Investigation of Intermediate Representations in Spoken Language Models
summary_en: Co-authored analysis of what intermediate representations the modality adapters in spoken language models actually produce.
summary_zh: 合著论文分析了语音大模型中的模态适配器究竟生成了怎样的中间表示。

title_en: Verbalized Sampling: How to Mitigate Mode Collapse and Unlock LLM Diversity
title_zh: Verbalized Sampling: How to Mitigate Mode Collapse and Unlock LLM Diversity
summary_en: Co-authored paper tracing LLM mode collapse to the training data itself and proposing verbalized sampling as a prompting fix that restores output diversity.
summary_zh: 合著论文将大模型的模式坍缩归因于训练数据本身，并提出“口语化采样”提示方法来恢复输出多样性。

title_en: Thoughtbubbles: an Unsupervised Method for Parallel Thinking in Latent Space
title_zh: Thoughtbubbles: an Unsupervised Method for Parallel Thinking in Latent Space
summary_en: Co-authored method that lets transformers learn to think in parallel in latent space without explicit chain-of-thought supervision.
summary_zh: 合著论文提出一种无监督方法，让 Transformer 在潜空间中并行“思考”，无需显式的思维链监督。

title_en: DistillKac: Few-Step Image Generation via Damped Wave Equations
title_zh: DistillKac: Few-Step Image Generation via Damped Wave Equations
summary_en: Co-authored few-step image generator built on the damped wave equation and its stochastic Kac representation, moving probability mass at finite speed rather than by diffusion.
summary_zh: 合著论文提出 DistillKac：基于阻尼波动方程及其 Kac 随机表示的少步图像生成模型，以有限速度而非扩散方式转移概率质量。

title_en: WebDS: An End-to-End Benchmark for Web-based Data Science
title_zh: WebDS: An End-to-End Benchmark for Web-based Data Science
summary_en: Co-authored end-to-end benchmark for agents that must find, combine and summarise real data from the live web.
summary_zh: 合著论文提出 WebDS：面向智能体在真实网络环境中查找、整合并总结数据的端到端基准。

title_en: A New Pair of GloVes
title_zh: A New Pair of GloVes
summary_en: Manning documents and evaluates new 2024 English GloVe models, a direct update to the word vectors he co-created in 2014.
summary_zh: 曼宁记录并评估了 2024 年新版英文 GloVe 模型，是对他 2014 年参与创建的词向量的直接更新。

title_en: Mechanisms vs. Outcomes: Probing for Syntax Fails to Explain Performance on Targeted Syntactic Evaluations
title_zh: Mechanisms vs. Outcomes: Probing for Syntax Fails to Explain Performance on Targeted Syntactic Evaluations
summary_en: Co-authored paper showing that syntactic probing accuracy does not explain how language models actually perform on targeted syntactic evaluations.
summary_zh: 合著论文表明，句法探针的准确率并不能解释语言模型在定向句法评测上的实际表现。

title_en: Stronger Baselines for Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Long-Context Language Models
title_zh: Stronger Baselines for Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Long-Context Language Models
summary_en: Co-authored study asking whether multi-stage RAG pipelines still pay off now that language models can read tens of thousands of tokens at once.
summary_zh: 合著论文探讨在语言模型已能一次读取数万 token 的情况下，多阶段 RAG 流水线是否仍有价值。

title_en: Drop Dropout on Single-Epoch Language Model Pretraining
title_zh: Drop Dropout on Single-Epoch Language Model Pretraining
summary_en: Co-authored study finding that dropout hurts rather than helps in single-epoch language model pretraining.
summary_zh: 合著论文发现，在单轮预训练的语言模型中，dropout 起到的是负作用。

title_en: Improved Representation Steering for Language Models
title_zh: Improved Representation Steering for Language Models
summary_en: Co-authored work improving representation-level steering for finer-grained, more interpretable control of language model behaviour.
summary_zh: 合著论文改进了表示层面的引导方法，以更细粒度、更可解释地控制语言模型的行为。

title_en: Tversky Neural Networks: Psychologically Plausible Deep Learning with Differentiable Tversky Similarity
title_zh: Tversky Neural Networks: Psychologically Plausible Deep Learning with Differentiable Tversky Similarity
summary_en: Co-authored paper replacing the geometric similarity standard in deep learning with a differentiable version of Tversky's psychologically grounded similarity.
summary_zh: 合著论文用可微分的 Tversky 相似度取代深度学习中常规的几何相似度，使其更贴近人类的相似性判断。

title_en: Do Language Models Use Their Depth Efficiently?
title_zh: Do Language Models Use Their Depth Efficiently?
summary_en: Co-authored analysis finding that deep language models do not compose features in their later layers as efficiently as their depth would suggest.
summary_zh: 合著论文分析发现，深层语言模型并未如其深度所暗示的那样，在后段层中高效地组合特征。

title_en: Osiris: A Lightweight Open-Source Hallucination Detection System
title_zh: Osiris: A Lightweight Open-Source Hallucination Detection System
summary_en: A three-author paper releasing Osiris, a lightweight open-source system for detecting hallucinations in retrieval-augmented generation.
summary_zh: 三人合著论文发布 Osiris：一个用于检测检索增强生成中幻觉的轻量级开源系统。

title_en: A Reasoning-Focused Legal Retrieval Benchmark
title_zh: A Reasoning-Focused Legal Retrieval Benchmark
summary_en: Co-authored benchmark testing whether legal retrieval systems can find authority that requires reasoning rather than keyword overlap.
summary_zh: 合著论文提出一个法律检索基准，考察检索系统能否找到需要推理而非关键词匹配才能命中的法律依据。

title_en: Synthetic Data Generation & Multi-Step RL for Reasoning & Tool Use
title_zh: Synthetic Data Generation & Multi-Step RL for Reasoning & Tool Use
summary_en: Co-authored work with Anna Goldie and Azalia Mirhoseini treating reinforcement learning for reasoning and tool use as a multi-step rather than single-step problem.
summary_zh: 他与 Anna Goldie、Azalia Mirhoseini 合著，把面向推理与工具使用的强化学习视为多步问题而非单步问题。

title_en: AI for Scaling Legal Reform: Mapping and Redacting Racial Covenants in Santa Clara County
title_zh: AI for Scaling Legal Reform: Mapping and Redacting Racial Covenants in Santa Clara County
summary_en: Co-authored applied project using AI to map and redact racially restrictive covenants across Santa Clara County property records.
summary_zh: 合著的应用研究，利用人工智能在圣克拉拉县的房产档案中定位并涂除带种族限制的地契条款。

title_en: AxBench: Steering LLMs? Even Simple Baselines Outperform Sparse Autoencoders
title_zh: AxBench: Steering LLMs? Even Simple Baselines Outperform Sparse Autoencoders
summary_en: Co-authored benchmark finding that simple prompting and finetuning baselines outperform sparse autoencoders at steering model outputs.
summary_zh: 合著论文提出 AxBench，发现简单的提示与微调基线在引导模型输出上优于稀疏自编码器。

title_en: Sneaking Syntax into Transformer Language Models with Tree Regularization
title_zh: Sneaking Syntax into Transformer Language Models with Tree Regularization
summary_en: Co-authored method that gives transformer language models a hierarchical syntax bias through regularization rather than architectural change.
summary_zh: 合著论文提出通过正则化而非改动架构，为 Transformer 语言模型注入层次化句法结构偏置。

title_en: MrT5: Dynamic Token Merging for Efficient Byte-level Language Models
title_zh: MrT5: Dynamic Token Merging for Efficient Byte-level Language Models
summary_en: Co-authored byte-level model that dynamically merges tokens, cutting the cost of tokenizer-free language modelling.
summary_zh: 合著论文提出 MrT5：字节级模型通过动态合并 token，降低无分词器语言建模的开销。

title_en: AuroraCap: Efficient, Performant Video Detailed Captioning and a New Benchmark
title_zh: AuroraCap: Efficient, Performant Video Detailed Captioning and a New Benchmark
summary_en: Co-authored video captioning model and benchmark for generating detailed, coherent descriptions of video content.
summary_zh: 合著论文提出 AuroraCap 视频详细描述模型及配套评测基准，用于生成连贯细致的视频描述。

source: The TWIML AI Podcast (formerly This We…

title_zh: Language Understanding and LLMs with Christopher Manning

title_en: S1 E11 Christopher Manning (Professor, Stanford University; Director, Stanford AI Lab; Assistant Director, Stanford HAI) - Shaping Language Understanding with LLMs
title_zh: S1 E11 Christopher Manning (Professor, Stanford University; Director, Stanford AI Lab; Assistant Director, Stanford HAI) - Shaping Language Understanding with LLMs
summary_en: Interview episode in which Manning discusses where LLM progress is heading over the next five years.
summary_zh: 访谈节目，曼宁谈他对未来五年大模型发展方向的判断。

title_en: Christopher Manning: Linguistics and the Development of NLP
title_zh: Christopher Manning: Linguistics and the Development of NLP
summary_en: Gradient Podcast interview in which Manning traces how linguistics shaped the development of NLP.
summary_zh: 《The Gradient》播客访谈，曼宁梳理语言学如何塑造了自然语言处理的发展。

title_en: Steps down as Director of the Stanford AI Lab
title_zh: 卸任斯坦福 AI 实验室主任
summary_en: Directed SAIL 2018–2025 through the field's period of enormous growth; Carlos Guestrin named as the new Director. Manning on leave from 1 October 2025 to 30 June 2026.
summary_zh: 2018–2025 年在该领域高速增长期主持 SAIL；Carlos Guestrin 接任主任。Manning 于 2025-10-01 至 2026-06-30 休假。

title_en: Christopher Manning Joins BranchLab Scientific Advisory Board
title_zh: Christopher Manning Joins BranchLab Scientific Advisory Board
summary_en: Manning joined BranchLab's Scientific Advisory Board, lending his machine-learning and NLP expertise to the company.
summary_zh: Manning加入了BranchLab科学顾问委员会，为该公司提供机器学习与自然语言处理方面的专业指导。

title_en: Leaving to cook up something new
title_zh: 离开去捣鼓点新东西
summary_en: 'I have a bet for what's next' — the stated direction is teaching AI systems brand-new capabilities.
summary_zh: 「我对下一步有一个赌注」—— 公开表述的方向是教 AI 系统全新的能力。

title_en: ACT-1: transformer for actions
title_zh: ACT-1：面向动作的 Transformer
summary_en: The first credible demonstration of an agent driving real software.
summary_zh: 首个可信的、智能体操作真实软件的演示。

title_en: Chain of Thought Monitorability: A New and Fragile Opportunity for AI Safety
title_zh: Chain of Thought Monitorability: A New and Fragile Opportunity for AI Safety
summary_en: Cross-lab position paper arguing that chain-of-thought monitorability is a real but fragile safety property worth preserving; Luan is among the authors.
summary_zh: 跨实验室联合立场论文，主张思维链可监控性是真实但脆弱、值得刻意保留的安全特性；Luan 位列作者之一。

title_en: Ep 55: Head of Amazon AGI Lab David Luan on DeepSeek’s Significance, What’s Next for Agents & Lessons from OpenAI
title_zh: Ep 55: Head of Amazon AGI Lab David Luan on DeepSeek’s Significance, What’s Next for Agents & Lessons from OpenAI
summary_en: Interview as head of Amazon's AGI Lab on what DeepSeek meant, where agents go next, and what he took from OpenAI.
summary_zh: 作为亚马逊 AGI 实验室负责人接受访谈，谈 DeepSeek 的意义、智能体的下一步，以及他从 OpenAI 带走的经验。

title_en: Product-Led AI: Adept CEO David Luan on Upleveling Human Work
title_zh: Product-Led AI: Adept CEO David Luan on Upleveling Human Work
summary_en: David Luan, then Adept's co-founder and CEO, discusses his thesis that AI agents should operate software directly, and how that reshapes human work, on Greylock's Product-Led AI podcast.
summary_zh: David Luan（时任Adept联合创始人兼CEO）在Greylock的Product-Led AI播客中，阐述其「让AI智能体直接操作软件」的理念，以及这将如何重塑人类的工作方式。

title_en: Why Google failed to make GPT-3 + why Multimodal Agents are the path to AGI — with David Luan of Adept
title_zh: Why Google failed to make GPT-3 + why Multimodal Agents are the path to AGI — with David Luan of Adept
summary_en: Latent Space interview on why Google never shipped GPT-3 and why he believes multimodal agents are the route to AGI.
summary_zh: Latent Space 访谈，谈谷歌为何始终没有做出 GPT-3，以及他为何认为多模态智能体是通向 AGI 的路径。

title_en: Exploring AI's Pace of Evolution, AGI's Future, and Data Dominance with Adept CEO David Luan | E1855
title_zh: Exploring AI's Pace of Evolution, AGI's Future, and Data Dominance with Adept CEO David Luan | E1855
summary_en: Long-form This Week in Startups interview in which Luan, then CEO of Adept, sets out his view of AI's pace of progress, the path to AGI, and why access to data decides who wins.
summary_zh: 在 This Week in Startups 的长篇访谈中，时任 Adept CEO 的 Luan 阐述了他对 AI 进展速度、通往 AGI 的路径，以及数据获取为何决定胜负的看法。

title_en: Adept CEO David Luan and Stanford's Percy Liang | Words into Action
title_zh: Adept CEO David Luan and Stanford's Percy Liang | Words into Action
summary_en: Greylock conversation with Percy Liang on turning language models into agents that operate real software.
summary_zh: Greylock 主持的对谈，与 Percy Liang 讨论如何把语言模型变成能操作真实软件的智能体。

title_en: Words into Action | Progress from Large Language Models to AGI
title_zh: Words into Action | Progress from Large Language Models to AGI
summary_en: David Luan, co-founder of Adept, joins Greylock's Saam Motamedi and Percy Liang to discuss the path from large language models toward AGI.
summary_zh: Adept联合创始人David Luan与Greylock的Saam Motamedi及Percy Liang对谈，探讨从大语言模型迈向通用人工智能（AGI）的路径。

title_en: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways
title_zh: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways
summary_en: Google's 540B-parameter PaLM model, trained with Pathways; Luan is a listed author, from his Google Brain period.
summary_zh: 谷歌用 Pathways 训练的 5400 亿参数 PaLM 模型论文；Luan 位列作者，属于其 Google Brain 时期的工作。

title_en: Show Your Work: Scratchpads for Intermediate Computation with Language Models
title_zh: Show Your Work: Scratchpads for Intermediate Computation with Language Models
summary_en: Shows that letting a model write intermediate steps to a scratchpad markedly improves multi-step computation — an early chain-of-thought result.
summary_zh: 表明让模型把中间步骤写入"草稿纸"能显著改善多步计算，是思维链方向的早期成果。

title_en: Generative Pretraining From Pixels
title_zh: Generative Pretraining From Pixels
summary_en: Co-authored OpenAI's Image GPT paper, showing a GPT-style transformer trained on pixels learns strong image representations, from his time as VP of Engineering at OpenAI.
summary_zh: 在担任OpenAI工程副总裁期间合著的Image GPT论文,展示了基于像素训练的GPT式Transformer可学习到强大的图像表征。

title_en: Leaves Amazon 'to cook up something new'
title_zh: 离开亚马逊，去「捣鼓点新东西」
summary_en: Announced on LinkedIn; says he has 'a bet for what's next' and will focus on teaching AI systems brand-new capabilities. Amazon's San Francisco AGI Lab was shut down after his exit.
summary_zh: 在 LinkedIn 宣布，称对「下一步有一个赌注」，将专注于教 AI 系统全新能力。其离职后亚马逊旧金山 AGI Lab 关闭。

title_zh: Who is David Luan — Amazon’s AI Lab lead who joined after startup Adept was acquired by retail giant, is now leaving?

title_zh: Amazon’s AGI lab head David Luan leaving company, CNBC reports

title_zh: When doing large scale software engineering using LLM, which is better, @OpenAI Codex5.3 or @AnthropicAI Opus4.6? Check out a fair comparison at https://t.co/kR

title_zh: https://t.co/QrWwA35t76 - Performance of Step1X-Edit approaches that of GPT4o and Gemini Flash - Consistency of Step1X-Edit is impressive

summary_zh: 沈向洋指出Step1X-Edit的图像编辑效果已接近GPT-4o和Gemini Flash，并称赞其一致性令人印象深刻。

title_en: 沈向洋：中国备案行业大模型数量占比约70%，未来数量将更多
title_zh: 沈向洋：中国备案行业大模型数量占比约70%，未来数量将更多
summary_en: He states that roughly 70% of China's registered industry-specific large models are officially filed with regulators, and expects the number to keep growing.
summary_zh: 他表示中国已备案的行业大模型数量占比约70%，并预计这一数字未来还将继续增长。

title_en: Too many objects, so little time: Open set object detection work by my colleagues and students 10 FPS (640x640) on NVIDIA Orin NX
title_zh: Too many objects, so little time: Open set object detection work by my colleagues and students 10 FPS (640x640) on NVIDIA Orin NX
summary_en: Shum highlighted open-set object detection work from his colleagues and students running at 10 FPS on an NVIDIA Orin NX.
summary_zh: 沈向洋介绍了其同事与学生的开放集目标检测研究成果，可在NVIDIA Orin NX上实现10 FPS的运行速度。

title_en: Check out Grounded-Segment-Anything by my students and colleagues: automatically Detect, Segment and Generate anything with image and text Inputs. Edge segmenta
title_zh: Check out Grounded-Segment-Anything by my students and colleagues: automatically Detect, Segment and Generate anything with image and text Inputs. Edge segmenta
summary_en: Shum promoted Grounded-Segment-Anything, a project from his students and colleagues combining detection, segmentation and text-driven generation.
summary_zh: 沈向洋推介了其学生与同事的Grounded-Segment-Anything项目，可结合检测、分割与文本驱动生成。

title_en: Creating Virtual AI Beings
title_zh: Creating Virtual AI Beings
summary_en: Shum co-authored a paper on building virtual AI beings, drawing on his computer vision and graphics background.
summary_zh: 沈向洋合著了一篇关于打造虚拟AI角色的论文，延续了他在计算机视觉与图形学领域的研究。

title_en: Data-Driven Learning for Data Rights, Data Pricing, and Privacy Computing
title_zh: Data-Driven Learning for Data Rights, Data Pricing, and Privacy Computing
summary_en: Shum co-authored a paper on data-driven approaches to data rights, pricing and privacy-preserving computation.
summary_zh: 沈向洋合著了一篇论文，探讨数据确权、数据定价与隐私计算的数据驱动方法。

title_zh: We are now at a much better place than people like Wiener and Shannon seventy years ago when it comes to uncovering, understanding, and even exploiting Intellig

summary_zh: 沈向洋认为，相比七十年前的维纳和香农，如今我们在揭示、理解乃至运用智能方面已处于更有利的位置。

title_en: Construction of panoramic mosaics with global and local alignment
title_zh: Construction of panoramic mosaics with global and local alignment

summary_zh: 沈向洋讲述了自己与罗切斯特理工学院聋人教授通过技术进行中文实时对话的经历，展现了无障碍语音技术的实际应用。

title_zh: Excited about InterpretML - a great open-source resource for developers to experiment with intelligible #AI! https://t.co/tqUG1qE6TO

title_en: The Design and Implementation of XiaoIce, an Empathetic Social Chatbot
title_zh: The Design and Implementation of XiaoIce, an Empathetic Social Chatbot

summary_zh: 微软小冰的系统论文，由他以执行副总裁身份主导该项目期间合著，阐述了小冰背后的移情计算设计。

title_en: From Search to Research

summary_en: Launches Nova Reel 1.1 in Amazon Bedrock, enabling multi-shot videos up to two minutes long from a single prompt or shot-by-shot direction.
summary_zh: 在亚马逊Bedrock中推出Nova Reel 1.1,可通过单一提示词或逐镜头指导生成长达两分钟的多镜头视频。

title_en: Big news: we've made #AmazonNova available through https://t.co/a4nvVJXKqJ, a new website to explore our foundation models. Plus, developers can download the al
title_zh: Big news: we've made #AmazonNova available through https://t.co/a4nvVJXKqJ, a new website to explore our foundation models. Plus, developers can download the al
summary_en: Announces Amazon Nova foundation models are now available through a dedicated website, alongside the new Nova Act SDK research preview.
summary_zh: 宣布亚马逊Nova基础模型现已通过专属网站开放,并同步推出Nova Act SDK研究预览版。

title_en: The Amazon Nova Family of Models: Technical Report and Model Card
title_zh: The Amazon Nova Family of Models: Technical Report and Model Card
summary_en: The technical report and model card for the Amazon Nova foundation models, published under the collective byline of the Amazon AGI organisation he led as head scientist.
summary_zh: 亚马逊 Nova 基础模型的技术报告与模型卡，由他担任首席科学家所领导的 Amazon AGI 团队以集体署名发表。

title_en: Rohit Prasad: Amazon Alexa and Conversational AI
title_zh: Rohit Prasad: Amazon Alexa and Conversational AI
summary_en: A long-form interview on the Lex Fridman Podcast in which he explains how Alexa was built and where conversational AI was heading, recorded while he was head scientist of Alexa.
summary_zh: 他在 Lex Fridman 播客中的长篇访谈，讲述 Alexa 的构建过程以及对话式人工智能的发展方向，录制时他任 Alexa 首席科学家。

title_en: Advancing the State of the Art in Open Domain Dialog Systems through the Alexa Prize
title_zh: Advancing the State of the Art in Open Domain Dialog Systems through the Alexa Prize
summary_en: A paper he co-authored reporting what the second Alexa Prize competition taught Amazon about building open-domain dialog systems that keep users talking.
summary_zh: 他参与合著的论文，总结第二届 Alexa Prize 竞赛让亚马逊学到的经验：如何构建能让用户持续对话的开放域对话系统。

title_en: On Evaluating and Comparing Open Domain Dialog Systems
title_zh: On Evaluating and Comparing Open Domain Dialog Systems
summary_en: A paper he co-authored proposing how to evaluate and compare open-domain dialog systems, a measurement problem the Alexa Prize forced his team to solve.
summary_zh: 他参与合著的论文，提出评估与比较开放域对话系统的方法——这正是 Alexa Prize 迫使其团队解决的度量难题。

title_en: Conversational AI: The Science Behind the Alexa Prize
title_zh: Conversational AI: The Science Behind the Alexa Prize
summary_en: The paper laying out the science behind the Alexa Prize, with him as second author alongside Ashwin Ram, describing the competition Amazon ran to advance conversational AI.
summary_zh: 阐述 Alexa Prize 背后科学原理的论文，他与 Ashwin Ram 并列为前两位作者，介绍亚马逊为推动对话式人工智能而举办的这项竞赛。

title_en: ALX306: State of the Union: Amazon Alexa and Recent Advances in Conversational AI
title_zh: ALX306: State of the Union: Amazon Alexa and Recent Advances in Conversational AI
summary_en: Prasad delivers Alexa's State of the Union at AWS re:Invent, covering recent advances in conversational AI.
summary_zh: Prasad在AWS re:Invent大会上发表Alexa年度状态报告，介绍对话式AI的最新进展。

title_en: Amazon announces his departure in a leadership shake-up
title_zh: 亚马逊在领导层调整中宣布其离职
summary_en: SVP Peter DeSantis consolidated the company's AGI work under his own leadership.
summary_zh: 高级副总裁 Peter DeSantis 将公司 AGI 工作整合至自己麾下。

title_en: Rohit Prasad reflected on leaving Amazon after 12 years | ETIH EdTech News
title_zh: Rohit Prasad reflected on leaving Amazon after 12 years | ETIH EdTech News
summary_en: Prasad speaks publicly about leaving Amazon after 12 years, confirming his exit from the AGI organisation he led.
summary_zh: 普拉萨德公开谈及在亚马逊工作 12 年后离职，确认已离开他主导的 AGI 部门。
